sections.label: Invocation
sections.name: श्रीगुरु चरन सरोज रज निज मनु मुकुरु सुधारि

verses.sa:
यस्याङ्के च विभाति भूधरसुता देवापगा मस्तके ।
भाले बालविधुर्गले च गरलं यस्योरसि व्यालराट् ।
सोऽयं भूतिविभूषणः सुरवरः सर्वाधिपः सर्वदा ।
शर्वः सर्वगतः शिवः शशिनिभः श्रीशङ्करः पातु माम् ॥
verses.tr:
yasyāṅke ca vibhāti bhūdharasutā devāpagā mastake
bhāle bālavidhurgale ca garalaṃ yasyorasi vyālarāṭ
so'yaṃ bhūtivibhūṣaṇaḥ suravaraḥ sarvādhipaḥ sarvadā
śarvaḥ sarvagataḥ śivaḥ śaśinibhaḥ śrīśaṅkaraḥ pātu mām
verses.head: श्लोक

verses.sa:
प्रसन्नतां या न गताभिषेकतस्तथा न मम्ले वनवासदुःखतः ।
मुखाम्बुजश्री रघुनन्दनस्य मे सदास्तु सा मञ्जुलमंगलप्रदा ॥
verses.tr:
prasannatāṃ yā na gatābhiṣekatastathā na mamle vanavāsaduḥkhataḥ
mukhāmbujaśrī raghunandanasya me sadāstu sā mañjulamaṃgalapradā

verses.sa:
नीलाम्बुजश्यामलकोमलाङ्गं सीतासमारोपितवामभागम् ।
पाणौ महासायकचारुचापं नमामि रामं रघुवंशनाथम् ॥
verses.tr:
nīlāmbujaśyāmalakomalāṅgaṃ sītāsamāropitavāmabhāgam
pāṇau mahāsāyakacārucāpaṃ namāmi rāmaṃ raghuvaṃśanātham

verses.sa:
श्रीगुरु चरन सरोज रज निज मनु मुकुरु सुधारि ।
बरनउँ रघुबर बिमल जसु जो दायकु फल चारि ॥
verses.tr:
śrīguru caran saroj raj nij manu mukuru sudhāri
baranaum̐ raghubar bimal jasu jo dāyaku phal cāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: May he on whose left side shines resplendent the daughter of the mountain-king; on whose head in the river of the gods; on whose brow the crescent moon; on whose throat the poison-staio; on whose breast a huge snake; whose adornments are streaks of ashes; the chief of divinities; the eternal lord of all; the complete, the omnipresent, the moon-like Siva, the holy Sankara; may he protect me.

May he who neither rejoiced when anointed king, nor was saddened by painful exile in the woods; the holy son of Raghu of the lotus face; may he ever vouchsafe to me success and prosperity. Him I adore, with his body dark and soft as the lotus, with Sita enthroned on his left side, with graceful bow and arrows io hand, even Rama, the lord of the race of Raghu.
Cleansing the mirror of my soul with the sand from the lotus feet of the holy guru, I sing Rama’s spotless fame, the giver of all good things.

sections.label: Doha 1
sections.name: सब कें उर अभिलाषु अस कहहिं मनाइ महेसु

verses.sa:
जब तें रामु ब्याहि घर आए ।
नित नव मंगल मोद बधाए ॥
verses.tr:
jab teṃ rāmu byāhi ghar āe
nit nav maṃgal mod badhāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भुवन चारिदस भूधर भारी ।
सुकृत मेघ बरषहि सुख बारी ॥
verses.tr:
bhuvan cāridas bhūdhar bhārī
sukṛt megh baraṣahi sukh bārī

verses.sa:
रिधि सिधि संपति नदीं सुहाई ।
उमगि अवध अंबुधि कहुँ आई ॥
verses.tr:
ridhi sidhi saṃpati nadīṃ suhāī
umagi avadh aṃbudhi kahum̐ āī

verses.sa:
मनिगन पुर नर नारि सुजाती ।
सुचि अमोल सुंदर सब भाँती ॥
verses.tr:
manigan pur nar nāri sujātī
suci amol suṃdar sab bhām̐tī

verses.sa:
कहि न जाइ कछु नगर बिभूती ।
जनु एतनिअ बिरंचि करतूती ॥
verses.tr:
kahi na jāi kachu nagar bibhūtī
janu etania biraṃci karatūtī

verses.sa:
सब बिधि सब पुर लोग सुखारी ।
रामचंद मुख चंदु निहारी ॥
verses.tr:
sab bidhi sab pur log sukhārī
rāmacaṃd mukh caṃdu nihārī

verses.sa:
मुदित मातु सब सखीं सहेली ।
फलित बिलोकि मनोरथ बेली ॥
verses.tr:
mudit mātu sab sakhīṃ sahelī
phalit biloki manorath belī

verses.sa:
राम रूपु गुनसीलु सुभाऊ ।
प्रमुदित होइ देखि सुनि राऊ ॥
verses.tr:
rām rūpu gunasīlu subhāū
pramudit hoi dekhi suni rāū

verses.sa:
सब कें उर अभिलाषु अस कहहिं मनाइ महेसु ।
आप अछत जुबराज पद रामहि देउ नरेसु ॥
verses.tr:
sab keṃ ur abhilāṣu as kahahiṃ manāi mahesu
āp achat jubarāj pad rāmahi deu naresu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: From the time that Rama returned home with his bride there was a constant succession of joys and delights. The fourteen spheres were like the great mountains, where clouds of virtue fall in showers of happiness; wealth, affluence and prosperity were bounteous rivers, which overflowed into Avadh as into the ocean; while the noble citizens, men and women alike, were its brilliant pearls, all precious and of perfect beauty. The magnificence of the capital was beyond description, it seemed the chief d’ruore of the Creator. Gazing on Raemchandra’s moon-like face, the people were perfectly happy; the queens and all their attendants were enraptured to see their heart’s desire bear fruit; and still more enraptured was the king, as he heard tell and saw for himself Kama’s beauty and accomplishments and amiability.
In every heart was one desire, which they ex pressed ia their prayers to Mahadeva: “‘O that the king in his own lifetime would entrast Rama with the regency.

sections.label: Doha 2
sections.name: यह बिचारु उर आनि नृप सुदिनु सुअवसरु पाइ

verses.sa:
एक समय सब सहित समाजा ।
राजसभाँ रघुराजु बिराजा ॥
verses.tr:
ek samaya sab sahit samājā
rājasabhām̐ raghurāju birājā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सकल सुकृत मूरति नरनाहू ।
राम सुजसु सुनि अतिहि उछाहू ॥
verses.tr:
sakal sukṛt mūrati naranāhū
rām sujasu suni atihi uchāhū

verses.sa:
नृप सब रहहिं कृपा अभिलाषें ।
लोकप करहिं प्रीति रुख राखें ॥
verses.tr:
nṛp sab rahahiṃ kṛpā abhilāṣeṃ
lokap karahiṃ prīti rukh rākheṃ

verses.sa:
तिभुवन तीनि काल जग माहीं ।
भूरि भाग दसरथ सम नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
tibhuvan tīni kāl jag māhīṃ
bhūri bhāg dasarath sam nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
मंगलमूल रामु सुत जासू ।
जो कछु कहिज थोर सबु तासू ॥
verses.tr:
maṃgalamūl rāmu sut jāsū
jo kachu kahij thor sabu tāsū

verses.sa:
रायँ सुभायँ मुकुरु कर लीन्हा ।
बदनु बिलोकि मुकुट सम कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
rāyam̐ subhāyam̐ mukuru kar līnhā
badanu biloki mukuṭ sam kīnhā

verses.sa:
श्रवन समीप भए सित केसा ।
मनहुँ जरठपनु अस उपदेसा ॥
verses.tr:
śravan samīp bhae sit kesā
manahum̐ jaraṭhapanu as upadesā

verses.sa:
नृप जुबराज राम कहुँ देहू ।
जीवन जनम लाहु किन लेहू ॥
verses.tr:
nṛp jubarāj rām kahum̐ dehū
jīvan janam lāhu kin lehū

verses.sa:
यह बिचारु उर आनि नृप सुदिनु सुअवसरु पाइ ।
प्रेम पुलकि तन मुदित मन गुरहि सुनायउ जाइ ॥
verses.tr:
yah bicāru ur āni nṛp sudinu suavasaru pāi
prem pulaki tan mudit man gurahi sunāyau jāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: One day the monarch sat enthroned in court with all his nobles. Himself the incarnation of every virtue, he was delighted beyond measure to hear of Rama’s renown. All kings were solicitous for his patronage, and the very gods desired his friendship. No man so blest as Dasarath in the three spheres of the universe, or in all time—past, present or tocome, Words fail to describe his blessedness, who had for his son Rama, the source of every bliss. The king happened to {take a mirror io his hand, and looking at his face in it set his crown straight. Close to his ear was a white hair like old age whispering:—‘“O kiog, make Rama regent, and thus accomplishment the purpose of your life.”

Having thus considered and settled it in his mind, the king on an auspicious day and at a fitting time, his body quivering with emotion and his soul full of joy, went and declared his purpose to his guru.

sections.label: Doha 3
sections.name: राजन राउर नामु जसु सब अभिमत दातार

verses.sa:
कहइ भुआलु सुनिअ मुनिनायक ।
भए राम सब बिधि सब लायक ॥
verses.tr:
kahai bhuālu sunia munināyak
bhae rām sab bidhi sab lāyak
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सेवक सचिव सकल पुरबासी ।
जे हमारे अरि मित्र उदासी ॥
verses.tr:
sevak saciv sakal purabāsī
je hamāre ari mitr udāsī

verses.sa:
सबहि रामु प्रिय जेहि बिधि मोही ।
प्रभु असीस जनु तनु धरि सोही ॥
verses.tr:
sabahi rāmu priya jehi bidhi mohī
prabhu asīs janu tanu dhari sohī

verses.sa:
बिप्र सहित परिवार गोसाईं ।
करहिं छोहु सब रौरिहि नाई ॥
verses.tr:
bipr sahit parivār gosāīṃ
karahiṃ chohu sab raurihi nāī

verses.sa:
जे गुर चरन रेनु सिर धरहीं ।
ते जनु सकल बिभव बस करहीं ॥
verses.tr:
je gur caran renu sir dharahīṃ
te janu sakal bibhav bas karahīṃ

verses.sa:
मोहि सम यहु अनुभयउ न दूजें ।
सबु पायउँ रज पावनि पूजें ॥
verses.tr:
mohi sam yahu anubhayau na dūjeṃ
sabu pāyaum̐ raj pāvani pūjeṃ

verses.sa:
अब अभिलाषु एकु मन मोरें ।
पूजहि नाथ अनुग्रह तोरें ॥
verses.tr:
ab abhilāṣu eku man moreṃ
pūjahi nāth anugrah toreṃ

verses.sa:
मुनि प्रसन्न लखि सहज सनेहू ।
कहेउ नरेस रजायसु देहू ॥
verses.tr:
muni prasann lakhi sahaj sanehū
kaheu nares rajāyasu dehū

verses.sa:
राजन राउर नामु जसु सब अभिमत दातार ।
फल अनुगामी महिप मनि मन अभिलाषु तुम्हार ॥
verses.tr:
rājan rāur nāmu jasu sab abhimat dātār
phal anugāmī mahip mani man abhilāṣu tumhār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Said the king; Hearken, great saint; Rama is now perfect in every accomplishment. Servants, ministers, the whole body of citizens, whether my enemies or friends or indifferent to me, all hold Rama as dear as even I do, and regard him as a glorious incarnation of my lord's blessing. The Brahmans and their families, reverend sir, have the same love for him as you have. They, who put on their head the dust from the feet of their spiritual father, obtain as it were the mastery over all dominion. There is no man _ my equal; but all that I have flows from the worship of your holy feet. I have now a desire at heart; it can only be accomplished, my lord, by your good favour.” The saint was pleased to witness his sincere devotion and said: “QO king give me your commands.
Your name and glory, sire, provide for every wish; on

sections.label: Doha 4
sections.name: बेगि बिलंबु न करिअ नृप साजिअ सबुइ समाजु

verses.sa:
सब बिधि गुरु प्रसन्न जियँ जानी ।
बोलेउ राउ रहँसि मृदु बानी ॥
verses.tr:
sab bidhi guru prasann jiyam̐ jānī
boleu rāu raham̐si mṛdu bānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नाथ रामु करिअहिं जुबराजू ।
कहिअ कृपा करि करिअ समाजू ॥
verses.tr:
nāth rāmu kariahiṃ jubarājū
kahia kṛpā kari karia samājū

verses.sa:
मोहि अछत यहु होइ उछाहू ।
लहहिं लोग सब लोचन लाहू ॥
verses.tr:
mohi achat yahu hoi uchāhū
lahahiṃ log sab locan lāhū

verses.sa:
प्रभु प्रसाद सिव सबइ निबाहीं ।
यह लालसा एक मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu prasād siv sabai nibāhīṃ
yah lālasā ek man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
पुनि न सोच तनु रहउ कि जाऊ ।
जेहिं न होइ पाछें पछिताऊ ॥
verses.tr:
puni na soc tanu rahau ki jāū
jehiṃ na hoi pācheṃ pachitāū

verses.sa:
सुनि मुनि दसरथ बचन सुहाए ।
मंगल मोद मूल मन भाए ॥
verses.tr:
suni muni dasarath bacan suhāe
maṃgal mod mūl man bhāe

verses.sa:
सुनु नृप जासु बिमुख पछिताहीं ।
जासु भजन बिनु जरनि न जाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sunu nṛp jāsu bimukh pachitāhīṃ
jāsu bhajan binu jarani na jāhīṃ

verses.sa:
भयउ तुम्हार तनय सोइ स्वामी ।
रामु पुनीत प्रेम अनुगामी ॥
verses.tr:
bhayau tumhār tanaya soi svāmī
rāmu punīt prem anugāmī

verses.sa:
बेगि बिलंबु न करिअ नृप साजिअ सबुइ समाजु ।
सुदिन सुमंगलु तबहिं जब रामु होहिं जुबराजु ॥
verses.tr:
begi bilaṃbu na karia nṛp sājia sabui samāju
sudin sumaṃgalu tabahiṃ jab rāmu hohiṃ jubarāju
verses.head: दोहा

trans: every desire of your soul, O jewel of kings, success follows naturally.”

When he saw the guru so amiably disposed, the king replied smilingly in gentle tones: ‘“My lord, invest Rama with regal powers; be pleased tc direct the necessary arrangements to be made. Let this happy event take place in my lifetime, that the eyes of all people may be gladdened by the sight. By my lord's blessing Siva has brought everything happily to pass, but I have still this one desire at heart. It will then be a matter of no concern whether T remain in the body or depart hence, if 1 have nothing on this score whereof, to repent.” When the saint heard Dasarath’s noble words, he experienced the greatest delight: ‘“‘ Hearken, O king; the lord whose averted face all creatures lament, and to whom one must pray for removal of all distress, has been born your son even the holy and compassionate Rama.
Quick, O king, let there be no delay, but at once make all the preparations: happy and auspicious indeed the day when Rama is proclaimed regent.”

sections.label: Doha 5
sections.name: कहेउ भूप मुनिराज कर जोइ जोइ आयसु होइ

verses.sa:
मुदित महिपति मंदिर आए ।
सेवक सचिव सुमंत्रु बोलाए ॥
verses.tr:
mudit mahipati maṃdir āe
sevak saciv sumaṃtru bolāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कहि जयजीव सीस तिन्ह नाए ।
भूप सुमंगल बचन सुनाए ॥
verses.tr:
kahi jayajīv sīs tinh nāe
bhūp sumaṃgal bacan sunāe

verses.sa:
जौं पाँचहि मत लागै नीका ।
करहु हरषि हियँ रामहि टीका ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ pām̐cahi mat lāgai nīkā
karahu haraṣi hiyam̐ rāmahi ṭīkā

verses.sa:
मंत्री मुदित सुनत प्रिय बानी ।
अभिमत बिरवँ परेउ जनु पानी ॥
verses.tr:
maṃtrī mudit sunat priya bānī
abhimat biravam̐ pareu janu pānī

verses.sa:
बिनती सचिव करहि कर जोरी ।
जिअहु जगतपति बरिस करोरी ॥
verses.tr:
binatī saciv karahi kar jorī
jiahu jagatapati baris karorī

verses.sa:
जग मंगल भल काजु बिचारा ।
बेगिअ नाथ न लाइअ बारा ॥
verses.tr:
jag maṃgal bhal kāju bicārā
begia nāth na lāia bārā

verses.sa:
नृपहि मोदु सुनि सचिव सुभाषा ।
बढ़त बौंड़ जनु लही सुसाखा ॥
verses.tr:
nṛpahi modu suni saciv subhāṣā
bar̤hat bauṃr̤ janu lahī susākhā

verses.sa:
कहेउ भूप मुनिराज कर जोइ जोइ आयसु होइ ।
राम राज अभिषेक हित बेगि करहु सोइ सोइ ॥
verses.tr:
kaheu bhūp munirāj kar joi joi āyasu hoi
rām rāj abhiṣek hit begi karahu soi soi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The glad king proceeded to the place and summoned his servant, the minister Sumanta. He bowed the head, crying ‘All hail,’ and the king then declared to him the glad news: ‘To-day tomy great joy the guru has charged me to install Rama as heir to the throne. If the proposal seems good to the council, prepare with gladness to impress the royal mark on Rama’s brow.’ The minister was rejoiced to hear these gracious words, which fell like a shower of rain on the young plant of his desire. With clasped hands he made his petition: “O lord of the world, live for ever; the deed you propose is good and beneficent; haste, my lord, let us have no delay.”” The king was delighted by his minister's assent, like a creeper that spreads apace when it has once clasped a strong bough.
Said the king: ‘“ Whatever orders the saint may give with regard to Rama’s coronation, see that you perform with all speed.”

sections.label: Doha 6
sections.name: ध्वज पताक तोरन कलस सजहु तुरग रथ नाग

verses.sa:
हरषि मुनीस कहेउ मृदु बानी ।
आनहु सकल सुतीरथ पानी ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣi munīs kaheu mṛdu bānī
ānahu sakal sutīrath pānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
औषध मूल फूल फल पाना ।
कहे नाम गनि मंगल नाना ॥
verses.tr:
auṣadh mūl phūl phal pānā
kahe nām gani maṃgal nānā

verses.sa:
चामर चरम बसन बहु भाँती ।
रोम पाट पट अगनित जाती ॥
verses.tr:
cāmar caram basan bahu bhām̐tī
rom pāṭ paṭ aganit jātī

verses.sa:
मनिगन मंगल बस्तु अनेका ।
जो जग जोगु भूप अभिषेका ॥
verses.tr:
manigan maṃgal bastu anekā
jo jag jogu bhūp abhiṣekā

verses.sa:
बेद बिदित कहि सकल बिधाना ।
कहेउ रचहु पुर बिबिध बिताना ॥
verses.tr:
bed bidit kahi sakal bidhānā
kaheu racahu pur bibidh bitānā

verses.sa:
सफल रसाल पूगफल केरा ।
रोपहु बीथिन्ह पुर चहुँ फेरा ॥
verses.tr:
saphal rasāl pūgaphal kerā
ropahu bīthinh pur cahum̐ pherā

verses.sa:
रचहु मंजु मनि चौकें चारू ।
कहहु बनावन बेगि बजारू ॥
verses.tr:
racahu maṃju mani caukeṃ cārū
kahahu banāvan begi bajārū

verses.sa:
पूजहु गनपति गुर कुलदेवा ।
सब बिधि करहु भूमिसुर सेवा ॥
verses.tr:
pūjahu ganapati gur kuladevā
sab bidhi karahu bhūmisur sevā

verses.sa:
ध्वज पताक तोरन कलस सजहु तुरग रथ नाग ।
सिर धरि मुनिबर बचन सबु निज निज काजहिं लाग ॥
verses.tr:
dhvaj patāk toran kalas sajahu turag rath nāg
sir dhari munibar bacan sabu nij nij kājahiṃ lāg
verses.head: दोहा

trans: In gentle accents the glad saint spoke and said: “Bring water from all holy places, and all kinds of herbs, roots, fruits and flowers (enumerating by name every auspicious variety) with chaurtes of different sizes apparel of all sorts, both of wool and silk and every other material, with jewels and all) the auspicious things that there are in the world, that are fit for u king’s installation.” Then after repeating. all the forms prescribed in the Veda, he said: “Erect in the city a number of pavilions, and plant the streets in every quarter with fruit-bearing!' mangoes and trees of betel-nut and plantains, and fashion bright and beautiful jewelled squares, and have all the bazars speedily decorated, and do reverence to Ganes and your guru and your family god, and diligently serve the Brahmans.
Make ready flags and banners and wreaths and vases, horses too, and chariots and elephants.” All were obedient,. to the holy sage’s words and busied themselves each in his own special work.

sections.label: Doha 7
sections.name: एहि अवसर मंगलु परम सुनि रहँसेउ रनिवासु

verses.sa:
जो मुनीस जेहि आयसु दीन्हा ।
सो तेहिं काजु प्रथम जनु कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
jo munīs jehi āyasu dīnhā
so tehiṃ kāju pratham janu kīnhā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बिप्र साधु सुर पूजत राजा ।
करत राम हित मंगल काजा ॥
verses.tr:
bipr sādhu sur pūjat rājā
karat rām hit maṃgal kājā

verses.sa:
सुनत राम अभिषेक सुहावा ।
बाज गहागह अवध बधावा ॥
verses.tr:
sunat rām abhiṣek suhāvā
bāj gahāgah avadh badhāvā

verses.sa:
राम सीय तन सगुन जनाए ।
फरकहिं मंगल अंग सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
rām sīya tan sagun janāe
pharakahiṃ maṃgal aṃg suhāe

verses.sa:
पुलकि सप्रेम परसपर कहहीं ।
भरत आगमनु सूचक अहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
pulaki saprem parasapar kahahīṃ
bharat āgamanu sūcak ahahīṃ

verses.sa:
भए बहुत दिन अति अवसेरी ।
सगुन प्रतीति भेंट प्रिय केरी ॥
verses.tr:
bhae bahut din ati avaserī
sagun pratīti bheṃṭ priya kerī

verses.sa:
भरत सरिस प्रिय को जग माहीं ।
इहइ सगुन फलु दूसर नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bharat saris priya ko jag māhīṃ
ihai sagun phalu dūsar nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
रामहि बंधु सोच दिन राती ।
अंडन्हि कमठ ह्रदउ जेहि भाँती ॥
verses.tr:
rāmahi baṃdhu soc din rātī
aṃḍanhi kamaṭh hradau jehi bhām̐tī

verses.sa:
एहि अवसर मंगलु परम सुनि रहँसेउ रनिवासु ।
सोभत लखि बिधु बढ़त जनु बारिधि बीचि बिलासु ॥
verses.tr:
ehi avasar maṃgalu param suni raham̐seu ranivāsu
sobhat lakhi bidhu bar̤hat janu bāridhi bīci bilāsu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Whatever the order that any one had been given by the saint, that he regarded as the very first thing to be done. The king worships Brahmans, saints and gods, and does everything to promote Rama’s prosperity. Oa hearing the glad news Rama’s installation, all Avadh resounded with songs of jubilee. Good omens declared themselves in the body, both of Rama and Sita by a sudden quiver of the lucky side, and they said affectionately to one another: “This betoken, Bharat’s return. We have greatly missed him for many a long day. This good sign assures us of a friend's approach, and in the whole world there is no friend so dear to us as Bharat: this good omen can have but one meaning” Every day Rama is as lovingly anxious about his brother asa turtle for its eggs in the sand far away.
_ At that time the ladies of the court were as delighted to hear these most glad tidings as the waves of ocean swell with joy on beholding the moon ia its glory.

sections.label: Doha 8
sections.name: राम राज अभिषेकु सुनि हियँ हरषे नर नारि

verses.sa:
प्रथम जाइ जिन्ह बचन सुनाए ।
भूषन बसन भूरि तिन्ह पाए ॥
verses.tr:
pratham jāi jinh bacan sunāe
bhūṣan basan bhūri tinh pāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
प्रेम पुलकि तन मन अनुरागीं ।
मंगल कलस सजन सब लागीं ॥
verses.tr:
prem pulaki tan man anurāgīṃ
maṃgal kalas sajan sab lāgīṃ

verses.sa:
चौकें चारु सुमित्राँ पुरी ।
मनिमय बिबिध भाँति अति रुरी ॥
verses.tr:
caukeṃ cāru sumitrām̐ purī
manimaya bibidh bhām̐ti ati rurī

verses.sa:
आनँद मगन राम महतारी ।
दिए दान बहु बिप्र हँकारी ॥
verses.tr:
ānam̐d magan rām mahatārī
die dān bahu bipr ham̐kārī

verses.sa:
पूजीं ग्रामदेबि सुर नागा ।
कहेउ बहोरि देन बलिभागा ॥
verses.tr:
pūjīṃ grāmadebi sur nāgā
kaheu bahori den balibhāgā

verses.sa:
जेहि बिधि होइ राम कल्यानू ।
देहु दया करि सो बरदानू ॥
verses.tr:
jehi bidhi hoi rām kalyānū
dehu dayā kari so baradānū

verses.sa:
गावहिं मंगल कोकिलबयनीं ।
बिधुबदनीं मृगसावकनयनीं ॥
verses.tr:
gāvahiṃ maṃgal kokilabayanīṃ
bidhubadanīṃ mṛgasāvakanayanīṃ

verses.sa:
राम राज अभिषेकु सुनि हियँ हरषे नर नारि ।
लगे सुमंगल सजन सब बिधि अनुकूल बिचारि ॥
verses.tr:
rām rāj abhiṣeku suni hiyam̐ haraṣe nar nāri
lage sumaṃgal sajan sab bidhi anukūl bicāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: First they took care that those who brought the news

were richly guerdoned with jewels and robes; then with a body all quivering with emotion and soul full of love, they proceeded to make all festal preparations. Samitre filled in a lovely square with exquisite gems of every kind; Rama's mother, drowned in joy, sent for u crowd of Brahmans and loaded them with gifts; then worshipped the local divinity and the gods and the serpents, and vowed them future sacrifices, praying; “‘ In your mercy grant me this boon, that Rama prosper.” Auspicious strains are chanted by moonfaced, fawneyed damsels, with voice sweet as that of the oil. Dohe 9,
On hearing of Rama's installation, all good women were glad of heart and began diligently to make, festal preparations, thinking God to be gracious to them. ~

sections.label: Doha 9
sections.name: सुनि सनेह साने बचन मुनि रघुबरहि प्रसंस

verses.sa:
तब नरनाहँ बसिष्ठु बोलाए ।
रामधाम सिख देन पठाए ॥
verses.tr:
tab naranāham̐ basiṣṭhu bolāe
rāmadhām sikh den paṭhāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
गुर आगमनु सुनत रघुनाथा ।
द्वार आइ पद नायउ माथा ॥
verses.tr:
gur āgamanu sunat raghunāthā
dvār āi pad nāyau māthā

verses.sa:
सादर अरघ देइ घर आने ।
सोरह भाँति पूजि सनमाने ॥
verses.tr:
sādar aragh dei ghar āne
sorah bhām̐ti pūji sanamāne

verses.sa:
गहे चरन सिय सहित बहोरी ।
बोले रामु कमल कर जोरी ॥
verses.tr:
gahe caran siya sahit bahorī
bole rāmu kamal kar jorī

verses.sa:
सेवक सदन स्वामि आगमनू ।
मंगल मूल अमंगल दमनू ॥
verses.tr:
sevak sadan svāmi āgamanū
maṃgal mūl amaṃgal damanū

verses.sa:
तदपि उचित जनु बोलि सप्रीती ।
पठइअ काज नाथ असि नीती ॥
verses.tr:
tadapi ucit janu boli saprītī
paṭhaia kāj nāth asi nītī

verses.sa:
प्रभुता तजि प्रभु कीन्ह सनेहू ।
भयउ पुनीत आजु यहु गेहू ॥
verses.tr:
prabhutā taji prabhu kīnh sanehū
bhayau punīt āju yahu gehū

verses.sa:
आयसु होइ सो करौं गोसाई ।
सेवक लहइ स्वामि सेवकाई ॥
verses.tr:
āyasu hoi so karauṃ gosāī
sevak lahai svāmi sevakāī

verses.sa:
सुनि सनेह साने बचन मुनि रघुबरहि प्रसंस ।
राम कस न तुम्ह कहहु अस हंस बंस अवतंस ॥
verses.tr:
suni saneh sāne bacan muni raghubarahi prasaṃs
rām kas na tumh kahahu as haṃs baṃs avataṃs
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Then the monarch {summoned Vasishtha and sent him to Rama’s apartments to inform him of the coming event. When Raghunath heard of the guru’s approach, he came to the door and bowed his head at his feet, and after reverently sprinkling lustral water, conducted him in and paid him honour in the sixteen prescribed modes. Then after again with Sita clasping his feet, ama thus spoke his lotus hands folded in prayer: ‘For a lord to visit his servant's house is a source of great joy, a cure for all distress; yet it had been more fitting, sir, and more in accordance with custom, had you kindly sent to say you wanted me. Since my lord has graciously waived his prerogative, my house has to-day become highly blest. Let me know, holy father, what are your orders; it is for a servant to do his master service.:
On hearing these affectionate words the saint extolled Raghubir: “O Rama, glory of the solar race, it is like you to speak thus.” 5

sections.label: Doha 10
sections.name: तेहि अवसर आए लखन मगन प्रेम आनंद

verses.sa:
बरनि राम गुन सीलु सुभाऊ ।
बोले प्रेम पुलकि मुनिराऊ ॥
verses.tr:
barani rām gun sīlu subhāū
bole prem pulaki munirāū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भूप सजेउ अभिषेक समाजू ।
चाहत देन तुम्हहि जुबराजू ॥
verses.tr:
bhūp sajeu abhiṣek samājū
cāhat den tumhahi jubarājū

verses.sa:
राम करहु सब संजम आजू ।
जौं बिधि कुसल निबाहै काजू ॥
verses.tr:
rām karahu sab saṃjam ājū
jauṃ bidhi kusal nibāhai kājū

verses.sa:
गुरु सिख देइ राय पहिं गयउ ।
राम हृदयँ अस बिसमउ भयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
guru sikh dei rāya pahiṃ gayau
rām hṛdayam̐ as bisamau bhayaū

verses.sa:
जनमे एक संग सब भाई ।
भोजन सयन केलि लरिकाई ॥
verses.tr:
janame ek saṃg sab bhāī
bhojan sayan keli larikāī

verses.sa:
करनबेध उपबीत बिआहा ।
संग संग सब भए उछाहा ॥
verses.tr:
karanabedh upabīt biāhā
saṃg saṃg sab bhae uchāhā

verses.sa:
बिमल बंस यहु अनुचित एकू ।
बंधु बिहाइ बड़ेहि अभिषेकू ॥
verses.tr:
bimal baṃs yahu anucit ekū
baṃdhu bihāi bar̤ehi abhiṣekū

verses.sa:
प्रभु सप्रेम पछितानि सुहाई ।
हरउ भगत मन कै कुटिलाई ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu saprem pachitāni suhāī
harau bhagat man kai kuṭilāī

verses.sa:
तेहि अवसर आए लखन मगन प्रेम आनंद ।
सनमाने प्रिय बचन कहि रघुकुल कैरव चंद ॥
verses.tr:
tehi avasar āe lakhan magan prem ānaṃd
sanamāne priya bacan kahi raghukul kairav caṃd
verses.head: दोहा

trans: merely the general idea of completeness.

After eulogizing Rama’s high qualifications and amiable character, the great saint with much emotion explained: “The king has prepared for a royal installation, and wishes to confer upon you the dignity of regent. To-day, Rama, you should devote yourself to practices of devotion, that God may bring the matter to a happy issue.” Having thus admonished him, the guru returned to the king; while Rama's heart was all amazement: ‘“ My brothers and I were all born together, and together have we ate and slept and played in childhood; the piercing of our ears, the investiture with the sacred thread, our marriage, in short all our rejoicings have taken place together. This is the one flaw ia a spotless line that the eldest only should be enthroned without his younger brothers.” These gracious regrets on the part of the lord remove all unworthy suspicion from the mind of his votaries.
Then came Lakshman, full of love and joy, and was welcomed with words of affection by the moon of the lilylike Solar race.:

sections.label: Doha 11
sections.name: बिपति हमारि बिलोकि बड़ि मातु करिअ सोइ आजु

verses.sa:
बाजहिं बाजने बिबिध बिधाना ।
पुर प्रमोदु नहिं जाइ बखाना ॥
verses.tr:
bājahiṃ bājane bibidh bidhānā
pur pramodu nahiṃ jāi bakhānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भरत आगमनु सकल मनावहिं ।
आवहुँ बेगि नयन फलु पावहिं ॥
verses.tr:
bharat āgamanu sakal manāvahiṃ
āvahum̐ begi nayan phalu pāvahiṃ

verses.sa:
हाट बाट घर गलीं अथाई ।
कहहिं परसपर लोग लोगाई ॥
verses.tr:
hāṭ bāṭ ghar galīṃ athāī
kahahiṃ parasapar log logāī

verses.sa:
कालि लगन भलि केतिक बारा ।
पूजिहि बिधि अभिलाषु हमारा ॥
verses.tr:
kāli lagan bhali ketik bārā
pūjihi bidhi abhilāṣu hamārā

verses.sa:
कनक सिंघासन सीय समेता ।
बैठहिं रामु होइ चित चेता ॥
verses.tr:
kanak siṃghāsan sīya sametā
baiṭhahiṃ rāmu hoi cit cetā

verses.sa:
सकल कहहिं कब होइहि काली ।
बिघन मनावहिं देव कुचाली ॥
verses.tr:
sakal kahahiṃ kab hoihi kālī
bighan manāvahiṃ dev kucālī

verses.sa:
तिन्हहि सोहाइ न अवध बधावा ।
चोरहि चंदिनि राति न भावा ॥
verses.tr:
tinhahi sohāi na avadh badhāvā
corahi caṃdini rāti na bhāvā

verses.sa:
सारद बोलि बिनय सुर करहीं ।
बारहिं बार पाय लै परहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sārad boli binaya sur karahīṃ
bārahiṃ bār pāya lai parahīṃ

verses.sa:
बिपति हमारि बिलोकि बड़ि मातु करिअ सोइ आजु ।
रामु जाहिं बन राजु तजि होइ सकल सुरकाजु ॥
verses.tr:
bipati hamāri biloki bar̤i mātu karia soi āju
rāmu jāhiṃ ban rāju taji hoi sakal surakāju
verses.head: दोहा

trans: There was a noise of music of every kind, and the delight of the city was beyond description. All prayed for Bharat’s return, that he might come quickly and like them enjoy the spectacle. In every street and lane and house and market and place of resort, men and women were saying to one another: ‘When will to-morrow come and the auspicious moment in which God will accomplish our desire; when, with Sita by his side, Rama will take his seat on the golden throne and all our wises be gratified.” They were all saying: ‘“ Who will to-morrow come?” But the envious gods prayed that difficulties might arise; the rejoicings at Avadh pleased them as little as a moonlight night pleases a thief. So they humbly called in Serade and again and again threw themselves at her feet:
“O mother, regard our great distress and make haste to relieve it. If Rama refuses the throne and retires into the forest, all will be well with us.”

sections.label: Doha 12
sections.name: नामु मंथरा मंदमति चेरी कैकेइ केरि

verses.sa:
सुनि सुर बिनय ठाढ़ि पछिताती ।
भइउँ सरोज बिपिन हिमराती ॥
verses.tr:
suni sur binaya ṭhār̤hi pachitātī
bhaium̐ saroj bipin himarātī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
देखि देव पुनि कहहिं निहोरी ।
मातु तोहि नहिं थोरिउ खोरी ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi dev puni kahahiṃ nihorī
mātu tohi nahiṃ thoriu khorī

verses.sa:
बिसमय हरष रहित रघुराऊ ।
तुम्ह जानहु सब राम प्रभाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
bisamaya haraṣ rahit raghurāū
tumh jānahu sab rām prabhāū

verses.sa:
जीव करम बस सुख दुख भागी ।
जाइअ अवध देव हित लागी ॥
verses.tr:
jīv karam bas sukh dukh bhāgī
jāia avadh dev hit lāgī

verses.sa:
बार बार गहि चरन सँकोचौ ।
चली बिचारि बिबुध मति पोची ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār gahi caran sam̐kocau
calī bicāri bibudh mati pocī

verses.sa:
ऊँच निवासु नीचि करतूती ।
देखि न सकहिं पराइ बिभूती ॥
verses.tr:
ūm̐c nivāsu nīci karatūtī
dekhi na sakahiṃ parāi bibhūtī

verses.sa:
आगिल काजु बिचारि बहोरी ।
करहहिं चाह कुसल कबि मोरी ॥
verses.tr:
āgil kāju bicāri bahorī
karahahiṃ cāh kusal kabi morī

verses.sa:
हरषि हृदयँ दसरथ पुर आई ।
जनु ग्रह दसा दुसह दुखदाई ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣi hṛdayam̐ dasarath pur āī
janu grah dasā dusah dukhadāī

verses.sa:
नामु मंथरा मंदमति चेरी कैकेइ केरि ।
अजस पेटारी ताहि करि गई गिरा मति फेरि ॥
verses.tr:
nāmu maṃtharā maṃdamati cerī kaikei keri
ajas peṭārī tāhi kari gaī girā mati pheri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: might have been urged by objectors that be had taken an unfai of his brother Bharat’s absence, air advantage

On hearing this prayer of the gods, she stood still thinking sadly: “I am like a winter's night to a bed of lotuses.” The gods seeing her hesitate cried yet once more: “O mother, not the least blame will attach to you; for Raghu-reo—you know his nature well —is exempt from sorrow as from joy; and (a for his people) they, like all other creatures, have their share in pain or pleasure, under the law of necessity: go therefore to Avadh and befriend os gods.” Time after time they clasped her feet, till she yielded and went, though still thinking to herself: ** the gods are meanspirited crew; though they dwell on high, their acts are low; and they cannot endure to see another’s prosperity.’ Again reflecting on the future, that the ublest poets would do her will!, she became cheerful of heart and flew to the city of Dasarath, as it were some intolerably inauspicious aspect of the planets.
Now Kaikeyi had a wicked handmaid, by name Manthara. Her ideas Serade@ first distorted and made her a very storehouse of meanness and then went her way.

sections.label: Doha 13
sections.name: सभय रानि कह कहसि किन कुसल रामु महिपालु

verses.sa:
दीख मंथरा नगरु बनावा ।
मंजुल मंगल बाज बधावा ॥
verses.tr:
dīkh maṃtharā nagaru banāvā
maṃjul maṃgal bāj badhāvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पूछेसि लोगन्ह काह उछाहू ।
राम तिलकु सुनि भा उर दाहू ॥
verses.tr:
pūchesi loganh kāh uchāhū
rām tilaku suni bhā ur dāhū

verses.sa:
करइ बिचारु कुबुद्धि कुजाती ।
होइ अकाजु कवनि बिधि राती ॥
verses.tr:
karai bicāru kubuddhi kujātī
hoi akāju kavani bidhi rātī

verses.sa:
देखि लागि मधु कुटिल किराती ।
जिमि गवँ तकइ लेउँ केहि भाँती ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi lāgi madhu kuṭil kirātī
jimi gavam̐ takai leum̐ kehi bhām̐tī

verses.sa:
भरत मातु पहिं गइ बिलखानी ।
का अनमनि हसि कह हँसि रानी ॥
verses.tr:
bharat mātu pahiṃ gai bilakhānī
kā anamani hasi kah ham̐si rānī

verses.sa:
ऊतरु देइ न लेइ उसासू ।
नारि चरित करि ढारइ आँसू ॥
verses.tr:
ūtaru dei na lei usāsū
nāri carit kari ḍhārai ām̐sū

verses.sa:
हँसि कह रानि गालु बड़ तोरें ।
दीन्ह लखन सिख अस मन मोरें ॥
verses.tr:
ham̐si kah rāni gālu bar̤ toreṃ
dīnh lakhan sikh as man moreṃ

verses.sa:
तबहुँ न बोल चेरि बड़ि पापिनि ।
छाड़इ स्वास कारि जनु साँपिनि ॥
verses.tr:
tabahum̐ na bol ceri bar̤i pāpini
chār̤ai svās kāri janu sām̐pini

verses.sa:
सभय रानि कह कहसि किन कुसल रामु महिपालु ।
लखनु भरतु रिपुदमनु सुनि भा कुबरी उर सालु ॥
verses.tr:
sabhaya rāni kah kahasi kin kusal rāmu mahipālu
lakhanu bharatu ripudamanu suni bhā kubarī ur sālu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When Manthara saw the preparations in the city, the joyous festivities, the music and the singing, she asked the people: “What mean these rejoicings?” Whenshe heard of Rama's inauguration, her soul was afire and she plotted, wicked wretch that she was, how that very night to defeat it; hke a crafty hillwomao, who has spied a honeycomb hanging from a tree and schemes how to get hold of it. So she went crying to Bharat’s mother. “What is wrong now?” the queen smiled and said. She gave no answer, but drew a deep sigh and, like a woman, began shedding a flood of tears. Said the queen laughing: “You were always an impudent girl, and Lakshman, I suspect, has been giving you a lesson.” Still the wicked handmaid said not a word, but breathed hard like some venomous serpent.
Said the queen with a nervous smile: “Is Rama not well, or the king, or Bharat, or Lakshman, or Satrughna?’”’ These words tortured the heart of the hump-backed girl.'. Chaupdi.

sections.label: Doha 14
sections.name: काने खोरे कूबरे कुटिल कुचाली जानि

verses.sa:
कत सिख देइ हमहि कोउ माई ।
गालु करब केहि कर बलु पाई ॥
verses.tr:
kat sikh dei hamahi kou māī
gālu karab kehi kar balu pāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
रामहि छाड़ि कुसल केहि आजू ।
जेहि जनेसु देइ जुबराजू ॥
verses.tr:
rāmahi chār̤i kusal kehi ājū
jehi janesu dei jubarājū

verses.sa:
भयउ कौसिलहि बिधि अति दाहिन ।
देखत गरब रहत उर नाहिन ॥
verses.tr:
bhayau kausilahi bidhi ati dāhin
dekhat garab rahat ur nāhin

verses.sa:
देखेहु कस न जाइ सब सोभा ।
जो अवलोकि मोर मनु छोभा ॥
verses.tr:
dekhehu kas na jāi sab sobhā
jo avaloki mor manu chobhā

verses.sa:
पूतु बिदेस न सोचु तुम्हारें ।
जानति हहु बस नाहु हमारें ॥
verses.tr:
pūtu bides na socu tumhāreṃ
jānati hahu bas nāhu hamāreṃ

verses.sa:
नीद बहुत प्रिय सेज तुराई ।
लखहु न भूप कपट चतुराई ॥
verses.tr:
nīd bahut priya sej turāī
lakhahu na bhūp kapaṭ caturāī

verses.sa:
सुनि प्रिय बचन मलिन मनु जानी ।
झुकी रानि अब रहु अरगानी ॥
verses.tr:
suni priya bacan malin manu jānī
jhukī rāni ab rahu aragānī

verses.sa:
पुनि अस कबहुँ कहसि घरफोरी ।
तब धरि जीभ कढ़ावउँ तोरी ॥
verses.tr:
puni as kabahum̐ kahasi gharaphorī
tab dhari jībh kar̤hāvaum̐ torī

verses.sa:
काने खोरे कूबरे कुटिल कुचाली जानि ।
तिय बिसेषि पुनि चेरि कहि भरतमातु मुसुकानि ॥
verses.tr:
kāne khore kūbare kuṭil kucālī jāni
tiya biseṣi puni ceri kahi bharatamātu musukāni
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “Why, O lady, should any one give me a lesson, and who is there to encourage me in any impudence? With whom again is it well to-day if not with Kama, whom the king is now associating with himself on the throne? God has been very gracious to Kausalya; and after seeing her, who else can have any pride left? Why not go and see all the magnificence, the sight of which has so agitated me? Your son is away and you take no heed, making sure of your influence with the king, and not observing his treachery and wiliness so drowsy are you and so anxious for your bed and pillow.” On hearing this affectionate address, the queen—who knew well her forward mind —cried: * Peace, have done. If you speak to me again in this way, you mischief-maker, I will have your tongue pulled out,”
But remembering that the one-eyed, the lame and the hump-backed are ever vicious and vile, more especially if they be women to boot, and slaves, Bharat’s mother smiled and added:

sections.label: Doha 15
sections.name: भरत सपथ तोहि सत्य कहु परिहरि कपट दुराउ

verses.sa:
प्रियबादिनि सिख दीन्हिउँ तोही ।
सपनेहुँ तो पर कोपु न मोही ॥
verses.tr:
priyabādini sikh dīnhium̐ tohī
sapanehum̐ to par kopu na mohī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुदिनु सुमंगल दायकु सोई ।
तोर कहा फुर जेहि दिन होई ॥
verses.tr:
sudinu sumaṃgal dāyaku soī
tor kahā phur jehi din hoī

verses.sa:
जेठ स्वामि सेवक लघु भाई ।
यह दिनकर कुल रीति सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
jeṭh svāmi sevak laghu bhāī
yah dinakar kul rīti suhāī

verses.sa:
राम तिलकु जौं साँचेहुँ काली ।
देउँ मागु मन भावत आली ॥
verses.tr:
rām tilaku jauṃ sām̐cehum̐ kālī
deum̐ māgu man bhāvat ālī

verses.sa:
कौसल्या सम सब महतारी ।
रामहि सहज सुभायँ पिआरी ॥
verses.tr:
kausalyā sam sab mahatārī
rāmahi sahaj subhāyam̐ piārī

verses.sa:
मो पर करहिं सनेहु बिसेषी ।
मैं करि प्रीति परीछा देखी ॥
verses.tr:
mo par karahiṃ sanehu biseṣī
maiṃ kari prīti parīchā dekhī

verses.sa:
जौं बिधि जनमु देइ करि छोहू ।
होहुँ राम सिय पूत पुतोहू ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ bidhi janamu dei kari chohū
hohum̐ rām siya pūt putohū

verses.sa:
प्रान तें अधिक रामु प्रिय मोरें ।
तिन्ह कें तिलक छोभु कस तोरें ॥
verses.tr:
prān teṃ adhik rāmu priya moreṃ
tinh keṃ tilak chobhu kas toreṃ

verses.sa:
भरत सपथ तोहि सत्य कहु परिहरि कपट दुराउ ।
हरष समय बिसमउ करसि कारन मोहि सुनाउ ॥
verses.tr:
bharat sapath tohi satya kahu parihari kapaṭ durāu
haraṣ samaya bisamau karasi kāran mohi sunāu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “T have only given you kind advice and am not the Jeast bit angry. If what you say is true, it is the best and happiest of days. It has ever been the custom in the Solar race that the eldest-born should be the lord, and the younger brothers his servants. If Rama is really to be crowned to-morrow, ask of me, girl, what you will and I will give it you. There is no difference between Kausalya and the other royal mothers. Rama is equally fond of all: in fact he has a special affection for me, az I have often tested. If I am_ born again, God in his goodness grant that Rama and Sita be again my son and daughter Rama is dearer to me
than life; why then should you be troubled at his being crowned king?,
I adjure you in Bharat’s name, tell me the truth without any fraud or concealment; declare tome the reason why you are in distress at such a time of gladness.” Chaupdi.

sections.label: Doha 16
sections.name: गूढ़ कपट प्रिय बचन सुनि तीय अधरबुधि रानि

verses.sa:
एकहिं बार आस सब पूजी ।
अब कछु कहब जीभ करि दूजी ॥
verses.tr:
ekahiṃ bār ās sab pūjī
ab kachu kahab jībh kari dūjī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
फोरै जोगु कपारु अभागा ।
भलेउ कहत दुख रउरेहि लागा ॥
verses.tr:
phorai jogu kapāru abhāgā
bhaleu kahat dukh raurehi lāgā

verses.sa:
कहहिं झूठि फुरि बात बनाई ।
ते प्रिय तुम्हहि करुइ मैं माई ॥
verses.tr:
kahahiṃ jhūṭhi phuri bāt banāī
te priya tumhahi karui maiṃ māī

verses.sa:
हमहुँ कहबि अब ठकुरसोहाती ।
नाहिं त मौन रहब दिनु राती ॥
verses.tr:
hamahum̐ kahabi ab ṭhakurasohātī
nāhiṃ ta maun rahab dinu rātī

verses.sa:
करि कुरूप बिधि परबस कीन्हा ।
बवा सो लुनिअ लहिअ जो दीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
kari kurūp bidhi parabas kīnhā
bavā so lunia lahia jo dīnhā

verses.sa:
कोउ नृप होउ हमहि का हानी ।
चेरि छाड़ि अब होब कि रानी ॥
verses.tr:
kou nṛp hou hamahi kā hānī
ceri chār̤i ab hob ki rānī

verses.sa:
जारै जोगु सुभाउ हमारा ।
अनभल देखि न जाइ तुम्हारा ॥
verses.tr:
jārai jogu subhāu hamārā
anabhal dekhi na jāi tumhārā

verses.sa:
तातें कछुक बात अनुसारी ।
छमिअ देबि बड़ि चूक हमारी ॥
verses.tr:
tāteṃ kachuk bāt anusārī
chamia debi bar̤i cūk hamārī

verses.sa:
गूढ़ कपट प्रिय बचन सुनि तीय अधरबुधि रानि ।
सुरमाया बस बैरिनिहि सुह्द जानि पतिआनि ॥
verses.tr:
gūr̤h kapaṭ priya bacan suni tīya adharabudhi rāni
suramāyā bas bairinihi suhd jāni patiāni
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “IT have been satisfied once already; have I a second tongue that I should speak again I deserve tohave my head broken on the funeral pile, wretch that I am, since I pain you by my well-meant words. Those who make the false appear true are the people who please you, my lady; while I offend you. Henceforth I too will speak only as my mistress pleases, or else will remain silent day and night. God has given me a deformed body and made me a slave: we must all reap as we have sown and take as we have given. Whoever is king, what do I lose Shall I cease to be aservant and become a queen It is only my worthless character that I cannot bear to see your disgrace, and hence I gave utterance to a word or two; but pardon me, mistress, it was a great fault oo my part.
On hearing these affectionate words, so deep and crafty, the queen, being only a weak-minded woman and under the influence of a divine delusion, really believed her enemy to be a friend.

sections.label: Doha 17
sections.name: तुम्हहि न सोचु सोहाग बल निज बस जानहु राउ

verses.sa:
सादर पुनि पुनि पूँछति ओही ।
सबरी गान मृगी जनु मोही ॥
verses.tr:
sādar puni puni pūm̐chati ohī
sabarī gān mṛgī janu mohī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तसि मति फिरी अहइ जसि भाबी ।
रहसी चेरि घात जनु फाबी ॥
verses.tr:
tasi mati phirī ahai jasi bhābī
rahasī ceri ghāt janu phābī

verses.sa:
तुम्ह पूँछहु मैं कहत डेराऊँ ।
धरेउ मोर घरफोरी नाऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
tumh pūm̐chahu maiṃ kahat ḍerāūm̐
dhareu mor gharaphorī nāūm̐

verses.sa:
सजि प्रतीति बहुबिधि गढ़ि छोली ।
अवध साढ़साती तब बोली ॥
verses.tr:
saji pratīti bahubidhi gar̤hi cholī
avadh sār̤hasātī tab bolī

verses.sa:
प्रिय सिय रामु कहा तुम्ह रानी ।
रामहि तुम्ह प्रिय सो फुरि बानी ॥
verses.tr:
priya siya rāmu kahā tumh rānī
rāmahi tumh priya so phuri bānī

verses.sa:
रहा प्रथम अब ते दिन बीते ।
समउ फिरें रिपु होहिं पिंरीते ॥
verses.tr:
rahā pratham ab te din bīte
samau phireṃ ripu hohiṃ piṃrīte

verses.sa:
भानु कमल कुल पोषनिहारा ।
बिनु जल जारि करइ सोइ छारा ॥
verses.tr:
bhānu kamal kul poṣanihārā
binu jal jāri karai soi chārā

verses.sa:
जरि तुम्हारि चह सवति उखारी ।
रूँधहु करि उपाउ बर बारी ॥
verses.tr:
jari tumhāri cah savati ukhārī
rūm̐dhahu kari upāu bar bārī

verses.sa:
तुम्हहि न सोचु सोहाग बल निज बस जानहु राउ ।
मन मलीन मुह मीठ नृप राउर सरल सुभाउ ॥
verses.tr:
tumhahi na socu sohāg bal nij bas jānahu rāu
man malīn muh mīṭh nṛp rāur saral subhāu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Again and again in kindly terms she questioned her, like a fawn bewitthed by the song of a huntress. Her reason veered as fate would have it so; and the slave-girl rejoiced ut the success of her scheme: * You ask, but I am afraid to reply, now that you have given me the name of mischief-maker;”’ thus spoke the malignant star of Avadh, trimming and fashioning her speech in every way to win confidence: “You spoke, O queen, of Sita and Rama as your friends; and true enough Rama did love you once, but now those days are past, in time friends become foes. The sun iovigorates the lotus, but barns it to ashes if it have no water: the rival queen would tear you up by the root: take care of your garden and hedge it about.
Thinking yourself the king’s favourite and that he is quite in your power, you notice nothing; but however fair his words, his heart is black; but you are so good-natured.

sections.label: Doha 18
sections.name: रचि पचि कोटिक कुटिलपन कीन्हेसि कपट प्रबोधु

verses.sa:
चतुर गँभीर राम महतारी ।
बीचु पाइ निज बात सँवारी ॥
verses.tr:
catur gam̐bhīr rām mahatārī
bīcu pāi nij bāt sam̐vārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पठए भरतु भूप ननिअउरें ।
राम मातु मत जानव रउरें ॥
verses.tr:
paṭhae bharatu bhūp naniaureṃ
rām mātu mat jānav raureṃ

verses.sa:
सेवहिं सकल सवति मोहि नीकें ।
गरबित भरत मातु बल पी कें ॥
verses.tr:
sevahiṃ sakal savati mohi nīkeṃ
garabit bharat mātu bal pī keṃ

verses.sa:
सालु तुम्हार कौसिलहि माई ।
कपट चतुर नहिं होइ जनाई ॥
verses.tr:
sālu tumhār kausilahi māī
kapaṭ catur nahiṃ hoi janāī

verses.sa:
राजहि तुम्ह पर प्रेमु बिसेषी ।
सवति सुभाउ सकइ नहिं देखी ॥
verses.tr:
rājahi tumh par premu biseṣī
savati subhāu sakai nahiṃ dekhī

verses.sa:
रची प्रंपचु भूपहि अपनाई ।
राम तिलक हित लगन धराई ॥
verses.tr:
racī praṃpacu bhūpahi apanāī
rām tilak hit lagan dharāī

verses.sa:
यह कुल उचित राम कहुँ टीका ।
सबहि सोहाइ मोहि सुठि नीका ॥
verses.tr:
yah kul ucit rām kahum̐ ṭīkā
sabahi sohāi mohi suṭhi nīkā

verses.sa:
आगिलि बात समुझि डरु मोही ।
देउ दैउ फिरि सो फलु ओही ॥
verses.tr:
āgili bāt samujhi ḍaru mohī
deu daiu phiri so phalu ohī

verses.sa: रचि पचि कोटिक कुटिलपन कीन्हेसि कपट प्रबोधु ॥
verses.tr: raci paci koṭik kuṭilapan kīnhesi kapaṭ prabodhu
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: कहिसि कथा सत सवति कै जेहि बिधि बाढ़ बिरोधु ॥
verses.tr: kahisi kathā sat savati kai jehi bidhi bār̤h birodhu

trans: Rama’s mother, on the contrary, is deep and crafty; and having found the means has played her own game. The king has sent away Bharat to his grandmother’s by her suggestion, and because he is your son; for she said all] the other queens are well disposed to me, but Bharat’s mother presumes on her influence with her lord. You, lady, are the thorn in Kausalya’s side; she is too deep and crafty for you to fathom; the king has greater love for you than for any one else, and like a rival she cannot bear to see it. For her own ends she has worked upon the king and got him to fix a day for Rama’s inauguration. Now Rama's promotion is a good thing for the family: all are pleased at it, and 1 too like it well. But I am alarmed when I consider the consequences; heaven make them recoil on her own head!”
With innumerable crafty devices she planned her cunning tale, telling story after story of jealous wives, whereby to increase her resentment.

sections.label: Doha 19
sections.name: कद्रूँ बिनतहि दीन्ह दुखु तुम्हहि कौसिलाँ देब

verses.sa:
भावी बस प्रतीति उर आई ।
पूँछ रानि पुनि सपथ देवाई ॥
verses.tr:
bhāvī bas pratīti ur āī
pūm̐ch rāni puni sapath devāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
का पूछहुँ तुम्ह अबहुँ न जाना ।
निज हित अनहित पसु पहिचाना ॥
verses.tr:
kā pūchahum̐ tumh abahum̐ na jānā
nij hit anahit pasu pahicānā

verses.sa:
भयउ पाखु दिन सजत समाजू ।
तुम्ह पाई सुधि मोहि सन आजू ॥
verses.tr:
bhayau pākhu din sajat samājū
tumh pāī sudhi mohi san ājū

verses.sa:
खाइअ पहिरिअ राज तुम्हारें ।
सत्य कहें नहिं दोषु हमारें ॥
verses.tr:
khāia pahiria rāj tumhāreṃ
satya kaheṃ nahiṃ doṣu hamāreṃ

verses.sa:
जौं असत्य कछु कहब बनाई ।
तौ बिधि देइहि हमहि सजाई ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ asatya kachu kahab banāī
tau bidhi deihi hamahi sajāī

verses.sa:
रामहि तिलक कालि जौं भयऊ ।
तुम्ह कहुँ बिपति बीजु बिधि बयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
rāmahi tilak kāli jauṃ bhayaū
tumh kahum̐ bipati bīju bidhi bayaū

verses.sa:
रेख खँचाइ कहउँ बलु भाषी ।
भामिनि भइहु दूध कइ माखी ॥
verses.tr:
rekh kham̐cāi kahaum̐ balu bhāṣī
bhāmini bhaihu dūdh kai mākhī

verses.sa:
जौं सुत सहित करहु सेवकाई ।
तौ घर रहहु न आन उपाई ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ sut sahit karahu sevakāī
tau ghar rahahu na ān upāī

verses.sa:
कद्रूँ बिनतहि दीन्ह दुखु तुम्हहि कौसिलाँ देब ।
भरतु बंदिगृह सेइहहिं लखनु राम के नेब ॥
verses.tr:
kadrūm̐ binatahi dīnh dukhu tumhahi kausilām̐ deb
bharatu baṃdigṛh seihahiṃ lakhanu rām ke neb
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘Overmastered by fate, the queen was persuaded at heart, and adjured her by the love she bore her to speak out. ‘“What is it you would ask? still do you not understand: even the brute beasts know what is good or bad for them. For the last fortnight the preparations have been going on, and it is only to-day that you learn the news from me. a am clothed and fed in your service, and I must therefore speak the truth at any cost. If] invent a word of falsehood, may God repay me for it! Should Rama be crowned to-morrow, God will have sown you a crop of misfortunes. I draw this line on the ground, O lady, and declare most emphatically that you will be like a fly ina milkbowl. Ifyou and your son will submit to be servants, you will be able to stay; but on no other conditions.
As Kadru tormented Binata! so will Kausalya treat you

sections.label: Doha 20
sections.name: अपने चलत न आजु लगि अनभल काहुक कीन्ह

verses.sa:
कैकयसुता सुनत कटु बानी ।
कहि न सकइ कछु सहमि सुखानी ॥
verses.tr:
kaikayasutā sunat kaṭu bānī
kahi na sakai kachu sahami sukhānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तन पसेउ कदली जिमि काँपी ।
कुबरीं दसन जीभ तब चाँपी ॥
verses.tr:
tan paseu kadalī jimi kām̐pī
kubarīṃ dasan jībh tab cām̐pī

verses.sa:
कहि कहि कोटिक कपट कहानी ।
धीरजु धरहु प्रबोधिसि रानी ॥
verses.tr:
kahi kahi koṭik kapaṭ kahānī
dhīraju dharahu prabodhisi rānī

verses.sa:
फिरा करमु प्रिय लागि कुचाली ।
बकिहि सराहइ मानि मराली ॥
verses.tr:
phirā karamu priya lāgi kucālī
bakihi sarāhai māni marālī

verses.sa:
सुनु मंथरा बात फुरि तोरी ।
दहिनि आँखि नित फरकइ मोरी ॥
verses.tr:
sunu maṃtharā bāt phuri torī
dahini ām̐khi nit pharakai morī

verses.sa:
दिन प्रति देखउँ राति कुसपने ।
कहउँ न तोहि मोह बस अपने ॥
verses.tr:
din prati dekhaum̐ rāti kusapane
kahaum̐ na tohi moh bas apane

verses.sa:
काह करौ सखि सूध सुभाऊ ।
दाहिन बाम न जानउँ काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
kāh karau sakhi sūdh subhāū
dāhin bām na jānaum̐ kāū

verses.sa:
अपने चलत न आजु लगि अनभल काहुक कीन्ह ।
केहिं अघ एकहि बार मोहि दैअँ दुसह दुखु दीन्ह ॥
verses.tr:
apane calat na āju lagi anabhal kāhuk kīnh
kehiṃ agh ekahi bār mohi daiam̐ dusah dukhu dīnh
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Bharat will be a slave in bonds, under Rama and Lakshman.” Chaupdi.

When she heard these cutting words, —Kekaya’s daughter could say nothing; she was all in a fever for fear: her limb, were bathed with perspiration; and she trembled like a plantain stalk. Then Humpback bit her tongue and with innumerable crafty speeches kept consoling the queen saying-. ing ‘courage.’ ‘courage,’ till with her ill-teaching she warped her like a seasoned plank, which there is no bending straight again. By a turn of fate the vile became a favourite, as though a beautiful flamingo should flatter an ugly crane. “Hearken, Manthare, your words are true; my right eye is always throbbing and every night I have some ill dream; but in my folly I did not tell you. What can I do, friend? Tam such an innocent that I cannot myself tell right from left.
Up to this day I have never of my own accord done an unkindness to any one: for what offence has heaven all at once put me to such intolerable distress?

sections.label: Doha 21
sections.name: परउँ कूप तुअ बचन पर सकउँ पूत पति त्यागि

verses.sa:
नैहर जनमु भरब बरु जाइ ।
जिअत न करबि सवति सेवकाई ॥
verses.tr:
naihar janamu bharab baru jāi
jiat na karabi savati sevakāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अरि बस दैउ जिआवत जाही ।
मरनु नीक तेहि जीवन चाही ॥
verses.tr:
ari bas daiu jiāvat jāhī
maranu nīk tehi jīvan cāhī

verses.sa:
दीन बचन कह बहुबिधि रानी ।
सुनि कुबरीं तियमाया ठानी ॥
verses.tr:
dīn bacan kah bahubidhi rānī
suni kubarīṃ tiyamāyā ṭhānī

verses.sa:
अस कस कहहु मानि मन ऊना ।
सुखु सोहागु तुम्ह कहुँ दिन दूना ॥
verses.tr:
as kas kahahu māni man ūnā
sukhu sohāgu tumh kahum̐ din dūnā

verses.sa:
जेहिं राउर अति अनभल ताका ।
सोइ पाइहि यहु फलु परिपाका ॥
verses.tr:
jehiṃ rāur ati anabhal tākā
soi pāihi yahu phalu paripākā

verses.sa:
जब तें कुमत सुना मैं स्वामिनि ।
भूख न बासर नींद न जामिनि ॥
verses.tr:
jab teṃ kumat sunā maiṃ svāmini
bhūkh na bāsar nīṃd na jāmini

verses.sa:
पूँछेउ गुनिन्ह रेख तिन्ह खाँची ।
भरत भुआल होहिं यह साँची ॥
verses.tr:
pūm̐cheu guninh rekh tinh khām̐cī
bharat bhuāl hohiṃ yah sām̐cī

verses.sa:
भामिनि करहु त कहौं उपाऊ ।
है तुम्हरीं सेवा बस राऊ ॥
verses.tr:
bhāmini karahu ta kahauṃ upāū
hai tumharīṃ sevā bas rāū

verses.sa:
परउँ कूप तुअ बचन पर सकउँ पूत पति त्यागि ।
कहसि मोर दुखु देखि बड़ कस न करब हित लागि ॥
verses.tr:
paraum̐ kūp tua bacan par sakaum̐ pūt pati tyāgi
kahasi mor dukhu dekhi bar̤ kas na karab hit lāgi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Rather would I go and spend all my daysin my father’s house than live a servant of a rival wife. Whoever God creates the dependent of an enemy, it is good for him to die rather than live.” Many such lamentable speeches did the queen utter, and Humpback, on hearing them, formed a thorough woman’s device: “Why speak thus, as though patient of disgrace? Your honour and wedded joy shall yet increase daily, and may he who has plotted you this misfortune in the end reap the fruit of it himself? Since your servant, my lady, first heard the bad news, I could neither eat by day or sleep at night. I consulted the astrologers and they declared positively: ‘Bharat shall be king, this much is certain. If, madam, you will only
what she said.,; thames:. 3 This couplet appears to be an interpolation, as it is said not to be in act upon it, I can tell you a way: for the king is under an obligation to you.’ Dohd 22.
‘T would throw myself down a well if you told me to do so, or even abandon my husband and son. Speak, then: you see how great is my distress: why should I not do what will be for my good?”

sections.label: Doha 22
sections.name: बड़ कुघातु करि पातकिनि कहेसि कोपगृहँ जाहु

verses.sa:
कुबरीं करि कबुली कैकेई ।
कपट छुरी उर पाहन टेई ॥
verses.tr:
kubarīṃ kari kabulī kaikeī
kapaṭ churī ur pāhan ṭeī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
लखइ न रानि निकट दुखु कैंसे ।
चरइ हरित तिन बलिपसु जैसें ॥
verses.tr:
lakhai na rāni nikaṭ dukhu kaiṃse
carai harit tin balipasu jaiseṃ

verses.sa:
सुनत बात मृदु अंत कठोरी ।
देति मनहुँ मधु माहुर घोरी ॥
verses.tr:
sunat bāt mṛdu aṃt kaṭhorī
deti manahum̐ madhu māhur ghorī

verses.sa:
कहइ चेरि सुधि अहइ कि नाही ।
स्वामिनि कहिहु कथा मोहि पाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kahai ceri sudhi ahai ki nāhī
svāmini kahihu kathā mohi pāhīṃ

verses.sa:
दुइ बरदान भूप सन थाती ।
मागहु आजु जुड़ावहु छाती ॥
verses.tr:
dui baradān bhūp san thātī
māgahu āju jur̤āvahu chātī

verses.sa:
सुतहि राजु रामहि बनवासू ।
देहु लेहु सब सवति हुलासु ॥
verses.tr:
sutahi rāju rāmahi banavāsū
dehu lehu sab savati hulāsu

verses.sa:
भूपति राम सपथ जब करई ।
तब मागेहु जेहिं बचनु न टरई ॥
verses.tr:
bhūpati rām sapath jab karaī
tab māgehu jehiṃ bacanu na ṭaraī

verses.sa:
होइ अकाजु आजु निसि बीतें ।
बचनु मोर प्रिय मानेहु जी तें ॥
verses.tr:
hoi akāju āju nisi bīteṃ
bacanu mor priya mānehu jī teṃ

verses.sa:
बड़ कुघातु करि पातकिनि कहेसि कोपगृहँ जाहु ।
काजु सँवारेहु सजग सबु सहसा जनि पतिआहु ॥
verses.tr:
bar̤ kughātu kari pātakini kahesi kopagṛham̐ jāhu
kāju sam̐vārehu sajag sabu sahasā jani patiāhu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Taking Kaikeyi as a victim for the slaughter, the Humpback whetted the knife of treachery on her heart of stone; and the queen, like a sacrificial beast that nibbles the green sward, saw not the approaching danger. Pleasant to hear, but disastrous in their results, her words were like honey mingled with deadly poison. Says the handmaid: “Do you ordo younot, my lady,’ remember the story you once told me of the two boons promised you by the king?! Ask for them now and relieve your soul: the kingdom for your son, banishment to the woods for RAma; thus shall you triumph over all your rivals. But ask not till the king has sworn by Rama, so that he may not go back from his word. If you let this night pass it will be too late; give heed to my words with all your heart.”
Said the wretch, having fully contrived her abominable design: * Go to the sulking-room; make all your arrangements circumspectly, and do not yield too readily.”

sections.label: Doha 23
sections.name: प्रमुदित पुर नर नारि। सब सजहिं सुमंगलचार

verses.sa:
कुबरिहि रानि प्रानप्रिय जानी ।
बार बार बड़ि बुद्धि बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
kubarihi rāni prānapriya jānī
bār bār bar̤i buddhi bakhānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तोहि सम हित न मोर संसारा ।
बहे जात कइ भइसि अधारा ॥
verses.tr:
tohi sam hit na mor saṃsārā
bahe jāt kai bhaisi adhārā

verses.sa:
जौं बिधि पुरब मनोरथु काली ।
करौं तोहि चख पूतरि आली ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ bidhi purab manorathu kālī
karauṃ tohi cakh pūtari ālī

verses.sa:
बहुबिधि चेरिहि आदरु देई ।
कोपभवन गवनि कैकेई ॥
verses.tr:
bahubidhi cerihi ādaru deī
kopabhavan gavani kaikeī

verses.sa:
बिपति बीजु बरषा रितु चेरी ।
भुइँ भइ कुमति कैकेई केरी ॥
verses.tr:
bipati bīju baraṣā ritu cerī
bhuim̐ bhai kumati kaikeī kerī

verses.sa:
पाइ कपट जलु अंकुर जामा ।
बर दोउ दल दुख फल परिनामा ॥
verses.tr:
pāi kapaṭ jalu aṃkur jāmā
bar dou dal dukh phal parināmā

verses.sa:
कोप समाजु साजि सबु सोई ।
राजु करत निज कुमति बिगोई ॥
verses.tr:
kop samāju sāji sabu soī
rāju karat nij kumati bigoī

verses.sa:
राउर नगर कोलाहलु होई ।
यह कुचालि कछु जान न कोई ॥
verses.tr:
rāur nagar kolāhalu hoī
yah kucāli kachu jān na koī

verses.sa:
प्रमुदित पुर नर नारि। सब सजहिं सुमंगलचार ।
एक प्रबिसहिं एक निर्गमहिं भीर भूप दरबार ॥
verses.tr:
pramudit pur nar nāri sab sajahiṃ sumaṃgalacār
ek prabisahiṃ ek nirgamahiṃ bhīr bhūp darabār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The queen thought Humpback her best friend, and again and again extolled her cleverness, saying:‘ I have no such friend as you in the whole world: I had been swept away by the flood but for your support. “To-morrow if God will Fulfil my desire I will cherish you, my dear, as the apple of mine eye. Thus lavishing every term of endearment on her

handmaid, Kaikeyi went to the dark room; her evil temper being the soil in which the servant-girl, like the rains, had sown the seed of calamity, which, watered by treachery, took root and sprouted with the two boons as its leaves, and in the end ruin for its fruit. Gathering about her every token of resentment, she undid her reign by her evil counsel. But meanwhile palace and city were given over to rejoicing, for o0 one knew of these wicked practices.
All the citizens in their delight were busied with festive preparations, and the royal hall of audience was crowded with a continuous stream of people passing in and out.

sections.label: Doha 24
sections.name: साँस समय सानंद नृपु गयउ कैकेई गेहँ

verses.sa:
बाल सखा सुन हियँ हरषाहीं ।
मिलि दस पाँच राम पहिं जाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bāl sakhā sun hiyam̐ haraṣāhīṃ
mili das pām̐c rām pahiṃ jāhīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
प्रभु आदरहिं प्रेमु पहिचानी ।
पूँछहिं कुसल खेम मृदु बानी ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu ādarahiṃ premu pahicānī
pūm̐chahiṃ kusal khem mṛdu bānī

verses.sa:
फिरहिं भवन प्रिय आयसु पाई ।
करत परसपर राम बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
phirahiṃ bhavan priya āyasu pāī
karat parasapar rām bar̤āī

verses.sa:
को रघुबीर सरिस संसारा ।
सीलु सनेह निबाहनिहारा ॥
verses.tr:
ko raghubīr saris saṃsārā
sīlu saneh nibāhanihārā

verses.sa:
जेंहि जेंहि जोनि करम बस भ्रमहीं ।
तहँ तहँ ईसु देउ यह हमहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jeṃhi jeṃhi joni karam bas bhramahīṃ
taham̐ taham̐ īsu deu yah hamahīṃ

verses.sa:
सेवक हम स्वामी सियनाहू ।
होउ नात यह ओर निबाहू ॥
verses.tr:
sevak ham svāmī siyanāhū
hou nāt yah or nibāhū

verses.sa:
अस अभिलाषु नगर सब काहू ।
कैकयसुता ह्दयँ अति दाहू ॥
verses.tr:
as abhilāṣu nagar sab kāhū
kaikayasutā hdayam̐ ati dāhū

verses.sa:
को न कुसंगति पाइ नसाई ।
रहइ न नीच मतें चतुराई ॥
verses.tr:
ko na kusaṃgati pāi nasāī
rahai na nīc mateṃ caturāī

verses.sa:
साँस समय सानंद नृपु गयउ कैकेई गेहँ ।
गवनु निठुरता निकट किय जनु धरि देह सनेहँ ॥
verses.tr:
sām̐s samaya sānaṃd nṛpu gayau kaikeī geham̐
gavanu niṭhuratā nikaṭ kiya janu dhari deh saneham̐
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Delighted at the news, not afew of Rama’s boyish friends went to congratulate him, and the Lord, sensible of their affection, received them graciously and politely asked of their welfare. At his permission they roam through the palace discussing his praises: “Is there anyone in the whole world so kind and amiable as Raghubir? Whatever future births fate has in store for us, God only grant us this, that we may always be the servants of Sita’s lordly spouse: we ask for nothing more.” This was the desire of every one in the city; only Kaikeyi’s heart was in a flame; for who is not spoiled by evil communications? There is no profit in taking counsel with the vile.
At eventide the happy king repaired to Kaikeyi's apart-

sections.label: Doha 25
sections.name: बार बार कह राउ सुमुखि सुलोचिनि पिकबचनि

verses.sa:
कोपभवन सुनि सकुचेउ राउ ।
भय बस अगहुड़ परइ न पाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
kopabhavan suni sakuceu rāu
bhaya bas agahur̤ parai na pāū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुरपति बसइ बाहँबल जाके ।
नरपति सकल रहहिं रुख ताकें ॥
verses.tr:
surapati basai bāham̐bal jāke
narapati sakal rahahiṃ rukh tākeṃ

verses.sa:
सो सुनि तिय रिस गयउ सुखाई ।
देखहु काम प्रताप बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
so suni tiya ris gayau sukhāī
dekhahu kām pratāp bar̤āī

verses.sa:
सूल कुलिस असि अँगवनिहारे ।
ते रतिनाथ सुमन सर मारे ॥
verses.tr:
sūl kulis asi am̐gavanihāre
te ratināth suman sar māre

verses.sa:
सभय नरेसु प्रिया पहिं गयऊ ।
देखि दसा दुखु दारुन भयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
sabhaya naresu priyā pahiṃ gayaū
dekhi dasā dukhu dārun bhayaū

verses.sa:
भूमि सयन पटु मोट पुराना ।
दिए डारि तन भूषण नाना ॥
verses.tr:
bhūmi sayan paṭu moṭ purānā
die ḍāri tan bhūṣaṇ nānā

verses.sa:
कुमतिहि कसि कुबेषता फाबी ।
अन अहिवातु सूच जनु भाबी ॥
verses.tr:
kumatihi kasi kubeṣatā phābī
an ahivātu sūc janu bhābī

verses.sa:
जाइ निकट नृपु कह मृदु बानी ।
प्रानप्रिया केहि हेतु रिसानी ॥
verses.tr:
jāi nikaṭ nṛpu kah mṛdu bānī
prānapriyā kehi hetu risānī

verses.sa:
केहि हेतु रानि रिसानि परसत पानि पतिहि नेवारई ।
मानहुँ सरोष भुअंग भामिनि बिषम भाँति निहारई ॥
verses.tr:
kehi hetu rāni risāni parasat pāni patihi nevāraī
mānahum̐ saroṣ bhuaṃg bhāmini biṣam bhām̐ti nihāraī
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
दोउ बासना रसना दसन बर मरम ठाहरु देखई ।
तुलसी नृपति भवतब्यता बस काम कौतुक लेखई ॥
verses.tr:
dou bāsanā rasanā dasan bar maram ṭhāharu dekhaī
tulasī nṛpati bhavatabyatā bas kām kautuk lekhaī

verses.sa:
बार बार कह राउ सुमुखि सुलोचिनि पिकबचनि ।
कारन मोहि सुनाउ गजगामिनि निज कोप कर ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār kah rāu sumukhi sulocini pikabacani
kāran mohi sunāu gajagāmini nij kop kar
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ments, as it were Love incarnate visiting Obduracy. Chaupai.

He was dismayed when he heard of the chamber of wrath and could scarcely put his feet to the ground for fear. He, under whose mighty arm the Lord of heaven dwells secure, and upon whose favor all monarchs wait, was in a fever at hearing of an angry woman; see how great is the power of love. The bearers of trident, thunderbolt, and sword are slain by the flowery shafts of lati’s spouse. Anxiously the king approached his beloved and was terribly distressed to see her condition, lying on the ground in old and coarse attire with all her personal adornments cast away: her wretched appearance according with her wretch ed design, as if in mourning for her instant widowhood.
The king drew near and asked in gentle tones: ‘Why are you angry, my heart’s delight? ~

Why so angry, my queen?” and touched her with his hands, She put away her lord and dashed upon hima furious glance like an enraged serpent, with her two wishes for its double tongue, and the boons for fangs, spying out awegloerable point. Under the influence of fate, says Tulsi, the king took it all as one of love’s devices.
Again and again the king cried: “Tell me the cause of your anger, O beautiful, bright-eyed dame, with voice as melodious as the fol, and gait as valuptuous as the elephant.

sections.label: Doha 26
sections.name: यह सुनि मन गुनि सपथ बड़ि बिहसि उठी मतिमंद

verses.sa:
अनहित तोर प्रिया केइँ कीन्हा ।
केहि दुइ सिर केहि जमु चह लीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
anahit tor priyā keim̐ kīnhā
kehi dui sir kehi jamu cah līnhā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कहु केहि रंकहि करौ नरेसू ।
कहु केहि नृपहि निकासौं देसू ॥
verses.tr:
kahu kehi raṃkahi karau naresū
kahu kehi nṛpahi nikāsauṃ desū

verses.sa:
सकउँ तोर अरि अमरउ मारी ।
काह कीट बपुरे नर नारी ॥
verses.tr:
sakaum̐ tor ari amarau mārī
kāh kīṭ bapure nar nārī

verses.sa:
जानसि मोर सुभाउ बरोरू ।
मनु तव आनन चंद चकोरू ॥
verses.tr:
jānasi mor subhāu barorū
manu tav ānan caṃd cakorū

verses.sa:
प्रिया प्रान सुत सरबसु मोरें ।
परिजन प्रजा सकल बस तोरें ॥
verses.tr:
priyā prān sut sarabasu moreṃ
parijan prajā sakal bas toreṃ

verses.sa:
जौं कछु कहौ कपटु करि तोही ।
भामिनि राम सपथ सत मोही ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ kachu kahau kapaṭu kari tohī
bhāmini rām sapath sat mohī

verses.sa:
बिहसि मागु मनभावति बाता ।
भूषन सजहि मनोहर गाता ॥
verses.tr:
bihasi māgu manabhāvati bātā
bhūṣan sajahi manohar gātā

verses.sa:
घरी कुघरी समुझि जियँ देखू ।
बेगि प्रिया परिहरहि कुबेषू ॥
verses.tr:
gharī kugharī samujhi jiyam̐ dekhū
begi priyā pariharahi kubeṣū

verses.sa:
यह सुनि मन गुनि सपथ बड़ि बिहसि उठी मतिमंद ।
भूषन सजति बिलोकि मृगु मनहुँ किरातिनि फंद ॥
verses.tr:
yah suni man guni sapath bar̤i bihasi uṭhī matimaṃd
bhūṣan sajati biloki mṛgu manahum̐ kirātini phaṃd
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Who is it, my dear, who has vexed you? Who is it with a head to spare and so enamoured of death? Tell me what begyer | should make a king, or what king I should banish from his realm. I could slay even an immortal, were he your enemy; of what account then are any poor worms of men and women? O my love, you know my sentiments and how my eyes ever turn to your face as the partridge to the moon. O my beloved! my life, my sun, and everything that I own, my palace, my subjects are all at your disposal. Could I tell you a word of untruth, lady, at least an oath by Rama must be binding. Ask with a smile whatever you desire; adorn your lovely person with jewels; consider within yourself what an hour of torture this is for me, and at once, my darling, put away this unseemly attire.”
On hearing this and considering the greatness of the

sections.label: Doha 27
sections.name: मागु मागु पै कहहु पिय कबहुँ न देहु न लेहु

verses.sa:
पुनि कह राउ सुह्रद जियँ जानी ।
प्रेम पुलकि मृदु मंजुल बानी ॥
verses.tr:
puni kah rāu suhrad jiyam̐ jānī
prem pulaki mṛdu maṃjul bānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भामिनि भयउ तोर मनभावा ।
घर घर नगर अनंद बधावा ॥
verses.tr:
bhāmini bhayau tor manabhāvā
ghar ghar nagar anaṃd badhāvā

verses.sa:
रामहि देउँ कालि जुबराजू ।
सजहि सुलोचनि मंगल साजू ॥
verses.tr:
rāmahi deum̐ kāli jubarājū
sajahi sulocani maṃgal sājū

verses.sa:
दलकि उठेउ सुनि ह्रदउ कठोरू ।
जनु छुइ गयउ पाक बरतोरू ॥
verses.tr:
dalaki uṭheu suni hradau kaṭhorū
janu chui gayau pāk baratorū

verses.sa:
ऐसिउ पीर बिहसि तेहि गोई ।
चोर नारि जिमि प्रगटि न रोई ॥
verses.tr:
aisiu pīr bihasi tehi goī
cor nāri jimi pragaṭi na roī

verses.sa:
लखहिं न भूप कपट चतुराई ।
कोटि कुटिल मनि गुरू पढ़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
lakhahiṃ na bhūp kapaṭ caturāī
koṭi kuṭil mani gurū par̤hāī

verses.sa:
जद्यपि नीति निपुन नरनाहू ।
नारिचरित जलनिधि अवगाहू ॥
verses.tr:
jadyapi nīti nipun naranāhū
nāricarit jalanidhi avagāhū

verses.sa:
कपट सनेहु बढ़ाइ बहोरी ।
बोली बिहसि नयन मुहु मोरी ॥
verses.tr:
kapaṭ sanehu bar̤hāi bahorī
bolī bihasi nayan muhu morī

verses.sa:
मागु मागु पै कहहु पिय कबहुँ न देहु न लेहु ।
देन कहेहु बरदान दुइ तेउ पावत संदेहु ॥
verses.tr:
māgu māgu pai kahahu piya kabahum̐ na dehu na lehu
den kahehu baradān dui teu pāvat saṃdehu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: oath, the wicked queen arose with a smile and resumed her
royal attire, like a huntress who sets the snare on marking the chase.

Thinking her reconciled, the king spoke again in soft and winning accents, his whole body quivering with love; ‘Your heart’s desire, lady, has come to pass; there is joy and gladness in every house in the city; to-morrow I give Rama-the rank of Regent; so, my love, make ready for the festival.” At the sound of these untoward words she sprang up with a bound, like an over-ripe gourd that bursts at a touch; with a smile on her lips, but with such secret pain at heart asa thief’s wife who dare not cry opeoly. The king could not penetrate her crafty schemes, for she had been tutored in every villainy by a master; and skilled as he was io statesmanship, the abyss of woman’s ways was more than he could fathom. Again she cried with a further show of hypocritical affection and a forced smile in her eyes and on her lips:—
‘Ask, ask, indeed; but tell me, sir, when has it come to giving and taking? you once promised me two boons, and yet I doubt my getting them.”

sections.label: Doha 28
sections.name: भूप मनोरथ सुभग बनु सुख सुबिहंग समाजु

verses.sa:
जानेउँ मरमु राउ हँसि कहई ।
तुम्हहि कोहाब परम प्रिय अहई ॥
verses.tr:
jāneum̐ maramu rāu ham̐si kahaī
tumhahi kohāb param priya ahaī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
थाति राखि न मागिहु काऊ ।
बिसरि गयउ मोहि भोर सुभाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
thāti rākhi na māgihu kāū
bisari gayau mohi bhor subhāū

verses.sa:
झूठेहुँ हमहि दोषु जनि देहू ।
दुइ कै चारि मागि मकु लेहू ॥
verses.tr:
jhūṭhehum̐ hamahi doṣu jani dehū
dui kai cāri māgi maku lehū

verses.sa:
रघुकुल रीति सदा चलि आई ।
प्रान जाहुँ बरु बचनु न जाई ॥
verses.tr:
raghukul rīti sadā cali āī
prān jāhum̐ baru bacanu na jāī

verses.sa:
नहिं असत्य सम पातक पुंजा ।
गिरि सम होहिं कि कोटिक गुंजा ॥
verses.tr:
nahiṃ asatya sam pātak puṃjā
giri sam hohiṃ ki koṭik guṃjā

verses.sa:
सत्यमूल सब सुकृत सुहाए ।
बेद पुरान बिदित मनु गाए ॥
verses.tr:
satyamūl sab sukṛt suhāe
bed purān bidit manu gāe

verses.sa:
तेहि पर राम सपथ करि आई ।
सुकृत सनेह अवधि रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
tehi par rām sapath kari āī
sukṛt saneh avadhi raghurāī

verses.sa:
बात दृढ़ाइ कुमति हँसि बोली ।
कुमत कुबिहग कुलह जनु खोली ॥
verses.tr:
bāt dṛr̤hāi kumati ham̐si bolī
kumat kubihag kulah janu kholī

verses.sa:
भूप मनोरथ सुभग बनु सुख सुबिहंग समाजु ।
भिल्लनि जिमि छाड़न चहति बचनु भयंकरु बाजु ॥
verses.tr:
bhūp manorath subhag banu sukh subihaṃg samāju
bhillani jimi chār̤an cahati bacanu bhayaṃkaru bāju
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The king replied with a smile: “I see what you mean, you are very fond of a little quarrel. You kept my promise in reserve and asked for nothing, and as my way is, I forgot all about it. Do not tax me with the guilt of a lie, but for two requests make four and you shall have them. It is un immemorial rule in the Raghu family to lose life rather than break a promise. No number of sins is eqaul to a lie; in the same way as myriads of ghuncht seeds will not make a mountain. Truth is the foundation of all merit and virtue, as the Vedas and Puranas declare and as Manu has expounded. Moreover I have sworn by Rama, the chief of our house, the perfection of all that is good and amiable.” When she had thus bound him to his word, the wicked queen smiled and cried—loosing as it were the bandage from the eyes of her hawk-like plot.
The King’s desire being as a pleasant forest, and the general happiness as a flock of birds, at which as a huntress she sent forth the cruel falcon of her speech:

sections.label: Doha 29
sections.name: कवनें अवसर का भयउ गयउँ नारि बिस्वास

verses.sa:
सुनहु प्रानप्रिय भावत जी का ।
देहु एक बर भरतहि टीका ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu prānapriya bhāvat jī kā
dehu ek bar bharatahi ṭīkā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मागउँ दूसर बर कर जोरी ।
पुरवहु नाथ मनोरथ मोरी ॥
verses.tr:
māgaum̐ dūsar bar kar jorī
puravahu nāth manorath morī

verses.sa:
तापस बेष बिसेषि उदासी ।
चौदह बरिस रामु बनबासी ॥
verses.tr:
tāpas beṣ biseṣi udāsī
caudah baris rāmu banabāsī

verses.sa:
सुनि मृदु बचन भूप हियँ सोकू ।
ससि कर छुअत बिकल जिमि कोकू ॥
verses.tr:
suni mṛdu bacan bhūp hiyam̐ sokū
sasi kar chuat bikal jimi kokū

verses.sa:
गयउ सहमि नहिं कछु कहि आवा ।
जनु सचान बन झपटेउ लावा ॥
verses.tr:
gayau sahami nahiṃ kachu kahi āvā
janu sacān ban jhapaṭeu lāvā

verses.sa:
बिबरन भयउ निपट नरपालू ।
दामिनि हनेउ मनहुँ तरु तालू ॥
verses.tr:
bibaran bhayau nipaṭ narapālū
dāmini haneu manahum̐ taru tālū

verses.sa:
माथे हाथ मूदि दोउ लोचन ।
तनु धरि सोचु लाग जनु सोचन ॥
verses.tr:
māthe hāth mūdi dou locan
tanu dhari socu lāg janu socan

verses.sa:
मोर मनोरथु सुरतरु फूला ।
फरत करिनि जिमि हतेउ समूला ॥
verses.tr:
mor manorathu surataru phūlā
pharat karini jimi hateu samūlā

verses.sa:
अवध उजारि कीन्हि कैकेईं ।
दीन्हसि अचल बिपति कै नेईं ॥
verses.tr:
avadh ujāri kīnhi kaikeīṃ
dīnhasi acal bipati kai neīṃ

verses.sa:
कवनें अवसर का भयउ गयउँ नारि बिस्वास ।
जोग सिद्धि फल समय जिमि जतिहि अबिद्या नास ॥
verses.tr:
kavaneṃ avasar kā bhayau gayaum̐ nāri bisvās
jog siddhi phal samaya jimi jatihi abidyā nās
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “Hear, my beloved, what is the desire of my heart. Grant me for one boon Bharat’s installation; and for the second (I beg with clasped hands, O my Lord, accomplish my desire) may Rama be banished to the woods for 14 years there to dwell in the penitential] garb of a hermit.” At these words of the queen the king’s heart grew faint, as the chakwa is troubled by the rays of the moon: he trembled all over, nor could he utter a sound, like a partridge in the wood at the swoop of a falcon; the mighty monarch was as crestfallen as a palm-tree struck by lightning; with his - hands to his forehead and closing both his eyes, as it were Grief personified, he began his moan: ‘My desire, that had blossomed like the tree of paradise, has been stricken and uprooted as it were by an elephant at the time of bearing. Kaikeyi has desolated Avadh and laid the foundation of everlasting calamity.
What a thing to happen at such a time? I am undone by putting trust in a woman; as at the time of heavenly reward for penance an ascetic is destroyed by ingnorance.”

sections.label: Doha 30
sections.name: धरम धुरंधर धीर धरि नयन उघारे रायँ

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि राउ मनहिं मन झाँखा ।
देखि कुभाँति कुमति मन माखा ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi rāu manahiṃ man jhām̐khā
dekhi kubhām̐ti kumati man mākhā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भरतु कि राउर पूत न होहीं ।
आनेहु मोल बेसाहि कि मोही ॥
verses.tr:
bharatu ki rāur pūt na hohīṃ
ānehu mol besāhi ki mohī

verses.sa:
जो सुनि सरु अस लाग तुम्हारें ।
काहे न बोलहु बचनु सँभारे ॥
verses.tr:
jo suni saru as lāg tumhāreṃ
kāhe na bolahu bacanu sam̐bhāre

verses.sa:
देहु उतरु अनु करहु कि नाहीं ।
सत्यसंध तुम्ह रघुकुल माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
dehu utaru anu karahu ki nāhīṃ
satyasaṃdh tumh raghukul māhīṃ

verses.sa:
देन कहेहु अब जनि बरु देहू ।
तजहुँ सत्य जग अपजसु लेहू ॥
verses.tr:
den kahehu ab jani baru dehū
tajahum̐ satya jag apajasu lehū

verses.sa:
सत्य सराहि कहेहु बरु देना ।
जानेहु लेइहि मागि चबेना ॥
verses.tr:
satya sarāhi kahehu baru denā
jānehu leihi māgi cabenā

verses.sa:
सिबि दधीचि बलि जो कछु भाषा ।
तनु धनु तजेउ बचन पनु राखा ॥
verses.tr:
sibi dadhīci bali jo kachu bhāṣā
tanu dhanu tajeu bacan panu rākhā

verses.sa:
अति कटु बचन कहति कैकेई ।
मानहुँ लोन जरे पर देई ॥
verses.tr:
ati kaṭu bacan kahati kaikeī
mānahum̐ lon jare par deī

verses.sa:
धरम धुरंधर धीर धरि नयन उघारे रायँ ।
सिरु धुनि लीन्हि उसास असि मारेसि मोहि कुठायँ ॥
verses.tr:
dharam dhuraṃdhar dhīr dhari nayan ughāre rāyam̐
siru dhuni līnhi usās asi māresi mohi kuṭhāyam̐
verses.head: दोहा

trans: In this manner the king burned within himself, and the wicked woman, seeing his evil plight, thus began: “What, then, is Bharat not your son too, but a slave as I am, bought for a price?_ If my words, thus like arrows, pierce you to the heart, why did you not think before you spoke? Answer now, say either yes or no, most truthful lord of Raghu's truthful line. Refuse me the boon you promised, break your word and be publicly disgraced. When you engaged to grant the boon, you were loud in your praises of truth, imagining, no doubt, that I should ask for a handful of parched grain. When Siva!, Dadhichi and Bali, made a promise; they gave life and wealth to keep their word.” Kaikeyi's speech was as stinging as salt applied to a burn.
The righteous king took courage and opened his eyes, and beating his head gasped out: “She has ‘pierced me in the most vital part.”

sections.label: Doha 31
sections.name: लोभु न रामहि राजु कर बहुत भरत पर प्रीति

verses.sa:
आगें दीखि जरत रिस भारी ।
मनहुँ रोष तरवारि उघारी ॥
verses.tr:
āgeṃ dīkhi jarat ris bhārī
manahum̐ roṣ taravāri ughārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मूठि कुबुद्धि धार निठुराई ।
धरी कूबरीं सान बनाई ॥
verses.tr:
mūṭhi kubuddhi dhār niṭhurāī
dharī kūbarīṃ sān banāī

verses.sa:
लखी महीप कराल कठोरा ।
सत्य कि जीवनु लेइहि मोरा ॥
verses.tr:
lakhī mahīp karāl kaṭhorā
satya ki jīvanu leihi morā

verses.sa:
बोले राउ कठिन करि छाती ।
बानी सबिनय तासु सोहाती ॥
verses.tr:
bole rāu kaṭhin kari chātī
bānī sabinaya tāsu sohātī

verses.sa:
प्रिया बचन कस कहसि कुभाँती ।
भीर प्रतीति प्रीति करि हाँती ॥
verses.tr:
priyā bacan kas kahasi kubhām̐tī
bhīr pratīti prīti kari hām̐tī

verses.sa:
मोरें भरतु रामु दुइ आँखी ।
सत्य कहउँ करि संकरू साखी ॥
verses.tr:
moreṃ bharatu rāmu dui ām̐khī
satya kahaum̐ kari saṃkarū sākhī

verses.sa:
अवसि दूतु मैं पठइब प्राता ।
ऐहहिं बेगि सुनत दोउ भ्राता ॥
verses.tr:
avasi dūtu maiṃ paṭhaib prātā
aihahiṃ begi sunat dou bhrātā

verses.sa:
सुदिन सोधि सबु साजु सजाई ।
देउँ भरत कहुँ राजु बजाई ॥
verses.tr:
sudin sodhi sabu sāju sajāī
deum̐ bharat kahum̐ rāju bajāī

verses.sa:
लोभु न रामहि राजु कर बहुत भरत पर प्रीति ।
मैं बड़ छोट बिचारि जियँ करत रहेउँ नृपनीति ॥
verses.tr:
lobhu na rāmahi rāju kar bahut bharat par prīti
maiṃ bar̤ choṭ bicāri jiyam̐ karat raheum̐ nṛpanīti
verses.head: दोहा

trans: He saw her standing before him burning with passion, as it were Fury’s own sword drawn from the sheath, with ill-counsel for its hilt and cruelty for its sharp edge whetted on the Humpback grindstone. The monarch saw her stern and terrible: ‘“‘ She will rob me either of life or honour ”; but stilling his heart he cried in suppliant tones which she. regarded not: “Bharat and Rama are as my two eyes. I tell you truly and call Siva as my witness. O my _ beloved, what is this ill word that you have uttered, destructive of all order, confidence and affection I will not fail to despatch a messenger at daybreak and as soonas they hear the news both brothers will come. Then after fixing an auspicious day and making all due preparation. I will solemnly confer the kingdom on Bharat.
Rama has no greed of empire and is devotedly attached to Bharat: I made my plans according to royal usage, thinking only of their respective ages.

sections.label: Doha 32
sections.name: प्रिया हास रिस परिहरहि मागु बिचारि बिबेकु

verses.sa:
राम सपथ सत कहुउँ सुभाऊ ।
राममातु कछु कहेउ न काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
rām sapath sat kahuum̐ subhāū
rāmamātu kachu kaheu na kāū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मैं सबु कीन्ह तोहि बिनु पूँछें ।
तेहि तें परेउ मनोरथु छूछें ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ sabu kīnh tohi binu pūm̐cheṃ
tehi teṃ pareu manorathu chūcheṃ

verses.sa:
रिस परिहरू अब मंगल साजू ।
कछु दिन गएँ भरत जुबराजू ॥
verses.tr:
ris pariharū ab maṃgal sājū
kachu din gaem̐ bharat jubarājū

verses.sa:
एकहि बात मोहि दुखु लागा ।
बर दूसर असमंजस मागा ॥
verses.tr:
ekahi bāt mohi dukhu lāgā
bar dūsar asamaṃjas māgā

verses.sa:
अजहुँ हृदय जरत तेहि आँचा ।
रिस परिहास कि साँचेहुँ साँचा ॥
verses.tr:
ajahum̐ hṛdaya jarat tehi ām̐cā
ris parihās ki sām̐cehum̐ sām̐cā

verses.sa:
कहु तजि रोषु राम अपराधू ।
सबु कोउ कहइ रामु सुठि साधू ॥
verses.tr:
kahu taji roṣu rām aparādhū
sabu kou kahai rāmu suṭhi sādhū

verses.sa:
तुहूँ सराहसि करसि सनेहू ।
अब सुनि मोहि भयउ संदेहू ॥
verses.tr:
tuhūm̐ sarāhasi karasi sanehū
ab suni mohi bhayau saṃdehū

verses.sa:
जासु सुभाउ अरिहि अनुकूला ।
सो किमि करिहि मातु प्रतिकूला ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu subhāu arihi anukūlā
so kimi karihi mātu pratikūlā

verses.sa:
प्रिया हास रिस परिहरहि मागु बिचारि बिबेकु ।
जेहिं देखाँ अब नयन भरि भरत राज अभिषेकु ॥
verses.tr:
priyā hās ris pariharahi māgu bicāri bibeku
jehiṃ dekhām̐ ab nayan bhari bharat rāj abhiṣeku
verses.head: दोहा

trans: T swear by Rama that I tell you true of his mother, that she'never said a word to me. I arranged it all without asking you, and this is how my scheme has failed. Put away your displeasure, assume a festal] garb; yeta few days and Bharat shall be Regent. There was only one thing that pained me, your second petition, really an unreasonable request. ‘To-day your bosom burns with unwonted fire; is it anger, or do you jest, or is it all really true Tell me calmly Rama's offence. Every onesays that he is amiability itself. Even you used to praise and caress him, and I am quite perplexed at what a now hear. His pleasant ways
would charm even an enemy; how then can he have vexed his own mother?
Have done, my beloved, with this, be it raillery or displeasure; make a just and reasonable request, that I may rejoice in the sight of Bharat's installation.

sections.label: Doha 33
sections.name: होत प्रात मुनिबेष धरि जौं न रामु बन जाहिं

verses.sa:
जिऐ मीन बरू बारि बिहीना ।
मनि बिनु फनिकु जिऐ दुख दीना ॥
verses.tr:
jiai mīn barū bāri bihīnā
mani binu phaniku jiai dukh dīnā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कहउँ सुभाउ न छलु मन माहीं ।
जीवनु मोर राम बिनु नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kahaum̐ subhāu na chalu man māhīṃ
jīvanu mor rām binu nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
समुझि देखु जियँ प्रिया प्रबीना ।
जीवनु राम दरस आधीना ॥
verses.tr:
samujhi dekhu jiyam̐ priyā prabīnā
jīvanu rām daras ādhīnā

verses.sa:
सुनि म्रदु बचन कुमति अति जरई ।
मनहुँ अनल आहुति घृत परई ॥
verses.tr:
suni mradu bacan kumati ati jaraī
manahum̐ anal āhuti ghṛt paraī

verses.sa:
कहइ करहु किन कोटि उपाया ।
इहाँ न लागिहि राउरि माया ॥
verses.tr:
kahai karahu kin koṭi upāyā
ihām̐ na lāgihi rāuri māyā

verses.sa:
देहु कि लेहु अजसु करि नाहीं ।
मोहि न बहुत प्रपंच सोहाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
dehu ki lehu ajasu kari nāhīṃ
mohi na bahut prapaṃc sohāhīṃ

verses.sa:
रामु साधु तुम्ह साधु सयाने ।
राममातु भलि सब पहिचाने ॥
verses.tr:
rāmu sādhu tumh sādhu sayāne
rāmamātu bhali sab pahicāne

verses.sa:
जस कौसिलाँ मोर भल ताका ।
तस फलु उन्हहि देउँ करि साका ॥
verses.tr:
jas kausilām̐ mor bhal tākā
tas phalu unhahi deum̐ kari sākā

verses.sa:
होत प्रात मुनिबेष धरि जौं न रामु बन जाहिं ।
मोर मरनु राउर अजस नृप समुझिअ मन माहिं ॥
verses.tr:
hot prāt munibeṣ dhari jauṃ na rāmu ban jāhiṃ
mor maranu rāur ajas nṛp samujhia man māhiṃ
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Rather might a fish live out of the water, or a wretched serpent live without its head-jewel—lI tell you my true case without any deception—but there is no life for me without Rama. Consider well, my dear, my prudent wife, my very existence depends upon my seeing Rama.” On hearing this soft speech the wicked woman blazed up like the fire on which has fallen an oblation of ghi: ‘You may devise and carry out any number of plans, but your subterfuges will not avail with me. Either grant my request, or refuse me and be disgraced; Ido not want any long discussion. Rama is good, you too are good and wise, and Rama’s mother, as you have discovered, is also good. The benefit that Kausalya devised for me is the only fruit that I now in turn give her.
At daybreak, if Rama does not assume the hermit’s dress and go out into the woods, my death will ensue, O king, and your disgrace; be well assured of this.”

sections.label: Doha 34
sections.name: देखी ब्याधि असाध नृपु परेउ धरनि धुनि माथ

verses.sa:
