अस कहि कुटिल भई उठि ठाढ़ी ।
मानहुँ रोष तरंगिनि बाढ़ी ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi kuṭil bhaī uṭhi ṭhār̤hī
mānahum̐ roṣ taraṃgini bār̤hī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पाप पहार प्रगट भइ सोई ।
भरी क्रोध जल जाइ न जोई ॥
verses.tr:
pāp pahār pragaṭ bhai soī
bharī krodh jal jāi na joī

verses.sa:
दोउ बर कूल कठिन हठ धारा ।
भवँर कूबरी बचन प्रचारा ॥
verses.tr:
dou bar kūl kaṭhin haṭh dhārā
bhavam̐r kūbarī bacan pracārā

verses.sa:
ढाहत भूपरूप तरु मूला ।
चली बिपति बारिधि अनुकूला ॥
verses.tr:
ḍhāhat bhūparūp taru mūlā
calī bipati bāridhi anukūlā

verses.sa:
लखी नरेस बात फुरि साँची ।
तिय मिस मीचु सीस पर नाची ॥
verses.tr:
lakhī nares bāt phuri sām̐cī
tiya mis mīcu sīs par nācī

verses.sa:
गहि पद बिनय कीन्ह बैठारी ।
जनि दिनकर कुल होसि कुठारी ॥
verses.tr:
gahi pad binaya kīnh baiṭhārī
jani dinakar kul hosi kuṭhārī

verses.sa:
मागु माथ अबहीं देउँ तोही ।
राम बिरहँ जनि मारसि मोही ॥
verses.tr:
māgu māth abahīṃ deum̐ tohī
rām biraham̐ jani mārasi mohī

verses.sa:
राखु राम कहुँ जेहि तेहि भाँती ।
नाहिं त जरिहि जनम भरि छाती ॥
verses.tr:
rākhu rām kahum̐ jehi tehi bhām̐tī
nāhiṃ ta jarihi janam bhari chātī

verses.sa:
देखी ब्याधि असाध नृपु परेउ धरनि धुनि माथ ।
कहत परम आरत बचन राम राम रघुनाथ ॥
verses.tr:
dekhī byādhi asādh nṛpu pareu dharani dhuni māth
kahat param ārat bacan rām rām raghunāth
verses.head: दोहा

trans: So saying, the wretch rose and stood erect, as it were a swollen flood of wrath that had risenin the mountains of sin, turgid with streams of passion, terrible to behold, with the two boons for its banks, her stern obduracy for its current, and her voluble speech for its eddies, overthrowing the king like some tree torn up by the roots, as it rushed on to the ocean of calamity. The king perceived that it was all true, and that death, in fashion as a woman, was dancing in triumph | on his head. Humbly he clasped her by the feet and begged her to be seated, crying: “Be not an axe at the root of the Solar race. Demand of me my head and I will give it at once, but do not kill me by the loss of Rama, be it in any way you will, or your heart will be ill at ease all your life long.”
Seeing that his disease was incurable, the king fell upon the ground and beat his head, sobbing out in most lamentable tones, “Rama, Rama.”’

sections.label: Doha 35
sections.name: मरम बचन सुनि राउ कह कहु कछु दोषु न तोर

verses.sa:
ब्याकुल राउ सिथिल सब गाता ।
करिनि कलपतरु मनहुँ निपाता ॥
verses.tr:
byākul rāu sithil sab gātā
karini kalapataru manahum̐ nipātā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कंठु सूख मुख आव न बानी ।
जनु पाठीनु दीन बिनु पानी ॥
verses.tr:
kaṃṭhu sūkh mukh āv na bānī
janu pāṭhīnu dīn binu pānī

verses.sa:
पुनि कह कटु कठोर कैकेई ।
मनहुँ घाय महुँ माहुर देई ॥
verses.tr:
puni kah kaṭu kaṭhor kaikeī
manahum̐ ghāya mahum̐ māhur deī

verses.sa:
जौं अंतहुँ अस करतबु रहेऊ ।
मागु मागु तुम्ह केहिं बल कहेऊ ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ aṃtahum̐ as karatabu raheū
māgu māgu tumh kehiṃ bal kaheū

verses.sa:
दुइ कि होइ एक समय भुआला ।
हँसब ठठाइ फुलाउब गाला ॥
verses.tr:
dui ki hoi ek samaya bhuālā
ham̐sab ṭhaṭhāi phulāub gālā

verses.sa:
दानि कहाउब अरु कृपनाई ।
होइ कि खेम कुसल रौताई ॥
verses.tr:
dāni kahāub aru kṛpanāī
hoi ki khem kusal rautāī

verses.sa:
छाड़हु बचनु कि धीरजु धरहू ।
जनि अबला जिमि करुना करहू ॥
verses.tr:
chār̤ahu bacanu ki dhīraju dharahū
jani abalā jimi karunā karahū

verses.sa:
तनु तिय तनय धामु धनु धरनी ।
सत्यसंध कहुँ तृन सम बरनी ॥
verses.tr:
tanu tiya tanaya dhāmu dhanu dharanī
satyasaṃdh kahum̐ tṛn sam baranī

verses.sa:
मरम बचन सुनि राउ कह कहु कछु दोषु न तोर ।
लागेउ तोहि पिसाच जिमि कालु कहावत मोर ॥
verses.tr:
maram bacan suni rāu kah kahu kachu doṣu na tor
lāgeu tohi pisāc jimi kālu kahāvat mor
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The king’s whole body was so broken down by distress that he seemed like the tree of paradise that some elephant had uprooted. His throat was dry, speech failed his lips, like some poor fish deprived of water. Again Kaikeyi plied him with biting taunts, infusing as it were poison into his wounds: ‘If you meant to act thus in the end, what compulsion was there to say, ask, ask? [sit possible, sire, to be two things at once To laugh and jest and at the same time mourn; to be called the munificent, and yet be miserly; to live without anxiety, and yet be a king Wither break your world or show more fortitude, do not, like a woman, appeal to compassion. It is said that life, wife, sons, home, wealth, nay the whole world, all are but as a straw compared to the ocean of truth.”
On hearing these fatal words the king exclaimed: os It is no fault of yours; my evil destiny, like some demoniacal delusion, has possessed you and bids you speak.

sections.label: Doha 36
sections.name: परेउ राउ कहि कोटि बिधि काहे करसि निदानु

verses.sa:
चहत न भरत भूपतहि भोरें ।
बिधि बस कुमति बसी जिय तोरें ॥
verses.tr:
cahat na bharat bhūpatahi bhoreṃ
bidhi bas kumati basī jiya toreṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सो सबु मोर पाप परिनामू ।
भयउ कुठाहर जेहिं बिधि बामू ॥
verses.tr:
so sabu mor pāp parināmū
bhayau kuṭhāhar jehiṃ bidhi bāmū

verses.sa:
सुबस बसिहि फिरि अवध सुहाई ।
सब गुन धाम राम प्रभुताई ॥
verses.tr:
subas basihi phiri avadh suhāī
sab gun dhām rām prabhutāī

verses.sa:
करिहहिं भाइ सकल सेवकाई ।
होइहि तिहुँ पुर राम बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
karihahiṃ bhāi sakal sevakāī
hoihi tihum̐ pur rām bar̤āī

verses.sa:
तोर कलंकु मोर पछिताऊ ।
मुएहुँ न मिटहि न जाइहि काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
tor kalaṃku mor pachitāū
muehum̐ na miṭahi na jāihi kāū

verses.sa:
अब तोहि नीक लाग करु सोई ।
लोचन ओट बैठु मुहु गोई ॥
verses.tr:
ab tohi nīk lāg karu soī
locan oṭ baiṭhu muhu goī

verses.sa:
जब लगि जिऔं कहउँ कर जोरी ।
तब लगि जनि कछु कहसि बहोरी ॥
verses.tr:
jab lagi jiauṃ kahaum̐ kar jorī
tab lagi jani kachu kahasi bahorī

verses.sa:
फिरि पछितैहसि अंत अभागी ।
मारसि गाइ नहारु लागी ॥
verses.tr:
phiri pachitaihasi aṃt abhāgī
mārasi gāi nahāru lāgī

verses.sa:
परेउ राउ कहि कोटि बिधि काहे करसि निदानु ।
कपट सयानि न कहति कछु जागति मनहुँ मसानु ॥
verses.tr:
pareu rāu kahi koṭi bidhi kāhe karasi nidānu
kapaṭ sayāni na kahati kachu jāgati manahum̐ masānu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Bharat has never dreamed of desiring the royal dignity but by the decree of fate evil counsel has lodged in your breast. All this is the result of my sins I can do nothing; God is against me. Hereafter beautiful Avadh shall flourish again under the sway of the all-perfect Rama; all his brethren shall do him service and his glory shall spread through the three spheres of creation; your disgrace also and my remorse, though we die, shall never be effaced or forgotten. Now do whatever seemeth you good; only stay out of my sight and let your face be veiled: with clasped hands I ask but this, speak not to me again so long asI live. You too will repent at the last. O miserable woman, who aiming at the tiger have thus shot dead the cow.”
The king fell to the ground crying again and again: ‘“Why have you wrought this ruin?” But the perfidious queen spoke not a word, like a funeral pile that is ever burning.

sections.label: Doha 37
sections.name: द्वार भीर सेवक सचिव कहहिं उदित रबि देखि

verses.sa:
राम राम रट बिकल भुआलू ।
जनु बिनु पंख बिहंग बेहालू ॥
verses.tr:
rām rām raṭ bikal bhuālū
janu binu paṃkh bihaṃg behālū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
हृदयँ मनाव भोरु जनि होई ।
रामहि जाइ कहै जनि कोई ॥
verses.tr:
hṛdayam̐ manāv bhoru jani hoī
rāmahi jāi kahai jani koī

verses.sa:
उदउ करहु जनि रबि रघुकुल गुर ।
अवध बिलोकि सूल होइहि उर ॥
verses.tr:
udau karahu jani rabi raghukul gur
avadh biloki sūl hoihi ur

verses.sa:
भूप प्रीति कैकइ कठिनाई ।
उभय अवधि बिधि रची बनाई ॥
verses.tr:
bhūp prīti kaikai kaṭhināī
ubhaya avadhi bidhi racī banāī

verses.sa:
बिलपत नृपहि भयउ भिनुसारा ।
बीना बेनु संख धुनि द्वारा ॥
verses.tr:
bilapat nṛpahi bhayau bhinusārā
bīnā benu saṃkh dhuni dvārā

verses.sa:
पढ़हिं भाट गुन गावहिं गायक ।
सुनत नृपहि जनु लागहिं सायक ॥
verses.tr:
par̤hahiṃ bhāṭ gun gāvahiṃ gāyak
sunat nṛpahi janu lāgahiṃ sāyak

verses.sa:
मंगल सकल सोहाहिं न कैसें ।
सहगामिनिहि बिभूषन जैसें ॥
verses.tr:
maṃgal sakal sohāhiṃ na kaiseṃ
sahagāminihi bibhūṣan jaiseṃ

verses.sa:
तेहिं निसि नीद परी नहि काहू ।
राम दरस लालसा उछाहू ॥
verses.tr:
tehiṃ nisi nīd parī nahi kāhū
rām daras lālasā uchāhū

verses.sa:
द्वार भीर सेवक सचिव कहहिं उदित रबि देखि ।
जागेउ अजहुँ न अवधपति कारनु कवनु बिसेषि ॥
verses.tr:
dvār bhīr sevak saciv kahahiṃ udit rabi dekhi
jāgeu ajahum̐ na avadhapati kāranu kavanu biseṣi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The king in his distress sobbing out ‘Rama, Rama,” was like some luckless bird clipped of its wings. In his heart he was praying: “May the day never break nor any one go and tell Rama. Rise not great patriarch of the Solar race, for at the sight of Avadh your breast will be consumed with anguish.” The king's affection and Kaikeyi’s cruelty were both the most extreme that God could make. While the monarch was yet lamenting, day broke and the music of lute and pipe and conch, resounded at his gate. Bards recited his titles, minstrels sang his praises; but like arrows they wounded the king, as he heard them. All tokens of rejoicing pleased him as little as the adornment of a widow who ascends the funeral pile. That night no one had slept, from the joyous anticipation of beholding Rama.
At the gate was a crowd of servants and ministers, who exclaimed as they beheld the risen sun: ‘What can be the reason why to-day of all days our lord awaketh not?

sections.label: Doha 38
sections.name: परी न राजहि नीद निसि हेतु जान जगदीसु

verses.sa:
पछिले पहर भूपु नित जागा ।
आजु हमहि बड़ अचरजु लागा ॥
verses.tr:
pachile pahar bhūpu nit jāgā
āju hamahi bar̤ acaraju lāgā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जाहु सुमंत्र जगावहु जाई ।
कीजिअ काजु रजायसु पाई ॥
verses.tr:
jāhu sumaṃtr jagāvahu jāī
kījia kāju rajāyasu pāī

verses.sa:
गए सुमंत्रु तब राउर माही ।
देखि भयावन जात डेराहीं ॥
verses.tr:
gae sumaṃtru tab rāur māhī
dekhi bhayāvan jāt ḍerāhīṃ

verses.sa:
धाइ खाइ जनु जाइ न हेरा ।
मानहुँ बिपति बिषाद बसेरा ॥
verses.tr:
dhāi khāi janu jāi na herā
mānahum̐ bipati biṣād baserā

verses.sa:
पूछें कोउ न ऊतरु देई ।
गए जेंहिं भवन भूप कैकैई ॥
verses.tr:
pūcheṃ kou na ūtaru deī
gae jeṃhiṃ bhavan bhūp kaikaiī

verses.sa:
कहि जयजीव बैठ सिरु नाई ।
दैखि भूप गति गयउ सुखाई ॥
verses.tr:
kahi jayajīv baiṭh siru nāī
daikhi bhūp gati gayau sukhāī

verses.sa:
सोच बिकल बिबरन महि परेऊ ।
मानहुँ कमल मूलु परिहरेऊ ॥
verses.tr:
soc bikal bibaran mahi pareū
mānahum̐ kamal mūlu parihareū

verses.sa:
सचिउ सभीत सकइ नहिं पूँछी ।
बोली असुभ भरी सुभ छूछी ॥
verses.tr:
saciu sabhīt sakai nahiṃ pūm̐chī
bolī asubh bharī subh chūchī

verses.sa:
परी न राजहि नीद निसि हेतु जान जगदीसु ।
रामु रामु रटि भोरु किय कहइ न मरमु महीसु ॥
verses.tr:
parī na rājahi nīd nisi hetu jān jagadīsu
rāmu rāmu raṭi bhoru kiya kahai na maramu mahīsu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: __ He was always wont to wake at the last watch; to-day it strikes us as very strange. Go Sumanta, and rouse him and obtain the royal order to commence the work.” Sumanta entered the palace, but as he passed on was struck with awe and dismay at its appearance, as though some terrible monster were about to spring upon him and devour him; it seemed the very home of calamity and distress. Asking, but with no one to answer him, he came to the apartment where were the king and Kaikeyi; with the salutation ‘Live for ever’ he bowed the head and sat down. On beholding the king’s condition he was much distressed, for he was fallen on the ground crushed and colourless, like a lotus broken off from its root. The terrified minister could ask no question; but she, full of evil and void of all good, answered and said: Doha 38.
‘“‘ The king has not slept all night: God knows why. He has done nothing but mutter ‘“ Rama, Rama,” even till day break; but he has not told me the reason.

sections.label: Doha 39
sections.name: जाइ दीख रघुबंसमनि नरपति निपट कुसाजु

verses.sa:
आनहु रामहि बेगि बोलाई ।
समाचार तब पूँछेहु आई ॥
verses.tr:
ānahu rāmahi begi bolāī
samācār tab pūm̐chehu āī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
चलेउ सुमंत्र राय रूख जानी ।
लखी कुचालि कीन्हि कछु रानी ॥
verses.tr:
caleu sumaṃtr rāya rūkh jānī
lakhī kucāli kīnhi kachu rānī

verses.sa:
सोच बिकल मग परइ न पाऊ ।
रामहि बोलि कहिहि का राऊ ॥
verses.tr:
soc bikal mag parai na pāū
rāmahi boli kahihi kā rāū

verses.sa:
उर धरि धीरजु गयउ दुआरें ।
पूछँहिं सकल देखि मनु मारें ॥
verses.tr:
ur dhari dhīraju gayau duāreṃ
pūcham̐hiṃ sakal dekhi manu māreṃ

verses.sa:
समाधानु करि सो सबही का ।
गयउ जहाँ दिनकर कुल टीका ॥
verses.tr:
samādhānu kari so sabahī kā
gayau jahām̐ dinakar kul ṭīkā

verses.sa:
रामु सुमंत्रहि आवत देखा ।
आदरु कीन्ह पिता सम लेखा ॥
verses.tr:
rāmu sumaṃtrahi āvat dekhā
ādaru kīnh pitā sam lekhā

verses.sa:
निरखि बदनु कहि भूप रजाई ।
रघुकुलदीपहि चलेउ लेवाई ॥
verses.tr:
nirakhi badanu kahi bhūp rajāī
raghukuladīpahi caleu levāī

verses.sa:
रामु कुभाँति सचिव सँग जाहीं ।
देखि लोग जहँ तहँ बिलखाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
rāmu kubhām̐ti saciv sam̐g jāhīṃ
dekhi log jaham̐ taham̐ bilakhāhīṃ

verses.sa: जाइ दीख रघुबंसमनि नरपति निपट कुसाजु ॥
verses.tr: jāi dīkh raghubaṃsamani narapati nipaṭ kusāju
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: सहमि परेउ लखि सिंघिनिहि मनहुँ बृद्ध गजराजु ॥
verses.tr: sahami pareu lakhi siṃghinihi manahum̐ bṛddh gajarāju

trans: Go at once and send Rama here, and when you come back you can ask what the matter is.” Perceiving it to be the king’s wish, Sumanta went; but he saw that the queen had formed some evil design. Sv anxious was he that his feet scarcely touched the ground as he wondered to himself: ‘What will the king have to say to Rama?’ Composing himself as he reached the gate, when all observed his sadness and asked the cause, he reassured them and proceeded to the prince’s abode. When Rama saw Sumanta coming, he received him with the same honour that he would have shown to his own father. Looking him in the face, he declared the king’s commands and returned with him. Remarking the state of disorder in‘ which Rama accompanied the minister, the people began to be a little anxious.

When the jewel of Raghu’s race had come and _ beheld the king’s miserable condition, Like some aged and pain-stricken elephant in the power of a tigress, his lips became parched and his body all aflame, like a poor snake that has been robbed of the jewel in its head. Seeing the furious Kaikeyi near, like death counting the minutes, the pitiful and amiable Raghunath, though he now for the first time saw sorrow, and had never before heard its name even, composed himself as the occasion required and in pleasant tones

sections.label: Doha 40
sections.name: सुत सनेह इत बचनु उत संकट परेउ नरेसु

verses.sa:
सूखहिं अधर जरइ सबु अंगू ।
मनहुँ दीन मनिहीन भुअंगू ॥
verses.tr:
sūkhahiṃ adhar jarai sabu aṃgū
manahum̐ dīn manihīn bhuaṃgū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सरुष समीप दीखि कैकेई ।
मानहुँ मीचु घरी गनि लेई ॥
verses.tr:
saruṣ samīp dīkhi kaikeī
mānahum̐ mīcu gharī gani leī

verses.sa:
करुनामय मृदु राम सुभाऊ ।
प्रथम दीख दुखु सुना न काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
karunāmaya mṛdu rām subhāū
pratham dīkh dukhu sunā na kāū

verses.sa:
तदपि धीर धरि समउ बिचारी ।
पूँछी मधुर बचन महतारी ॥
verses.tr:
tadapi dhīr dhari samau bicārī
pūm̐chī madhur bacan mahatārī

verses.sa:
मोहि कहु मातु तात दुख कारन ।
करिअ जतन जेहिं होइ निवारन ॥
verses.tr:
mohi kahu mātu tāt dukh kāran
karia jatan jehiṃ hoi nivāran

verses.sa:
सुनहु राम सबु कारन एहू ।
राजहि तुम पर बहुत सनेहू ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu rām sabu kāran ehū
rājahi tum par bahut sanehū

verses.sa:
देन कहेन्हि मोहि दुइ बरदाना ।
मागेउँ जो कछु मोहि सोहाना ॥
verses.tr:
den kahenhi mohi dui baradānā
māgeum̐ jo kachu mohi sohānā

verses.sa:
सो सुनि भयउ भूप उर सोचू ।
छाड़ि न सकहिं तुम्हार सँकोचू ॥
verses.tr:
so suni bhayau bhūp ur socū
chār̤i na sakahiṃ tumhār sam̐kocū

verses.sa:
सुत सनेह इत बचनु उत संकट परेउ नरेसु ।
सकहु न आयसु धरहु सिर मेटहु कठिन कलेसु ॥
verses.tr:
sut saneh it bacanu ut saṃkaṭ pareu naresu
sakahu na āyasu dharahu sir meṭahu kaṭhin kalesu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: asked his mother: ‘Tell me, mother, the cause of my father’s distress, that I may endeavour to put an end to it.” ** Listen, Rama: the sole cause is this: the king is very fond of you: he has promised to grant me two requests, and I have asked for what I wanted; but he is disturbed on hearing them and cannot get rid of a scruple on your acconnt.
On the one side is his love for his son; in the other his promise; he is thus ina strait. If it lies in your power, be obedient to his commands and so terminate his misery.”

sections.label: Doha 41
sections.name: मुनिगन मिलनु बिसेषि बन सबहि भाँति हित मोर

verses.sa:
निधरक बैठि कहइ कटु बानी ।
सुनत कठिनता अति अकुलानी ॥
verses.tr:
nidharak baiṭhi kahai kaṭu bānī
sunat kaṭhinatā ati akulānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जीभ कमान बचन सर नाना ।
मनहुँ महिप मृदु लच्छ समाना ॥
verses.tr:
jībh kamān bacan sar nānā
manahum̐ mahip mṛdu lacch samānā

verses.sa:
जनु कठोरपनु धरें सरीरू ।
सिखइ धनुषबिद्या बर बीरू ॥
verses.tr:
janu kaṭhorapanu dhareṃ sarīrū
sikhai dhanuṣabidyā bar bīrū

verses.sa:
सब प्रसंगु रघुपतिहि सुनाई ।
बैठि मनहुँ तनु धरि निठुराई ॥
verses.tr:
sab prasaṃgu raghupatihi sunāī
baiṭhi manahum̐ tanu dhari niṭhurāī

verses.sa:
मन मुसकाइ भानुकुल भानु ।
रामु सहज आनंद निधानू ॥
verses.tr:
man musakāi bhānukul bhānu
rāmu sahaj ānaṃd nidhānū

verses.sa:
बोले बचन बिगत सब दूषन ।
मृदु मंजुल जनु बाग बिभूषन ॥
verses.tr:
bole bacan bigat sab dūṣan
mṛdu maṃjul janu bāg bibhūṣan

verses.sa:
सुनु जननी सोइ सुतु बड़भागी ।
जो पितु मातु बचन अनुरागी ॥
verses.tr:
sunu jananī soi sutu bar̤abhāgī
jo pitu mātu bacan anurāgī

verses.sa:
तनय मातु पितु तोषनिहारा ।
दुर्लभ जननि सकल संसारा ॥
verses.tr:
tanaya mātu pitu toṣanihārā
durlabh janani sakal saṃsārā

verses.sa:
मुनिगन मिलनु बिसेषि बन सबहि भाँति हित मोर ।
तेहि महँ पितु आयसु बहुरि संमत जननी तोर ॥
verses.tr:
munigan milanu biseṣi ban sabahi bhām̐ti hit mor
tehi maham̐ pitu āyasu bahuri saṃmat jananī tor
verses.head: दोहा

trans: She sat and spoke stinging words so composedly that Cruelty itself was disturbed to hear her. From the bow of her tongue she shot forth the arrows of her speech against the king as it were some yielding target; us though Obduracy had taken form and become a bold and practised archer. Sitting like the very incarnation of heartlessness, she expounded to Raghupati the whole history. Rama, the sun of the Solar race, the fountain of every joy, smiled inwardly and replied in guileless terms, so soft and gracious that they seemed the very jewels of the goddess of speech: ‘Hearken, mother; blessed is the son who obeys his parent’s commands; a son who cherishes his father and mother is not often found in the world.
I have a particular. wish to join the hermits in the woods and now there is also my father’s order and your approval, mother.

sections.label: Doha 42
sections.name: सहज सरल रघुबर बचन कुमति कुटिल करि जान

verses.sa:
भरत प्रानप्रिय पावहिं राजू ।
बिधि सब बिधि मोहि सनमुख आजु ॥
verses.tr:
bharat prānapriya pāvahiṃ rājū
bidhi sab bidhi mohi sanamukh āju
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जों न जाउँ बन ऐसेहु काजा ।
प्रथम गनिअ मोहि मूढ़ समाजा ॥
verses.tr:
joṃ na jāum̐ ban aisehu kājā
pratham gania mohi mūr̤h samājā

verses.sa:
सेवहिं अरँडु कलपतरु त्यागी ।
परिहरि अमृत लेहिं बिषु मागी ॥
verses.tr:
sevahiṃ aram̐ḍu kalapataru tyāgī
parihari amṛt lehiṃ biṣu māgī

verses.sa:
तेउ न पाइ अस समउ चुकाहीं ।
देखु बिचारि मातु मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
teu na pāi as samau cukāhīṃ
dekhu bicāri mātu man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
अंब एक दुखु मोहि बिसेषी ।
निपट बिकल नरनायकु देखी ॥
verses.tr:
aṃb ek dukhu mohi biseṣī
nipaṭ bikal naranāyaku dekhī

verses.sa:
थोरिहिं बात पितहि दुख भारी ।
होति प्रतीति न मोहि महतारी ॥
verses.tr:
thorihiṃ bāt pitahi dukh bhārī
hoti pratīti na mohi mahatārī

verses.sa:
राउ धीर गुन उदधि अगाधू ।
भा मोहि ते कछु बड़ अपराधू ॥
verses.tr:
rāu dhīr gun udadhi agādhū
bhā mohi te kachu bar̤ aparādhū

verses.sa:
जातें मोहि न कहत कछु राऊ ।
मोरि सपथ तोहि कहु सतिभाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
jāteṃ mohi na kahat kachu rāū
mori sapath tohi kahu satibhāū

verses.sa:
सहज सरल रघुबर बचन कुमति कुटिल करि जान ।
चलइ जोंक जल बक्रगति जद्यपि सलिलु समान ॥
verses.tr:
sahaj saral raghubar bacan kumati kuṭil kari jān
calai joṃk jal bakragati jadyapi salilu samān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Bharat, moreover, whom I Love as myself, will obtain the kingdom; in every way God favours me to-day. If I go not-to the woods under these circumstances, then reckon ine. first in any assembly of fools. ‘They who desert the tree of paradise to tend a castor-oil plant, or refuse ambrosia to ask for poison, having once lost their chance, will never get it again; see, mother, and ponder this in your heart. One special anxiety still remains, when I see the king so exceedingly disturbed. I cannot understand, mother, how my father can be so much pained by sucha trifling matter. He is stout-hearted and a fathomless ocean of piety; there must have been some great offence oo my part, that he will not say a word to me: I adjure you to tell me the truth.”
Though Raghubar’s words were as straightforward as possible, the wicked queen gave them a perverse twist 2; like a leech, which must always move crookedly, however smooth the water be.

sections.label: Doha 43
sections.name: गइ मुरुछा रामहि सुमिरि नृप फिरि करवट लीन्ह

verses.sa:
रहसी रानि राम रुख पाई ।
बोली कपट सनेहु जनाई ॥
verses.tr:
rahasī rāni rām rukh pāī
bolī kapaṭ sanehu janāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सपथ तुम्हार भरत कै आना ।
हेतु न दूसर मै कछु जाना ॥
verses.tr:
sapath tumhār bharat kai ānā
hetu na dūsar mai kachu jānā

verses.sa:
तुम्ह अपराध जोगु नहिं ताता ।
जननी जनक बंधु सुखदाता ॥
verses.tr:
tumh aparādh jogu nahiṃ tātā
jananī janak baṃdhu sukhadātā

verses.sa:
राम सत्य सबु जो कछु कहहू ।
तुम्ह पितु मातु बचन रत अहहू ॥
verses.tr:
rām satya sabu jo kachu kahahū
tumh pitu mātu bacan rat ahahū

verses.sa:
पितहि बुझाइ कहहु बलि सोई ।
चौथेंपन जेहिं अजसु न होई ॥
verses.tr:
pitahi bujhāi kahahu bali soī
cautheṃpan jehiṃ ajasu na hoī

verses.sa:
तुम्ह सम सुअन सुकृत जेहिं दीन्हे ।
उचित न तासु निरादरु कीन्हे ॥
verses.tr:
tumh sam suan sukṛt jehiṃ dīnhe
ucit na tāsu nirādaru kīnhe

verses.sa:
लागहिं कुमुख बचन सुभ कैसे ।
मगहँ गयादिक तीरथ जैसे ॥
verses.tr:
lāgahiṃ kumukh bacan subh kaise
magaham̐ gayādik tīrath jaise

verses.sa:
रामहि मातु बचन सब भाए ।
जिमि सुरसरि गत सलिल सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
rāmahi mātu bacan sab bhāe
jimi surasari gat salil suhāe

verses.sa:
गइ मुरुछा रामहि सुमिरि नृप फिरि करवट लीन्ह ।
सचिव राम आगमन कहि बिनय समय सम कीन्ह ॥
verses.tr:
gai muruchā rāmahi sumiri nṛp phiri karavaṭ līnh
saciv rām āgaman kahi binaya samaya sam kīnh
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Seeing Rama’s readiness, the queen smiled and said with much show of false affection: ‘I swear by yourself and Bharat, there is no other cause that I know of. There is no room for fault in you, my son, who confer such happiness both on your parents and your brother. All that you say, R^ma, is true; you are devoted to the wishes of your father and mother. Remonstrate, then, solemaly with your sire, that he incar not sin and disgrace in his old age. Having been blest with a son like you, he cannot properly disregard your advice.” These fair words in her false mouth were like Gaya and the other holy places that are in Magadba: but Rama took his mother’s speech io good part, like the Ganges, which in its course receives and hallows any stream.
At the remembrance of Rama, the king’s swoon left him and he turned on his side. Taking advantage of the opportunity, the minister humbly informed him of Rama’s arrival.

sections.label: Doha 44
sections.name: तुम्ह प्रेरक सब के हृदयँ सो मति रामहि देहु

verses.sa:
अवनिप अकनि रामु पगु धारे ।
धरि धीरजु तब नयन उघारे ॥
verses.tr:
avanip akani rāmu pagu dhāre
dhari dhīraju tab nayan ughāre
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सचिवँ सँभारि राउ बैठारे ।
चरन परत नृप रामु निहारे ॥
verses.tr:
sacivam̐ sam̐bhāri rāu baiṭhāre
caran parat nṛp rāmu nihāre

verses.sa:
लिए सनेह बिकल उर लाई ।
गै मनि मनहुँ फनिक फिरि पाई ॥
verses.tr:
lie saneh bikal ur lāī
gai mani manahum̐ phanik phiri pāī

verses.sa:
रामहि चितइ रहेउ नरनाहू ।
चला बिलोचन बारि प्रबाहू ॥
verses.tr:
rāmahi citai raheu naranāhū
calā bilocan bāri prabāhū

verses.sa:
सोक बिबस कछु कहै न पारा ।
हृदयँ लगावत बारहिं बारा ॥
verses.tr:
sok bibas kachu kahai na pārā
hṛdayam̐ lagāvat bārahiṃ bārā

verses.sa:
बिधिहि मनाव राउ मन माहीं ।
जेहिं रघुनाथ न कानन जाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bidhihi manāv rāu man māhīṃ
jehiṃ raghunāth na kānan jāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सुमिरि महेसहि कहइ निहोरी ।
बिनती सुनहु सदासिव मोरी ॥
verses.tr:
sumiri mahesahi kahai nihorī
binatī sunahu sadāsiv morī

verses.sa:
आसुतोष तुम्ह अवढर दानी ।
आरति हरहु दीन जनु जानी ॥
verses.tr:
āsutoṣ tumh avaḍhar dānī
ārati harahu dīn janu jānī

verses.sa:
तुम्ह प्रेरक सब के हृदयँ सो मति रामहि देहु ।
बचनु मोर तजि रहहि घर परिहरि सीलु सनेहु ॥
verses.tr:
tumh prerak sab ke hṛdayam̐ so mati rāmahi dehu
bacanu mor taji rahahi ghar parihari sīlu sanehu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When the king heard that Rama had come, he summoned up courage and opened his eyes. The minister supported his‘sovereign to a seat, where the king saw Rama falling at his feet. In an agony of affection, he clasped him to his bosom, like some snake that has recovered the jewel it had of tears came into his eyes, nor in his sore distress could be utter a word, but again and again he pressed him to his heart. Inwardly he was praying God that Ragbaneth might not be banished to the woods; and remembering Mahadeva humbly begged: ‘Immortal Siva, hear my petition; thou art easily satisfied, compassionate and generous; recognize then in me a poor suppliant and remove my distress.
As thou directest the hearts of all, give Rama the sense to disregard my words and stay at home, forgetful for once of his filial affection.

sections.label: Doha 45
sections.name: मंगल समय सनेह बस सोच परिहरिअ तात

verses.sa:
अजसु होउ जग सुजसु नसाऊ ।
नरक परौ बरु सुरपुरु जाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
ajasu hou jag sujasu nasāū
narak parau baru surapuru jāū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सब दुख दुसह सहावहु मोही ।
लोचन ओट रामु जनि होंही ॥
verses.tr:
sab dukh dusah sahāvahu mohī
locan oṭ rāmu jani hoṃhī

verses.sa:
अस मन गुनइ राउ नहिं बोला ।
पीपर पात सरिस मनु डोला ॥
verses.tr:
as man gunai rāu nahiṃ bolā
pīpar pāt saris manu ḍolā

verses.sa:
रघुपति पितहि प्रेमबस जानी ।
पुनि कछु कहिहि मातु अनुमानी ॥
verses.tr:
raghupati pitahi premabas jānī
puni kachu kahihi mātu anumānī

verses.sa:
देस काल अवसर अनुसारी ।
बोले बचन बिनीत बिचारी ॥
verses.tr:
des kāl avasar anusārī
bole bacan binīt bicārī

verses.sa:
तात कहउँ कछु करउँ ढिठाई ।
अनुचितु छमब जानि लरिकाई ॥
verses.tr:
tāt kahaum̐ kachu karaum̐ ḍhiṭhāī
anucitu chamab jāni larikāī

verses.sa:
अति लघु बात लागि दुखु पावा ।
काहुँ न मोहि कहि प्रथम जनावा ॥
verses.tr:
ati laghu bāt lāgi dukhu pāvā
kāhum̐ na mohi kahi pratham janāvā

verses.sa:
देखि गोसाइँहि पूँछिउँ माता ।
सुनि प्रसंगु भए सीतल गाता ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi gosāim̐hi pūm̐chium̐ mātā
suni prasaṃgu bhae sītal gātā

verses.sa:
मंगल समय सनेह बस सोच परिहरिअ तात ।
आयसु देइअ हरषि हियँ कहि पुलके प्रभु गात ॥
verses.tr:
maṃgal samaya saneh bas soc pariharia tāt
āyasu deia haraṣi hiyam̐ kahi pulake prabhu gāt
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Welcome disgrace and perish my good name; may I sink into Hell rather than mount to Heaven; be it mine to support the most intolerable pain rather than have Rama taken from my sight.” Thinking thus to himself, the king spoke not a word, while his soul quivered like a pipal leaf. Perceiving his father to be thus overpowered with love, Raghupati spoke again with a view to his mother, in modest and thoughtful phrase, as the place, the time, and the circumstances demanded: “Father, if I speak a little wilfally, forgive the offence by reason of my childish years. You are troubled about a very little matter; why did you not speak and let me know of this at the first After seeing you, sire, 1 questioned my mother, and on hearing her explanation my fear subsided.
Put away, father, the anxiety which at this time of rejoicing your affection has caused you, and give me your commands:” so spoke the Lord with heartfelt joy and a body quivering with emotion..

sections.label: Doha 46
sections.name: मुख सुखाहिं लोचन स्त्रवहि सोकु न हृदयँ समाइ

verses.sa:
धन्य जनमु जगतीतल तासू ।
पितहि प्रमोदु चरित सुनि जासू ॥
verses.tr:
dhanya janamu jagatītal tāsū
pitahi pramodu carit suni jāsū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
चारि पदारथ करतल ताकें ।
प्रिय पितु मातु प्रान सम जाकें ॥
verses.tr:
cāri padārath karatal tākeṃ
priya pitu mātu prān sam jākeṃ

verses.sa:
आयसु पालि जनम फलु पाई ।
ऐहउँ बेगिहिं होउ रजाई ॥
verses.tr:
āyasu pāli janam phalu pāī
aihaum̐ begihiṃ hou rajāī

verses.sa:
बिदा मातु सन आवउँ मागी ।
चलिहउँ बनहि बहुरि पग लागी ॥
verses.tr:
bidā mātu san āvaum̐ māgī
calihaum̐ banahi bahuri pag lāgī

verses.sa:
अस कहि राम गवनु तब कीन्हा ।
भूप सोक बसु उतरु न दीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi rām gavanu tab kīnhā
bhūp sok basu utaru na dīnhā

verses.sa:
नगर ब्यापि गइ बात सुतीछी ।
छुअत चढ़ी जनु सब तन बीछी ॥
verses.tr:
nagar byāpi gai bāt sutīchī
chuat car̤hī janu sab tan bīchī

verses.sa:
सुनि भए बिकल सकल नर नारी ।
बेलि बिटप जिमि देखि दवारी ॥
verses.tr:
suni bhae bikal sakal nar nārī
beli biṭap jimi dekhi davārī

verses.sa:
जो जहँ सुनइ धुनइ सिरु सोई ।
बड़ बिषादु नहिं धीरजु होई ॥
verses.tr:
jo jaham̐ sunai dhunai siru soī
bar̤ biṣādu nahiṃ dhīraju hoī

verses.sa:
मुख सुखाहिं लोचन स्त्रवहि सोकु न हृदयँ समाइ ।
मनहुँ करुन रस कटकई उतरी अवध बजाइ ॥
verses.tr:
mukh sukhāhiṃ locan stravahi soku na hṛdayam̐ samāi
manahum̐ karun ras kaṭakaī utarī avadh bajāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘Blessed is his birth into the world whose father is rejoiced to hear of his doings. He has in his hand all the four rewards of life, who holds his parents dear as his own life. By obeying your orders, I attain the end of my existence. If then it be your command, I can soon come back, and after taking Leave of my mother, I will throw my- _ self once more at your feet and then start for the woods.”

Having thus spoken, Rama departed, while the King in his anguish answered not a word. The bitter news spread through the city, like the sting of a scorpion that at once affects the whole body. Every man or woman that heard it was as distrest as the creepers and bushes when a forest is on fire. Wherever it was told, every one beat his head, and the grief was too great to be endared.

Their lips were parched, their eyes streamed, their heart could not contain their sorrow; it seemed as though the Pathetic, in battle array and with beat of drum, had marched into Avadh and taken up quarters there.

sections.label: Doha 47
sections.name: काह न पावकु जारि सक का न समुद्र समाइ

verses.sa:
मिलेहि माझ बिधि बात बेगारी ।
जहँ तहँ देहिं कैकेइहि गारी ॥
verses.tr:
milehi mājh bidhi bāt begārī
jaham̐ taham̐ dehiṃ kaikeihi gārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
एहि पापिनिहि बूझि का परेऊ ।
छाइ भवन पर पावकु धरेऊ ॥
verses.tr:
ehi pāpinihi būjhi kā pareū
chāi bhavan par pāvaku dhareū

verses.sa:
निज कर नयन काढ़ि चह दीखा ।
डारि सुधा बिषु चाहत चीखा ॥
verses.tr:
nij kar nayan kār̤hi cah dīkhā
ḍāri sudhā biṣu cāhat cīkhā

verses.sa:
कुटिल कठोर कुबुद्धि अभागी ।
भइ रघुबंस बेनु बन आगी ॥
verses.tr:
kuṭil kaṭhor kubuddhi abhāgī
bhai raghubaṃs benu ban āgī

verses.sa:
पालव बैठि पेड़ु एहिं काटा ।
सुख महुँ सोक ठाटु धरि ठाटा ॥
verses.tr:
pālav baiṭhi per̤u ehiṃ kāṭā
sukh mahum̐ sok ṭhāṭu dhari ṭhāṭā

verses.sa:
सदा रामु एहि प्रान समाना ।
कारन कवन कुटिलपनु ठाना ॥
verses.tr:
sadā rāmu ehi prān samānā
kāran kavan kuṭilapanu ṭhānā

verses.sa:
सत्य कहहिं कबि नारि सुभाऊ ।
सब बिधि अगहु अगाध दुराऊ ॥
verses.tr:
satya kahahiṃ kabi nāri subhāū
sab bidhi agahu agādh durāū

verses.sa:
निज प्रतिबिंबु बरुकु गहि जाई ।
जानि न जाइ नारि गति भाई ॥
verses.tr:
nij pratibiṃbu baruku gahi jāī
jāni na jāi nāri gati bhāī

verses.sa:
काह न पावकु जारि सक का न समुद्र समाइ ।
का न करै अबला प्रबल केहि जग कालु न खाइ ॥
verses.tr:
kāh na pāvaku jāri sak kā na samudr samāi
kā na karai abalā prabal kehi jag kālu na khāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “It was a well-contrived plan, but God has spoilt it.” In this fashion they kept abusing Kaikeyi: ‘' What could this wicked woman mean by thus setting fire to a new-thatched house; who tears out her eyes with her own hands, and yet wishes to see; who throws away ambrosia and prefers the taste of poison; cruel stubborn, demented wretch, a very fire among the reeds of Raghu’s line; who sitting ona branch of the tree has hacked down the stem; and in the midst of joy has introduced this tragedy? Rama used ever to be dear to her as life; for what reason has she now taken to such perversity The poets say truly that a woman’s mind is altogether inscrutable, unfathomable and beyond comprehension. Sooner may a man catch his own shadow in the glass than grasp the ways of a woman.
What is there that fire will not burn; what is there that ocean cannot contain; what cannot a woman doin her strength; or what is there in the world that death does not

sections.label: Doha 48
sections.name: चंदु चवै बरु अनल कन सुधा होइ बिषतूल

verses.sa:
का सुनाइ बिधि काह सुनावा ।
का देखाइ चह काह देखावा ॥
verses.tr:
kā sunāi bidhi kāh sunāvā
kā dekhāi cah kāh dekhāvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
एक कहहिं भल भूप न कीन्हा ।
बरु बिचारि नहिं कुमतिहि दीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
ek kahahiṃ bhal bhūp na kīnhā
baru bicāri nahiṃ kumatihi dīnhā

verses.sa:
जो हठि भयउ सकल दुख भाजनु ।
अबला बिबस ग्यानु गुनु गा जनु ॥
verses.tr:
jo haṭhi bhayau sakal dukh bhājanu
abalā bibas gyānu gunu gā janu

verses.sa:
एक धरम परमिति पहिचाने ।
नृपहि दोसु नहिं देहिं सयाने ॥
verses.tr:
ek dharam paramiti pahicāne
nṛpahi dosu nahiṃ dehiṃ sayāne

verses.sa:
सिबि दधीचि हरिचंद कहानी ।
एक एक सन कहहिं बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
sibi dadhīci haricaṃd kahānī
ek ek san kahahiṃ bakhānī

verses.sa:
एक भरत कर संमत कहहीं ।
एक उदास भायँ सुनि रहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ek bharat kar saṃmat kahahīṃ
ek udās bhāyam̐ suni rahahīṃ

verses.sa:
कान मूदि कर रद गहि जीहा ।
एक कहहिं यह बात अलीहा ॥
verses.tr:
kān mūdi kar rad gahi jīhā
ek kahahiṃ yah bāt alīhā

verses.sa:
सुकृत जाहिं अस कहत तुम्हारे ।
रामु भरत कहुँ प्रानपिआरे ॥
verses.tr:
sukṛt jāhiṃ as kahat tumhāre
rāmu bharat kahum̐ prānapiāre

verses.sa:
चंदु चवै बरु अनल कन सुधा होइ बिषतूल ।
सपनेहुँ कबहुँ न करहिं किछु भरतु राम प्रतिकूल ॥
verses.tr:
caṃdu cavai baru anal kan sudhā hoi biṣatūl
sapanehum̐ kabahum̐ na karahiṃ kichu bharatu rām pratikūl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: God first ordained one thing, but now ordains something quite different, and what he would show us now is | the very reverse of what he showed us then.” Said one: “The king has not done well, and without consideration has granted the wicked woman her request. He has wilfally brought all this misery upon himself, and in yielding toa woman has lost all good sense and discretion.” Another wisely recognized the king's supreme virtue and would not blame him, as they repeated to one another the legends of Siva, Dadhichi, and Harischandra.' One suggested Bharat’s connivance, another was distressed at the mention of such a thing; while a third stopping his ears with his hands and biting his tongue exclaimed: ‘“‘ Such words are false; you damn yourself hy. saying such things. Bharat is Rama’s dearest friend.;
Sooner shall the moon rain sparks of fire, or ambrosia have the same effect as poison, than Bharat ever dream of doing anything to injure Rama,”

sections.label: Doha 49
sections.name: सीय कि पिय सँगु परिहरिहि लखनु कि रहिहहिं धाम

verses.sa:
एक बिधातहिं दूषनु देंहीं ।
सुधा देखाइ दीन्ह बिषु जेहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ek bidhātahiṃ dūṣanu deṃhīṃ
sudhā dekhāi dīnh biṣu jehīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
खरभरु नगर सोचु सब काहू ।
दुसह दाहु उर मिटा उछाहू ॥
verses.tr:
kharabharu nagar socu sab kāhū
dusah dāhu ur miṭā uchāhū

verses.sa:
बिप्रबधू कुलमान्य जठेरी ।
जे प्रिय परम कैकेई केरी ॥
verses.tr:
biprabadhū kulamānya jaṭherī
je priya param kaikeī kerī

verses.sa:
लगीं देन सिख सीलु सराही ।
बचन बानसम लागहिं ताही ॥
verses.tr:
lagīṃ den sikh sīlu sarāhī
bacan bānasam lāgahiṃ tāhī

verses.sa:
भरतु न मोहि प्रिय राम समाना ।
सदा कहहु यहु सबु जगु जाना ॥
verses.tr:
bharatu na mohi priya rām samānā
sadā kahahu yahu sabu jagu jānā

verses.sa:
करहु राम पर सहज सनेहू ।
केहिं अपराध आजु बनु देहू ॥
verses.tr:
karahu rām par sahaj sanehū
kehiṃ aparādh āju banu dehū

verses.sa:
कबहुँ न कियहु सवति आरेसू ।
प्रीति प्रतीति जान सबु देसू ॥
verses.tr:
kabahum̐ na kiyahu savati āresū
prīti pratīti jān sabu desū

verses.sa:
कौसल्याँ अब काह बिगारा ।
तुम्ह जेहि लागि बज्र पुर पारा ॥
verses.tr:
kausalyām̐ ab kāh bigārā
tumh jehi lāgi bajr pur pārā

verses.sa:
सीय कि पिय सँगु परिहरिहि लखनु कि रहिहहिं धाम ।
राजु कि भूँजब भरत पुर नृपु कि जिइहि बिनु राम ॥
verses.tr:
sīya ki piya sam̐gu pariharihi lakhanu ki rahihahiṃ dhām
rāju ki bhūm̐jab bharat pur nṛpu ki jiihi binu rām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: One reproached the Creator, who had promised ambrosia but given poison. The whole city was agitated and every one so sad that the intolerable pain in their heart utterly effaced all the previous rejoicing. The venerable and highborn Brahman matrons, who were Kaikeyi’s chief friends, began to give her advice and praise her good disposition; but their words pierced her like arrows: You have always said, as every one knows, that Bharat was not so dear to you as Rama: show him, then, your wonted affection; for what offence do you now banish him to the woods You have never shown any jealousy of the rival queens; your love and confidence in them were known throughout the land. What has Kausalya done wrong now that you should launch this thunderbolt against the city?
What! will Sita desert her spouse, or Lakshman remain her at home Will Bharat enjoy the dominion of the state, or the king survive without Rama.

sections.label: Doha 50
sections.name: सखिन्ह सिखावनु दीन्ह सुनत मधुर परिनाम हित

verses.sa:
अस बिचारि उर छाड़हु कोहू ।
सोक कलंक कोठि जनि होहू ॥
verses.tr:
as bicāri ur chār̤ahu kohū
sok kalaṃk koṭhi jani hohū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भरतहि अवसि देहु जुबराजू ।
कानन काह राम कर काजू ॥
verses.tr:
bharatahi avasi dehu jubarājū
kānan kāh rām kar kājū

verses.sa:
नाहिन रामु राज के भूखे ।
धरम धुरीन बिषय रस रूखे ॥
verses.tr:
nāhin rāmu rāj ke bhūkhe
dharam dhurīn biṣaya ras rūkhe

verses.sa:
गुर गृह बसहुँ रामु तजि गेहू ।
नृप सन अस बरु दूसर लेहू ॥
verses.tr:
gur gṛh basahum̐ rāmu taji gehū
nṛp san as baru dūsar lehū

verses.sa:
जौं नहिं लगिहहु कहें हमारे ।
नहिं लागिहि कछु हाथ तुम्हारे ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ nahiṃ lagihahu kaheṃ hamāre
nahiṃ lāgihi kachu hāth tumhāre

verses.sa:
जौं परिहास कीन्हि कछु होई ।
तौ कहि प्रगट जनावहु सोई ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ parihās kīnhi kachu hoī
tau kahi pragaṭ janāvahu soī

verses.sa:
राम सरिस सुत कानन जोगू ।
काह कहिहि सुनि तुम्ह कहुँ लोगू ॥
verses.tr:
rām saris sut kānan jogū
kāh kahihi suni tumh kahum̐ logū

verses.sa:
उठहु बेगि सोइ करहु उपाई ।
जेहि बिधि सोकु कलंकु नसाई ॥
verses.tr:
uṭhahu begi soi karahu upāī
jehi bidhi soku kalaṃku nasāī

verses.sa:
जेहि भाँति सोकु कलंकु जाइ उपाय करि कुल पालही ।
हठि फेरु रामहि जात बन जनि बात दूसरि चालही ॥
verses.tr:
jehi bhām̐ti soku kalaṃku jāi upāya kari kul pālahī
haṭhi pheru rāmahi jāt ban jani bāt dūsari cālahī
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
जिमि भानु बिनु दिनु प्रान बिनु तनु चंद बिनु जिमि जामिनी ।
तिमि अवध तुलसीदास प्रभु बिनु समुझि धौं जियँ भामिनी ॥
verses.tr:
jimi bhānu binu dinu prān binu tanu caṃd binu jimi jāminī
timi avadh tulasīdās prabhu binu samujhi dhauṃ jiyam̐ bhāminī

verses.sa:
सखिन्ह सिखावनु दीन्ह सुनत मधुर परिनाम हित ।
तेइँ कछु कान न कीन्ह कुटिल प्रबोधी कूबरी ॥
verses.tr:
sakhinh sikhāvanu dīnh sunat madhur parinām hit
teim̐ kachu kān na kīnh kuṭil prabodhī kūbarī
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Reflect upon this and expel passion from your breast,
nor make yourself a stronghold of remorse and disgrace.

By all means make Bharat the king's coadjutor; but what need is there for Rama to be banished to the woods 7 Rama is not greedy of royal power; he is righteous and averse to sensual pleasures. Lethim leave the, palace and go and live with his guru; ask this of the king as yaar second petition. A son like Rama does not deserve, banish: ment; what will people say to you when they hear of it? lf you do not agree to what I tell you, nothing will prosper in your hands. If this is only some jest of yours, speak out clearly and let me know. Up quickly and devise a plan to avert future remorse and disgrace. ‘ehh

Devise a plan to avert remorse and disgrace and save your family. Beinstant in diverting Rama from going to the woods, and labour for nothing else. As the day with. out the sun, as the body without life, asthe night without the moon, so (says Tulsi Das) is Avadh without its lord; I beg you, lady, to consider this.”
Pleasant to hear and beneficial io result was the advice her friends gave; but she paid no heed to ‘it, having been tutored in villainy by Humpback.

sections.label: Doha 51
sections.name: नव गयंदु रघुबीर मनु राजु अलान समान

verses.sa:
उतरु न देइ दुसह रिस रूखी ।
मृगिन्ह चितव जनु बाघिनि भूखी ॥
verses.tr:
utaru na dei dusah ris rūkhī
mṛginh citav janu bāghini bhūkhī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
ब्याधि असाधि जानि तिन्ह त्यागी ।
चलीं कहत मतिमंद अभागी ॥
verses.tr:
byādhi asādhi jāni tinh tyāgī
calīṃ kahat matimaṃd abhāgī

verses.sa:
राजु करत यह दैअँ बिगोई ।
कीन्हेसि अस जस करइ न कोई ॥
verses.tr:
rāju karat yah daiam̐ bigoī
kīnhesi as jas karai na koī

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि बिलपहिं पुर नर नारीं ।
देहिं कुचालिहि कोटिक गारीं ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi bilapahiṃ pur nar nārīṃ
dehiṃ kucālihi koṭik gārīṃ

verses.sa:
जरहिं बिषम जर लेहिं उसासा ।
कवनि राम बिनु जीवन आसा ॥
verses.tr:
jarahiṃ biṣam jar lehiṃ usāsā
kavani rām binu jīvan āsā

verses.sa:
बिपुल बियोग प्रजा अकुलानी ।
जनु जलचर गन सूखत पानी ॥
verses.tr:
bipul biyog prajā akulānī
janu jalacar gan sūkhat pānī

verses.sa:
अति बिषाद बस लोग लोगाई ।
गए मातु पहिं रामु गोसाई ॥
verses.tr:
ati biṣād bas log logāī
gae mātu pahiṃ rāmu gosāī

verses.sa:
मुख प्रसन्न चित चौगुन चाऊ ।
मिटा सोचु जनि राखै राऊ ॥
verses.tr:
mukh prasann cit caugun cāū
miṭā socu jani rākhai rāū

verses.sa:
नव गयंदु रघुबीर मनु राजु अलान समान ।
छूट जानि बन गवनु सुनि उर अनंदु अधिकान ॥
verses.tr:
nav gayaṃdu raghubīr manu rāju alān samān
chūṭ jāni ban gavanu suni ur anaṃdu adhikān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: She answered not a word, but raged with irrepressible fury like a hungry tigress that has spied a deer. Perceiving her disease to be incurable, they left her, saying as they went: ‘Demented wretch! Fate has destroyed her in her pride; she has acted in such a way as no one has ever acted before.” Thus all the men and women of the city were lamenting and heaping countless abuse on the wicked queen. Burning with intolerable fever they sob out: “What hope of life is there without Rama?” Agonized by his loss, the people were as miserable as creatures of the deep when water fails. Great was the distress of all, whether man or woman: but the saintly Rama went to his mother, with joy in his face and fourfold joy in his soul, fearing only that the king might detain him.
The Glory of Raghu's line resembled some young elephant with kingship for its chain: the news of banishment was ag its breaking: at which he rejoices exceedingly..

sections.label: Doha 52
sections.name: जेहि चाहत नर नारि सब अति आरत एहि भाँति

verses.sa:
रघुकुलतिलक जोरि दोउ हाथा ।
मुदित मातु पद नायउ माथा ॥
verses.tr:
raghukulatilak jori dou hāthā
mudit mātu pad nāyau māthā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
दीन्हि असीस लाइ उर लीन्हे ।
भूषन बसन निछावरि कीन्हे ॥
verses.tr:
dīnhi asīs lāi ur līnhe
bhūṣan basan nichāvari kīnhe

verses.sa:
बार बार मुख चुंबति माता ।
नयन नेह जलु पुलकित गाता ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār mukh cuṃbati mātā
nayan neh jalu pulakit gātā

verses.sa:
गोद राखि पुनि हृदयँ लगाए ।
स्त्रवत प्रेनरस पयद सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
god rākhi puni hṛdayam̐ lagāe
stravat prenaras payad suhāe

verses.sa:
प्रेमु प्रमोदु न कछु कहि जाई ।
रंक धनद पदबी जनु पाई ॥
verses.tr:
premu pramodu na kachu kahi jāī
raṃk dhanad padabī janu pāī

verses.sa:
सादर सुंदर बदनु निहारी ।
बोली मधुर बचन महतारी ॥
verses.tr:
sādar suṃdar badanu nihārī
bolī madhur bacan mahatārī

verses.sa:
कहहु तात जननी बलिहारी ।
कबहिं लगन मुद मंगलकारी ॥
verses.tr:
kahahu tāt jananī balihārī
kabahiṃ lagan mud maṃgalakārī

verses.sa:
सुकृत सील सुख सीवँ सुहाई ।
जनम लाभ कइ अवधि अघाई ॥
verses.tr:
sukṛt sīl sukh sīvam̐ suhāī
janam lābh kai avadhi aghāī

verses.sa:
जेहि चाहत नर नारि सब अति आरत एहि भाँति ।
जिमि चातक चातकि तृषित बृष्टि सरद रितु स्वाति ॥
verses.tr:
jehi cāhat nar nāri sab ati ārat ehi bhām̐ti
jimi cātak cātaki tṛṣit bṛṣṭi sarad ritu svāti
verses.head: दोहा

trans: With folded hands the Crown of Raghu’s line bowed his head blithely at his mother’s feet. She gave him her blessing and clasped him to her bosom, and scattered around him gifts of jewels and raiment. Again and again she kissed his face, with tears of joy in her eyes and her body all quivering with emotion. She seating him in her lap, she pressed him once more to her heart, while drops of affection trickled from her comely breasts. Her rapture of love was past all telling, like that of a beggar made all at once rich as Kuver. Tenderly regarding his lovely features, his mother thus addressed him in sweetest tones: ‘“ Tell me, my son, I adjure you as your mother,’ when is the happy moment to be»;_ you are such an exquisite paragon of piety, amiability and good fortune, that in you Avadh has reaped the full fruition of its existence:
For whom the people long as anxiously as a pair of thirsting chdetaks, in the season of autumn, for the rainfall of Arcturus.

sections.label: Doha 53
sections.name: बरष चारिदस बिपिन बसि करि पितु बचन प्रमान

verses.sa:
तात जाउँ बलि बेगि नहाहू ।
जो मन भाव मधुर कछु खाहू ॥
verses.tr:
tāt jāum̐ bali begi nahāhū
jo man bhāv madhur kachu khāhū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पितु समीप तब जाएहु भैआ ।
भइ बड़ि बार जाइ बलि मैआ ॥
verses.tr:
pitu samīp tab jāehu bhaiā
bhai bar̤i bār jāi bali maiā

verses.sa:
मातु बचन सुनि अति अनुकूला ।
जनु सनेह सुरतरु के फूला ॥
verses.tr:
mātu bacan suni ati anukūlā
janu saneh surataru ke phūlā

verses.sa:
सुख मकरंद भरे श्रियमूला ।
निरखि राम मनु भवरुँ न भूला ॥
verses.tr:
sukh makaraṃd bhare śriyamūlā
nirakhi rām manu bhavarum̐ na bhūlā

verses.sa:
धरम धुरीन धरम गति जानी ।
कहेउ मातु सन अति मृदु बानी ॥
verses.tr:
dharam dhurīn dharam gati jānī
kaheu mātu san ati mṛdu bānī

verses.sa:
पिताँ दीन्ह मोहि कानन राजू ।
जहँ सब भाँति मोर बड़ काजू ॥
verses.tr:
pitām̐ dīnh mohi kānan rājū
jaham̐ sab bhām̐ti mor bar̤ kājū

verses.sa:
आयसु देहि मुदित मन माता ।
जेहिं मुद मंगल कानन जाता ॥
verses.tr:
āyasu dehi mudit man mātā
jehiṃ mud maṃgal kānan jātā

verses.sa:
जनि सनेह बस डरपसि भोरें ।
आनँदु अंब अनुग्रह तोरें ॥
verses.tr:
jani saneh bas ḍarapasi bhoreṃ
ānam̐du aṃb anugrah toreṃ

verses.sa:
बरष चारिदस बिपिन बसि करि पितु बचन प्रमान ।
आइ पाय पुनि देखिहउँ मनु जनि करसि मलान ॥
verses.tr:
baraṣ cāridas bipin basi kari pitu bacan pramān
āi pāya puni dekhihaum̐ manu jani karasi malān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Go at once, my darling, I beg of you, and bathe and take something nice to eat, such as you like, and then, dear boy approach your father: I, your mother, protest there has been too much delay.” On hearing his mother’s most loving speech, which seemed as the flower of the paradisal tree of affection laden with the fragrance of delight and produced from the stem of prosperity, Rama’s bee-like soul was not distracted by the sight, but in his righteousness he distinguished the path of virtue, and thus in honeyed tones addressed his mother: *‘ My father has assigned me the woods for my realm, where I shall have much in every way todo. Give me your orders, mother, with a cheerful heart, that I too may cheerfully and in auspicious wise set outfor the forest. Do not in your affection give way to causeless alarm; my happiness, mother, depends on your
After staying fourteen years in the woods, in obedience to my sire’s command!, I will come back and again behold your feet; make not your mind uneasy.”

sections.label: Doha 54
sections.name: निरखि राम रुख सचिवसुत कारनु कहेउ बुझाइ

verses.sa:
बचन बिनीत मधुर रघुबर के ।
सर सम लगे मातु उर करके ॥
verses.tr:
bacan binīt madhur raghubar ke
sar sam lage mātu ur karake
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सहमि सूखि सुनि सीतलि बानी ।
जिमि जवास परें पावस पानी ॥
verses.tr:
sahami sūkhi suni sītali bānī
jimi javās pareṃ pāvas pānī

verses.sa:
कहि न जाइ कछु हृदय बिषादू ।
मनहुँ मृगी सुनि केहरि नादू ॥
verses.tr:
kahi na jāi kachu hṛdaya biṣādū
manahum̐ mṛgī suni kehari nādū

verses.sa:
नयन सजल तन थर थर काँपी ।
माजहि खाइ मीन जनु मापी ॥
verses.tr:
nayan sajal tan thar thar kām̐pī
mājahi khāi mīn janu māpī

verses.sa:
धरि धीरजु सुत बदनु निहारी ।
गदगद बचन कहति महतारी ॥
verses.tr:
dhari dhīraju sut badanu nihārī
gadagad bacan kahati mahatārī

verses.sa:
तात पितहि तुम्ह प्रानपिआरे ।
देखि मुदित नित चरित तुम्हारे ॥
verses.tr:
tāt pitahi tumh prānapiāre
dekhi mudit nit carit tumhāre

verses.sa:
राजु देन कहुँ सुभ दिन साधा ।
कहेउ जान बन केहिं अपराधा ॥
verses.tr:
rāju den kahum̐ subh din sādhā
kaheu jān ban kehiṃ aparādhā

verses.sa:
तात सुनावहु मोहि निदानू ।
को दिनकर कुल भयउ कृसानू ॥
verses.tr:
tāt sunāvahu mohi nidānū
ko dinakar kul bhayau kṛsānū

verses.sa:
निरखि राम रुख सचिवसुत कारनु कहेउ बुझाइ ।
सुनि प्रसंगु रहि मूक जिमि दसा बरनि नहिं जाइ ॥
verses.tr:
nirakhi rām rukh sacivasut kāranu kaheu bujhāi
suni prasaṃgu rahi mūk jimi dasā barani nahiṃ jāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Raghubar’s sweet and dutiful words pierced like arrows through his mother’s heart. At the sound of his chilling speech she withered and drooped like the jawdsa) at a shower in the rains. The anguish of her soul was past telling, as when an elephant shrinks at the roar of a tiger. Iler eyes filled with tears and her body trembled all over, like a fish overtaken by the scour of a Hooded river.2, Summiog up courage, she looked her son in the face and thus spoke, in faltering accents: “‘ My son, you are your father’s darling and it is a constant delight to him to watch your doings. He had fixed an auspicious day for giving you the sceptre; for what offence does he now banish you to the woods ‘Iell me my boy, the upshot of it all; who is the destroying fire of the Sun-god’s line?”
After a look at Rama’s face the minister's son explained to her the reason. On hearing his account she was struck dumb: words fail to describe her condition.

sections.label: Doha 55
sections.name: राजु देन कहि दीन्ह बनु मोहि न सो दुख लेसु

verses.sa:
राखि न सकइ न कहि सक जाहू ।
दुहूँ भाँति उर दारुन दाहू ॥
verses.tr:
rākhi na sakai na kahi sak jāhū
duhūm̐ bhām̐ti ur dārun dāhū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
लिखत सुधाकर गा लिखि राहू ।
बिधि गति बाम सदा सब काहू ॥
verses.tr:
likhat sudhākar gā likhi rāhū
bidhi gati bām sadā sab kāhū

verses.sa:
धरम सनेह उभयँ मति घेरी ।
भइ गति साँप छुछुंदरि केरी ॥
verses.tr:
dharam saneh ubhayam̐ mati gherī
bhai gati sām̐p chuchuṃdari kerī

verses.sa:
राखउँ सुतहि करउँ अनुरोधू ।
धरमु जाइ अरु बंधु बिरोधू ॥
verses.tr:
rākhaum̐ sutahi karaum̐ anurodhū
dharamu jāi aru baṃdhu birodhū

verses.sa:
कहउँ जान बन तौ बड़ि हानी ।
संकट सोच बिबस भइ रानी ॥
verses.tr:
kahaum̐ jān ban tau bar̤i hānī
saṃkaṭ soc bibas bhai rānī

verses.sa:
बहुरि समुझि तिय धरमु सयानी ।
रामु भरतु दोउ सुत सम जानी ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri samujhi tiya dharamu sayānī
rāmu bharatu dou sut sam jānī

verses.sa:
सरल सुभाउ राम महतारी ।
बोली बचन धीर धरि भारी ॥
verses.tr:
saral subhāu rām mahatārī
bolī bacan dhīr dhari bhārī

verses.sa:
तात जाउँ बलि कीन्हेहु नीका ।
पितु आयसु सब धरमक टीका ॥
verses.tr:
tāt jāum̐ bali kīnhehu nīkā
pitu āyasu sab dharamak ṭīkā

verses.sa:
राजु देन कहि दीन्ह बनु मोहि न सो दुख लेसु ।
तुम्ह बिनु भरतहि भूपतिहि प्रजहि प्रचंड कलेसु ॥
verses.tr:
rāju den kahi dīnh banu mohi na so dukh lesu
tumh binu bharatahi bhūpatihi prajahi pracaṃḍ kalesu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘She could neither detain him, nor yet say Go; either way her heart was distraught with cruel pain: as though for ‘moon’ one had written ‘eclipse ’: God's hand is ever against us all. Duty and affection both Laid siege to her soul; her dilemma was |like that of a snake with a musk-rat. “T€ I keep my son, it will be a sin; my past virtue will go for nothing and my friends will abhor me. If L order him into exile, it will be a sad loss.” Io this distressing strait the queen was sore tried. Again reflecting discreetly on her wifely duty and remembering that Rama and Bharat were both: equally her sons, the queen in the sweetness of her
disposition summoned up’ courage and, spoke these woefal words: “May I die, my son, but you have done well; a father’s command is the;most paramount daty.
Though he promised you the kingdom: and now banishes you to the woods I um not the least sad or sorry: but, without you, Bharat and the king and the people will all be put to terrible distress.

sections.label: Doha 56
sections.name: यह बिचारि नहिं करउँ हठ झूठ सनेहु बढ़ाइ

verses.sa:
जौं केवल पितु आयसु ताता ।
तौ जनि जाहु जानि बड़ि माता ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ keval pitu āyasu tātā
tau jani jāhu jāni bar̤i mātā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जौं पितु मातु कहेउ बन जाना ।
तौं कानन सत अवध समाना ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ pitu mātu kaheu ban jānā
tauṃ kānan sat avadh samānā

verses.sa:
पितु बनदेव मातु बनदेवी ।
खग मृग चरन सरोरुह सेवी ॥
verses.tr:
pitu banadev mātu banadevī
khag mṛg caran saroruh sevī

verses.sa:
अंतहुँ उचित नृपहि बनबासू ।
बय बिलोकि हियँ होइ हराँसू ॥
verses.tr:
aṃtahum̐ ucit nṛpahi banabāsū
baya biloki hiyam̐ hoi harām̐sū

verses.sa:
बड़भागी बनु अवध अभागी ।
जो रघुबंसतिलक तुम्ह त्यागी ॥
verses.tr:
bar̤abhāgī banu avadh abhāgī
jo raghubaṃsatilak tumh tyāgī

verses.sa:
जौं सुत कहौ संग मोहि लेहू ।
तुम्हरे हृदयँ होइ संदेहू ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ sut kahau saṃg mohi lehū
tumhare hṛdayam̐ hoi saṃdehū

verses.sa:
पूत परम प्रिय तुम्ह सबही के ।
प्रान प्रान के जीवन जी के ॥
verses.tr:
pūt param priya tumh sabahī ke
prān prān ke jīvan jī ke

verses.sa:
ते तुम्ह कहहु मातु बन जाऊँ ।
मैं सुनि बचन बैठि पछिताऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
te tumh kahahu mātu ban jāūm̐
maiṃ suni bacan baiṭhi pachitāūm̐

verses.sa:
यह बिचारि नहिं करउँ हठ झूठ सनेहु बढ़ाइ ।
मानि मातु कर नात बलि सुरति बिसरि जनि जाइ ॥
verses.tr:
yah bicāri nahiṃ karaum̐ haṭh jhūṭh sanehu bar̤hāi
māni mātu kar nāt bali surati bisari jani jāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Yet. boy, if it is only your father’s order, then go not; hold your mother still greater. If both father and mother bid you go, the forest will bea hundredtimes better than Avadh, with its god for your father, its goddess for your mother and birds and deer to wait upon your lotus feet. At the end of life retirement to the woods is the proper thing for a king, but 1 am troubled at heart when I consider your tender age. How blest the forest and how wretched Avadh if you abandon it, you, the crown of Raghu's line. If, child, I say ‘take me with you,’ there may be some hesitation in your mind;O my son, all hold you most dear, life of our life; if you say ‘mother, I go alone to the woods’ on hearing your words I sink down in despair.
Being thus minded I do not press my suit with a show of love beyond what I really feel; agree to your mother’s

sections.label: Doha 57
sections.name: समाचार तेहि समय सुनि सीय उठी अकुलाइ

verses.sa:
देव पितर सब तुन्हहि गोसाई ।
राखहुँ पलक नयन की नाई ॥
verses.tr:
dev pitar sab tunhahi gosāī
rākhahum̐ palak nayan kī nāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अवधि अंबु प्रिय परिजन मीना ।
तुम्ह करुनाकर धरम धुरीना ॥
verses.tr:
avadhi aṃbu priya parijan mīnā
tumh karunākar dharam dhurīnā

verses.sa:
अस बिचारि सोइ करहु उपाई ।
सबहि जिअत जेहिं भेंटेहु आई ॥
verses.tr:
as bicāri soi karahu upāī
sabahi jiat jehiṃ bheṃṭehu āī

verses.sa:
जाहु सुखेन बनहि बलि जाऊँ ।
करि अनाथ जन परिजन गाऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
jāhu sukhen banahi bali jāūm̐
kari anāth jan parijan gāūm̐

verses.sa:
सब कर आजु सुकृत फल बीता ।
भयउ कराल कालु बिपरीता ॥
verses.tr:
sab kar āju sukṛt phal bītā
bhayau karāl kālu biparītā

verses.sa:
बहुबिधि बिलपि चरन लपटानी ।
परम अभागिनि आपुहि जानी ॥
verses.tr:
bahubidhi bilapi caran lapaṭānī
param abhāgini āpuhi jānī

verses.sa:
दारुन दुसह दाहु उर ब्यापा ।
बरनि न जाहिं बिलाप कलापा ॥
verses.tr:
dārun dusah dāhu ur byāpā
barani na jāhiṃ bilāp kalāpā

verses.sa:
राम उठाइ मातु उर लाई ।
कहि मृदु बचन बहुरि समुझाई ॥
verses.tr:
rām uṭhāi mātu ur lāī
kahi mṛdu bacan bahuri samujhāī

verses.sa:
समाचार तेहि समय सुनि सीय उठी अकुलाइ ।
जाइ सासु पद कमल जुग बंदि बैठि सिरु नाइ ॥
verses.tr:
samācār tehi samaya suni sīya uṭhī akulāi
jāi sāsu pad kamal jug baṃdi baiṭhi siru nāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: request; or if you go alone, at least I pray you not to forget me.

May all the gods and the spirits of your ancestors guard you, noble boy, as closely as the eyelids guard the eyes. The term of banishment is like the water of a lake in which the fish are friends and relations; you are all-merciful and righteous; remember then to make your plans so that you may find them all alive when you come again. (Go in peace to the woods—ah! woe is me |—leaving your servants, your relatives, the whole city in bereavement; to-day the fruit of all their past good deeds has gone, and awful death con-fronts them.’ Thus with many mournful meanings she clung to his feet, accounting herself the most hapless of women. Cruel and intolerable pangs pierced her heart through and through, and the burden of her misery was past all telling. Rama raised his mother and took her to his bosom and consoled her with many soothing words.

sections.label: Doha 58
sections.name: पिता जनक भूपाल मनि ससुर भानुकुल भानु

verses.sa:
दीन्हि असीस सासु मृदु बानी ।
अति सुकुमारि देखि अकुलानी ॥
verses.tr:
dīnhi asīs sāsu mṛdu bānī
ati sukumāri dekhi akulānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बैठि नमितमुख सोचति सीता ।
रूप रासि पति प्रेम पुनीता ॥
verses.tr:
baiṭhi namitamukh socati sītā
rūp rāsi pati prem punītā

verses.sa:
चलन चहत बन जीवननाथू ।
केहि सुकृती सन होइहि साथू ॥
verses.tr:
calan cahat ban jīvananāthū
kehi sukṛtī san hoihi sāthū

verses.sa:
की तनु प्रान कि केवल प्राना ।
बिधि करतबु कछु जाइ न जाना ॥
verses.tr:
kī tanu prān ki keval prānā
bidhi karatabu kachu jāi na jānā

verses.sa:
चारु चरन नख लेखति धरनी ।
नूपुर मुखर मधुर कबि बरनी ॥
verses.tr:
cāru caran nakh lekhati dharanī
nūpur mukhar madhur kabi baranī

verses.sa:
मनहुँ प्रेम बस बिनती करहीं ।
हमहि सीय पद जनि परिहरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
manahum̐ prem bas binatī karahīṃ
hamahi sīya pad jani pariharahīṃ

verses.sa:
मंजु बिलोचन मोचति बारी ।
बोली देखि राम महतारी ॥
verses.tr:
maṃju bilocan mocati bārī
bolī dekhi rām mahatārī

verses.sa:
तात सुनहु सिय अति सुकुमारी ।
सासु ससुर परिजनहि पिआरी ॥
verses.tr:
tāt sunahu siya ati sukumārī
sāsu sasur parijanahi piārī

verses.sa:
पिता जनक भूपाल मनि ससुर भानुकुल भानु ।
पति रबिकुल कैरव बिपिन बिधु गुन रूप निधानु ॥
verses.tr:
pitā janak bhūpāl mani sasur bhānukul bhānu
pati rabikul kairav bipin bidhu gun rūp nidhānu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: At that moment Sita, who had heard: the news, rose in great agitation, and having reverenced her mother’s lotus feet, bowed her head and sat down.

In tender accents her mother gave her blessing, and at the sight of her delicate frame was more distressed than ever. With drooping eyes Sita, the perfection of beauty, model of wifely devotion, sat and thought: ‘The lord of my life would go to the woods, how can I merit to accompany him? Whether in the body or only in the soul, go I must; but God’s doings are inscrutable.’ With her lovely toe-nails she wrote upon the ground, while the music of her anklets, like the poet's honeyed song, rang out the passionate prayer: ‘Never may we be torn from Sita’s feet.’ Seeing her let fall a flood of tears from her lovely eyes, Rama's mother cried: “Hearken, my son; Sita is very delicate; she is the darling of your father and mother and all your Kindred.

Her own father is Janak, jewel of kings; her father-inlaw is the Phosbus of the solar race; her lord, the perfection of beauty and virtue, is as it were the moon of the lily-like progeny of the sun-god;:

sections.label: Doha 59
sections.name: करि केहरि निसिचर चरहिं दुष्ट जंतु बन भूरि

verses.sa:
मैं पुनि पुत्रबधू प्रिय पाई ।
रूप रासि गुन सील सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ puni putrabadhū priya pāī
rūp rāsi gun sīl suhāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नयन पुतरि करि प्रीति बढ़ाई ।
राखेउँ प्रान जानिकिहिं लाई ॥
verses.tr:
nayan putari kari prīti bar̤hāī
rākheum̐ prān jānikihiṃ lāī

verses.sa:
कलपबेलि जिमि बहुबिधि लाली ।
सींचि सनेह सलिल प्रतिपाली ॥
verses.tr:
kalapabeli jimi bahubidhi lālī
sīṃci saneh salil pratipālī

verses.sa:
फूलत फलत भयउ बिधि बामा ।
जानि न जाइ काह परिनामा ॥
verses.tr:
phūlat phalat bhayau bidhi bāmā
jāni na jāi kāh parināmā

verses.sa:
पलँग पीठ तजि गोद हिंड़ोरा ।
सियँ न दीन्ह पगु अवनि कठोरा ॥
verses.tr:
palam̐g pīṭh taji god hiṃr̤orā
siyam̐ na dīnh pagu avani kaṭhorā

verses.sa:
जिअनमूरि जिमि जोगवत रहऊँ ।
दीप बाति नहिं टारन कहऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
jianamūri jimi jogavat rahaūm̐
dīp bāti nahiṃ ṭāran kahaūm̐

verses.sa:
सोइ सिय चलन चहति बन साथा ।
आयसु काह होइ रघुनाथा ॥
verses.tr:
soi siya calan cahati ban sāthā
āyasu kāh hoi raghunāthā

verses.sa:
चंद किरन रस रसिक चकोरी ।
रबि रुख नयन सकइ किमि जोरी ॥
verses.tr:
caṃd kiran ras rasik cakorī
rabi rukh nayan sakai kimi jorī

verses.sa:
करि केहरि निसिचर चरहिं दुष्ट जंतु बन भूरि ।
बिष बाटिकाँ कि सोह सुत सुभग सजीवनि मूरि ॥
verses.tr:
kari kehari nisicar carahiṃ duṣṭ jaṃtu ban bhūri
biṣ bāṭikām̐ ki soh sut subhag sajīvani mūri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: I again have found in her a dear daughter, amiable, beautiful and accomplished. She is like the apple of my eye and my affection has so grown that it is only in Janaki that I have my being!. I have tended her as carefully as the tree of paradise and watered her growth with streams of affection. When she should have blossomed and borne fruit, God has turned against me, and there is no knowing what will be the end. Orever sbe left her bed or seat,

I cradled her in my lap, and never has Sita set her foot on the hard ground. I cherished her as the very source of my life, and never bade her so much as even to trim the wick of a lamp. And this is the Sita who would follow you to the woods; what are your orders, O Raghunath? Can the partridge, that drinks in with delight the rays of the moon, endure to fix its gaze on the orb of the sun
Elephants, lions, goblins, and many fierce avimals roam the wood: ah, my son, is the charming tree of life fit, to set in such a deadly pasture?

sections.label: Doha 60
sections.name: कहि प्रिय बचन बिबेकमय कीन्हि मातु परितोष

verses.sa:
बन हित कोल किरात किसोरी ।
रचीं बिरंचि बिषय सुख भोरी ॥
verses.tr:
ban hit kol kirāt kisorī
racīṃ biraṃci biṣaya sukh bhorī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पाइन कृमि जिमि कठिन सुभाऊ ।
तिन्हहि कलेसु न कानन काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
pāin kṛmi jimi kaṭhin subhāū
tinhahi kalesu na kānan kāū

verses.sa:
कै तापस तिय कानन जोगू ।
जिन्ह तप हेतु तजा सब भोगू ॥
verses.tr:
kai tāpas tiya kānan jogū
jinh tap hetu tajā sab bhogū

verses.sa:
सिय बन बसिहि तात केहि भाँती ।
चित्रलिखित कपि देखि डेराती ॥
verses.tr:
siya ban basihi tāt kehi bhām̐tī
citralikhit kapi dekhi ḍerātī

verses.sa:
सुरसर सुभग बनज बन चारी ।
डाबर जोगु कि हंसकुमारी ॥
verses.tr:
surasar subhag banaj ban cārī
ḍābar jogu ki haṃsakumārī

verses.sa:
अस बिचारि जस आयसु होई ।
मैं सिख देउँ जानकिहि सोई ॥
verses.tr:
as bicāri jas āyasu hoī
maiṃ sikh deum̐ jānakihi soī

verses.sa:
जौं सिय भवन रहै कह अंबा ।
मोहि कहँ होइ बहुत अवलंबा ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ siya bhavan rahai kah aṃbā
mohi kaham̐ hoi bahut avalaṃbā

verses.sa:
सुनि रघुबीर मातु प्रिय बानी ।
सील सनेह सुधाँ जनु सानी ॥
verses.tr:
suni raghubīr mātu priya bānī
sīl saneh sudhām̐ janu sānī

verses.sa:
कहि प्रिय बचन बिबेकमय कीन्हि मातु परितोष ।
लगे प्रबोधन जानकिहि प्रगटि बिपिन गुन दोष ॥
verses.tr:
kahi priya bacan bibekamaya kīnhi mātu paritoṣ
lage prabodhan jānakihi pragaṭi bipin gun doṣ
verses.head: दोहा

trans: God has created for the forest Kol and Kirat women, who care not for bodily delights. Of nature as hard as the stone insect, the woods are no trial to them. A_ hermit’s wife again is fit for the woods, who for the sake of penance has renounced all pleasures. But how, my son, can Sita live in the woods, who would be frightened by even the picture of a monkey? Can the cygnet that has sported in the lovely lotus-beds of the Ganges find fit abode in a muddy puddle? First ponder this, and then, as you order I will instruct Janaki. If she remain at home and call me mother, she will be the support of my life.” Raghubir on hearing his mother’s speech, which was drenched as it were with the ambrosia of grace and affection,
Replied in tender and discreet terms for his mother’s consolation, and began to set clearly before Janaki all) the pleasures and troubles of forest life,

sections.label: Doha 61
sections.name: गुर श्रुति संमत धरम फलु पाइअ बिनहिं कलेस

verses.sa:
मातु समीप कहत सकुचाहीं ।
बोले समउ समुझि मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
mātu samīp kahat sakucāhīṃ
bole samau samujhi man māhīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राजकुमारि सिखावन सुनहू ।
आन भाँति जियँ जनि कछु गुनहू ॥
verses.tr:
rājakumāri sikhāvan sunahū
ān bhām̐ti jiyam̐ jani kachu gunahū

verses.sa:
आपन मोर नीक जौं चहहू ।
बचनु हमार मानि गृह रहहू ॥
verses.tr:
āpan mor nīk jauṃ cahahū
bacanu hamār māni gṛh rahahū

verses.sa:
आयसु मोर सासु सेवकाई ।
सब बिधि भामिनि भवन भलाई ॥
verses.tr:
āyasu mor sāsu sevakāī
sab bidhi bhāmini bhavan bhalāī

verses.sa:
एहि ते अधिक धरमु नहिं दूजा ।
सादर सासु ससुर पद पूजा ॥
verses.tr:
ehi te adhik dharamu nahiṃ dūjā
sādar sāsu sasur pad pūjā

verses.sa:
जब जब मातु करिहि सुधि मोरी ।
होइहि प्रेम बिकल मति भोरी ॥
verses.tr:
jab jab mātu karihi sudhi morī
hoihi prem bikal mati bhorī

verses.sa:
तब तब तुम्ह कहि कथा पुरानी ।
सुंदरि समुझाएहु मृदु बानी ॥
verses.tr:
tab tab tumh kahi kathā purānī
suṃdari samujhāehu mṛdu bānī

verses.sa:
कहउँ सुभायँ सपथ सत मोही ।
सुमुखि मातु हित राखउँ तोही ॥
verses.tr:
kahaum̐ subhāyam̐ sapath sat mohī
sumukhi mātu hit rākhaum̐ tohī

verses.sa:
गुर श्रुति संमत धरम फलु पाइअ बिनहिं कलेस ।
हठ बस सब संकट सहे गालव नहुष नरेस ॥
verses.tr:
gur śruti saṃmat dharam phalu pāia binahiṃ kales
haṭh bas sab saṃkaṭ sahe gālav nahuṣ nares
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Speaking diffideutly as in the presence of his mother, and considering well within himself the requirements of the time: “Hearken, lady, to my instructions; nor from any different fancies in your mind. If you desire your own good and mine, agree to what I say and remain at home. My order is this: the service of a mother-in-law is in every way, madam, a blessing toa family. There is no other duty so paramount as reverential submission toa husband’s parents. Whenever my mother recalls me to mind and is distracted by affectionate solicitude, do you, my love, console her with old-world tales and tender speeches.
I speak from my heart and confirm it with a hundred Oaths: it is for my mother’s sake, beloved, I leave you here.
The reward of virtue can be obtained without trouble by submission to Scripture and one’s spiritual director; through their obstinacy Galava and king Nahusha were subjected to all sorts of trouble.

sections.label: Doha 62
sections.name: भूमि सयन बलकल बसन असनु कंद फल मूल

verses.sa:
मैं पुनि करि प्रवान पितु बानी ।
बेगि फिरब सुनु सुमुखि सयानी ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ puni kari pravān pitu bānī
begi phirab sunu sumukhi sayānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
दिवस जात नहिं लागिहि बारा ।
सुंदरि सिखवनु सुनहु हमारा ॥
verses.tr:
divas jāt nahiṃ lāgihi bārā
suṃdari sikhavanu sunahu hamārā

verses.sa:
जौ हठ करहु प्रेम बस बामा ।
तौ तुम्ह दुखु पाउब परिनामा ॥
verses.tr:
jau haṭh karahu prem bas bāmā
tau tumh dukhu pāub parināmā

verses.sa:
काननु कठिन भयंकरु भारी ।
घोर घामु हिम बारि बयारी ॥
verses.tr:
kānanu kaṭhin bhayaṃkaru bhārī
ghor ghāmu him bāri bayārī

verses.sa:
कुस कंटक मग काँकर नाना ।
चलब पयादेहिं बिनु पदत्राना ॥
verses.tr:
kus kaṃṭak mag kām̐kar nānā
calab payādehiṃ binu padatrānā

verses.sa:
चरन कमल मुदु मंजु तुम्हारे ।
मारग अगम भूमिधर भारे ॥
verses.tr:
caran kamal mudu maṃju tumhāre
mārag agam bhūmidhar bhāre

verses.sa:
कंदर खोह नदीं नद नारे ।
अगम अगाध न जाहिं निहारे ॥
verses.tr:
kaṃdar khoh nadīṃ nad nāre
agam agādh na jāhiṃ nihāre

verses.sa:
भालु बाघ बृक केहरि नागा ।
करहिं नाद सुनि धीरजु भागा ॥
verses.tr:
bhālu bāgh bṛk kehari nāgā
karahiṃ nād suni dhīraju bhāgā

verses.sa:
भूमि सयन बलकल बसन असनु कंद फल मूल ।
ते कि सदा सब दिन मिलिहिं सबुइ समय अनुकूल ॥
verses.tr:
bhūmi sayan balakal basan asanu kaṃd phal mūl
te ki sadā sab din milihiṃ sabui samaya anukūl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: I shall soon fulfil my father’s words and come back again; hearken, fair and sensible dame. ‘The days will quickly pass away; listen, love, to my advice. If, my spouse, you persist in your affectionate obstinacy, you will rue it in the end. The forest is exceedingly toilsome and terrible, with awful heat and cold and rain and wind; the path is beset with prickly grass and stones, and you will have to walk without protection for your feet: and your lotus feet are so soft and pretty, while the road is most difficult: and there are huge mountains, chasms and precipices, streams, rivers and torrents, deep and impassable, terrible to behold; while bears and tigers, wolves, lions and elephants make such a roaring that the boldest is dismayed.

For ye must there in your hande )ere a bowe ready to drawe, And as 6 thief, thus must yelyve, ever in drede and awe, think that even they will be always forthcoming every day, but only when they are in season.:

sections.label: Doha 63
sections.name: सहज सुह्द गुर स्वामि सिख जो न करइ सिर मानि

verses.sa:
नर अहार रजनीचर चरहीं ।
कपट बेष बिधि कोटिक करहीं ॥
verses.tr:
nar ahār rajanīcar carahīṃ
kapaṭ beṣ bidhi koṭik karahīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
लागइ अति पहार कर पानी ।
बिपिन बिपति नहिं जाइ बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
lāgai ati pahār kar pānī
bipin bipati nahiṃ jāi bakhānī

verses.sa:
ब्याल कराल बिहग बन घोरा ।
निसिचर निकर नारि नर चोरा ॥
verses.tr:
byāl karāl bihag ban ghorā
nisicar nikar nāri nar corā

verses.sa:
डरपहिं धीर गहन सुधि आएँ ।
मृगलोचनि तुम्ह भीरु सुभाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
ḍarapahiṃ dhīr gahan sudhi āem̐
mṛgalocani tumh bhīru subhāem̐

verses.sa:
हंसगवनि तुम्ह नहिं बन जोगू ।
सुनि अपजसु मोहि देइहि लोगू ॥
verses.tr:
haṃsagavani tumh nahiṃ ban jogū
suni apajasu mohi deihi logū

verses.sa:
मानस सलिल सुधाँ प्रतिपाली ।
जिअइ कि लवन पयोधि मराली ॥
verses.tr:
mānas salil sudhām̐ pratipālī
jiai ki lavan payodhi marālī

verses.sa:
नव रसाल बन बिहरनसीला ।
सोह कि कोकिल बिपिन करीला ॥
verses.tr:
nav rasāl ban biharanasīlā
soh ki kokil bipin karīlā

verses.sa:
रहहु भवन अस हृदयँ बिचारी ।
चंदबदनि दुखु कानन भारी ॥
verses.tr:
rahahu bhavan as hṛdayam̐ bicārī
caṃdabadani dukhu kānan bhārī

verses.sa: सहज सुह्द गुर स्वामि सिख जो न करइ सिर मानि ॥
verses.tr: sahaj suhd gur svāmi sikh jo na karai sir māni
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: सो पछिताइ अघाइ उर अवसि होइ हित हानि ॥
verses.tr: so pachitāi aghāi ur avasi hoi hit hāni

trans: There are man-eating demons who assume all sorts of deceptive forms; the rainfall on the hills is excessive, and in short the hardships of the forest are past all telling. There are terrible serpents and fierce wild birds and gangs of goblins that steal both man and woman. The bravest shudders at the thought of the dense forest; while you, my fawn-eyed wife, are timid by nature. Ah! delicate dame, you are not fit for the woods; people will revile me on hearing of sucha thing. Can the swan that has been nurtured in the ambrosial flood of the Manu lake exist in the salt sea? Can the foil, that roves with delight through the luxuriant mango groves, take pleasure in a jungle of karil, bushes f Ponder this, my fair bride, and stay at home; the hardships of the forest are too great.
Whoever with a view to her own good does not at once accept the advice given by a friend, or a guru, or her husband shall assuredly have a surfeit of repentance and gain no

sections.label: Doha 64
sections.name: प्राननाथ करुनायतन सुंदर सुखद सुजान

verses.sa:
सुनि मृदु बचन मनोहर पिय के ।
लोचन ललित भरे जल सिय के ॥
verses.tr:
suni mṛdu bacan manohar piya ke
locan lalit bhare jal siya ke
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सीतल सिख दाहक भइ कैंसें ।
चकइहि सरद चंद निसि जैंसें ॥
verses.tr:
sītal sikh dāhak bhai kaiṃseṃ
cakaihi sarad caṃd nisi jaiṃseṃ

verses.sa:
उतरु न आव बिकल बैदेही ।
तजन चहत सुचि स्वामि सनेही ॥
verses.tr:
utaru na āv bikal baidehī
tajan cahat suci svāmi sanehī

verses.sa:
बरबस रोकि बिलोचन बारी ।
धरि धीरजु उर अवनिकुमारी ॥
verses.tr:
barabas roki bilocan bārī
dhari dhīraju ur avanikumārī

verses.sa:
लागि सासु पग कह कर जोरी ।
छमबि देबि बड़ि अबिनय मोरी ॥
verses.tr:
lāgi sāsu pag kah kar jorī
chamabi debi bar̤i abinaya morī

verses.sa:
दीन्हि प्रानपति मोहि सिख सोई ।
जेहि बिधि मोर परम हित होई ॥
verses.tr:
dīnhi prānapati mohi sikh soī
jehi bidhi mor param hit hoī

verses.sa:
मैं पुनि समुझि दीखि मन माहीं ।
पिय बियोग सम दुखु जग नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ puni samujhi dīkhi man māhīṃ
piya biyog sam dukhu jag nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
प्राननाथ करुनायतन सुंदर सुखद सुजान ।
तुम्ह बिनु रघुकुल कुमुद बिधु सुरपुर नरक समान ॥
verses.tr:
prānanāth karunāyatan suṃdar sukhad sujān
tumh binu raghukul kumud bidhu surapur narak samān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: On hearing the tender and winning words of her husband, Sita’s lotus eyes filled with tears, and his soothing advice caused her as burning pain as the autumn moon causes the chakwi, In her distress no answer came to her lips: ‘So great is his love that he would leave me behind.’ Perforce restraining her tears and summing up courage, Earth's daughter embraced her mother’s feet, and with folded hands thus spake: “Pardon me, lady, my great presumption: my dear lord has thought me what is all for my own good; but I look to my feelings, and conclude that no sorrow in the world is so great as separation from one’s beloved.
O my dear lord, most compassionate, beautiful, bounteous and wise, the moon of the lilies of the Raghu race, heaven without you would be very hell.

sections.label: Doha 65
sections.name: खग मृग परिजन नगरु बनु बलकल बिमल दुकूल

verses.sa:
मातु पिता भगिनी प्रिय भाई ।
प्रिय परिवारु सुह्रद समुदाई ॥
verses.tr:
mātu pitā bhaginī priya bhāī
priya parivāru suhrad samudāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सासु ससुर गुर सजन सहाई ।
सुत सुंदर सुसील सुखदाई ॥
verses.tr:
sāsu sasur gur sajan sahāī
sut suṃdar susīl sukhadāī

verses.sa:
जहँ लगि नाथ नेह अरु नाते ।
पिय बिनु तियहि तरनिहु ते ताते ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ lagi nāth neh aru nāte
piya binu tiyahi taranihu te tāte

verses.sa:
तनु धनु धामु धरनि पुर राजू ।
पति बिहीन सबु सोक समाजू ॥
verses.tr:
tanu dhanu dhāmu dharani pur rājū
pati bihīn sabu sok samājū

verses.sa:
भोग रोगसम भूषन भारू ।
जम जातना सरिस संसारू ॥
verses.tr:
bhog rogasam bhūṣan bhārū
jam jātanā saris saṃsārū

verses.sa:
प्राननाथ तुम्ह बिनु जग माहीं ।
मो कहुँ सुखद कतहुँ कछु नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
prānanāth tumh binu jag māhīṃ
mo kahum̐ sukhad katahum̐ kachu nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
जिय बिनु देह नदी बिनु बारी ।
तैसिअ नाथ पुरुष बिनु नारी ॥
verses.tr:
jiya binu deh nadī binu bārī
taisia nāth puruṣ binu nārī

verses.sa:
नाथ सकल सुख साथ तुम्हारें ।
सरद बिमल बिधु बदनु निहारें ॥
verses.tr:
nāth sakal sukh sāth tumhāreṃ
sarad bimal bidhu badanu nihāreṃ

verses.sa:
खग मृग परिजन नगरु बनु बलकल बिमल दुकूल ।
नाथ साथ सुरसदन सम परनसाल सुख मूल ॥
verses.tr:
khag mṛg parijan nagaru banu balakal bimal dukūl
nāth sāth surasadan sam paranasāl sukh mūl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Dear are father and mother, sisters and brothers; dear are My Companions and my many friends; but father-inlaw and mother-in-law, spiritual director, generous associates, and even sons, however, beautiful, amiable and affectionate, nay. my Lord, all love and every tie of kindred, to a woman without her husband, are a greater distress than the sun's most burning heat. Life, wealth, house, land, city and empire are but accumulated misery toa woman bereft of her lord. Ease is disease, her jewels a burden, and the world like the torments of hell. Without you, O lord of my soul, there is nothing in the whole world that could give me any comfort. As the body without a soul, asa river without water, so, my lord, is a woman without her husband. With you, my lord, are all delights, as Jong asI can behold your face that vies in brightness with the autumn moon.
The birds and deer will be my attendants, the forest my city, and strips of bark my glistening robes; with my. lord a hut of grass will be us the palace of the gods, and all will be well.

sections.label: Doha 66
sections.name: राखिअ अवध जो अवधि लगि रहत न जनिअहिं प्रान

verses.sa:
बनदेवीं बनदेव उदारा ।
करिहहिं सासु ससुर सम सारा ॥
verses.tr:
banadevīṃ banadev udārā
karihahiṃ sāsu sasur sam sārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कुस किसलय साथरी सुहाई ।
प्रभु सँग मंजु मनोज तुराई ॥
verses.tr:
kus kisalaya sātharī suhāī
prabhu sam̐g maṃju manoj turāī

verses.sa:
कंद मूल फल अमिअ अहारू ।
अवध सौध सत सरिस पहारू ॥
verses.tr:
kaṃd mūl phal amia ahārū
avadh saudh sat saris pahārū

verses.sa:
छिनु छिनु प्रभु पद कमल बिलोकि ।
रहिहउँ मुदित दिवस जिमि कोकी ॥
verses.tr:
chinu chinu prabhu pad kamal biloki
rahihaum̐ mudit divas jimi kokī

verses.sa:
बन दुख नाथ कहे बहुतेरे ।
भय बिषाद परिताप घनेरे ॥
verses.tr:
ban dukh nāth kahe bahutere
bhaya biṣād paritāp ghanere

verses.sa:
प्रभु बियोग लवलेस समाना ।
सब मिलि होहिं न कृपानिधाना ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu biyog lavales samānā
sab mili hohiṃ na kṛpānidhānā

verses.sa:
अस जियँ जानि सुजान सिरोमनि ।
लेइअ संग मोहि छाड़िअ जनि ॥
verses.tr:
as jiyam̐ jāni sujān siromani
leia saṃg mohi chār̤ia jani

verses.sa:
बिनती बहुत करौं का स्वामी ।
करुनामय उर अंतरजामी ॥
verses.tr:
binatī bahut karauṃ kā svāmī
karunāmaya ur aṃtarajāmī

verses.sa:
राखिअ अवध जो अवधि लगि रहत न जनिअहिं प्रान ।
दीनबंधु संदर सुखद सील सनेह निधान ॥
verses.tr:
rākhia avadh jo avadhi lagi rahat na janiahiṃ prān
dīnabaṃdhu saṃdar sukhad sīl saneh nidhān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The sylvan nymphs and gods will] of their grace protect me like my own lord’s parents; my simple litter of grass and twigs will with my lord become a sumptuous marriage-couch; bulbs, roots and fruits will form an ambrosial repast, and the mountains resemble the stately halls of Avadh. Every moment I gaze on my lord’s lotus feet, I shall be as glad asthe chakwi at the dawn. You have recounted, my lord, the numerous hardships of the-forest, its terrors, annoyances and many discomforts; but O fountain of mercy, all these united will not be comparable to the pain of bereavement. Consider this, O jewel of wisdom, and take me with you, abandon me not. Why make long supplication my lord is full of compassion and Knoweth the heart.
Do you think, if you keep me at Avadh, that I can survive till the end of your exile? O most beautiful, help of the helpless, fountain of grace and of love.

sections.label: Doha 67
sections.name: ऐसेउ बचन कठोर सुनि जौं न ह्रदउ बिलगान

verses.sa:
मोहि मग चलत न होइहि हारी ।
छिनु छिनु चरन सरोज निहारी ॥
verses.tr:
mohi mag calat na hoihi hārī
chinu chinu caran saroj nihārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सबहि भाँति पिय सेवा करिहौं ।
मारग जनित सकल श्रम हरिहौं ॥
verses.tr:
sabahi bhām̐ti piya sevā karihauṃ
mārag janit sakal śram harihauṃ

verses.sa:
पाय पखारी बैठि तरु छाहीं ।
करिहउँ बाउ मुदित मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
pāya pakhārī baiṭhi taru chāhīṃ
karihaum̐ bāu mudit man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
श्रम कन सहित स्याम तनु देखें ।
कहँ दुख समउ प्रानपति पेखें ॥
verses.tr:
śram kan sahit syām tanu dekheṃ
kaham̐ dukh samau prānapati pekheṃ

verses.sa:
सम महि तृन तरुपल्लव डासी ।
पाग पलोटिहि सब निसि दासी ॥
verses.tr:
sam mahi tṛn tarupallav ḍāsī
pāg paloṭihi sab nisi dāsī

verses.sa:
बारबार मृदु मूरति जोही ।
लागहि तात बयारि न मोही ॥
verses.tr:
bārabār mṛdu mūrati johī
lāgahi tāt bayāri na mohī

verses.sa:
को प्रभु सँग मोहि चितवनिहारा ।
सिंघबधुहि जिमि ससक सिआरा ॥
verses.tr:
ko prabhu sam̐g mohi citavanihārā
siṃghabadhuhi jimi sasak siārā

verses.sa:
मैं सुकुमारि नाथ बन जोगू ।
तुम्हहि उचित तप मो कहुँ भोगू ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ sukumāri nāth ban jogū
tumhahi ucit tap mo kahum̐ bhogū

verses.sa:
ऐसेउ बचन कठोर सुनि जौं न ह्रदउ बिलगान ।
तौ प्रभु बिषम बियोग दुख सहिहहिं पावँर प्रान ॥
verses.tr:
aiseu bacan kaṭhor suni jauṃ na hradau bilagān
tau prabhu biṣam biyog dukh sahihahiṃ pāvam̐r prān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: As I go along the road I shall never weary, every moment beholding your lotus feet. In every way I shall minister to my beloved, and relieve him of all the toil of the march. Seated in the shade of some tree, I shall Juve your feet and rapturously fan you, and gazing on your body stained with sweat and blackened by the sun, what thought, my dearest lord, shall I have for my own hard times Spreading grass and leaves on the level ground, your slave will all night shampoo your feet, and ever gazing on your gracious form, nor heat nor wind will ever vex me. Who will look at me when I am with my lord, except as a hare or jackal furtively regards a lioness?
