Then gaily cried: “Do anything to save your boat, bring water at once and bathe my feet; time has been lost; take me across.” The gracious lord thus made request of a boatman; even he by one thought on whose name mankind is transported across the boundless ocean of existence, and for whose three strides the whole universe did not suffice. The Ganges rejoiced on beholding his toe-nails, and the sound of his words was relieved of all anxiety. On receiving Rama’s commands, the ferryman brought a basin full of water and in an ecstacy of joy and love proceeded to bathe his lotus feet. All the gods rained down flowers and uttered
their congratulations: “Never was anyone so meritorious!”
_ After laving his feet, and drinking of the water, both himself and his family, and thus redeeming the souls of his Ba tee he joyfully conveyed his lord across to the other side,

sections.label: Doha 102
sections.name: बहुत कीन्ह प्रभु लखन सियँ नहिं कछु केवटु लेइ

verses.sa:
उतरि ठाड़ भए सुरसरि रेता ।
सीयराम गुह लखन समेता ॥
verses.tr:
utari ṭhār̤ bhae surasari retā
sīyarām guh lakhan sametā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
केवट उतरि दंडवत कीन्हा ।
प्रभुहि सकुच एहि नहिं कछु दीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
kevaṭ utari daṃḍavat kīnhā
prabhuhi sakuc ehi nahiṃ kachu dīnhā

verses.sa:
पिय हिय की सिय जाननिहारी ।
मनि मुदरी मन मुदित उतारी ॥
verses.tr:
piya hiya kī siya jānanihārī
mani mudarī man mudit utārī

verses.sa:
कहेउ कृपाल लेहि उतराई ।
केवट चरन गहे अकुलाई ॥
verses.tr:
kaheu kṛpāl lehi utarāī
kevaṭ caran gahe akulāī

verses.sa:
नाथ आजु मैं काह न पावा ।
मिटे दोष दुख दारिद दावा ॥
verses.tr:
nāth āju maiṃ kāh na pāvā
miṭe doṣ dukh dārid dāvā

verses.sa:
बहुत काल मैं कीन्हि मजूरी ।
आजु दीन्ह बिधि बनि भलि भूरी ॥
verses.tr:
bahut kāl maiṃ kīnhi majūrī
āju dīnh bidhi bani bhali bhūrī

verses.sa:
अब कछु नाथ न चाहिअ मोरें ।
दीनदयाल अनुग्रह तोरें ॥
verses.tr:
ab kachu nāth na cāhia moreṃ
dīnadayāl anugrah toreṃ

verses.sa:
फिरती बार मोहि जे देबा ।
सो प्रसादु मैं सिर धरि लेबा ॥
verses.tr:
phiratī bār mohi je debā
so prasādu maiṃ sir dhari lebā

verses.sa:
बहुत कीन्ह प्रभु लखन सियँ नहिं कछु केवटु लेइ ।
बिदा कीन्ह करुनायतन भगति बिमल बरु देइ ॥
verses.tr:
bahut kīnh prabhu lakhan siyam̐ nahiṃ kachu kevaṭu lei
bidā kīnh karunāyatan bhagati bimal baru dei
verses.head: दोहा

trans: They landed and stood on the sands of the Ganges, Sita, Rama Lakshman and Guha. The ferryman landed too and made his obeisance. The lord was ashamed that he had nothing to give him. Sita knew what was passing in the mind. of her beloved and cheerfully drew a jewelled ring from off her finger. Said the All-merciful: “Take your toll.” The ferryman in distress clasped his feet: ‘What have I not already received, my lord? sin, sorrow, poverty and all their attendant ills have been removed I have laboured for a length of years, but today God has given me my wages in full, Now, gracious lord, I ask for nothing but your favour; at the time of your return, whatever you bestow upon me I will thankfully accept.”
’ Lakshman and the lord both pressed him much, but the ferryman would take nothing; the All-merciful then dismissed him with the gift of unclouded faith, best of all boons.

sections.label: Doha 103
sections.name: प्राननाथ देवर सहित कुसल कोसला आइ

verses.sa:
तब मज्जनु करि रघुकुलनाथा ।
पूजि पारथिव नायउ माथा ॥
verses.tr:
tab majjanu kari raghukulanāthā
pūji pārathiv nāyau māthā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सियँ सुरसरिहि कहेउ कर जोरी ।
मातु मनोरथ पुरउबि मोरी ॥
verses.tr:
siyam̐ surasarihi kaheu kar jorī
mātu manorath puraubi morī

verses.sa:
पति देवर संग कुसल बहोरी ।
आइ करौं जेहिं पूजा तोरी ॥
verses.tr:
pati devar saṃg kusal bahorī
āi karauṃ jehiṃ pūjā torī

verses.sa:
सुनि सिय बिनय प्रेम रस सानी ।
भइ तब बिमल बारि बर बानी ॥
verses.tr:
suni siya binaya prem ras sānī
bhai tab bimal bāri bar bānī

verses.sa:
सुनु रघुबीर प्रिया बैदेही ।
तव प्रभाउ जग बिदित न केही ॥
verses.tr:
sunu raghubīr priyā baidehī
tav prabhāu jag bidit na kehī

verses.sa:
लोकप होहिं बिलोकत तोरें ।
तोहि सेवहिं सब सिधि कर जोरें ॥
verses.tr:
lokap hohiṃ bilokat toreṃ
tohi sevahiṃ sab sidhi kar joreṃ

verses.sa:
तुम्ह जो हमहि बड़ि बिनय सुनाई ।
कृपा कीन्हि मोहि दीन्हि बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
tumh jo hamahi bar̤i binaya sunāī
kṛpā kīnhi mohi dīnhi bar̤āī

verses.sa:
तदपि देबि मैं देबि असीसा ।
सफल होपन हित निज बागीसा ॥
verses.tr:
tadapi debi maiṃ debi asīsā
saphal hopan hit nij bāgīsā

verses.sa:
प्राननाथ देवर सहित कुसल कोसला आइ ।
पूजहि सब मनकामना सुजसु रहिहि जग छाइ ॥
verses.tr:
prānanāth devar sahit kusal kosalā āi
pūjahi sab manakāmanā sujasu rahihi jag chāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Then the lord of Raghu’s line bathed and bowed his head in adoration to Mahadeva: while Sita with clasped hands thus addressed the sacred stream: “O mother, accomplish my desire that I may return io safety with my husband and his brother and again adore you.’ On hearing Sita’s humble and affectionate speech, favourable response came from the holy flood: “Hearken, Vaidehi best beloved of Raghubir; who is there in the world who knows not your glory? they who behold you become as the sovereigns of the spheres, and all the powers of magic meekly do you service. In the petition that you have deigned to address to me, you have graciously paid me all too high an honour; yet, lady, unworthy as [ am, [ bestow upon you my blessing, in order to prove my utterances true.
You shall return in safety to Kosala with your beloved and his brother; your every wish shall be accomplished, and your renown shall be spread throughout the world.’

sections.label: Doha 104
sections.name: तब गनपति सिव सुमिरि प्रभु नाइ सुरसरिहि माथ

verses.sa:
गंग बचन सुनि मंगल मूला ।
मुदित सीय सुरसरि अनुकुला ॥
verses.tr:
gaṃg bacan suni maṃgal mūlā
mudit sīya surasari anukulā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तब प्रभु गुहहि कहेउ घर जाहू ।
सुनत सूख मुखु भा उर दाहू ॥
verses.tr:
tab prabhu guhahi kaheu ghar jāhū
sunat sūkh mukhu bhā ur dāhū

verses.sa:
दीन बचन गुह कह कर जोरी ।
बिनय सुनहु रघुकुलमनि मोरी ॥
verses.tr:
dīn bacan guh kah kar jorī
binaya sunahu raghukulamani morī

verses.sa:
नाथ साथ रहि पंथु देखाई ।
करि दिन चारि चरन सेवकाई ॥
verses.tr:
nāth sāth rahi paṃthu dekhāī
kari din cāri caran sevakāī

verses.sa:
जेहिं बन जाइ रहब रघुराई ।
परनकुटी मैं करबि सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
jehiṃ ban jāi rahab raghurāī
paranakuṭī maiṃ karabi suhāī

verses.sa:
तब मोहि कहँ जसि देब रजाई ।
सोइ करिहउँ रघुबीर दोहाई ॥
verses.tr:
tab mohi kaham̐ jasi deb rajāī
soi karihaum̐ raghubīr dohāī

verses.sa:
सहज सनेह राम लखि तासु ।
संग लीन्ह गुह हृदय हुलासू ॥
verses.tr:
sahaj saneh rām lakhi tāsu
saṃg līnh guh hṛdaya hulāsū

verses.sa:
पुनि गुहँ ग्याति बोलि सब लीन्हे ।
करि परितोषु बिदा तब कीन्हे ॥
verses.tr:
puni guham̐ gyāti boli sab līnhe
kari paritoṣu bidā tab kīnhe

verses.sa:
तब गनपति सिव सुमिरि प्रभु नाइ सुरसरिहि माथ ।
सखा अनुज सिया सहित बन गवनु कीन्ह रधुनाथ ॥
verses.tr:
tab ganapati siv sumiri prabhu nāi surasarihi māth
sakhā anuj siyā sahit ban gavanu kīnh radhunāth
verses.head: दोहा

trans: On hearing Ganges’s gracious speech, Sita was delighted to find it so propitious. Then said the lord to Guha: ‘Retarn home.” At this his face grew wan and his bosom burned, and with clasped hands and in suppliant tones he cried: ‘Noblest of the sons of Raghu, hearken to my prayer. Let me remain with my lord to show the road and do him service for a day or two, and make a shapely hut of twigs for him in the wood where he goes to stay. After that I swear by Raghubir to do as he shall command me.” Seeing his unfeigned affection, he took him with him, to Guha’s delight, who thereupon called all his kinsmen and dismissed them with kind assurances.
Then directing his intention to Ganes and Siva, and bowing his head to the Ganges, the lord with his companion and his brother and Sita took his way to the woods.

sections.label: Doha 105
sections.name: सेवहिं सुकृति साधु सुचि पावहिं सब मनकाम

verses.sa:
तेहि दिन भयउ बिटप तर बासू ।
लखन सखाँ सब कीन्ह सुपासू ॥
verses.tr:
tehi din bhayau biṭap tar bāsū
lakhan sakhām̐ sab kīnh supāsū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
प्रात प्रातकृत करि रधुसाई ।
तीरथराजु दीख प्रभु जाई ॥
verses.tr:
prāt prātakṛt kari radhusāī
tīratharāju dīkh prabhu jāī

verses.sa:
सचिव सत्य श्रध्दा प्रिय नारी ।
माधव सरिस मीतु हितकारी ॥
verses.tr:
saciv satya śradhdā priya nārī
mādhav saris mītu hitakārī

verses.sa:
चारि पदारथ भरा भँडारु ।
पुन्य प्रदेस देस अति चारु ॥
verses.tr:
cāri padārath bharā bham̐ḍāru
punya prades des ati cāru

verses.sa:
छेत्र अगम गढ़ु गाढ़ सुहावा ।
सपनेहुँ नहिं प्रतिपच्छिन्ह पावा ॥
verses.tr:
chetr agam gar̤hu gār̤h suhāvā
sapanehum̐ nahiṃ pratipacchinh pāvā

verses.sa:
सेन सकल तीरथ बर बीरा ।
कलुष अनीक दलन रनधीरा ॥
verses.tr:
sen sakal tīrath bar bīrā
kaluṣ anīk dalan ranadhīrā

verses.sa:
संगमु सिंहासनु सुठि सोहा ।
छत्रु अखयबटु मुनि मनु मोहा ॥
verses.tr:
saṃgamu siṃhāsanu suṭhi sohā
chatru akhayabaṭu muni manu mohā

verses.sa:
चवँर जमुन अरु गंग तरंगा ।
देखि होहिं दुख दारिद भंगा ॥
verses.tr:
cavam̐r jamun aru gaṃg taraṃgā
dekhi hohiṃ dukh dārid bhaṃgā

verses.sa:
सेवहिं सुकृति साधु सुचि पावहिं सब मनकाम ।
बंदी बेद पुरान गन कहहिं बिमल गुन ग्राम ॥
verses.tr:
sevahiṃ sukṛti sādhu suci pāvahiṃ sab manakām
baṃdī bed purān gan kahahiṃ bimal gun grām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: That day he halted under a tree, and Lakshman and his - attendant supplied all his necessities. At dawn, having performed his morning ablutions he proceeded to visit the king of Sanctuaries. A king with Truth forhis minister, Faith for his cherished consort, the god Mahadeva for his friend and favourite; his treasury stored with the four great prizes of life, and all holy places for his fair dominion; with an impregnable domain and magnificent forts, so strong. that no enemy could ever dream of taking them; with an army of shrines of such virtue and power as to rout the whole army of Sin; with the meeting of the rivers for his glorious throne and the Akhaya-bat for his royal umbrella, dazzling even the soul, of a saint; with the waves of the Ganga and Jamuna for his chauries, a vision to disperse all sorrow and distress::
His attendants pure and holy anchorites, guerdoned with all they desire: his heralds, the Vedas and Puranas, to declare his immaculate virtue. Chaup4i.

sections.label: Doha 106
sections.name: दीन्हि असीस मुनीस उर अति अनंदु अस जानि

verses.sa:
को कहि सकइ प्रयाग प्रभाऊ ।
कलुष पुंज कुंजर मृगराऊ ॥
verses.tr:
ko kahi sakai prayāg prabhāū
kaluṣ puṃj kuṃjar mṛgarāū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अस तीरथपति देखि सुहावा ।
सुख सागर रघुबर सुखु पावा ॥
verses.tr:
as tīrathapati dekhi suhāvā
sukh sāgar raghubar sukhu pāvā

verses.sa:
कहि सिय लखनहि सखहि सुनाई ।
श्रीमुख तीरथराज बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
kahi siya lakhanahi sakhahi sunāī
śrīmukh tīratharāj bar̤āī

verses.sa:
करि प्रनामु देखत बन बागा ।
कहत महातम अति अनुरागा ॥
verses.tr:
kari pranāmu dekhat ban bāgā
kahat mahātam ati anurāgā

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि आइ बिलोकी बेनी ।
सुमिरत सकल सुमंगल देनी ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi āi bilokī benī
sumirat sakal sumaṃgal denī

verses.sa:
मुदित नहाइ कीन्हि सिव सेवा ।
पुजि जथाबिधि तीरथ देवा ॥
verses.tr:
mudit nahāi kīnhi siv sevā
puji jathābidhi tīrath devā

verses.sa:
तब प्रभु भरद्वाज पहिं आए ।
करत दंडवत मुनि उर लाए ॥
verses.tr:
tab prabhu bharadvāj pahiṃ āe
karat daṃḍavat muni ur lāe

verses.sa:
मुनि मन मोद न कछु कहि जाइ ।
ब्रह्मानंद रासि जनु पाई ॥
verses.tr:
muni man mod na kachu kahi jāi
brahmānaṃd rāsi janu pāī

verses.sa:
दीन्हि असीस मुनीस उर अति अनंदु अस जानि ।
लोचन गोचर सुकृत फल मनहुँ किए बिधि आनि ॥
verses.tr:
dīnhi asīs munīs ur ati anaṃdu as jāni
locan gocar sukṛt phal manahum̐ kie bidhi āni
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Who can tell the power of Praydg, a lion to destroy the elephantine monster Sin? On beholding the beauty of this king of sanctuaries, Raghubar, the ocean of delight, was delighted, and with his holy mouth he discoursed on its greatness to Sita, his brother and his companion. After making it an obeisance he visited the woods and groves, dilating on their virtue with the utmost devotion. So he came to the Tribeni—the mere thought of which confers all happiness—and after gazing upon it, rapturously bathed and paid homage to Siva and to the divinity of the spot in all due form. Then came the lord to Bharadveja; as he prostrated himself at his feet, the saint took him to his breast in an ecstacy of joy past all telling, as though he had realized the perfect bliss of heaven.
The patriarch gave him his blessing with as much joy of heart as though God had set before him in visible form the reward of his virtue.

sections.label: Doha 107
sections.name: करम बचन मन छाड़ि छलु जब लगि जनु न तुम्हार

verses.sa:
कुसल प्रस्न करि आसन दीन्हे ।
पूजि प्रेम परिपूरन कीन्हे ॥
verses.tr:
kusal prasn kari āsan dīnhe
pūji prem paripūran kīnhe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कंद मूल फल अंकुर नीके ।
दिए आनि मुनि मनहुँ अमी के ॥
verses.tr:
kaṃd mūl phal aṃkur nīke
die āni muni manahum̐ amī ke

verses.sa:
सीय लखन जन सहित सुहाए ।
अति रुचि राम मूल फल खाए ॥
verses.tr:
sīya lakhan jan sahit suhāe
ati ruci rām mūl phal khāe

verses.sa:
भए बिगतश्रम रामु सुखारे ।
भरव्दाज मृदु बचन उचारे ॥
verses.tr:
bhae bigataśram rāmu sukhāre
bharavdāj mṛdu bacan ucāre

verses.sa:
आजु सुफल तपु तीरथ त्यागू ।
आजु सुफल जप जोग बिरागू ॥
verses.tr:
āju suphal tapu tīrath tyāgū
āju suphal jap jog birāgū

verses.sa:
सफल सकल सुभ साधन साजू ।
राम तुम्हहि अवलोकत आजू ॥
verses.tr:
saphal sakal subh sādhan sājū
rām tumhahi avalokat ājū

verses.sa:
लाभ अवधि सुख अवधि न दूजी ।
तुम्हारें दरस आस सब पूजी ॥
verses.tr:
lābh avadhi sukh avadhi na dūjī
tumhāreṃ daras ās sab pūjī

verses.sa:
अब करि कृपा देहु बर एहू ।
निज पद सरसिज सहज सनेहू ॥
verses.tr:
ab kari kṛpā dehu bar ehū
nij pad sarasij sahaj sanehū

verses.sa:
करम बचन मन छाड़ि छलु जब लगि जनु न तुम्हार ।
तब लगि सुखु सपनेहुँ नहीं किएँ कोटि उपचार ॥
verses.tr:
karam bacan man chār̤i chalu jab lagi janu na tumhār
tab lagi sukhu sapanehum̐ nahīṃ kiem̐ koṭi upacār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: After enquiring of his welfare, he conducted him to a seat and indulged his affection in doing him honour, Then he brought and presented roots, fruits and herbs, all sweet as ambrosia, of which Rama, with Sita, Lakshman and their attendant, partook with much pleasure and content. Rama was refreshed and all his fatigue forgotten. Then cried Bharadveja in complacent tones: ‘“‘ This day my penance, my pilgrimages, and my vigils have been rewarded; my prayers my meditations and my detachment from the world have to-day borne fruit; yea, all my pious practices have to-day, Rama, been rewarded by the sight of you. This and nought else is the height of gain, the height of happiness; in beholding you my every desire is satisfied. Now of your favour grant me this one boon, a life-long devotion to your lotus feet.
Until a man in heart, word and deed, and without reserve, ‘becomes wholly yours, he cannot even dream of happiness, despite all that he may do.”

sections.label: Doha 108
sections.name: राम कीन्ह बिश्राम निसि प्रात प्रयाग नहाइ

verses.sa:
सुनि मुनि बचन रामु सकुचाने ।
भाव भगति आनंद अघाने ॥
verses.tr:
suni muni bacan rāmu sakucāne
bhāv bhagati ānaṃd aghāne
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तब रघुबर मुनि सुजसु सुहावा ।
कोटि भाँति कहि सबहि सुनावा ॥
verses.tr:
tab raghubar muni sujasu suhāvā
koṭi bhām̐ti kahi sabahi sunāvā

verses.sa:
सो बड सो सब गुन गन गेहू ।
जेहि मुनीस तुम्ह आदर देहू ॥
verses.tr:
so baḍ so sab gun gan gehū
jehi munīs tumh ādar dehū

verses.sa:
मुनि रघुबीर परसपर नवहीं ।
बचन अगोचर सुखु अनुभवहीं ॥
verses.tr:
muni raghubīr parasapar navahīṃ
bacan agocar sukhu anubhavahīṃ

verses.sa:
यह सुधि पाइ प्रयाग निवासी ।
बटु तापस मुनि सिद्ध उदासी ॥
verses.tr:
yah sudhi pāi prayāg nivāsī
baṭu tāpas muni siddh udāsī

verses.sa:
भरद्वाज आश्रम सब आए ।
देखन दसरथ सुअन सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
bharadvāj āśram sab āe
dekhan dasarath suan suhāe

verses.sa:
राम प्रनाम कीन्ह सब काहू ।
मुदित भए लहि लोयन लाहू ॥
verses.tr:
rām pranām kīnh sab kāhū
mudit bhae lahi loyan lāhū

verses.sa:
देहिं असीस परम सुखु पाई ।
फिरे सराहत सुंदरताई ॥
verses.tr:
dehiṃ asīs param sukhu pāī
phire sarāhat suṃdaratāī

verses.sa:
राम कीन्ह बिश्राम निसि प्रात प्रयाग नहाइ ।
चले सहित सिय लखन जन मुददित मुनिहि सिरु नाइ ॥
verses.tr:
rām kīnh biśrām nisi prāt prayāg nahāi
cale sahit siya lakhan jan mudadit munihi siru nāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: On hearing the saint’s words, Rama was confused, yet revelled with delight in so exquisite a display of faith. Then proceeded he to declare unto them all in countless ways the saints illustrious renown: “Great indeed and highly endowed is he, Holy Father, whom you are pleased to honour.” ‘Thus they bowed to one another, the saint and Raghubir, and were filled as they conversed with indescribable happiness. When the people of Prayag heArd the news, all the religious students, ascetics, monks, hermits and anchorites flocked to Bharadvdja’s cell to see the glorious son of Dasarath. All made their obeisance and rejoiced that their eyes had been so highly favoured. They blessed him and returned with exceeding joy, extolling his beauty.
Rama rested for the night. At daybreak he bathed at Prayag, and then, after bowing his head to the saint proceeded joyfully on his way with Sita, Lakshman and his attendant.

sections.label: Doha 109
sections.name: बिदा किए बटु बिनय करि फिरे पाइ मन काम

verses.sa:
राम सप्रेम कहेउ मुनि पाहीं ।
नाथ कहिअ हम केहि मग जाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
rām saprem kaheu muni pāhīṃ
nāth kahia ham kehi mag jāhīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मुनि मन बिहसि राम सन कहहीं ।
सुगम सकल मग तुम्ह कहुँ अहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
muni man bihasi rām san kahahīṃ
sugam sakal mag tumh kahum̐ ahahīṃ

verses.sa:
साथ लागि मुनि सिष्य बोलाए ।
सुनि मन मुदित पचासक आए ॥
verses.tr:
sāth lāgi muni siṣya bolāe
suni man mudit pacāsak āe

verses.sa:
सबन्हि राम पर प्रेम अपारा ।
सकल कहहि मगु दीख हमारा ॥
verses.tr:
sabanhi rām par prem apārā
sakal kahahi magu dīkh hamārā

verses.sa:
मुनि बटु चारि संग तब दीन्हे ।
जिन्ह बहु जनम सुकृत सब कीन्हे ॥
verses.tr:
muni baṭu cāri saṃg tab dīnhe
jinh bahu janam sukṛt sab kīnhe

verses.sa:
करि प्रनामु रिषि आयसु पाई ।
प्रमुदित हृदयँ चले रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
kari pranāmu riṣi āyasu pāī
pramudit hṛdayam̐ cale raghurāī

verses.sa:
ग्राम निकट जब निकसहि जाई ।
देखहि दरसु नारि नर धाई ॥
verses.tr:
grām nikaṭ jab nikasahi jāī
dekhahi darasu nāri nar dhāī

verses.sa:
होहि सनाथ जनम फलु पाई ।
फिरहि दुखित मनु संग पठाई ॥
verses.tr:
hohi sanāth janam phalu pāī
phirahi dukhit manu saṃg paṭhāī

verses.sa:
बिदा किए बटु बिनय करि फिरे पाइ मन काम ।
उतरि नहाए जमुन जल जो सरीर सम स्याम ॥
verses.tr:
bidā kie baṭu binaya kari phire pāi man kām
utari nahāe jamun jal jo sarīr sam syām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Rama had affectionately asked the saint: “‘ Tell me, my lord, by what road we shall go.” ‘The saint replied with a smile: ‘All ways are easy to you,” but called his disciples to go with him. They came with joy, some fifty in number, all in their boundless love for Rama declaring that they knew the road. The saint selected four students who in many previous existences had done many good deeds. Then having bowed to the saint and received his permission to depart, Raghurdi went forth rejoicing. When they had come out near to the village, the men and women who all flocked to see them found in the sight of their lord the fruition of their life, and sadly turning home, sent their heart after him.
Courteously Rama dismissed the disciples, who returned with their heart’s desire obtained; then alighted and bathed in the stream of Jamund, dark as his own body.

sections.label: Doha 110
sections.name: सजल नयन तन पुलकि निज इष्टदेउ पहिचानि

verses.sa:
सुनत तीरवासी नर नारी ।
धाए निज निज काज बिसारी ॥
verses.tr:
sunat tīravāsī nar nārī
dhāe nij nij kāj bisārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
लखन राम सिय सुन्दरताई ।
देखि करहिं निज भाग्य बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
lakhan rām siya sundaratāī
dekhi karahiṃ nij bhāgya bar̤āī

verses.sa:
अति लालसा बसहिं मन माहीं ।
नाउँ गाउँ बूझत सकुचाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ati lālasā basahiṃ man māhīṃ
nāum̐ gāum̐ būjhat sakucāhīṃ

verses.sa:
जे तिन्ह महुँ बयबिरिध सयाने ।
तिन्ह करि जुगुति रामु पहिचाने ॥
verses.tr:
je tinh mahum̐ bayabiridh sayāne
tinh kari juguti rāmu pahicāne

verses.sa:
सकल कथा तिन्ह सबहि सुनाई ।
बनहि चले पितु आयसु पाई ॥
verses.tr:
sakal kathā tinh sabahi sunāī
banahi cale pitu āyasu pāī

verses.sa:
सुनि सबिषाद सकल पछिताहीं ।
रानी रायँ कीन्ह भल नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
suni sabiṣād sakal pachitāhīṃ
rānī rāyam̐ kīnh bhal nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
तेहि अवसर एक तापसु आवा ।
तेजपुंज लघुबयस सुहावा ॥
verses.tr:
tehi avasar ek tāpasu āvā
tejapuṃj laghubayas suhāvā

verses.sa:
कवि अलखित गति बेषु बिरागी ।
मन क्रम बचन राम अनुरागी ॥
verses.tr:
kavi alakhit gati beṣu birāgī
man kram bacan rām anurāgī

verses.sa:
सजल नयन तन पुलकि निज इष्टदेउ पहिचानि ।
परेउ दंड जिमि धरनितल दसा न जाइ बखानि ॥
verses.tr:
sajal nayan tan pulaki nij iṣṭadeu pahicāni
pareu daṃḍ jimi dharanital dasā na jāi bakhāni
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The dwellers on the bank, when they heard of his arri-

val, left whatever they were doing and ran to see him. On beholding the beauty of Lakshman, Rama and Sita, they congratulated themselves on their good fortune, and all with longing heart began diffidently to ask their name and home. The sage elders of the party had wit enough to. recognize Rama, and related his whole history, and how he had come into the desert by his father’s order. At this, they were all sad and complained: ‘The king and queen have done ill."! Men and women alike, on beholding the beauty of Rama, Lakshman and Sita, were agitated with love and pity: “What kind of father and mother must they be, friend, who have sent such children into the wood?”
Then Raghubir urgently exhorted his guide, who in submission to his commands took his way home.

sections.label: Doha 111
sections.name: तब रघुबीर अनेक बिधि सखहि सिखावनु दीन्ह

verses.sa:
राम सप्रेम पुलकि उर लावा ।
परम रंक जनु पारसु पावा ॥
verses.tr:
rām saprem pulaki ur lāvā
param raṃk janu pārasu pāvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मनहुँ प्रेमु परमारथु दोऊ ।
मिलत धरे तन कह सबु कोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
manahum̐ premu paramārathu doū
milat dhare tan kah sabu koū

verses.sa:
बहुरि लखन पायन्ह सोइ लागा ।
लीन्ह उठाइ उमगि अनुरागा ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri lakhan pāyanh soi lāgā
līnh uṭhāi umagi anurāgā

verses.sa:
पुनि सिय चरन धूरि धरि सीसा ।
जननि जानि सिसु दीन्हि असीसा ॥
verses.tr:
puni siya caran dhūri dhari sīsā
janani jāni sisu dīnhi asīsā

verses.sa:
कीन्ह निषाद दंडवत तेही ।
मिलेउ मुदित लखि राम सनेही ॥
verses.tr:
kīnh niṣād daṃḍavat tehī
mileu mudit lakhi rām sanehī

verses.sa:
पिअत नयन पुट रूपु पियूषा ।
मुदित सुअसनु पाइ जिमि भूखा ॥
verses.tr:
piat nayan puṭ rūpu piyūṣā
mudit suasanu pāi jimi bhūkhā

verses.sa:
ते पितु मातु कहहु सखि कैसे ।
जिन्ह पठए बन बालक ऐसे ॥
verses.tr:
te pitu mātu kahahu sakhi kaise
jinh paṭhae ban bālak aise

verses.sa:
राम लखन सिय रूपु निहारी ।
होहिं सनेह बिकल नर नारी ॥
verses.tr:
rām lakhan siya rūpu nihārī
hohiṃ saneh bikal nar nārī

verses.sa:
तब रघुबीर अनेक बिधि सखहि सिखावनु दीन्ह ।
राम रजायसु सीस धरि भवन गवनु तेंइँ कीन्ह ॥
verses.tr:
tab raghubīr anek bidhi sakhahi sikhāvanu dīnh
rām rajāyasu sīs dhari bhavan gavanu teṃim̐ kīnh
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Again with clasped hands Sita, Rama and Lakshman made renewed obeisance to the Jamun, and as they went on their way their talk was all of the daughter of the Sun and her glory. Many travellers met them on the way, and exclaimed, after gazing with affection at the two brothers: “You have all the marks of royalty on your person; on seeing them we are troubled at heart, for you go your way on foot, and the astrologers methinks are false. ‘The road is difficult; the mountains and forests are very great; yet you have with you a delicate girl, Elephants and tigers make the woods too terrible to contemplate; with your permission, we will accompany you, will escort you as far as you please, and then make our bow and return.”
As they proffered this request, their body trembled all over with excess of love, and their eyes filled with tears; but the All-merciful gently and courteously dismissed them.

sections.label: Doha 112
sections.name: एहि बिधि पूँछहिं प्रेम बस पुलक गात जलु नैन

verses.sa:
पुनि सियँ राम लखन कर जोरी ।
जमुनहि कीन्ह प्रनामु बहोरी ॥
verses.tr:
puni siyam̐ rām lakhan kar jorī
jamunahi kīnh pranāmu bahorī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
चले ससीय मुदित दोउ भाई ।
रबितनुजा कइ करत बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
cale sasīya mudit dou bhāī
rabitanujā kai karat bar̤āī

verses.sa:
पथिक अनेक मिलहिं मग जाता ।
कहहिं सप्रेम देखि दोउ भ्राता ॥
verses.tr:
pathik anek milahiṃ mag jātā
kahahiṃ saprem dekhi dou bhrātā

verses.sa:
राज लखन सब अंग तुम्हारें ।
देखि सोचु अति हृदय हमारें ॥
verses.tr:
rāj lakhan sab aṃg tumhāreṃ
dekhi socu ati hṛdaya hamāreṃ

verses.sa:
मारग चलहु पयादेहि पाएँ ।
ज्योतिषु झूठ हमारें भाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
mārag calahu payādehi pāem̐
jyotiṣu jhūṭh hamāreṃ bhāem̐

verses.sa:
अगमु पंथ गिरि कानन भारी ।
तेहि महँ साथ नारि सुकुमारी ॥
verses.tr:
agamu paṃth giri kānan bhārī
tehi maham̐ sāth nāri sukumārī

verses.sa:
करि केहरि बन जाइ न जोई ।
हम सँग चलहि जो आयसु होई ॥
verses.tr:
kari kehari ban jāi na joī
ham sam̐g calahi jo āyasu hoī

verses.sa:
जाब जहाँ लगि तहँ पहुँचाई ।
फिरब बहोरि तुम्हहि सिरु नाई ॥
verses.tr:
jāb jahām̐ lagi taham̐ pahum̐cāī
phirab bahori tumhahi siru nāī

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि पूँछहिं प्रेम बस पुलक गात जलु नैन ।
कृपासिंधु फेरहि तिन्हहि कहि बिनीत मृदु बैन ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi pūm̐chahiṃ prem bas pulak gāt jalu nain
kṛpāsiṃdhu pherahi tinhahi kahi binīt mṛdu bain
verses.head: दोहा

trans: All the towns and villages along the road where the envy of the cities of the Serpents and the Gods:‘ At what an auspicious moment and by what a holy man must they have been founded, to be so happy and blessed and altogether highly favoured!’ Whatever spot was trodden by

Rama’s feet Paradise was not to be compared to it. The dwellers by the wayside, of high desert, w^ere the praise of the denizens of heaven, as they feasted their eyes on Sita and Lakshman and Rama dark of hue as a storm-cloud. The ponds and river in which Rama bathed were the envy of the lake and river of heaven; the trees under which the Lord sat were magnified by the tree of life; and Earth, touched by the dust of Rama’s lotus feet, thought her good fortune complete.
The clouds gave him shade, the exultant hosts of heaven rained down flowers, as Rama proceeded on his way looking at the rocks and woods and birds and deer.

sections.label: Doha 113
sections.name: छाँह करहि घन बिबुधगन बरषहि सुमन सिहाहिं

verses.sa:
जे पुर गाँव बसहिं मग माहीं ।
तिन्हहि नाग सुर नगर सिहाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
je pur gām̐v basahiṃ mag māhīṃ
tinhahi nāg sur nagar sihāhīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
केहि सुकृतीं केहि घरीं बसाए ।
धन्य पुन्यमय परम सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
kehi sukṛtīṃ kehi gharīṃ basāe
dhanya punyamaya param suhāe

verses.sa:
जहँ जहँ राम चरन चलि जाहीं ।
तिन्ह समान अमरावति नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ jaham̐ rām caran cali jāhīṃ
tinh samān amarāvati nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
पुन्यपुंज मग निकट निवासी ।
तिन्हहि सराहहिं सुरपुरबासी ॥
verses.tr:
punyapuṃj mag nikaṭ nivāsī
tinhahi sarāhahiṃ surapurabāsī

verses.sa:
जे भरि नयन बिलोकहिं रामहि ।
सीता लखन सहित घनस्यामहि ॥
verses.tr:
je bhari nayan bilokahiṃ rāmahi
sītā lakhan sahit ghanasyāmahi

verses.sa:
जे सर सरित राम अवगाहहिं ।
तिन्हहि देव सर सरित सराहहिं ॥
verses.tr:
je sar sarit rām avagāhahiṃ
tinhahi dev sar sarit sarāhahiṃ

verses.sa:
जेहि तरु तर प्रभु बैठहिं जाई ।
करहिं कलपतरु तासु बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
jehi taru tar prabhu baiṭhahiṃ jāī
karahiṃ kalapataru tāsu bar̤āī

verses.sa:
परसि राम पद पदुम परागा ।
मानति भूमि भूरि निज भागा ॥
verses.tr:
parasi rām pad padum parāgā
mānati bhūmi bhūri nij bhāgā

verses.sa:
छाँह करहि घन बिबुधगन बरषहि सुमन सिहाहिं ।
देखत गिरि बन बिहग मृग रामु चले मग जाहिं ॥
verses.tr:
chām̐h karahi ghan bibudhagan baraṣahi suman sihāhiṃ
dekhat giri ban bihag mṛg rāmu cale mag jāhiṃ
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Whenever Sita, Lakshman and Raghurdi came out near a village on the way, every one,—young and old; man and woman —came directly they heard the news, forgetting their own private affairs, and as they gazed on their beauty obtained the fruition of their eyes and were made happy for ever. At the sight of the two heroes their eyes filled with tears, their body quivered with emotion, and they became all-enraptured, their state of mind as indescribable as though a beggar had discovered a pile of heavenly jewels. Every one was telling his neighbour: ‘Now is the time to prove the value of sight,” One in his delight to see - Rama would go with him, gazing as, he went; another, drawing his beautiful image into his heart by the way of his eyes, was utterly overpowered in body, soul and speech.
One, seeing a fine shady fig-tree, would spread under it soft grass and leaves and cry; “Rest a little after your fatigue, and proceed again either at once or at daybreak.”

sections.label: Doha 114
sections.name: एक देखिं बट छाँह भलि डासि मृदुल तृन पात

verses.sa:
सीता लखन सहित रघुराई ।
गाँव निकट जब निकसहिं जाई ॥
verses.tr:
sītā lakhan sahit raghurāī
gām̐v nikaṭ jab nikasahiṃ jāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुनि सब बाल बृद्ध नर नारी ।
चलहिं तुरत गृहकाजु बिसारी ॥
verses.tr:
suni sab bāl bṛddh nar nārī
calahiṃ turat gṛhakāju bisārī

verses.sa:
राम लखन सिय रूप निहारी ।
पाइ नयनफलु होहिं सुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
rām lakhan siya rūp nihārī
pāi nayanaphalu hohiṃ sukhārī

verses.sa:
सजल बिलोचन पुलक सरीरा ।
सब भए मगन देखि दोउ बीरा ॥
verses.tr:
sajal bilocan pulak sarīrā
sab bhae magan dekhi dou bīrā

verses.sa:
बरनि न जाइ दसा तिन्ह केरी ।
लहि जनु रंकन्ह सुरमनि ढेरी ॥
verses.tr:
barani na jāi dasā tinh kerī
lahi janu raṃkanh suramani ḍherī

verses.sa:
एकन्ह एक बोलि सिख देहीं ।
लोचन लाहु लेहु छन एहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ekanh ek boli sikh dehīṃ
locan lāhu lehu chan ehīṃ

verses.sa:
रामहि देखि एक अनुरागे ।
चितवत चले जाहिं सँग लागे ॥
verses.tr:
rāmahi dekhi ek anurāge
citavat cale jāhiṃ sam̐g lāge

verses.sa:
एक नयन मग छबि उर आनी ।
होहिं सिथिल तन मन बर बानी ॥
verses.tr:
ek nayan mag chabi ur ānī
hohiṃ sithil tan man bar bānī

verses.sa:
एक देखिं बट छाँह भलि डासि मृदुल तृन पात ।
कहहिं गवाँइअ छिनुकु श्रमु गवनब अबहिं कि प्रात ॥
verses.tr:
ek dekhiṃ baṭ chām̐h bhali ḍāsi mṛdul tṛn pāt
kahahiṃ gavām̐ia chinuku śramu gavanab abahiṃ ki prāt
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Another brought a jar full of water and tenderly besought him ‘Drink’ my lord.” On hearing, their affectionate speech and seeing their great devotion, the compassionate and most amiable Rama, who moreover perceived that. Sita was wearied, rested for a while in the shade of the fig-tree. All were enraptured with his beauty—men and women alike—and their soul was enamoured of his incomparable loveliness, Like a circle of partridges about his moon-like face, so fixed was their gaze, At the sight of his body, dark in hue as a young tamdl tree, a myriad Loves were fascinated; while Lakshman, all comely from head to foot, charmed the soul with his fair limbs, bright as the lightning; io his anchorite’s dress, with his tightly-fitted quiver and bow, and arrows gleaming in his lotus hand.

sections.label: Doha 115
sections.name: जटा मुकुट सीसनि सुभग उर भुज नयन बिसाल

verses.sa:
एक कलस भरि आनहिं पानी ।
अँचइअ नाथ कहहिं मृदु बानी ॥
verses.tr:
ek kalas bhari ānahiṃ pānī
am̐caia nāth kahahiṃ mṛdu bānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुनि प्रिय बचन प्रीति अति देखी ।
राम कृपाल सुसील बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
suni priya bacan prīti ati dekhī
rām kṛpāl susīl biseṣī

verses.sa:
जानी श्रमित सीय मन माहीं ।
घरिक बिलंबु कीन्ह बट छाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jānī śramit sīya man māhīṃ
gharik bilaṃbu kīnh baṭ chāhīṃ

verses.sa:
मुदित नारि नर देखहिं सोभा ।
रूप अनूप नयन मनु लोभा ॥
verses.tr:
mudit nāri nar dekhahiṃ sobhā
rūp anūp nayan manu lobhā

verses.sa:
एकटक सब सोहहिं चहुँ ओरा ।
रामचंद्र मुख चंद चकोरा ॥
verses.tr:
ekaṭak sab sohahiṃ cahum̐ orā
rāmacaṃdr mukh caṃd cakorā

verses.sa:
तरुन तमाल बरन तनु सोहा ।
देखत कोटि मदन मनु मोहा ॥
verses.tr:
tarun tamāl baran tanu sohā
dekhat koṭi madan manu mohā

verses.sa:
दामिनि बरन लखन सुठि नीके ।
नख सिख सुभग भावते जी के ॥
verses.tr:
dāmini baran lakhan suṭhi nīke
nakh sikh subhag bhāvate jī ke

verses.sa:
मुनिपट कटिन्ह कसें तूनीरा ।
सोहहिं कर कमलिनि धनु तीरा ॥
verses.tr:
munipaṭ kaṭinh kaseṃ tūnīrā
sohahiṃ kar kamalini dhanu tīrā

verses.sa:
जटा मुकुट सीसनि सुभग उर भुज नयन बिसाल ।
सरद परब बिधु बदन बर लसत स्वेद कन जाल ॥
verses.tr:
jaṭā mukuṭ sīsani subhag ur bhuj nayan bisāl
sarad parab bidhu badan bar lasat sved kan jāl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: With their hair done up in a knot as a crown upon their graceful heads, with broad chest, strong arms, and large deep eyes, with face like the autumnal full moon, glistening with beads of moisture,

The loveliness of the two brothers is past all telling; it is boundless, and my wit is scant. With every faculty of mind and soul, they all gaze upon the beauteous trio; man and woman thirsting and faint with love, like deer dazed by a light. The village women drew near Sita with tender and basbful enquiries, and again embracing her feet, in their simplicity whispered the question:—‘Noble lady, we have a petition, but, like women, are afraid to make it. Pardon our presumption, madam and be not offended by our country manners. These two charming young princes, from whom emerald and gold might borrow splendoar,
The one dark, the other fair, but both beautiful and homes of delight, with face like the autumn moon, and eyes like the lotuses of autumn,

sections.label: Doha 116
sections.name: स्यामल गौर किसोर बर सुंदर सुषमा ऐन

verses.sa:
बरनि न जाइ मनोहर जोरी ।
सोभा बहुत थोरि मति मोरी ॥
verses.tr:
barani na jāi manohar jorī
sobhā bahut thori mati morī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राम लखन सिय सुंदरताई ।
सब चितवहिं चित मन मति लाई ॥
verses.tr:
rām lakhan siya suṃdaratāī
sab citavahiṃ cit man mati lāī

verses.sa:
थके नारि नर प्रेम पिआसे ।
मनहुँ मृगी मृग देखि दिआ से ॥
verses.tr:
thake nāri nar prem piāse
manahum̐ mṛgī mṛg dekhi diā se

verses.sa:
सीय समीप ग्रामतिय जाहीं ।
पूँछत अति सनेहँ सकुचाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sīya samīp grāmatiya jāhīṃ
pūm̐chat ati saneham̐ sakucāhīṃ

verses.sa:
बार बार सब लागहिं पाएँ ।
कहहिं बचन मृदु सरल सुभाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār sab lāgahiṃ pāem̐
kahahiṃ bacan mṛdu saral subhāem̐

verses.sa:
राजकुमारि बिनय हम करहीं ।
तिय सुभायँ कछु पूँछत डरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
rājakumāri binaya ham karahīṃ
tiya subhāyam̐ kachu pūm̐chat ḍarahīṃ

verses.sa:
स्वामिनि अबिनय छमबि हमारी ।
बिलगु न मानब जानि गवाँरी ॥
verses.tr:
svāmini abinaya chamabi hamārī
bilagu na mānab jāni gavām̐rī

verses.sa:
राजकुअँर दोउ सहज सलोने ।
इन्ह तें लही दुति मरकत सोने ॥
verses.tr:
rājakuam̐r dou sahaj salone
inh teṃ lahī duti marakat sone

verses.sa:
स्यामल गौर किसोर बर सुंदर सुषमा ऐन ।
सरद सर्बरीनाथ मुखु सरद सरोरुह नैन ॥
verses.tr:
syāmal gaur kisor bar suṃdar suṣamā ain
sarad sarbarīnāth mukhu sarad saroruh nain
verses.head: दोहा

trans: That would put to shame a myriad loves, say, fair lady, how stand they to you.” On hearing their pleasant and loving speech, Sita smiled in modest confusion, and looking first at them and then at the earth was abashed—the pretty maid-— with a double atashment. But drooping her fawn-like eyes, and with a voice sweet as the foil’s she lovingly replied: “The fair youth, so easy and graceful, is by name Lakshman, my younger brother-in-law; while he, the dark com-

sections.label: Doha 117
sections.name: अति सप्रेम सिय पायँ परि बहुबिधि देहिं असीस

verses.sa:
कोटि मनोज लजावनिहारे ।
सुमुखि कहहु को आहिं तुम्हारे ॥
verses.tr:
koṭi manoj lajāvanihāre
sumukhi kahahu ko āhiṃ tumhāre
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुनि सनेहमय मंजुल बानी ।
सकुची सिय मन महुँ मुसुकानी ॥
verses.tr:
suni sanehamaya maṃjul bānī
sakucī siya man mahum̐ musukānī

verses.sa:
तिन्हहि बिलोकि बिलोकति धरनी ।
दुहुँ सकोच सकुचित बरबरनी ॥
verses.tr:
tinhahi biloki bilokati dharanī
duhum̐ sakoc sakucit barabaranī

verses.sa:
सकुचि सप्रेम बाल मृग नयनी ।
बोली मधुर बचन पिकबयनी ॥
verses.tr:
sakuci saprem bāl mṛg nayanī
bolī madhur bacan pikabayanī

verses.sa:
सहज सुभाय सुभग तन गोरे ।
नामु लखनु लघु देवर मोरे ॥
verses.tr:
sahaj subhāya subhag tan gore
nāmu lakhanu laghu devar more

verses.sa:
बहुरि बदनु बिधु अंचल ढाँकी ।
पिय तन चितइ भौंह करि बाँकी ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri badanu bidhu aṃcal ḍhām̐kī
piya tan citai bhauṃh kari bām̐kī

verses.sa:
खंजन मंजु तिरीछे नयननि ।
निज पति कहेउ तिन्हहि सियँ सयननि ॥
verses.tr:
khaṃjan maṃju tirīche nayanani
nij pati kaheu tinhahi siyam̐ sayanani

verses.sa:
भइ मुदित सब ग्रामबधूटीं ।
रंकन्ह राय रासि जनु लूटीं ॥
verses.tr:
bhai mudit sab grāmabadhūṭīṃ
raṃkanh rāya rāsi janu lūṭīṃ

verses.sa:
अति सप्रेम सिय पायँ परि बहुबिधि देहिं असीस ।
सदा सोहागिनि होहु तुम्ह जब लगि महि अहि सीस ॥
verses.tr:
ati saprem siya pāyam̐ pari bahubidhi dehiṃ asīs
sadā sohāgini hohu tumh jab lagi mahi ahi sīs
verses.head: दोहा

trans: lexioned, with the large eyes and arms, the all-beautiful with the gentle voice:” here veiling her moon-like face with the border of her robe she looked towards her husband, and her eyebrows with 9 side-long glance like a pretty
“khanjan thus by signs indicated to them her lord. All
the village women were as delighted as beggars who have
robbed a pile of jewels. Dohd 113.
Falling at Sita feet in their great affection, they invoked upon her every blessing: May your happy wedded life last as long as Earth rests on the serpent’s head.
May yoube as dear to your lord as Parvati to Siva.

sections.label: Doha 118
sections.name: लखन जानकी सहित तब गवनु कीन्ह रघुनाथ

verses.sa:
पारबती सम पतिप्रिय होहू ।
देबि न हम पर छाड़ब छोहू ॥
verses.tr:
pārabatī sam patipriya hohū
debi na ham par chār̤ab chohū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पुनि पुनि बिनय करिअ कर जोरी ।
जौं एहि मारग फिरिअ बहोरी ॥
verses.tr:
puni puni binaya karia kar jorī
jauṃ ehi mārag phiria bahorī

verses.sa:
दरसनु देब जानि निज दासी ।
लखीं सीयँ सब प्रेम पिआसी ॥
verses.tr:
darasanu deb jāni nij dāsī
lakhīṃ sīyam̐ sab prem piāsī

verses.sa:
मधुर बचन कहि कहि परितोषीं ।
जनु कुमुदिनीं कौमुदीं पोषीं ॥
verses.tr:
madhur bacan kahi kahi paritoṣīṃ
janu kumudinīṃ kaumudīṃ poṣīṃ

verses.sa:
तबहिं लखन रघुबर रुख जानी ।
पूँछेउ मगु लोगन्हि मृदु बानी ॥
verses.tr:
tabahiṃ lakhan raghubar rukh jānī
pūm̐cheu magu loganhi mṛdu bānī

verses.sa:
सुनत नारि नर भए दुखारी ।
पुलकित गात बिलोचन बारी ॥
verses.tr:
sunat nāri nar bhae dukhārī
pulakit gāt bilocan bārī

verses.sa:
मिटा मोदु मन भए मलीने ।
बिधि निधि दीन्ह लेत जनु छीने ॥
verses.tr:
miṭā modu man bhae malīne
bidhi nidhi dīnh let janu chīne

verses.sa:
समुझि करम गति धीरजु कीन्हा ।
सोधि सुगम मगु तिन्ह कहि दीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
samujhi karam gati dhīraju kīnhā
sodhi sugam magu tinh kahi dīnhā

verses.sa:
लखन जानकी सहित तब गवनु कीन्ह रघुनाथ ।
फेरे सब प्रिय बचन कहि लिए लाइ मन साथ ॥
verses.tr:
lakhan jānakī sahit tab gavanu kīnh raghunāth
phere sab priya bacan kahi lie lāi man sāth
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Yet, lady, cease not to have some regard for us: again and again with clasped hands we beseech you, if you return hy this road, remember us your servants, and allow us to see you.” Finding them all so athirst with love, Sita comforted them with many soothing words, as the lily is cheered by the moonlight. Then Lakshman, perceiving Raghubir’s wish, gently asked the people the way. At his words they became sad, their limbs trembled, their eyes filled with tears, their joy was extinguished, and they were troubled at heart: “God has given usa treasure only to take it away again!” Then reflecting on the ways of Fate and taking courage, they fixed upon the easiest road and explained i to them.
Raghunath took his way to the woods, and with him Lakshman and Janaki; and they all returned home, but with many fond speeches, and in heart accompanied them,

sections.label: Doha 119
sections.name: जौं ए मुनि पट धर जटिल सुंदर सुठि सुकुमार

verses.sa:
फिरत नारि नर अति पछिताहीं ।
देअहि दोषु देहिं मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
phirat nāri nar ati pachitāhīṃ
deahi doṣu dehiṃ man māhīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सहित बिषाद परसपर कहहीं ।
बिधि करतब उलटे सब अहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sahit biṣād parasapar kahahīṃ
bidhi karatab ulaṭe sab ahahīṃ

verses.sa:
निपट निरंकुस निठुर निसंकू ।
जेहिं ससि कीन्ह सरुज सकलंकू ॥
verses.tr:
nipaṭ niraṃkus niṭhur nisaṃkū
jehiṃ sasi kīnh saruj sakalaṃkū

verses.sa:
रूख कलपतरु सागरु खारा ।
तेहिं पठए बन राजकुमारा ॥
verses.tr:
rūkh kalapataru sāgaru khārā
tehiṃ paṭhae ban rājakumārā

verses.sa:
जौं पे इन्हहि दीन्ह बनबासू ।
कीन्ह बादि बिधि भोग बिलासू ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ pe inhahi dīnh banabāsū
kīnh bādi bidhi bhog bilāsū

verses.sa:
ए बिचरहिं मग बिनु पदत्राना ।
रचे बादि बिधि बाहन नाना ॥
verses.tr:
e bicarahiṃ mag binu padatrānā
race bādi bidhi bāhan nānā

verses.sa:
ए महि परहिं डासि कुस पाता ।
सुभग सेज कत सृजत बिधाता ॥
verses.tr:
e mahi parahiṃ ḍāsi kus pātā
subhag sej kat sṛjat bidhātā

verses.sa:
तरुबर बास इन्हहि बिधि दीन्हा ।
धवल धाम रचि रचि श्रमु कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
tarubar bās inhahi bidhi dīnhā
dhaval dhām raci raci śramu kīnhā

verses.sa:
जौं ए मुनि पट धर जटिल सुंदर सुठि सुकुमार ।
बिबिध भाँति भूषन बसन बादि किए करतार ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ e muni paṭ dhar jaṭil suṃdar suṭhi sukumār
bibidh bhām̐ti bhūṣan basan bādi kie karatār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Men and women alike on their way back lamented exceedingly and imputed blame to Fate, saying sadly to one another: ‘God’s doings are all perverse. He is utterly uncontrollable, cruel and remorseless; who has made the moon sickly and spotted, the tree of paradise a lifeless block, and the ocean all salt, and who now has sent these princely boys into the wilderness If the woods are their proper abode, then for whom has he intended ease and pleasure? If they are to wander on their way barefooted, it is to no purpose that he has invented so many kinds of carriages. If they are to lie on the ground littered only with grass and leaves, for whom has God created comfort- able couches If he makes them live under the trees, why has he taken such pains to erect splendid palaces?
If such lovely and delicate children wear the rough dress and matted locks of anchorites, it is to no purpose that the great artificer has made so many kinds of dress and ornn-iment.

sections.label: Doha 120
sections.name: एहि बिधि कहि कहि बचन प्रिय लेहिं नयन भरि नीर

verses.sa:
जौं ए कंद मूल फल खाहीं ।
बादि सुधादि असन जग माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ e kaṃd mūl phal khāhīṃ
bādi sudhādi asan jag māhīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
एक कहहिं ए सहज सुहाए ।
आपु प्रगट भए बिधि न बनाए ॥
verses.tr:
ek kahahiṃ e sahaj suhāe
āpu pragaṭ bhae bidhi na banāe

verses.sa:
जहँ लगि बेद कही बिधि करनी ।
श्रवन नयन मन गोचर बरनी ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ lagi bed kahī bidhi karanī
śravan nayan man gocar baranī

verses.sa:
देखहु खोजि भुअन दस चारी ।
कहँ अस पुरुष कहाँ असि नारी ॥
verses.tr:
dekhahu khoji bhuan das cārī
kaham̐ as puruṣ kahām̐ asi nārī

verses.sa:
इन्हहि देखि बिधि मनु अनुरागा ।
पटतर जोग बनावै लागा ॥
verses.tr:
inhahi dekhi bidhi manu anurāgā
paṭatar jog banāvai lāgā

verses.sa:
कीन्ह बहुत श्रम ऐक न आए ।
तेहिं इरिषा बन आनि दुराए ॥
verses.tr:
kīnh bahut śram aik na āe
tehiṃ iriṣā ban āni durāe

verses.sa:
एक कहहिं हम बहुत न जानहिं ।
आपुहि परम धन्य करि मानहिं ॥
verses.tr:
ek kahahiṃ ham bahut na jānahiṃ
āpuhi param dhanya kari mānahiṃ

verses.sa:
ते पुनि पुन्यपुंज हम लेखे ।
जे देखहिं देखिहहिं जिन्ह देखे ॥
verses.tr:
te puni punyapuṃj ham lekhe
je dekhahiṃ dekhihahiṃ jinh dekhe

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि कहि कहि बचन प्रिय लेहिं नयन भरि नीर ।
किमि चलिहहि मारग अगम सुठि सुकुमार सरीर ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi kahi kahi bacan priya lehiṃ nayan bhari nīr
kimi calihahi mārag agam suṭhi sukumār sarīr
verses.head: दोहा

trans: If they are to eat only fruits and herbs, all the delicacies of the world are thrown away.’ Said one:“ They are so beautiful, they must have been spontaneously produced and not made by God at all. In all the works of God of which the Vedas speak, that either the earscan hear, or the eyes see, or the mind imagine, or the tongue tell—search and examine the whole fourteen spheres —where is there such a man, and where such a woman? When he saw them, God was so pleased that he essayed to make their match: bat after much labour, nothing came of it, and thus in spite he has sent and buried them in the woods.” Said another: “I am no great scholar, but [ account myself supremely happy; nay, blessed are all, in my opinion, who see him, or have seen him, or shall see him.”:
With such affectionate discourse their eyes filled with tears: ‘How can they, who are so delicate, traverse so difficult a road.”

sections.label: Doha 121
sections.name: अबला बालक बृद्ध जन कर मीजहिं पछिताहिं

verses.sa:
नारि सनेह बिकल बस होहीं ।
चकई साँझ समय जनु सोहीं ॥
verses.tr:
nāri saneh bikal bas hohīṃ
cakaī sām̐jh samaya janu sohīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मृदु पद कमल कठिन मगु जानी ।
गहबरि हृदयँ कहहिं बर बानी ॥
verses.tr:
mṛdu pad kamal kaṭhin magu jānī
gahabari hṛdayam̐ kahahiṃ bar bānī

verses.sa:
परसत मृदुल चरन अरुनारे ।
सकुचति महि जिमि हृदय हमारे ॥
verses.tr:
parasat mṛdul caran arunāre
sakucati mahi jimi hṛdaya hamāre

verses.sa:
जौं जगदीस इन्हहि बनु दीन्हा ।
कस न सुमनमय मारगु कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ jagadīs inhahi banu dīnhā
kas na sumanamaya māragu kīnhā

verses.sa:
जौं मागा पाइअ बिधि पाहीं ।
ए रखिअहिं सखि आँखिन्ह माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ māgā pāia bidhi pāhīṃ
e rakhiahiṃ sakhi ām̐khinh māhīṃ

verses.sa:
जे नर नारि न अवसर आए ।
तिन्ह सिय रामु न देखन पाए ॥
verses.tr:
je nar nāri na avasar āe
tinh siya rāmu na dekhan pāe

verses.sa:
सुनि सुरुप बूझहिं अकुलाई ।
अब लगि गए कहाँ लगि भाई ॥
verses.tr:
suni surup būjhahiṃ akulāī
ab lagi gae kahām̐ lagi bhāī

verses.sa:
समरथ धाइ बिलोकहिं जाई ।
प्रमुदित फिरहिं जनमफलु पाई ॥
verses.tr:
samarath dhāi bilokahiṃ jāī
pramudit phirahiṃ janamaphalu pāī

verses.sa: अबला बालक बृद्ध जन कर मीजहिं पछिताहिं ॥
verses.tr: abalā bālak bṛddh jan kar mījahiṃ pachitāhiṃ
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: होहिं प्रेमबस लोग इमि रामु जहाँ जहँ जाहिं ॥
verses.tr: hohiṃ premabas log imi rāmu jahām̐ jaham̐ jāhiṃ

trans: All the women were made as uneasy by their love as is the chakwi at evening time. As they thought upon their tender lotus feet and the hardness of the road, they were distrest at heart and cried in plaintive tones; “At the touch of their soft and rosy feet, the very earth shrinks, as shrinks our heart. If the great God must send them to the woods, why did he not strew their path with flowers If there be one boon that we may ask of Heaven and obtain, let it be, friend, that we keep them ever in our eyes.” All the people who had not come in time, and thus had missed seeing Sita and Rama, when they heard of their beauty, asked anxiously ‘How far, brother, will they have got by this time: [hey who were strong ran on and saw them, and returned with joy, having obtained the fruition of their eyes.
The women and children and the aged wrung their hands and lamented. In this manner, wherever Rama went, the people were smitten with love.

sections.label: Doha 122
sections.name: एहि बिधि रघुकुल कमल रबि मग लोगन्ह सुख देत

verses.sa:
गाँव गाँव अस होइ अनंदू ।
देखि भानुकुल कैरव चंदू ॥
verses.tr:
gām̐v gām̐v as hoi anaṃdū
dekhi bhānukul kairav caṃdū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जे कछु समाचार सुनि पावहिं ।
ते नृप रानिहि दोसु लगावहिं ॥
verses.tr:
je kachu samācār suni pāvahiṃ
te nṛp rānihi dosu lagāvahiṃ

verses.sa:
कहहिं एक अति भल नरनाहू ।
दीन्ह हमहि जोइ लोचन लाहू ॥
verses.tr:
kahahiṃ ek ati bhal naranāhū
dīnh hamahi joi locan lāhū

verses.sa:
कहहिं परस्पर लोग लोगाईं ।
बातें सरल सनेह सुहाईं ॥
verses.tr:
kahahiṃ paraspar log logāīṃ
bāteṃ saral saneh suhāīṃ

verses.sa:
ते पितु मातु धन्य जिन्ह जाए ।
धन्य सो नगरु जहाँ तें आए ॥
verses.tr:
te pitu mātu dhanya jinh jāe
dhanya so nagaru jahām̐ teṃ āe

verses.sa:
धन्य सो देसु सैलु बन गाऊँ ।
जहँ जहँ जाहिं धन्य सोइ ठाऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
dhanya so desu sailu ban gāūm̐
jaham̐ jaham̐ jāhiṃ dhanya soi ṭhāūm̐

verses.sa:
सुख पायउ बिरंचि रचि तेही ।
ए जेहि के सब भाँति सनेही ॥
verses.tr:
sukh pāyau biraṃci raci tehī
e jehi ke sab bhām̐ti sanehī

verses.sa:
राम लखन पथि कथा सुहाई ।
रही सकल मग कानन छाई ॥
verses.tr:
rām lakhan pathi kathā suhāī
rahī sakal mag kānan chāī

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि रघुकुल कमल रबि मग लोगन्ह सुख देत ।
जाहिं चले देखत बिपिन सिय सौमित्रि समेत ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi raghukul kamal rabi mag loganh sukh det
jāhiṃ cale dekhat bipin siya saumitri samet
verses.head: दोहा

trans: In every village was similar rejoicing at the sight of the moon of the lilylike solar race. Some who had learnt by hear-say of what had been going on imputed blame to the king and queen. One said: “It was very good of the king to give our eyes such a treat.” Said others among themselves in simple and loving phrase: “Happy the father and mother who gave them birth and happy the city from whence they came? Happy the hills, and plains, and woods, and towns, and every spot which they visit. Even the Creator who made them is pleased—nay, is absolutely in love with them.” The delightful history of Rama, Lakshman and Sita thus spread over every road and forest.
In this manner the Sun of the lotus-like Solar race gladdened the people on the road, as with Sita and the son of Sumitra he proceeded on his travels through the woods,

sections.label: Doha 123
sections.name: जिन्ह जिन्ह देखे पथिक प्रिय सिय समेत दोउ भाइ

verses.sa:
आगे रामु लखनु बने पाछें ।
तापस बेष बिराजत काछें ॥
verses.tr:
āge rāmu lakhanu bane pācheṃ
tāpas beṣ birājat kācheṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
उभय बीच सिय सोहति कैसे ।
ब्रह्म जीव बिच माया जैसे ॥
verses.tr:
ubhaya bīc siya sohati kaise
brahm jīv bic māyā jaise

verses.sa:
बहुरि कहउँ छबि जसि मन बसई ।
जनु मधु मदन मध्य रति लसई ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri kahaum̐ chabi jasi man basaī
janu madhu madan madhya rati lasaī

verses.sa:
उपमा बहुरि कहउँ जियँ जोही ।
जनु बुध बिधु बिच रोहिनि सोही ॥
verses.tr:
upamā bahuri kahaum̐ jiyam̐ johī
janu budh bidhu bic rohini sohī

verses.sa:
प्रभु पद रेख बीच बिच सीता ।
धरति चरन मग चलति सभीता ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu pad rekh bīc bic sītā
dharati caran mag calati sabhītā

verses.sa:
सीय राम पद अंक बराएँ ।
लखन चलहिं मगु दाहिन लाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
sīya rām pad aṃk barāem̐
lakhan calahiṃ magu dāhin lāem̐

verses.sa:
राम लखन सिय प्रीति सुहाई ।
बचन अगोचर किमि कहि जाई ॥
verses.tr:
rām lakhan siya prīti suhāī
bacan agocar kimi kahi jāī

verses.sa:
खग मृग मगन देखि छबि होहीं ।
लिए चोरि चित राम बटोहीं ॥
verses.tr:
khag mṛg magan dekhi chabi hohīṃ
lie cori cit rām baṭohīṃ

verses.sa:
जिन्ह जिन्ह देखे पथिक प्रिय सिय समेत दोउ भाइ ।
भव मगु अगमु अनंदु तेइ बिनु श्रम रहे सिराइ ॥
verses.tr:
jinh jinh dekhe pathik priya siya samet dou bhāi
bhav magu agamu anaṃdu tei binu śram rahe sirāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Rama walked in front and Lakshman behind, conspicuous in the hermit’s dress they wore; and between the two Sita shone resplendent as Maya who connects the life of God with the life of the world. Or, to describe her beauty by another fancy, she seemed like Rati between Spring and Love; or, to ransack my mind for yet another simile, like the constellation Rohini between Budha and the Moon. As she went along the way, Sita carefully planted her feet between the footprints of her lord; while Lakshman, avoid-ing the footprints of them both, set his feet us he went to their right and left. The charming affection of all three was beyond all telling; how can I declare it Birds and deer were fascinated at the sight of their beauty, and Rama the wayfarer stole their heart.
All who beheld the dear travellers, Sita and the two brothers, joyously and without fatigue arrived at once at the end of the toilsome journey of life.

sections.label: Doha 124
sections.name: सुचि सुंदर आश्रमु निरखि हरषे राजिवनेन

verses.sa:
अजहुँ जासु उर सपनेहुँ काऊ ।
बसहुँ लखनु सिय रामु बटाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
ajahum̐ jāsu ur sapanehum̐ kāū
basahum̐ lakhanu siya rāmu baṭāū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राम धाम पथ पाइहि सोई ।
जो पथ पाव कबहुँ मुनि कोई ॥
verses.tr:
rām dhām path pāihi soī
jo path pāv kabahum̐ muni koī

verses.sa:
तब रघुबीर श्रमित सिय जानी ।
देखि निकट बटु सीतल पानी ॥
verses.tr:
tab raghubīr śramit siya jānī
dekhi nikaṭ baṭu sītal pānī

verses.sa:
तहँ बसि कंद मूल फल खाई ।
प्रात नहाइ चले रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
taham̐ basi kaṃd mūl phal khāī
prāt nahāi cale raghurāī

verses.sa:
देखत बन सर सैल सुहाए ।
बालमीकि आश्रम प्रभु आए ॥
verses.tr:
dekhat ban sar sail suhāe
bālamīki āśram prabhu āe

verses.sa:
राम दीख मुनि बासु सुहावन ।
सुंदर गिरि काननु जलु पावन ॥
verses.tr:
rām dīkh muni bāsu suhāvan
suṃdar giri kānanu jalu pāvan

verses.sa:
सरनि सरोज बिटप बन फूले ।
गुंजत मंजु मधुप रस भूले ॥
verses.tr:
sarani saroj biṭap ban phūle
guṃjat maṃju madhup ras bhūle

verses.sa:
खग मृग बिपुल कोलाहल करहीं ।
बिरहित बैर मुदित मन चरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
khag mṛg bipul kolāhal karahīṃ
birahit bair mudit man carahīṃ

verses.sa:
सुचि सुंदर आश्रमु निरखि हरषे राजिवनेन ।
सुनि रघुबर आगमनु मुनि आगें आयउ लेन ॥
verses.tr:
suci suṃdar āśramu nirakhi haraṣe rājivanen
suni raghubar āgamanu muni āgeṃ āyau len
verses.head: दोहा

trans: And to this day any soul in which the vision of the wayfarers, Rama, Sita and Lakshman abides, finds the path that leads to Rama’s home, path that scarce a saint may find. Then Raghubir, knowing that Sita was tired, and observing a fig-tree close at hand and cool water, there rested and took some roots and fruits to eat, and after bathing at dawn again went on his way. Admiring the beauty of the woods and lakes and rocks, he arrived at Valmiki’s hermitage. He found the saint’s dwelling a charming spot, a lovely wooded hill with a spring of clear water, lotuses in the pond, the forest trees all in flower, with a delightful hum of bees drunk with sweets, anda joyous clamour of birds and beasts feeding happily and in peace together.
The Lotus-eyed was glad as he gazed upon the bright and fair retreat, and the saint on hearing of his arrival came forth to meet him.

sections.label: Doha 125
sections.name: तात बचन पुनि मातु हित भाइ भरत अस राउ

verses.sa:
मुनि कहुँ राम दंडवत कीन्हा ।
आसिरबादु बिप्रबर दीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
muni kahum̐ rām daṃḍavat kīnhā
āsirabādu biprabar dīnhā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
देखि राम छबि नयन जुड़ाने ।
करि सनमानु आश्रमहिं आने ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi rām chabi nayan jur̤āne
kari sanamānu āśramahiṃ āne

verses.sa:
मुनिबर अतिथि प्रानप्रिय पाए ।
कंद मूल फल मधुर मगाए ॥
verses.tr:
munibar atithi prānapriya pāe
kaṃd mūl phal madhur magāe

verses.sa:
सिय सौमित्रि राम फल खाए ।
तब मुनि आश्रम दिए सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
siya saumitri rām phal khāe
tab muni āśram die suhāe

verses.sa:
बालमीकि मन आनँदु भारी ।
मंगल मूरति नयन निहारी ॥
verses.tr:
bālamīki man ānam̐du bhārī
maṃgal mūrati nayan nihārī

verses.sa:
तब कर कमल जोरि रघुराई ।
बोले बचन श्रवन सुखदाई ॥
verses.tr:
tab kar kamal jori raghurāī
bole bacan śravan sukhadāī

verses.sa:
तुम्ह त्रिकाल दरसी मुनिनाथा ।
बिस्व बदर जिमि तुम्हरें हाथा ॥
verses.tr:
tumh trikāl darasī munināthā
bisv badar jimi tumhareṃ hāthā

verses.sa:
अस कहि प्रभु सब कथा बखानी ।
जेहि जेहि भाँति दीन्ह बनु रानी ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi prabhu sab kathā bakhānī
jehi jehi bhām̐ti dīnh banu rānī

verses.sa:
तात बचन पुनि मातु हित भाइ भरत अस राउ ।
मो कहुँ दरस तुम्हार प्रभु सबु मम पुन्य प्रभाउ ॥
verses.tr:
tāt bacan puni mātu hit bhāi bharat as rāu
mo kahum̐ daras tumhār prabhu sabu mam punya prabhāu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Rama prostrated himself before him, as the holy man gave him his blessing. At the sight of Rama's beauty, his eyes were rejoiced and he conducted him with all honour to his cell; there gave hima choice seat asa guest dear to him as his own life, and sent for herbs and sweet fruits, of which Sita, Lakshman and Rama ate. Great was the joy of Valmiki’s soul as his eyes beheld the image of bliss. Then folding his lotus hands, Rama thus spoke in words to charm his ears: “King of sages, all time, past, present and future, is in your ken, and the universe is like a little plum inthe palm of your hand.” So saying, the lord related to him the whole history and how the queen had banished him.
‘« My father’s promise, my mother’s schemes, my brother Bharat’s coronation, and my own meeting with you, my lord, are all blessings that only past merit can have won for me.

sections.label: Doha 126
sections.name: राम सरुप तुम्हार बचन अगोचर बुद्धिपर

verses.sa:
देखि पाय मुनिराय तुम्हारे ।
भए सुकृत सब सुफल हमारे ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi pāya munirāya tumhāre
bhae sukṛt sab suphal hamāre
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अब जहँ राउर आयसु होई ।
मुनि उदबेगु न पावै कोई ॥
verses.tr:
ab jaham̐ rāur āyasu hoī
muni udabegu na pāvai koī

verses.sa:
मुनि तापस जिन्ह तें दुखु लहहीं ।
ते नरेस बिनु पावक दहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
muni tāpas jinh teṃ dukhu lahahīṃ
te nares binu pāvak dahahīṃ

verses.sa:
मंगल मूल बिप्र परितोषू ।
दहइ कोटि कुल भूसुर रोषू ॥
verses.tr:
maṃgal mūl bipr paritoṣū
dahai koṭi kul bhūsur roṣū

verses.sa:
अस जियँ जानि कहिअ सोइ ठाऊँ ।
सिय सौमित्रि सहित जहँ जाऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
as jiyam̐ jāni kahia soi ṭhāūm̐
siya saumitri sahit jaham̐ jāūm̐

verses.sa:
तहँ रचि रुचिर परन तृन साला ।
बासु करौ कछु काल कृपाला ॥
verses.tr:
taham̐ raci rucir paran tṛn sālā
bāsu karau kachu kāl kṛpālā

verses.sa:
सहज सरल सुनि रघुबर बानी ।
साधु साधु बोले मुनि ग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
sahaj saral suni raghubar bānī
sādhu sādhu bole muni gyānī

verses.sa:
कस न कहहु अस रघुकुलकेतू ।
तुम्ह पालक संतत श्रुति सेतू ॥
verses.tr:
kas na kahahu as raghukulaketū
tumh pālak saṃtat śruti setū

verses.sa:
श्रुति सेतु पालक राम तुम्ह जगदीस माया जानकी ।
जो सृजति जगु पालति हरति रूख पाइ कृपानिधान की ॥
verses.tr:
śruti setu pālak rām tumh jagadīs māyā jānakī
jo sṛjati jagu pālati harati rūkh pāi kṛpānidhān kī
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
जो सहससीसु अहीसु महिधरु लखनु सचराचर धनी ।
सुर काज धरि नरराज तनु चले दलन खल निसिचर अनी ॥
verses.tr:
jo sahasasīsu ahīsu mahidharu lakhanu sacarācar dhanī
sur kāj dhari nararāj tanu cale dalan khal nisicar anī

verses.sa:
राम सरुप तुम्हार बचन अगोचर बुद्धिपर ।
अबिगत अकथ अपार नेति नित निगम कह ॥
verses.tr:
rām sarup tumhār bacan agocar buddhipar
abigat akath apār neti nit nigam kah
verses.head: दोहा

trans: In beholding your feet, holy sir, all my good deeds are

rewarded. Now, wherever it may be your order, and no anchorite be troubled —for those monarchs burn, even though there be no fire, who vex either saint or ascetic: the satisfaction of a Brahman is the root of all happiness, while his wrath consumes « thousand generations—tell me then some place to which [ can go with Sita and Sumitra’s son, and there build a pretty hut of grass and twigs and rest awhile, kind sir.” On hearing his ingenious speech, the allwise, seer exclaimed: “True, true It is only natural for you so to speak, pride of the Raghu line, guardian of the eternal bridge of Kevelation.

Guardiao of the bridge of Revelation, you, O Rama, are the lord of the universe, and Janaki is Maya, who at your gracious will creates, preserves, or destroys the world. And Lakshman is the thousand-headed serpent lord, the supporter of the world with all that it contains, Living or lifeless, who in behalf of the gods has taken a kingly form and goes forth to rout the demon host,
- Your semblance, O Rama, transcends speech and is beyond conception, all-pervading, unutterable, illimitable, undefinable even by the Scriptures.

sections.label: Doha 127
sections.name: पूँछेहु मोहि कि रहौं कहँ मैं पूँछत सकुचाउँ

verses.sa:
जगु पेखन तुम्ह देखनिहारे ।
बिधि हरि संभु नचावनिहारे ॥
verses.tr:
jagu pekhan tumh dekhanihāre
bidhi hari saṃbhu nacāvanihāre
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तेउ न जानहिं मरमु तुम्हारा ।
औरु तुम्हहि को जाननिहारा ॥
verses.tr:
teu na jānahiṃ maramu tumhārā
auru tumhahi ko jānanihārā

verses.sa:
सोइ जानइ जेहि देहु जनाई ।
जानत तुम्हहि तुम्हइ होइ जाई ॥
verses.tr:
soi jānai jehi dehu janāī
jānat tumhahi tumhai hoi jāī

verses.sa:
तुम्हरिहि कृपाँ तुम्हहि रघुनंदन ।
जानहिं भगत भगत उर चंदन ॥
verses.tr:
tumharihi kṛpām̐ tumhahi raghunaṃdan
jānahiṃ bhagat bhagat ur caṃdan

verses.sa:
चिदानंदमय देह तुम्हारी ।
बिगत बिकार जान अधिकारी ॥
verses.tr:
cidānaṃdamaya deh tumhārī
bigat bikār jān adhikārī

verses.sa:
नर तनु धरेहु संत सुर काजा ।
कहहु करहु जस प्राकृत राजा ॥
verses.tr:
nar tanu dharehu saṃt sur kājā
kahahu karahu jas prākṛt rājā

verses.sa:
राम देखि सुनि चरित तुम्हारे ।
जड़ मोहहिं बुध होहिं सुखारे ॥
verses.tr:
rām dekhi suni carit tumhāre
jar̤ mohahiṃ budh hohiṃ sukhāre

verses.sa:
तुम्ह जो कहहु करहु सबु साँचा ।
जस काछिअ तस चाहिअ नाचा ॥
verses.tr:
tumh jo kahahu karahu sabu sām̐cā
jas kāchia tas cāhia nācā

verses.sa:
पूँछेहु मोहि कि रहौं कहँ मैं पूँछत सकुचाउँ ।
जहँ न होहु तहँ देहु कहि तुम्हहि देखावौं ठाउँ ॥
verses.tr:
pūm̐chehu mohi ki rahauṃ kaham̐ maiṃ pūm̐chat sakucāum̐
jaham̐ na hohu taham̐ dehu kahi tumhahi dekhāvauṃ ṭhāum̐
verses.head: दोहा

trans: You look on at the drama of life, and Brahma, Hari and Sambhu are your puppets. Even they know not your secret, and who else could discover you? He only knows you to whom you have vouchsafed knowledge; and he who knows you becomes one with you. It is by your grace, O Raghunandan, that your votaries learn to know you, soothing sandal-wood of the devout soul. Your body is pure intelligence and bliss, devoid of change, as they know who have found you. In behalf of the saints and the gods you have taken a human body and speak and act like an ordinary king. Fools are bewildered, but the wise rejoice, as they see or hear of your doings; whatever you say or do is true, and we can only play such parts as you set ys.
You ask of me‘ Where can I stay?’ but I ask with

sections.label: Doha 128
sections.name: जसु तुम्हार मानस बिमल हंसिनि जीहा जासु

verses.sa:
सुनि मुनि बचन प्रेम रस साने ।
सकुचि राम मन महुँ मुसुकाने ॥
verses.tr:
suni muni bacan prem ras sāne
sakuci rām man mahum̐ musukāne
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बालमीकि हँसि कहहिं बहोरी ।
बानी मधुर अमिअ रस बोरी ॥
verses.tr:
bālamīki ham̐si kahahiṃ bahorī
bānī madhur amia ras borī

verses.sa:
सुनहु राम अब कहउँ निकेता ।
जहाँ बसहु सिय लखन समेता ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu rām ab kahaum̐ niketā
jahām̐ basahu siya lakhan sametā

verses.sa:
जिन्ह के श्रवन समुद्र समाना ।
कथा तुम्हारि सुभग सरि नाना ॥
verses.tr:
jinh ke śravan samudr samānā
kathā tumhāri subhag sari nānā

verses.sa:
भरहिं निरंतर होहिं न पूरे ।
तिन्ह के हिय तुम्ह कहुँ गृह रूरे ॥
verses.tr:
bharahiṃ niraṃtar hohiṃ na pūre
tinh ke hiya tumh kahum̐ gṛh rūre

verses.sa:
लोचन चातक जिन्ह करि राखे ।
रहहिं दरस जलधर अभिलाषे ॥
verses.tr:
locan cātak jinh kari rākhe
rahahiṃ daras jaladhar abhilāṣe

verses.sa:
निदरहिं सरित सिंधु सर भारी ।
रूप बिंदु जल होहिं सुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
nidarahiṃ sarit siṃdhu sar bhārī
rūp biṃdu jal hohiṃ sukhārī

verses.sa:
तिन्ह के हृदय सदन सुखदायक ।
बसहु बंधु सिय सह रघुनायक ॥
verses.tr:
tinh ke hṛdaya sadan sukhadāyak
basahu baṃdhu siya sah raghunāyak

verses.sa:
जसु तुम्हार मानस बिमल हंसिनि जीहा जासु ।
मुकुताहल गुन गन चुनइ राम बसहु हियँ तासु ॥
verses.tr:
jasu tumhār mānas bimal haṃsini jīhā jāsu
mukutāhal gun gan cunai rām basahu hiyam̐ tāsu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: trembling, tell me where are you not, there will I assign you a place.”

On hearing the sage’s affectionate words, Rama was abashed and smiled to himself. Again Valmiki cried gaily in tones of honeyed sweetness: “Hearken, Rama;1 will now tell you the places where you and Sita and Lakshman should abide. They whose ears are like the ocean to catch the blessed streams of your traditions, and though ever replen-ished are never filled to the full, their heart shall be your chosen abode. They whose eyes long for your presence, as passionately as the chdtak for the rain-cloud, and scorning the water of river, lake or sea, quench their thirst only in your beauty, their hearts are your glorious mansion; there abide, O Raghunaeyak, with Lakshman and Sita.
Whose tongue, like the swan in the clear hyperboreal lake of your renown gathers up the pearls of your perfections; in his heart, Rama, fix your home.

sections.label: Doha 129
sections.name: सबु करि मागहिं एक फलु राम चरन रति होउ

verses.sa:
प्रभु प्रसाद सुचि सुभग सुबासा ।
सादर जासु लहइ नित नासा ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu prasād suci subhag subāsā
sādar jāsu lahai nit nāsā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तुम्हहि निबेदित भोजन करहीं ।
प्रभु प्रसाद पट भूषन धरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
tumhahi nibedit bhojan karahīṃ
prabhu prasād paṭ bhūṣan dharahīṃ

verses.sa:
सीस नवहिं सुर गुरु द्विज देखी ।
प्रीति सहित करि बिनय बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
sīs navahiṃ sur guru dvij dekhī
prīti sahit kari binaya biseṣī

verses.sa:
कर नित करहिं राम पद पूजा ।
राम भरोस हृदयँ नहि दूजा ॥
verses.tr:
kar nit karahiṃ rām pad pūjā
rām bharos hṛdayam̐ nahi dūjā

verses.sa:
चरन राम तीरथ चलि जाहीं ।
राम बसहु तिन्ह के मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
caran rām tīrath cali jāhīṃ
rām basahu tinh ke man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
मंत्रराजु नित जपहिं तुम्हारा ।
पूजहिं तुम्हहि सहित परिवारा ॥
verses.tr:
maṃtrarāju nit japahiṃ tumhārā
pūjahiṃ tumhahi sahit parivārā

verses.sa:
तरपन होम करहिं बिधि नाना ।
बिप्र जेवाँइ देहिं बहु दाना ॥
verses.tr:
tarapan hom karahiṃ bidhi nānā
bipr jevām̐i dehiṃ bahu dānā

verses.sa:
तुम्ह तें अधिक गुरहि जियँ जानी ।
सकल भायँ सेवहिं सनमानी ॥
verses.tr:
tumh teṃ adhik gurahi jiyam̐ jānī
sakal bhāyam̐ sevahiṃ sanamānī

verses.sa:
सबु करि मागहिं एक फलु राम चरन रति होउ ।
तिन्ह कें मन मंदिर बसहु सिय रघुनंदन दोउ ॥
verses.tr:
sabu kari māgahiṃ ek phalu rām caran rati hou
tinh keṃ man maṃdir basahu siya raghunaṃdan dou
verses.head: दोहा

trans: They who ever reverently inhale the sweet and blessed odour of the offerings to their lord; who feed upon what has been offered to you; who wear only raiment and adornments first offered to you; who bow their heads when they see a god, a guru, ora Brahman, and treat them with all honour and affection; whose hands are ever engaged io paying. R4ma worship; who have no other hope but Rama in their heart; and whose feet ever bear them to his shrines; be their soul, Rama, your dwelling-place. They who are ever repeat ing your holy name, and adoring you with their family; who perform the varied rites of oblation and sacrifice; who feast Brahmans, and give them liberal] donations; who regard their own guru even more than you, and serve him with all honour and affection.
Who ask of all one only boon, devotion to Rama; be _ their heart your temple wherein to abide, O Sita and you two brothers.

sections.label: Doha 130
sections.name: स्वामि सखा पितु मातु गुर जिन्ह के सब तुम्ह तात

verses.sa:
काम कोह मद मान न मोहा ।
लोभ न छोभ न राग न द्रोहा ॥
verses.tr:
kām koh mad mān na mohā
lobh na chobh na rāg na drohā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जिन्ह कें कपट दंभ नहिं माया ।
तिन्ह कें हृदय बसहु रघुराया ॥
verses.tr:
jinh keṃ kapaṭ daṃbh nahiṃ māyā
tinh keṃ hṛdaya basahu raghurāyā

verses.sa:
सब के प्रिय सब के हितकारी ।
दुख सुख सरिस प्रसंसा गारी ॥
verses.tr:
sab ke priya sab ke hitakārī
dukh sukh saris prasaṃsā gārī

verses.sa:
कहहिं सत्य प्रिय बचन बिचारी ।
जागत सोवत सरन तुम्हारी ॥
verses.tr:
kahahiṃ satya priya bacan bicārī
jāgat sovat saran tumhārī

verses.sa:
तुम्हहि छाड़ि गति दूसरि नाहीं ।
राम बसहु तिन्ह के मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
tumhahi chār̤i gati dūsari nāhīṃ
rām basahu tinh ke man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
जननी सम जानहिं परनारी ।
धनु पराव बिष तें बिष भारी ॥
verses.tr:
jananī sam jānahiṃ paranārī
dhanu parāv biṣ teṃ biṣ bhārī

verses.sa:
जे हरषहिं पर संपति देखी ।
दुखित होहिं पर बिपति बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
je haraṣahiṃ par saṃpati dekhī
dukhit hohiṃ par bipati biseṣī

verses.sa:
जिन्हहि राम तुम्ह प्रानपिआरे ।
तिन्ह के मन सुभ सदन तुम्हारे ॥
verses.tr:
jinhahi rām tumh prānapiāre
tinh ke man subh sadan tumhāre

verses.sa:
स्वामि सखा पितु मातु गुर जिन्ह के सब तुम्ह तात ।
मन मंदिर तिन्ह कें बसहु सीय सहित दोउ भ्रात ॥
verses.tr:
svāmi sakhā pitu mātu gur jinh ke sab tumh tāt
man maṃdir tinh keṃ basahu sīya sahit dou bhrāt
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Who so is unmoved by lust, anger, pride or arrogance, and is without covetousness, excitement, partiality or malice without fraud, hypocrisy or heretical delusion; dwell in his heart, Raghurdeya. They who are all men’s Friends, and are friendly to all; to whom pleasure and pain, praise and abuse are alike; who are careful to say what is both true and kind; who, whether sleeping or waking, place themselves under your protection and have no other way of salvation but you; in their heart, Rama, abide. They who look upon another man’s wife us their own mother, and another man’s wealth as the deadliest poison, who rejoice to see a neighbour’s prosperity and are grieved for his misfortunes; and to whom you, O Rama, are dear as their own life: be their ~ heart your auspicious abode.
To whom, my son, you are at once master and companion, father, mother and spiritual guide; be their heart you temple, ye brothers twain, wherein with Sita to abide.

sections.label: Doha 131
sections.name: जाहि न चाहिअ कबहुँ कछु तुम्ह सन सहज सनेहु

verses.sa:
अवगुन तजि सब के गुन गहहीं ।
बिप्र धेनु हित संकट सहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
avagun taji sab ke gun gahahīṃ
bipr dhenu hit saṃkaṭ sahahīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नीति निपुन जिन्ह कइ जग लीका ।
घर तुम्हार तिन्ह कर मनु नीका ॥
verses.tr:
nīti nipun jinh kai jag līkā
ghar tumhār tinh kar manu nīkā

verses.sa:
गुन तुम्हार समुझइ निज दोसा ।
जेहि सब भाँति तुम्हार भरोसा ॥
verses.tr:
gun tumhār samujhai nij dosā
jehi sab bhām̐ti tumhār bharosā

verses.sa:
राम भगत प्रिय लागहिं जेही ।
तेहि उर बसहु सहित बैदेही ॥
verses.tr:
rām bhagat priya lāgahiṃ jehī
tehi ur basahu sahit baidehī

verses.sa:
जाति पाँति धनु धरम बड़ाई ।
प्रिय परिवार सदन सुखदाई ॥
verses.tr:
jāti pām̐ti dhanu dharam bar̤āī
priya parivār sadan sukhadāī

verses.sa:
सब तजि तुम्हहि रहइ उर लाई ।
तेहि के हृदयँ रहहु रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
sab taji tumhahi rahai ur lāī
tehi ke hṛdayam̐ rahahu raghurāī

verses.sa:
सरगु नरकु अपबरगु समाना ।
जहँ तहँ देख धरें धनु बाना ॥
verses.tr:
saragu naraku apabaragu samānā
jaham̐ taham̐ dekh dhareṃ dhanu bānā

verses.sa:
करम बचन मन राउर चेरा ।
राम करहु तेहि कें उर डेरा ॥
verses.tr:
karam bacan man rāur cerā
rām karahu tehi keṃ ur ḍerā

verses.sa:
जाहि न चाहिअ कबहुँ कछु तुम्ह सन सहज सनेहु ।
बसहु निरंतर तासु मन सो राउर निज गेहु ॥
verses.tr:
jāhi na cāhia kabahum̐ kachu tumh san sahaj sanehu
basahu niraṃtar tāsu man so rāur nij gehu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: They who pick out all men’s good points and leave their bad; who endure.troubles on behalf of Brahmans and kine; and who are of note in the world for soundness of doctrine; ~ in their heart be your chosen home. They who understand your righteousness and their own defects and fix all their hopes on you, and have an affection for all your worshippers;. in their heart dwell, you and Sita. He who has left all tribe, sect, wealth, hereditary religion, worldly advancement, friend, relations, home and all, and given himself wholly to you; in his heart take up your abode, Raghurdi. To whom heaven and hell and release from transmigration are all alike, if only they can behold the god with his bow and arrows; and who in heart, word and deed are your faithful slaves; be their heart, Ltema, your tabernacle.
They who never ask for anything but simply love you; in their heart abide for ever, for that is your very home.”

sections.label: Doha 132
sections.name: चित्रकूट महिमा अमित कहीं महामुनि गाइ

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि मुनिबर भवन देखाए ।
बचन सप्रेम राम मन भाए ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi munibar bhavan dekhāe
bacan saprem rām man bhāe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कह मुनि सुनहु भानुकुलनायक ।
आश्रम कहउँ समय सुखदायक ॥
verses.tr:
kah muni sunahu bhānukulanāyak
āśram kahaum̐ samaya sukhadāyak

verses.sa:
चित्रकूट गिरि करहु निवासू ।
तहँ तुम्हार सब भाँति सुपासू ॥
verses.tr:
citrakūṭ giri karahu nivāsū
taham̐ tumhār sab bhām̐ti supāsū

verses.sa:
सैलु सुहावन कानन चारू ।
करि केहरि मृग बिहग बिहारू ॥
verses.tr:
sailu suhāvan kānan cārū
kari kehari mṛg bihag bihārū

verses.sa:
नदी पुनीत पुरान बखानी ।
अत्रिप्रिया निज तपबल आनी ॥
verses.tr:
nadī punīt purān bakhānī
atripriyā nij tapabal ānī

verses.sa:
सुरसरि धार नाउँ मंदाकिनि ।
जो सब पातक पोतक डाकिनि ॥
verses.tr:
surasari dhār nāum̐ maṃdākini
jo sab pātak potak ḍākini

verses.sa:
अत्रि आदि मुनिबर बहु बसहीं ।
करहिं जोग जप तप तन कसहीं ॥
verses.tr:
atri ādi munibar bahu basahīṃ
karahiṃ jog jap tap tan kasahīṃ

verses.sa:
चलहु सफल श्रम सब कर करहू ।
राम देहु गौरव गिरिबरहू ॥
verses.tr:
calahu saphal śram sab kar karahū
rām dehu gaurav giribarahū

verses.sa:
चित्रकूट महिमा अमित कहीं महामुनि गाइ ।
आए नहाए सरित बर सिय समेत दोउ भाइ ॥
verses.tr:
citrakūṭ mahimā amit kahīṃ mahāmuni gāi
āe nahāe sarit bar siya samet dou bhāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Such were the dwelling-places the sage indicated, and his loving speech pleased Rama’s soul. The saint continued: Hearken, lord of the solar race; [ will tell you a hermitage suitable for your present wants. Take up your abode on the hill of Chitra-kut; there you will have every convenience. It is a beautiful hill finely wooded, the haunt of elephants, tigers, deer and birds. It has a sacred river mentioned in the Puranas, which the wife of Atri brought there by the power of penance. 2 It is called the Mandakini, and is a branch of the Ganges, as quick to drown sin as a witcb to strangle and infant. Atri and other sages live there, engaged in meditation and prayer and wasting their body with penance. Go and bless their labours, Kama, and confer dignity on the mountain.”
All the glories of Chitra-kut did the great saint tell and declare. The two brothers and Sita proceeded to bathe in the sacred stream.

sections.label: Doha 133
sections.name: लखन जानकी सहित प्रभु राजत रुचिर निकेत

verses.sa:
रघुबर कहेउ लखन भल घाटू ।
करहु कतहुँ अब ठाहर ठाटू ॥
verses.tr:
raghubar kaheu lakhan bhal ghāṭū
karahu katahum̐ ab ṭhāhar ṭhāṭū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
लखन दीख पय उतर करारा ।
चहुँ दिसि फिरेउ धनुष जिमि नारा ॥
verses.tr:
lakhan dīkh paya utar karārā
cahum̐ disi phireu dhanuṣ jimi nārā

verses.sa:
नदी पनच सर सम दम दाना ।
सकल कलुष कलि साउज नाना ॥
verses.tr:
nadī panac sar sam dam dānā
sakal kaluṣ kali sāuj nānā

verses.sa:
चित्रकूट जनु अचल अहेरी ।
चुकइ न घात मार मुठभेरी ॥
verses.tr:
citrakūṭ janu acal aherī
cukai na ghāt mār muṭhabherī

verses.sa:
अस कहि लखन ठाउँ देखरावा ।
थलु बिलोकि रघुबर सुखु पावा ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi lakhan ṭhāum̐ dekharāvā
thalu biloki raghubar sukhu pāvā

verses.sa:
रमेउ राम मनु देवन्ह जाना ।
चले सहित सुर थपति प्रधाना ॥
verses.tr:
rameu rām manu devanh jānā
cale sahit sur thapati pradhānā

verses.sa:
कोल किरात बेष सब आए ।
रचे परन तृन सदन सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
kol kirāt beṣ sab āe
race paran tṛn sadan suhāe

verses.sa:
बरनि न जाहि मंजु दुइ साला ।
एक ललित लघु एक बिसाला ॥
verses.tr:
barani na jāhi maṃju dui sālā
ek lalit laghu ek bisālā

verses.sa:
लखन जानकी सहित प्रभु राजत रुचिर निकेत ।
सोह मदनु मुनि बेष जनु रति रितुराज समेत ॥
verses.tr:
lakhan jānakī sahit prabhu rājat rucir niket
soh madanu muni beṣ janu rati riturāj samet
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Said Raghubar, “Itis a good place, Lakshman; now make arrangements for our stopping somewhere here.” Lakshman then spied out the north bank: “The ravine bends round it like a bow, with the river for its string, asceticism and charity for its arrows, and all the sins of this evil age for its quarry, while Mount Chitra-kut is the huntsman of unerring aim striking at close quarters.” So

saying, Lakshman showed the spot; when he had seen it, Raghupati was pleased. The gods learnt that Rama was well content, and came with Indra at their head. In the garb of Kols and Kirats they came and put up neat huts of boughs and grass, two of them; both prettier than words can tell, the one of larger size, the other a nice little cottage.
In his rustic cell the Lord, attended by Lakshman and Janaki, shone forth as beautiful as Love in the dress of a hermit between Rati and Spring.

sections.label: Doha 134
sections.name: जथाजोग सनमानि प्रभु बिदा किए मुनिबृंद

verses.sa:
अमर नाग किंनर दिसिपाला ।
चित्रकूट आए तेहि काला ॥
verses.tr:
amar nāg kiṃnar disipālā
citrakūṭ āe tehi kālā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राम प्रनामु कीन्ह सब काहू ।
मुदित देव लहि लोचन लाहू ॥
verses.tr:
rām pranāmu kīnh sab kāhū
mudit dev lahi locan lāhū

verses.sa:
बरषि सुमन कह देव समाजू ।
नाथ सनाथ भए हम आजू ॥
verses.tr:
baraṣi suman kah dev samājū
nāth sanāth bhae ham ājū

verses.sa:
करि बिनती दुख दुसह सुनाए ।
हरषित निज निज सदन सिधाए ॥
verses.tr:
kari binatī dukh dusah sunāe
haraṣit nij nij sadan sidhāe

verses.sa:
चित्रकूट रघुनंदनु छाए ।
समाचार सुनि सुनि मुनि आए ॥
verses.tr:
citrakūṭ raghunaṃdanu chāe
samācār suni suni muni āe

verses.sa:
आवत देखि मुदित मुनिबृंदा ।
कीन्ह दंडवत रघुकुल चंदा ॥
verses.tr:
āvat dekhi mudit munibṛṃdā
kīnh daṃḍavat raghukul caṃdā

verses.sa:
मुनि रघुबरहि लाइ उर लेहीं ।
सुफल होन हित आसिष देहीं ॥
verses.tr:
muni raghubarahi lāi ur lehīṃ
suphal hon hit āsiṣ dehīṃ

verses.sa:
सिय सौमित्र राम छबि देखहिं ।
साधन सकल सफल करि लेखहिं ॥
verses.tr:
siya saumitr rām chabi dekhahiṃ
sādhan sakal saphal kari lekhahiṃ

verses.sa:
जथाजोग सनमानि प्रभु बिदा किए मुनिबृंद ।
करहि जोग जप जाग तप निज आश्रमन्हि सुछंद ॥
verses.tr:
jathājog sanamāni prabhu bidā kie munibṛṃd
karahi jog jap jāg tap nij āśramanhi suchaṃd
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Then flocked to Chitra-kut gods, serpents, Kinnars and Digp&ls. All the immortals bowed low before Rama and gazed with joy on that most longed-for vision. Showering down flowers and exclaiming ‘“‘ At length, O Lord, we have found our Lord,” the heavenly host in piteous wise declared their intolerable distress, and joyfully started for their several homes. As soon as they heard the news of Raghunandan’s stay at Chitra-kut, the saints sallied forth; seeing the holy company draw near, Rama prostrated himself before them: but they all took him to their bosom, and invoked upon him blessings, knowing that they would be accomplished. As they beheld the beauty of R6ma and Sita and Sumitra’s son, they accounted all their good deeds to have been well rewarded.
After all due honours paid, the Lord dismissed the’ saintly throng to practise contemplation, prayer, sacrifice and penance at pleasure in their own retreats.

sections.label: Doha 135
sections.name: अब हम नाथ सनाथ सब भए देखि प्रभु पाय

verses.sa:
यह सुधि कोल किरातन्ह पाई ।
हरषे जनु नव निधि घर आई ॥
verses.tr:
yah sudhi kol kirātanh pāī
haraṣe janu nav nidhi ghar āī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कंद मूल फल भरि भरि दोना ।
चले रंक जनु लूटन सोना ॥
verses.tr:
kaṃd mūl phal bhari bhari donā
cale raṃk janu lūṭan sonā

verses.sa:
तिन्ह महँ जिन्ह देखे दोउ भ्राता ।
अपर तिन्हहि पूँछहि मगु जाता ॥
verses.tr:
tinh maham̐ jinh dekhe dou bhrātā
apar tinhahi pūm̐chahi magu jātā

verses.sa:
कहत सुनत रघुबीर निकाई ।
आइ सबन्हि देखे रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
kahat sunat raghubīr nikāī
āi sabanhi dekhe raghurāī

verses.sa:
करहिं जोहारु भेंट धरि आगे ।
प्रभुहि बिलोकहिं अति अनुरागे ॥
verses.tr:
karahiṃ johāru bheṃṭ dhari āge
prabhuhi bilokahiṃ ati anurāge

verses.sa:
चित्र लिखे जनु जहँ तहँ ठाढ़े ।
पुलक सरीर नयन जल बाढ़े ॥
verses.tr:
citr likhe janu jaham̐ taham̐ ṭhār̤he
pulak sarīr nayan jal bār̤he

verses.sa:
राम सनेह मगन सब जाने ।
कहि प्रिय बचन सकल सनमाने ॥
verses.tr:
rām saneh magan sab jāne
kahi priya bacan sakal sanamāne

verses.sa:
प्रभुहि जोहारि बहोरि बहोरी ।
बचन बिनीत कहहिं कर जोरी ॥
verses.tr:
prabhuhi johāri bahori bahorī
bacan binīt kahahiṃ kar jorī

verses.sa:
अब हम नाथ सनाथ सब भए देखि प्रभु पाय ।
भाग हमारे आगमनु राउर कोसलराय ॥
verses.tr:
ab ham nāth sanāth sab bhae dekhi prabhu pāya
bhāg hamāre āgamanu rāur kosalarāya
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When the Kols and Kirats got the tidings, they were as glad as if the nine treasures had come to their house.

With leaf platters full of herbs, roots and fruits, they ran like beggars scrambling for gold. Those among them who had already seen the two brothers were questioned about them by the others on the road. Telling and hearing Rama’s perfections, all came and saw him. Laying their offering before him and making obeisance, their love increased exceedingly as they gazed upon their Lord. Motionless as figures in a picture they stood about any how, their body thrilling with emotion and their eyes filled with tears. Rama, perceiving that they were overwhelmed with affection, spoke to them words of kindness and received them with honour. Again and again bowing low before the Lord, the addressed him in humble strain with folded hands:
‘Now at length that we have seen our Lord’s feet, we have all found a protector: OO prince of Kosala, what a blessing for us is your arrival.

sections.label: Doha 136
sections.name: बेद बचन मुनि मन अगम ते प्रभु करुना ऐन

verses.sa:
धन्य भूमि बन पंथ पहारा ।
जहँ जहँ नाथ पाउ तुम्ह धारा ॥
verses.tr:
dhanya bhūmi ban paṃth pahārā
jaham̐ jaham̐ nāth pāu tumh dhārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
धन्य बिहग मृग काननचारी ।
सफल जनम भए तुम्हहि निहारी ॥
verses.tr:
dhanya bihag mṛg kānanacārī
saphal janam bhae tumhahi nihārī

verses.sa:
हम सब धन्य सहित परिवारा ।
दीख दरसु भरि नयन तुम्हारा ॥
verses.tr:
ham sab dhanya sahit parivārā
dīkh darasu bhari nayan tumhārā

verses.sa:
कीन्ह बासु भल ठाउँ बिचारी ।
इहाँ सकल रितु रहब सुखारी ॥
