verses.tr:
kīnh bāsu bhal ṭhāum̐ bicārī
ihām̐ sakal ritu rahab sukhārī

verses.sa:
हम सब भाँति करब सेवकाई ।
करि केहरि अहि बाघ बराई ॥
verses.tr:
ham sab bhām̐ti karab sevakāī
kari kehari ahi bāgh barāī

verses.sa:
बन बेहड़ गिरि कंदर खोहा ।
सब हमार प्रभु पग पग जोहा ॥
verses.tr:
ban behar̤ giri kaṃdar khohā
sab hamār prabhu pag pag johā

verses.sa:
तहँ तहँ तुम्हहि अहेर खेलाउब ।
सर निरझर जलठाउँ देखाउब ॥
verses.tr:
taham̐ taham̐ tumhahi aher khelāub
sar nirajhar jalaṭhāum̐ dekhāub

verses.sa:
हम सेवक परिवार समेता ।
नाथ न सकुचब आयसु देता ॥
verses.tr:
ham sevak parivār sametā
nāth na sakucab āyasu detā

verses.sa:
बेद बचन मुनि मन अगम ते प्रभु करुना ऐन ।
बचन किरातन्ह के सुनत जिमि पितु बालक बैन ॥
verses.tr:
bed bacan muni man agam te prabhu karunā ain
bacan kirātanh ke sunat jimi pitu bālak bain
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Happy land and forest and road and hill, where thou, my lord, hast planted thy foot; happy the birds and deer and beasts of the forest, whose life has been crowned by thy sight; happy we and all our kin, who have filled our eyes with thy vision. Thou hast chosen an excellent spot whereon to take up thy abode; here ut all seasons of the year thou wilt live at ease. We will do thee service in every way, by driving away elephants, lions, snakes and tigers. The thickets, ravines, mountains, chasms and caves have all, my lord, been explored by us foot by foot; we will take you to the different haunts of game, and point out to you the lakes and waterfalls and every other place. We and our people arethy servants; do not hesitate to command us.”
The lord, whom the Veda cannot utter nor the saints comprehend, in his infinite compassion listened to the words of the Kirats, as a father to the vice of a child.

sections.label: Doha 137
sections.name: नीलकंठ कलकंठ सुक चातक चक्क चकोर

verses.sa:
रामहि केवल प्रेमु पिआरा ।
जानि लेउ जो जाननिहारा ॥
verses.tr:
rāmahi keval premu piārā
jāni leu jo jānanihārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राम सकल बनचर तब तोषे ।
कहि मृदु बचन प्रेम परिपोषे ॥
verses.tr:
rām sakal banacar tab toṣe
kahi mṛdu bacan prem paripoṣe

verses.sa:
बिदा किए सिर नाइ सिधाए ।
प्रभु गुन कहत सुनत घर आए ॥
verses.tr:
bidā kie sir nāi sidhāe
prabhu gun kahat sunat ghar āe

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि सिय समेत दोउ भाई ।
बसहिं बिपिन सुर मुनि सुखदाई ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi siya samet dou bhāī
basahiṃ bipin sur muni sukhadāī

verses.sa:
जब ते आइ रहे रघुनायकु ।
तब तें भयउ बनु मंगलदायकु ॥
verses.tr:
jab te āi rahe raghunāyaku
tab teṃ bhayau banu maṃgaladāyaku

verses.sa:
फूलहिं फलहिं बिटप बिधि नाना ।
मंजु बलित बर बेलि बिताना ॥
verses.tr:
phūlahiṃ phalahiṃ biṭap bidhi nānā
maṃju balit bar beli bitānā

verses.sa:
सुरतरु सरिस सुभायँ सुहाए ।
मनहुँ बिबुध बन परिहरि आए ॥
verses.tr:
surataru saris subhāyam̐ suhāe
manahum̐ bibudh ban parihari āe

verses.sa:
गंज मंजुतर मधुकर श्रेनी ।
त्रिबिध बयारि बहइ सुख देनी ॥
verses.tr:
gaṃj maṃjutar madhukar śrenī
tribidh bayāri bahai sukh denī

verses.sa:
नीलकंठ कलकंठ सुक चातक चक्क चकोर ।
भाँति भाँति बोलहिं बिहग श्रवन सुखद चित चोर ॥
verses.tr:
nīlakaṃṭh kalakaṃṭh suk cātak cakk cakor
bhām̐ti bhām̐ti bolahiṃ bihag śravan sukhad cit cor
verses.head: दोहा

trans: It is only love that Rama loves; understand this, ye who are men of understanding. He charmed all the foresters by his tender loving speeches. Having taking leave and bowed the head, they set forth, and discoursing on the way of their Lord’s perfections they reached their homes. In this fashion the two brothers and Sita dwelt in the forest, delighting gods and saints. From the time that Raghu-neyak took his up his abode there, the wood became bounteous in blessing; every kind of tree blossomed and bore fruit; luxariant creepers formed pleasant and beautiful canopies; as though the tree of paradise in all its native loveliness had abandoned the groves of heaven. Strings of bees made a grateful buzzing, and a delicious air breathed soft, cool and fragrant. Dohe 132.
Jays, cuckoos, parrots, chdaks, chakwds, chakors, and birds of every description charmed the ear and ravished the soul with their notes.

sections.label: Doha 138
sections.name: चित्रकूट के बिहग मृग बेलि बिटप तृन जाति

verses.sa:
केरि केहरि कपि कोल कुरंगा ।
बिगतबैर बिचरहिं सब संगा ॥
verses.tr:
keri kehari kapi kol kuraṃgā
bigatabair bicarahiṃ sab saṃgā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
फिरत अहेर राम छबि देखी ।
होहिं मुदित मृगबंद बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
phirat aher rām chabi dekhī
hohiṃ mudit mṛgabaṃd biseṣī

verses.sa:
बिबुध बिपिन जहँ लगि जग माहीं ।
देखि राम बनु सकल सिहाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bibudh bipin jaham̐ lagi jag māhīṃ
dekhi rām banu sakal sihāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सुरसरि सरसइ दिनकर कन्या ।
मेकलसुता गोदावरि धन्या ॥
verses.tr:
surasari sarasai dinakar kanyā
mekalasutā godāvari dhanyā

verses.sa:
सब सर सिंधु नदी नद नाना ।
मंदाकिनि कर करहिं बखाना ॥
verses.tr:
sab sar siṃdhu nadī nad nānā
maṃdākini kar karahiṃ bakhānā

verses.sa:
उदय अस्त गिरि अरु कैलासू ।
मंदर मेरु सकल सुरबासू ॥
verses.tr:
udaya ast giri aru kailāsū
maṃdar meru sakal surabāsū

verses.sa:
सैल हिमाचल आदिक जेते ।
चित्रकूट जसु गावहिं तेते ॥
verses.tr:
sail himācal ādik jete
citrakūṭ jasu gāvahiṃ tete

verses.sa:
बिंधि मुदित मन सुखु न समाई ।
श्रम बिनु बिपुल बड़ाई पाई ॥
verses.tr:
biṃdhi mudit man sukhu na samāī
śram binu bipul bar̤āī pāī

verses.sa:
चित्रकूट के बिहग मृग बेलि बिटप तृन जाति ।
पुन्य पुंज सब धन्य अस कहहिं देव दिन राति ॥
verses.tr:
citrakūṭ ke bihag mṛg beli biṭap tṛn jāti
punya puṃj sab dhanya as kahahiṃ dev din rāti
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Elephants, lions, monkeys, boars and deer forgot their animosity and sported together. Enraptured above all were the herds of deer who beheld the beauty of Rama as he tracked the chase. All the forests of the gods that there are in the world were envious at the sight of Rama’s forest. The Ganges, the Sarasvati, the sunborn Jamuna, the Narmada, daughter of Mount Mekal, and the sacred Godavari, every river, stream and torrent discoursed of the Mandakini. The mountains of the rising and the setting sun, Kailas, Mandar, Meru, home of all the gods, the crags of Himalaya, and all the hills there be, sang the glory of Chitra-kut. The delight of the gods was more than their soul could contain, to think it had won such renown without an effort.
‘Of highest merit and blessed indeed are all the birds, deer, creepers, trees and grasses of Chitra-kut,” so day and night cried the gods.

sections.label: Doha 139
sections.name: -छिनु छिनु लखि सिय राम पद जानि आपु पर नेहु

verses.sa:
नयनवंत रघुबरहि बिलोकी ।
पाइ जनम फल होहिं बिसोकी ॥
verses.tr:
nayanavaṃt raghubarahi bilokī
pāi janam phal hohiṃ bisokī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
परसि चरन रज अचर सुखारी ।
भए परम पद के अधिकारी ॥
verses.tr:
parasi caran raj acar sukhārī
bhae param pad ke adhikārī

verses.sa:
सो बनु सैलु सुभायँ सुहावन ।
मंगलमय अति पावन पावन ॥
verses.tr:
so banu sailu subhāyam̐ suhāvan
maṃgalamaya ati pāvan pāvan

verses.sa:
महिमा कहिअ कवनि बिधि तासू ।
सुखसागर जहँ कीन्ह निवासू ॥
verses.tr:
mahimā kahia kavani bidhi tāsū
sukhasāgar jaham̐ kīnh nivāsū

verses.sa:
पय पयोधि तजि अवध बिहाई ।
जहँ सिय लखनु रामु रहे आई ॥
verses.tr:
paya payodhi taji avadh bihāī
jaham̐ siya lakhanu rāmu rahe āī

verses.sa:
कहि न सकहिं सुषमा जसि कानन ।
जौं सत सहस होंहिं सहसानन ॥
verses.tr:
kahi na sakahiṃ suṣamā jasi kānan
jauṃ sat sahas hoṃhiṃ sahasānan

verses.sa:
सो मैं बरनि कहौं बिधि केहीं ।
डाबर कमठ कि मंदर लेहीं ॥
verses.tr:
so maiṃ barani kahauṃ bidhi kehīṃ
ḍābar kamaṭh ki maṃdar lehīṃ

verses.sa:
सेवहिं लखनु करम मन बानी ।
जाइ न सीलु सनेहु बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
sevahiṃ lakhanu karam man bānī
jāi na sīlu sanehu bakhānī

verses.sa:
-छिनु छिनु लखि सिय राम पद जानि आपु पर नेहु ।
करत न सपनेहुँ लखनु चितु बंधु मातु पितु गेहु ॥
verses.tr:
-chinu chinu lakhi siya rām pad jāni āpu par nehu
karat na sapanehum̐ lakhanu citu baṃdhu mātu pitu gehu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: All creatures with eyes, who looked on Rama, felt with delight that now they had lived to some purpose. Things without life, touched by the dust of his feet, were gladdened by promotion to the highest sphere. The woods and rocks, all charming in themselves, were so blissful, so entirely the holiest of the holy, that how can I declare their glory, when they became the abode of the infinitely blessed, and when leaving the Milky Ocean and deserting Avadh, Sita, Rama, and Lakshman came there to dwell? The delights of the forest would be past telling even by a hundred thousand Seshnags. How then can I describe them, any more thana common hole tortoise could uplift Mount Mandar? In every thought, word and act Lakshman does him service, with an amiability and devotion more than can be told.
lor ever gazing on the feet of Sita and Rama and conscious of their Love for him, not even in his sleep did Lakshman dream of absent kindred, or father or mother, or home.

sections.label: Doha 140
sections.name: -सुमिरत रामहि तजहिं जन तृन सम बिषय बिलासु

verses.sa:
राम संग सिय रहति सुखारी ।
पुर परिजन गृह सुरति बिसारी ॥
verses.tr:
rām saṃg siya rahati sukhārī
pur parijan gṛh surati bisārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
छिनु छिनु पिय बिधु बदनु निहारी ।
प्रमुदित मनहुँ चकोरकुमारी ॥
verses.tr:
chinu chinu piya bidhu badanu nihārī
pramudit manahum̐ cakorakumārī

verses.sa:
नाह नेहु नित बढ़त बिलोकी ।
हरषित रहति दिवस जिमि कोकी ॥
verses.tr:
nāh nehu nit bar̤hat bilokī
haraṣit rahati divas jimi kokī

verses.sa:
सिय मनु राम चरन अनुरागा ।
अवध सहस सम बनु प्रिय लागा ॥
verses.tr:
siya manu rām caran anurāgā
avadh sahas sam banu priya lāgā

verses.sa:
परनकुटी प्रिय प्रियतम संगा ।
प्रिय परिवारु कुरंग बिहंगा ॥
verses.tr:
paranakuṭī priya priyatam saṃgā
priya parivāru kuraṃg bihaṃgā

verses.sa:
सासु ससुर सम मुनितिय मुनिबर ।
असनु अमिअ सम कंद मूल फर ॥
verses.tr:
sāsu sasur sam munitiya munibar
asanu amia sam kaṃd mūl phar

verses.sa:
नाथ साथ साँथरी सुहाई ।
मयन सयन सय सम सुखदाई ॥
verses.tr:
nāth sāth sām̐tharī suhāī
mayan sayan saya sam sukhadāī

verses.sa:
लोकप होहिं बिलोकत जासू ।
तेहि कि मोहि सक बिषय बिलासू ॥
verses.tr:
lokap hohiṃ bilokat jāsū
tehi ki mohi sak biṣaya bilāsū

verses.sa:
-सुमिरत रामहि तजहिं जन तृन सम बिषय बिलासु ।
रामप्रिया जग जननि सिय कछु न आचरजु तासु ॥
verses.tr:
-sumirat rāmahi tajahiṃ jan tṛn sam biṣaya bilāsu
rāmapriyā jag janani siya kachu na ācaraju tāsu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: In Rama’s company Sita lived so happy that she lost all memory of city, family and home. Ever watching the moonlike face of her beloved, she rejoiced like the partridge at night, and seeing her lord’s affection daily increase she was as happy as the cackoo by day. Her heart was so enamoured of him that the forest was a thousand times as dear to her as Avadh; dear wasthe cottage with her love’s society, dear were the fawns and birds, now her only attendants: like her husband’s father and mother were the hermits and their wives, and sweet as ambrosia the wild fruits and roots. Shared with her lord, a litter of leaves 2 was a hundredfold more delightful than Cupid’s own couch. How can material delights beguile him, the mere sight of whom confers the sovereignty of the spheres?
Remembering Rama, men discard as no more worth than

sections.label: Doha 141
sections.name: रामु लखन सीता सहित सोहत परन निकेत

verses.sa:
सीय लखन जेहि बिधि सुखु लहहीं ।
सोइ रघुनाथ करहि सोइ कहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sīya lakhan jehi bidhi sukhu lahahīṃ
soi raghunāth karahi soi kahahīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कहहिं पुरातन कथा कहानी ।
सुनहिं लखनु सिय अति सुखु मानी ॥
verses.tr:
kahahiṃ purātan kathā kahānī
sunahiṃ lakhanu siya ati sukhu mānī

verses.sa:
जब जब रामु अवध सुधि करहीं ।
तब तब बारि बिलोचन भरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jab jab rāmu avadh sudhi karahīṃ
tab tab bāri bilocan bharahīṃ

verses.sa:
सुमिरि मातु पितु परिजन भाई ।
भरत सनेहु सीलु सेवकाई ॥
verses.tr:
sumiri mātu pitu parijan bhāī
bharat sanehu sīlu sevakāī

verses.sa:
कृपासिंधु प्रभु होहिं दुखारी ।
धीरजु धरहिं कुसमउ बिचारी ॥
verses.tr:
kṛpāsiṃdhu prabhu hohiṃ dukhārī
dhīraju dharahiṃ kusamau bicārī

verses.sa:
लखि सिय लखनु बिकल होइ जाहीं ।
जिमि पुरुषहि अनुसर परिछाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
lakhi siya lakhanu bikal hoi jāhīṃ
jimi puruṣahi anusar parichāhīṃ

verses.sa:
प्रिया बंधु गति लखि रघुनंदनु ।
धीर कृपाल भगत उर चंदनु ॥
verses.tr:
priyā baṃdhu gati lakhi raghunaṃdanu
dhīr kṛpāl bhagat ur caṃdanu

verses.sa:
लगे कहन कछु कथा पुनीता ।
सुनि सुखु लहहिं लखनु अरु सीता ॥
verses.tr:
lage kahan kachu kathā punītā
suni sukhu lahahiṃ lakhanu aru sītā

verses.sa:
रामु लखन सीता सहित सोहत परन निकेत ।
जिमि बासव बस अमरपुर सची जयंत समेत ॥
verses.tr:
rāmu lakhan sītā sahit sohat paran niket
jimi bāsav bas amarapur sacī jayaṃt samet
verses.head: दोहा

trans: a blade of grass all the pleasures of sense; no wonder then in Sita’s case, Rama’s own beloved, the mother of the world. Chaupdi.

Anything that would please Sita and Lakshman, that would Raghunath do, exactly as they suggested. He would recite legends and tales of olden times, in the hearing of which Lakshman and Sita took great delight. If ever he made mention of Avadh, his eyes filled with tears; as he

called to mind his father and mother, his family and his brother, with all Bharat’s affection and amiable attention, the compassionate Lord grew most sad, but restrained himself knowing that the time was out of joint. At the sight Sita and Lakshman became distressed also, like the shadow that follows a man. When Raghunandan noticed the emotion of his spouse and his brother, being self-restrained and tender and as soothing to his votaries as sandal-wood when applied to the breast, he would begin to relate some sacred story to divert them. Dohe 136.

sections.label: Doha 142
sections.name: नहिं तृन चरहिं पिअहिं जलु मोचहिं लोचन बारि

verses.sa:
जोगवहिं प्रभु सिय लखनहिं कैसें ।
पलक बिलोचन गोलक जैसें ॥
verses.tr:
jogavahiṃ prabhu siya lakhanahiṃ kaiseṃ
palak bilocan golak jaiseṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सेवहिं लखनु सीय रघुबीरहि ।
जिमि अबिबेकी पुरुष सरीरहि ॥
verses.tr:
sevahiṃ lakhanu sīya raghubīrahi
jimi abibekī puruṣ sarīrahi

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि प्रभु बन बसहिं सुखारी ।
खग मृग सुर तापस हितकारी ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi prabhu ban basahiṃ sukhārī
khag mṛg sur tāpas hitakārī

verses.sa:
कहेउँ राम बन गवनु सुहावा ।
सुनहु सुमंत्र अवध जिमि आवा ॥
verses.tr:
kaheum̐ rām ban gavanu suhāvā
sunahu sumaṃtr avadh jimi āvā

verses.sa:
फिरेउ निषादु प्रभुहि पहुँचाई ।
सचिव सहित रथ देखेसि आई ॥
verses.tr:
phireu niṣādu prabhuhi pahum̐cāī
saciv sahit rath dekhesi āī

verses.sa:
मंत्री बिकल बिलोकि निषादू ।
कहि न जाइ जस भयउ बिषादू ॥
verses.tr:
maṃtrī bikal biloki niṣādū
kahi na jāi jas bhayau biṣādū

verses.sa:
राम राम सिय लखन पुकारी ।
परेउ धरनितल ब्याकुल भारी ॥
verses.tr:
rām rām siya lakhan pukārī
pareu dharanital byākul bhārī

verses.sa:
देखि दखिन दिसि हय हिहिनाहीं ।
जनु बिनु पंख बिहग अकुलाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi dakhin disi haya hihināhīṃ
janu binu paṃkh bihag akulāhīṃ

verses.sa:
नहिं तृन चरहिं पिअहिं जलु मोचहिं लोचन बारि ।
ब्याकुल भए निषाद सब रघुबर बाजि निहारि ॥
verses.tr:
nahiṃ tṛn carahiṃ piahiṃ jalu mocahiṃ locan bāri
byākul bhae niṣād sab raghubar bāji nihāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Rama and Lakshman with Sita in their leafy hut were as resplendent as Indra in the city of heaven with his spouse Sachi and their son Jayanta.

‘The Lord was as watchful over Sita and his younger brother as the eyelids over the pupil of the eye; while Lakshman was as careful of Sita and Raghubir as a fool of his own body. ‘Thus happily the Lord lived in the woods, gratify alike birds, beasts and pious ascetics. I have now told the story of Rama’s exile to the woods; here how Sumanta reached Avadh. The Nishad returned after escorting his Lord, and came in sight of the Minister and the chariot. No words can tell the distress with which he found the Minister to be agonized. Crying out ‘Hama, Rama, Sita, Lakshman,” he had fallen to the ground utterly overpowered, while the horses kept on looking to the south and neighing as piteously as a bird that has lost its wings.
They would neither eat grass nor drink water, and their eyes shed tears. At the sight of RAma's horses all the Nisbads were deeply grieved.

sections.label: Doha 143
sections.name: भयउ निषाद बिषादबस देखत सचिव तुरंग

verses.sa:
धरि धीरज तब कहइ निषादू ।
अब सुमंत्र परिहरहु बिषादू ॥
verses.tr:
dhari dhīraj tab kahai niṣādū
ab sumaṃtr pariharahu biṣādū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तुम्ह पंडित परमारथ ग्याता ।
धरहु धीर लखि बिमुख बिधाता ॥
verses.tr:
tumh paṃḍit paramārath gyātā
dharahu dhīr lakhi bimukh bidhātā

verses.sa:
बिबिध कथा कहि कहि मृदु बानी ।
रथ बैठारेउ बरबस आनी ॥
verses.tr:
bibidh kathā kahi kahi mṛdu bānī
rath baiṭhāreu barabas ānī

verses.sa:
सोक सिथिल रथ सकइ न हाँकी ।
रघुबर बिरह पीर उर बाँकी ॥
verses.tr:
sok sithil rath sakai na hām̐kī
raghubar birah pīr ur bām̐kī

verses.sa:
चरफराहिं मग चलहिं न घोरे ।
बन मृग मनहुँ आनि रथ जोरे ॥
verses.tr:
carapharāhiṃ mag calahiṃ na ghore
ban mṛg manahum̐ āni rath jore

verses.sa:
अढ़ुकि परहिं फिरि हेरहिं पीछें ।
राम बियोगि बिकल दुख तीछें ॥
verses.tr:
ar̤huki parahiṃ phiri herahiṃ pīcheṃ
rām biyogi bikal dukh tīcheṃ

verses.sa:
जो कह रामु लखनु बैदेही ।
हिंकरि हिंकरि हित हेरहिं तेही ॥
verses.tr:
jo kah rāmu lakhanu baidehī
hiṃkari hiṃkari hit herahiṃ tehī

verses.sa:
बाजि बिरह गति कहि किमि जाती ।
बिनु मनि फनिक बिकल जेहि भाँती ॥
verses.tr:
bāji birah gati kahi kimi jātī
binu mani phanik bikal jehi bhām̐tī

verses.sa:
भयउ निषाद बिषादबस देखत सचिव तुरंग ।
बोलि सुसेवक चारि तब दिए सारथी संग ॥
verses.tr:
bhayau niṣād biṣādabas dekhat saciv turaṃg
boli susevak cāri tab die sārathī saṃg
verses.head: दोहा

trans: At length summoning up courage the Nishad said: * now, Sumanta, cease mourning; you are a learned man and a philosopher, submit patiently to adverse fortune.” With such kindly expostulations he made him mount the chariot, whether he would or no; but he was so unstrung by grief that he could not drive, his heart ached so grievously for Rama's loss. The horses reared and would not go; you would think they were wild deer put in harness, jibbing, lying down and turning to look behind them, being overcome by sore pain for Rama’s loss. If any one mentioned the name of Rama, Lakshman, or Sita, the horses would at once neigh and look at him; the way in which they declared their grief is not to be described, like a snake that has lost its headjewel.
The sight of the Minister and the horses made the Nishad very sad. He told off four trusty grooms and with them a charioteer.

sections.label: Doha 144
sections.name: बिप्र बिबेकी बेदबिद संमत साधु सुजाति

verses.sa:
गुह सारथिहि फिरेउ पहुँचाई ।
बिरहु बिषादु बरनि नहिं जाई ॥
verses.tr:
guh sārathihi phireu pahum̐cāī
birahu biṣādu barani nahiṃ jāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
चले अवध लेइ रथहि निषादा ।
होहि छनहिं छन मगन बिषादा ॥
verses.tr:
cale avadh lei rathahi niṣādā
hohi chanahiṃ chan magan biṣādā

verses.sa:
सोच सुमंत्र बिकल दुख दीना ।
धिग जीवन रघुबीर बिहीना ॥
verses.tr:
soc sumaṃtr bikal dukh dīnā
dhig jīvan raghubīr bihīnā

verses.sa:
रहिहि न अंतहुँ अधम सरीरू ।
जसु न लहेउ बिछुरत रघुबीरू ॥
verses.tr:
rahihi na aṃtahum̐ adham sarīrū
jasu na laheu bichurat raghubīrū

verses.sa:
भए अजस अघ भाजन प्राना ।
कवन हेतु नहिं करत पयाना ॥
verses.tr:
bhae ajas agh bhājan prānā
kavan hetu nahiṃ karat payānā

verses.sa:
अहह मंद मनु अवसर चूका ।
अजहुँ न हृदय होत दुइ टूका ॥
verses.tr:
ahah maṃd manu avasar cūkā
ajahum̐ na hṛdaya hot dui ṭūkā

verses.sa:
मीजि हाथ सिरु धुनि पछिताई ।
मनहँ कृपन धन रासि गवाँई ॥
verses.tr:
mīji hāth siru dhuni pachitāī
manaham̐ kṛpan dhan rāsi gavām̐ī

verses.sa:
बिरिद बाँधि बर बीरु कहाई ।
चलेउ समर जनु सुभट पराई ॥
verses.tr:
birid bām̐dhi bar bīru kahāī
caleu samar janu subhaṭ parāī

verses.sa:
बिप्र बिबेकी बेदबिद संमत साधु सुजाति ।
जिमि धोखें मदपान कर सचिव सोच तेहि भाँति ॥
verses.tr:
bipr bibekī bedabid saṃmat sādhu sujāti
jimi dhokheṃ madapān kar saciv soc tehi bhām̐ti
verses.head: दोहा

trans: After making over the charioteer, Guha returned home, more sorry at leaving than words can tell. The Nishad’s

drove off to Avadh; sunk every moment in deeper distress, Sumanta, tortured by regrets, a prey to woe, cried: “A curse for life without Raghu-bir This vile body must perish at last; it lost all glory when bereft of Raghu-bir and became a sink of infamy and crime; why does it not take its departure? Ah fool that it is, it missed its opportunity, seeing that to-day my heart has not broken in twain.” Wringing his hands and beating his head in his remorse he went his way like a miser robbed of his pelf, or like a warrior of high renown, some famous champion, who has had to flee from the battle-field.
The Minister’s grief was like that of some learned Brahman well read in the Vedas, a man of good repute, of integrity and birth, who has been entrapped into drinking.

sections.label: Doha 145
sections.name: -धाइ पूँछिहहिं मोहि जब बिकल नगर नर नारि

verses.sa:
जिमि कुलीन तिय साधु सयानी ।
पतिदेवता करम मन बानी ॥
verses.tr:
jimi kulīn tiya sādhu sayānī
patidevatā karam man bānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
रहै करम बस परिहरि नाहू ।
सचिव हृदयँ तिमि दारुन दाहु ॥
verses.tr:
rahai karam bas parihari nāhū
saciv hṛdayam̐ timi dārun dāhu

verses.sa:
लोचन सजल डीठि भइ थोरी ।
सुनइ न श्रवन बिकल मति भोरी ॥
verses.tr:
locan sajal ḍīṭhi bhai thorī
sunai na śravan bikal mati bhorī

verses.sa:
सूखहिं अधर लागि मुहँ लाटी ।
जिउ न जाइ उर अवधि कपाटी ॥
verses.tr:
sūkhahiṃ adhar lāgi muham̐ lāṭī
jiu na jāi ur avadhi kapāṭī

verses.sa:
बिबरन भयउ न जाइ निहारी ।
मारेसि मनहुँ पिता महतारी ॥
verses.tr:
bibaran bhayau na jāi nihārī
māresi manahum̐ pitā mahatārī

verses.sa:
हानि गलानि बिपुल मन ब्यापी ।
जमपुर पंथ सोच जिमि पापी ॥
verses.tr:
hāni galāni bipul man byāpī
jamapur paṃth soc jimi pāpī

verses.sa:
बचनु न आव हृदयँ पछिताई ।
अवध काह मैं देखब जाई ॥
verses.tr:
bacanu na āv hṛdayam̐ pachitāī
avadh kāh maiṃ dekhab jāī

verses.sa:
राम रहित रथ देखिहि जोई ।
सकुचिहि मोहि बिलोकत सोई ॥
verses.tr:
rām rahit rath dekhihi joī
sakucihi mohi bilokat soī

verses.sa:
-धाइ पूँछिहहिं मोहि जब बिकल नगर नर नारि ।
उतरु देब मैं सबहि तब हृदयँ बज्रु बैठारि ॥
verses.tr:
-dhāi pūm̐chihahiṃ mohi jab bikal nagar nar nāri
utaru deb maiṃ sabahi tab hṛdayam̐ bajru baiṭhāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Or like some well-born, virtuous and discreet lady, who is entirely devoted to her lord, but whom Fate has forced to desert him; such was the cruel torture that racked the Minister’s heart. His eyes so full of tears that he could scarcely see; his ears deaf, his senses all confused, his lips dry his tongue cleaving to his palate, the breath of life only restrained by the bar of Rama's promise to return; all the colour gone from his face, he looked like one who had murdered his father and mother. His soul was so possessed with the greatness of his loss and his remorse that he might be some grievous sinner trembling at the gate of death. Words would not come, but to himself he moaned: “How can I look Avadh in the face; when they see the chariot and no Rama in it, they will turn in bewilderment to me.
When the agitated citizens run to question me and I have to answer them, my heart will be cleft asunder as by a thunderbolt.

sections.label: Doha 146
sections.name: -ह्रदउ न बिदरेउ पंक जिमि बिछुरत प्रीतमु नीरु

verses.sa:
पुछिहहिं दीन दुखित सब माता ।
कहब काह मैं तिन्हहि बिधाता ॥
verses.tr:
puchihahiṃ dīn dukhit sab mātā
kahab kāh maiṃ tinhahi bidhātā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पूछिहि जबहिं लखन महतारी ।
कहिहउँ कवन सँदेस सुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
pūchihi jabahiṃ lakhan mahatārī
kahihaum̐ kavan sam̐des sukhārī

verses.sa:
राम जननि जब आइहि धाई ।
सुमिरि बच्छु जिमि धेनु लवाई ॥
verses.tr:
rām janani jab āihi dhāī
sumiri bacchu jimi dhenu lavāī

verses.sa:
पूँछत उतरु देब मैं तेही ।
गे बनु राम लखनु बैदेही ॥
verses.tr:
pūm̐chat utaru deb maiṃ tehī
ge banu rām lakhanu baidehī

verses.sa:
जोइ पूँछिहि तेहि ऊतरु देबा ।
जाइ अवध अब यहु सुखु लेबा ॥
verses.tr:
joi pūm̐chihi tehi ūtaru debā
jāi avadh ab yahu sukhu lebā

verses.sa:
पूँछिहि जबहिं राउ दुख दीना ।
जिवनु जासु रघुनाथ अधीना ॥
verses.tr:
pūm̐chihi jabahiṃ rāu dukh dīnā
jivanu jāsu raghunāth adhīnā

verses.sa:
देहउँ उतरु कौनु मुहु लाई ।
आयउँ कुसल कुअँर पहुँचाई ॥
verses.tr:
dehaum̐ utaru kaunu muhu lāī
āyaum̐ kusal kuam̐r pahum̐cāī

verses.sa:
सुनत लखन सिय राम सँदेसू ।
तृन जिमि तनु परिहरिहि नरेसू ॥
verses.tr:
sunat lakhan siya rām sam̐desū
tṛn jimi tanu pariharihi naresū

verses.sa: -ह्रदउ न बिदरेउ पंक जिमि बिछुरत प्रीतमु नीरु ॥
verses.tr: -hradau na bidareu paṃk jimi bichurat prītamu nīru
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: जानत हौं मोहि दीन्ह बिधि यहु जातना सरीरु ॥
verses.tr: jānat hauṃ mohi dīnh bidhi yahu jātanā sarīru

trans: When the piteous queen-mothers ask of me, Good God! what shall I say to them? When Lakshman’s mother questions me, what good news can | tell her When Rama's mother comes running, like a cow mindful of its now weaned calf, and questions me, I can only answer, ‘Rama, Lakshman and Sita have gone into the forest.’ Whoever asks, I must answer so: this is the treat a shall have at Avadh. When the sorrowful king, whose life hangs upon Rama, questions me, with what face can I answer him, ‘I have seen the princes safe to their journey's end and have come back.’ When the king hears the news of Lakshman, Sita and Rama, he will discard his life as not worth a straw.
My heart bereft of its beloved is like clay drained of water, but it cracks not: now I know how capable of torture is this body that God has given me.”

sections.label: Doha 147
sections.name: -सचिव आगमनु सुनत सबु बिकल भयउ रनिवासु

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि करत पंथ पछितावा ।
तमसा तीर तुरत रथु आवा ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi karat paṃth pachitāvā
tamasā tīr turat rathu āvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बिदा किए करि बिनय निषादा ।
फिरे पायँ परि बिकल बिषादा ॥
verses.tr:
bidā kie kari binaya niṣādā
phire pāyam̐ pari bikal biṣādā

verses.sa:
पैठत नगर सचिव सकुचाई ।
जनु मारेसि गुर बाँभन गाई ॥
verses.tr:
paiṭhat nagar saciv sakucāī
janu māresi gur bām̐bhan gāī

verses.sa:
बैठि बिटप तर दिवसु गवाँवा ।
साँझ समय तब अवसरु पावा ॥
verses.tr:
baiṭhi biṭap tar divasu gavām̐vā
sām̐jh samaya tab avasaru pāvā

verses.sa:
अवध प्रबेसु कीन्ह अँधिआरें ।
पैठ भवन रथु राखि दुआरें ॥
verses.tr:
avadh prabesu kīnh am̐dhiāreṃ
paiṭh bhavan rathu rākhi duāreṃ

verses.sa:
जिन्ह जिन्ह समाचार सुनि पाए ।
भूप द्वार रथु देखन आए ॥
verses.tr:
jinh jinh samācār suni pāe
bhūp dvār rathu dekhan āe

verses.sa:
रथु पहिचानि बिकल लखि घोरे ।
गरहिं गात जिमि आतप ओरे ॥
verses.tr:
rathu pahicāni bikal lakhi ghore
garahiṃ gāt jimi ātap ore

verses.sa:
नगर नारि नर ब्याकुल कैंसें ।
निघटत नीर मीनगन जैंसें ॥
verses.tr:
nagar nāri nar byākul kaiṃseṃ
nighaṭat nīr mīnagan jaiṃseṃ

verses.sa:
-सचिव आगमनु सुनत सबु बिकल भयउ रनिवासु ।
भवन भयंकरु लाग तेहि मानहुँ प्रेत निवासु ॥
verses.tr:
-saciv āgamanu sunat sabu bikal bhayau ranivāsu
bhavan bhayaṃkaru lāg tehi mānahum̐ pret nivāsu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Thas bemoaning himself as he went, he quickly arrived in his chariot at the bank of Tamasa. There he courteously dismissed the Nishads, who after falling at his feet turned sorrowfully away. The Minister was as downcast on entering the city as one who had killed his own spiritual guide or a Brahman, or cow. He passed the day sitting under a tree, and at eventide took the opportunity to enter Avadh in the dark. He slunk into his house, leaving the chariot at the gate. All who heard the tidings came to the king’s door to see the chariot, and having recognized it and observed the distress of the horses, their body melted away like hail in the sun. All the citizens were as woebegone as fish when the waters are dried up.
When they heard of the Minister’s arrival, all the ladies

sections.label: Doha 148
sections.name: देखि सचिवँ जय जीव कहि कीन्हेउ दंड प्रनामु

verses.sa:
अति आरति सब पूँछहिं रानी ।
उतरु न आव बिकल भइ बानी ॥
verses.tr:
ati ārati sab pūm̐chahiṃ rānī
utaru na āv bikal bhai bānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुनइ न श्रवन नयन नहिं सूझा ।
कहहु कहाँ नृप तेहि तेहि बूझा ॥
verses.tr:
sunai na śravan nayan nahiṃ sūjhā
kahahu kahām̐ nṛp tehi tehi būjhā

verses.sa:
दासिन्ह दीख सचिव बिकलाई ।
कौसल्या गृहँ गईं लवाई ॥
verses.tr:
dāsinh dīkh saciv bikalāī
kausalyā gṛham̐ gaīṃ lavāī

verses.sa:
जाइ सुमंत्र दीख कस राजा ।
अमिअ रहित जनु चंदु बिराजा ॥
verses.tr:
jāi sumaṃtr dīkh kas rājā
amia rahit janu caṃdu birājā

verses.sa:
आसन सयन बिभूषन हीना ।
परेउ भूमितल निपट मलीना ॥
verses.tr:
āsan sayan bibhūṣan hīnā
pareu bhūmital nipaṭ malīnā

verses.sa:
लेइ उसासु सोच एहि भाँती ।
सुरपुर तें जनु खँसेउ जजाती ॥
verses.tr:
lei usāsu soc ehi bhām̐tī
surapur teṃ janu kham̐seu jajātī

verses.sa:
लेत सोच भरि छिनु छिनु छाती ।
जनु जरि पंख परेउ संपाती ॥
verses.tr:
let soc bhari chinu chinu chātī
janu jari paṃkh pareu saṃpātī

verses.sa:
राम राम कह राम सनेही ।
पुनि कह राम लखन बैदेही ॥
verses.tr:
rām rām kah rām sanehī
puni kah rām lakhan baidehī

verses.sa:
देखि सचिवँ जय जीव कहि कीन्हेउ दंड प्रनामु ।
सुनत उठेउ ब्याकुल नृपति कहु सुमंत्र कहँ रामु ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi sacivam̐ jaya jīv kahi kīnheu daṃḍ pranāmu
sunat uṭheu byākul nṛpati kahu sumaṃtr kaham̐ rāmu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: of the court were agitated. The palace struck him with as much dread as a haunted chamber,

All the queens questioned him in great excitement; no answer came, his voice was all broken. With no ears to hear, nor eyes to see, he could only ask every one he met, ‘Tell me where is the king.’ Seeing his confusion, the bandmaid-ens conducted him to Kausalya's apartments. On entering, Sumanta found the king in such state as the moon shows when all its lustre has waned. Fasting, sleapless, stript of every adornment, he lay on the ground in utter wretchedness, sighing as piteously as Yayati after he had been hurled from heaven, his heart every moment bursting with grief, like Sampati falling with singed wings, fondly crying ‘Rama, Rama, Rama’, and again ‘Rama, Lakshman, Sita.’ Doha 143,
The Minister on seeing him cried ‘All hail!; and bowed to the ground. At the sound of his voice the king started up hurriedly and exclaimed ‘O Sumanta, where is Rama?’

sections.label: Doha 149
sections.name: सखा रामु सिय लखनु जहँ तहाँ मोहि पहुँचाउ

verses.sa:
भूप सुमंत्रु लीन्ह उर लाई ।
बूड़त कछु अधार जनु पाई ॥
verses.tr:
bhūp sumaṃtru līnh ur lāī
būr̤at kachu adhār janu pāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सहित सनेह निकट बैठारी ।
पूँछत राउ नयन भरि बारी ॥
verses.tr:
sahit saneh nikaṭ baiṭhārī
pūm̐chat rāu nayan bhari bārī

verses.sa:
राम कुसल कहु सखा सनेही ।
कहँ रघुनाथु लखनु बैदेही ॥
verses.tr:
rām kusal kahu sakhā sanehī
kaham̐ raghunāthu lakhanu baidehī

verses.sa:
आने फेरि कि बनहि सिधाए ।
सुनत सचिव लोचन जल छाए ॥
verses.tr:
āne pheri ki banahi sidhāe
sunat saciv locan jal chāe

verses.sa:
सोक बिकल पुनि पूँछ नरेसू ।
कहु सिय राम लखन संदेसू ॥
verses.tr:
sok bikal puni pūm̐ch naresū
kahu siya rām lakhan saṃdesū

verses.sa:
राम रूप गुन सील सुभाऊ ।
सुमिरि सुमिरि उर सोचत राऊ ॥
verses.tr:
rām rūp gun sīl subhāū
sumiri sumiri ur socat rāū

verses.sa:
राउ सुनाइ दीन्ह बनबासू ।
सुनि मन भयउ न हरषु हराँसू ॥
verses.tr:
rāu sunāi dīnh banabāsū
suni man bhayau na haraṣu harām̐sū

verses.sa:
सो सुत बिछुरत गए न प्राना ।
को पापी बड़ मोहि समाना ॥
verses.tr:
so sut bichurat gae na prānā
ko pāpī bar̤ mohi samānā

verses.sa:
सखा रामु सिय लखनु जहँ तहाँ मोहि पहुँचाउ ।
नाहिं त चाहत चलन अब प्रान कहउँ सतिभाउ ॥
verses.tr:
sakhā rāmu siya lakhanu jaham̐ tahām̐ mohi pahum̐cāu
nāhiṃ ta cāhat calan ab prān kahaum̐ satibhāu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The king clasped Sumanta to his bosom, like a drowning man who has caught hold of some support. He seated him affectionately by his side, and with his eyes full of tears asked: ‘Tell me, kind friend, of Rama’s welfare: where are Raghunath, Lakshman and Sita Have you brought them back, or have they sought the forest?” At these words the Minister’s eyes streamed with tears. Overpowered by anxiety, the king asked again: “give me tidings of Sita, Rama and Lakshman.” Calling to mind Rama’s beauty and amiability, he sorrowed yet more: “I promised him the kingdom and then imposed exile; he obeyed with soul unmoved either by joy or sorrow. Bereft of such a son I yet can live: who so guilty a monster as I?
Take me, my friend, to the place where Rama, Sita and Lakshman are. IE not, I tell you the very truth, my soul will take flight at once.”

sections.label: Doha 150
sections.name: प्रथम बासु तमसा भयउ दूसर सुरसरि तीर

verses.sa:
पुनि पुनि पूँछत मंत्रहि राऊ ।
प्रियतम सुअन सँदेस सुनाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
puni puni pūm̐chat maṃtrahi rāū
priyatam suan sam̐des sunāū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
करहि सखा सोइ बेगि उपाऊ ।
रामु लखनु सिय नयन देखाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
karahi sakhā soi begi upāū
rāmu lakhanu siya nayan dekhāū

verses.sa:
सचिव धीर धरि कह मुदु बानी ।
महाराज तुम्ह पंडित ग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
saciv dhīr dhari kah mudu bānī
mahārāj tumh paṃḍit gyānī

verses.sa:
बीर सुधीर धुरंधर देवा ।
साधु समाजु सदा तुम्ह सेवा ॥
verses.tr:
bīr sudhīr dhuraṃdhar devā
sādhu samāju sadā tumh sevā

verses.sa:
जनम मरन सब दुख भोगा ।
हानि लाभ प्रिय मिलन बियोगा ॥
verses.tr:
janam maran sab dukh bhogā
hāni lābh priya milan biyogā

verses.sa:
काल करम बस हौहिं गोसाईं ।
बरबस राति दिवस की नाईं ॥
verses.tr:
kāl karam bas hauhiṃ gosāīṃ
barabas rāti divas kī nāīṃ

verses.sa:
सुख हरषहिं जड़ दुख बिलखाहीं ।
दोउ सम धीर धरहिं मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sukh haraṣahiṃ jar̤ dukh bilakhāhīṃ
dou sam dhīr dharahiṃ man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
धीरज धरहु बिबेकु बिचारी ।
छाड़िअ सोच सकल हितकारी ॥
verses.tr:
dhīraj dharahu bibeku bicārī
chār̤ia soc sakal hitakārī

verses.sa:
प्रथम बासु तमसा भयउ दूसर सुरसरि तीर ।
न्हाई रहे जलपानु करि सिय समेत दोउ बीर ॥
verses.tr:
pratham bāsu tamasā bhayau dūsar surasari tīr
nhāī rahe jalapānu kari siya samet dou bīr
verses.head: दोहा

trans: | Agnin and again he implored him: “Friend, tell me of my son. Hearken, comrade; contrive some means for speedily showing me Rama, Lakshman and Sita.” Summoning up courage the Minister gently replied: “Sire, your majesty is a soholar and philosopher, a model of courage and endurance, and a constant attendant of holy assemblies. Life and death; pleasure, pain and all enjoymeonte; loss and gaia; the society of friends and their bereavement; all, sir, are governed by time and fate as unalterably as the succession of night and day. Fools triumph in prosperity, and are downcast in adversity; wise men account both alike. Consider the matter wisely and take courage; the good of all depends upon you; cease vain regrets,
Their first halt was at the Tamasa; their second on the bank of the Ganges, where the two heroes and Sita bathed and stayed to drink water.

sections.label: Doha 151
sections.name: गुर सन कहब सँदेसु बार बार पद पदुम गहि

verses.sa:
केवट कीन्हि बहुत सेवकाई ।
सो जामिनि सिंगरौर गवाँई ॥
verses.tr:
kevaṭ kīnhi bahut sevakāī
so jāmini siṃgaraur gavām̐ī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
होत प्रात बट छीरु मगावा ।
जटा मुकुट निज सीस बनावा ॥
verses.tr:
hot prāt baṭ chīru magāvā
jaṭā mukuṭ nij sīs banāvā

verses.sa:
राम सखाँ तब नाव मगाई ।
प्रिया चढ़ाइ चढ़े रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
rām sakhām̐ tab nāv magāī
priyā car̤hāi car̤he raghurāī

verses.sa:
लखन बान धनु धरे बनाई ।
आपु चढ़े प्रभु आयसु पाई ॥
verses.tr:
lakhan bān dhanu dhare banāī
āpu car̤he prabhu āyasu pāī

verses.sa:
बिकल बिलोकि मोहि रघुबीरा ।
बोले मधुर बचन धरि धीरा ॥
verses.tr:
bikal biloki mohi raghubīrā
bole madhur bacan dhari dhīrā

verses.sa:
तात प्रनामु तात सन कहेहु ।
बार बार पद पंकज गहेहू ॥
verses.tr:
tāt pranāmu tāt san kahehu
bār bār pad paṃkaj gahehū

verses.sa:
करबि पायँ परि बिनय बहोरी ।
तात करिअ जनि चिंता मोरी ॥
verses.tr:
karabi pāyam̐ pari binaya bahorī
tāt karia jani ciṃtā morī

verses.sa:
बन मग मंगल कुसल हमारें ।
कृपा अनुग्रह पुन्य तुम्हारें ॥
verses.tr:
ban mag maṃgal kusal hamāreṃ
kṛpā anugrah punya tumhāreṃ

verses.sa:
तुम्हरे अनुग्रह तात कानन जात सब सुखु पाइहौं ।
प्रतिपालि आयसु कुसल देखन पाय पुनि फिरि आइहौं ॥
verses.tr:
tumhare anugrah tāt kānan jāt sab sukhu pāihauṃ
pratipāli āyasu kusal dekhan pāya puni phiri āihauṃ
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
जननीं सकल परितोषि परि परि पायँ करि बिनती घनी ।
तुलसी करेहु सोइ जतनु जेहिं कुसली रहहिं कोसल धनी ॥
verses.tr:
jananīṃ sakal paritoṣi pari pari pāyam̐ kari binatī ghanī
tulasī karehu soi jatanu jehiṃ kusalī rahahiṃ kosal dhanī

verses.sa:
गुर सन कहब सँदेसु बार बार पद पदुम गहि ।
करब सोइ उपदेसु जेहिं न सोच मोहि अवधपति ॥
verses.tr:
gur san kahab sam̐desu bār bār pad padum gahi
karab soi upadesu jehiṃ na soc mohi avadhapati
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The boatmen showed them great courtesy and they passed the night at Sringavera. At daybreak they called for milk of the fig-tree and fastened up the hair of their head into 4 crown-like top-knot. Then Rama’s friend called for the boat, and after putting his beloved on board, Rama himself followed, and after him by his Lord’s permission, Lakshman too claimed the boat equipt with bow and arrows. Seeing my distress, Raghu-bir restrained his emotion and addressed me thus kindly: ‘Father, give my salutation to my father,and again and again embrace his lotus feet. There at his feet entreat him with all humility, saying, Father, mourn not for me; my banishment to the forest is pleasant and profitable to myself, and on your part is a grace, a favour, and 4 meritorious deed.

By your favour, father, I go to the forest, there to enjoy complete happiness. After fulfiling your command, I shall return again in safety to behold your feet.” Next falling at the feet of each of the queen mothers, console and implore them to make every effort that -Kosala’s king may live happy.
_ Again and again clasping the.lotus feet. of my spiritual instractor, give him this my message: ‘So exhort the king that he may cease to sorrow on my account.’ Chaupdi.

sections.label: Doha 152
sections.name: कहि प्रनाम कछु कहन लिय सिय भइ सिथिल सनेह

verses.sa:
पुरजन परिजन सकल निहोरी ।
तात सुनाएहु बिनती मोरी ॥
verses.tr:
purajan parijan sakal nihorī
tāt sunāehu binatī morī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सोइ सब भाँति मोर हितकारी ।
जातें रह नरनाहु सुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
soi sab bhām̐ti mor hitakārī
jāteṃ rah naranāhu sukhārī

verses.sa:
कहब सँदेसु भरत के आएँ ।
नीति न तजिअ राजपदु पाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
kahab sam̐desu bharat ke āem̐
nīti na tajia rājapadu pāem̐

verses.sa:
पालेहु प्रजहि करम मन बानी ।
सेएहु मातु सकल सम जानी ॥
verses.tr:
pālehu prajahi karam man bānī
seehu mātu sakal sam jānī

verses.sa:
ओर निबाहेहु भायप भाई ।
करि पितु मातु सुजन सेवकाई ॥
verses.tr:
or nibāhehu bhāyap bhāī
kari pitu mātu sujan sevakāī

verses.sa:
तात भाँति तेहि राखब राऊ ।
सोच मोर जेहिं करै न काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
tāt bhām̐ti tehi rākhab rāū
soc mor jehiṃ karai na kāū

verses.sa:
लखन कहे कछु बचन कठोरा ।
बरजि राम पुनि मोहि निहोरा ॥
verses.tr:
lakhan kahe kachu bacan kaṭhorā
baraji rām puni mohi nihorā

verses.sa:
बार बार निज सपथ देवाई ।
कहबि न तात लखन लरिकाई ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār nij sapath devāī
kahabi na tāt lakhan larikāī

verses.sa:
कहि प्रनाम कछु कहन लिय सिय भइ सिथिल सनेह ।
थकित बचन लोचन सजल पुलक पल्लवित देह ॥
verses.tr:
kahi pranām kachu kahan liya siya bhai sithil saneh
thakit bacan locan sajal pulak pallavit deh
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Bowing down before all the citizens and the people of the court make known to them, sir, this my petiton: * He is my best friend who ensures the king’s happiness.’ Say to Bharat, too, when he comes,’ Now that you have obtained the royal dignity, forget not sound polity. Cherish your subjects in word, thought and deed, and be obedient to all the queen-mothers without partiality. Fulfil your duty, brother, as a brother, and in datifulness to father, mother and Kindred, and take such care of the king, sir, that he may never regret me. ‘Lakshman gave vent to some angry words, but Kama checked him, and begged of me again and again, adjuring me by himself, not to mention his childishness.
Sita sent her reverence, and would have said more, but was unable; her voice faltered, her eyes filled with tears, and her body quivered with emotion.

sections.label: Doha 153
sections.name: भयउ कोलाहलु अवध अति सुनि नृप राउर सोरु

verses.sa:
तेहि अवसर रघुबर रूख पाई ।
केवट पारहि नाव चलाई ॥
verses.tr:
tehi avasar raghubar rūkh pāī
kevaṭ pārahi nāv calāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
रघुकुलतिलक चले एहि भाँती ।
देखउँ ठाढ़ कुलिस धरि छाती ॥
verses.tr:
raghukulatilak cale ehi bhām̐tī
dekhaum̐ ṭhār̤h kulis dhari chātī

verses.sa:
मैं आपन किमि कहौं कलेसू ।
जिअत फिरेउँ लेइ राम सँदेसू ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ āpan kimi kahauṃ kalesū
jiat phireum̐ lei rām sam̐desū

verses.sa:
अस कहि सचिव बचन रहि गयऊ ।
हानि गलानि सोच बस भयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi saciv bacan rahi gayaū
hāni galāni soc bas bhayaū

verses.sa:
सुत बचन सुनतहिं नरनाहू ।
परेउ धरनि उर दारुन दाहू ॥
verses.tr:
sut bacan sunatahiṃ naranāhū
pareu dharani ur dārun dāhū

verses.sa:
तलफत बिषम मोह मन मापा ।
माजा मनहुँ मीन कहुँ ब्यापा ॥
verses.tr:
talaphat biṣam moh man māpā
mājā manahum̐ mīn kahum̐ byāpā

verses.sa:
करि बिलाप सब रोवहिं रानी ।
महा बिपति किमि जाइ बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
kari bilāp sab rovahiṃ rānī
mahā bipati kimi jāi bakhānī

verses.sa:
सुनि बिलाप दुखहू दुखु लागा ।
धीरजहू कर धीरजु भागा ॥
verses.tr:
suni bilāp dukhahū dukhu lāgā
dhīrajahū kar dhīraju bhāgā

verses.sa:
भयउ कोलाहलु अवध अति सुनि नृप राउर सोरु ।
बिपुल बिहग बन परेउ निसि मानहुँ कुलिस कठोरु ॥
verses.tr:
bhayau kolāhalu avadh ati suni nṛp rāur soru
bipul bihag ban pareu nisi mānahum̐ kulis kaṭhoru
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Then it was that ata sign from Raghubar the boatmaa propelled the boat to the opposite side. In this manner the Glory of Wahao’s line went his way, and I stood looking on with a heart as of adamant. How can I describe my own anguish, who have come back alive, bearing Rama's message?’ With these words the Minister stopped speaking being overpowered by affection, remorse and distress. When he had heard Sumanta’s speech, the king fell to the ground, heartbroken with grief, and in a wild phrenzy of soul writhed like a fish in the scour of a turbid stream. All the queens wept and made lamentation; how can I describe so great a calamity? at the sound of their wailings. Sorrow itself grew sorrowful and Endurance could no more endure.
Avadh was in a tumult at the sound of the outcry in the king's palace: as when a cruel thunderbolt has fallen at night in some dense forest full of birds.

sections.label: Doha 154
sections.name: प्रिया बचन मृदु सुनत नृपु चितयउ आँखि उघारि

verses.sa:
प्रान कंठगत भयउ भुआलू ।
मनि बिहीन जनु ब्याकुल ब्यालू ॥
verses.tr:
prān kaṃṭhagat bhayau bhuālū
mani bihīn janu byākul byālū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
इद्रीं सकल बिकल भइँ भारी ।
जनु सर सरसिज बनु बिनु बारी ॥
verses.tr:
idrīṃ sakal bikal bhaim̐ bhārī
janu sar sarasij banu binu bārī

verses.sa:
कौसल्याँ नृपु दीख मलाना ।
रबिकुल रबि अँथयउ जियँ जाना ॥
verses.tr:
kausalyām̐ nṛpu dīkh malānā
rabikul rabi am̐thayau jiyam̐ jānā

verses.sa:
उर धरि धीर राम महतारी ।
बोली बचन समय अनुसारी ॥
verses.tr:
ur dhari dhīr rām mahatārī
bolī bacan samaya anusārī

verses.sa:
नाथ समुझि मन करिअ बिचारू ।
राम बियोग पयोधि अपारू ॥
verses.tr:
nāth samujhi man karia bicārū
rām biyog payodhi apārū

verses.sa:
करनधार तुम्ह अवध जहाजू ।
चढ़ेउ सकल प्रिय पथिक समाजू ॥
verses.tr:
karanadhār tumh avadh jahājū
car̤heu sakal priya pathik samājū

verses.sa:
धीरजु धरिअ त पाइअ पारू ।
नाहिं त बूड़िहि सबु परिवारू ॥
verses.tr:
dhīraju dharia ta pāia pārū
nāhiṃ ta būr̤ihi sabu parivārū

verses.sa:
जौं जियँ धरिअ बिनय पिय मोरी ।
रामु लखनु सिय मिलहिं बहोरी ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ jiyam̐ dharia binaya piya morī
rāmu lakhanu siya milahiṃ bahorī

verses.sa:
प्रिया बचन मृदु सुनत नृपु चितयउ आँखि उघारि ।
तलफत मीन मलीन जनु सींचत सीतल बारि ॥
verses.tr:
priyā bacan mṛdu sunat nṛpu citayau ām̐khi ughāri
talaphat mīn malīn janu sīṃcat sītal bāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The breath of life flickered at the king’s mouth, forlorn us a snake robbed of its jewel; all his senses as heavy smitten as the lotuses in a lake that has been drained of its water. When Kausalya say the king’s misery —the sun of the solar race setting us it were at noon—Rama’s mother summoned up courage and spoke in words befitting the occasion.: ‘Consider, my lord, and reflect that Rama’s exile is like the vast ocean, you are the helmsman of the good ship Avadh, and your friends are the merchants, its passengers; if you have courage you will get across: if not the whole family will be drowned. Take to heart this entreaty of mine, my spouse, and you will yet see again Rama, Lakshman and Sita.
Hearing these tender words from his beloved, the king opened his eyes and looked up, writhing like some hapless fish when sprinkled with cold water.

sections.label: Doha 155
sections.name: राम राम कहि राम कहि राम राम कहि राम

verses.sa:
धरि धीरजु उठी बैठ भुआलू ।
कहु सुमंत्र कहँ राम कृपालू ॥
verses.tr:
dhari dhīraju uṭhī baiṭh bhuālū
kahu sumaṃtr kaham̐ rām kṛpālū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कहाँ लखनु कहँ रामु सनेही ।
कहँ प्रिय पुत्रबधू बैदेही ॥
verses.tr:
kahām̐ lakhanu kaham̐ rāmu sanehī
kaham̐ priya putrabadhū baidehī

verses.sa:
बिलपत राउ बिकल बहु भाँती ।
भइ जुग सरिस सिराति न राती ॥
verses.tr:
bilapat rāu bikal bahu bhām̐tī
bhai jug saris sirāti na rātī

verses.sa:
तापस अंध साप सुधि आई ।
कौसल्यहि सब कथा सुनाई ॥
verses.tr:
tāpas aṃdh sāp sudhi āī
kausalyahi sab kathā sunāī

verses.sa:
भयउ बिकल बरनत इतिहासा ।
राम रहित धिग जीवन आसा ॥
verses.tr:
bhayau bikal baranat itihāsā
rām rahit dhig jīvan āsā

verses.sa:
सो तनु राखि करब मैं काहा ।
जेंहि न प्रेम पनु मोर निबाहा ॥
verses.tr:
so tanu rākhi karab maiṃ kāhā
jeṃhi na prem panu mor nibāhā

verses.sa:
हा रघुनंदन प्रान पिरीते ।
तुम्ह बिनु जिअत बहुत दिन बीते ॥
verses.tr:
hā raghunaṃdan prān pirīte
tumh binu jiat bahut din bīte

verses.sa:
हा जानकी लखन हा रघुबर ।
हा पितु हित चित चातक जलधर ॥
verses.tr:
hā jānakī lakhan hā raghubar
hā pitu hit cit cātak jaladhar

verses.sa:
राम राम कहि राम कहि राम राम कहि राम ।
तनु परिहरि रघुबर बिरहँ राउ गयउ सुरधाम ॥
verses.tr:
rām rām kahi rām kahi rām rām kahi rām
tanu parihari raghubar biraham̐ rāu gayau suradhām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The king with an effort sat up: “Tell me, Sumanta, where is my generous Rama Where is Lakshman? Where my loving Rama Where my dear daughter-inlaw, the princess of Videha?” Thus miserably moaning, the night seemed an age long and as though it never would end. The blind hermit’s curse came back to his mind, and he. told the whole story to Kausalya. As he related the circumstances his agitation increased: ‘“‘ Bereft as I am of RAma, I have done with life and hope; why should I cherish a body that has failed to fulfil my love's engagement? Ah Raghunandan, dearer to me than life, already I have lived too long without you. Ah, Janaki and Lakshman Ah, Raghubar the raincloud of a fond father’s chdtak-like heart.”
Crying ‘Rama, Kama l’ and again ‘Rama!’ and yet once more ‘Rama, Rama, Rama!’ the king’s soul, bereft of Raghubar, quitted his body and entered heaven.

sections.label: Doha 156
sections.name: तब बसिष्ठ मुनि समय सम कहि अनेक इतिहास

verses.sa:
जिअन मरन फलु दसरथ पावा ।
अंड अनेक अमल जसु छावा ॥
verses.tr:
jian maran phalu dasarath pāvā
aṃḍ anek amal jasu chāvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जिअत राम बिधु बदनु निहारा ।
राम बिरह करि मरनु सँवारा ॥
verses.tr:
jiat rām bidhu badanu nihārā
rām birah kari maranu sam̐vārā

verses.sa:
सोक बिकल सब रोवहिं रानी ।
रूपु सील बलु तेजु बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
sok bikal sab rovahiṃ rānī
rūpu sīl balu teju bakhānī

verses.sa:
करहिं बिलाप अनेक प्रकारा ।
परहीं भूमितल बारहिं बारा ॥
verses.tr:
karahiṃ bilāp anek prakārā
parahīṃ bhūmital bārahiṃ bārā

verses.sa:
बिलपहिं बिकल दास अरु दासी ।
घर घर रुदनु करहिं पुरबासी ॥
verses.tr:
bilapahiṃ bikal dās aru dāsī
ghar ghar rudanu karahiṃ purabāsī

verses.sa:
अँथयउ आजु भानुकुल भानू ।
धरम अवधि गुन रूप निधानू ॥
verses.tr:
am̐thayau āju bhānukul bhānū
dharam avadhi gun rūp nidhānū

verses.sa:
गारीं सकल कैकइहि देहीं ।
नयन बिहीन कीन्ह जग जेहीं ॥
verses.tr:
gārīṃ sakal kaikaihi dehīṃ
nayan bihīn kīnh jag jehīṃ

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि बिलपत रैनि बिहानी ।
आए सकल महामुनि ग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi bilapat raini bihānī
āe sakal mahāmuni gyānī

verses.sa:
तब बसिष्ठ मुनि समय सम कहि अनेक इतिहास ।
सोक नेवारेउ सबहि कर निज बिग्यान प्रकास ॥
verses.tr:
tab basiṣṭh muni samaya sam kahi anek itihās
sok nevāreu sabahi kar nij bigyān prakās
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Thus Dasarath reaped his reward both in life and death, and his spotless fame has spread through countless cycles of creation. In life he saw Rama's moon-like face, and dying for his loss had a glorious death. All the queens bewept him in an agony of grief, and spoke of his beauty, his amiability, his power and majesty. ‘They made manifold lamentation, throwing themselves upon the ground again and again. Men-servants and maid-servants sadly bemoaned him; and there was weeping in every house throughout the city: ‘To-day has set the sun of the solar race, the perfection of justice, the treasury of all good qualities.” All reviled Kaikeyi, who had robbed the world of its very eyes. In this manner the night was spent in lamentations till all the great and learned sages arrived.
Then the holy Vasishtha recited many legends befitting the time, and checked their grief by the wisdom that he displayed.

sections.label: Doha 157
sections.name: एहि बिधि सोचत भरत मन धावन पहुँचे आइ

verses.sa:
तेल नाँव भरि नृप तनु राखा ।
दूत बोलाइ बहुरि अस भाषा ॥
verses.tr:
tel nām̐v bhari nṛp tanu rākhā
dūt bolāi bahuri as bhāṣā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
धावहु बेगि भरत पहिं जाहू ।
नृप सुधि कतहुँ कहहु जनि काहू ॥
verses.tr:
dhāvahu begi bharat pahiṃ jāhū
nṛp sudhi katahum̐ kahahu jani kāhū

verses.sa:
एतनेइ कहेहु भरत सन जाई ।
गुर बोलाई पठयउ दोउ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
etanei kahehu bharat san jāī
gur bolāī paṭhayau dou bhāī

verses.sa:
सुनि मुनि आयसु धावन धाए ।
चले बेग बर बाजि लजाए ॥
verses.tr:
suni muni āyasu dhāvan dhāe
cale beg bar bāji lajāe

verses.sa:
अनरथु अवध अरंभेउ जब तें ।
कुसगुन होहिं भरत कहुँ तब तें ॥
verses.tr:
anarathu avadh araṃbheu jab teṃ
kusagun hohiṃ bharat kahum̐ tab teṃ

verses.sa:
देखहिं राति भयानक सपना ।
जागि करहिं कटु कोटि कलपना ॥
verses.tr:
dekhahiṃ rāti bhayānak sapanā
jāgi karahiṃ kaṭu koṭi kalapanā

verses.sa:
बिप्र जेवाँइ देहिं दिन दाना ।
सिव अभिषेक करहिं बिधि नाना ॥
verses.tr:
bipr jevām̐i dehiṃ din dānā
siv abhiṣek karahiṃ bidhi nānā

verses.sa:
मागहिं हृदयँ महेस मनाई ।
कुसल मातु पितु परिजन भाई ॥
verses.tr:
māgahiṃ hṛdayam̐ mahes manāī
kusal mātu pitu parijan bhāī

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि सोचत भरत मन धावन पहुँचे आइ ।
गुर अनुसासन श्रवन सुनि चले गनेसु मनाइ ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi socat bharat man dhāvan pahum̐ce āi
gur anusāsan śravan suni cale ganesu manāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: After filling a boat with oil and putting the king’s body in it, he summoned messengers and thus addressed them: ‘“‘ Hasten with all speed to Bharat, and say nothing to any-body about the king; only tell Bharat when you arrive. ‘The guru has sent for you two brothers.”’ On receiving the saint’s orders, they ran off at once with speed that would shame the fleetest of horses. Directly these troubles had begun at Avadh, Bharat was visited with evil omens; he saw fearful visions in his sleep by night, and on awaking formed all sorts of ill conjectures. He daily fasted Brahmans and gave alms, and with elaborate ritual poured water over the emblem of Mahadeva. and with heartfelt prayers implored the god for the prosperity of his parents, his family and his brethren.
In this state of anxiety was Bharat found by the heralds on their arrival. As soon as he had heard his guru’s commands he offered up a prayer to Ganes and started.

sections.label: Doha 158
sections.name: पुरजन मिलिहिं न कहहिं कछु गवँहिं जोहारहिं जाहिं

verses.sa:
चले समीर बेग हय हाँके ।
नाघत सरित सैल बन बाँके ॥
verses.tr:
cale samīr beg haya hām̐ke
nāghat sarit sail ban bām̐ke
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
हृदयँ सोचु बड़ कछु न सोहाई ।
अस जानहिं जियँ जाउँ उड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
hṛdayam̐ socu bar̤ kachu na sohāī
as jānahiṃ jiyam̐ jāum̐ ur̤āī

verses.sa:
एक निमेष बरस सम जाई ।
एहि बिधि भरत नगर निअराई ॥
verses.tr:
ek nimeṣ baras sam jāī
ehi bidhi bharat nagar niarāī

verses.sa:
असगुन होहिं नगर पैठारा ।
रटहिं कुभाँति कुखेत करारा ॥
verses.tr:
asagun hohiṃ nagar paiṭhārā
raṭahiṃ kubhām̐ti kukhet karārā

verses.sa:
खर सिआर बोलहिं प्रतिकूला ।
सुनि सुनि होइ भरत मन सूला ॥
verses.tr:
khar siār bolahiṃ pratikūlā
suni suni hoi bharat man sūlā

verses.sa:
श्रीहत सर सरिता बन बागा ।
नगरु बिसेषि भयावनु लागा ॥
verses.tr:
śrīhat sar saritā ban bāgā
nagaru biseṣi bhayāvanu lāgā

verses.sa:
खग मृग हय गय जाहिं न जोए ।
राम बियोग कुरोग बिगोए ॥
verses.tr:
khag mṛg haya gaya jāhiṃ na joe
rām biyog kurog bigoe

verses.sa:
नगर नारि नर निपट दुखारी ।
मनहुँ सबन्हि सब संपति हारी ॥
verses.tr:
nagar nāri nar nipaṭ dukhārī
manahum̐ sabanhi sab saṃpati hārī

verses.sa:
पुरजन मिलिहिं न कहहिं कछु गवँहिं जोहारहिं जाहिं ।
भरत कुसल पूँछि न सकहिं भय बिषाद मन माहिं ॥
verses.tr:
purajan milihiṃ na kahahiṃ kachu gavam̐hiṃ johārahiṃ jāhiṃ
bharat kusal pūm̐chi na sakahiṃ bhaya biṣād man māhiṃ
verses.head: दोहा

trans: They went with the speed of the wind, urging on their horses over rivers, rocks and trackless forests. So great was his distress of mind that nothing pleased him; he thought to himself, ‘O that I had wings to fly |’ A moment seemed like a year. In this manner Bharat drew near to the city. On entering he was met by evil omens. Gruesome noises sounded in uncanny places, asses and jackals uttered pres-ages of ill, which pierced him to the heart as he listened. Even the lakes and rivers, groves and gardens, seemed forlorn; while the city struck him as more melancholy still. Birds, deer, horses and elephants were painful to look at, as though the loss of Rama were some dreadful disease that had destroyed them. The citizens were as downcast as if they had all lost everything they had in the world.
The people who met him did not speak, but bowed and

sections.label: Doha 159
sections.name: सुनि सुत बचन सनेहमय कपट नीर भरि नैन

verses.sa:
हाट बाट नहिं जाइ निहारी ।
जनु पुर दहँ दिसि लागि दवारी ॥
verses.tr:
hāṭ bāṭ nahiṃ jāi nihārī
janu pur daham̐ disi lāgi davārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
आवत सुत सुनि कैकयनंदिनि ।
हरषी रबिकुल जलरुह चंदिनि ॥
verses.tr:
āvat sut suni kaikayanaṃdini
haraṣī rabikul jalaruh caṃdini

verses.sa:
सजि आरती मुदित उठि धाई ।
द्वारेहिं भेंटि भवन लेइ आई ॥
verses.tr:
saji āratī mudit uṭhi dhāī
dvārehiṃ bheṃṭi bhavan lei āī

verses.sa:
भरत दुखित परिवारु निहारा ।
मानहुँ तुहिन बनज बनु मारा ॥
verses.tr:
bharat dukhit parivāru nihārā
mānahum̐ tuhin banaj banu mārā

verses.sa:
कैकेई हरषित एहि भाँति ।
मनहुँ मुदित दव लाइ किराती ॥
verses.tr:
kaikeī haraṣit ehi bhām̐ti
manahum̐ mudit dav lāi kirātī

verses.sa:
सुतहि ससोच देखि मनु मारें ।
पूँछति नैहर कुसल हमारें ॥
verses.tr:
sutahi sasoc dekhi manu māreṃ
pūm̐chati naihar kusal hamāreṃ

verses.sa:
सकल कुसल कहि भरत सुनाई ।
पूँछी निज कुल कुसल भलाई ॥
verses.tr:
sakal kusal kahi bharat sunāī
pūm̐chī nij kul kusal bhalāī

verses.sa:
कहु कहँ तात कहाँ सब माता ।
कहँ सिय राम लखन प्रिय भ्राता ॥
verses.tr:
kahu kaham̐ tāt kahām̐ sab mātā
kaham̐ siya rām lakhan priya bhrātā

verses.sa:
सुनि सुत बचन सनेहमय कपट नीर भरि नैन ।
भरत श्रवन मन सूल सम पापिनि बोली बैन ॥
verses.tr:
suni sut bacan sanehamaya kapaṭ nīr bhari nain
bharat śravan man sūl sam pāpini bolī bain
verses.head: दोहा

trans: passed on. For the fear and dismay in his mind Bharat could not ask ‘Is all well?’

, The market places and streets were as dreary as though the city had been the prey of a general conflagration. When Kaikeyi heard of her son’s approach, the moon of the lotuslike solar race rejoiced. She sprang up gladly and ran with lamp io hand and met him at the door and brought him in. Bharat saw all the household as woe-begone as a bed of lotuses. when smitten by the frost, his mother as jubilant as a wild hill-woman who has set the forest in a blaze. Seeing her son sad and distressed, she asked ‘Is all well in my mother’s house?’ Bharat assured her that all was well, and then asked after the welfare of his own family: ‘Say, where is my father and where the other queen-mothers? where ia ‘Sita and my dear brothers, Rama and Lakshman?”
On hearing her son’s loving speech, the guilty woman eyes filled with false tears, and she replied in words that pierced Bharat’s ears and soul:

sections.label: Doha 160
sections.name: भरतहि बिसरेउ पितु मरन सुनत राम बन गौनु

verses.sa:
तात बात मैं सकल सँवारी ।
भै मंथरा सहाय बिचारी ॥
verses.tr:
tāt bāt maiṃ sakal sam̐vārī
bhai maṃtharā sahāya bicārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कछुक काज बिधि बीच बिगारेउ ।
भूपति सुरपति पुर पगु धारेउ ॥
verses.tr:
kachuk kāj bidhi bīc bigāreu
bhūpati surapati pur pagu dhāreu

verses.sa:
सुनत भरतु भए बिबस बिषादा ।
जनु सहमेउ करि केहरि नादा ॥
verses.tr:
sunat bharatu bhae bibas biṣādā
janu sahameu kari kehari nādā

verses.sa:
तात तात हा तात पुकारी ।
परे भूमितल ब्याकुल भारी ॥
verses.tr:
tāt tāt hā tāt pukārī
pare bhūmital byākul bhārī

verses.sa:
चलत न देखन पायउँ तोही ।
तात न रामहि सौंपेहु मोही ॥
verses.tr:
calat na dekhan pāyaum̐ tohī
tāt na rāmahi sauṃpehu mohī

verses.sa:
बहुरि धीर धरि उठे सँभारी ।
कहु पितु मरन हेतु महतारी ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri dhīr dhari uṭhe sam̐bhārī
kahu pitu maran hetu mahatārī

verses.sa:
सुनि सुत बचन कहति कैकेई ।
मरमु पाँछि जनु माहुर देई ॥
verses.tr:
suni sut bacan kahati kaikeī
maramu pām̐chi janu māhur deī

verses.sa:
आदिहु तें सब आपनि करनी ।
कुटिल कठोर मुदित मन बरनी ॥
verses.tr:
ādihu teṃ sab āpani karanī
kuṭil kaṭhor mudit man baranī

verses.sa:
भरतहि बिसरेउ पितु मरन सुनत राम बन गौनु ।
हेतु अपनपउ जानि जियँ थकित रहे धरि मौनु ॥
verses.tr:
bharatahi bisareu pitu maran sunat rām ban gaunu
hetu apanapau jāni jiyam̐ thakit rahe dhari maunu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘My son, I had arranged everything with the help of poor! Manthara, but God somehow spoilt my plan half-way. The king has gone to heaven.” On hearing this Bharat was overcome with distress, like an elephant at the roar of a lion. Crying ‘My father, my father, alas, my father!” he fell upon the ground in grievous affliction. ‘“ I could not see you ere you left, nor did you my father, commend me to Rama.’ Again with an effort, he collected himself and got up: “Tell me, mother, the cause of my father’s death.” On hearing her son’s words Kaikeyi replied, as one who drops poison into a wound, and with a glad heart, vile wretch that she was recounted all that she had done from the very ‘beginning.
Bharat forgot his father’s death when he heard of Rama’s banishment, and knowing himself to be the cause he was staggered and remained speechless.

sections.label: Doha 161
sections.name: हंसबंसु दसरथु जनकु राम लखन से भाइ

verses.sa:
बिकल बिलोकि सुतहि समुझावति ।
मनहुँ जरे पर लोनु लगावति ॥
verses.tr:
bikal biloki sutahi samujhāvati
manahum̐ jare par lonu lagāvati
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तात राउ नहिं सोचे जोगू ।
बिढ़इ सुकृत जसु कीन्हेउ भोगू ॥
verses.tr:
tāt rāu nahiṃ soce jogū
bir̤hai sukṛt jasu kīnheu bhogū

verses.sa:
जीवत सकल जनम फल पाए ।
अंत अमरपति सदन सिधाए ॥
verses.tr:
jīvat sakal janam phal pāe
aṃt amarapati sadan sidhāe

verses.sa:
अस अनुमानि सोच परिहरहू ।
सहित समाज राज पुर करहू ॥
verses.tr:
as anumāni soc pariharahū
sahit samāj rāj pur karahū

verses.sa:
सुनि सुठि सहमेउ राजकुमारू ।
पाकें छत जनु लाग अँगारू ॥
verses.tr:
suni suṭhi sahameu rājakumārū
pākeṃ chat janu lāg am̐gārū

verses.sa:
धीरज धरि भरि लेहिं उसासा ।
पापनि सबहि भाँति कुल नासा ॥
verses.tr:
dhīraj dhari bhari lehiṃ usāsā
pāpani sabahi bhām̐ti kul nāsā

verses.sa:
जौं पै कुरुचि रही अति तोही ।
जनमत काहे न मारे मोही ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ pai kuruci rahī ati tohī
janamat kāhe na māre mohī

verses.sa:
पेड़ काटि तैं पालउ सींचा ।
मीन जिअन निति बारि उलीचा ॥
verses.tr:
per̤ kāṭi taiṃ pālau sīṃcā
mīn jian niti bāri ulīcā

verses.sa:
हंसबंसु दसरथु जनकु राम लखन से भाइ ।
जननी तूँ जननी भई बिधि सन कछु न बसाइ ॥
verses.tr:
haṃsabaṃsu dasarathu janaku rām lakhan se bhāi
jananī tūm̐ jananī bhaī bidhi san kachu na basāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Seeing her son’s distress she comforted him, in such a manner as when one applies salt toa burn: ‘“ The king, my boy, is no fit subject for lamentation; he won glory and renown and lived happily. In his life he reaped all life’s rewards, and in the end has entered the court of heaven. Regard the matter in this light and banish grief; in state assume the sovereignty of the realm.’ The prince shrank exceedingly at her words, as though cautery had been applied to a festered wound; then collecting himself he gave adeep sigh: Wretched woman, the rain of us all if this was your vile desire, why did you not kill me at my brith? After cutting down a tree you water the branches and drain a pond to keep the fish alive.
Born of the solar race, with Dasarath for my father and Rama and Lakshman for my brothers, I have had you, mother, for a mother: what can be done against Fate?

sections.label: Doha 162
sections.name: राम बिरोधी हृदय तें प्रगट कीन्ह बिधि मोहि

verses.sa:
जब तैं कुमति कुमत जियँ ठयऊ ।
खंड खंड होइ ह्रदउ न गयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
jab taiṃ kumati kumat jiyam̐ ṭhayaū
khaṃḍ khaṃḍ hoi hradau na gayaū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बर मागत मन भइ नहिं पीरा ।
गरि न जीह मुहँ परेउ न कीरा ॥
verses.tr:
bar māgat man bhai nahiṃ pīrā
gari na jīh muham̐ pareu na kīrā

verses.sa:
भूपँ प्रतीत तोरि किमि कीन्ही ।
मरन काल बिधि मति हरि लीन्ही ॥
verses.tr:
bhūpam̐ pratīt tori kimi kīnhī
maran kāl bidhi mati hari līnhī

verses.sa:
बिधिहुँ न नारि हृदय गति जानी ।
सकल कपट अघ अवगुन खानी ॥
verses.tr:
bidhihum̐ na nāri hṛdaya gati jānī
sakal kapaṭ agh avagun khānī

verses.sa:
सरल सुसील धरम रत राऊ ।
सो किमि जानै तीय सुभाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
saral susīl dharam rat rāū
so kimi jānai tīya subhāū

verses.sa:
अस को जीव जंतु जग माहीं ।
जेहि रघुनाथ प्रानप्रिय नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
as ko jīv jaṃtu jag māhīṃ
jehi raghunāth prānapriya nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
भे अति अहित रामु तेउ तोही ।
को तू अहसि सत्य कहु मोही ॥
verses.tr:
bhe ati ahit rāmu teu tohī
ko tū ahasi satya kahu mohī

verses.sa:
जो हसि सो हसि मुहँ मसि लाई ।
आँखि ओट उठि बैठहिं जाई ॥
verses.tr:
jo hasi so hasi muham̐ masi lāī
ām̐khi oṭ uṭhi baiṭhahiṃ jāī

verses.sa:
राम बिरोधी हृदय तें प्रगट कीन्ह बिधि मोहि ।
मो समान को पातकी बादि कहउँ कछु तोहि ॥
verses.tr:
rām birodhī hṛdaya teṃ pragaṭ kīnh bidhi mohi
mo samān ko pātakī bādi kahaum̐ kachu tohi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Wretch when you formed such an evil design in your mind, how was it your heart did not break in pieces When you asked the boon, your soul felt no pain, your tongue did not burn, nor your mouth fester? How could the king trust you his hour of death had come, and God had robbed him of his senses. Not even God knows the ways of a woman's heart; such a mine is it of all deceit, crime and sin. The king was sosimple, good and pious, what did he know of woman’s nature Is there any living creature in the world who loves not Raghunath like himself? Yet he was your special enemy. Tell me the truth, what are you. Whatever you may be you have blackened your own face; up, hence out of my sight.
God has created me out of a womb hostile to Rama; who so guilty a wretch asI? but it is useless for me to say anything to you.” 5

sections.label: Doha 163
sections.name: मलिन बसन बिबरन बिकल कृस सरीर दुख भार

verses.sa:
सुनि सत्रुघुन मातु कुटिलाई ।
जरहिं गात रिस कछु न बसाई ॥
verses.tr:
suni satrughun mātu kuṭilāī
jarahiṃ gāt ris kachu na basāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तेहि अवसर कुबरी तहँ आई ।
बसन बिभूषन बिबिध बनाई ॥
verses.tr:
tehi avasar kubarī taham̐ āī
basan bibhūṣan bibidh banāī

verses.sa:
लखि रिस भरेउ लखन लघु भाई ।
बरत अनल घृत आहुति पाई ॥
verses.tr:
lakhi ris bhareu lakhan laghu bhāī
barat anal ghṛt āhuti pāī

verses.sa:
हुमगि लात तकि कूबर मारा ।
परि मुह भर महि करत पुकारा ॥
verses.tr:
humagi lāt taki kūbar mārā
pari muh bhar mahi karat pukārā

verses.sa:
कूबर टूटेउ फूट कपारू ।
दलित दसन मुख रुधिर प्रचारू ॥
verses.tr:
kūbar ṭūṭeu phūṭ kapārū
dalit dasan mukh rudhir pracārū

verses.sa:
आह दइअ मैं काह नसावा ।
करत नीक फलु अनइस पावा ॥
verses.tr:
āh daia maiṃ kāh nasāvā
karat nīk phalu anais pāvā

verses.sa:
सुनि रिपुहन लखि नख सिख खोटी ।
लगे घसीटन धरि धरि झोंटी ॥
verses.tr:
suni ripuhan lakhi nakh sikh khoṭī
lage ghasīṭan dhari dhari jhoṃṭī

verses.sa:
भरत दयानिधि दीन्हि छड़ाई ।
कौसल्या पहिं गे दोउ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
bharat dayānidhi dīnhi char̤āī
kausalyā pahiṃ ge dou bhāī

verses.sa:
मलिन बसन बिबरन बिकल कृस सरीर दुख भार ।
कनक कलप बर बेलि बन मानहुँ हनी तुसार ॥
verses.tr:
malin basan bibaran bikal kṛs sarīr dukh bhār
kanak kalap bar beli ban mānahum̐ hanī tusār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When Satrughna heard of his mother’s wickedness he burned all over, his anger was beyond control. At that very moment Humpback came up, dressed out in fine attire and many jewels. On seeing her, Lakshman’s young brother was filled with passion, like fire upon which butter has been poured. He sprung forward and struck her such a blow on her hump that she fell flat on her face and screamed aloud. Her hump was smashed, her head split, her teeth broken and her month streamed with blood ‘Ah my God! what harm have I done this is an ill reward for all my services!” Then Satrughna, seeing her so all vile from head to foot, seized her by the hair of the head and began dragging her about, till the merciful Bharat rescued her. Both brothers then went to Kausalya.
In sordid attire, pale, agitated, with wasted frame and soul opprest with woe, she seemed some lovely creeper or golden lotus smitten by the frost.

sections.label: Doha 164
sections.name: मातु भरत के बचन मृदु सुनि सुनि उठी सँभारि

verses.sa:
भरतहि देखि मातु उठि धाई ।
मुरुछित अवनि परी झइँ आई ॥
verses.tr:
bharatahi dekhi mātu uṭhi dhāī
muruchit avani parī jhaim̐ āī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
देखत भरतु बिकल भए भारी ।
परे चरन तन दसा बिसारी ॥
verses.tr:
dekhat bharatu bikal bhae bhārī
pare caran tan dasā bisārī

verses.sa:
मातु तात कहँ देहि देखाई ।
कहँ सिय रामु लखनु दोउ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
mātu tāt kaham̐ dehi dekhāī
kaham̐ siya rāmu lakhanu dou bhāī

verses.sa:
कैकइ कत जनमी जग माझा ।
जौं जनमि त भइ काहे न बाँझा ॥
verses.tr:
kaikai kat janamī jag mājhā
jauṃ janami ta bhai kāhe na bām̐jhā

verses.sa:
कुल कलंकु जेहिं जनमेउ मोही ।
अपजस भाजन प्रियजन द्रोही ॥
verses.tr:
kul kalaṃku jehiṃ janameu mohī
apajas bhājan priyajan drohī

verses.sa:
को तिभुवन मोहि सरिस अभागी ।
गति असि तोरि मातु जेहि लागी ॥
verses.tr:
ko tibhuvan mohi saris abhāgī
gati asi tori mātu jehi lāgī

verses.sa:
पितु सुरपुर बन रघुबर केतू ।
मैं केवल सब अनरथ हेतु ॥
verses.tr:
pitu surapur ban raghubar ketū
maiṃ keval sab anarath hetu

verses.sa:
धिग मोहि भयउँ बेनु बन आगी ।
दुसह दाह दुख दूषन भागी ॥
verses.tr:
dhig mohi bhayaum̐ benu ban āgī
dusah dāh dukh dūṣan bhāgī

verses.sa: मातु भरत के बचन मृदु सुनि सुनि उठी सँभारि ॥
verses.tr: mātu bharat ke bacan mṛdu suni suni uṭhī sam̐bhāri
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: लिए उठाइ लगाइ उर लोचन मोचति बारि ॥
verses.tr: lie uṭhāi lagāi ur locan mocati bāri

trans: When the queen saw Bharat she sprang up in haste, but fell swooning to the ground overtaken with giddiness, At this sight Bharat was grievously distrest, and threw himself at her feet, forgetting his own condition: Mother, let me see my father; where is Sita, and where Rama and Lakshman, my two brothers Why was Kaikeyi born into the world? or if born, why was she not barren instead of bear- -ing to disgrace the family, a very sink of infamy, the curse of my home? Who in the three spheres is so wretched as I am, on whose account, mother, you have been brought to this plight? My father dead, Rama banished, and I alone the cause of all this calamity Woe is me, a very fire amongst the reeds, fraught with intolerable torment, anguish and offence.”
Hearing Bharat speak so tenderly, his mother again took courage and arose and lifted him up and clasped him to her bosom, while she wiped the tears from his eyes.

sections.label: Doha 165
sections.name: पितु आयस भूषन बसन तात तजे रघुबीर

verses.sa:
सरल सुभाय मायँ हियँ लाए ।
अति हित मनहुँ राम फिरि आए ॥
verses.tr:
saral subhāya māyam̐ hiyam̐ lāe
ati hit manahum̐ rām phiri āe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भेंटेउ बहुरि लखन लघु भाई ।
सोकु सनेहु न हृदयँ समाई ॥
verses.tr:
bheṃṭeu bahuri lakhan laghu bhāī
soku sanehu na hṛdayam̐ samāī

verses.sa:
देखि सुभाउ कहत सबु कोई ।
राम मातु अस काहे न होई ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi subhāu kahat sabu koī
rām mātu as kāhe na hoī

verses.sa:
माताँ भरतु गोद बैठारे ।
आँसु पौंछि मृदु बचन उचारे ॥
verses.tr:
mātām̐ bharatu god baiṭhāre
ām̐su pauṃchi mṛdu bacan ucāre

verses.sa:
अजहुँ बच्छ बलि धीरज धरहू ।
कुसमउ समुझि सोक परिहरहू ॥
verses.tr:
ajahum̐ bacch bali dhīraj dharahū
kusamau samujhi sok pariharahū

verses.sa:
जनि मानहु हियँ हानि गलानी ।
काल करम गति अघटित जानि ॥
verses.tr:
jani mānahu hiyam̐ hāni galānī
kāl karam gati aghaṭit jāni

verses.sa:
काहुहि दोसु देहु जनि ताता ।
भा मोहि सब बिधि बाम बिधाता ॥
verses.tr:
kāhuhi dosu dehu jani tātā
bhā mohi sab bidhi bām bidhātā

verses.sa:
जो एतेहुँ दुख मोहि जिआवा ।
अजहुँ को जानइ का तेहि भावा ॥
verses.tr:
jo etehum̐ dukh mohi jiāvā
ajahum̐ ko jānai kā tehi bhāvā

verses.sa:
पितु आयस भूषन बसन तात तजे रघुबीर ।
बिसमउ हरषु न हृदयँ कछु पहिरे बलकल चीर ॥
verses.tr:
pitu āyas bhūṣan basan tāt taje raghubīr
bisamau haraṣu na hṛdayam̐ kachu pahire balakal cīr
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Simple and kind, she took him to her heart as lovingly as though Rama himself had come back. Then Lakshman’s young brother was also embraced, while soul overflowed with sorrow and affection. All who witnessed her kindness said: “She is Rama’s mother, it is natural to her." Seat- | ing Bharatin her lap she wiped away her tears and said soothingly; Now, my child, I adjure you to compose yourself; reflect that the times are evil and cease to lament. Think no more of your Loss and vexation; remember that the course of time and fate is unalterable. Do not attach blame to any one my son: it is God who has set himself against me. He has made me live through such distress: who knows what may be his pleasure with me now?
At his father’s command Raghubir put aside his ornaments and ordinary attire and. assumed the bark dress
without either dismay or exaltation.

sections.label: Doha 166
sections.name: कौसल्या के बचन सुनि भरत सहित रनिवास

verses.sa:
मुख प्रसन्न मन रंग न रोषू ।
सब कर सब बिधि करि परितोषू ॥
verses.tr:
mukh prasann man raṃg na roṣū
sab kar sab bidhi kari paritoṣū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
चले बिपिन सुनि सिय सँग लागी ।
रहइ न राम चरन अनुरागी ॥
verses.tr:
cale bipin suni siya sam̐g lāgī
rahai na rām caran anurāgī

verses.sa:
सुनतहिं लखनु चले उठि साथा ।
रहहिं न जतन किए रघुनाथा ॥
verses.tr:
sunatahiṃ lakhanu cale uṭhi sāthā
rahahiṃ na jatan kie raghunāthā

verses.sa:
तब रघुपति सबही सिरु नाई ।
चले संग सिय अरु लघु भाई ॥
verses.tr:
tab raghupati sabahī siru nāī
cale saṃg siya aru laghu bhāī

verses.sa:
रामु लखनु सिय बनहि सिधाए ।
गइउँ न संग न प्रान पठाए ॥
verses.tr:
rāmu lakhanu siya banahi sidhāe
gaium̐ na saṃg na prān paṭhāe

verses.sa:
यहु सबु भा इन्ह आँखिन्ह आगें ।
तउ न तजा तनु जीव अभागें ॥
verses.tr:
yahu sabu bhā inh ām̐khinh āgeṃ
tau na tajā tanu jīv abhāgeṃ

verses.sa:
मोहि न लाज निज नेहु निहारी ।
राम सरिस सुत मैं महतारी ॥
verses.tr:
mohi na lāj nij nehu nihārī
rām saris sut maiṃ mahatārī

verses.sa:
जिऐ मरै भल भूपति जाना ।
मोर हृदय सत कुलिस समाना ॥
verses.tr:
jiai marai bhal bhūpati jānā
mor hṛdaya sat kulis samānā

verses.sa:
कौसल्या के बचन सुनि भरत सहित रनिवास ।
ब्याकुल बिलपत राजगृह मानहुँ सोक नेवासु ॥
verses.tr:
kausalyā ke bacan suni bharat sahit ranivās
byākul bilapat rājagṛh mānahum̐ sok nevāsu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: With acheerful countenance and a soul unmoved by anger or attachment, he did all in his power to comfort us. Sita hearing he was off to the forest, went too; in her devotion to Rama’s feet she could not stay. Lakshman also, when he heard the news, rose up to accompany him, and for all Rama’s persuasions would not remain behind. Then Raghupati bowed his head to all in turn and set out accompanied by Sita and his younger brother Rama, Lakshman and Sita and went thus into exile. I neither joined them nor sent my spirit after them. All this took place before my eyes, and yet—wretch that I am life did not leave my body. I felt no shame, for all my love, with such a son, as — Rama and myself his mother. The king knew well the time to live and the time to die, but my heart is « hundredfold harder than adamant.”
Hearing Kausalya’s words, Bharat and all the seraglio made woeful lamentation; the palace seemed the very home of affliction.

sections.label: Doha 167
sections.name: जे परिहरि हरि हर चरन भजहिं भूतगन घोर

verses.sa:
बिलपहिं बिकल भरत दोउ भाई ।
कौसल्याँ लिए हृदयँ लगाई ॥
verses.tr:
bilapahiṃ bikal bharat dou bhāī
kausalyām̐ lie hṛdayam̐ lagāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भाँति अनेक भरतु समुझाए ।
कहि बिबेकमय बचन सुनाए ॥
verses.tr:
bhām̐ti anek bharatu samujhāe
kahi bibekamaya bacan sunāe

verses.sa:
भरतहुँ मातु सकल समुझाईं ।
कहि पुरान श्रुति कथा सुहाईं ॥
verses.tr:
bharatahum̐ mātu sakal samujhāīṃ
kahi purān śruti kathā suhāīṃ

verses.sa:
छल बिहीन सुचि सरल सुबानी ।
बोले भरत जोरि जुग पानी ॥
verses.tr:
chal bihīn suci saral subānī
bole bharat jori jug pānī

verses.sa:
जे अघ मातु पिता सुत मारें ।
गाइ गोठ महिसुर पुर जारें ॥
verses.tr:
je agh mātu pitā sut māreṃ
gāi goṭh mahisur pur jāreṃ

verses.sa:
जे अघ तिय बालक बध कीन्हें ।
मीत महीपति माहुर दीन्हें ॥
verses.tr:
je agh tiya bālak badh kīnheṃ
mīt mahīpati māhur dīnheṃ

verses.sa:
जे पातक उपपातक अहहीं ।
करम बचन मन भव कबि कहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
je pātak upapātak ahahīṃ
karam bacan man bhav kabi kahahīṃ

verses.sa:
ते पातक मोहि होहुँ बिधाता ।
जौं यहु होइ मोर मत माता ॥
verses.tr:
te pātak mohi hohum̐ bidhātā
jauṃ yahu hoi mor mat mātā

verses.sa:
जे परिहरि हरि हर चरन भजहिं भूतगन घोर ।
तेहि कइ गति मोहि देउ बिधि जौं जननी मत मोर ॥
verses.tr:
je parihari hari har caran bhajahiṃ bhūtagan ghor
tehi kai gati mohi deu bidhi jauṃ jananī mat mor
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Bharat, nay, both brothers, wept piteously. Kausalya clasped them to her bosom, and comforted Bharat in every way with words of excellent wisdom. With appropriate maxims from the Purdnas and Vedas all the queens reasoned ° with Bharat. And he, pure, guileless and sincere, made fitting answer thus with clasped hands: ‘The crime of slaying father, mother or guru; of burning cows in their stalls ora city of Brahman; the crime of murdering wife or child; of poisoning a friend or a king; every mortal or venial sin, of thought, word and deed, as enumerated by the seers; may all these sins be mine, O God, if this, mother, was a plot of mine.
May God award me the fate of those who forsake the. feet of Hari and Hara and worship abominable demons, if, mother, this was any plot of mine.

sections.label: Doha 168
sections.name: मातु भरत के बचन सुनि साँचे सरल सुभायँ

verses.sa:
बेचहिं बेदु धरमु दुहि लेहीं ।
पिसुन पराय पाप कहि देहीं ॥
verses.tr:
becahiṃ bedu dharamu duhi lehīṃ
pisun parāya pāp kahi dehīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कपटी कुटिल कलहप्रिय क्रोधी ।
बेद बिदूषक बिस्व बिरोधी ॥
verses.tr:
kapaṭī kuṭil kalahapriya krodhī
bed bidūṣak bisv birodhī

verses.sa:
लोभी लंपट लोलुपचारा ।
जे ताकहिं परधनु परदारा ॥
verses.tr:
lobhī laṃpaṭ lolupacārā
je tākahiṃ paradhanu paradārā

verses.sa:
पावौं मैं तिन्ह के गति घोरा ।
जौं जननी यहु संमत मोरा ॥
verses.tr:
pāvauṃ maiṃ tinh ke gati ghorā
jauṃ jananī yahu saṃmat morā

verses.sa:
जे नहिं साधुसंग अनुरागे ।
परमारथ पथ बिमुख अभागे ॥
verses.tr:
je nahiṃ sādhusaṃg anurāge
paramārath path bimukh abhāge

verses.sa:
जे न भजहिं हरि नरतनु पाई ।
जिन्हहि न हरि हर सुजसु सोहाई ॥
verses.tr:
je na bhajahiṃ hari naratanu pāī
jinhahi na hari har sujasu sohāī

verses.sa:
तजि श्रुतिपंथु बाम पथ चलहीं ।
बंचक बिरचि बेष जगु छलहीं ॥
verses.tr:
taji śrutipaṃthu bām path calahīṃ
baṃcak biraci beṣ jagu chalahīṃ

verses.sa:
तिन्ह कै गति मोहि संकर देऊ ।
जननी जौं यहु जानौं भेऊ ॥
verses.tr:
tinh kai gati mohi saṃkar deū
jananī jauṃ yahu jānauṃ bheū

verses.sa:
मातु भरत के बचन सुनि साँचे सरल सुभायँ ।
कहति राम प्रिय तात तुम्ह सदा बचन मन कायँ ॥
verses.tr:
mātu bharat ke bacan suni sām̐ce saral subhāyam̐
kahati rām priya tāt tumh sadā bacan man kāyam̐
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Those who sell the Veda and trade on piety; backbiters, who talk of others’ faults; the treacherous, the perverse, the litigious, the violent; the revilers of the Veda, the enemies of all creation; the covetous, the lecherous, the fickle, the boastful, who covet their neighbour’s wealth or their neighbour’s wife; may I come to a like ill end with them if, mother, his plot had my consent. The wretches who have no regard for the example of the good, who reject the way of salvation, who worship not the incarnation of Hari and take no delight in the glory of Hari and Hara, who abandon the path of Scripture and follow a contrary road, who by knavish disguise impose upon the world; may Sankara allot me a fate like theirs if, mother, I knew of this plot.

Hearken, mother; in all} my thoughts, word and deeds I um the slave of the All-merciful. The omniscient Rama dwells in my heart and discerns perfectly between true affection and feigned.” As he thus spoke, his eyes streamed with tears, his body quivered, and his toes drew lines upon the ground. Again his mother took and clasped him to her bosom, knowing him to be indeed a votary of Rama’s.
Hearing Bharat’s true and honest and generous words,

sections.label: Doha 169
sections.name: तात हृदयँ धीरजु धरहु करहु जो अवसर आजु

verses.sa:
राम प्रानहु तें प्रान तुम्हारे ।
तुम्ह रघुपतिहि प्रानहु तें प्यारे ॥
verses.tr:
rām prānahu teṃ prān tumhāre
tumh raghupatihi prānahu teṃ pyāre
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बिधु बिष चवै स्त्रवै हिमु आगी ।
होइ बारिचर बारि बिरागी ॥
verses.tr:
bidhu biṣ cavai stravai himu āgī
hoi bāricar bāri birāgī

verses.sa:
भएँ ग्यानु बरु मिटै न मोहू ।
तुम्ह रामहि प्रतिकूल न होहू ॥
verses.tr:
bhaem̐ gyānu baru miṭai na mohū
tumh rāmahi pratikūl na hohū

verses.sa:
मत तुम्हार यहु जो जग कहहीं ।
सो सपनेहुँ सुख सुगति न लहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
mat tumhār yahu jo jag kahahīṃ
so sapanehum̐ sukh sugati na lahahīṃ

verses.sa:
अस कहि मातु भरतु हियँ लाए ।
थन पय स्त्रवहिं नयन जल छाए ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi mātu bharatu hiyam̐ lāe
than paya stravahiṃ nayan jal chāe

verses.sa:
करत बिलाप बहुत यहि भाँती ।
बैठेहिं बीति गइ सब राती ॥
verses.tr:
karat bilāp bahut yahi bhām̐tī
baiṭhehiṃ bīti gai sab rātī

verses.sa:
बामदेउ बसिष्ठ तब आए ।
सचिव महाजन सकल बोलाए ॥
verses.tr:
bāmadeu basiṣṭh tab āe
saciv mahājan sakal bolāe

verses.sa:
मुनि बहु भाँति भरत उपदेसे ।
कहि परमारथ बचन सुदेसे ॥
verses.tr:
muni bahu bhām̐ti bharat upadese
kahi paramārath bacan sudese

verses.sa:
तात हृदयँ धीरजु धरहु करहु जो अवसर आजु ।
उठे भरत गुर बचन सुनि करन कहेउ सबु साजु ॥
verses.tr:
tāt hṛdayam̐ dhīraju dharahu karahu jo avasar āju
uṭhe bharat gur bacan suni karan kaheu sabu sāju
verses.head: दोहा

trans: his mother exclaimed: “Son, you have ever in thought, word and deed been Rama's friend. Chaupdi.

Rama is the very life of your life, and you are dearer than life to him. The moon may drop poison, ice distil fire, fish avoid water,a sage persist in folly; but you could never become Rama’s enemy. IE any one in the world says this was of your contriving, he shall never even in his sleep have any peace or happiness.” With these words his mother took Bharat to her arms while her breasts dropped milk and her eyes filled with tears. As they sat and made such long lamentation, the whole night was spent. Saints Vamadeva and Vasishtha came and summoned all the Minister and nobles and did everything to console Bharat by appropriate discourse on religious topics.
** Son, take heart and perform the duties of the day.” Bharat arose a3 the guru’s command and ordered everything to be done.

sections.label: Doha 170
sections.name: सिंघासन भूषन बसन अन्न धरनि धन धाम

verses.sa:
नृपतनु बेद बिदित अन्हवावा ।
परम बिचित्र बिमानु बनावा ॥
verses.tr:
nṛpatanu bed bidit anhavāvā
param bicitr bimānu banāvā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
गहि पद भरत मातु सब राखी ।
रहीं रानि दरसन अभिलाषी ॥
verses.tr:
gahi pad bharat mātu sab rākhī
rahīṃ rāni darasan abhilāṣī

verses.sa:
चंदन अगर भार बहु आए ।
अमित अनेक सुगंध सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
caṃdan agar bhār bahu āe
amit anek sugaṃdh suhāe

verses.sa:
सरजु तीर रचि चिता बनाई ।
जनु सुरपुर सोपान सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
saraju tīr raci citā banāī
janu surapur sopān suhāī

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि दाह क्रिया सब कीन्ही ।
बिधिवत न्हाइ तिलांजुलि दीन्ही ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi dāh kriyā sab kīnhī
bidhivat nhāi tilāṃjuli dīnhī

verses.sa:
सोधि सुमृति सब बेद पुराना ।
कीन्ह भरत दसगात बिधाना ॥
verses.tr:
sodhi sumṛti sab bed purānā
kīnh bharat dasagāt bidhānā

verses.sa:
जहँ जस मुनिबर आयसु दीन्हा ।
तहँ तस सहस भाँति सबु कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ jas munibar āyasu dīnhā
taham̐ tas sahas bhām̐ti sabu kīnhā

verses.sa:
भए बिसुद्ध दिए सब दाना ।
धेनु बाजि गज बाहन नाना ॥
verses.tr:
bhae bisuddh die sab dānā
dhenu bāji gaj bāhan nānā

verses.sa:
सिंघासन भूषन बसन अन्न धरनि धन धाम ।
दिए भरत लहि भूमिसुर भे परिपूरन काम ॥
verses.tr:
siṃghāsan bhūṣan basan ann dharani dhan dhām
