die bharat lahi bhūmisur bhe paripūran kām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: As directed in the Veda, he had the body of the king washed and a sumptuous funeral car prepared. Then clasping the feet of each of the queens he bid them stay. They stayed in the hope of seeing Rama. Many loads of sandalwood and aloes were brought and immense quantities of sweetscented spices. The pile was raised on the bank of the Sarja likea fair ladder reaching to heaven. Soall the rites of cremation were accomplished; the prescribed bathing, the oblation of sesamum seeds, the ceremony of the ten balls of rice, which Bharat performed after due study of the Vedas, the Purdnas and the Code or Ritual. Whatever order was given at any time by the great sage was thereupon executed accordingly a thousand times over. For his purification he gave abundant gifts; cows, horses, elephants, all
kinds of carriages. Dohe 164.
Thrones, jewels, robes, grain, lands, money, and houses did Bharat take and present to the Brahmans: their every wish was gratified.

sections.label: Doha 171
sections.name: सुनहु भरत भावी प्रबल बिलखि कहेउ मुनिनाथ

verses.sa:
पितु हित भरत कीन्हि जसि करनी ।
सो मुख लाख जाइ नहिं बरनी ॥
verses.tr:
pitu hit bharat kīnhi jasi karanī
so mukh lākh jāi nahiṃ baranī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुदिनु सोधि मुनिबर तब आए ।
सचिव महाजन सकल बोलाए ॥
verses.tr:
sudinu sodhi munibar tab āe
saciv mahājan sakal bolāe

verses.sa:
बैठे राजसभाँ सब जाई ।
पठए बोलि भरत दोउ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
baiṭhe rājasabhām̐ sab jāī
paṭhae boli bharat dou bhāī

verses.sa:
भरतु बसिष्ठ निकट बैठारे ।
नीति धरममय बचन उचारे ॥
verses.tr:
bharatu basiṣṭh nikaṭ baiṭhāre
nīti dharamamaya bacan ucāre

verses.sa:
प्रथम कथा सब मुनिबर बरनी ।
कैकइ कुटिल कीन्हि जसि करनी ॥
verses.tr:
pratham kathā sab munibar baranī
kaikai kuṭil kīnhi jasi karanī

verses.sa:
भूप धरमब्रतु सत्य सराहा ।
जेहिं तनु परिहरि प्रेमु निबाहा ॥
verses.tr:
bhūp dharamabratu satya sarāhā
jehiṃ tanu parihari premu nibāhā

verses.sa:
कहत राम गुन सील सुभाऊ ।
सजल नयन पुलकेउ मुनिराऊ ॥
verses.tr:
kahat rām gun sīl subhāū
sajal nayan pulakeu munirāū

verses.sa:
बहुरि लखन सिय प्रीति बखानी ।
सोक सनेह मगन मुनि ग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri lakhan siya prīti bakhānī
sok saneh magan muni gyānī

verses.sa:
सुनहु भरत भावी प्रबल बिलखि कहेउ मुनिनाथ ।
हानि लाभु जीवन मरनु जसु अपजसु बिधि हाथ ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu bharat bhāvī prabal bilakhi kaheu munināth
hāni lābhu jīvan maranu jasu apajasu bidhi hāth
verses.head: दोहा

trans: All the ceremonies that Bharat performed on his father’s account were more than a million tongues could tell. Then

came the great sages, after determining an auspicious day and summoned all the nobles and ministers, who went and sat down in the royal council chamber, where they sent and summoned Bharat and his brother. Vasishtha seated Bharat by his side addressed him in words full of wisdom and piety. Firstthe boly man repeated the whole history of Kaikeyi’s monstrous doing and extolled the king for his piety and faithfulness to his promise, who by his death had manifested his love. As he spoke of Rama‘s good qualities and amiable disposition the saint’s eyes filled with tears and his body quivered with emotion, As he went on to tell of the affection shown by Lakshman and Sita, the ascetic sage was drowned in love and grief.
‘Hearken, Bharat ”—thus sadly spoke the prince of sages—‘Fate is overstrong; loss and gain, life and death, honour and dishonour are in God's hands. Chaupdi.

sections.label: Doha 172
sections.name: सोचिअ गृही जो मोह बस करइ करम पथ त्याग

verses.sa:
अस बिचारि केहि देइअ दोसू ।
ब्यरथ काहि पर कीजिअ रोसू ॥
verses.tr:
as bicāri kehi deia dosū
byarath kāhi par kījia rosū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तात बिचारु केहि करहु मन माहीं ।
सोच जोगु दसरथु नृपु नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
tāt bicāru kehi karahu man māhīṃ
soc jogu dasarathu nṛpu nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सोचिअ बिप्र जो बेद बिहीना ।
तजि निज धरमु बिषय लयलीना ॥
verses.tr:
socia bipr jo bed bihīnā
taji nij dharamu biṣaya layalīnā

verses.sa:
सोचिअ नृपति जो नीति न जाना ।
जेहि न प्रजा प्रिय प्रान समाना ॥
verses.tr:
socia nṛpati jo nīti na jānā
jehi na prajā priya prān samānā

verses.sa:
सोचिअ बयसु कृपन धनवानू ।
जो न अतिथि सिव भगति सुजानू ॥
verses.tr:
socia bayasu kṛpan dhanavānū
jo na atithi siv bhagati sujānū

verses.sa:
सोचिअ सूद्रु बिप्र अवमानी ।
मुखर मानप्रिय ग्यान गुमानी ॥
verses.tr:
socia sūdru bipr avamānī
mukhar mānapriya gyān gumānī

verses.sa:
सोचिअ पुनि पति बंचक नारी ।
कुटिल कलहप्रिय इच्छाचारी ॥
verses.tr:
socia puni pati baṃcak nārī
kuṭil kalahapriya icchācārī

verses.sa:
सोचिअ बटु निज ब्रतु परिहरई ।
जो नहिं गुर आयसु अनुसरई ॥
verses.tr:
socia baṭu nij bratu pariharaī
jo nahiṃ gur āyasu anusaraī

verses.sa:
सोचिअ गृही जो मोह बस करइ करम पथ त्याग ।
सोचिअ जति प्रंपच रत बिगत बिबेक बिराग ॥
verses.tr:
socia gṛhī jo moh bas karai karam path tyāg
socia jati praṃpac rat bigat bibek birāg
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Having so considered, why blame any one, or why be angry with any without cause? Ponder this in your heart, my son; king Dasarath is not to be pitied. Pitiable the Brahman who is ignorant of the Veda and has abandoned his faith and become absorbed in the delights of sense; pitiable the king who knows not the principles of govern: ment and to whom his subjects are not as dear as his own life; pitiable the merchant, miserly and rich, who regards not the duties of hospitality nor the service of Mahadeva; pitiable the Sudra who insultsa Brahman, who is boastfal, ambitious and proud of his knowledge; pitiable again the wife who deceives her own husband, and who is perverse, quarrelsome and self-willed; pitiable the religious student who breaks his vows and obeys not the commands of his guru,
Pitiable the householder who, overcome by delusion, for-sakes the path of religion; pitiable the ascetic who is enamoured of the world and has lost his judgment and selfgovernance;

sections.label: Doha 173
sections.name: कहहु तात केहि भाँति कोउ करिहि बड़ाई तासु

verses.sa:
बैखानस सोइ सोचै जोगु ।
तपु बिहाइ जेहि भावइ भोगू ॥
verses.tr:
baikhānas soi socai jogu
tapu bihāi jehi bhāvai bhogū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सोचिअ पिसुन अकारन क्रोधी ।
जननि जनक गुर बंधु बिरोधी ॥
verses.tr:
socia pisun akāran krodhī
janani janak gur baṃdhu birodhī

verses.sa:
सब बिधि सोचिअ पर अपकारी ।
निज तनु पोषक निरदय भारी ॥
verses.tr:
sab bidhi socia par apakārī
nij tanu poṣak niradaya bhārī

verses.sa:
सोचनीय सबहि बिधि सोई ।
जो न छाड़ि छलु हरि जन होई ॥
verses.tr:
socanīya sabahi bidhi soī
jo na chār̤i chalu hari jan hoī

verses.sa:
सोचनीय नहिं कोसलराऊ ।
भुवन चारिदस प्रगट प्रभाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
socanīya nahiṃ kosalarāū
bhuvan cāridas pragaṭ prabhāū

verses.sa:
भयउ न अहइ न अब होनिहारा ।
भूप भरत जस पिता तुम्हारा ॥
verses.tr:
bhayau na ahai na ab honihārā
bhūp bharat jas pitā tumhārā

verses.sa:
बिधि हरि हरु सुरपति दिसिनाथा ।
बरनहिं सब दसरथ गुन गाथा ॥
verses.tr:
bidhi hari haru surapati disināthā
baranahiṃ sab dasarath gun gāthā

verses.sa:
कहहु तात केहि भाँति कोउ करिहि बड़ाई तासु ।
राम लखन तुम्ह सत्रुहन सरिस सुअन सुचि जासु ॥
verses.tr:
kahahu tāt kehi bhām̐ti kou karihi bar̤āī tāsu
rām lakhan tumh satruhan saris suan suci jāsu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Pitiable the anchorite who has given up penance and takes delight in pleasure; pitiable the backbiter and the angry without a cause, the enemies of their own parents, their spiritual guide and their kinsmen; pitiable in every way is the malevolent who cherishes self and is utterly merciless; pitiable in every way is he who does not eschew guile and become a follower of Hari; but the king of Kosala is not to be pitied; his glory is spread abroad through the fourteen spheres. Their neither has been, nor is now, nor shall be hereafter, aking like your father, Bharat. Brahma, Vishnu, Siva, Indra and all the Regents of the air sing the virtues of Dasarath.
Tell me, my son, in what way can any one magnify him, who has such noble sons as Rama, Lakshman, you and Satrughna?,

sections.label: Doha 174
sections.name: अनुचित उचित बिचारु तजि जे पालहिं पितु बैन

verses.sa:
सब प्रकार भूपति बड़भागी ।
बादि बिषादु करिअ तेहि लागी ॥
verses.tr:
sab prakār bhūpati bar̤abhāgī
bādi biṣādu karia tehi lāgī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
यहु सुनि समुझि सोचु परिहरहू ।
सिर धरि राज रजायसु करहू ॥
verses.tr:
yahu suni samujhi socu pariharahū
sir dhari rāj rajāyasu karahū

verses.sa:
राँय राजपदु तुम्ह कहुँ दीन्हा ।
पिता बचनु फुर चाहिअ कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
rām̐ya rājapadu tumh kahum̐ dīnhā
pitā bacanu phur cāhia kīnhā

verses.sa:
तजे रामु जेहिं बचनहि लागी ।
तनु परिहरेउ राम बिरहागी ॥
verses.tr:
taje rāmu jehiṃ bacanahi lāgī
tanu parihareu rām birahāgī

verses.sa:
नृपहि बचन प्रिय नहिं प्रिय प्राना ।
करहु तात पितु बचन प्रवाना ॥
verses.tr:
nṛpahi bacan priya nahiṃ priya prānā
karahu tāt pitu bacan pravānā

verses.sa:
करहु सीस धरि भूप रजाई ।
हइ तुम्ह कहँ सब भाँति भलाई ॥
verses.tr:
karahu sīs dhari bhūp rajāī
hai tumh kaham̐ sab bhām̐ti bhalāī

verses.sa:
परसुराम पितु अग्या राखी ।
मारी मातु लोक सब साखी ॥
verses.tr:
parasurām pitu agyā rākhī
mārī mātu lok sab sākhī

verses.sa:
तनय जजातिहि जौबनु दयऊ ।
पितु अग्याँ अघ अजसु न भयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
tanaya jajātihi jaubanu dayaū
pitu agyām̐ agh ajasu na bhayaū

verses.sa:
अनुचित उचित बिचारु तजि जे पालहिं पितु बैन ।
ते भाजन सुख सुजस के बसहिं अमरपति ऐन ॥
verses.tr:
anucit ucit bicāru taji je pālahiṃ pitu bain
te bhājan sukh sujas ke basahiṃ amarapati ain
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The king is altogether fortunate; it is vain to lament on his account. Thus hearing and considering, cease from grief; obediently submit to the royal commands. The king has given you the throne, and you must needs fulfil your father’s word. The monarch who for the sake of his word abandoned Rama, though in the anguish of separation from Rama he lost his life, and thus held his word dearer than life, is a father, my son, whose word must be obeyed. Bow your head to the royal command; it will bein every way for your good. Parasurdm, to obey his father’s order, slew his own mother, as all the world bears witness;and Yayati, son gave him up his youth!; in a father’s order there can be no sin nor disgrace.
They who cherish their father’s words, without discuss ing right or wrong, they are vessels of honour and glory and dwell in the palace of the king of heaven.

sections.label: Doha 175
sections.name: कीजिअ गुर आयसु अवसि कहहिं सचिव कर जोरि

verses.sa:
अवसि नरेस बचन फुर करहू ।
पालहु प्रजा सोकु परिहरहू ॥
verses.tr:
avasi nares bacan phur karahū
pālahu prajā soku pariharahū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुरपुर नृप पाइहि परितोषू ।
तुम्ह कहुँ सुकृत सुजसु नहिं दोषू ॥
verses.tr:
surapur nṛp pāihi paritoṣū
tumh kahum̐ sukṛt sujasu nahiṃ doṣū

verses.sa:
बेद बिदित संमत सबही का ।
जेहि पितु देइ सो पावइ टीका ॥
verses.tr:
bed bidit saṃmat sabahī kā
jehi pitu dei so pāvai ṭīkā

verses.sa:
करहु राजु परिहरहु गलानी ।
मानहु मोर बचन हित जानी ॥
verses.tr:
karahu rāju pariharahu galānī
mānahu mor bacan hit jānī

verses.sa:
सुनि सुखु लहब राम बैदेहीं ।
अनुचित कहब न पंडित केहीं ॥
verses.tr:
suni sukhu lahab rām baidehīṃ
anucit kahab na paṃḍit kehīṃ

verses.sa:
कौसल्यादि सकल महतारीं ।
तेउ प्रजा सुख होहिं सुखारीं ॥
verses.tr:
kausalyādi sakal mahatārīṃ
teu prajā sukh hohiṃ sukhārīṃ

verses.sa:
परम तुम्हार राम कर जानिहि ।
सो सब बिधि तुम्ह सन भल मानिहि ॥
verses.tr:
param tumhār rām kar jānihi
so sab bidhi tumh san bhal mānihi

verses.sa:
सौंपेहु राजु राम कै आएँ ।
सेवा करेहु सनेह सुहाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
sauṃpehu rāju rām kai āem̐
sevā karehu saneh suhāem̐

verses.sa:
कीजिअ गुर आयसु अवसि कहहिं सचिव कर जोरि ।
रघुपति आएँ उचित जस तस तब करब बहोरि ॥
verses.tr:
kījia gur āyasu avasi kahahiṃ saciv kar jori
raghupati āem̐ ucit jas tas tab karab bahori
verses.head: दोहा

trans: You must certainly make good the king’s word; cherish your subjects and cease to grieve. He will receive comfort in heaven; for you it will be a merit and honour, and no fault. It is laid down in the Veda, and approved by all men, that he takes the crown to whom the father gives it. Reign then, nor further distress yourself, but accept my -advice as the best for you. Rama and Sita will rejoice when they hear of it and no wise man will call it wrong. Kausalya and all the queens will be happy in the happiness of the people. Rama knows your secret thoughts and will take it quite in good part; on his return you can deliver up the throne and serve him with cheerful affection.”
The ministers with clasped hands exclaimed: ‘You must needs obey your guru's command: when Raghupati returns, you can then do as shall seem yood.”

sections.label: Doha 176
sections.name: भरतु कमल कर जोरि धीर धुरंधर धीर धरि

verses.sa:
कौसल्या धरि धीरजु कहई ।
पूत पथ्य गुर आयसु अहई ॥
verses.tr:
kausalyā dhari dhīraju kahaī
pūt pathya gur āyasu ahaī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सो आदरिअ करिअ हित मानी ।
तजिअ बिषादु काल गति जानी ॥
verses.tr:
so ādaria karia hit mānī
tajia biṣādu kāl gati jānī

verses.sa:
बन रघुपति सुरपति नरनाहू ।
तुम्ह एहि भाँति तात कदराहू ॥
verses.tr:
ban raghupati surapati naranāhū
tumh ehi bhām̐ti tāt kadarāhū

verses.sa:
परिजन प्रजा सचिव सब अंबा ।
तुम्हही सुत सब कहँ अवलंबा ॥
verses.tr:
parijan prajā saciv sab aṃbā
tumhahī sut sab kaham̐ avalaṃbā

verses.sa:
लखि बिधि बाम कालु कठिनाई ।
धीरजु धरहु मातु बलि जाई ॥
verses.tr:
lakhi bidhi bām kālu kaṭhināī
dhīraju dharahu mātu bali jāī

verses.sa:
सिर धरि गुर आयसु अनुसरहू ।
प्रजा पालि परिजन दुखु हरहू ॥
verses.tr:
sir dhari gur āyasu anusarahū
prajā pāli parijan dukhu harahū

verses.sa:
गुर के बचन सचिव अभिनंदनु ।
सुने भरत हिय हित जनु चंदनु ॥
verses.tr:
gur ke bacan saciv abhinaṃdanu
sune bharat hiya hit janu caṃdanu

verses.sa:
सुनी बहोरि मातु मृदु बानी ।
सील सनेह सरल रस सानी ॥
verses.tr:
sunī bahori mātu mṛdu bānī
sīl saneh saral ras sānī

verses.sa:
सानी सरल रस मातु बानी सुनि भरत ब्याकुल भए ।
लोचन सरोरुह स्त्रवत सींचत बिरह उर अंकुर नए ॥
verses.tr:
sānī saral ras mātu bānī suni bharat byākul bhae
locan saroruh stravat sīṃcat birah ur aṃkur nae
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
सो दसा देखत समय तेहि बिसरी सबहि सुधि देह की ।
तुलसी सराहत सकल सादर सीवँ सहज सनेह की ॥
verses.tr:
so dasā dekhat samaya tehi bisarī sabahi sudhi deh kī
tulasī sarāhat sakal sādar sīvam̐ sahaj saneh kī

verses.sa:
भरतु कमल कर जोरि धीर धुरंधर धीर धरि ।
बचन अमिअँ जनु बोरि देत उचित उत्तर सबहि ॥
verses.tr:
bharatu kamal kar jori dhīr dhuraṃdhar dhīr dhari
bacan amiam̐ janu bori det ucit uttar sabahi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Kausalya took courage and cried: “‘ My son, you have your father’s and your guru’s commands, which you must respect.and affectionately carry out. Cease to lament, knowing it to be the will of Fate that R^ma is in banishment, the king in heaven, and you in such perplexity. You, my son,” continued his mother, ‘are the sole refuge of your family, your people and the ministers of state. Seeing God against us and the fates untoward, summon up resolution. I, your mother, adjure you, obediently comply with your guru's command; cherish your people, relieve the affliction of your family.’ The guru’s speech and the ministers’ approval had been as grateful to Bharat’s hearing as sandal perfumes, but when he heard his mother’s tender appeal fraught with the pathos of sincere affection—

When he heard his mother’s pathetic appeal, Bharat was overcome; his lotus eyes rained with tears that bedewed the fresh shoots of desolation in hissoul, All who then beheld his condition entirely forgot about themselves ves—ah, Tulsi!— and reverently extolled him as the very perfection of true love.
Clasping his lotus hands, Bharat, the champion of honour, stoutly made answer to them all in noble words that seemed as if dipped in nectar.

sections.label: Doha 177
sections.name: पितु सुरपुर सिय रामु बन करन कहहु मोहि राजु

verses.sa:
मोहि उपदेसु दीन्ह गुर नीका ।
प्रजा सचिव संमत सबही का ॥
verses.tr:
mohi upadesu dīnh gur nīkā
prajā saciv saṃmat sabahī kā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मातु उचित धरि आयसु दीन्हा ।
अवसि सीस धरि चाहउँ कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
mātu ucit dhari āyasu dīnhā
avasi sīs dhari cāhaum̐ kīnhā

verses.sa:
गुर पितु मातु स्वामि हित बानी ।
सुनि मन मुदित करिअ भलि जानी ॥
verses.tr:
gur pitu mātu svāmi hit bānī
suni man mudit karia bhali jānī

verses.sa:
उचित कि अनुचित किएँ बिचारू ।
धरमु जाइ सिर पातक भारू ॥
verses.tr:
ucit ki anucit kiem̐ bicārū
dharamu jāi sir pātak bhārū

verses.sa:
तुम्ह तौ देहु सरल सिख सोई ।
जो आचरत मोर भल होई ॥
verses.tr:
tumh tau dehu saral sikh soī
jo ācarat mor bhal hoī

verses.sa:
जद्यपि यह समुझत हउँ नीकें ।
तदपि होत परितोषु न जी कें ॥
verses.tr:
jadyapi yah samujhat haum̐ nīkeṃ
tadapi hot paritoṣu na jī keṃ

verses.sa:
अब तुम्ह बिनय मोरि सुनि लेहू ।
मोहि अनुहरत सिखावनु देहू ॥
verses.tr:
ab tumh binaya mori suni lehū
mohi anuharat sikhāvanu dehū

verses.sa:
ऊतरु देउँ छमब अपराधू ।
दुखित दोष गुन गनहिं न साधू ॥
verses.tr:
ūtaru deum̐ chamab aparādhū
dukhit doṣ gun ganahiṃ na sādhū

verses.sa:
पितु सुरपुर सिय रामु बन करन कहहु मोहि राजु ।
एहि तें जानहु मोर हित कै आपन बड़ काजु ॥
verses.tr:
pitu surapur siya rāmu ban karan kahahu mohi rāju
ehi teṃ jānahu mor hit kai āpan bar̤ kāju
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “The guru has given me good advice, which has been _approved by ministers, people, and all. My mother, too, has given me proper commands, and I must needs bow and obey. The injunctions of a guru, a father or mother, or master. or friend, should be cheerfully performed as soon as heard, and as all for the best; to deliberate whether they are right or wrong is a failure of duty and involves grievous sin. You have now given me honest advice, which it will be good: for me to follow; yet, though [ understand this clearly, my soul is still discontent. Hearken them to my prayer, and according to my circumstances so instruct me, forgiving my presumption in answering you: when a man is in distress yood people do not reckon up his merits and demerits.
My father is in heaven, and Sita and Rama in exile, and you tell to be king; is it my gain or your own advantage that you expect to result from this -

sections.label: Doha 178
sections.name: कैकेई सुअ कुटिलमति राम बिमुख गतलाज

verses.sa:
हित हमार सियपति सेवकाई ।
सो हरि लीन्ह मातु कुटिलाई ॥
verses.tr:
hit hamār siyapati sevakāī
so hari līnh mātu kuṭilāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मैं अनुमानि दीख मन माहीं ।
आन उपायँ मोर हित नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ anumāni dīkh man māhīṃ
ān upāyam̐ mor hit nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सोक समाजु राजु केहि लेखें ।
लखन राम सिय बिनु पद देखें ॥
verses.tr:
sok samāju rāju kehi lekheṃ
lakhan rām siya binu pad dekheṃ

verses.sa:
बादि बसन बिनु भूषन भारू ।
बादि बिरति बिनु ब्रह्म बिचारू ॥
verses.tr:
bādi basan binu bhūṣan bhārū
bādi birati binu brahm bicārū

verses.sa:
सरुज सरीर बादि बहु भोगा ।
बिनु हरिभगति जायँ जप जोगा ॥
verses.tr:
saruj sarīr bādi bahu bhogā
binu haribhagati jāyam̐ jap jogā

verses.sa:
जायँ जीव बिनु देह सुहाई ।
बादि मोर सबु बिनु रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
jāyam̐ jīv binu deh suhāī
bādi mor sabu binu raghurāī

verses.sa:
जाउँ राम पहिं आयसु देहू ।
एकहिं आँक मोर हित एहू ॥
verses.tr:
jāum̐ rām pahiṃ āyasu dehū
ekahiṃ ām̐k mor hit ehū

verses.sa:
मोहि नृप करि भल आपन चहहू ।
सोउ सनेह जड़ता बस कहहू ॥
verses.tr:
mohi nṛp kari bhal āpan cahahū
sou saneh jar̤atā bas kahahū

verses.sa:
कैकेई सुअ कुटिलमति राम बिमुख गतलाज ।
तुम्ह चाहत सुखु मोहबस मोहि से अधम कें राज ॥
verses.tr:
kaikeī sua kuṭilamati rām bimukh gatalāj
tumh cāhat sukhu mohabas mohi se adham keṃ rāj
verses.head: दोहा

trans: My gain is to serve Sita’s lord, and of this I have been robbed by my mother’s wickedness. After reflecting and searching my thoughts I find no other way of happiness than this. Of what account is a throne with all its cares, if I cannot see the feet of Lakshman, Rama and Sita Without clothes a mass of jewels is of no use; of no use is asceticism without divine meditation; of no use is any enjoyment to a diseased body; prayer and penance go for nought without faith io Hari; without life, beauty of body is nought; and all is nought to me without Rama. Permit me to join Rama; this is one word is my only happiness. If again in making me king it is your own advantage that you desire, you speak under the influence of foolish affection..
In your infatuation you hope for happiness from the reign of such a wretch as I, Kaikeyi's son, of wicked nature, Rama’s enemy, and lost to shame.

sections.label: Doha 179
sections.name: कारन तें कारजु कठिन होइ दोसु नहि मोर

verses.sa:
कहउँ साँचु सब सुनि पतिआहू ।
चाहिअ धरमसील नरनाहू ॥
verses.tr:
kahaum̐ sām̐cu sab suni patiāhū
cāhia dharamasīl naranāhū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मोहि राजु हठि देइहहु जबहीं ।
रसा रसातल जाइहि तबहीं ॥
verses.tr:
mohi rāju haṭhi deihahu jabahīṃ
rasā rasātal jāihi tabahīṃ

verses.sa:
मोहि समान को पाप निवासू ।
जेहि लगि सीय राम बनबासू ॥
verses.tr:
mohi samān ko pāp nivāsū
jehi lagi sīya rām banabāsū

verses.sa:
रायँ राम कहुँ काननु दीन्हा ।
बिछुरत गमनु अमरपुर कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
rāyam̐ rām kahum̐ kānanu dīnhā
bichurat gamanu amarapur kīnhā

verses.sa:
मैं सठु सब अनरथ कर हेतू ।
बैठ बात सब सुनउँ सचेतू ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ saṭhu sab anarath kar hetū
baiṭh bāt sab sunaum̐ sacetū

verses.sa:
बिनु रघुबीर बिलोकि अबासू ।
रहे प्रान सहि जग उपहासू ॥
verses.tr:
binu raghubīr biloki abāsū
rahe prān sahi jag upahāsū

verses.sa:
राम पुनीत बिषय रस रूखे ।
लोलुप भूमि भोग के भूखे ॥
verses.tr:
rām punīt biṣaya ras rūkhe
lolup bhūmi bhog ke bhūkhe

verses.sa:
कहँ लगि कहौं हृदय कठिनाई ।
निदरि कुलिसु जेहिं लही बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
kaham̐ lagi kahauṃ hṛdaya kaṭhināī
nidari kulisu jehiṃ lahī bar̤āī

verses.sa:
कारन तें कारजु कठिन होइ दोसु नहि मोर ।
कुलिस अस्थि तें उपल तें लोह कराल कठोर ॥
verses.tr:
kāran teṃ kāraju kaṭhin hoi dosu nahi mor
kulis asthi teṃ upal teṃ loh karāl kaṭhor
verses.head: दोहा

trans: I speak the truth; hearken all and believe; in a king is required a righteous disposition. If you persist in giving the crown to me, earth will sink into hell. What guilty wretch is equal to me, for whom Sita and Rama have been exiled? The king banished Rama, but died in losing him. I, the miserable cause of all this wrongdoing, sit and listen to it all unmoved. I see the palace with no Rama there, yet live to endure the world’s jeers. Holy Rama eschews all pleasures of sense, and I, a greedy king, am hungering after enjoyment. In what words can I tell the hardness of my heart, which surpasses even adamant?
That every result is harder than its cause is no fault of mine; the thunderbolt is harder than bonel, and iron more stiff and unbending than the rock from which it is quarried.

sections.label: Doha 180
sections.name: ग्रह ग्रहीत पुनि बात बस तेहि पुनि बीछी मार

verses.sa:
कैकेई भव तनु अनुरागे ।
पाँवर प्रान अघाइ अभागे ॥
verses.tr:
kaikeī bhav tanu anurāge
pām̐var prān aghāi abhāge
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जौं प्रिय बिरहँ प्रान प्रिय लागे ।
देखब सुनब बहुत अब आगे ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ priya biraham̐ prān priya lāge
dekhab sunab bahut ab āge

verses.sa:
लखन राम सिय कहुँ बनु दीन्हा ।
पठइ अमरपुर पति हित कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
lakhan rām siya kahum̐ banu dīnhā
paṭhai amarapur pati hit kīnhā

verses.sa:
लीन्ह बिधवपन अपजसु आपू ।
दीन्हेउ प्रजहि सोकु संतापू ॥
verses.tr:
līnh bidhavapan apajasu āpū
dīnheu prajahi soku saṃtāpū

verses.sa:
मोहि दीन्ह सुखु सुजसु सुराजू ।
कीन्ह कैकेईं सब कर काजू ॥
verses.tr:
mohi dīnh sukhu sujasu surājū
kīnh kaikeīṃ sab kar kājū

verses.sa:
एहि तें मोर काह अब नीका ।
तेहि पर देन कहहु तुम्ह टीका ॥
verses.tr:
ehi teṃ mor kāh ab nīkā
tehi par den kahahu tumh ṭīkā

verses.sa:
कैकई जठर जनमि जग माहीं ।
यह मोहि कहँ कछु अनुचित नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kaikaī jaṭhar janami jag māhīṃ
yah mohi kaham̐ kachu anucit nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
मोरि बात सब बिधिहिं बनाई ।
प्रजा पाँच कत करहु सहाई ॥
verses.tr:
mori bāt sab bidhihiṃ banāī
prajā pām̐c kat karahu sahāī

verses.sa:
ग्रह ग्रहीत पुनि बात बस तेहि पुनि बीछी मार ।
तेहि पिआइअ बारुनी कहहु काह उपचार ॥
verses.tr:
grah grahīt puni bāt bas tehi puni bīchī mār
tehi piāia bārunī kahahu kāh upacār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: If my worthless life can cling to a body born or Kaikeyi it will have a surfeit of misery: if, bereaved of my beloved, life is still dear to me, I shall have much hereafter to see and hear. Kaikeyi has banished Lakshman, Rama and Sita and for her own advantage hascaused the death of the king; sbe has*aken upon herself widowhood and disgrace and has caused the people sorrow and affliction, has allotted me glory and honour and dominion and has settled everybody's business. What good is this now to me? and yet you too cry out to make me a king. I have been born into the world from Kaikeyi's womb, and all this is only my due; God has fashioned all my destiny; but why should my people combine to give a helping hand?
Stricken as I am by fate, overcome by organio disease, and then stung by a scorpion, you giveme wine to drink: tell me, tell me what kind of treatment is this?

sections.label: Doha 181
sections.name: राम मातु सुठि सरलचित मो पर प्रेमु बिसेषि

verses.sa:
कैकइ सुअन जोगु जग जोई ।
चतुर बिरंचि दीन्ह मोहि सोई ॥
verses.tr:
kaikai suan jogu jag joī
catur biraṃci dīnh mohi soī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
दसरथ तनय राम लघु भाई ।
दीन्हि मोहि बिधि बादि बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
dasarath tanaya rām laghu bhāī
dīnhi mohi bidhi bādi bar̤āī

verses.sa:
तुम्ह सब कहहु कढ़ावन टीका ।
राय रजायसु सब कहँ नीका ॥
verses.tr:
tumh sab kahahu kar̤hāvan ṭīkā
rāya rajāyasu sab kaham̐ nīkā

verses.sa:
उतरु देउँ केहि बिधि केहि केही ।
कहहु सुखेन जथा रुचि जेही ॥
verses.tr:
utaru deum̐ kehi bidhi kehi kehī
kahahu sukhen jathā ruci jehī

verses.sa:
मोहि कुमातु समेत बिहाई ।
कहहु कहिहि के कीन्ह भलाई ॥
verses.tr:
mohi kumātu samet bihāī
kahahu kahihi ke kīnh bhalāī

verses.sa:
मो बिनु को सचराचर माहीं ।
जेहि सिय रामु प्रानप्रिय नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
mo binu ko sacarācar māhīṃ
jehi siya rāmu prānapriya nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
परम हानि सब कहँ बड़ लाहू ।
अदिनु मोर नहि दूषन काहू ॥
verses.tr:
param hāni sab kaham̐ bar̤ lāhū
adinu mor nahi dūṣan kāhū

verses.sa:
संसय सील प्रेम बस अहहू ।
सबुइ उचित सब जो कछु कहहू ॥
verses.tr:
saṃsaya sīl prem bas ahahū
sabui ucit sab jo kachu kahahū

verses.sa:
राम मातु सुठि सरलचित मो पर प्रेमु बिसेषि ।
कहइ सुभाय सनेह बस मोरि दीनता देखि ॥
verses.tr:
rām mātu suṭhi saralacit mo par premu biseṣi
kahai subhāya saneh bas mori dīnatā dekhi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The wise Creator has ordained for me everything that befits a son of Kaikeyi. That Iam also Dasarath's son and Rama's younger brother is an honour which God has bestowed upon me to no purpose. You all tell me to allow myself to be crowned for kingly power is desired by all men, How and whom shall I answer You talk at random as the fancy takes you. Apart from myself and my unhappy mother, tell me who will say that I have acted rightly ¢ excepting myself, who else is there in the whole animate or inanimate creation that does not love Sita and Rama as their own life? That a universal calamity should be my great gain, this-is my ilifortune and no blame to any one. You are moved by anxiety, kindness and affection, and anything you say is all for the best.;
Rama’s mother is so utterly guileless and bears me such great love that she speaks from natural amiability, on seeing my remorse.

sections.label: Doha 182
sections.name: आपनि दारुन दीनता कहउँ सबहि सिरु नाइ

verses.sa:
गुर बिबेक सागर जगु जाना ।
जिन्हहि बिस्व कर बदर समाना ॥
verses.tr:
gur bibek sāgar jagu jānā
jinhahi bisv kar badar samānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मो कहँ तिलक साज सज सोऊ ।
भएँ बिधि बिमुख बिमुख सबु कोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
mo kaham̐ tilak sāj saj soū
bhaem̐ bidhi bimukh bimukh sabu koū

verses.sa:
परिहरि रामु सीय जग माहीं ।
कोउ न कहिहि मोर मत नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
parihari rāmu sīya jag māhīṃ
kou na kahihi mor mat nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सो मैं सुनब सहब सुखु मानी ।
अंतहुँ कीच तहाँ जहँ पानी ॥
verses.tr:
so maiṃ sunab sahab sukhu mānī
aṃtahum̐ kīc tahām̐ jaham̐ pānī

verses.sa:
डरु न मोहि जग कहिहि कि पोचू ।
परलोकहु कर नाहिन सोचू ॥
verses.tr:
ḍaru na mohi jag kahihi ki pocū
paralokahu kar nāhin socū

verses.sa:
एकइ उर बस दुसह दवारी ।
मोहि लगि भे सिय रामु दुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
ekai ur bas dusah davārī
mohi lagi bhe siya rāmu dukhārī

verses.sa:
जीवन लाहु लखन भल पावा ।
सबु तजि राम चरन मनु लावा ॥
verses.tr:
jīvan lāhu lakhan bhal pāvā
sabu taji rām caran manu lāvā

verses.sa:
मोर जनम रघुबर बन लागी ।
झूठ काह पछिताउँ अभागी ॥
verses.tr:
mor janam raghubar ban lāgī
jhūṭh kāh pachitāum̐ abhāgī

verses.sa:
आपनि दारुन दीनता कहउँ सबहि सिरु नाइ ।
देखें बिनु रघुनाथ पद जिय कै जरनि न जाइ ॥
verses.tr:
āpani dārun dīnatā kahaum̐ sabahi siru nāi
dekheṃ binu raghunāth pad jiya kai jarani na jāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The guru, as all the world knows, is an ocean of ‘wisdom, and the universe is like a plum io the palm of his hand. He too is making ready for my coronation: when God is against me, every one is against me. Except Rama and Sita there is not any one in the whole world who will not say this was a scheme of mine, and I must listen and bear it patiently: wherever there is water, there at last will be mud. I am not afraid of the world calling me vile; [ have no thought for heaven: the one great intolerable anguish of soul is this, that through me Sita and Rama have been rendered unhappy. Well has Lakshman reaped his life’s reward who left all and clave to Rama; while my birth has been the cause of Kama’sbanishment. Wretch that 1 am, why thus lament in vain.
I declare before you all my grievous distress; unless I see Rama’s feet, the fire in my soul cannot be quenched.

sections.label: Doha 183
sections.name: जद्यपि जनमु कुमातु तें मैं सठु सदा सदोस

verses.sa:
आन उपाउ मोहि नहि सूझा ।
को जिय कै रघुबर बिनु बूझा ॥
verses.tr:
ān upāu mohi nahi sūjhā
ko jiya kai raghubar binu būjhā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
एकहिं आँक इहइ मन माहीं ।
प्रातकाल चलिहउँ प्रभु पाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ekahiṃ ām̐k ihai man māhīṃ
prātakāl calihaum̐ prabhu pāhīṃ

verses.sa:
जद्यपि मैं अनभल अपराधी ।
भै मोहि कारन सकल उपाधी ॥
verses.tr:
jadyapi maiṃ anabhal aparādhī
bhai mohi kāran sakal upādhī

verses.sa:
तदपि सरन सनमुख मोहि देखी ।
छमि सब करिहहिं कृपा बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
tadapi saran sanamukh mohi dekhī
chami sab karihahiṃ kṛpā biseṣī

verses.sa:
सील सकुच सुठि सरल सुभाऊ ।
कृपा सनेह सदन रघुराऊ ॥
verses.tr:
sīl sakuc suṭhi saral subhāū
kṛpā saneh sadan raghurāū

verses.sa:
अरिहुक अनभल कीन्ह न रामा ।
मैं सिसु सेवक जद्यपि बामा ॥
verses.tr:
arihuk anabhal kīnh na rāmā
maiṃ sisu sevak jadyapi bāmā

verses.sa:
तुम्ह पै पाँच मोर भल मानी ।
आयसु आसिष देहु सुबानी ॥
verses.tr:
tumh pai pām̐c mor bhal mānī
āyasu āsiṣ dehu subānī

verses.sa:
जेहिं सुनि बिनय मोहि जनु जानी ।
आवहिं बहुरि रामु रजधानी ॥
verses.tr:
jehiṃ suni binaya mohi janu jānī
āvahiṃ bahuri rāmu rajadhānī

verses.sa:
जद्यपि जनमु कुमातु तें मैं सठु सदा सदोस ।
आपन जानि न त्यागिहहिं मोहि रघुबीर भरोस ॥
verses.tr:
jadyapi janamu kumātu teṃ maiṃ saṭhu sadā sados
āpan jāni na tyāgihahiṃ mohi raghubīr bharos
verses.head: दोहा

trans: No other remedy can I discover: without Raghubar what care I for life? This wish alone is stamped upon my soul; at daybreak let me follow my lord. Although I am a guilty wretch, and all his trouble is on my account, still when he sees my suppliant mien he will in his great mercy forgive meall. Raghurdi is so meek and utterly guileless of disposition, such a home of mercy and tenderness, that he would never injure even an enemy: while I, bad as I am, am his son and hisservant. Be pleased, sirs, then to give me your blessing and permit me to depart, knowing it to be for my good; so Rama will come again to his kingdom, after hearing my prayers and considering my devotion,
Though born of a wicked mother, and myself evil and ever doing wrong, still 1 am confident of Raghubir that he will know me for his own, and not abandon me.”

sections.label: Doha 184
sections.name: अवसि चलिअ बन रामु जहँ भरत मंत्रु भल कीन्ह

verses.sa:
भरत बचन सब कहँ प्रिय लागे ।
राम सनेह सुधाँ जनु पागे ॥
verses.tr:
bharat bacan sab kaham̐ priya lāge
rām saneh sudhām̐ janu pāge
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
लोग बियोग बिषम बिष दागे ।
मंत्र सबीज सुनत जनु जागे ॥
verses.tr:
log biyog biṣam biṣ dāge
maṃtr sabīj sunat janu jāge

verses.sa:
मातु सचिव गुर पुर नर नारी ।
सकल सनेहँ बिकल भए भारी ॥
verses.tr:
mātu saciv gur pur nar nārī
sakal saneham̐ bikal bhae bhārī

verses.sa:
भरतहि कहहि सराहि सराही ।
राम प्रेम मूरति तनु आही ॥
verses.tr:
bharatahi kahahi sarāhi sarāhī
rām prem mūrati tanu āhī

verses.sa:
तात भरत अस काहे न कहहू ।
प्रान समान राम प्रिय अहहू ॥
verses.tr:
tāt bharat as kāhe na kahahū
prān samān rām priya ahahū

verses.sa:
जो पावँरु अपनी जड़ताई ।
तुम्हहि सुगाइ मातु कुटिलाई ॥
verses.tr:
jo pāvam̐ru apanī jar̤atāī
tumhahi sugāi mātu kuṭilāī

verses.sa:
सो सठु कोटिक पुरुष समेता ।
बसिहि कलप सत नरक निकेता ॥
verses.tr:
so saṭhu koṭik puruṣ sametā
basihi kalap sat narak niketā

verses.sa:
अहि अघ अवगुन नहि मनि गहई ।
हरइ गरल दुख दारिद दहई ॥
verses.tr:
ahi agh avagun nahi mani gahaī
harai garal dukh dārid dahaī

verses.sa:
अवसि चलिअ बन रामु जहँ भरत मंत्रु भल कीन्ह ।
सोक सिंधु बूड़त सबहि तुम्ह अवलंबनु दीन्ह ॥
verses.tr:
avasi calia ban rāmu jaham̐ bharat maṃtru bhal kīnh
sok siṃdhu būr̤at sabahi tumh avalaṃbanu dīnh
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Bharat’s words pleased all, imbued as they were with the nectar of piety. The people suffering from the baneful poison of separation revived as if at the sound of a healing charm. The queen-mothers, the ministers, the guru and all the men and women in the city were agitated by the vehemence of their affection and kept on telling Bharat’s praises: ‘His body is the very personification of devotion to Rama; ah, my lord Bharat, how can we say otherwise, seeing that Rama is as precious to you as your life? If any churl in his folly ascribe to you your mother’s sin, the wretch, withall who are his from generation to generation, shall have their abode in hell for hundreds of ages. The jewel is not infected with the guilt and villany of the serpent (in whose head it is found), butis an antidote to poison and subdues pain and poverty.
By all means let us follow Rama to the wood; Bharat has given good advice; sinking as we all were in an ocean of despair, you have held out help to as.’

sections.label: Doha 185
sections.name: जरउ सो संपति सदन सुखु सुहद मातु पितु भाइ

verses.sa:
भा सब कें मन मोदु न थोरा ।
जनु घन धुनि सुनि चातक मोरा ॥
verses.tr:
bhā sab keṃ man modu na thorā
janu ghan dhuni suni cātak morā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
चलत प्रात लखि निरनउ नीके ।
भरतु प्रानप्रिय भे सबही के ॥
verses.tr:
calat prāt lakhi niranau nīke
bharatu prānapriya bhe sabahī ke

verses.sa:
मुनिहि बंदि भरतहि सिरु नाई ।
चले सकल घर बिदा कराई ॥
verses.tr:
munihi baṃdi bharatahi siru nāī
cale sakal ghar bidā karāī

verses.sa:
धन्य भरत जीवनु जग माहीं ।
सीलु सनेहु सराहत जाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
dhanya bharat jīvanu jag māhīṃ
sīlu sanehu sarāhat jāhīṃ

verses.sa:
कहहि परसपर भा बड़ काजू ।
सकल चलै कर साजहिं साजू ॥
verses.tr:
kahahi parasapar bhā bar̤ kājū
sakal calai kar sājahiṃ sājū

verses.sa:
जेहि राखहिं रहु घर रखवारी ।
सो जानइ जनु गरदनि मारी ॥
verses.tr:
jehi rākhahiṃ rahu ghar rakhavārī
so jānai janu garadani mārī

verses.sa:
कोउ कह रहन कहिअ नहिं काहू ।
को न चहइ जग जीवन लाहू ॥
verses.tr:
kou kah rahan kahia nahiṃ kāhū
ko na cahai jag jīvan lāhū

verses.sa:
जरउ सो संपति सदन सुखु सुहद मातु पितु भाइ ।
सनमुख होत जो राम पद करै न सहस सहाइ ॥
verses.tr:
jarau so saṃpati sadan sukhu suhad mātu pitu bhāi
sanamukh hot jo rām pad karai na sahas sahāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: There was as great joy in the hearts of all as when the chdtak and peacock hear the sound of thunder. To start to-morrow seemed an excellent resolution; Bharat; was to every one dear as his own life. After reverencing the sage and bowing the head to Bharat, they all took leave and went to their several homes, praising as they went his affectionate disposition, whose life was a blessing to the whole world. Exclaiming to one another, ‘what a glorious idea!’ they all went to make their preparations. Whoever was left with orders to keep watch at home felt it like his death-stroke, and one would cry: ‘No one ought to be told to stay: who does not desire life’s best reward?
Perish property, house, fortune, friends, parents, kinsmen and all, that does not help to bring one to Rema.”

sections.label: Doha 186
sections.name: आरत जननी जानि सब भरत सनेह सुजान

verses.sa:
घर घर साजहिं बाहन नाना ।
हरषु हृदयँ परभात पयाना ॥
verses.tr:
ghar ghar sājahiṃ bāhan nānā
haraṣu hṛdayam̐ parabhāt payānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भरत जाइ घर कीन्ह बिचारू ।
नगरु बाजि गज भवन भँडारू ॥
verses.tr:
bharat jāi ghar kīnh bicārū
nagaru bāji gaj bhavan bham̐ḍārū

verses.sa:
संपति सब रघुपति कै आही ।
जौ बिनु जतन चलौं तजि ताही ॥
verses.tr:
saṃpati sab raghupati kai āhī
jau binu jatan calauṃ taji tāhī

verses.sa:
तौ परिनाम न मोरि भलाई ।
पाप सिरोमनि साइँ दोहाई ॥
verses.tr:
tau parinām na mori bhalāī
pāp siromani sāim̐ dohāī

verses.sa:
करइ स्वामि हित सेवकु सोई ।
दूषन कोटि देइ किन कोई ॥
verses.tr:
karai svāmi hit sevaku soī
dūṣan koṭi dei kin koī

verses.sa:
अस बिचारि सुचि सेवक बोले ।
जे सपनेहुँ निज धरम न डोले ॥
verses.tr:
as bicāri suci sevak bole
je sapanehum̐ nij dharam na ḍole

verses.sa:
कहि सबु मरमु धरमु भल भाषा ।
जो जेहि लायक सो तेहिं राखा ॥
verses.tr:
kahi sabu maramu dharamu bhal bhāṣā
jo jehi lāyak so tehiṃ rākhā

verses.sa:
करि सबु जतनु राखि रखवारे ।
राम मातु पहिं भरतु सिधारे ॥
verses.tr:
kari sabu jatanu rākhi rakhavāre
rām mātu pahiṃ bharatu sidhāre

verses.sa:
आरत जननी जानि सब भरत सनेह सुजान ।
कहेउ बनावन पालकीं सजन सुखासन जान ॥
verses.tr:
ārat jananī jāni sab bharat saneh sujān
kaheu banāvan pālakīṃ sajan sukhāsan jān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: In every house carriages of all kinds were making ready, and the start to-morrow was-a heart-felt joy. Bharat pondered on going home: ‘The city, with its horses, elephants, palaces and treasuries, and all its wealth, is Rama's. If I recklessly go and leave it, in the end it will not be good for me; to injure one’s own lord is a crowning sin. A good servant acts for his master’s interests, however much others may abuse him.” So thinking, he called such faithful servants as would never dream of failing in their duty, and after declaring to them his intention and instructing them in their work, he told them off for the posts for which they were severally fit, When he had thusdiligently posted the ‘guards he proceeded to visit Rama’s mother.
Understanding the ways of love, he sympathized with a mother’s anxiety and ordered to be got ready convenient palanquins and seated carriages.

sections.label: Doha 187
sections.name: सौंपि नगर सुचि सेवकनि सादर सकल चलाइ

verses.sa:
चक्क चक्कि जिमि पुर नर नारी ।
चहत प्रात उर आरत भारी ॥
verses.tr:
cakk cakki jimi pur nar nārī
cahat prāt ur ārat bhārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जागत सब निसि भयउ बिहाना ।
भरत बोलाए सचिव सुजाना ॥
verses.tr:
jāgat sab nisi bhayau bihānā
bharat bolāe saciv sujānā

verses.sa:
कहेउ लेहु सबु तिलक समाजू ।
बनहिं देब मुनि रामहिं राजू ॥
verses.tr:
kaheu lehu sabu tilak samājū
banahiṃ deb muni rāmahiṃ rājū

verses.sa:
बेगि चलहु सुनि सचिव जोहारे ।
तुरत तुरग रथ नाग सँवारे ॥
verses.tr:
begi calahu suni saciv johāre
turat turag rath nāg sam̐vāre

verses.sa:
अरुंधती अरु अगिनि समाऊ ।
रथ चढ़ि चले प्रथम मुनिराऊ ॥
verses.tr:
aruṃdhatī aru agini samāū
rath car̤hi cale pratham munirāū

verses.sa:
बिप्र बृंद चढ़ि बाहन नाना ।
चले सकल तप तेज निधाना ॥
verses.tr:
bipr bṛṃd car̤hi bāhan nānā
cale sakal tap tej nidhānā

verses.sa:
नगर लोग सब सजि सजि जाना ।
चित्रकूट कहँ कीन्ह पयाना ॥
verses.tr:
nagar log sab saji saji jānā
citrakūṭ kaham̐ kīnh payānā

verses.sa:
सिबिका सुभग न जाहिं बखानी ।
चढ़ि चढ़ि चलत भई सब रानी ॥
verses.tr:
sibikā subhag na jāhiṃ bakhānī
car̤hi car̤hi calat bhaī sab rānī

verses.sa:
सौंपि नगर सुचि सेवकनि सादर सकल चलाइ ।
सुमिरि राम सिय चरन तब चले भरत दोउ भाइ ॥
verses.tr:
sauṃpi nagar suci sevakani sādar sakal calāi
sumiri rām siya caran tab cale bharat dou bhāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Tbe men and women of the oity like the chakwa and chakwi were anxious at heart for the dawn, when they might start. The whole night had been spent in watching, when Bharat summoned his wise counsellors and said to them: * Tuke all materials for the coronation, and there in the forest, sirs, invest Rama with the sovereignty: start at once.” At his word they bowed and speedily made ready horses, carriages and elephants. The king of sages ( Vasishtha) first mounted his chariot and led the way with his spouse Arundhati and all the materials for sacrifice. A host of Brahmans renowned for their asceticism, followed iu vehicles of different kinds, and next the citizens on their own conveyances all set forth for Chitra-kut. The elegance of the palanquins in which the different Ranis were seated is beyond description.
After making over the city to his faithful servants and

sections.label: Doha 188
sections.name: पय अहार फल असन एक निसि भोजन एक लोग

verses.sa:
राम दरस बस सब नर नारी ।
जनु करि करिनि चले तकि बारी ॥
verses.tr:
rām daras bas sab nar nārī
janu kari karini cale taki bārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बन सिय रामु समुझि मन माहीं ।
सानुज भरत पयादेहिं जाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ban siya rāmu samujhi man māhīṃ
sānuj bharat payādehiṃ jāhīṃ

verses.sa:
देखि सनेहु लोग अनुरागे ।
उतरि चले हय गय रथ त्यागे ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi sanehu log anurāge
utari cale haya gaya rath tyāge

verses.sa:
जाइ समीप राखि निज डोली ।
राम मातु मृदु बानी बोली ॥
verses.tr:
jāi samīp rākhi nij ḍolī
rām mātu mṛdu bānī bolī

verses.sa:
तात चढ़हु रथ बलि महतारी ।
होइहि प्रिय परिवारु दुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
tāt car̤hahu rath bali mahatārī
hoihi priya parivāru dukhārī

verses.sa:
तुम्हरें चलत चलिहि सबु लोगू ।
सकल सोक कृस नहिं मग जोगू ॥
verses.tr:
tumhareṃ calat calihi sabu logū
sakal sok kṛs nahiṃ mag jogū

verses.sa:
सिर धरि बचन चरन सिरु नाई ।
रथ चढ़ि चलत भए दोउ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
sir dhari bacan caran siru nāī
rath car̤hi calat bhae dou bhāī

verses.sa:
तमसा प्रथम दिवस करि बासू ।
दूसर गोमति तीर निवासू ॥
verses.tr:
tamasā pratham divas kari bāsū
dūsar gomati tīr nivāsū

verses.sa:
पय अहार फल असन एक निसि भोजन एक लोग ।
करत राम हित नेम ब्रत परिहरि भूषन भोग ॥
verses.tr:
paya ahār phal asan ek nisi bhojan ek log
karat rām hit nem brat parihari bhūṣan bhog
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ceremoniously starting the procession, Bharat himself with
his brother started too, his thoughts fixed on Rama and Sita.

All the people were as eager for a’ ‘sight of Rama as when a herd of elephants makes a rush for a stream. Reflecting within themselves that Sita and Rama were in exile, Bharat and his brother went on foot. The people were moved by their affection and themselves dismounted and left horses, elephants, and carriages, But Rama’s mother stopped her palanquin by his side and softly said: ‘My son I entreat you to mount your chariot,’;or all your people will be sufferers; if you walk, they will all walk, and they are so wasted with sorrow that they are not fit for the journey.” Obedient to her commands he bowed his), head to her feet. and with his brother mounted the chariot. They halted the first day at the Tamasa, and the second on the bank of the Gomati.
Out of devotion to Rama, some vowed to drink only water, some to eat nothing but fruit, others to make only one meal and that at night, and they forsworeal] luxuries of dress and food.

sections.label: Doha 189
sections.name: अस बिचारि गुहँ ग्याति सन कहेउ सजग सब होहु

verses.sa:
सई तीर बसि चले बिहाने ।
सृंगबेरपुर सब निअराने ॥
verses.tr:
saī tīr basi cale bihāne
sṛṃgaberapur sab niarāne
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
समाचार सब सुने निषादा ।
हृदयँ बिचार करइ सबिषादा ॥
verses.tr:
samācār sab sune niṣādā
hṛdayam̐ bicār karai sabiṣādā

verses.sa:
कारन कवन भरतु बन जाहीं ।
है कछु कपट भाउ मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kāran kavan bharatu ban jāhīṃ
hai kachu kapaṭ bhāu man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
जौं पै जियँ न होति कुटिलाई ।
तौ कत लीन्ह संग कटकाई ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ pai jiyam̐ na hoti kuṭilāī
tau kat līnh saṃg kaṭakāī

verses.sa:
जानहिं सानुज रामहि मारी ।
करउँ अकंटक राजु सुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
jānahiṃ sānuj rāmahi mārī
karaum̐ akaṃṭak rāju sukhārī

verses.sa:
भरत न राजनीति उर आनी ।
तब कलंकु अब जीवन हानी ॥
verses.tr:
bharat na rājanīti ur ānī
tab kalaṃku ab jīvan hānī

verses.sa:
सकल सुरासुर जुरहिं जुझारा ।
रामहि समर न जीतनिहारा ॥
verses.tr:
sakal surāsur jurahiṃ jujhārā
rāmahi samar na jītanihārā

verses.sa:
का आचरजु भरतु अस करहीं ।
नहिं बिष बेलि अमिअ फल फरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kā ācaraju bharatu as karahīṃ
nahiṃ biṣ beli amia phal pharahīṃ

verses.sa:
अस बिचारि गुहँ ग्याति सन कहेउ सजग सब होहु ।
हथवाँसहु बोरहु तरनि कीजिअ घाटारोहु ॥
verses.tr:
as bicāri guham̐ gyāti san kaheu sajag sab hohu
hathavām̐sahu borahu tarani kījia ghāṭārohu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: After resting at the Sai they started at dawn and drew near to the city of Sringavera.¢ When the Nishad heard the news he thought sadly to himself: “For what reason is Bharat going to the forest? he has some evil design at heart. If he had no wrong intention, why should he bring ao army with him He thinks to kill Rama and his brother, and then to reign in ease and security. Bharat has not taken to heart the maxims of sound polity; there was disgrace already, and now there will be loss of life. If all the gods and demons were to combine to fight, they would never conquer Rama in battle. What wonder that Bharat should act thus; fruits of ambrosia do not grow from a poison stock.”
Having thus reflected, Guha cried to his kinsmen: “Be

sections.label: Doha 190
sections.name: बिगत बिषाद निषादपति सबहि बढ़ाइ उछाहु

verses.sa:
होहु सँजोइल रोकहु घाटा ।
ठाटहु सकल मरै के ठाटा ॥
verses.tr:
hohu sam̐joil rokahu ghāṭā
ṭhāṭahu sakal marai ke ṭhāṭā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सनमुख लोह भरत सन लेऊँ ।
जिअत न सुरसरि उतरन देऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
sanamukh loh bharat san leūm̐
jiat na surasari utaran deūm̐

verses.sa:
समर मरनु पुनि सुरसरि तीरा ।
राम काजु छनभंगु सरीरा ॥
verses.tr:
samar maranu puni surasari tīrā
rām kāju chanabhaṃgu sarīrā

verses.sa:
भरत भाइ नृपु मै जन नीचू ।
बड़ें भाग असि पाइअ मीचू ॥
verses.tr:
bharat bhāi nṛpu mai jan nīcū
bar̤eṃ bhāg asi pāia mīcū

verses.sa:
स्वामि काज करिहउँ रन रारी ।
जस धवलिहउँ भुवन दस चारी ॥
verses.tr:
svāmi kāj karihaum̐ ran rārī
jas dhavalihaum̐ bhuvan das cārī

verses.sa:
तजउँ प्रान रघुनाथ निहोरें ।
दुहूँ हाथ मुद मोदक मोरें ॥
verses.tr:
tajaum̐ prān raghunāth nihoreṃ
duhūm̐ hāth mud modak moreṃ

verses.sa:
साधु समाज न जाकर लेखा ।
राम भगत महुँ जासु न रेखा ॥
verses.tr:
sādhu samāj na jākar lekhā
rām bhagat mahum̐ jāsu na rekhā

verses.sa:
जायँ जिअत जग सो महि भारू ।
जननी जौबन बिटप कुठारू ॥
verses.tr:
jāyam̐ jiat jag so mahi bhārū
jananī jauban biṭap kuṭhārū

verses.sa:
बिगत बिषाद निषादपति सबहि बढ़ाइ उछाहु ।
सुमिरि राम मागेउ तुरत तरकस धनुष सनाहु ॥
verses.tr:
bigat biṣād niṣādapati sabahi bar̤hāi uchāhu
sumiri rām māgeu turat tarakas dhanuṣ sanāhu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: on the alert, up and sink the boat and close the ferry. Chaupdi.

Make ready and blockade the pass, equip yourselves with every‘ instrument of death. Take up arms against Bharat, and never let him cross the Ganges alive. To die in the battle and on the Ganges bank; in Rama’s cause to lay down this frail body; and mean as I am to join battle with a king like Bharat; all this is a great gain for me, even if I meet my death. It I war and fight on my lord’s behalf, 1 reap brilliant renown throughout the fourteen spheres. If I lose my life for Raghunath, I shall have both hands full of luscious sweets. Whoever is not numbered among the just, nor counted among Rama's votaries, is all the time that he lives only a burden to earth, and an axe at the foot of the tree of his mother’s youth.”
The Nishad king thus fearlessly excited that ardour of his followers, and mindful of Rama called in haste for quiver and bow and coat of mail.

sections.label: Doha 191
sections.name: भाइहु लावहु धोख जनि आजु काज बड़ मोहि

verses.sa:
बेगहु भाइहु सजहु सँजोऊ ।
सुनि रजाइ कदराइ न कोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
begahu bhāihu sajahu sam̐joū
suni rajāi kadarāi na koū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भलेहिं नाथ सब कहहिं सहरषा ।
एकहिं एक बढ़ावइ करषा ॥
verses.tr:
bhalehiṃ nāth sab kahahiṃ saharaṣā
ekahiṃ ek bar̤hāvai karaṣā

verses.sa:
चले निषाद जोहारि जोहारी ।
सूर सकल रन रूचइ रारी ॥
verses.tr:
cale niṣād johāri johārī
sūr sakal ran rūcai rārī

verses.sa:
सुमिरि राम पद पंकज पनहीं ।
भाथीं बाँधि चढ़ाइन्हि धनहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sumiri rām pad paṃkaj panahīṃ
bhāthīṃ bām̐dhi car̤hāinhi dhanahīṃ

verses.sa:
अँगरी पहिरि कूँड़ि सिर धरहीं ।
फरसा बाँस सेल सम करहीं ॥
verses.tr:
am̐garī pahiri kūm̐r̤i sir dharahīṃ
pharasā bām̐s sel sam karahīṃ

verses.sa:
एक कुसल अति ओड़न खाँड़े ।
कूदहि गगन मनहुँ छिति छाँड़े ॥
verses.tr:
ek kusal ati or̤an khām̐r̤e
kūdahi gagan manahum̐ chiti chām̐r̤e

verses.sa:
निज निज साजु समाजु बनाई ।
गुह राउतहि जोहारे जाई ॥
verses.tr:
nij nij sāju samāju banāī
guh rāutahi johāre jāī

verses.sa:
देखि सुभट सब लायक जाने ।
लै लै नाम सकल सनमाने ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi subhaṭ sab lāyak jāne
lai lai nām sakal sanamāne

verses.sa:
भाइहु लावहु धोख जनि आजु काज बड़ मोहि ।
सुनि सरोष बोले सुभट बीर अधीर न होहि ॥
verses.tr:
bhāihu lāvahu dhokh jani āju kāj bar̤ mohi
suni saroṣ bole subhaṭ bīr adhīr na hohi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘Hasten, brethren, to complete your equipment, and after hearing my command Let no one hesitate.” All cheerfully responded, “Tis well, my lord,” and mutually en-couraged each other’s zeal, Bowing again and again before the Nishad all the gallant warriors, eager for the fray, invoking the sandals of Rama’s lotus feet, girt themselves with quiver, slung on the bow, donned their coats of mail, put helmet on head, and furbished up axe and bludgeon and spear—some so expert in the use of shield’ and sword that they seemed when they sprung into the air as though they had left the earth for good. When each and all had completed their full arrangements, they went and bowed before king Guha. Seeing his gallant warriors so fit and ready, be addressed them each by name with courteous phrase.
‘Do not play me false, my brethren; this is a great day’s work for me.” At this they cried with vehemence, ** Fear not, captain.

sections.label: Doha 192
sections.name: गहहु घाट भट समिटि सब लेउँ मरम मिलि जाइ

verses.sa:
राम प्रताप नाथ बल तोरे ।
करहिं कटकु बिनु भट बिनु घोरे ॥
verses.tr:
rām pratāp nāth bal tore
karahiṃ kaṭaku binu bhaṭ binu ghore
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जीवत पाउ न पाछें धरहीं ।
रुंड मुंडमय मेदिनि करहीं ॥
verses.tr:
jīvat pāu na pācheṃ dharahīṃ
ruṃḍ muṃḍamaya medini karahīṃ

verses.sa:
दीख निषादनाथ भल टोलू ।
कहेउ बजाउ जुझाऊ ढोलू ॥
verses.tr:
dīkh niṣādanāth bhal ṭolū
kaheu bajāu jujhāū ḍholū

verses.sa:
एतना कहत छींक भइ बाँए ।
कहेउ सगुनिअन्ह खेत सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
etanā kahat chīṃk bhai bām̐e
kaheu sagunianh khet suhāe

verses.sa:
बूढ़ु एकु कह सगुन बिचारी ।
भरतहि मिलिअ न होइहि रारी ॥
verses.tr:
būr̤hu eku kah sagun bicārī
bharatahi milia na hoihi rārī

verses.sa:
रामहि भरतु मनावन जाहीं ।
सगुन कहइ अस बिग्रहु नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
rāmahi bharatu manāvan jāhīṃ
sagun kahai as bigrahu nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सुनि गुह कहइ नीक कह बूढ़ा ।
सहसा करि पछिताहिं बिमूढ़ा ॥
verses.tr:
suni guh kahai nīk kah būr̤hā
sahasā kari pachitāhiṃ bimūr̤hā

verses.sa:
भरत सुभाउ सीलु बिनु बूझें ।
बड़ि हित हानि जानि बिनु जूझें ॥
verses.tr:
bharat subhāu sīlu binu būjheṃ
bar̤i hit hāni jāni binu jūjheṃ

verses.sa:
गहहु घाट भट समिटि सब लेउँ मरम मिलि जाइ ।
बूझि मित्र अरि मध्य गति तस तब करिहउँ आइ ॥
verses.tr:
gahahu ghāṭ bhaṭ samiṭi sab leum̐ maram mili jāi
būjhi mitr ari madhya gati tas tab karihaum̐ āi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: By Rama's favour and your might, my lord, we will leave the enemy without a single fighting-man or horse. While life last, we will never draw back our foot, and will make the earth one heap of corpses and skulls." When the Nishad lord had inspected his gallant band he cried “Beat the drum for the onset.” When he had so said, some one sneezed on the left. The soothsayers exclaimed, ‘A prosperous issue to the battle!’ One old man thought over the omen and said ‘Bharat must be met, but there will be no fighting. He is going to make entreaty to Kama, the omen says thus; there will beno battle.” On hearing this, Guha said: “The elder has spoken well; fools act in haste and repent. Unless we ascertain Bharat’s temper and disposition, we may do ourselves harm by fighting without knowledge.
Close up, my men, and stop the pass, and all join to dis. cover the mystery. When we know whether he isa friend, an enemy, or a neutral, we can then Lay our plans accordingly.

sections.label: Doha 193
sections.name: करत दंडवत देखि तेहि भरत लीन्ह उर लाइ

verses.sa:
लखन सनेहु सुभायँ सुहाएँ ।
बैरु प्रीति नहिं दुरइँ दुराएँ ॥
verses.tr:
lakhan sanehu subhāyam̐ suhāem̐
bairu prīti nahiṃ duraim̐ durāem̐
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अस कहि भेंट सँजोवन लागे ।
कंद मूल फल खग मृग मागे ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi bheṃṭ sam̐jovan lāge
kaṃd mūl phal khag mṛg māge

verses.sa:
मीन पीन पाठीन पुराने ।
भरि भरि भार कहारन्ह आने ॥
verses.tr:
mīn pīn pāṭhīn purāne
bhari bhari bhār kahāranh āne

verses.sa:
मिलन साजु सजि मिलन सिधाए ।
मंगल मूल सगुन सुभ पाए ॥
verses.tr:
milan sāju saji milan sidhāe
maṃgal mūl sagun subh pāe

verses.sa:
देखि दूरि तें कहि निज नामू ।
कीन्ह मुनीसहि दंड प्रनामू ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi dūri teṃ kahi nij nāmū
kīnh munīsahi daṃḍ pranāmū

verses.sa:
जानि रामप्रिय दीन्हि असीसा ।
भरतहि कहेउ बुझाइ मुनीसा ॥
verses.tr:
jāni rāmapriya dīnhi asīsā
bharatahi kaheu bujhāi munīsā

verses.sa:
राम सखा सुनि संदनु त्यागा ।
चले उतरि उमगत अनुरागा ॥
verses.tr:
rām sakhā suni saṃdanu tyāgā
cale utari umagat anurāgā

verses.sa:
गाउँ जाति गुहँ नाउँ सुनाई ।
कीन्ह जोहारु माथ महि लाई ॥
verses.tr:
gāum̐ jāti guham̐ nāum̐ sunāī
kīnh johāru māth mahi lāī

verses.sa:
करत दंडवत देखि तेहि भरत लीन्ह उर लाइ ।
मनहुँ लखन सन भेंट भइ प्रेम न हृदयँ समाइ ॥
verses.tr:
karat daṃḍavat dekhi tehi bharat līnh ur lāi
manahum̐ lakhan san bheṃṭ bhai prem na hṛdayam̐ samāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: We shall soon test his devotion and honest intent; hatred and love are not to be concealed.” So saying, he began to make ready a present, and sent for bulbs, roots and fruits, birds and beasts, with the finest of fish, large pedthzns, which were brought by the fishermen in basketsful. When everything was arranged they went out to meet him, and had the most auspicious omens of good fortune. As soon as he saw the great sage afar off, he declared his name and prostrated himself before him. Vasishtha, knowing him to be a friend of Rama’s, gave him his blessing, and told Bharat about him. He, on hearing that he was Rama’s friend, left his chariot and advanced on foot to meet him with exuberant affection. Guha declared his home and race and name, and making obeisance laid his forehead to
the ground. Dohe 199.
But Bharat, seeing him about to prostrate himself, took him to his bosom with as much uncontrollable rapture as though it were Lakshman he had met.

sections.label: Doha 194
sections.name: स्वपच सबर खस जमन जड़ पावँर कोल किरात

verses.sa:
भेंटत भरतु ताहि अति प्रीती ।
लोग सिहाहिं प्रेम कै रीती ॥
verses.tr:
bheṃṭat bharatu tāhi ati prītī
log sihāhiṃ prem kai rītī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
धन्य धन्य धुनि मंगल मूला ।
सुर सराहि तेहि बरिसहिं फूला ॥
verses.tr:
dhanya dhanya dhuni maṃgal mūlā
sur sarāhi tehi barisahiṃ phūlā

verses.sa:
लोक बेद सब भाँतिहिं नीचा ।
जासु छाँह छुइ लेइअ सींचा ॥
verses.tr:
lok bed sab bhām̐tihiṃ nīcā
jāsu chām̐h chui leia sīṃcā

verses.sa:
तेहि भरि अंक राम लघु भ्राता ।
मिलत पुलक परिपूरित गाता ॥
verses.tr:
tehi bhari aṃk rām laghu bhrātā
milat pulak paripūrit gātā

verses.sa:
राम राम कहि जे जमुहाहीं ।
तिन्हहि न पाप पुंज समुहाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
rām rām kahi je jamuhāhīṃ
tinhahi na pāp puṃj samuhāhīṃ

verses.sa:
यह तौ राम लाइ उर लीन्हा ।
कुल समेत जगु पावन कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
yah tau rām lāi ur līnhā
kul samet jagu pāvan kīnhā

verses.sa:
करमनास जलु सुरसरि परई ।
तेहि को कहहु सीस नहिं धरई ॥
verses.tr:
karamanās jalu surasari paraī
tehi ko kahahu sīs nahiṃ dharaī

verses.sa:
उलटा नामु जपत जगु जाना ।
बालमीकि भए ब्रह्म समाना ॥
verses.tr:
ulaṭā nāmu japat jagu jānā
bālamīki bhae brahm samānā

verses.sa:
स्वपच सबर खस जमन जड़ पावँर कोल किरात ।
रामु कहत पावन परम होत भुवन बिख्यात ॥
verses.tr:
svapac sabar khas jaman jar̤ pāvam̐r kol kirāt
rāmu kahat pāvan param hot bhuvan bikhyāt
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Bharat received him with the very greatest affection, and the people extolled the manner of hislove. There was a jubilant cry of ‘Glory, Glory,’as the gods applauded and rained down flowers upon him. ‘Though this man is in every way vile, both by custom of the world and by scriptural prescription, so that contact with his shadow requires ablution, yet Rama’s brother has embraced him in his arms and thrilled all over with delight at meeting him. One who cries ‘Rama, Rama,’ even in a yawn, a multitude of sins will not rise up against him. Here is one whom Rama had clasped to his bosom and thereby purified him and all his family. If water of the Karmnasa falls into the Ganges, tell me who will refuse to reverence it? again, it is known throughout the world that Valmiki was made equal to Brahma simply for repeating Rama’s name backwards.
Even a Chandal, a Savara, a Khasiya, a stupid foreigner, an outcast, a Kol, or a Kirat, by repeating the name of Rama becomes most holy and renowned throughout the world.

sections.label: Doha 195
sections.name: समुझि मोरि करतूति कुलु प्रभु महिमा जियँ जोइ

verses.sa:
नहिं अचिरजु जुग जुग चलि आई ।
केहि न दीन्हि रघुबीर बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
nahiṃ aciraju jug jug cali āī
kehi na dīnhi raghubīr bar̤āī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राम नाम महिमा सुर कहहीं ।
सुनि सुनि अवधलोग सुखु लहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
rām nām mahimā sur kahahīṃ
suni suni avadhalog sukhu lahahīṃ

verses.sa:
रामसखहि मिलि भरत सप्रेमा ।
पूँछी कुसल सुमंगल खेमा ॥
verses.tr:
rāmasakhahi mili bharat sapremā
pūm̐chī kusal sumaṃgal khemā

verses.sa:
देखि भरत कर सील सनेहू ।
भा निषाद तेहि समय बिदेहू ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi bharat kar sīl sanehū
bhā niṣād tehi samaya bidehū

verses.sa:
सकुच सनेहु मोदु मन बाढ़ा ।
भरतहि चितवत एकटक ठाढ़ा ॥
verses.tr:
sakuc sanehu modu man bār̤hā
bharatahi citavat ekaṭak ṭhār̤hā

verses.sa:
धरि धीरजु पद बंदि बहोरी ।
बिनय सप्रेम करत कर जोरी ॥
verses.tr:
dhari dhīraju pad baṃdi bahorī
binaya saprem karat kar jorī

verses.sa:
कुसल मूल पद पंकज पेखी ।
मैं तिहुँ काल कुसल निज लेखी ॥
verses.tr:
kusal mūl pad paṃkaj pekhī
maiṃ tihum̐ kāl kusal nij lekhī

verses.sa:
अब प्रभु परम अनुग्रह तोरें ।
सहित कोटि कुल मंगल मोरें ॥
verses.tr:
ab prabhu param anugrah toreṃ
sahit koṭi kul maṃgal moreṃ

verses.sa:
समुझि मोरि करतूति कुलु प्रभु महिमा जियँ जोइ ।
जो न भजइ रघुबीर पद जग बिधि बंचित सोइ ॥
verses.tr:
samujhi mori karatūti kulu prabhu mahimā jiyam̐ joi
jo na bhajai raghubīr pad jag bidhi baṃcit soi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: It is no wonder, it has been so for ages; who is there whom Raghubir cannot exalt?”’ As the gods told the greatness of Rama’s name, the people of Avadh listened and were glad. Bharat affectionately greeted Rama's friend and asked him of his health and welfare. At the sight of Bharat’s affectionate disposition, the Nishad was at once utterly overpowered; so great was his confusion, his love and his delight, that he could only stand and stare at Bharat. Collecting, himself, he again embraced his feet and with clasped hands made this loving speech: ‘When I beheld his blessed lotus feet I accounted myself blessed for ever. Now my lord, by your high favour my prosperity is secured for thousands of generations.
Reflecting on my past deeds and my descent and again considering the greatness of the Lord, any man in the world who adores not the feet of Raghubir must be under supernatural delusion.

sections.label: Doha 196
sections.name: सनकारे सेवक सकल चले स्वामि रुख पाइ

verses.sa:
कपटी कायर कुमति कुजाती ।
लोक बेद बाहेर सब भाँती ॥
verses.tr:
kapaṭī kāyar kumati kujātī
lok bed bāher sab bhām̐tī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राम कीन्ह आपन जबही तें ।
भयउँ भुवन भूषन तबही तें ॥
verses.tr:
rām kīnh āpan jabahī teṃ
bhayaum̐ bhuvan bhūṣan tabahī teṃ

verses.sa:
देखि प्रीति सुनि बिनय सुहाई ।
मिलेउ बहोरि भरत लघु भाई ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi prīti suni binaya suhāī
mileu bahori bharat laghu bhāī

verses.sa:
कहि निषाद निज नाम सुबानीं ।
सादर सकल जोहारीं रानीं ॥
verses.tr:
kahi niṣād nij nām subānīṃ
sādar sakal johārīṃ rānīṃ

verses.sa:
जानि लखन सम देहिं असीसा ।
जिअहु सुखी सय लाख बरीसा ॥
verses.tr:
jāni lakhan sam dehiṃ asīsā
jiahu sukhī saya lākh barīsā

verses.sa:
निरखि निषादु नगर नर नारी ।
भए सुखी जनु लखनु निहारी ॥
verses.tr:
nirakhi niṣādu nagar nar nārī
bhae sukhī janu lakhanu nihārī

verses.sa:
कहहिं लहेउ एहिं जीवन लाहू ।
भेंटेउ रामभद्र भरि बाहू ॥
verses.tr:
kahahiṃ laheu ehiṃ jīvan lāhū
bheṃṭeu rāmabhadr bhari bāhū

verses.sa:
सुनि निषादु निज भाग बड़ाई ।
प्रमुदित मन लइ चलेउ लेवाई ॥
verses.tr:
suni niṣādu nij bhāg bar̤āī
pramudit man lai caleu levāī

verses.sa:
सनकारे सेवक सकल चले स्वामि रुख पाइ ।
घर तरु तर सर बाग बन बास बनाएन्हि जाइ ॥
verses.tr:
sanakāre sevak sakal cale svāmi rukh pāi
ghar taru tar sar bāg ban bās banāenhi jāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: False, cowardly, low-minded and low-born as I am, an utter outcast by the Inws both of God and society; since the time that Rama took me For his own, I have become the glory of the world.” After witnessing his devotion and hearing his graceful humility Lakshman’s younger brother next embraced him, Then the Nishad introduced himself by name and respectfully saluted the royal dames, who received him even as they would Lakshman and gave him their blessing: ‘“‘ May you live happily for millions of years” The citizens too were as glad to see him as if he had been Lakshman and cried: “Here is one who has lived to some purpose; whom Rama's our brother has taken to his arms and embraced.’ When the Nishad heard them thus magnify his good fortune, he was glad at heart as he showed them the way.
Ata signal all his attendants, having learnt their master’s will, went on and made ready tents under the trees and rest-hoases by the ponds, gardens and groves.

sections.label: Doha 197
sections.name: एहि बिधि मज्जनु भरतु करि गुर अनुसासन पाइ

verses.sa:
सृंगबेरपुर भरत दीख जब ।
भे सनेहँ सब अंग सिथिल तब ॥
verses.tr:
sṛṃgaberapur bharat dīkh jab
bhe saneham̐ sab aṃg sithil tab
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सोहत दिएँ निषादहि लागू ।
जनु तनु धरें बिनय अनुरागू ॥
verses.tr:
sohat diem̐ niṣādahi lāgū
janu tanu dhareṃ binaya anurāgū

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि भरत सेनु सबु संगा ।
दीखि जाइ जग पावनि गंगा ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi bharat senu sabu saṃgā
dīkhi jāi jag pāvani gaṃgā

verses.sa:
रामघाट कहँ कीन्ह प्रनामू ।
भा मनु मगनु मिले जनु रामू ॥
verses.tr:
rāmaghāṭ kaham̐ kīnh pranāmū
bhā manu maganu mile janu rāmū

verses.sa:
करहिं प्रनाम नगर नर नारी ।
मुदित ब्रह्ममय बारि निहारी ॥
verses.tr:
karahiṃ pranām nagar nar nārī
mudit brahmamaya bāri nihārī

verses.sa:
करि मज्जनु मागहिं कर जोरी ।
रामचंद्र पद प्रीति न थोरी ॥
verses.tr:
kari majjanu māgahiṃ kar jorī
rāmacaṃdr pad prīti na thorī

verses.sa:
भरत कहेउ सुरसरि तव रेनू ।
सकल सुखद सेवक सुरधेनू ॥
verses.tr:
bharat kaheu surasari tav renū
sakal sukhad sevak suradhenū

verses.sa:
जोरि पानि बर मागउँ एहू ।
सीय राम पद सहज सनेहू ॥
verses.tr:
jori pāni bar māgaum̐ ehū
sīya rām pad sahaj sanehū

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि मज्जनु भरतु करि गुर अनुसासन पाइ ।
मातु नहानीं जानि सब डेरा चले लवाइ ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi majjanu bharatu kari gur anusāsan pāi
mātu nahānīṃ jāni sab ḍerā cale lavāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When Bharat beheld the city of Sringavera, he was overcome by emotion and was unnerved in every limb, As he leant upon the Nishad, it was as goodly a sight as though embodied Humility and Love had met together. In this manner Bharat with all his; army went to see the earth-purifying stream of the Ganges. As he made his obeisance to the ford where Ra-na‘had ‘crossed, he was as entranced as though he had met Rama himself. The citizens bowing low gazed upon the divine stream with rapture, and after’

bathing prayed with clasped hands; ‘May our love to Ramchandra’s feet never grow less.” Bharat exclaimed: “Thy sands, O Ganga, are the bestowers of all happiness, the very cow of plenty to thy votaries: with folded hands I beg this boon, unalterable devotion to Sita and Rama.”
When Bharat had thus bathed and Knew that all his mothers had bathed too, he received the guru’s permission and took them to their tents.

sections.label: Doha 198
sections.name: जहँ सिंसुपा पुनीत तर रघुबर किय बिश्रामु

verses.sa:
जहँ तहँ लोगन्ह डेरा कीन्हा ।
भरत सोधु सबही कर लीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ taham̐ loganh ḍerā kīnhā
bharat sodhu sabahī kar līnhā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुर सेवा करि आयसु पाई ।
राम मातु पहिं गे दोउ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
sur sevā kari āyasu pāī
rām mātu pahiṃ ge dou bhāī

verses.sa:
चरन चाँपि कहि कहि मृदु बानी ।
जननीं सकल भरत सनमानी ॥
verses.tr:
caran cām̐pi kahi kahi mṛdu bānī
jananīṃ sakal bharat sanamānī

verses.sa:
भाइहि सौंपि मातु सेवकाई ।
आपु निषादहि लीन्ह बोलाई ॥
verses.tr:
bhāihi sauṃpi mātu sevakāī
āpu niṣādahi līnh bolāī

verses.sa:
चले सखा कर सों कर जोरें ।
सिथिल सरीर सनेह न थोरें ॥
verses.tr:
cale sakhā kar soṃ kar joreṃ
sithil sarīr saneh na thoreṃ

verses.sa:
पूँछत सखहि सो ठाउँ देखाऊ ।
नेकु नयन मन जरनि जुड़ाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
pūm̐chat sakhahi so ṭhāum̐ dekhāū
neku nayan man jarani jur̤āū

verses.sa:
जहँ सिय रामु लखनु निसि सोए ।
कहत भरे जल लोचन कोए ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ siya rāmu lakhanu nisi soe
kahat bhare jal locan koe

verses.sa:
भरत बचन सुनि भयउ बिषादू ।
तुरत तहाँ लइ गयउ निषादू ॥
verses.tr:
bharat bacan suni bhayau biṣādū
turat tahām̐ lai gayau niṣādū

verses.sa:
जहँ सिंसुपा पुनीत तर रघुबर किय बिश्रामु ।
अति सनेहँ सादर भरत कीन्हेउ दंड प्रनामु ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ siṃsupā punīt tar raghubar kiya biśrāmu
ati saneham̐ sādar bharat kīnheu daṃḍ pranāmu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Wherever the people had pitched their tents, Bharat took every care of them all. After paying homage to the guru and obtaining his permission, the two brothers went to Rama's mother, Then Bharat, after kissing their feet, with many tender phrases did reverence to all the queens, and having left them to the dutiful care of his brother, went away with the Nishad. Hand-in-band they went, his body fainting with excess of love, as he begged his companion to show him the spot—that the fierce longing of his eyes and soul might be a little assuaged—where Sita, Rama and Lakshman had spent the night. As he spoke, his eyes overflowed with tears, and the Nishad in great distress at his speech led him at once to the place.
Where Raghubar had rested under the sacred sinsipa tree. With great reverence and devotion Bharat prostrated himself.

sections.label: Doha 199
sections.name: पति देवता सुतीय मनि सीय साँथरी देखि

verses.sa:
कुस साँथरीनिहारि सुहाई ।
कीन्ह प्रनामु प्रदच्छिन जाई ॥
verses.tr:
kus sām̐tharīnihāri suhāī
kīnh pranāmu pradacchin jāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
चरन रेख रज आँखिन्ह लाई ।
बनइ न कहत प्रीति अधिकाई ॥
verses.tr:
caran rekh raj ām̐khinh lāī
banai na kahat prīti adhikāī

verses.sa:
कनक बिंदु दुइ चारिक देखे ।
राखे सीस सीय सम लेखे ॥
verses.tr:
kanak biṃdu dui cārik dekhe
rākhe sīs sīya sam lekhe

verses.sa:
सजल बिलोचन हृदयँ गलानी ।
कहत सखा सन बचन सुबानी ॥
verses.tr:
sajal bilocan hṛdayam̐ galānī
kahat sakhā san bacan subānī

verses.sa:
श्रीहत सीय बिरहँ दुतिहीना ।
जथा अवध नर नारि बिलीना ॥
verses.tr:
śrīhat sīya biraham̐ dutihīnā
jathā avadh nar nāri bilīnā

verses.sa:
पिता जनक देउँ पटतर केही ।
करतल भोगु जोगु जग जेही ॥
verses.tr:
pitā janak deum̐ paṭatar kehī
karatal bhogu jogu jag jehī

verses.sa:
ससुर भानुकुल भानु भुआलू ।
जेहि सिहात अमरावतिपालू ॥
verses.tr:
sasur bhānukul bhānu bhuālū
jehi sihāt amarāvatipālū

verses.sa:
प्राननाथु रघुनाथ गोसाई ।
जो बड़ होत सो राम बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
prānanāthu raghunāth gosāī
jo bar̤ hot so rām bar̤āī

verses.sa:
पति देवता सुतीय मनि सीय साँथरी देखि ।
बिहरत ह्रदउ न हहरि हर पबि तें कठिन बिसेषि ॥
verses.tr:
pati devatā sutīya mani sīya sām̐tharī dekhi
biharat hradau na hahari har pabi teṃ kaṭhin biseṣi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When he spied the delectable grassy couch, he again made obeisance and reverently paced round it. He put upon his eyes the dust of the foot-prints, with ao enthusiasm of devotion beyond all telling And seeing two or three golden spangles, he placed them upon his head as relios of Sita. With streaming eyes and aching heart he thus in gentle tones addressed his companion: ‘They are dim and lustreless through Sita’s absence, and all the people of Avadh are equally woe-begone. To whom can I compare her father, Janak, who was conversant at once with all life’s pleasures and all philosophy? Her father-inlaw, the sun-like monarch of the solar race, was the envy of even the lord of heaven. Her husband is the beloved
Raghunath, by whose greatness alone it is that any one is great.
I gaze on the couch of Sita, that devoted wife, that jewel of good women, and my heart breaks not with agitation; surely it is harder than a thunderbolt.

sections.label: Doha 200
sections.name: सुखस्वरुप रघुबंसमनि मंगल मोद निधान

verses.sa:
लालन जोगु लखन लघु लोने ।
भे न भाइ अस अहहिं न होने ॥
verses.tr:
lālan jogu lakhan laghu lone
bhe na bhāi as ahahiṃ na hone
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पुरजन प्रिय पितु मातु दुलारे ।
सिय रघुबरहि प्रानपिआरे ॥
verses.tr:
purajan priya pitu mātu dulāre
siya raghubarahi prānapiāre

verses.sa:
मृदु मूरति सुकुमार सुभाऊ ।
तात बाउ तन लाग न काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
mṛdu mūrati sukumār subhāū
tāt bāu tan lāg na kāū

verses.sa:
ते बन सहहिं बिपति सब भाँती ।
निदरे कोटि कुलिस एहिं छाती ॥
verses.tr:
te ban sahahiṃ bipati sab bhām̐tī
nidare koṭi kulis ehiṃ chātī

verses.sa:
राम जनमि जगु कीन्ह उजागर ।
रूप सील सुख सब गुन सागर ॥
verses.tr:
rām janami jagu kīnh ujāgar
rūp sīl sukh sab gun sāgar

verses.sa:
पुरजन परिजन गुर पितु माता ।
राम सुभाउ सबहि सुखदाता ॥
verses.tr:
purajan parijan gur pitu mātā
rām subhāu sabahi sukhadātā

verses.sa:
बैरिउ राम बड़ाई करहीं ।
बोलनि मिलनि बिनय मन हरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bairiu rām bar̤āī karahīṃ
bolani milani binaya man harahīṃ

verses.sa:
सारद कोटि कोटि सत सेषा ।
करि न सकहिं प्रभु गुन गन लेखा ॥
verses.tr:
sārad koṭi koṭi sat seṣā
kari na sakahiṃ prabhu gun gan lekhā

verses.sa:
सुखस्वरुप रघुबंसमनि मंगल मोद निधान ।
ते सोवत कुस डासि महि बिधि गति अति बलवान ॥
verses.tr:
sukhasvarup raghubaṃsamani maṃgal mod nidhān
te sovat kus ḍāsi mahi bidhi gati ati balavān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Lakshman so young and comely and made to be fondled: never was there such a brother, nor is there, nor will be: so beloved by the people, the darling of his father and mother, and dear as their own life to Rama and Sita; the picture of delicicy, the daintiest of striplings, whose body has never been exposed to the hot wind, how can he bear the hardships of the forest? O my heart would shame for hardness a million thunderbolts! Rama at his birth was the light of the world, an ocean of beauty, of virtue, and all good qualities. Rama's amiability was the delight of his subjects, his household, his guru, his father and mother, and all. Even enemies would praise Rama: his courtesy of speech and manner stole every heart Nota million Sarasvati, not a hundred million Seshnags could reckon up all my lord’s virtues.
The image of bliss, the jewel of the family of Raghu, the storehouse of all auspicious delights, slept on the ground on this littered grass: how wonderful are the ways of Providence!

sections.label: Doha 201
sections.name: अंतरजामी रामु सकुच सप्रेम कृपायतन

verses.sa:
राम सुना दुखु कान न काऊ ।
जीवनतरु जिमि जोगवइ राऊ ॥
verses.tr:
rām sunā dukhu kān na kāū
jīvanataru jimi jogavai rāū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पलक नयन फनि मनि जेहि भाँती ।
जोगवहिं जननि सकल दिन राती ॥
verses.tr:
palak nayan phani mani jehi bhām̐tī
jogavahiṃ janani sakal din rātī

verses.sa:
ते अब फिरत बिपिन पदचारी ।
कंद मूल फल फूल अहारी ॥
verses.tr:
te ab phirat bipin padacārī
kaṃd mūl phal phūl ahārī

verses.sa:
धिग कैकेई अमंगल मूला ।
भइसि प्रान प्रियतम प्रतिकूला ॥
verses.tr:
dhig kaikeī amaṃgal mūlā
bhaisi prān priyatam pratikūlā

verses.sa:
मैं धिग धिग अघ उदधि अभागी ।
सबु उतपातु भयउ जेहि लागी ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ dhig dhig agh udadhi abhāgī
sabu utapātu bhayau jehi lāgī

verses.sa:
कुल कलंकु करि सृजेउ बिधाताँ ।
साइँदोह मोहि कीन्ह कुमाताँ ॥
verses.tr:
kul kalaṃku kari sṛjeu bidhātām̐
sāim̐doh mohi kīnh kumātām̐

verses.sa:
सुनि सप्रेम समुझाव निषादू ।
नाथ करिअ कत बादि बिषादू ॥
verses.tr:
suni saprem samujhāv niṣādū
nāth karia kat bādi biṣādū

verses.sa:
राम तुम्हहि प्रिय तुम्ह प्रिय रामहि ।
यह निरजोसु दोसु बिधि बामहि ॥
verses.tr:
rām tumhahi priya tumh priya rāmahi
yah nirajosu dosu bidhi bāmahi

verses.sa:
बिधि बाम की करनी कठिन जेंहिं मातु कीन्ही बावरी ।
तेहि राति पुनि पुनि करहिं प्रभु सादर सरहना रावरी ॥
verses.tr:
bidhi bām kī karanī kaṭhin jeṃhiṃ mātu kīnhī bāvarī
tehi rāti puni puni karahiṃ prabhu sādar sarahanā rāvarī
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
तुलसी न तुम्ह सो राम प्रीतमु कहतु हौं सौहें किएँ ।
परिनाम मंगल जानि अपने आनिए धीरजु हिएँ ॥
verses.tr:
tulasī na tumh so rām prītamu kahatu hauṃ sauheṃ kiem̐
parinām maṃgal jāni apane ānie dhīraju hiem̐

verses.sa:
अंतरजामी रामु सकुच सप्रेम कृपायतन ।
चलिअ करिअ बिश्रामु यह बिचारि दृढ़ आनि मन ॥
verses.tr:
aṃtarajāmī rāmu sakuc saprem kṛpāyatan
calia karia biśrāmu yah bicāri dṛr̤h āni man
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Ramu had never heard mention of pain, the king cherished him like the tree of life, and day and night all his mothers guarded him as the eyelids guard the eyes, and as a serpent guards the jewel in its head, And now he is roaming on foot through the woods, with nothing to eat but wild roots and fruits. A curse on thee, Kaikeyi, root of all evil, thou hast undone my best beloved: cursed be my wretched self, that ocean of iniquity, on whose» account all these calamities have come to pass. God created me to disgrace my family, and my wicked mother has made me the ruin of my lord.” Hearing these words the Nishad affectionately implored him: “Why, my lord, make these vain laments? Rama is dear to you, and you are dear to Rama; even she is blameless: the blame rests with adverse fate.

The ways of adverse fate are cruel; it has made your mother mad, That every night Kama again and again broke out into respectful praise of you. There is no one so dearly beloved by lema as you. I declare this on oath: be assured that all will be well in the end, and take comfort to your soul.
Rama is omniscient, full of meekness, tenderness and compassion; of this make firm assurance in your heart; and come, take rest.”

sections.label: Doha 202
sections.name: प्रातक्रिया करि मातु पद बंदि गुरहि सिरु नाइ

verses.sa:
सखा बचन सुनि उर धरि धीरा ।
बास चले सुमिरत रघुबीरा ॥
verses.tr:
sakhā bacan suni ur dhari dhīrā
bās cale sumirat raghubīrā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
यह सुधि पाइ नगर नर नारी ।
चले बिलोकन आरत भारी ॥
verses.tr:
yah sudhi pāi nagar nar nārī
cale bilokan ārat bhārī

verses.sa:
परदखिना करि करहिं प्रनामा ।
देहिं कैकइहि खोरि निकामा ॥
verses.tr:
paradakhinā kari karahiṃ pranāmā
dehiṃ kaikaihi khori nikāmā

verses.sa:
भरी भरि बारि बिलोचन लेंहीं ।
बाम बिधाताहि दूषन देहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bharī bhari bāri bilocan leṃhīṃ
bām bidhātāhi dūṣan dehīṃ

verses.sa:
एक सराहहिं भरत सनेहू ।
कोउ कह नृपति निबाहेउ नेहू ॥
verses.tr:
ek sarāhahiṃ bharat sanehū
kou kah nṛpati nibāheu nehū

verses.sa:
निंदहिं आपु सराहि निषादहि ।
को कहि सकइ बिमोह बिषादहि ॥
verses.tr:
niṃdahiṃ āpu sarāhi niṣādahi
ko kahi sakai bimoh biṣādahi

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि राति लोगु सबु जागा ।
भा भिनुसार गुदारा लागा ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi rāti logu sabu jāgā
bhā bhinusār gudārā lāgā

verses.sa:
गुरहि सुनावँ चढ़ाइ सुहाईं ।
नईं नाव सब मातु चढ़ाईं ॥
verses.tr:
gurahi sunāvam̐ car̤hāi suhāīṃ
naīṃ nāv sab mātu car̤hāīṃ

verses.sa:
दंड चारि महँ भा सबु पारा ।
उतरि भरत तब सबहि सँभारा ॥
verses.tr:
daṃḍ cāri maham̐ bhā sabu pārā
utari bharat tab sabahi sam̐bhārā

verses.sa:
प्रातक्रिया करि मातु पद बंदि गुरहि सिरु नाइ ।
आगें किए निषाद गन दीन्हेउ कटकु चलाइ ॥
verses.tr:
prātakriyā kari mātu pad baṃdi gurahi siru nāi
āgeṃ kie niṣād gan dīnheu kaṭaku calāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Hearing his companion’s speech he took comfort and with his thoughts directed to Raghubir went to his tent. When the citizens were informed heavy with woe they too came to see. Having reverently paced around, they made obeisance and cursed Kaikeyi to their hearts’ content. Their eyes streamed with tears as they reproach the cruelty of fate. One would praise Bharat for his devotion, another would say the king had sown the greatest love; they reproached themselves and praised the Nishad: who can describe their agitation and distress? In this manner they all kept watch throughout the night and at daybreak began the passage. First the guru was put on a fine handsome boat, and then all the queens on another boat newly built. fu an hour and a half all had crossed over; as they came to land Bharat took count of them all.
After performing his morning rites and reverencing his mother's feet and bowing the head to the guru, he sent the Nisheds on ahead and started the host.

sections.label: Doha 203
sections.name: भरत तीसरे पहर कहँ कीन्ह प्रबेसु प्रयाग

verses.sa:
कियउ निषादनाथु अगुआईं ।
मातु पालकीं सकल चलाईं ॥
verses.tr:
kiyau niṣādanāthu aguāīṃ
mātu pālakīṃ sakal calāīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
साथ बोलाइ भाइ लघु दीन्हा ।
बिप्रन्ह सहित गवनु गुर कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
sāth bolāi bhāi laghu dīnhā
bipranh sahit gavanu gur kīnhā

verses.sa:
आपु सुरसरिहि कीन्ह प्रनामू ।
सुमिरे लखन सहित सिय रामू ॥
verses.tr:
āpu surasarihi kīnh pranāmū
sumire lakhan sahit siya rāmū

verses.sa:
गवने भरत पयोदेहिं पाए ।
कोतल संग जाहिं डोरिआए ॥
verses.tr:
gavane bharat payodehiṃ pāe
kotal saṃg jāhiṃ ḍoriāe

verses.sa:
कहहिं सुसेवक बारहिं बारा ।
होइअ नाथ अस्व असवारा ॥
verses.tr:
kahahiṃ susevak bārahiṃ bārā
hoia nāth asv asavārā

verses.sa:
रामु पयोदेहि पायँ सिधाए ।
हम कहँ रथ गज बाजि बनाए ॥
verses.tr:
rāmu payodehi pāyam̐ sidhāe
ham kaham̐ rath gaj bāji banāe

verses.sa:
सिर भर जाउँ उचित अस मोरा ।
सब तें सेवक धरमु कठोरा ॥
verses.tr:
sir bhar jāum̐ ucit as morā
sab teṃ sevak dharamu kaṭhorā

verses.sa:
देखि भरत गति सुनि मृदु बानी ।
सब सेवक गन गरहिं गलानी ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi bharat gati suni mṛdu bānī
sab sevak gan garahiṃ galānī

verses.sa:
भरत तीसरे पहर कहँ कीन्ह प्रबेसु प्रयाग ।
कहत राम सिय राम सिय उमगि उमगि अनुराग ॥
verses.tr:
bharat tīsare pahar kaham̐ kīnh prabesu prayāg
kahat rām siya rām siya umagi umagi anurāg
verses.head: दोहा

trans: He made the Nishad king lead the van and started all the queens in their palanquins. He charged his younger brother with their escort, and made guru go with the Brahmans. He himself bowed reverently to the Ganges, and invoking Rama, Sita and Lakshman, set forth on foot, while his horse was led by the bridle. Again and again his faithful servants cried: “Be pleased, my lord, to mount your horse.” “Rama,” he answered, ‘“ has gone on foot, and are chariots, elephants and horses made for me? It would be right for me to walk on my head; a servant’s work should always be the hardest.” When they saw his behaviour and heard his tender speech, all his servants melted away for pity.
At the third watch of the day Bharat entered Prayag, crying ‘O Rama, Sita; Rama, Sita!’ with irrepressible affection.

sections.label: Doha 204
sections.name: अरथ न धरम न काम रुचि गति न चहउँ निरबान

verses.sa:
झलका झलकत पायन्ह कैंसें ।
पंकज कोस ओस कन जैसें ॥
verses.tr:
jhalakā jhalakat pāyanh kaiṃseṃ
paṃkaj kos os kan jaiseṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भरत पयादेहिं आए आजू ।
भयउ दुखित सुनि सकल समाजू ॥
verses.tr:
bharat payādehiṃ āe ājū
bhayau dukhit suni sakal samājū

verses.sa:
खबरि लीन्ह सब लोग नहाए ।
कीन्ह प्रनामु त्रिबेनिहिं आए ॥
verses.tr:
khabari līnh sab log nahāe
kīnh pranāmu tribenihiṃ āe

verses.sa:
सबिधि सितासित नीर नहाने ।
दिए दान महिसुर सनमाने ॥
verses.tr:
sabidhi sitāsit nīr nahāne
die dān mahisur sanamāne

verses.sa:
देखत स्यामल धवल हलोरे ।
पुलकि सरीर भरत कर जोरे ॥
verses.tr:
dekhat syāmal dhaval halore
pulaki sarīr bharat kar jore

verses.sa:
सकल काम प्रद तीरथराऊ ।
बेद बिदित जग प्रगट प्रभाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
sakal kām prad tīratharāū
bed bidit jag pragaṭ prabhāū

verses.sa:
मागउँ भीख त्यागि निज धरमू ।
आरत काह न करइ कुकरमू ॥
verses.tr:
māgaum̐ bhīkh tyāgi nij dharamū
ārat kāh na karai kukaramū

verses.sa:
अस जियँ जानि सुजान सुदानी ।
सफल करहिं जग जाचक बानी ॥
verses.tr:
as jiyam̐ jāni sujān sudānī
saphal karahiṃ jag jācak bānī

verses.sa:
अरथ न धरम न काम रुचि गति न चहउँ निरबान ।
जनम जनम रति राम पद यह बरदानु न आन ॥
verses.tr:
arath na dharam na kām ruci gati na cahaum̐ nirabān
janam janam rati rām pad yah baradānu na ān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The blisters on his feet glistened like drops of dew on u lotus bud. The whole company were distressed, when they heard that Bharat had made the day’s march on foot.
