After ascertaining that all the people had bathed, he went and did homage to the threefold stream. All who had dipped in the parti-coloured flood gave alms and did honour to the Brahmans. As Bharat gazed on the commingling of the dark and white waves, his body throbbed with emotion and he clasped his hands in prayer: “O queen of the holy places, bounteous of every blessing, whose power is declared io the Vedas and renowned throughout the world, I abandon my proper calling and make myself a beggar: is there anything so vile that a man in distress will not doit? As I know you to be all-wise and beneficent, accomplish the prayer of thy suppliant.

I crave not wealth nor religious merit, nor voluptuous delights, nor deliverance from transmigration; but only that in every new birth I may persevere in love to Rama; this is the boon I beg, and nought else.

sections.label: Doha 205
sections.name: तनु पुलकेउ हियँ हरषु सुनि बेनि बचन अनुकूल

verses.sa:
जानहुँ रामु कुटिल करि मोही ।
लोग कहउ गुर साहिब द्रोही ॥
verses.tr:
jānahum̐ rāmu kuṭil kari mohī
log kahau gur sāhib drohī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सीता राम चरन रति मोरें ।
अनुदिन बढ़उ अनुग्रह तोरें ॥
verses.tr:
sītā rām caran rati moreṃ
anudin bar̤hau anugrah toreṃ

verses.sa:
जलदु जनम भरि सुरति बिसारउ ।
जाचत जलु पबि पाहन डारउ ॥
verses.tr:
jaladu janam bhari surati bisārau
jācat jalu pabi pāhan ḍārau

verses.sa:
चातकु रटनि घटें घटि जाई ।
बढ़े प्रेमु सब भाँति भलाई ॥
verses.tr:
cātaku raṭani ghaṭeṃ ghaṭi jāī
bar̤he premu sab bhām̐ti bhalāī

verses.sa:
कनकहिं बान चढ़इ जिमि दाहें ।
तिमि प्रियतम पद नेम निबाहें ॥
verses.tr:
kanakahiṃ bān car̤hai jimi dāheṃ
timi priyatam pad nem nibāheṃ

verses.sa:
भरत बचन सुनि माझ त्रिबेनी ।
भइ मृदु बानि सुमंगल देनी ॥
verses.tr:
bharat bacan suni mājh tribenī
bhai mṛdu bāni sumaṃgal denī

verses.sa:
तात भरत तुम्ह सब बिधि साधू ।
राम चरन अनुराग अगाधू ॥
verses.tr:
tāt bharat tumh sab bidhi sādhū
rām caran anurāg agādhū

verses.sa:
बाद गलानि करहु मन माहीं ।
तुम्ह सम रामहि कोउ प्रिय नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bād galāni karahu man māhīṃ
tumh sam rāmahi kou priya nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
तनु पुलकेउ हियँ हरषु सुनि बेनि बचन अनुकूल ।
भरत धन्य कहि धन्य सुर हरषित बरषहिं फूल ॥
verses.tr:
tanu pulakeu hiyam̐ haraṣu suni beni bacan anukūl
bharat dhanya kahi dhanya sur haraṣit baraṣahiṃ phūl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Rama knows my wickedness; the people call me the rain of my lord and master; through your favour may my devotion to the feet of Sita and Rama increase more and more every day. Though the cloud neglects her all her life, and while she begs for rain, casts down upon her thunder and hail, yet were the chatak to cease her impor-tunity, she would be despised; she perseveres in her affection, and is much honoured. Again, as the quality of gold is refined by the fire, so may my vow to the feet of my beloved endure through all tribulation.” In answer to Bharat’s speech there came a soft and auspicious voice from the midst of the Tribeni: “Son Bharat, you are altogether upright; your love to Rama’s feet is onfathomable; you distress yourself without cause; there is no one so dear to Rama as you are.”
As he heard the river’s gracious speech, Bharat’s body quivered with heartfelt gladness; the heaven resounded with shouts of applause, and the gods rained down flowers.

sections.label: Doha 206
sections.name: तुम्ह गलानि जियँ जनि करहु समुझी मातु करतूति

verses.sa:
प्रमुदित तीरथराज निवासी ।
बैखानस बटु गृही उदासी ॥
verses.tr:
pramudit tīratharāj nivāsī
baikhānas baṭu gṛhī udāsī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कहहिं परसपर मिलि दस पाँचा ।
भरत सनेह सीलु सुचि साँचा ॥
verses.tr:
kahahiṃ parasapar mili das pām̐cā
bharat saneh sīlu suci sām̐cā

verses.sa:
सुनत राम गुन ग्राम सुहाए ।
भरद्वाज मुनिबर पहिं आए ॥
verses.tr:
sunat rām gun grām suhāe
bharadvāj munibar pahiṃ āe

verses.sa:
दंड प्रनामु करत मुनि देखे ।
मूरतिमंत भाग्य निज लेखे ॥
verses.tr:
daṃḍ pranāmu karat muni dekhe
mūratimaṃt bhāgya nij lekhe

verses.sa:
धाइ उठाइ लाइ उर लीन्हे ।
दीन्हि असीस कृतारथ कीन्हे ॥
verses.tr:
dhāi uṭhāi lāi ur līnhe
dīnhi asīs kṛtārath kīnhe

verses.sa:
आसनु दीन्ह नाइ सिरु बैठे ।
चहत सकुच गृहँ जनु भजि पैठे ॥
verses.tr:
āsanu dīnh nāi siru baiṭhe
cahat sakuc gṛham̐ janu bhaji paiṭhe

verses.sa:
मुनि पूँछब कछु यह बड़ सोचू ।
बोले रिषि लखि सीलु सँकोचू ॥
verses.tr:
muni pūm̐chab kachu yah bar̤ socū
bole riṣi lakhi sīlu sam̐kocū

verses.sa:
सुनहु भरत हम सब सुधि पाई ।
बिधि करतब पर किछु न बसाई ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu bharat ham sab sudhi pāī
bidhi karatab par kichu na basāī

verses.sa:
तुम्ह गलानि जियँ जनि करहु समुझी मातु करतूति ।
तात कैकइहि दोसु नहिं गई गिरा मति धूति ॥
verses.tr:
tumh galāni jiyam̐ jani karahu samujhī mātu karatūti
tāt kaikaihi dosu nahiṃ gaī girā mati dhūti
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The inhabitants of Prayag, aged anchorites and boy students, householders and celibates, were all enraptured and said to one another as they met in groups: ‘Bharat’s, affection and amiability are thoroughly genuine.’ Still hearing of Rama’s many charming qualities, Bharat approached the great saint Bharadvaj. When the saint saw him prostrate himself upon the ground, he looked upon him as his own good angel incarnate, and ran and raised him up and took him to his arms and gave him the blessing he desired, and made him sit down. He bowed his head and sat, shrinking into the inmost recesses of shame-facedness; greatly distrest lest the saint should ask any question. Seeing hisconfusion the saint said: ‘Hearken,
Bharat; I have heard everything; God's doings are beyond our power.
Be not distrest at heart by the thought of what your mother has done. Son, it is no fault of Kaikeyi's; it was Sarasvati who stole away her senses.

sections.label: Doha 207
sections.name: अब अति कीन्हेहु भरत भल तुम्हहि उचित मत एहु

verses.sa:
यहउ कहत भल कहिहि न कोऊ ।
लोकु बेद बुध संमत दोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
yahau kahat bhal kahihi na koū
loku bed budh saṃmat doū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तात तुम्हार बिमल जसु गाई ।
पाइहि लोकउ बेदु बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
tāt tumhār bimal jasu gāī
pāihi lokau bedu bar̤āī

verses.sa:
लोक बेद संमत सबु कहई ।
जेहि पितु देइ राजु सो लहई ॥
verses.tr:
lok bed saṃmat sabu kahaī
jehi pitu dei rāju so lahaī

verses.sa:
राउ सत्यब्रत तुम्हहि बोलाई ।
देत राजु सुखु धरमु बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
rāu satyabrat tumhahi bolāī
det rāju sukhu dharamu bar̤āī

verses.sa:
राम गवनु बन अनरथ मूला ।
जो सुनि सकल बिस्व भइ सूला ॥
verses.tr:
rām gavanu ban anarath mūlā
jo suni sakal bisv bhai sūlā

verses.sa:
सो भावी बस रानि अयानी ।
करि कुचालि अंतहुँ पछितानी ॥
verses.tr:
so bhāvī bas rāni ayānī
kari kucāli aṃtahum̐ pachitānī

verses.sa:
तहँउँ तुम्हार अलप अपराधू ।
कहै सो अधम अयान असाधू ॥
verses.tr:
taham̐um̐ tumhār alap aparādhū
kahai so adham ayān asādhū

verses.sa:
करतेहु राजु त तुम्हहि न दोषू ।
रामहि होत सुनत संतोषू ॥
verses.tr:
karatehu rāju ta tumhahi na doṣū
rāmahi hot sunat saṃtoṣū

verses.sa:
अब अति कीन्हेहु भरत भल तुम्हहि उचित मत एहु ।
सकल सुमंगल मूल जग रघुबर चरन सनेहु ॥
verses.tr:
ab ati kīnhehu bharat bhal tumhahi ucit mat ehu
sakal sumaṃgal mūl jag raghubar caran sanehu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: If you say thus, ‘No one will excuse me;’ I reply, Scripture and the practice of the world are both accepted as authorities by the wise; and your glory, my son, will be sung unsullied, while the Veda and custom will both be honoured, for every one admits that this is according both to custom and the Veda that he takes the throne to whom his father gives it. The truthful king summoned you to confer upon you the honour of sovereignty and its higher duties. Rama’s banishment is a monstrous Wrong, which the whole world is grieved to hear of: but the queen was demented by the power of Fate, and in the end she has repented of the evil she has done. You are not the least in fault; whoever says you are is a vile and ignorant wretch. Had you reigned, it would have been no sin, and Rama would have been pleased to hear of it.
But now, Bharat, you have done still better; your present purpose is excellent; devotion to the feet of Raghubar is the root of every blessing in the world.

sections.label: Doha 208
sections.name: तुम्ह कहँ भरत कलंक यह हम सब कहँ उपदेसु

verses.sa:
सो तुम्हार धनु जीवनु प्राना ।
भूरिभाग को तुम्हहि समाना ॥
verses.tr:
so tumhār dhanu jīvanu prānā
bhūribhāg ko tumhahi samānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
यह तम्हार आचरजु न ताता ।
दसरथ सुअन राम प्रिय भ्राता ॥
verses.tr:
yah tamhār ācaraju na tātā
dasarath suan rām priya bhrātā

verses.sa:
सुनहु भरत रघुबर मन माहीं ।
पेम पात्रु तुम्ह सम कोउ नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu bharat raghubar man māhīṃ
pem pātru tumh sam kou nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
लखन राम सीतहि अति प्रीती ।
निसि सब तुम्हहि सराहत बीती ॥
verses.tr:
lakhan rām sītahi ati prītī
nisi sab tumhahi sarāhat bītī

verses.sa:
जाना मरमु नहात प्रयागा ।
मगन होहिं तुम्हरें अनुरागा ॥
verses.tr:
jānā maramu nahāt prayāgā
magan hohiṃ tumhareṃ anurāgā

verses.sa:
तुम्ह पर अस सनेहु रघुबर कें ।
सुख जीवन जग जस जड़ नर कें ॥
verses.tr:
tumh par as sanehu raghubar keṃ
sukh jīvan jag jas jar̤ nar keṃ

verses.sa:
यह न अधिक रघुबीर बड़ाई ।
प्रनत कुटुंब पाल रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
yah na adhik raghubīr bar̤āī
pranat kuṭuṃb pāl raghurāī

verses.sa:
तुम्ह तौ भरत मोर मत एहू ।
धरें देह जनु राम सनेहू ॥
verses.tr:
tumh tau bharat mor mat ehū
dhareṃ deh janu rām sanehū

verses.sa:
तुम्ह कहँ भरत कलंक यह हम सब कहँ उपदेसु ।
राम भगति रस सिद्धि हित भा यह समउ गनेसु ॥
verses.tr:
tumh kaham̐ bharat kalaṃk yah ham sab kaham̐ upadesu
rām bhagati ras siddhi hit bhā yah samau ganesu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: This is your wealth and the very breath of your life; is there any one with good fortune equal to yours Nor, my son, is it strange that you should act thus; you area son of Dasarath’s and Rama's own brother. Hearken, Bharat; in Rae ghupati’s heart there is no one upon whom so much love is lavished as upon you. Lakshman, Rama and Sita are all most fond of you; they spent the whole night in your praises. I learnt their secret when they came here to Pray4g to bathe; they were overwhelmed with love for you. Raghubar has as great affection for you asa fool has fora life of pleasure. And this is no great credit to Raghurai, who cherishes all his suppliants and their kin; while you, Bharat, as it seems to me, are the very incarnation of love to him.
That which seems a reproach to you, Bharat, is a lesson to all of us; it is an event which inaugurates a new flood of passionate devotion.

sections.label: Doha 209
sections.name: जासु सनेह सकोच बस राम प्रगट भए आइ

verses.sa:
नव बिधु बिमल तात जसु तोरा ।
रघुबर किंकर कुमुद चकोरा ॥
verses.tr:
nav bidhu bimal tāt jasu torā
raghubar kiṃkar kumud cakorā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
उदित सदा अँथइहि कबहूँ ना ।
घटिहि न जग नभ दिन दिन दूना ॥
verses.tr:
udit sadā am̐thaihi kabahūm̐ nā
ghaṭihi na jag nabh din din dūnā

verses.sa:
कोक तिलोक प्रीति अति करिही ।
प्रभु प्रताप रबि छबिहि न हरिही ॥
verses.tr:
kok tilok prīti ati karihī
prabhu pratāp rabi chabihi na harihī

verses.sa:
निसि दिन सुखद सदा सब काहू ।
ग्रसिहि न कैकइ करतबु राहू ॥
verses.tr:
nisi din sukhad sadā sab kāhū
grasihi na kaikai karatabu rāhū

verses.sa:
पूरन राम सुपेम पियूषा ।
गुर अवमान दोष नहिं दूषा ॥
verses.tr:
pūran rām supem piyūṣā
gur avamān doṣ nahiṃ dūṣā

verses.sa:
राम भगत अब अमिअँ अघाहूँ ।
कीन्हेहु सुलभ सुधा बसुधाहूँ ॥
verses.tr:
rām bhagat ab amiam̐ aghāhūm̐
kīnhehu sulabh sudhā basudhāhūm̐

verses.sa:
भूप भगीरथ सुरसरि आनी ।
सुमिरत सकल सुंमगल खानी ॥
verses.tr:
bhūp bhagīrath surasari ānī
sumirat sakal suṃmagal khānī

verses.sa:
दसरथ गुन गन बरनि न जाहीं ।
अधिकु कहा जेहि सम जग नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
dasarath gun gan barani na jāhīṃ
adhiku kahā jehi sam jag nāhīṃ

verses.sa: जासु सनेह सकोच बस राम प्रगट भए आइ ॥
verses.tr: jāsu saneh sakoc bas rām pragaṭ bhae āi
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: जे हर हिय नयननि कबहुँ निरखे नहीं अघाइ ॥
verses.tr: je har hiya nayanani kabahum̐ nirakhe nahīṃ aghāi

trans: Your glory, my son, is a newly created and spotless moon; its lotuses and partridges are Rama's servants; it is ever rising and never sets, nor wanes in the world its heaven, but increases day by day; the three spheres, like the chakwas are exceedingly enamoured of it, and the sun of Rama’s majesty never robs it of splendour, but by day as well as night it is ever bountiful to- all, and Kaikeyi’s evil deeds cannot eclipse it. Full of the nectar of devotion to Rama, and unsullied by any stain for wrong done to the gurul, you are saturated with the nectar of faith, and have brought this nectar within tlie reach of the whole world. King Bhagiratha brought down the Ganges, whose invocation is a mine of all prosperity; but Dasarath’s virtues are past all] telling; why say more? He has no equal in the world. -
Through his devotion and humility Rama was made manifest, whom the eyes of Siva’s heart are never wearied of beholdiog.

sections.label: Doha 210
sections.name: पुलक गात हियँ रामु सिय सजल सरोरुह नैन

verses.sa:
कीरति बिधु तुम्ह कीन्ह अनूपा ।
जहँ बस राम पेम मृगरूपा ॥
verses.tr:
kīrati bidhu tumh kīnh anūpā
jaham̐ bas rām pem mṛgarūpā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तात गलानि करहु जियँ जाएँ ।
डरहु दरिद्रहि पारसु पाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
tāt galāni karahu jiyam̐ jāem̐
ḍarahu daridrahi pārasu pāem̐

verses.sa:
सुनहु भरत हम झूठ न कहहीं ।
उदासीन तापस बन रहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu bharat ham jhūṭh na kahahīṃ
udāsīn tāpas ban rahahīṃ

verses.sa:
सब साधन कर सुफल सुहावा ।
लखन राम सिय दरसनु पावा ॥
verses.tr:
sab sādhan kar suphal suhāvā
lakhan rām siya darasanu pāvā

verses.sa:
तेहि फल कर फलु दरस तुम्हारा ।
सहित पयाग सुभाग हमारा ॥
verses.tr:
tehi phal kar phalu daras tumhārā
sahit payāg subhāg hamārā

verses.sa:
भरत धन्य तुम्ह जसु जगु जयऊ ।
कहि अस पेम मगन पुनि भयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
bharat dhanya tumh jasu jagu jayaū
kahi as pem magan puni bhayaū

verses.sa:
सुनि मुनि बचन सभासद हरषे ।
साधु सराहि सुमन सुर बरषे ॥
verses.tr:
suni muni bacan sabhāsad haraṣe
sādhu sarāhi suman sur baraṣe

verses.sa:
धन्य धन्य धुनि गगन पयागा ।
सुनि सुनि भरतु मगन अनुरागा ॥
verses.tr:
dhanya dhanya dhuni gagan payāgā
suni suni bharatu magan anurāgā

verses.sa:
पुलक गात हियँ रामु सिय सजल सरोरुह नैन ।
करि प्रनामु मुनि मंडलिहि बोले गदगद बैन ॥
verses.tr:
pulak gāt hiyam̐ rāmu siya sajal saroruh nain
kari pranāmu muni maṃḍalihi bole gadagad bain
verses.head: दोहा

trans: You have created an incomparable moon of glory, in which for the figure of the hare is stamped love to Rama. Cease, my son, from lamentation; you have found the philosopher's stone and yet fear poverty! Hearken, Bharat; I tell no falsehood; a hermit and ascetic dwelling in the forest, I obtained a glorious reward for all my good deeds when I beheld Rama, Sita and Lakshman; the fruit of that fruit is the sight of you: Praydg and I are both highly favoured. Bharat, I congratulate you; you have achieved universal renown.” So saying the saint was overwhelmed with emotion. As they hearkened to his words, the whole assembly rejoiced; the gods applauded his goodness and rained down flowers. Shouts of ‘Glory, Glory,’ resounded in poe and in Praydg; Bharat was lost in rapture at the sound.
With quivering body, with his heart full of Rama and Sita, and his lotus eyes flowing with tears, he bowed to the saintly assembly and thus spoke in faltering accents:

sections.label: Doha 211
sections.name: अजिन बसन फल असन महि सयन डासि कुस पात

verses.sa:
मुनि समाजु अरु तीरथराजू ।
साँचिहुँ सपथ अघाइ अकाजू ॥
verses.tr:
muni samāju aru tīratharājū
sām̐cihum̐ sapath aghāi akājū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
एहिं थल जौं किछु कहिअ बनाई ।
एहि सम अधिक न अघ अधमाई ॥
verses.tr:
ehiṃ thal jauṃ kichu kahia banāī
ehi sam adhik na agh adhamāī

verses.sa:
तुम्ह सर्बग्य कहउँ सतिभाऊ ।
उर अंतरजामी रघुराऊ ॥
verses.tr:
tumh sarbagya kahaum̐ satibhāū
ur aṃtarajāmī raghurāū

verses.sa:
मोहि न मातु करतब कर सोचू ।
नहिं दुखु जियँ जगु जानिहि पोचू ॥
verses.tr:
mohi na mātu karatab kar socū
nahiṃ dukhu jiyam̐ jagu jānihi pocū

verses.sa:
नाहिन डरु बिगरिहि परलोकू ।
पितहु मरन कर मोहि न सोकू ॥
verses.tr:
nāhin ḍaru bigarihi paralokū
pitahu maran kar mohi na sokū

verses.sa:
सुकृत सुजस भरि भुअन सुहाए ।
लछिमन राम सरिस सुत पाए ॥
verses.tr:
sukṛt sujas bhari bhuan suhāe
lachiman rām saris sut pāe

verses.sa:
राम बिरहँ तजि तनु छनभंगू ।
भूप सोच कर कवन प्रसंगू ॥
verses.tr:
rām biraham̐ taji tanu chanabhaṃgū
bhūp soc kar kavan prasaṃgū

verses.sa:
राम लखन सिय बिनु पग पनहीं ।
करि मुनि बेष फिरहिं बन बनही ॥
verses.tr:
rām lakhan siya binu pag panahīṃ
kari muni beṣ phirahiṃ ban banahī

verses.sa:
अजिन बसन फल असन महि सयन डासि कुस पात ।
बसि तरु तर नित सहत हिम आतप बरषा बात ॥
verses.tr:
ajin basan phal asan mahi sayan ḍāsi kus pāt
basi taru tar nit sahat him ātap baraṣā bāt
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “Ip a conolave of saints and in this so holy a place, truth must needs be spoken; any oath is superfinous and vain if insuch a spot I were to say anything false, no sin or vileness would equal mine. You are all-wise, and therefore I speak honestly; Rama, too, knows the secrets of the heart. Iam not grieved for what my mother has done, nor pained at heart lest the world deem me caitiff. I have no dread of the loss of heaven, no sorrow for my father’s death, whose good deeds and renown are glorious all the world over, who had such sons as Lakshman’ and Rama, and who, as soon as he lost Rama dropt his fragile body; why make long mourning for the king? But Rama, Lakshman and Sita, without shoes to their feet, in hermit’s dress, are wanderivg from wood to wood;
Clad in deer-skins, feeding on wild fruits, sleeping on the ground ona litter of grass and leaves, under trees, ever exposed to the inclemency of cold and heat and rain and wind.

sections.label: Doha 212
sections.name: करि प्रबोध मुनिबर कहेउ अतिथि पेमप्रिय होहु

verses.sa:
एहि दुख दाहँ दहइ दिन छाती ।
भूख न बासर नीद न राती ॥
verses.tr:
ehi dukh dāham̐ dahai din chātī
bhūkh na bāsar nīd na rātī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
एहि कुरोग कर औषधु नाहीं ।
सोधेउँ सकल बिस्व मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ehi kurog kar auṣadhu nāhīṃ
sodheum̐ sakal bisv man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
मातु कुमत बढ़ई अघ मूला ।
तेहिं हमार हित कीन्ह बँसूला ॥
verses.tr:
mātu kumat bar̤haī agh mūlā
tehiṃ hamār hit kīnh bam̐sūlā

verses.sa:
कलि कुकाठ कर कीन्ह कुजंत्रू ।
गाड़ि अवधि पढ़ि कठिन कुमंत्रु ॥
verses.tr:
kali kukāṭh kar kīnh kujaṃtrū
gār̤i avadhi par̤hi kaṭhin kumaṃtru

verses.sa:
मोहि लगि यहु कुठाटु तेहिं ठाटा ।
घालेसि सब जगु बारहबाटा ॥
verses.tr:
mohi lagi yahu kuṭhāṭu tehiṃ ṭhāṭā
ghālesi sab jagu bārahabāṭā

verses.sa:
मिटइ कुजोगु राम फिरि आएँ ।
बसइ अवध नहिं आन उपाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
miṭai kujogu rām phiri āem̐
basai avadh nahiṃ ān upāem̐

verses.sa:
भरत बचन सुनि मुनि सुखु पाई ।
सबहिं कीन्ह बहु भाँति बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
bharat bacan suni muni sukhu pāī
sabahiṃ kīnh bahu bhām̐ti bar̤āī

verses.sa:
तात करहु जनि सोचु बिसेषी ।
सब दुखु मिटहि राम पग देखी ॥
verses.tr:
tāt karahu jani socu biseṣī
sab dukhu miṭahi rām pag dekhī

verses.sa:
करि प्रबोध मुनिबर कहेउ अतिथि पेमप्रिय होहु ।
कंद मूल फल फूल हम देहिं लेहु करि छोहु ॥
verses.tr:
kari prabodh munibar kaheu atithi pemapriya hohu
kaṃd mūl phal phūl ham dehiṃ lehu kari chohu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: This is the burning pain that is ever consuming my breast, so that I cannot eat by day nor sleep by night. For this sore disease there is no remedy: I have searched in mind the whole world over. My mother’sevil counsel, the root of all calamity, like a carpenter fashioned an axe out of my advantage, made a handle of the ill-wood of Resentment, and fixed the term of banishment as it were a horrible spell. To me she applied this infamous contrivance and has hurled me down in wide-spreading ruin. These disasters will cease when Rama returns to live in Avadh; there is no other remedy.” When the saints heard Bharat’s speech, they were glad and all gave him high praise: ‘Son, grieve not so sorely: at the sight of Rama's feet all sorrow will pass away.”
The great saints comforted him:and said;: * Be our welcome guest: accept such herbs and roots and fruits as we can offer, and be content.”

sections.label: Doha 213
sections.name: राम बिरह ब्याकुल भरतु सानुज सहित समाज

verses.sa:
सुनि मुनि बचन भरत हिंय सोचू ।
भयउ कुअवसर कठिन सँकोचू ॥
verses.tr:
suni muni bacan bharat hiṃya socū
bhayau kuavasar kaṭhin sam̐kocū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जानि गरुइ गुर गिरा बहोरी ।
चरन बंदि बोले कर जोरी ॥
verses.tr:
jāni garui gur girā bahorī
caran baṃdi bole kar jorī

verses.sa:
सिर धरि आयसु करिअ तुम्हारा ।
परम धरम यहु नाथ हमारा ॥
verses.tr:
sir dhari āyasu karia tumhārā
param dharam yahu nāth hamārā

verses.sa:
भरत बचन मुनिबर मन भाए ।
सुचि सेवक सिष निकट बोलाए ॥
verses.tr:
bharat bacan munibar man bhāe
suci sevak siṣ nikaṭ bolāe

verses.sa:
चाहिए कीन्ह भरत पहुनाई ।
कंद मूल फल आनहु जाई ॥
verses.tr:
cāhie kīnh bharat pahunāī
kaṃd mūl phal ānahu jāī

verses.sa:
भलेहीं नाथ कहि तिन्ह सिर नाए ।
प्रमुदित निज निज काज सिधाए ॥
verses.tr:
bhalehīṃ nāth kahi tinh sir nāe
pramudit nij nij kāj sidhāe

verses.sa:
मुनिहि सोच पाहुन बड़ नेवता ।
तसि पूजा चाहिअ जस देवता ॥
verses.tr:
munihi soc pāhun bar̤ nevatā
tasi pūjā cāhia jas devatā

verses.sa:
सुनि रिधि सिधि अनिमादिक आई ।
आयसु होइ सो करहिं गोसाई ॥
verses.tr:
suni ridhi sidhi animādik āī
āyasu hoi so karahiṃ gosāī

verses.sa:
राम बिरह ब्याकुल भरतु सानुज सहित समाज ।
पहुनाई करि हरहु श्रम कहा मुदित मुनिराज ॥
verses.tr:
rām birah byākul bharatu sānuj sahit samāj
pahunāī kari harahu śram kahā mudit munirāj
verses.head: दोहा

trans: On hearing the saints’ words Bharat was troubled at heart; the time was not onefor feasting, and yet he was very loth to decline. At last, reflecting that a guru’s command is imperative, he kissed his feet and replied with clasped hands: “I must needs bow to your bebest, for this, my lord, is my highest duty.” The great saint was pleased at Bharat’s words and called up all his trusty servants: ‘An entertainment must be provided for Bharat: go and gather herbs, roots and fruits.” They bowed the head and said ‘Certainly, my lord,’ and gladly set about each his own work. But the saint thought to himself: “I have invited a distinguished guest, who should be treated likea god.” At his command Anima and the other good Fairies came: “What are your orders, master, and we obey.”
“‘ Bharat and his brother and all their. host are distrest by the loss of Rama; show them hospitality and ease them of their toil;” thus cheerily spoke the great saint.

sections.label: Doha 214
sections.name: बहुरि सपरिजन भरत कहुँ रिषि अस आयसु दीन्ह

verses.sa:
रिधि सिधि सिर धरि मुनिबर बानी ।
बड़भागिनि आपुहि अनुमानी ॥
verses.tr:
ridhi sidhi sir dhari munibar bānī
bar̤abhāgini āpuhi anumānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कहहिं परसपर सिधि समुदाई ।
अतुलित अतिथि राम लघु भाई ॥
verses.tr:
kahahiṃ parasapar sidhi samudāī
atulit atithi rām laghu bhāī

verses.sa:
मुनि पद बंदि करिअ सोइ आजू ।
होइ सुखी सब राज समाजू ॥
verses.tr:
muni pad baṃdi karia soi ājū
hoi sukhī sab rāj samājū

verses.sa:
अस कहि रचेउ रुचिर गृह नाना ।
जेहि बिलोकि बिलखाहिं बिमाना ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi raceu rucir gṛh nānā
jehi biloki bilakhāhiṃ bimānā

verses.sa:
भोग बिभूति भूरि भरि राखे ।
देखत जिन्हहि अमर अभिलाषे ॥
verses.tr:
bhog bibhūti bhūri bhari rākhe
dekhat jinhahi amar abhilāṣe

verses.sa:
दासीं दास साजु सब लीन्हें ।
जोगवत रहहिं मनहि मनु दीन्हें ॥
verses.tr:
dāsīṃ dās sāju sab līnheṃ
jogavat rahahiṃ manahi manu dīnheṃ

verses.sa:
सब समाजु सजि सिधि पल माहीं ।
जे सुख सुरपुर सपनेहुँ नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sab samāju saji sidhi pal māhīṃ
je sukh surapur sapanehum̐ nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
प्रथमहिं बास दिए सब केही ।
सुंदर सुखद जथा रुचि जेही ॥
verses.tr:
prathamahiṃ bās die sab kehī
suṃdar sukhad jathā ruci jehī

verses.sa:
बहुरि सपरिजन भरत कहुँ रिषि अस आयसु दीन्ह ।
बिधि बिसमय दायकु बिभव मुनिबर तपबल कीन्ह ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri saparijan bharat kahum̐ riṣi as āyasu dīnh
bidhi bisamaya dāyaku bibhav munibar tapabal kīnh
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The Fairies bowed to his commands and thought themselves most highly favoured, saying one to another: Rama's brother is indeed a guest beyond compare.” Then kissing the saint’s feet, ‘To-day we will do such things that the whole of the king’s party shall be pleased.” So saying, a number of such charming pavilions were erected, that the equipages of the gods were put out of countenance at the sigh of them. They were furnished with so much luxury and magnificence that the immortals beheld them longingly. Men-servants and maid-servants with every appliance were in attendance and gave their whole mind to their work. In an instant of time the Fairies completed all the arrangements though no dream of heaven was ever so beautiful. First the people were assigned their quarters, all bright and pleasant and in accordance with their taste.
Then, as the saint had ordered, Bharat ‘and his family had theirs assigned them, which astonished even the Creator

sections.label: Doha 215
sections.name: संपत चकई भरतु चक मुनि आयस खेलवार

verses.sa:
मुनि प्रभाउ जब भरत बिलोका ।
सब लघु लगे लोकपति लोका ॥
verses.tr:
muni prabhāu jab bharat bilokā
sab laghu lage lokapati lokā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुख समाजु नहिं जाइ बखानी ।
देखत बिरति बिसारहीं ग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
sukh samāju nahiṃ jāi bakhānī
dekhat birati bisārahīṃ gyānī

verses.sa:
आसन सयन सुबसन बिताना ।
बन बाटिका बिहग मृग नाना ॥
verses.tr:
āsan sayan subasan bitānā
ban bāṭikā bihag mṛg nānā

verses.sa:
सुरभि फूल फल अमिअ समाना ।
बिमल जलासय बिबिध बिधाना ॥
verses.tr:
surabhi phūl phal amia samānā
bimal jalāsaya bibidh bidhānā

verses.sa:
असन पान सुच अमिअ अमी से ।
देखि लोग सकुचात जमी से ॥
verses.tr:
asan pān suc amia amī se
dekhi log sakucāt jamī se

verses.sa:
सुर सुरभी सुरतरु सबही कें ।
लखि अभिलाषु सुरेस सची कें ॥
verses.tr:
sur surabhī surataru sabahī keṃ
lakhi abhilāṣu sures sacī keṃ

verses.sa:
रितु बसंत बह त्रिबिध बयारी ।
सब कहँ सुलभ पदारथ चारी ॥
verses.tr:
ritu basaṃt bah tribidh bayārī
sab kaham̐ sulabh padārath cārī

verses.sa:
स्त्रक चंदन बनितादिक भोगा ।
देखि हरष बिसमय बस लोगा ॥
verses.tr:
strak caṃdan banitādik bhogā
dekhi haraṣ bisamaya bas logā

verses.sa: संपत चकई भरतु चक मुनि आयस खेलवार ॥
verses.tr: saṃpat cakaī bharatu cak muni āyas khelavār
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: तेहि निसि आश्रम पिंजराँ राखे भा भिनुसार ॥
verses.tr: tehi nisi āśram piṃjarām̐ rākhe bhā bhinusār

trans: by their snagnificence; so great the power of the holy ascetic’s penance.

When Bharat beheld the saint’s power, the realms of all the rulers of the spheres seem tohim as trifles. The luxuries that had been prepared cannot be described; any philosopher would forget his self-restraint on seeing them. Thrones, couches, drapery and canopies; groves’ and i gardens; birds and beasts; sweet-scented flowers, fruits like nectar, and many a lake of limpid water; with luscious food and drinks of innumerable kinds, so that the people Were quite put out of countenance by what they saw, as though they had been ascetics. uch one had as it were his own cow of plenty and tree of paradise. Indra and Sachi grew covetous atthe sight. The season, spring Pr (alla -air soft, cool, and fragrant; all the great obj-cts life ready at hand; garlands, perfumes, dancing-gies and delights of every kind to charm and astonish the speStator..
Aftluence, like the chakwi', and Bharat as her mate, by 2 compulsion of the saint’s order were prisoned together that 7 \ night, as by a fowler, in the cage of the hermitage, ge” \, dawn broke. ‘,

sections.label: Doha 216
sections.name: किएँ जाहिं छाया जलद सुखद बहइ बर बात

verses.sa:
कीन्ह निमज्जनु तीरथराजा ।
नाइ मुनिहि सिरु सहित समाजा ॥
verses.tr:
kīnh nimajjanu tīratharājā
nāi munihi siru sahit samājā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
रिषि आयसु असीस सिर राखी ।
करि दंडवत बिनय बहु भाषी ॥
verses.tr:
riṣi āyasu asīs sir rākhī
kari daṃḍavat binaya bahu bhāṣī

verses.sa:
पथ गति कुसल साथ सब लीन्हे ।
चले चित्रकूटहिं चितु दीन्हें ॥
verses.tr:
path gati kusal sāth sab līnhe
cale citrakūṭahiṃ citu dīnheṃ

verses.sa:
रामसखा कर दीन्हें लागू ।
चलत देह धरि जनु अनुरागू ॥
verses.tr:
rāmasakhā kar dīnheṃ lāgū
calat deh dhari janu anurāgū

verses.sa:
नहिं पद त्रान सीस नहिं छाया ।
पेमु नेमु ब्रतु धरमु अमाया ॥
verses.tr:
nahiṃ pad trān sīs nahiṃ chāyā
pemu nemu bratu dharamu amāyā

verses.sa:
लखन राम सिय पंथ कहानी ।
पूँछत सखहि कहत मृदु बानी ॥
verses.tr:
lakhan rām siya paṃth kahānī
pūm̐chat sakhahi kahat mṛdu bānī

verses.sa:
राम बास थल बिटप बिलोकें ।
उर अनुराग रहत नहिं रोकैं ॥
verses.tr:
rām bās thal biṭap bilokeṃ
ur anurāg rahat nahiṃ rokaiṃ

verses.sa:
दैखि दसा सुर बरिसहिं फूला ।
भइ मृदु महि मगु मंगल मूला ॥
verses.tr:
daikhi dasā sur barisahiṃ phūlā
bhai mṛdu mahi magu maṃgal mūlā

verses.sa:
किएँ जाहिं छाया जलद सुखद बहइ बर बात ।
तस मगु भयउ न राम कहँ जस भा भरतहि जात ॥
verses.tr:
kiem̐ jāhiṃ chāyā jalad sukhad bahai bar bāt
tas magu bhayau na rām kaham̐ jas bhā bharatahi jāt
verses.head: दोहा

Then taking guides well acquainted with the road, he set out reso et: — kat; sapported on the arm ofARama’s Erien [ie seemed,—a he went, the very incarnation of Love. sections.label: Doha 217
sections.name: रामु सँकोची प्रेम बस भरत सपेम पयोधि

verses.sa:
जड़ चेतन मग जीव घनेरे ।
जे चितए प्रभु जिन्ह प्रभु हेरे ॥
verses.tr:
jar̤ cetan mag jīv ghanere
je citae prabhu jinh prabhu here
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
ते सब भए परम पद जोगू ।
भरत दरस मेटा भव रोगू ॥
verses.tr:
te sab bhae param pad jogū
bharat daras meṭā bhav rogū

verses.sa:
यह बड़ि बात भरत कइ नाहीं ।
सुमिरत जिनहि रामु मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
yah bar̤i bāt bharat kai nāhīṃ
sumirat jinahi rāmu man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
बारक राम कहत जग जेऊ ।
होत तरन तारन नर तेऊ ॥
verses.tr:
bārak rām kahat jag jeū
hot taran tāran nar teū

verses.sa:
भरतु राम प्रिय पुनि लघु भ्राता ।
कस न होइ मगु मंगलदाता ॥
verses.tr:
bharatu rām priya puni laghu bhrātā
kas na hoi magu maṃgaladātā

verses.sa:
सिद्ध साधु मुनिबर अस कहहीं ।
भरतहि निरखि हरषु हियँ लहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
siddh sādhu munibar as kahahīṃ
bharatahi nirakhi haraṣu hiyam̐ lahahīṃ

verses.sa:
देखि प्रभाउ सुरेसहि सोचू ।
जगु भल भलेहि पोच कहुँ पोचू ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi prabhāu suresahi socū
jagu bhal bhalehi poc kahum̐ pocū

verses.sa:
गुर सन कहेउ करिअ प्रभु सोई ।
रामहि भरतहि भेंट न होई ॥
verses.tr:
gur san kaheu karia prabhu soī
rāmahi bharatahi bheṃṭ na hoī

verses.sa:
रामु सँकोची प्रेम बस भरत सपेम पयोधि ।
बनी बात बेगरन चहति करिअ जतनु छलु सोधि ॥
verses.tr:
rāmu sam̐kocī prem bas bharat sapem payodhi
banī bāt begaran cahati karia jatanu chalu sodhi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: All created things, whether living or lifeless, that saw the Lord, or were seen by him, were rendered fit for salvation, and the sight of Bharat has now healed them of the curse of transmigration! This is no great thing for Bharat, whom Rema is mindful to remember. A single mention of the name of Rama on earth makes a man safe and a saviour of others. But Bharat is Rama’s beloved and own brother; why should he not bring a blessing-on the road he treads? As saints, sages and hermits thus reasoned and gazed upon Bharat, they rejoiced at heart Indra was troubled by the sight of his power: ‘In the world things turn out well for the good and badly for the bad.” Then turning to his guru (Vrihaspati), “Something must be done, sir, to prevent the meeting between Rama and Bharat.
Rama is so modest and sympathetic, and Bharat such an ocean of affection; our scheme threatens to be spoilt; we must bestir ourselves and devise some new stratagem.”

sections.label: Doha 218
sections.name: मनहुँ न आनिअ अमरपति रघुबर भगत अकाजु

verses.sa:
बचन सुनत सुरगुरु मुसकाने ।
सहसनयन बिनु लोचन जाने ॥
verses.tr:
bacan sunat suraguru musakāne
sahasanayan binu locan jāne
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मायापति सेवक सन माया ।
करइ त उलटि परइ सुरराया ॥
verses.tr:
māyāpati sevak san māyā
karai ta ulaṭi parai surarāyā

verses.sa:
तब किछु कीन्ह राम रुख जानी ।
अब कुचालि करि होइहि हानी ॥
verses.tr:
tab kichu kīnh rām rukh jānī
ab kucāli kari hoihi hānī

verses.sa:
सुनु सुरेस रघुनाथ सुभाऊ ।
निज अपराध रिसाहिं न काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
sunu sures raghunāth subhāū
nij aparādh risāhiṃ na kāū

verses.sa:
जो अपराधु भगत कर करई ।
राम रोष पावक सो जरई ॥
verses.tr:
jo aparādhu bhagat kar karaī
rām roṣ pāvak so jaraī

verses.sa:
लोकहुँ बेद बिदित इतिहासा ।
यह महिमा जानहिं दुरबासा ॥
verses.tr:
lokahum̐ bed bidit itihāsā
yah mahimā jānahiṃ durabāsā

verses.sa:
भरत सरिस को राम सनेही ।
जगु जप राम रामु जप जेही ॥
verses.tr:
bharat saris ko rām sanehī
jagu jap rām rāmu jap jehī

verses.sa:
मनहुँ न आनिअ अमरपति रघुबर भगत अकाजु ।
अजसु लोक परलोक दुख दिन दिन सोक समाजु ॥
verses.tr:
manahum̐ na ānia amarapati raghubar bhagat akāju
ajasu lok paralok dukh din din sok samāju
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Hearing the speech, the teacher of the gods smiled, to find the thousand-eyed so blind, and said: * Leave tricks alone; it will be all trouble in vain; any deception here would be absurd. O king of heaven, any delusion practised on a servant of the lord of delusion must recoil on the contriver. I inter-fered once, knowing it was Rama's wish, but any under-band work now would only do harm. Listen, O king: it is Rama's nature never to be angry at any sin against himself, but whoever sins against one of his servants is consumed in the fire of his wrath. Popular tradition and the
Vedas abound in such legends; Durvasas knows well this great trait in his character. Andis there any one so faithful to Rama and Bharat, who is ever repeating Rama’s name and Rama his?
Think not, lord of the immortals, to injure any servant of Raghubar's, unless you would suffer the pain of disgrace in this world, sorrow in the next, and a daily increasing burden of regret.

sections.label: Doha 219
sections.name: राम भगत परहित निरत पर दुख दुखी दयाल

verses.sa:
सुनु सुरेस उपदेसु हमारा ।
रामहि सेवकु परम पिआरा ॥
verses.tr:
sunu sures upadesu hamārā
rāmahi sevaku param piārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मानत सुखु सेवक सेवकाई ।
सेवक बैर बैरु अधिकाई ॥
verses.tr:
mānat sukhu sevak sevakāī
sevak bair bairu adhikāī

verses.sa:
जद्यपि सम नहिं राग न रोषू ।
गहहिं न पाप पूनु गुन दोषू ॥
verses.tr:
jadyapi sam nahiṃ rāg na roṣū
gahahiṃ na pāp pūnu gun doṣū

verses.sa:
करम प्रधान बिस्व करि राखा ।
जो जस करइ सो तस फलु चाखा ॥
verses.tr:
karam pradhān bisv kari rākhā
jo jas karai so tas phalu cākhā

verses.sa:
तदपि करहिं सम बिषम बिहारा ।
भगत अभगत हृदय अनुसारा ॥
verses.tr:
tadapi karahiṃ sam biṣam bihārā
bhagat abhagat hṛdaya anusārā

verses.sa:
अगुन अलेप अमान एकरस ।
रामु सगुन भए भगत पेम बस ॥
verses.tr:
agun alep amān ekaras
rāmu sagun bhae bhagat pem bas

verses.sa:
राम सदा सेवक रुचि राखी ।
बेद पुरान साधु सुर साखी ॥
verses.tr:
rām sadā sevak ruci rākhī
bed purān sādhu sur sākhī

verses.sa:
अस जियँ जानि तजहु कुटिलाई ।
करहु भरत पद प्रीति सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
as jiyam̐ jāni tajahu kuṭilāī
karahu bharat pad prīti suhāī

verses.sa:
राम भगत परहित निरत पर दुख दुखी दयाल ।
भगत सिरोमनि भरत तें जनि डरपहु सुरपाल ॥
verses.tr:
rām bhagat parahit nirat par dukh dukhī dayāl
bhagat siromani bharat teṃ jani ḍarapahu surapāl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Hearken to my advice, king of the gods: Rama has the greatest love for his servants; he is pleased ut any service done toa servant, while enmity to a servant is the height of enmity himself. Although ne is ever the same, without either passion or anger, and contracts neither sin nor merit, virtue nor defect; and though he has made fate the sovereign of the universe, and every one has to taste the fruit of his own actions, still he plays at variations according as heartsare faithful or unfaithful. Though without attributes or form, illimitable and impossible, Rama has yielded to the love of his followers and taken a material) form. He has always regarded the wishes of his servants, as the Vedas and Pur^nas and gods and saints bear witness. Knowing this, refrain from oaughtiness and show Fitting devotion.
Any worshipper of Rama is zealous for the good of others, sorrows, with the sorrowful, and is full of compassion; then fear not Bharat, O king, who is the crown of worsbip-

sections.label: Doha 220
sections.name: रघुबर बरन बिलोकि बर बारि समेत समाज

verses.sa:
सत्यसंध प्रभु सुर हितकारी ।
भरत राम आयस अनुसारी ॥
verses.tr:
satyasaṃdh prabhu sur hitakārī
bharat rām āyas anusārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
स्वारथ बिबस बिकल तुम्ह होहू ।
भरत दोसु नहिं राउर मोहू ॥
verses.tr:
svārath bibas bikal tumh hohū
bharat dosu nahiṃ rāur mohū

verses.sa:
सुनि सुरबर सुरगुर बर बानी ।
भा प्रमोदु मन मिटी गलानी ॥
verses.tr:
suni surabar suragur bar bānī
bhā pramodu man miṭī galānī

verses.sa:
बरषि प्रसून हरषि सुरराऊ ।
लगे सराहन भरत सुभाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
baraṣi prasūn haraṣi surarāū
lage sarāhan bharat subhāū

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि भरत चले मग जाहीं ।
दसा देखि मुनि सिद्ध सिहाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi bharat cale mag jāhīṃ
dasā dekhi muni siddh sihāhīṃ

verses.sa:
जबहिं रामु कहि लेहिं उसासा ।
उमगत पेमु मनहँ चहु पासा ॥
verses.tr:
jabahiṃ rāmu kahi lehiṃ usāsā
umagat pemu manaham̐ cahu pāsā

verses.sa:
द्रवहिं बचन सुनि कुलिस पषाना ।
पुरजन पेमु न जाइ बखाना ॥
verses.tr:
dravahiṃ bacan suni kulis paṣānā
purajan pemu na jāi bakhānā

verses.sa:
बीच बास करि जमुनहिं आए ।
निरखि नीरु लोचन जल छाए ॥
verses.tr:
bīc bās kari jamunahiṃ āe
nirakhi nīru locan jal chāe

verses.sa:
रघुबर बरन बिलोकि बर बारि समेत समाज ।
होत मगन बारिधि बिरह चढ़े बिबेक जहाज ॥
verses.tr:
raghubar baran biloki bar bāri samet samāj
hot magan bāridhi birah car̤he bibek jahāj
verses.head: दोहा

trans: pers. Chaupdi. The lord is an ocean of truth and a well-wisher of the

gods, and Bharat obeys his orders. You are troubled by your own selfishness; there is no fault in Bharat: it is a delusion on your part.!”” When the great god heard the words of the heavenly preceptor he got understanding and his anxiety passed away. In his joy he rained down flowers and began to extol Bharat’s good qualities. In this manner Bharat went on his way, while saints and sages looked and praised. Whenever he sighed Rama’s name, it seemed like the babbling over of love. Thunderbolts and stones melted at his words; as for the people, their emotion is beyond description. Encampiog half-way, he came to the Jamuna, and as he gazed on its water his-eyes filled with tears.
As he and his retinue gazed on the lovely stream, the

sections.label: Doha 221
sections.name: मगबासी नर नारि सुनि धाम काम तजि धाइ

verses.sa:
जमुन तीर तेहि दिन करि बासू ।
भयउ समय सम सबहि सुपासू ॥
verses.tr:
jamun tīr tehi din kari bāsū
bhayau samaya sam sabahi supāsū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
रातहिं घाट घाट की तरनी ।
आईं अगनित जाहिं न बरनी ॥
verses.tr:
rātahiṃ ghāṭ ghāṭ kī taranī
āīṃ aganit jāhiṃ na baranī

verses.sa:
प्रात पार भए एकहि खेंवाँ ।
तोषे रामसखा की सेवाँ ॥
verses.tr:
prāt pār bhae ekahi kheṃvām̐
toṣe rāmasakhā kī sevām̐

verses.sa:
चले नहाइ नदिहि सिर नाई ।
साथ निषादनाथ दोउ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
cale nahāi nadihi sir nāī
sāth niṣādanāth dou bhāī

verses.sa:
आगें मुनिबर बाहन आछें ।
राजसमाज जाइ सबु पाछें ॥
verses.tr:
āgeṃ munibar bāhan ācheṃ
rājasamāj jāi sabu pācheṃ

verses.sa:
तेहिं पाछें दोउ बंधु पयादें ।
भूषन बसन बेष सुठि सादें ॥
verses.tr:
tehiṃ pācheṃ dou baṃdhu payādeṃ
bhūṣan basan beṣ suṭhi sādeṃ

verses.sa:
सेवक सुह्रद सचिवसुत साथा ।
सुमिरत लखनु सीय रघुनाथा ॥
verses.tr:
sevak suhrad sacivasut sāthā
sumirat lakhanu sīya raghunāthā

verses.sa:
जहँ जहँ राम बास बिश्रामा ।
तहँ तहँ करहिं सप्रेम प्रनामा ॥
verses.tr:
jaham̐ jaham̐ rām bās biśrāmā
taham̐ taham̐ karahiṃ saprem pranāmā

verses.sa:
मगबासी नर नारि सुनि धाम काम तजि धाइ ।
देखि सरूप सनेह सब मुदित जनम फलु पाइ ॥
verses.tr:
magabāsī nar nāri suni dhām kām taji dhāi
dekhi sarūp saneh sab mudit janam phalu pāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: colour of Rama’s body, he was. plunged into a sea of desolation, till he climbed the boat of discretion. Chaupdi.

That day he halted on the bank of the Jamuna, giving every one time for what they had to do. In the night boats came from all the ghats in greater number than could be counted. At daybreak all crossed in a single trip. The good service of Rama’s companion pleased him greatly. After bathing and bowing to the river, he again set forth with the Nishad king and Satrughna. First: of all in his glorious car went the great saint, followed by all the royal host; after them the two brothers on foot; their dress, apparel and ornaments all of the very simplest. With them their servants and friend and the minister's son, invoking Lakshman, Sita and Rama, Any spot wherever Rema had encamped or rested they lovingly saluted.
At the news, the dwellers by the roadside left their household work and ran after them; seeing his form, they were overcome with love and joy and had their life’s reward.

sections.label: Doha 222
sections.name: चलत पयादें खात फल पिता दीन्ह तजि राजु

verses.sa:
कहहिं सपेम एक एक पाहीं ।
रामु लखनु सखि होहिं कि नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kahahiṃ sapem ek ek pāhīṃ
rāmu lakhanu sakhi hohiṃ ki nāhīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बय बपु बरन रूप सोइ आली ।
सीलु सनेहु सरिस सम चाली ॥
verses.tr:
baya bapu baran rūp soi ālī
sīlu sanehu saris sam cālī

verses.sa:
बेषु न सो सखि सीय न संगा ।
आगें अनी चली चतुरंगा ॥
verses.tr:
beṣu na so sakhi sīya na saṃgā
āgeṃ anī calī caturaṃgā

verses.sa:
नहिं प्रसन्न मुख मानस खेदा ।
सखि संदेहु होइ एहिं भेदा ॥
verses.tr:
nahiṃ prasann mukh mānas khedā
sakhi saṃdehu hoi ehiṃ bhedā

verses.sa:
तासु तरक तियगन मन मानी ।
कहहिं सकल तेहि सम न सयानी ॥
verses.tr:
tāsu tarak tiyagan man mānī
kahahiṃ sakal tehi sam na sayānī

verses.sa:
तेहि सराहि बानी फुरि पूजी ।
बोली मधुर बचन तिय दूजी ॥
verses.tr:
tehi sarāhi bānī phuri pūjī
bolī madhur bacan tiya dūjī

verses.sa:
कहि सपेम सब कथाप्रसंगू ।
जेहि बिधि राम राज रस भंगू ॥
verses.tr:
kahi sapem sab kathāprasaṃgū
jehi bidhi rām rāj ras bhaṃgū

verses.sa:
भरतहि बहुरि सराहन लागी ।
सील सनेह सुभाय सुभागी ॥
verses.tr:
bharatahi bahuri sarāhan lāgī
sīl saneh subhāya subhāgī

verses.sa:
चलत पयादें खात फल पिता दीन्ह तजि राजु ।
जात मनावन रघुबरहि भरत सरिस को आजु ॥
verses.tr:
calat payādeṃ khāt phal pitā dīnh taji rāju
jāt manāvan raghubarahi bharat saris ko āju
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Lovingly one said to another: ‘Friend, are they Rama and Lakshman, or not? In age, figure, complexion and beauty they are the same, dear girl, and resemble them in an equally affectionate disposition. But their dress is. not the same, friend, nor is Sita with them, and before them marches 8 vast host of horse and foot, elephants and chariots. Nor are they glad of countenance, but have some sorrow at heart; from this difference, friend, a doubt arises.” The women were persuaded by her arguments and cried: There is no one go clever as you.” After praising her and admiring the truth of her remarks, another woman spoke in winning tones, and lovingly related the whole history, how Rama had Lost the delights of empire; and again set to praising Bharat for his affectionate disposition and happy natare.:.
‘He travels on foot, feeding only on wild fruits, and abandoning the crown given him by his father, is going to ama to persuade him to return; is there any one at the present day like Bharat?

sections.label: Doha 223
sections.name: भरत दरसु देखत खुलेउ मग लोगन्ह कर भागु

verses.sa:
भायप भगति भरत आचरनू ।
कहत सुनत दुख दूषन हरनू ॥
verses.tr:
bhāyap bhagati bharat ācaranū
kahat sunat dukh dūṣan haranū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जो कछु कहब थोर सखि सोई ।
राम बंधु अस काहे न होई ॥
verses.tr:
jo kachu kahab thor sakhi soī
rām baṃdhu as kāhe na hoī

verses.sa:
हम सब सानुज भरतहि देखें ।
भइन्ह धन्य जुबती जन लेखें ॥
verses.tr:
ham sab sānuj bharatahi dekheṃ
bhainh dhanya jubatī jan lekheṃ

verses.sa:
सुनि गुन देखि दसा पछिताहीं ।
कैकइ जननि जोगु सुतु नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
suni gun dekhi dasā pachitāhīṃ
kaikai janani jogu sutu nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
कोउ कह दूषनु रानिहि नाहिन ।
बिधि सबु कीन्ह हमहि जो दाहिन ॥
verses.tr:
kou kah dūṣanu rānihi nāhin
bidhi sabu kīnh hamahi jo dāhin

verses.sa:
कहँ हम लोक बेद बिधि हीनी ।
लघु तिय कुल करतूति मलीनी ॥
verses.tr:
kaham̐ ham lok bed bidhi hīnī
laghu tiya kul karatūti malīnī

verses.sa:
बसहिं कुदेस कुगाँव कुबामा ।
कहँ यह दरसु पुन्य परिनामा ॥
verses.tr:
basahiṃ kudes kugām̐v kubāmā
kaham̐ yah darasu punya parināmā

verses.sa:
अस अनंदु अचिरिजु प्रति ग्रामा ।
जनु मरुभूमि कलपतरु जामा ॥
verses.tr:
as anaṃdu aciriju prati grāmā
janu marubhūmi kalapataru jāmā

verses.sa:
भरत दरसु देखत खुलेउ मग लोगन्ह कर भागु ।
जनु सिंघलबासिन्ह भयउ बिधि बस सुलभ प्रयागु ॥
verses.tr:
bharat darasu dekhat khuleu mag loganh kar bhāgu
janu siṃghalabāsinh bhayau bidhi bas sulabh prayāgu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: _ To tell and hear of Bharat’s brotherly devotion and his course of action dispels all sin and sorrow. Anything that I can say, friend, is all too little; he is Rama's brother; how could he be different from what he is All of us who have seen him and Satrughna have truly become blessed among women.” Hearing his virtues and seeing his forlorn state they lamented; ‘' He is not a fit son for such a mother as Kaikeyi.’ (One said: ‘It is no blame to the queen that God has been so kind to us. What are we, outcasts from the world and the Veda, women of low birth and mean livelihood, whose home is a wretched hovel in some poor village of this miserable country, that we should have such a vision, a sufficient reward for the highest religious merit?” There was the same delight and wonder in every town, as though the tree of paradise had sprung up in the desert.
At the sight of Bharat, the good fortune of the people by the wayside manifested itself in like manner, as though by the will of providence Pray^g had been made accessible to the people of Lanka.

sections.label: Doha 224
sections.name: तेहि बासर बसि प्रातहीं चले सुमिरि रघुनाथ

verses.sa:
निज गुन सहित राम गुन गाथा ।
सुनत जाहिं सुमिरत रघुनाथा ॥
verses.tr:
nij gun sahit rām gun gāthā
sunat jāhiṃ sumirat raghunāthā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तीरथ मुनि आश्रम सुरधामा ।
निरखि निमज्जहिं करहिं प्रनामा ॥
verses.tr:
tīrath muni āśram suradhāmā
nirakhi nimajjahiṃ karahiṃ pranāmā

verses.sa:
मनहीं मन मागहिं बरु एहू ।
सीय राम पद पदुम सनेहू ॥
verses.tr:
manahīṃ man māgahiṃ baru ehū
sīya rām pad padum sanehū

verses.sa:
मिलहिं किरात कोल बनबासी ।
बैखानस बटु जती उदासी ॥
verses.tr:
milahiṃ kirāt kol banabāsī
baikhānas baṭu jatī udāsī

verses.sa:
करि प्रनामु पूँछहिं जेहिं तेही ।
केहि बन लखनु रामु बैदेही ॥
verses.tr:
kari pranāmu pūm̐chahiṃ jehiṃ tehī
kehi ban lakhanu rāmu baidehī

verses.sa:
ते प्रभु समाचार सब कहहीं ।
भरतहि देखि जनम फलु लहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
te prabhu samācār sab kahahīṃ
bharatahi dekhi janam phalu lahahīṃ

verses.sa:
जे जन कहहिं कुसल हम देखे ।
ते प्रिय राम लखन सम लेखे ॥
verses.tr:
je jan kahahiṃ kusal ham dekhe
te priya rām lakhan sam lekhe

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि बूझत सबहि सुबानी ।
सुनत राम बनबास कहानी ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi būjhat sabahi subānī
sunat rām banabās kahānī

verses.sa:
तेहि बासर बसि प्रातहीं चले सुमिरि रघुनाथ ।
राम दरस की लालसा भरत सरिस सब साथ ॥
verses.tr:
tehi bāsar basi prātahīṃ cale sumiri raghunāth
rām daras kī lālasā bharat saris sab sāth
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Hearing tbese praises of his own and Rama's many virtues, he went on his way, ever mindful of Raghunath. Whenever he spied any holy place, or hermitage, or temple, he bathed and reverently saluted it, praying in his heart of hearts for this one boon, perseverance in devotion to the feet of Sita and Kama. If there met hima Kirat, or Kol, or other dweller in the woods, anchorite or student, hermit or ascetic, whoever he might be, he saluted him and asked in what part of the forest were Lakshman, Rama and the Videhan princess, They told him all the news of the lord, and at the sight of Bharat reaped their life’s reward. If any person said ‘We have seen them well,’ they were counted as dear as Kama and -Lakshman themselves. In this manner asking courteously of every one, he heard the whole story of Rama’s forest life.
- Halting that day, Bharat started again at dawn, invoking Raghunath: all who were with him being equally desirous with himself for a sight of Rama. |

sections.label: Doha 225
sections.name: भरत प्रेमु तेहि समय जस तस कहि सकइ न सेषु

verses.sa:
मंगल सगुन होहिं सब काहू ।
फरकहिं सुखद बिलोचन बाहू ॥
verses.tr:
maṃgal sagun hohiṃ sab kāhū
pharakahiṃ sukhad bilocan bāhū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भरतहि सहित समाज उछाहू ।
मिलिहहिं रामु मिटहि दुख दाहू ॥
verses.tr:
bharatahi sahit samāj uchāhū
milihahiṃ rāmu miṭahi dukh dāhū

verses.sa:
करत मनोरथ जस जियँ जाके ।
जाहिं सनेह सुराँ सब छाके ॥
verses.tr:
karat manorath jas jiyam̐ jāke
jāhiṃ saneh surām̐ sab chāke

verses.sa:
सिथिल अंग पग मग डगि डोलहिं ।
बिहबल बचन पेम बस बोलहिं ॥
verses.tr:
sithil aṃg pag mag ḍagi ḍolahiṃ
bihabal bacan pem bas bolahiṃ

verses.sa:
रामसखाँ तेहि समय देखावा ।
सैल सिरोमनि सहज सुहावा ॥
verses.tr:
rāmasakhām̐ tehi samaya dekhāvā
sail siromani sahaj suhāvā

verses.sa:
जासु समीप सरित पय तीरा ।
सीय समेत बसहिं दोउ बीरा ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu samīp sarit paya tīrā
sīya samet basahiṃ dou bīrā

verses.sa:
देखि करहिं सब दंड प्रनामा ।
कहि जय जानकि जीवन रामा ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi karahiṃ sab daṃḍ pranāmā
kahi jaya jānaki jīvan rāmā

verses.sa:
प्रेम मगन अस राज समाजू ।
जनु फिरि अवध चले रघुराजू ॥
verses.tr:
prem magan as rāj samājū
janu phiri avadh cale raghurājū

verses.sa:
भरत प्रेमु तेहि समय जस तस कहि सकइ न सेषु ।
कबिहिं अगम जिमि ब्रह्मसुखु अह मम मलिन जनेषु ॥
verses.tr:
bharat premu tehi samaya jas tas kahi sakai na seṣu
kabihiṃ agam jimi brahmasukhu ah mam malin janeṣu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ' Every one had auspicious omens; lucky throbbings in the eyes and arm; Bharat and the host rejoiced, “Rama will be found and our sore distress will be atan end.” Each indulged his own fancy, and as they marched all seemed intoxicated with the wine of love, their limbs relaxed, their feet unsteady on the ground, and the accents of their voice in-~ articalate from excess of emotion. Then was the time that Rama's guide pointed out the monarch of mountains in all its beauty, near which on the river’s bank the two heroes and Sita were dwelling. All at the sight fell to the ground with cries of ‘Glory to Rama, the life of Janaki |’ The royal host was as overwhelmed with emotion as though Rama had come back to Avadh.
Bharat’s love at that time was such that not Seshnag could describe it: it is as fur beyond the poet as the bliss of heaven is beyond a man stained by selfishness and sensuality.

sections.label: Doha 226
sections.name: सुनत सुमंगल बैन मन प्रमोद तन पुलक भर

verses.sa:
सकल सनेह सिथिल रघुबर कें ।
गए कोस दुइ दिनकर ढरकें ॥
verses.tr:
sakal saneh sithil raghubar keṃ
gae kos dui dinakar ḍharakeṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जलु थलु देखि बसे निसि बीतें ।
कीन्ह गवन रघुनाथ पिरीतें ॥
verses.tr:
jalu thalu dekhi base nisi bīteṃ
kīnh gavan raghunāth pirīteṃ

verses.sa:
उहाँ रामु रजनी अवसेषा ।
जागे सीयँ सपन अस देखा ॥
verses.tr:
uhām̐ rāmu rajanī avaseṣā
jāge sīyam̐ sapan as dekhā

verses.sa:
सहित समाज भरत जनु आए ।
नाथ बियोग ताप तन ताए ॥
verses.tr:
sahit samāj bharat janu āe
nāth biyog tāp tan tāe

verses.sa:
सकल मलिन मन दीन दुखारी ।
देखीं सासु आन अनुहारी ॥
verses.tr:
sakal malin man dīn dukhārī
dekhīṃ sāsu ān anuhārī

verses.sa:
सुनि सिय सपन भरे जल लोचन ।
भए सोचबस सोच बिमोचन ॥
verses.tr:
suni siya sapan bhare jal locan
bhae socabas soc bimocan

verses.sa:
लखन सपन यह नीक न होई ।
कठिन कुचाह सुनाइहि कोई ॥
verses.tr:
lakhan sapan yah nīk na hoī
kaṭhin kucāh sunāihi koī

verses.sa:
अस कहि बंधु समेत नहाने ।
पूजि पुरारि साधु सनमाने ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi baṃdhu samet nahāne
pūji purāri sādhu sanamāne

verses.sa:
सनमानि सुर मुनि बंदि बैठे उत्तर दिसि देखत भए ।
नभ धूरि खग मृग भूरि भागे बिकल प्रभु आश्रम गए ॥
verses.tr:
sanamāni sur muni baṃdi baiṭhe uttar disi dekhat bhae
nabh dhūri khag mṛg bhūri bhāge bikal prabhu āśram gae
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
तुलसी उठे अवलोकि कारनु काह चित सचकित रहे ।
सब समाचार किरात कोलन्हि आइ तेहि अवसर कहे ॥
verses.tr:
tulasī uṭhe avaloki kāranu kāh cit sacakit rahe
sab samācār kirāt kolanhi āi tehi avasar kahe

verses.sa:
सुनत सुमंगल बैन मन प्रमोद तन पुलक भर ।
सरद सरोरुह नैन तुलसी भरे सनेह जल ॥
verses.tr:
sunat sumaṃgal bain man pramod tan pulak bhar
sarad saroruh nain tulasī bhare saneh jal
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Being all unmanned by their love for Raghubar, they had gone but two kos by the close of day, then sonnning land and water they halted. When the night was past, the be. loved of Raghunath sallied forth again. On the other hand Rama while it was yet dark, awoke, and Sita told him what she had seen ina dream: ‘Methought Bharat had come with an army, being tortured in body by the fever of separation from his Lord; all were sad, wretched and downcast, and the queens consort were greatly altered.’ On hearing Sita’s dream, the healer of sorrows grew sorrowful and his eyes filled with tears: “This dream, Lakshman, bodes no good: we shall hear of something that we by no means wished.” So saying, he and his brother bathed, worshipped Pareri and propitiated the saints.

After propitiating the gods and reverencing the saints, the lord went and sat down with his gaze to the north. The dust in the air and the many birds and deer taking to flight disquieted him and he returned to the hermitage. He stood up and looked, anxious in mind as to the cause. Then came Kirdts and Kols and told him all the news.
When he heard the glad tidings his heart was full of joy and his body quivered all over: white his eyes, like the autumnal lotus, were filled with the moisture of affection.

sections.label: Doha 227
sections.name: नाथ सुह्रद सुठि सरल चित सील सनेह निधान

verses.sa:
बहुरि सोचबस भे सियरवनू ।
कारन कवन भरत आगवनू ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri socabas bhe siyaravanū
kāran kavan bharat āgavanū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
एक आइ अस कहा बहोरी ।
सेन संग चतुरंग न थोरी ॥
verses.tr:
ek āi as kahā bahorī
sen saṃg caturaṃg na thorī

verses.sa:
सो सुनि रामहि भा अति सोचू ।
इत पितु बच इत बंधु सकोचू ॥
verses.tr:
so suni rāmahi bhā ati socū
it pitu bac it baṃdhu sakocū

verses.sa:
भरत सुभाउ समुझि मन माहीं ।
प्रभु चित हित थिति पावत नाही ॥
verses.tr:
bharat subhāu samujhi man māhīṃ
prabhu cit hit thiti pāvat nāhī

verses.sa:
समाधान तब भा यह जाने ।
भरतु कहे महुँ साधु सयाने ॥
verses.tr:
samādhān tab bhā yah jāne
bharatu kahe mahum̐ sādhu sayāne

verses.sa:
लखन लखेउ प्रभु हृदयँ खभारू ।
कहत समय सम नीति बिचारू ॥
verses.tr:
lakhan lakheu prabhu hṛdayam̐ khabhārū
kahat samaya sam nīti bicārū

verses.sa:
बिनु पूँछ कछु कहउँ गोसाईं ।
सेवकु समयँ न ढीठ ढिठाई ॥
verses.tr:
binu pūm̐ch kachu kahaum̐ gosāīṃ
sevaku samayam̐ na ḍhīṭh ḍhiṭhāī

verses.sa:
तुम्ह सर्बग्य सिरोमनि स्वामी ।
आपनि समुझि कहउँ अनुगामी ॥
verses.tr:
tumh sarbagya siromani svāmī
āpani samujhi kahaum̐ anugāmī

verses.sa: नाथ सुह्रद सुठि सरल चित सील सनेह निधान ॥
verses.tr: nāth suhrad suṭhi saral cit sīl saneh nidhān
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: सब पर प्रीति प्रतीति जियँ जानिअ आपु समान ॥
verses.tr: sab par prīti pratīti jiyam̐ jānia āpu samān

trans: Again Sita’s lord became anxious: ‘What can be the cause of Bharat's coming?’ Then came one and said: ‘There is with him oo small army io full equipment.’ Hearing this, Rama was greatly disturbed; on the one hand was his father's injunction, on the other his regard for his brother. Thinking to himself over Bharat’s disposition, the lord’s mind found no sure standing-point; but at last he calmed himself with the reflection: * Bharat is said to be good and sensible.’ Lakshman saw that his lord was troubled at heart, and spoke out ashe thought the occasion demanded: “I speak, sire, before [ am asked; but sometimes impertinence in a servant is not impertinent. You, master, are the crown of the wise; I a mere retainer, but I say what [ thiuk.
You, my lord, are kind and easy, a storehouse of amiability; you love and trust every one, and think them all like yourself.

sections.label: Doha 228
sections.name: ससि गुर तिय गामी नघुषु चढ़ेउ भूमिसुर जान

verses.sa:
बिषई जीव पाइ प्रभुताई ।
मूढ़ मोह बस होहिं जनाई ॥
verses.tr:
biṣaī jīv pāi prabhutāī
mūr̤h moh bas hohiṃ janāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भरतु नीति रत साधु सुजाना ।
प्रभु पद प्रेम सकल जगु जाना ॥
verses.tr:
bharatu nīti rat sādhu sujānā
prabhu pad prem sakal jagu jānā

verses.sa:
तेऊ आजु राम पदु पाई ।
चले धरम मरजाद मेटाई ॥
verses.tr:
teū āju rām padu pāī
cale dharam marajād meṭāī

verses.sa:
कुटिल कुबंध कुअवसरु ताकी ।
जानि राम बनवास एकाकी ॥
verses.tr:
kuṭil kubaṃdh kuavasaru tākī
jāni rām banavās ekākī

verses.sa:
करि कुमंत्रु मन साजि समाजू ।
आए करै अकंटक राजू ॥
verses.tr:
kari kumaṃtru man sāji samājū
āe karai akaṃṭak rājū

verses.sa:
कोटि प्रकार कलपि कुटलाई ।
आए दल बटोरि दोउ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
koṭi prakār kalapi kuṭalāī
āe dal baṭori dou bhāī

verses.sa:
जौं जियँ होति न कपट कुचाली ।
केहि सोहाति रथ बाजि गजाली ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ jiyam̐ hoti na kapaṭ kucālī
kehi sohāti rath bāji gajālī

verses.sa:
भरतहि दोसु देइ को जाएँ ।
जग बौराइ राज पदु पाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
bharatahi dosu dei ko jāem̐
jag baurāi rāj padu pāem̐

verses.sa:
ससि गुर तिय गामी नघुषु चढ़ेउ भूमिसुर जान ।
लोक बेद तें बिमुख भा अधम न बेन समान ॥
verses.tr:
sasi gur tiya gāmī naghuṣu car̤heu bhūmisur jān
lok bed teṃ bimukh bhā adham na ben samān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: A worldly man, who has got power, becomes mad and

infatuated and so betrays himself. Bharat was well-taught, good and clever, and, as every one knew, was devoted to his lord’s feet; but now that he has become king, he breaks down in his course all the bounds of duty. A wicked and ill-disposed brother having spied out his time, and knowing that Rama is alone in the forest, he has taken evil counsel and equipt an army, and has come to make his sovereignty secure. After plottiog all sorts of wicked schemes, the two brothers have assembled their army and come. If he had no treacherous malpractice at heart, why should he affect chariots and horses and elephants But why reproach Bharat? all the world goes mad on getting dominion. Dohe 219.
The Moon-god debauched his guru’s wife: Nahusha mounted a palanquin borne by Brahmans; and who fell so low as Vena, the enemy of established usage and the Veda?

sections.label: Doha 229
sections.name: छत्रि जाति रघुकुल जनमु राम अनुग जगु जान

verses.sa:
सहसबाहु सुरनाथु त्रिसंकू ।
केहि न राजमद दीन्ह कलंकू ॥
verses.tr:
sahasabāhu suranāthu trisaṃkū
kehi na rājamad dīnh kalaṃkū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भरत कीन्ह यह उचित उपाऊ ।
रिपु रिन रंच न राखब काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
bharat kīnh yah ucit upāū
ripu rin raṃc na rākhab kāū

verses.sa:
एक कीन्हि नहिं भरत भलाई ।
निदरे रामु जानि असहाई ॥
verses.tr:
ek kīnhi nahiṃ bharat bhalāī
nidare rāmu jāni asahāī

verses.sa:
समुझि परिहि सोउ आजु बिसेषी ।
समर सरोष राम मुखु पेखी ॥
verses.tr:
samujhi parihi sou āju biseṣī
samar saroṣ rām mukhu pekhī

verses.sa:
एतना कहत नीति रस भूला ।
रन रस बिटपु पुलक मिस फूला ॥
verses.tr:
etanā kahat nīti ras bhūlā
ran ras biṭapu pulak mis phūlā

verses.sa:
प्रभु पद बंदि सीस रज राखी ।
बोले सत्य सहज बलु भाषी ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu pad baṃdi sīs raj rākhī
bole satya sahaj balu bhāṣī

verses.sa:
अनुचित नाथ न मानब मोरा ।
भरत हमहि उपचार न थोरा ॥
verses.tr:
anucit nāth na mānab morā
bharat hamahi upacār na thorā

verses.sa:
कहँ लगि सहिअ रहिअ मनु मारें ।
नाथ साथ धनु हाथ हमारें ॥
verses.tr:
kaham̐ lagi sahia rahia manu māreṃ
nāth sāth dhanu hāth hamāreṃ

verses.sa:
छत्रि जाति रघुकुल जनमु राम अनुग जगु जान ।
लातहुँ मारें चढ़ति सिर नीच को धूरि समान ॥
verses.tr:
chatri jāti raghukul janamu rām anug jagu jān
lātahum̐ māreṃ car̤hati sir nīc ko dhūri samān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Sahasra-babu, Indra, Trisanku; all were brought to
disgrace by the intoxication of kingly power. Bharat has planned this clever scheme, so as not to leave himself a

! was awa at the time, but when he retarne | and heard of what ha single enemy in the field; butin one point be has made. a mistake, in di-pising Rama as if be had no friends; he will discover this to-day with a vengeance, when he sees Rama's indignant face in the battle.” So saying he forgot all prudence, and his whole body, so to speak. bristled with pogoacity. Falling at his Lord's feet and putting the dust of them upon his head, he cried in tones of natural and honest vehemence: “My lord, think it not wrong of me;: Bharat has tried me not a little; how long shall I endure a remain quiet, my lord being with me and my bow in my and? 3

Am I not of warrior descent, a scion of the house of Raghu, and known throughout the world as Rama's brother? What is so low as the dust? Yet if stirred by a kick it rises and falls upon your head.!”’

sections.label: Doha 230
sections.name: अति सरोष माखे लखनु लखि सुनि सपथ प्रवान

verses.sa:
उठि कर जोरि रजायसु मागा ।
मनहुँ बीर रस सोवत जागा ॥
verses.tr:
uṭhi kar jori rajāyasu māgā
manahum̐ bīr ras sovat jāgā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बाँधि जटा सिर कसि कटि भाथा ।
साजि सरासनु सायकु हाथा ॥
verses.tr:
bām̐dhi jaṭā sir kasi kaṭi bhāthā
sāji sarāsanu sāyaku hāthā

verses.sa:
आजु राम सेवक जसु लेऊँ ।
भरतहि समर सिखावन देऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
āju rām sevak jasu leūm̐
bharatahi samar sikhāvan deūm̐

verses.sa:
राम निरादर कर फलु पाई ।
सोवहुँ समर सेज दोउ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
rām nirādar kar phalu pāī
sovahum̐ samar sej dou bhāī

verses.sa:
आइ बना भल सकल समाजू ।
प्रगट करउँ रिस पाछिल आजू ॥
verses.tr:
āi banā bhal sakal samājū
pragaṭ karaum̐ ris pāchil ājū

verses.sa:
जिमि करि निकर दलइ मृगराजू ।
लेइ लपेटि लवा जिमि बाजू ॥
verses.tr:
jimi kari nikar dalai mṛgarājū
lei lapeṭi lavā jimi bājū

verses.sa:
तैसेहिं भरतहि सेन समेता ।
सानुज निदरि निपातउँ खेता ॥
verses.tr:
taisehiṃ bharatahi sen sametā
sānuj nidari nipātaum̐ khetā

verses.sa:
जौं सहाय कर संकरु आई ।
तौ मारउँ रन राम दोहाई ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ sahāya kar saṃkaru āī
tau māraum̐ ran rām dohāī

verses.sa:
अति सरोष माखे लखनु लखि सुनि सपथ प्रवान ।
सभय लोक सब लोकपति चाहत भभरि भगान ॥
verses.tr:
ati saroṣ mākhe lakhanu lakhi suni sapath pravān
sabhaya lok sab lokapati cāhat bhabhari bhagān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘As he stood with clasped hands and sought permission,
he seemed like Heroism itself aroused from slumber, binding up his hair in a knot, girding on his quiver by his side,

trimming his bow, and taking arrows in hand. “To-day: I shall distinguish myself as Rama's servant and will give: Bharat a lesson in fighting. Reaping the fruit of their: contempt for Rama, both brothers shall sleep on the couch: of battle. It is well that the whole host has come; to-day’ I shall manifest my wrath and have done with it. Asa. lian tears in pieces a herd of elephants, or as a hawk. clutches and carries off a quail, so will I lightly overthrow upon the field Bharat and his brother and all their host.. If Siva himself should come to their aid, in Rama’s name I would worst him in battle.”
Lakshman spoke so furiously that the regents of the spheres, beholding and hearing his solemn oath, looked on in terror and longed to flee away.

sections.label: Doha 231
sections.name: भरतहि होइ न राजमदु बिधि हरि हर पद पाइ

verses.sa:
जगु भय मगन गगन भइ बानी ।
लखन बाहुबलु बिपुल बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
jagu bhaya magan gagan bhai bānī
lakhan bāhubalu bipul bakhānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तात प्रताप प्रभाउ तुम्हारा ।
को कहि सकइ को जाननिहारा ॥
verses.tr:
tāt pratāp prabhāu tumhārā
ko kahi sakai ko jānanihārā

verses.sa:
अनुचित उचित काजु किछु होऊ ।
समुझि करिअ भल कह सबु कोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
anucit ucit kāju kichu hoū
samujhi karia bhal kah sabu koū

verses.sa:
सहसा करि पाछैं पछिताहीं ।
कहहिं बेद बुध ते बुध नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sahasā kari pāchaiṃ pachitāhīṃ
kahahiṃ bed budh te budh nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सुनि सुर बचन लखन सकुचाने ।
राम सीयँ सादर सनमाने ॥
verses.tr:
suni sur bacan lakhan sakucāne
rām sīyam̐ sādar sanamāne

verses.sa:
कही तात तुम्ह नीति सुहाई ।
सब तें कठिन राजमदु भाई ॥
verses.tr:
kahī tāt tumh nīti suhāī
sab teṃ kaṭhin rājamadu bhāī

verses.sa:
जो अचवँत नृप मातहिं तेई ।
नाहिन साधुसभा जेहिं सेई ॥
verses.tr:
jo acavam̐t nṛp mātahiṃ teī
nāhin sādhusabhā jehiṃ seī

verses.sa:
सुनहु लखन भल भरत सरीसा ।
बिधि प्रपंच महँ सुना न दीसा ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu lakhan bhal bharat sarīsā
bidhi prapaṃc maham̐ sunā na dīsā

verses.sa: भरतहि होइ न राजमदु बिधि हरि हर पद पाइ ॥
verses.tr: bharatahi hoi na rājamadu bidhi hari har pad pāi
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: कबहुँ कि काँजी सीकरनि छीरसिंधु बिनसाइ ॥
verses.tr: kabahum̐ ki kām̐jī sīkarani chīrasiṃdhu binasāi

trans: The world was entranced; a voice was heard in the air, declaring the mighty power of Lakshman’s arm: *‘ Son, who can tell, or who can understand your might and majesty? but any business, whether right or wrong, should be done deliberately; so every one agrees. They who act rashly and afterwards repent, the Vedas say are anything but wise.” On hearing this voice from heaven Lakshman was abashed, and both Rama and Sita addressed him courteously: ‘What you have said, brother, is sound wisdom: the intoxication of power is the worst of all the merest taste of it maddens any king who has not been trained in the school of philosophy. But hearken, Lukshman: in the whole of God's creation 1 have never seen nor heard of any one so good as Bharat.
He would never be intoxicated with power, even though he sat upon the throne of Brahma, Vishnu and Siva. What! can a few drops of kdnji curdie the milky ocean?

sections.label: Doha 232
sections.name: सुनि रघुबर बानी बिबुध देखि भरत पर हेतु

verses.sa:
तिमिरु तरुन तरनिहि मकु गिलई ।
गगनु मगन मकु मेघहिं मिलई ॥
verses.tr:
timiru tarun taranihi maku gilaī
gaganu magan maku meghahiṃ milaī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
गोपद जल बूड़हिं घटजोनी ।
सहज छमा बरु छाड़ै छोनी ॥
verses.tr:
gopad jal būr̤ahiṃ ghaṭajonī
sahaj chamā baru chār̤ai chonī

verses.sa:
मसक फूँक मकु मेरु उड़ाई ।
होइ न नृपमदु भरतहि भाई ॥
verses.tr:
masak phūm̐k maku meru ur̤āī
hoi na nṛpamadu bharatahi bhāī

verses.sa:
लखन तुम्हार सपथ पितु आना ।
सुचि सुबंधु नहिं भरत समाना ॥
verses.tr:
lakhan tumhār sapath pitu ānā
suci subaṃdhu nahiṃ bharat samānā

verses.sa:
सगुन खीरु अवगुन जलु ताता ।
मिलइ रचइ परपंचु बिधाता ॥
verses.tr:
sagun khīru avagun jalu tātā
milai racai parapaṃcu bidhātā

verses.sa:
भरतु हंस रबिबंस तड़ागा ।
जनमि कीन्ह गुन दोष बिभागा ॥
verses.tr:
bharatu haṃs rabibaṃs tar̤āgā
janami kīnh gun doṣ bibhāgā

verses.sa:
गहि गुन पय तजि अवगुन बारी ।
निज जस जगत कीन्हि उजिआरी ॥
verses.tr:
gahi gun paya taji avagun bārī
nij jas jagat kīnhi ujiārī

verses.sa:
कहत भरत गुन सीलु सुभाऊ ।
पेम पयोधि मगन रघुराऊ ॥
verses.tr:
kahat bharat gun sīlu subhāū
pem payodhi magan raghurāū

verses.sa:
सुनि रघुबर बानी बिबुध देखि भरत पर हेतु ।
सकल सराहत राम सो प्रभु को कृपानिकेतु ॥
verses.tr:
suni raghubar bānī bibudh dekhi bharat par hetu
sakal sarāhat rām so prabhu ko kṛpāniketu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The sun may grow dim at midday; yea, sooner may the pure ether be absorbed in cloud; sooner may Agastya be drowned in the puddle of a cow’s footprint, or earth forget te be long-suffering; sooner may the buzz of a mosquito puff away Mount Meru, than ki gly pride, my brother, touch Bharat. O Lakshman, I swear by you and by our’ father

there is none so true a brother as Bharat. The Creator has fashioned the world by mixing the milk of goodness with the water of evil; Bharat is the swan in the lake of the Solar race, who from the day of his birth has known to distinguish between the good and the evil; choosing the milk of goodness and discarding the water of evil, be has illumined the whole world with his glory.” As Raghurdi thus recited Bharat’s virtues and amiable disposition, he became drowned in a sea of love.
The gods, hearing his speech and seeing his affection for Bharat, all applauded Rama, saying: ‘Who so compassionate as the Lord?

sections.label: Doha 233
sections.name: मातु मते महुँ मानि मोहि जो कछु करहिं सो थोर

verses.sa:
जौं न होत जग जनम भरत को ।
सकल धरम धुर धरनि धरत को ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ na hot jag janam bharat ko
sakal dharam dhur dharani dharat ko
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कबि कुल अगम भरत गुन गाथा ।
को जानइ तुम्ह बिनु रघुनाथा ॥
verses.tr:
kabi kul agam bharat gun gāthā
ko jānai tumh binu raghunāthā

verses.sa:
लखन राम सियँ सुनि सुर बानी ।
अति सुखु लहेउ न जाइ बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
lakhan rām siyam̐ suni sur bānī
ati sukhu laheu na jāi bakhānī

verses.sa:
इहाँ भरतु सब सहित सहाए ।
मंदाकिनीं पुनीत नहाए ॥
verses.tr:
ihām̐ bharatu sab sahit sahāe
maṃdākinīṃ punīt nahāe

verses.sa:
सरित समीप राखि सब लोगा ।
मागि मातु गुर सचिव नियोगा ॥
verses.tr:
sarit samīp rākhi sab logā
māgi mātu gur saciv niyogā

verses.sa:
चले भरतु जहँ सिय रघुराई ।
साथ निषादनाथु लघु भाई ॥
verses.tr:
cale bharatu jaham̐ siya raghurāī
sāth niṣādanāthu laghu bhāī

verses.sa:
समुझि मातु करतब सकुचाहीं ।
करत कुतरक कोटि मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
samujhi mātu karatab sakucāhīṃ
karat kutarak koṭi man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
रामु लखनु सिय सुनि मम नाऊँ ।
उठि जनि अनत जाहिं तजि ठाऊँ ॥
verses.tr:
rāmu lakhanu siya suni mam nāūm̐
uṭhi jani anat jāhiṃ taji ṭhāūm̐

verses.sa:
मातु मते महुँ मानि मोहि जो कछु करहिं सो थोर ।
अघ अवगुन छमि आदरहिं समुझि आपनी ओर ॥
verses.tr:
mātu mate mahum̐ māni mohi jo kachu karahiṃ so thor
agh avagun chami ādarahiṃ samujhi āpanī or
verses.head: दोहा

trans: If Bharat had not been born into the world, who was there on earth to be the champion of all right? Bharat’s good qualities are more than all the poets could describe; who save you, Raghunath, could comprehend them?” When Lakshman, Rama and Sita heard these words of the gods they were more glad than can be told. Now Bharat and all his host bathed in the sacred Mandakini. Then leaving the people on the bank and having asked permission from his mother, his guru and the Minister, he set out to visit Sita and Raghurdi with the Nishad king and his brother. Ashe thought upon his mother’s deeds he was abashed, and formed a thousand ill-conjectures in his mind: ‘“ What if Rama, Lakshman and Sita, on hearing my name,
should leave the place and go elsewhere ie
Taking me to be my mother’s accomplice, nothing that he might do would be too much. If, again, he overlooks my sin and folly, and receives me kindly as his well-wisher;

sections.label: Doha 234
sections.name: लगे होन मंगल सगुन सुनि गुनि कहत निषादु

verses.sa:
जौं परिहरहिं मलिन मनु जानी ।
जौ सनमानहिं सेवकु मानी ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ pariharahiṃ malin manu jānī
jau sanamānahiṃ sevaku mānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मोरें सरन रामहि की पनही ।
राम सुस्वामि दोसु सब जनही ॥
verses.tr:
moreṃ saran rāmahi kī panahī
rām susvāmi dosu sab janahī

verses.sa:
जग जस भाजन चातक मीना ।
नेम पेम निज निपुन नबीना ॥
verses.tr:
jag jas bhājan cātak mīnā
nem pem nij nipun nabīnā

verses.sa:
अस मन गुनत चले मग जाता ।
सकुच सनेहँ सिथिल सब गाता ॥
verses.tr:
as man gunat cale mag jātā
sakuc saneham̐ sithil sab gātā

verses.sa:
फेरत मनहुँ मातु कृत खोरी ।
चलत भगति बल धीरज धोरी ॥
verses.tr:
pherat manahum̐ mātu kṛt khorī
calat bhagati bal dhīraj dhorī

verses.sa:
जब समुझत रघुनाथ सुभाऊ ।
तब पथ परत उताइल पाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
jab samujhat raghunāth subhāū
tab path parat utāil pāū

verses.sa:
भरत दसा तेहि अवसर कैसी ।
जल प्रबाहँ जल अलि गति जैसी ॥
verses.tr:
bharat dasā tehi avasar kaisī
jal prabāham̐ jal ali gati jaisī

verses.sa:
देखि भरत कर सोचु सनेहू ।
भा निषाद तेहि समयँ बिदेहू ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi bharat kar socu sanehū
bhā niṣād tehi samayam̐ bidehū

verses.sa:
लगे होन मंगल सगुन सुनि गुनि कहत निषादु ।
मिटिहि सोचु होइहि हरषु पुनि परिनाम बिषादु ॥
verses.tr:
lage hon maṃgal sagun suni guni kahat niṣādu
miṭihi socu hoihi haraṣu puni parinām biṣādu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Whether he spurns me as a black-hearted wretch, or wel-comes meas his servant, my only refuge is at Rama’s feet; he is the best of masters, the fault is all his servants. The chdtak and the fish are celebrated throughout the world for the thoroughness and constancy of their vows of love.” With these thoughts in his mind he went on his way, his whole body rendered powerless by excessive love’ and trepidation; his mother’s sin, as it were, turning him back, while his

strong faith, like some sturdy bull, dragged him forward. Whenever he thought of Rama’s good nature, his feet moved swiftly along the way; his course was like that of a water-fly carried about by the stream. Seeing Bharat’s anxiety and affection, the Nishad was transported out of himself.
Auspicious omens began to occur, and the Nishad after hearing them and making a calculation said: “Sorrow will pass away, joy will succeed; butin the end there will be distress again.”

sections.label: Doha 235
sections.name: जीति मोह महिपालु दल सहित बिबेक भुआलु

verses.sa:
सेवक बचन सत्य सब जाने ।
आश्रम निकट जाइ निअराने ॥
verses.tr:
sevak bacan satya sab jāne
āśram nikaṭ jāi niarāne
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भरत दीख बन सैल समाजू ।
मुदित छुधित जनु पाइ सुनाजू ॥
verses.tr:
bharat dīkh ban sail samājū
mudit chudhit janu pāi sunājū

verses.sa:
ईति भीति जनु प्रजा दुखारी ।
त्रिबिध ताप पीड़ित ग्रह मारी ॥
verses.tr:
īti bhīti janu prajā dukhārī
tribidh tāp pīr̤it grah mārī

verses.sa:
जाइ सुराज सुदेस सुखारी ।
होहिं भरत गति तेहि अनुहारी ॥
verses.tr:
jāi surāj sudes sukhārī
hohiṃ bharat gati tehi anuhārī

verses.sa:
राम बास बन संपति भ्राजा ।
सुखी प्रजा जनु पाइ सुराजा ॥
verses.tr:
rām bās ban saṃpati bhrājā
sukhī prajā janu pāi surājā

verses.sa:
सचिव बिरागु बिबेकु नरेसू ।
बिपिन सुहावन पावन देसू ॥
verses.tr:
saciv birāgu bibeku naresū
bipin suhāvan pāvan desū

verses.sa:
भट जम नियम सैल रजधानी ।
सांति सुमति सुचि सुंदर रानी ॥
verses.tr:
bhaṭ jam niyam sail rajadhānī
sāṃti sumati suci suṃdar rānī

verses.sa:
सकल अंग संपन्न सुराऊ ।
राम चरन आश्रित चित चाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
sakal aṃg saṃpann surāū
rām caran āśrit cit cāū

verses.sa:
जीति मोह महिपालु दल सहित बिबेक भुआलु ।
करत अकंटक राजु पुरँ सुख संपदा सुकालु ॥
verses.tr:
jīti moh mahipālu dal sahit bibek bhuālu
karat akaṃṭak rāju puram̐ sukh saṃpadā sukālu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Knowing his servant’s words to be all true, he went on and drew near to the hermitage. When Bharat saw the vast woods and rocks, he was us glad asa hungry wretch on getting a good meal. Like people afflicted by every calamity', worn out with troubles’, ill fortane and pestilence, who rejoice on escaping to a prosperous and well-governed country, so were Bharat’s feelings. The forest where Rama dwelt was as bright and happy as. people are happy who have got a good king; with Asceticism for King Wisdom’s Minister of State; with the beautiful and sacred groves for his realm; with Continence and Faithfulness for champions, and the rocks for his capital; with Peace and Good will for his virtuous and lovely queens;a king perfect at all points; a suppliant at Rama’s feet, and therefore easy in mind.
Royal Wisdom, having conquered King Delusion with all his host, held undisputed sway in his capital: all was joy, happiness, and prosperity.

sections.label: Doha 236
sections.name: राम सैल सोभा निरखि भरत हृदयँ अति पेमु

verses.sa:
बन प्रदेस मुनि बास घनेरे ।
जनु पुर नगर गाउँ गन खेरे ॥
verses.tr:
ban prades muni bās ghanere
janu pur nagar gāum̐ gan khere
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बिपुल बिचित्र बिहग मृग नाना ।
प्रजा समाजु न जाइ बखाना ॥
verses.tr:
bipul bicitr bihag mṛg nānā
prajā samāju na jāi bakhānā

verses.sa:
खगहा करि हरि बाघ बराहा ।
देखि महिष बृष साजु सराहा ॥
verses.tr:
khagahā kari hari bāgh barāhā
dekhi mahiṣ bṛṣ sāju sarāhā

verses.sa:
बयरु बिहाइ चरहिं एक संगा ।
जहँ तहँ मनहुँ सेन चतुरंगा ॥
verses.tr:
bayaru bihāi carahiṃ ek saṃgā
jaham̐ taham̐ manahum̐ sen caturaṃgā

verses.sa:
झरना झरहिं मत्त गज गाजहिं ।
मनहुँ निसान बिबिधि बिधि बाजहिं ॥
verses.tr:
jharanā jharahiṃ matt gaj gājahiṃ
manahum̐ nisān bibidhi bidhi bājahiṃ

verses.sa:
चक चकोर चातक सुक पिक गन ।
कूजत मंजु मराल मुदित मन ॥
verses.tr:
cak cakor cātak suk pik gan
kūjat maṃju marāl mudit man

verses.sa:
अलिगन गावत नाचत मोरा ।
जनु सुराज मंगल चहु ओरा ॥
verses.tr:
aligan gāvat nācat morā
janu surāj maṃgal cahu orā

verses.sa:
बेलि बिटप तृन सफल सफूला ।
सब समाजु मुद मंगल मूला ॥
verses.tr:
beli biṭap tṛn saphal saphūlā
sab samāju mud maṃgal mūlā

verses.sa:
राम सैल सोभा निरखि भरत हृदयँ अति पेमु ।
तापस तप फलु पाइ जिमि सुखी सिरानें नेमु ॥
verses.tr:
rām sail sobhā nirakhi bharat hṛdayam̐ ati pemu
tāpas tap phalu pāi jimi sukhī sirāneṃ nemu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The frequent hermits’ cells about the woods were his cities, towns, villages and hamlets; the many birds and beasts of all descriptions were his innumerable subjects. The hares, elephants, lions, tigers, boars, buffaloes and wolves, a wonder to behold, forgetting their antipathies, grazed together, like a duly marshalled ‘army complete in all its parts. Theroar of ‘the mountain torrents and the cries of mad elephants were like the din of kettle drums; the chakwds, chakors, chdtaks, parrots and cuckoos made a delightful concert; swans were in their glory; the bees buzzed and the peacocks danced like the Festive encourage of some Raja, while the creepers, trees and grasses, with the flowers and fruits, formed his brilliant court.
Beholding the beauty of Rama’s hill, Bharat’s heart was overpowered with love, like as an ascetic is overjoyed when he completes his vow and reaps the fruit of his penanve.

sections.label: Doha 237
sections.name: जहाँ बैठि मुनिगन सहित नित सिय रामु सुजान

verses.sa:
तब केवट ऊँचें चढ़ि धाई ।
कहेउ भरत सन भुजा उठाई ॥
verses.tr:
tab kevaṭ ūm̐ceṃ car̤hi dhāī
kaheu bharat san bhujā uṭhāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नाथ देखिअहिं बिटप बिसाला ।
पाकरि जंबु रसाल तमाला ॥
verses.tr:
nāth dekhiahiṃ biṭap bisālā
pākari jaṃbu rasāl tamālā

verses.sa:
जिन्ह तरुबरन्ह मध्य बटु सोहा ।
मंजु बिसाल देखि मनु मोहा ॥
verses.tr:
jinh tarubaranh madhya baṭu sohā
maṃju bisāl dekhi manu mohā

verses.sa:
नील सघन पल्ल्व फल लाला ।
अबिरल छाहँ सुखद सब काला ॥
verses.tr:
nīl saghan pallv phal lālā
abiral chāham̐ sukhad sab kālā

verses.sa:
मानहुँ तिमिर अरुनमय रासी ।
बिरची बिधि सँकेलि सुषमा सी ॥
verses.tr:
mānahum̐ timir arunamaya rāsī
biracī bidhi sam̐keli suṣamā sī

verses.sa:
ए तरु सरित समीप गोसाँई ।
रघुबर परनकुटी जहँ छाई ॥
verses.tr:
e taru sarit samīp gosām̐ī
raghubar paranakuṭī jaham̐ chāī

verses.sa:
तुलसी तरुबर बिबिध सुहाए ।
कहुँ कहुँ सियँ कहुँ लखन लगाए ॥
verses.tr:
tulasī tarubar bibidh suhāe
kahum̐ kahum̐ siyam̐ kahum̐ lakhan lagāe

verses.sa:
बट छायाँ बेदिका बनाई ।
सियँ निज पानि सरोज सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
baṭ chāyām̐ bedikā banāī
siyam̐ nij pāni saroj suhāī

verses.sa:
जहाँ बैठि मुनिगन सहित नित सिय रामु सुजान ।
सुनहिं कथा इतिहास सब आगम निगम पुरान ॥
verses.tr:
jahām̐ baiṭhi munigan sahit nit siya rāmu sujān
sunahiṃ kathā itihās sab āgam nigam purān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Then the pilot mounted a height and reaching out his hand cried to Bharat: “See, my lord, those huge trees pakar, jdnan, mango and tamdid, in the midst of which is conspicuous a bar tree, so beautiful and grand that the soul is charmed at the sight, with dense dark shoots and red fruit, affording a pleasant shade in all seasons of the year, a mass of black and purple, as if God had brought together all that was lovely to make it. Under this tree, near the river, sir, where Rama has roofed in his sylvan hut, are many graceful shrubs of Tulsi, planted, some by Sita’s lord and some by Lakshman, and in the shade of the bar tree Sita with her own lotus hands has reare:| a charming altar.
There the well-instracted Sita and Rama are ever wont

sections.label: Doha 238
sections.name: पेम अमिअ मंदरु बिरहु भरतु पयोधि गँभीर

verses.sa:
सखा बचन सुनि बिटप निहारी ।
उमगे भरत बिलोचन बारी ॥
verses.tr:
sakhā bacan suni biṭap nihārī
umage bharat bilocan bārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
करत प्रनाम चले दोउ भाई ।
कहत प्रीति सारद सकुचाई ॥
verses.tr:
karat pranām cale dou bhāī
kahat prīti sārad sakucāī

verses.sa:
हरषहिं निरखि राम पद अंका ।
मानहुँ पारसु पायउ रंका ॥
verses.tr:
haraṣahiṃ nirakhi rām pad aṃkā
mānahum̐ pārasu pāyau raṃkā

verses.sa:
रज सिर धरि हियँ नयनन्हि लावहिं ।
रघुबर मिलन सरिस सुख पावहिं ॥
verses.tr:
raj sir dhari hiyam̐ nayananhi lāvahiṃ
raghubar milan saris sukh pāvahiṃ

verses.sa:
देखि भरत गति अकथ अतीवा ।
प्रेम मगन मृग खग जड़ जीवा ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi bharat gati akath atīvā
prem magan mṛg khag jar̤ jīvā

verses.sa:
सखहि सनेह बिबस मग भूला ।
कहि सुपंथ सुर बरषहिं फूला ॥
verses.tr:
sakhahi saneh bibas mag bhūlā
kahi supaṃth sur baraṣahiṃ phūlā

verses.sa:
निरखि सिद्ध साधक अनुरागे ।
सहज सनेहु सराहन लागे ॥
verses.tr:
nirakhi siddh sādhak anurāge
sahaj sanehu sarāhan lāge

verses.sa:
होत न भूतल भाउ भरत को ।
अचर सचर चर अचर करत को ॥
verses.tr:
hot na bhūtal bhāu bharat ko
acar sacar car acar karat ko

verses.sa:
पेम अमिअ मंदरु बिरहु भरतु पयोधि गँभीर ।
मथि प्रगटेउ सुर साधु हित कृपासिंधु रघुबीर ॥
verses.tr:
pem amia maṃdaru birahu bharatu payodhi gam̐bhīr
mathi pragaṭeu sur sādhu hit kṛpāsiṃdhu raghubīr
verses.head: दोहा

trans: to sit in the midst of the hermits, listening while sacred legends are read and all the Vedas, Shastras and PurAnas,” Chaupdi.

As he listened to his friend’s speech and gazed upon the tree, Bharat’s eyes overflowed with tears. The two brothers advanced reverently; Serad& would fail to do justice to their love. When they saw the prints of Rama’sfeet they rejoiced like some beggar on finding the philosopher's stone, and applied the dust to their head, heart and eyes, with as’ much delight as if they had found Rama himself.
