Seeing Bharat’s utterly indescribable condition, birds, beasts and all] created things, whether animate, or inanimate, were absorbed in devotion. The guide in his excitement lost the way, but the gods showed it to him and rained down flowers.. Saints and sages gazed in rapture and burst out into praises of his sincere affection: ‘Who in all the world is like Bharat, who makes fools wise and the wise fools?’
Rayhu-bir, the ocean of compassion, after churning the depths of Bharat’s soul with the Mount Meru of bereavement, brought out from it the nectar of love.

sections.label: Doha 239
sections.name: लसत मंजु मुनि मंडली मध्य सीय रघुचंदु

verses.sa:
सखा समेत मनोहर जोटा ।
लखेउ न लखन सघन बन ओटा ॥
verses.tr:
sakhā samet manohar joṭā
lakheu na lakhan saghan ban oṭā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भरत दीख प्रभु आश्रमु पावन ।
सकल सुमंगल सदनु सुहावन ॥
verses.tr:
bharat dīkh prabhu āśramu pāvan
sakal sumaṃgal sadanu suhāvan

verses.sa:
करत प्रबेस मिटे दुख दावा ।
जनु जोगीं परमारथु पावा ॥
verses.tr:
karat prabes miṭe dukh dāvā
janu jogīṃ paramārathu pāvā

verses.sa:
देखे भरत लखन प्रभु आगे ।
पूँछे बचन कहत अनुरागे ॥
verses.tr:
dekhe bharat lakhan prabhu āge
pūm̐che bacan kahat anurāge

verses.sa:
सीस जटा कटि मुनि पट बाँधें ।
तून कसें कर सरु धनु काँधें ॥
verses.tr:
sīs jaṭā kaṭi muni paṭ bām̐dheṃ
tūn kaseṃ kar saru dhanu kām̐dheṃ

verses.sa:
बेदी पर मुनि साधु समाजू ।
सीय सहित राजत रघुराजू ॥
verses.tr:
bedī par muni sādhu samājū
sīya sahit rājat raghurājū

verses.sa:
बलकल बसन जटिल तनु स्यामा ।
जनु मुनि बेष कीन्ह रति कामा ॥
verses.tr:
balakal basan jaṭil tanu syāmā
janu muni beṣ kīnh rati kāmā

verses.sa:
कर कमलनि धनु सायकु फेरत ।
जिय की जरनि हरत हँसि हेरत ॥
verses.tr:
kar kamalani dhanu sāyaku pherat
jiya kī jarani harat ham̐si herat

verses.sa:
लसत मंजु मुनि मंडली मध्य सीय रघुचंदु ।
ग्यान सभाँ जनु तनु धरे भगति सच्चिदानंदु ॥
verses.tr:
lasat maṃju muni maṃḍalī madhya sīya raghucaṃdu
gyān sabhām̐ janu tanu dhare bhagati saccidānaṃdu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The two fair brothers and their guide were not visible to Lakshman, by reason of the dense shade of the forest; but Bharat could see his lord’s sacred hermitage, the charming home of everything delightful. As he entered it his burning grief was assuaged, us when an ascetic is rewarded with salvation. He saw before him Lakshman affectionately conversing with his Lord, his hair fastened in a knot, a hermit’s robe girt about his loins, his quiver slung, arrows in his hand, and his bow on his shoulder. By the altar an assembly of saints and sages, among whom Sita and Rama were conspicuous in hermit’s attire, with matted hair and body darkened by exposure; like Rati and Kamadeva in saint’s disguise. He, who with one smiling glance can dispel every anguish of soul, had bow and arrows ready in his lotus hands.)
In the midst of the circle of saints, Sita and Rama shone forth as fair as Faith and the Supreme Spirit incarnate in the council chamber cf wisdom.

sections.label: Doha 240
sections.name: बरबस लिए उठाइ उर लाए कृपानिधान

verses.sa:
सानुज सखा समेत मगन मन ।
बिसरे हरष सोक सुख दुख गन ॥
verses.tr:
sānuj sakhā samet magan man
bisare haraṣ sok sukh dukh gan
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पाहि नाथ कहि पाहि गोसाई ।
भूतल परे लकुट की नाई ॥
verses.tr:
pāhi nāth kahi pāhi gosāī
bhūtal pare lakuṭ kī nāī

verses.sa:
बचन सपेम लखन पहिचाने ।
करत प्रनामु भरत जियँ जाने ॥
verses.tr:
bacan sapem lakhan pahicāne
karat pranāmu bharat jiyam̐ jāne

verses.sa:
बंधु सनेह सरस एहि ओरा ।
उत साहिब सेवा बस जोरा ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdhu saneh saras ehi orā
ut sāhib sevā bas jorā

verses.sa:
मिलि न जाइ नहिं गुदरत बनई ।
सुकबि लखन मन की गति भनई ॥
verses.tr:
mili na jāi nahiṃ gudarat banaī
sukabi lakhan man kī gati bhanaī

verses.sa:
रहे राखि सेवा पर भारू ।
चढ़ी चंग जनु खैंच खेलारू ॥
verses.tr:
rahe rākhi sevā par bhārū
car̤hī caṃg janu khaiṃc khelārū

verses.sa:
कहत सप्रेम नाइ महि माथा ।
भरत प्रनाम करत रघुनाथा ॥
verses.tr:
kahat saprem nāi mahi māthā
bharat pranām karat raghunāthā

verses.sa:
उठे रामु सुनि पेम अधीरा ।
कहुँ पट कहुँ निषंग धनु तीरा ॥
verses.tr:
uṭhe rāmu suni pem adhīrā
kahum̐ paṭ kahum̐ niṣaṃg dhanu tīrā

verses.sa:
बरबस लिए उठाइ उर लाए कृपानिधान ।
भरत राम की मिलनि लखि बिसरे सबहि अपान ॥
verses.tr:
barabas lie uṭhāi ur lāe kṛpānidhān
bharat rām kī milani lakhi bisare sabahi apān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: _ He, his brother and their guide were so absorbed that joy and sorrow, pleasure and pain were all forgotten. Crying ‘Mercy, mercy, O lord and master!’ he fell flat on the ground, like a log. [Lakshman recognized his loving cry and made obeisance, knowing that it must be Bharat. On the one hand he was moved by brotherly affection, but on the other was the stronger claim of obedience to his lord. Unable to embrace him and yet loth to refrain; what Poet

whole world, w i i. i St aee weed oe obliged in the forest to go armed, to protect himself against could describe Lakshman’s state of mind Though obedience was the weightier, and therefore he stayed, he was like a child pulling against a kite high in the air. Bowing his head to the ground, he said affectionately: “It is Bharat, O Raghu^th, who greets you.” On hearing this, Rama started upin loving agitation, his robe flying in one direction and his quiver and bow and arrows in another, Dohd 231.

sections.label: Doha 241
sections.name: मिलि सपेम रिपुसूदनहि केवटु भेंटेउ राम

verses.sa:
मिलनि प्रीति किमि जाइ बखानी ।
कबिकुल अगम करम मन बानी ॥
verses.tr:
milani prīti kimi jāi bakhānī
kabikul agam karam man bānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
परम पेम पूरन दोउ भाई ।
मन बुधि चित अहमिति बिसराई ॥
verses.tr:
param pem pūran dou bhāī
man budhi cit ahamiti bisarāī

verses.sa:
कहहु सुपेम प्रगट को करई ।
केहि छाया कबि मति अनुसरई ॥
verses.tr:
kahahu supem pragaṭ ko karaī
kehi chāyā kabi mati anusaraī

verses.sa:
कबिहि अरथ आखर बलु साँचा ।
अनुहरि ताल गतिहि नटु नाचा ॥
verses.tr:
kabihi arath ākhar balu sām̐cā
anuhari tāl gatihi naṭu nācā

verses.sa:
अगम सनेह भरत रघुबर को ।
जहँ न जाइ मनु बिधि हरि हर को ॥
verses.tr:
agam saneh bharat raghubar ko
jaham̐ na jāi manu bidhi hari har ko

verses.sa:
सो मैं कुमति कहौं केहि भाँती ।
बाज सुराग कि गाँडर ताँती ॥
verses.tr:
so maiṃ kumati kahauṃ kehi bhām̐tī
bāj surāg ki gām̐ḍar tām̐tī

verses.sa:
मिलनि बिलोकि भरत रघुबर की ।
सुरगन सभय धकधकी धरकी ॥
verses.tr:
milani biloki bharat raghubar kī
suragan sabhaya dhakadhakī dharakī

verses.sa:
समुझाए सुरगुरु जड़ जागे ।
बरषि प्रसून प्रसंसन लागे ॥
verses.tr:
samujhāe suraguru jar̤ jāge
baraṣi prasūn prasaṃsan lāge

verses.sa:
मिलि सपेम रिपुसूदनहि केवटु भेंटेउ राम ।
भूरि भायँ भेंटे भरत लछिमन करत प्रनाम ॥
verses.tr:
mili sapem ripusūdanahi kevaṭu bheṃṭeu rām
bhūri bhāyam̐ bheṃṭe bharat lachiman karat pranām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Whether he would or no, the All-compassionate took and raised him ap and clasped himto his bosom. Those who witnessed the meeting of Bharat and Rama lost all self-consciousness.

How can such an affectionate meeting be described? Their thoughts, words and actions were beyond any poet. Both brothers were filled with the utmost love; self, reason, knowledge and understanding were all forgotten. Tell me who can pourtray such perfect love by what shadow can the poet’s mind attain to it If the poet has a model, he can work out his meaning by the force of words, and players dance when they have an accompaniment; but the love of Rama and Bharat is unapproachable, beyond the conception even of Brahma, Vishnu and Siva; how then can I describe it? If an instrument is only strung with grass, can it make sweet music? When the gods saw the meeting of Bharat and Raghubar they were alarmed and trembled »I] over; but when Vrihaspati had spoken to them, they awoke from their folly and rained down flowers and applauded.
After affectionately embracing Satrughna, Kama greeted the pilot; and then Lakshman too as a brother courteously greeted Bharat.

sections.label: Doha 242
sections.name: नाथ साथ मुनिनाथ के मातु सकल पुर लोग

verses.sa:
भेंटेउ लखन ललकि लघु भाई ।
बहुरि निषादु लीन्ह उर लाई ॥
verses.tr:
bheṃṭeu lakhan lalaki laghu bhāī
bahuri niṣādu līnh ur lāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पुनि मुनिगन दुहुँ भाइन्ह बंदे ।
अभिमत आसिष पाइ अनंदे ॥
verses.tr:
puni munigan duhum̐ bhāinh baṃde
abhimat āsiṣ pāi anaṃde

verses.sa:
सानुज भरत उमगि अनुरागा ।
धरि सिर सिय पद पदुम परागा ॥
verses.tr:
sānuj bharat umagi anurāgā
dhari sir siya pad padum parāgā

verses.sa:
पुनि पुनि करत प्रनाम उठाए ।
सिर कर कमल परसि बैठाए ॥
verses.tr:
puni puni karat pranām uṭhāe
sir kar kamal parasi baiṭhāe

verses.sa:
सीयँ असीस दीन्हि मन माहीं ।
मगन सनेहँ देह सुधि नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
sīyam̐ asīs dīnhi man māhīṃ
magan saneham̐ deh sudhi nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सब बिधि सानुकूल लखि सीता ।
भे निसोच उर अपडर बीता ॥
verses.tr:
sab bidhi sānukūl lakhi sītā
bhe nisoc ur apaḍar bītā

verses.sa:
कोउ किछु कहइ न कोउ किछु पूँछा ।
प्रेम भरा मन निज गति छूँछा ॥
verses.tr:
kou kichu kahai na kou kichu pūm̐chā
prem bharā man nij gati chūm̐chā

verses.sa:
तेहि अवसर केवटु धीरजु धरि ।
जोरि पानि बिनवत प्रनामु करि ॥
verses.tr:
tehi avasar kevaṭu dhīraju dhari
jori pāni binavat pranāmu kari

verses.sa:
नाथ साथ मुनिनाथ के मातु सकल पुर लोग ।
सेवक सेनप सचिव सब आए बिकल बियोग ॥
verses.tr:
nāth sāth munināth ke mātu sakal pur log
sevak senap saciv sab āe bikal biyog
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When he bad fondly embraced his younger brother, Lakshman next took the Nishad to his bosom. Then the two brothers, Bharat and Satrughna, after reverencing all the saints and joyfully receiving from them the desired blessing in a rapture of love, placed on their head the dust of Sita’s lotus feet. As they again and again prostrated themselves
here. It ordinarily means ‘a sheep.’

‘she raised them up, and with a touch of her lotus hands mo-tioned them to be seated; in her heart invoking a blessing upon them, and so absorbed in affection as to lose all selfconsciousness. When he saw Sita to thoroughly propitious, he became free from anxiety and all fear passed away. No one made any remark nor asked any question; the soul was so full of love that it ceased to act. Then the pilot took courage and bowing with clasped hands made humble petition:
‘Distressed by your absence, my lord, there have come with the great sage your mothers and all the: people of the city, your servants, captains and ministers.”

sections.label: Doha 243
sections.name: जेहि लखि लखनहु तें अधिक मिले मुदित मुनिराउ

verses.sa:
सीलसिंधु सुनि गुर आगवनू ।
सिय समीप राखे रिपुदवनू ॥
verses.tr:
sīlasiṃdhu suni gur āgavanū
siya samīp rākhe ripudavanū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
चले सबेग रामु तेहि काला ।
धीर धरम धुर दीनदयाला ॥
verses.tr:
cale sabeg rāmu tehi kālā
dhīr dharam dhur dīnadayālā

verses.sa:
गुरहि देखि सानुज अनुरागे ।
दंड प्रनाम करन प्रभु लागे ॥
verses.tr:
gurahi dekhi sānuj anurāge
daṃḍ pranām karan prabhu lāge

verses.sa:
मुनिबर धाइ लिए उर लाई ।
प्रेम उमगि भेंटे दोउ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
munibar dhāi lie ur lāī
prem umagi bheṃṭe dou bhāī

verses.sa:
प्रेम पुलकि केवट कहि नामू ।
कीन्ह दूरि तें दंड प्रनामू ॥
verses.tr:
prem pulaki kevaṭ kahi nāmū
kīnh dūri teṃ daṃḍ pranāmū

verses.sa:
रामसखा रिषि बरबस भेंटा ।
जनु महि लुठत सनेह समेटा ॥
verses.tr:
rāmasakhā riṣi barabas bheṃṭā
janu mahi luṭhat saneh sameṭā

verses.sa:
रघुपति भगति सुमंगल मूला ।
नभ सराहि सुर बरिसहिं फूला ॥
verses.tr:
raghupati bhagati sumaṃgal mūlā
nabh sarāhi sur barisahiṃ phūlā

verses.sa:
एहि सम निपट नीच कोउ नाहीं ।
बड़ बसिष्ठ सम को जग माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ehi sam nipaṭ nīc kou nāhīṃ
bar̤ basiṣṭh sam ko jag māhīṃ

verses.sa:
जेहि लखि लखनहु तें अधिक मिले मुदित मुनिराउ ।
सो सीतापति भजन को प्रगट प्रताप प्रभाउ ॥
verses.tr:
jehi lakhi lakhanahu teṃ adhik mile mudit munirāu
so sītāpati bhajan ko pragaṭ pratāp prabhāu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When the Ocean of amiability heard the guru had come, he left Satrughna with Sita and went off in haste that very minute; he Rama, the steadfast, the righteous, the allmerciful. On seeing the guru, he and his brother were delighted and fell on their faces to the ground. The holy man ran and raised them up and embraced them, and greeted both brothers with the utmost affection. The pilot, quivering with emotion, gave his name and prostrated himself afar off; but the Rishi must needs greet him asa friend of Rama's, as though love had been spilt upon the ground and he stopped to pick it up Faith in Rama is the root of all goods; in heaven the gods applauding rained down flowers: “There is no one so utterly vile as he, nor any one in the world equal to the great Vasishtha:
Yet the king of saints on seeing him was overjoyed and embraced him before Lakshman; so glorious in their manifestation are the effects of faith in Sita’s lord.”

sections.label: Doha 244
sections.name: भेटीं रघुबर मातु सब करि प्रबोधु परितोषु

verses.sa:
आरत लोग राम सबु जाना ।
करुनाकर सुजान भगवाना ॥
verses.tr:
ārat log rām sabu jānā
karunākar sujān bhagavānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जो जेहि भायँ रहा अभिलाषी ।
तेहि तेहि कै तसि तसि रुख राखी ॥
verses.tr:
jo jehi bhāyam̐ rahā abhilāṣī
tehi tehi kai tasi tasi rukh rākhī

verses.sa:
सानुज मिलि पल महु सब काहू ।
कीन्ह दूरि दुखु दारुन दाहू ॥
verses.tr:
sānuj mili pal mahu sab kāhū
kīnh dūri dukhu dārun dāhū

verses.sa:
यह बड़ि बातँ राम कै नाहीं ।
जिमि घट कोटि एक रबि छाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
yah bar̤i bātam̐ rām kai nāhīṃ
jimi ghaṭ koṭi ek rabi chāhīṃ

verses.sa:
मिलि केवटिहि उमगि अनुरागा ।
पुरजन सकल सराहहिं भागा ॥
verses.tr:
mili kevaṭihi umagi anurāgā
purajan sakal sarāhahiṃ bhāgā

verses.sa:
देखीं राम दुखित महतारीं ।
जनु सुबेलि अवलीं हिम मारीं ॥
verses.tr:
dekhīṃ rām dukhit mahatārīṃ
janu subeli avalīṃ him mārīṃ

verses.sa:
प्रथम राम भेंटी कैकेई ।
सरल सुभायँ भगति मति भेई ॥
verses.tr:
pratham rām bheṃṭī kaikeī
saral subhāyam̐ bhagati mati bheī

verses.sa:
पग परि कीन्ह प्रबोधु बहोरी ।
काल करम बिधि सिर धरि खोरी ॥
verses.tr:
pag pari kīnh prabodhu bahorī
kāl karam bidhi sir dhari khorī

verses.sa: भेटीं रघुबर मातु सब करि प्रबोधु परितोषु ॥
verses.tr: bheṭīṃ raghubar mātu sab kari prabodhu paritoṣu
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: अंब ईस आधीन जगु काहु न देइअ दोषु ॥
verses.tr: aṃb īs ādhīn jagu kāhu na deia doṣu

trans: Finding all the people sad, Rama, the all-merciful and all-wise God, gave every one his wish in the way he most desired; in an instant he and his brother embraced them all and at once removed the sore anguish of their pain. This was no such great thing for Rama to do; similarly the sun is reflected at once in a thousand water jars. All the citizens with rapturous affection embraced the pilot and praised his good fortune. Seeing his mothers as woebegone as the sprays of some delicate Creeper smitten by the frost, Rama first of all saluted Kaikeyi, softening her will by his gentleness and piety. Falling at her feet he soothed her with many words, attributing all the blame to Fate, Destiny and Providence.
Raghubar embraced all his mothers and consoled them, saying: ‘Mother, the world is subject to God; there is no one to blame.’

sections.label: Doha 245
sections.name: महिसुर मंत्री मातु गुर गने लोग लिए साथ

verses.sa:
गुरतिय पद बंदे दुहु भाई ।
सहित बिप्रतिय जे सँग आई ॥
verses.tr:
guratiya pad baṃde duhu bhāī
sahit bipratiya je sam̐g āī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
गंग गौरि सम सब सनमानीं ।
देहिं असीस मुदित मृदु बानी ॥
verses.tr:
gaṃg gauri sam sab sanamānīṃ
dehiṃ asīs mudit mṛdu bānī

verses.sa:
गहि पद लगे सुमित्रा अंका ।
जनु भेटीं संपति अति रंका ॥
verses.tr:
gahi pad lage sumitrā aṃkā
janu bheṭīṃ saṃpati ati raṃkā

verses.sa:
पुनि जननि चरननि दोउ भ्राता ।
परे पेम ब्याकुल सब गाता ॥
verses.tr:
puni janani caranani dou bhrātā
pare pem byākul sab gātā

verses.sa:
अति अनुराग अंब उर लाए ।
नयन सनेह सलिल अन्हवाए ॥
verses.tr:
ati anurāg aṃb ur lāe
nayan saneh salil anhavāe

verses.sa:
तेहि अवसर कर हरष बिषादू ।
किमि कबि कहै मूक जिमि स्वादू ॥
verses.tr:
tehi avasar kar haraṣ biṣādū
kimi kabi kahai mūk jimi svādū

verses.sa:
मिलि जननहि सानुज रघुराऊ ।
गुर सन कहेउ कि धारिअ पाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
mili jananahi sānuj raghurāū
gur san kaheu ki dhāria pāū

verses.sa:
पुरजन पाइ मुनीस नियोगू ।
जल थल तकि तकि उतरेउ लोगू ॥
verses.tr:
purajan pāi munīs niyogū
jal thal taki taki utareu logū

verses.sa: महिसुर मंत्री मातु गुर गने लोग लिए साथ ॥
verses.tr: mahisur maṃtrī mātu gur gane log lie sāth
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: पावन आश्रम गवनु किय भरत लखन रघुनाथ ॥
verses.tr: pāvan āśram gavanu kiya bharat lakhan raghunāth

trans: The two brothers kissed the feet of their guru's wife; as also of the BrAhman ladies who had accompanied her, paying the same honour to them as to Ganga and Ganri; and they with gentle voice gladly gave them their blessing. When he embraced Sumitra, after clasping her feet, he was like a beggar who has picked up a fortune. Then both ‘brothers fell at the feet of queen Kausalya and their whole body was convulsed with love; the mother took them tenderly to her bosom and bathed them wiib tears of affection. How can any poet describe the mingled joy and grief of such a time, any more than adumb man can express the sweetness that he tastes After embracing their mother, Rama and his brother requested the guru to accompany them, and at his command the citizens crossed over, admiring the scenery as they went.
Taking with them the Brahmans, the Minister, the queens, the guru, and some others chosen out of the people, Bharat, Lakshman and Raghunath proceeded to the holy hermitage.

sections.label: Doha 246
sections.name: लागि लागि पग सबनि सिय भेंटति अति अनुराग

verses.sa:
सीय आइ मुनिबर पग लागी ।
उचित असीस लही मन मागी ॥
verses.tr:
sīya āi munibar pag lāgī
ucit asīs lahī man māgī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
गुरपतिनिहि मुनितियन्ह समेता ।
मिली पेमु कहि जाइ न जेता ॥
verses.tr:
gurapatinihi munitiyanh sametā
milī pemu kahi jāi na jetā

verses.sa:
बंदि बंदि पग सिय सबही के ।
आसिरबचन लहे प्रिय जी के ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdi baṃdi pag siya sabahī ke
āsirabacan lahe priya jī ke

verses.sa:
सासु सकल जब सीयँ निहारीं ।
मूदे नयन सहमि सुकुमारीं ॥
verses.tr:
sāsu sakal jab sīyam̐ nihārīṃ
mūde nayan sahami sukumārīṃ

verses.sa:
परीं बधिक बस मनहुँ मरालीं ।
काह कीन्ह करतार कुचालीं ॥
verses.tr:
parīṃ badhik bas manahum̐ marālīṃ
kāh kīnh karatār kucālīṃ

verses.sa:
तिन्ह सिय निरखि निपट दुखु पावा ।
सो सबु सहिअ जो दैउ सहावा ॥
verses.tr:
tinh siya nirakhi nipaṭ dukhu pāvā
so sabu sahia jo daiu sahāvā

verses.sa:
जनकसुता तब उर धरि धीरा ।
नील नलिन लोयन भरि नीरा ॥
verses.tr:
janakasutā tab ur dhari dhīrā
nīl nalin loyan bhari nīrā

verses.sa:
मिली सकल सासुन्ह सिय जाई ।
तेहि अवसर करुना महि छाई ॥
verses.tr:
milī sakal sāsunh siya jāī
tehi avasar karunā mahi chāī

verses.sa: लागि लागि पग सबनि सिय भेंटति अति अनुराग ॥
verses.tr: lāgi lāgi pag sabani siya bheṃṭati ati anurāg
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: हृदयँ असीसहिं पेम बस रहिअहु भरी सोहाग ॥
verses.tr: hṛdayam̐ asīsahiṃ pem bas rahiahu bharī sohāg

trans: Sita came and embraced the saint’s feet and received the precious blessing that her soul desired. The affectionate manner in which she greeted the guru’s wife and the Brahman ladies is beyond description. Again and again she ‘kissed all their feet and received their benediction rejoicing her heart. When the queen-mothers looked at Sita, they closed their eyes and shuddered to see her so delicate, like some cygnet fallen into the clutch of a fowler; what a cruel thing God hasdone As they gazed at her, they became distrest beyond measure, that she should have to bear all that Fate had put upon her. Then Janak’s daughter summoning up courage, while her dark lotus eyes were
suffused with tears, went and embraced all her mothers-inlaw; and that moment Earth reeked with piteousness.
Again and again kissing all their feet, Sita most tender-

sections.label: Doha 247
sections.name: भोरु भएँ रघुनंदनहि जो मुनि आयसु दीन्ह

verses.sa:
बिकल सनेहँ सीय सब रानीं ।
बैठन सबहि कहेउ गुर ग्यानीं ॥
verses.tr:
bikal saneham̐ sīya sab rānīṃ
baiṭhan sabahi kaheu gur gyānīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कहि जग गति मायिक मुनिनाथा ।
कहे कछुक परमारथ गाथा ॥
verses.tr:
kahi jag gati māyik munināthā
kahe kachuk paramārath gāthā

verses.sa:
नृप कर सुरपुर गवनु सुनावा ।
सुनि रघुनाथ दुसह दुखु पावा ॥
verses.tr:
nṛp kar surapur gavanu sunāvā
suni raghunāth dusah dukhu pāvā

verses.sa:
मरन हेतु निज नेहु बिचारी ।
भे अति बिकल धीर धुर धारी ॥
verses.tr:
maran hetu nij nehu bicārī
bhe ati bikal dhīr dhur dhārī

verses.sa:
कुलिस कठोर सुनत कटु बानी ।
बिलपत लखन सीय सब रानी ॥
verses.tr:
kulis kaṭhor sunat kaṭu bānī
bilapat lakhan sīya sab rānī

verses.sa:
सोक बिकल अति सकल समाजू ।
मानहुँ राजु अकाजेउ आजू ॥
verses.tr:
sok bikal ati sakal samājū
mānahum̐ rāju akājeu ājū

verses.sa:
मुनिबर बहुरि राम समुझाए ।
सहित समाज सुसरित नहाए ॥
verses.tr:
munibar bahuri rām samujhāe
sahit samāj susarit nahāe

verses.sa:
ब्रतु निरंबु तेहि दिन प्रभु कीन्हा ।
मुनिहु कहें जलु काहुँ न लीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
bratu niraṃbu tehi din prabhu kīnhā
munihu kaheṃ jalu kāhum̐ na līnhā

verses.sa: भोरु भएँ रघुनंदनहि जो मुनि आयसु दीन्ह ॥
verses.tr: bhoru bhaem̐ raghunaṃdanahi jo muni āyasu dīnh
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: श्रद्धा भगति समेत प्रभु सो सबु सादरु कीन्ह ॥
verses.tr: śraddhā bhagati samet prabhu so sabu sādaru kīnh

trans: ly embraced them: and from their heart came the loving benediction ‘May you long live a happy wife!’ Chaupdi.

Sita and the queens being thus agitated by emotion, the. learned guru bade them all be seated. First he expounded to them the instability of the world and spoke a little of the joys of heaven, and then aanounced the king's death. At the news Raghunath was grievously distrest; thinking * he had died out of love for him, the firmest of the firm was sore shaken. On hearing the sad tidings, which fell upon them like a thunderbolt, Lakshman, Sita and all the queens broke out into lamentations, and the whole assembly was as much agitated as if the king had died only that very day. Then the great sage exhorted Rama and directed him and all the people to bathe in the sacred stream. All that day the lord fasted even from water; and though the saint allowed them, no one else would drink ejther.
At daybreak, according to the order given him by the saint, the lord Raghunandan reverently and devoutly performed his father’s funeral obsequies. Chaupdi.

sections.label: Doha 248
sections.name: धर्म सेतु करुनायतन कस न कहहु अस राम

verses.sa:
करि पितु क्रिया बेद जसि बरनी ।
भे पुनीत पातक तम तरनी ॥
verses.tr:
kari pitu kriyā bed jasi baranī
bhe punīt pātak tam taranī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जासु नाम पावक अघ तूला ।
सुमिरत सकल सुमंगल मूला ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu nām pāvak agh tūlā
sumirat sakal sumaṃgal mūlā

verses.sa:
सुद्ध सो भयउ साधु संमत अस ।
तीरथ आवाहन सुरसरि जस ॥
verses.tr:
suddh so bhayau sādhu saṃmat as
tīrath āvāhan surasari jas

verses.sa:
सुद्ध भएँ दुइ बासर बीते ।
बोले गुर सन राम पिरीते ॥
verses.tr:
suddh bhaem̐ dui bāsar bīte
bole gur san rām pirīte

verses.sa:
नाथ लोग सब निपट दुखारी ।
कंद मूल फल अंबु अहारी ॥
verses.tr:
nāth log sab nipaṭ dukhārī
kaṃd mūl phal aṃbu ahārī

verses.sa:
सानुज भरतु सचिव सब माता ।
देखि मोहि पल जिमि जुग जाता ॥
verses.tr:
sānuj bharatu saciv sab mātā
dekhi mohi pal jimi jug jātā

verses.sa:
सब समेत पुर धारिअ पाऊ ।
आपु इहाँ अमरावति राऊ ॥
verses.tr:
sab samet pur dhāria pāū
āpu ihām̐ amarāvati rāū

verses.sa:
बहुत कहेउँ सब कियउँ ढिठाई ।
उचित होइ तस करिअ गोसाँई ॥
verses.tr:
bahut kaheum̐ sab kiyaum̐ ḍhiṭhāī
ucit hoi tas karia gosām̐ī

verses.sa:
धर्म सेतु करुनायतन कस न कहहु अस राम ।
लोग दुखित दिन दुइ दरस देखि लहहुँ बिश्राम ॥
verses.tr:
dharm setu karunāyatan kas na kahahu as rām
log dukhit din dui daras dekhi lahahum̐ biśrām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Having celebrated every rite as prescribed in the Veda, he became pure, even he, the Sun to annihilate the night of sin, whose name, is a fire that consumes the cotton of wickedness, and which if merely invoked is the source of all prosperity. He became pure, in like manner as, theologians say, a bather in the Ganges who invokes other tiraths is parified.) After his purification, when two days had passed, Rama said affectionately to the guru: ‘My lord, all the people are much inconvenienced by having nothing to-take but water and the wild produce of the woods. When I look at Bharat and his brothers, the Minister and all the queens, a minute seems to me like an age. Return, I pray, with allo€ them to the city: for you are here, the king is in heaven, and there is no one left at Ayodhya. I have said
too much and have presumed greatly: but do, sir, as you think best.”
‘“O Rama, bulwark of righteousness, home of coimpas- | sion, it is but natural for you to speak thus: the people are ‘wearied, let them rest for two days and enjoy your presence.”

sections.label: Doha 249
sections.name: सरनि सरोरुह जल बिहग कूजत गुंजत भृंग

verses.sa:
राम बचन सुनि सभय समाजू ।
जनु जलनिधि महुँ बिकल जहाजू ॥
verses.tr:
rām bacan suni sabhaya samājū
janu jalanidhi mahum̐ bikal jahājū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुनि गुर गिरा सुमंगल मूला ।
भयउ मनहुँ मारुत अनुकुला ॥
verses.tr:
suni gur girā sumaṃgal mūlā
bhayau manahum̐ mārut anukulā

verses.sa:
पावन पयँ तिहुँ काल नहाहीं ।
जो बिलोकि अंघ ओघ नसाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
pāvan payam̐ tihum̐ kāl nahāhīṃ
jo biloki aṃgh ogh nasāhīṃ

verses.sa:
मंगलमूरति लोचन भरि भरि ।
निरखहिं हरषि दंडवत करि करि ॥
verses.tr:
maṃgalamūrati locan bhari bhari
nirakhahiṃ haraṣi daṃḍavat kari kari

verses.sa:
राम सैल बन देखन जाहीं ।
जहँ सुख सकल सकल दुख नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
rām sail ban dekhan jāhīṃ
jaham̐ sukh sakal sakal dukh nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
झरना झरिहिं सुधासम बारी ।
त्रिबिध तापहर त्रिबिध बयारी ॥
verses.tr:
jharanā jharihiṃ sudhāsam bārī
tribidh tāpahar tribidh bayārī

verses.sa:
बिटप बेलि तृन अगनित जाती ।
फल प्रसून पल्लव बहु भाँती ॥
verses.tr:
biṭap beli tṛn aganit jātī
phal prasūn pallav bahu bhām̐tī

verses.sa:
सुंदर सिला सुखद तरु छाहीं ।
जाइ बरनि बन छबि केहि पाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
suṃdar silā sukhad taru chāhīṃ
jāi barani ban chabi kehi pāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सरनि सरोरुह जल बिहग कूजत गुंजत भृंग ।
बैर बिगत बिहरत बिपिन मृग बिहंग बहुरंग ॥
verses.tr:
sarani saroruh jal bihag kūjat guṃjat bhṛṃg
bair bigat biharat bipin mṛg bihaṃg bahuraṃg
verses.head: दोहा

trans: On hearing Rama’s words, the assembly was in dismay, like a ship tossed on the ocean; but when they heard the saint’s auspicious speech, it was as if the wind had turned ip their favour. At the three set times they bathed in the sacred stream, the mere sight of which destroys any multitude of sins; and ever feasting their eyes on the incarnation of blessedness, and again and again prostrating themselves before him, they looked and rejoiced. Then they went to see Rema’s hill and wood where all was good and nought evil: the torrents flowing with streams of nectar; the air so soft, cool and fragrant that it soothed every pain of mind or body; the trees, creepers and grasses of infinite variety; the many kind of fruits, flowers and sprays; the magnificent rocks and the pleasant shade under the trees, all made the forest beautiful beyond description.
The ponds were gay with lotuses, the haunt of cooing waterfowl and buzzing bees, while forgetful of mutual antipathies, beasts roamed in the forest and birds of varied plumage.

sections.label: Doha 250
sections.name: यह जिंयँ जानि सँकोचु तजि करिअ छोहु लखि नेहु

verses.sa:
कोल किरात भिल्ल बनबासी ।
मधु सुचि सुंदर स्वादु सुधा सी ॥
verses.tr:
kol kirāt bhill banabāsī
madhu suci suṃdar svādu sudhā sī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भरि भरि परन पुटीं रचि रुरी ।
कंद मूल फल अंकुर जूरी ॥
verses.tr:
bhari bhari paran puṭīṃ raci rurī
kaṃd mūl phal aṃkur jūrī

verses.sa:
सबहि देहिं करि बिनय प्रनामा ।
कहि कहि स्वाद भेद गुन नामा ॥
verses.tr:
sabahi dehiṃ kari binaya pranāmā
kahi kahi svād bhed gun nāmā

verses.sa:
देहिं लोग बहु मोल न लेहीं ।
फेरत राम दोहाई देहीं ॥
verses.tr:
dehiṃ log bahu mol na lehīṃ
pherat rām dohāī dehīṃ

verses.sa:
कहहिं सनेह मगन मृदु बानी ।
मानत साधु पेम पहिचानी ॥
verses.tr:
kahahiṃ saneh magan mṛdu bānī
mānat sādhu pem pahicānī

verses.sa:
तुम्ह सुकृती हम नीच निषादा ।
पावा दरसनु राम प्रसादा ॥
verses.tr:
tumh sukṛtī ham nīc niṣādā
pāvā darasanu rām prasādā

verses.sa:
हमहि अगम अति दरसु तुम्हारा ।
जस मरु धरनि देवधुनि धारा ॥
verses.tr:
hamahi agam ati darasu tumhārā
jas maru dharani devadhuni dhārā

verses.sa:
राम कृपाल निषाद नेवाजा ।
परिजन प्रजउ चहिअ जस राजा ॥
verses.tr:
rām kṛpāl niṣād nevājā
parijan prajau cahia jas rājā

verses.sa:
यह जिंयँ जानि सँकोचु तजि करिअ छोहु लखि नेहु ।
हमहि कृतारथ करन लगि फल तृन अंकुर लेहु ॥
verses.tr:
yah jiṃyam̐ jāni sam̐kocu taji karia chohu lakhi nehu
hamahi kṛtārath karan lagi phal tṛn aṃkur lehu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The Kols, Kirats and Bhils, the inhabitants of the woods, brought delicious honey sweet as nectar, and piled Op leafy bowls with herbs, roots, fruits and flowers daiatily arranged. With humble salutations they offered them to all telling the taste, character, quality and name of each. The people offered a liberal price, but they would not accept it, and begged them for Rama’s sake to take it back, saying in gentle tones in the depth of their affection: ‘Phe good accept what they know to be of love. You are holy, and we low Nishads; by Rama’s favour we have been admitted into your presence, an honour as difficult of attain ment for us as for the desert of Maru to be watered by the Ganges. Rama is merciful and the Nishads’ patron; as i the king, so should be his family and subjects.
Consider this in your mind,and without more demu recognize our affection and make friends with us; accep these fruits and herbs and flowers and so render us happy.

sections.label: Doha 251
sections.name: बिहरहिं बन चहु ओर प्रतिदिन प्रमुदित लोग सब

verses.sa:
तुम्ह प्रिय पाहुने बन पगु धारे ।
सेवा जोगु न भाग हमारे ॥
verses.tr:
tumh priya pāhune ban pagu dhāre
sevā jogu na bhāg hamāre
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
देब काह हम तुम्हहि गोसाँई ।
ईधनु पात किरात मिताई ॥
verses.tr:
deb kāh ham tumhahi gosām̐ī
īdhanu pāt kirāt mitāī

verses.sa:
यह हमारि अति बड़ि सेवकाई ।
लेहि न बासन बसन चोराई ॥
verses.tr:
yah hamāri ati bar̤i sevakāī
lehi na bāsan basan corāī

verses.sa:
हम जड़ जीव जीव गन घाती ।
कुटिल कुचाली कुमति कुजाती ॥
verses.tr:
ham jar̤ jīv jīv gan ghātī
kuṭil kucālī kumati kujātī

verses.sa:
पाप करत निसि बासर जाहीं ।
नहिं पट कटि नहि पेट अघाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
pāp karat nisi bāsar jāhīṃ
nahiṃ paṭ kaṭi nahi peṭ aghāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सपोनेहुँ धरम बुद्धि कस काऊ ।
यह रघुनंदन दरस प्रभाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
saponehum̐ dharam buddhi kas kāū
yah raghunaṃdan daras prabhāū

verses.sa:
जब तें प्रभु पद पदुम निहारे ।
मिटे दुसह दुख दोष हमारे ॥
verses.tr:
jab teṃ prabhu pad padum nihāre
miṭe dusah dukh doṣ hamāre

verses.sa:
बचन सुनत पुरजन अनुरागे ।
तिन्ह के भाग सराहन लागे ॥
verses.tr:
bacan sunat purajan anurāge
tinh ke bhāg sarāhan lāge

verses.sa:
लागे सराहन भाग सब अनुराग बचन सुनावहीं ।
बोलनि मिलनि सिय राम चरन सनेहु लखि सुखु पावहीं ॥
verses.tr:
lāge sarāhan bhāg sab anurāg bacan sunāvahīṃ
bolani milani siya rām caran sanehu lakhi sukhu pāvahīṃ
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
नर नारि निदरहिं नेहु निज सुनि कोल भिल्लनि की गिरा ।
तुलसी कृपा रघुबंसमनि की लोह लै लौका तिरा ॥
verses.tr:
nar nāri nidarahiṃ nehu nij suni kol bhillani kī girā
tulasī kṛpā raghubaṃsamani kī loh lai laukā tirā

verses.sa:
बिहरहिं बन चहु ओर प्रतिदिन प्रमुदित लोग सब ।
जल ज्यों दादुर मोर भए पीन पावस प्रथम ॥
verses.tr:
biharahiṃ ban cahu or pratidin pramudit log sab
jal jyoṃ dādur mor bhae pīn pāvas pratham
verses.head: दोहा

trans: You have come to the forest as our welcome guests though we are all unworthy to do you service. And what i it, sirs, that we offer you uel and fodder are a Kirat’ tokens of friendship, and our greatest service is not to steal and run off with your clothes and dishes. We are a rod people, often taking life, of vile nature and vile pursuits low-minded and low-born, who day and night commit sin without either clothes for the body or food to satisfy the belly; how could we possibly have ever dreamt of the know ledge of virtue, but for the effectual apparition of Rama Since we beheld our lord’s lotus feet, our sore distress and sin have both been removed.” On hearing this speech the citizens were much affected and broke out into praise of their good fortune.:

All began to praise their good fortune and addressed them in loving terms, being delighted to find in their speech and attitude such devotion to the feet of Sita and Rama Every one, man or woman, thought little of his own devo tion, on hearing the language of the Kols and Bhils through the mercy of the jewel of Raghu’s line (says Tulsi a boat floats, even though laden with iron.
Day after day all the people felt as great delight, as the: roamed through every part of the forest, as the frogs an peacocks when invigorated by a shower at the beginning o the rains.

sections.label: Doha 252
sections.name: निसि न नीद नहिं भूख दिन भरतु बिकल सुचि सोच

verses.sa:
पुर जन नारि मगन अति प्रीती ।
बासर जाहिं पलक सम बीती ॥
verses.tr:
pur jan nāri magan ati prītī
bāsar jāhiṃ palak sam bītī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सीय सासु प्रति बेष बनाई ।
सादर करइ सरिस सेवकाई ॥
verses.tr:
sīya sāsu prati beṣ banāī
sādar karai saris sevakāī

verses.sa:
लखा न मरमु राम बिनु काहूँ ।
माया सब सिय माया माहूँ ॥
verses.tr:
lakhā na maramu rām binu kāhūm̐
māyā sab siya māyā māhūm̐

verses.sa:
सीयँ सासु सेवा बस कीन्हीं ।
तिन्ह लहि सुख सिख आसिष दीन्हीं ॥
verses.tr:
sīyam̐ sāsu sevā bas kīnhīṃ
tinh lahi sukh sikh āsiṣ dīnhīṃ

verses.sa:
लखि सिय सहित सरल दोउ भाई ।
कुटिल रानि पछितानि अघाई ॥
verses.tr:
lakhi siya sahit saral dou bhāī
kuṭil rāni pachitāni aghāī

verses.sa:
अवनि जमहि जाचति कैकेई ।
महि न बीचु बिधि मीचु न देई ॥
verses.tr:
avani jamahi jācati kaikeī
mahi na bīcu bidhi mīcu na deī

verses.sa:
लोकहुँ बेद बिदित कबि कहहीं ।
राम बिमुख थलु नरक न लहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
lokahum̐ bed bidit kabi kahahīṃ
rām bimukh thalu narak na lahahīṃ

verses.sa:
यहु संसउ सब के मन माहीं ।
राम गवनु बिधि अवध कि नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
yahu saṃsau sab ke man māhīṃ
rām gavanu bidhi avadh ki nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
निसि न नीद नहिं भूख दिन भरतु बिकल सुचि सोच ।
नीच कीच बिच मगन जस मीनहि सलिल सँकोच ॥
verses.tr:
nisi na nīd nahiṃ bhūkh din bharatu bikal suci soc
nīc kīc bic magan jas mīnahi salil sam̐koc
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The citizens of Ayodhya were so absorbed in excess o
love that a day was gone ina mioute. Sita, assuming a many formsas she had mothers-in-law, waited reverently

upon them all with equal attention. No one but Rama noticed the miracle; for Sita is the very power of delusion, and the Delusion’s lord. Sita won over all the queens by her services, and they being pleased gave her both instruction and benediction. Looking at Sita and the two noble brothers, the wicked queen repented bitterly: and Kaikeyi now prays in her heart: “Is there no escape for me? Does God refuse me even death? as it is declared in the Vedas and by popular tradition, and as the poets also have sung, that if Rama be against you, not even in hell can you find a restingplace.”’ Now this was the question in every one’s mind: * Good God, will Rama return to Avadh or not?”
Bharat was so anxious and sorely perplext that he could neither sleep by night nor eat by day, like asa fish sunk in the last of the mud is in trouble about water..

sections.label: Doha 253
sections.name: गुर पद कमल प्रनामु करि बैठे आयसु पाइ

verses.sa:
कीन्ही मातु मिस काल कुचाली ।
ईति भीति जस पाकत साली ॥
verses.tr:
kīnhī mātu mis kāl kucālī
īti bhīti jas pākat sālī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
केहि बिधि होइ राम अभिषेकू ।
मोहि अवकलत उपाउ न एकू ॥
verses.tr:
kehi bidhi hoi rām abhiṣekū
mohi avakalat upāu na ekū

verses.sa:
अवसि फिरहिं गुर आयसु मानी ।
मुनि पुनि कहब राम रुचि जानी ॥
verses.tr:
avasi phirahiṃ gur āyasu mānī
muni puni kahab rām ruci jānī

verses.sa:
मातु कहेहुँ बहुरहिं रघुराऊ ।
राम जननि हठ करबि कि काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
mātu kahehum̐ bahurahiṃ raghurāū
rām janani haṭh karabi ki kāū

verses.sa:
मोहि अनुचर कर केतिक बाता ।
तेहि महँ कुसमउ बाम बिधाता ॥
verses.tr:
mohi anucar kar ketik bātā
tehi maham̐ kusamau bām bidhātā

verses.sa:
जौं हठ करउँ त निपट कुकरमू ।
हरगिरि तें गुरु सेवक धरमू ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ haṭh karaum̐ ta nipaṭ kukaramū
haragiri teṃ guru sevak dharamū

verses.sa:
एकउ जुगुति न मन ठहरानी ।
सोचत भरतहि रैनि बिहानी ॥
verses.tr:
ekau juguti na man ṭhaharānī
socat bharatahi raini bihānī

verses.sa:
प्रात नहाइ प्रभुहि सिर नाई ।
बैठत पठए रिषयँ बोलाई ॥
verses.tr:
prāt nahāi prabhuhi sir nāī
baiṭhat paṭhae riṣayam̐ bolāī

verses.sa:
गुर पद कमल प्रनामु करि बैठे आयसु पाइ ।
बिप्र महाजन सचिव सब जुरे सभासद आइ ॥
verses.tr:
gur pad kamal pranāmu kari baiṭhe āyasu pāi
bipr mahājan saciv sab jure sabhāsad āi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘Tt was Fate in my mother’s form that did me _ this injury, as when a ricefield ripening for the harvest is smitten by hail. In what manner can Rama's coronation be secured? There is nothing now left for me to do. He would certainly return in obedience to an order of the guru; but then the saint will only order what knows Rama to wish. At his mother’s bidding, too, he would return, but Kausalya would never insist upon anything. Of what account am I, who am only his vassal, and am fallen upon evil times, and have God against me. If I resist him, it would be a grievous sin; for the duty of a servant to his master out-weighs Kuilds.” Without being able to settle a single plan in his mind, Bharat spent the whole night in thought. At daybreak he bathed, bowed his head to his lord, and was sitting down when he was sent for by the Rishi.
After saluting the guru’s lotus feet and receiving his permission, he took his seat: while all the Brahmans, nobles and ministers of state came and assembled in council.

sections.label: Doha 254
sections.name: राखें राम रजाइ रुख हम सब कर हित होइ

verses.sa:
बोले मुनिबरु समय समाना ।
सुनहु सभासद भरत सुजाना ॥
verses.tr:
bole munibaru samaya samānā
sunahu sabhāsad bharat sujānā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
धरम धुरीन भानुकुल भानू ।
राजा रामु स्वबस भगवानू ॥
verses.tr:
dharam dhurīn bhānukul bhānū
rājā rāmu svabas bhagavānū

verses.sa:
सत्यसंध पालक श्रुति सेतू ।
राम जनमु जग मंगल हेतू ॥
verses.tr:
satyasaṃdh pālak śruti setū
rām janamu jag maṃgal hetū

verses.sa:
गुर पितु मातु बचन अनुसारी ।
खल दलु दलन देव हितकारी ॥
verses.tr:
gur pitu mātu bacan anusārī
khal dalu dalan dev hitakārī

verses.sa:
नीति प्रीति परमारथ स्वारथु ।
कोउ न राम सम जान जथारथु ॥
verses.tr:
nīti prīti paramārath svārathu
kou na rām sam jān jathārathu

verses.sa:
बिधि हरि हरु ससि रबि दिसिपाला ।
माया जीव करम कुलि काला ॥
verses.tr:
bidhi hari haru sasi rabi disipālā
māyā jīv karam kuli kālā

verses.sa:
अहिप महिप जहँ लगि प्रभुताई ।
जोग सिद्धि निगमागम गाई ॥
verses.tr:
ahip mahip jaham̐ lagi prabhutāī
jog siddhi nigamāgam gāī

verses.sa:
करि बिचार जिंयँ देखहु नीकें ।
राम रजाइ सीस सबही कें ॥
verses.tr:
kari bicār jiṃyam̐ dekhahu nīkeṃ
rām rajāi sīs sabahī keṃ

verses.sa:
राखें राम रजाइ रुख हम सब कर हित होइ ।
समुझि सयाने करहु अब सब मिलि संमत सोइ ॥
verses.tr:
rākheṃ rām rajāi rukh ham sab kar hit hoi
samujhi sayāne karahu ab sab mili saṃmat soi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The great sage addressed them in words appropriate to the occasion: “Hearken, ye counsellor, and you, wise Bharat. The champion of righteousness, the sun of the Solar race, king Rama, the autocratic, the lord God, the ocean of truth, the protector, the bulwark of scripture, has taken birth for the benefit of the whole world. Obedient to the word of his guru and his father and mother; destroy~ ing the armies of the wicked and befriending the gods; in policy and devotion, in all things that pertain to this life or the next, there is no one equal to Rama in the knowledge of whatis right. Brahma, Vishnu and Siva; the sun, the moon, the guardians of the spheres, Delusion, life, Fate, and this Iron age; the sovereigns of hell, the sovereigns of earth and all the powers that be; magic and sorcery and every spell in the Vedas and the Tantras—ponder it in your heart and consider well—all are obedient to Rama’s commands,
If we observe Rama’s pleasure and commands, it will be well for us all; now, wise sirs, think it over, and all re-solye to do whatever may be decided.

sections.label: Doha 255
sections.name: बूझिअ मोहि उपाउ अब सो सब मोर अभागु

verses.sa:
सब कहुँ सुखद राम अभिषेकू ।
मंगल मोद मूल मग एकू ॥
verses.tr:
sab kahum̐ sukhad rām abhiṣekū
maṃgal mod mūl mag ekū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
केहि बिधि अवध चलहिं रघुराऊ ।
कहहु समुझि सोइ करिअ उपाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
kehi bidhi avadh calahiṃ raghurāū
kahahu samujhi soi karia upāū

verses.sa:
सब सादर सुनि मुनिबर बानी ।
नय परमारथ स्वारथ सानी ॥
verses.tr:
sab sādar suni munibar bānī
naya paramārath svārath sānī

verses.sa:
उतरु न आव लोग भए भोरे ।
तब सिरु नाइ भरत कर जोरे ॥
verses.tr:
utaru na āv log bhae bhore
tab siru nāi bharat kar jore

verses.sa:
भानुबंस भए भूप घनेरे ।
अधिक एक तें एक बड़ेरे ॥
verses.tr:
bhānubaṃs bhae bhūp ghanere
adhik ek teṃ ek bar̤ere

verses.sa:
जनमु हेतु सब कहँ पितु माता ।
करम सुभासुभ देइ बिधाता ॥
verses.tr:
janamu hetu sab kaham̐ pitu mātā
karam subhāsubh dei bidhātā

verses.sa:
दलि दुख सजइ सकल कल्याना ।
अस असीस राउरि जगु जाना ॥
verses.tr:
dali dukh sajai sakal kalyānā
as asīs rāuri jagu jānā

verses.sa:
सो गोसाइँ बिधि गति जेहिं छेंकी ।
सकइ को टारि टेक जो टेकी ॥
verses.tr:
so gosāim̐ bidhi gati jehiṃ cheṃkī
sakai ko ṭāri ṭek jo ṭekī

verses.sa:
बूझिअ मोहि उपाउ अब सो सब मोर अभागु ।
सुनि सनेहमय बचन गुर उर उमगा अनुरागु ॥
verses.tr:
būjhia mohi upāu ab so sab mor abhāgu
suni sanehamaya bacan gur ur umagā anurāgu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Rama’s coronation will be agreeable to all, as a sure source of happiness and the one way to felicity. How is he to be brought back to Avadh? Think before you speak, and upon that plan we will act.” All listened respectfully to Vasishtha’s speech, full as it was of justice, religion and worldly wisdom; but no answer was forthooming: every one was dumbfounded, till with bowed head and clasped hands Bharat spoke: ‘In the Solar race there have been many kings, each one greater than the other; all owed their birth to their parents, but their good or ill fortune was the gift of God. And, as all the world knows, it was through your blessing that they triumphed over sorrow and attained complete prosperity; whatever the course of fate that you, sir, marked out for them, none could alter it; it was fixed immoveably..
And yet now you ask advice of me: such is my ill fate.” When the guru heard this affectionate speech, love sprung up in his heart,

sections.label: Doha 256
sections.name: अँतरजामी रामु सिय तुम्ह सरबग्य सुजान

verses.sa:
तात बात फुरि राम कृपाहीं ।
राम बिमुख सिधि सपनेहुँ नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
tāt bāt phuri rām kṛpāhīṃ
rām bimukh sidhi sapanehum̐ nāhīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सकुचउँ तात कहत एक बाता ।
अरध तजहिं बुध सरबस जाता ॥
verses.tr:
sakucaum̐ tāt kahat ek bātā
aradh tajahiṃ budh sarabas jātā

verses.sa:
तुम्ह कानन गवनहु दोउ भाई ।
फेरिअहिं लखन सीय रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
tumh kānan gavanahu dou bhāī
pheriahiṃ lakhan sīya raghurāī

verses.sa:
सुनि सुबचन हरषे दोउ भ्राता ।
भे प्रमोद परिपूरन गाता ॥
verses.tr:
suni subacan haraṣe dou bhrātā
bhe pramod paripūran gātā

verses.sa:
मन प्रसन्न तन तेजु बिराजा ।
जनु जिय राउ रामु भए राजा ॥
verses.tr:
man prasann tan teju birājā
janu jiya rāu rāmu bhae rājā

verses.sa:
बहुत लाभ लोगन्ह लघु हानी ।
सम दुख सुख सब रोवहिं रानी ॥
verses.tr:
bahut lābh loganh laghu hānī
sam dukh sukh sab rovahiṃ rānī

verses.sa:
कहहिं भरतु मुनि कहा सो कीन्हे ।
फलु जग जीवन्ह अभिमत दीन्हे ॥
verses.tr:
kahahiṃ bharatu muni kahā so kīnhe
phalu jag jīvanh abhimat dīnhe

verses.sa:
कानन करउँ जनम भरि बासू ।
एहिं तें अधिक न मोर सुपासू ॥
verses.tr:
kānan karaum̐ janam bhari bāsū
ehiṃ teṃ adhik na mor supāsū

verses.sa:
अँतरजामी रामु सिय तुम्ह सरबग्य सुजान ।
जो फुर कहहु त नाथ निज कीजिअ बचनु प्रवान ॥
verses.tr:
am̐tarajāmī rāmu siya tumh sarabagya sujān
jo phur kahahu ta nāth nij kījia bacanu pravān
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “My son, this is a true saying, it is all Rama’s mercy; without Rama no one can ever dream of happiness. There ig one way, my son, though I am ashamed to propose it; but a wise man will sacrifice the half when he sees the whole going; do you two brothers go into exile, then Lakshman, Sita and Rama will come back.” On hearing this favourable speech, the two brothers rejoiced and their whole body thrilled with excitement; they were as pleased at heart and as radiant all over as if king Dasarath had been restored to life and Rama were already enthroned. The people gained much and sacrificed little; but the queens all wept, for their pain was equal to their joy. Said Bbarat: ‘What the saint has proposed is already as good as none; he has granted me the one thing above all others that I most desired. I will stay all my life in the forest; there is nothing I should like better.
Rama and Sita know my heart and you are full of knowledge and wisdom; if, my lord, you mean what you say, make your word good.”

sections.label: Doha 257
sections.name: सब के उर अंतर बसहु जानहु भाउ कुभाउ

verses.sa:
भरत बचन सुनि देखि सनेहू ।
सभा सहित मुनि भए बिदेहू ॥
verses.tr:
bharat bacan suni dekhi sanehū
sabhā sahit muni bhae bidehū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भरत महा महिमा जलरासी ।
मुनि मति ठाढ़ि तीर अबला सी ॥
verses.tr:
bharat mahā mahimā jalarāsī
muni mati ṭhār̤hi tīr abalā sī

verses.sa:
गा चह पार जतनु हियँ हेरा ।
पावति नाव न बोहितु बेरा ॥
verses.tr:
gā cah pār jatanu hiyam̐ herā
pāvati nāv na bohitu berā

verses.sa:
औरु करिहि को भरत बड़ाई ।
सरसी सीपि कि सिंधु समाई ॥
verses.tr:
auru karihi ko bharat bar̤āī
sarasī sīpi ki siṃdhu samāī

verses.sa:
भरतु मुनिहि मन भीतर भाए ।
सहित समाज राम पहिं आए ॥
verses.tr:
bharatu munihi man bhītar bhāe
sahit samāj rām pahiṃ āe

verses.sa:
प्रभु प्रनामु करि दीन्ह सुआसनु ।
बैठे सब सुनि मुनि अनुसासनु ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu pranāmu kari dīnh suāsanu
baiṭhe sab suni muni anusāsanu

verses.sa:
बोले मुनिबरु बचन बिचारी ।
देस काल अवसर अनुहारी ॥
verses.tr:
bole munibaru bacan bicārī
des kāl avasar anuhārī

verses.sa:
सुनहु राम सरबग्य सुजाना ।
धरम नीति गुन ग्यान निधाना ॥
verses.tr:
sunahu rām sarabagya sujānā
dharam nīti gun gyān nidhānā

verses.sa:
सब के उर अंतर बसहु जानहु भाउ कुभाउ ।
पुरजन जननी भरत हित होइ सो कहिअ उपाउ ॥
verses.tr:
sab ke ur aṃtar basahu jānahu bhāu kubhāu
purajan jananī bharat hit hoi so kahia upāu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Hearing Bharat’s words and seeing his love, the saint and the whole assembly were transported out of themselves. Bharat’s vast generosity was like «a sheet of water and the saint’s proposal like a woman standing on its brink, anxious to cross and trying different ways, but unable to find either ship, boat, or raft. Who can describe Bharat’s magnanimity? Can the ocean be contained ina river-shell The saint was inwardly at heart charmed with Bharat, and accompanied by the assembly went to Rama. The lord saluted him and led him to a seat of honour and on receiving the saint’s permission all sat down. Then spoke Vasishtha in well-considered words, according to the circumstances of the place and time: ‘Hearken, Rama; you are omniscient and wise, a store-house of piety, pradence, virtue and intelligence;
You dwell io the hearts of all and know what they really wish or do not wish: now advise what will be best for your subjects, your mothers and Bharat.

sections.label: Doha 258
sections.name: भरत बिनय सादर सुनिअ करिअ बिचारु बहोरि

verses.sa:
आरत कहहिं बिचारि न काऊ ।
सूझ जूआरिहि आपन दाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
ārat kahahiṃ bicāri na kāū
sūjh jūārihi āpan dāū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुनि मुनि बचन कहत रघुराऊ ।
नाथ तुम्हारेहि हाथ उपाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
suni muni bacan kahat raghurāū
nāth tumhārehi hāth upāū

verses.sa:
सब कर हित रुख राउरि राखें ।
आयसु किएँ मुदित फुर भाषें ॥
verses.tr:
sab kar hit rukh rāuri rākheṃ
āyasu kiem̐ mudit phur bhāṣeṃ

verses.sa:
प्रथम जो आयसु मो कहुँ होई ।
माथें मानि करौ सिख सोई ॥
verses.tr:
pratham jo āyasu mo kahum̐ hoī
mātheṃ māni karau sikh soī

verses.sa:
पुनि जेहि कहँ जस कहब गोसाईं ।
सो सब भाँति घटिहि सेवकाईं ॥
verses.tr:
puni jehi kaham̐ jas kahab gosāīṃ
so sab bhām̐ti ghaṭihi sevakāīṃ

verses.sa:
कह मुनि राम सत्य तुम्ह भाषा ।
भरत सनेहँ बिचारु न राखा ॥
verses.tr:
kah muni rām satya tumh bhāṣā
bharat saneham̐ bicāru na rākhā

verses.sa:
तेहि तें कहउँ बहोरि बहोरी ।
भरत भगति बस भइ मति मोरी ॥
verses.tr:
tehi teṃ kahaum̐ bahori bahorī
bharat bhagati bas bhai mati morī

verses.sa:
मोरें जान भरत रुचि राखि ।
जो कीजिअ सो सुभ सिव साखी ॥
verses.tr:
moreṃ jān bharat ruci rākhi
jo kījia so subh siv sākhī

verses.sa:
भरत बिनय सादर सुनिअ करिअ बिचारु बहोरि ।
करब साधुमत लोकमत नृपनय निगम निचोरि ॥
verses.tr:
bharat binaya sādar sunia karia bicāru bahori
karab sādhumat lokamat nṛpanaya nigam nicori
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ee 1 For, though they recovered two of their sons, they lost the other two.

A man in pain talks wildly, and a gambler watches only his own play.” ‘On hearing the saint’s speech, Raghurai replied: ‘My lord, the remedy is ia your own hands. To attend to your wishes will be best for all. Only give the order, and cheerfully, [ assure you, whatever your commands may be, I answer for myself in the first place, those instructions I will dutifully obey; and after me, each, as he has his orders, will hasten to do his service.” Said the saint: Rama, you say truly; but Bharat's affection has disturbed calculation; therefore I say again and again my judgment is overcome by Bharat’'s piety; in my opinion, Siva be my witness, whatever will please Bharat is the best thing to be done.

Listen respectfully to Bharat’s prayer; reconsider the matter; and after weighing well the duties of a king and the texts of Scripture, take the advice given you both by philosophers and men of the world.”

sections.label: Doha 259
sections.name: तब मुनि बोले भरत सन सब सँकोचु तजि तात

verses.sa:
गुरु अनुराग भरत पर देखी ।
राम ह्दयँ आनंदु बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
guru anurāg bharat par dekhī
rām hdayam̐ ānaṃdu biseṣī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भरतहि धरम धुरंधर जानी ।
निज सेवक तन मानस बानी ॥
verses.tr:
bharatahi dharam dhuraṃdhar jānī
nij sevak tan mānas bānī

verses.sa:
बोले गुर आयस अनुकूला ।
बचन मंजु मृदु मंगलमूला ॥
verses.tr:
bole gur āyas anukūlā
bacan maṃju mṛdu maṃgalamūlā

verses.sa:
नाथ सपथ पितु चरन दोहाई ।
भयउ न भुअन भरत सम भाई ॥
verses.tr:
nāth sapath pitu caran dohāī
bhayau na bhuan bharat sam bhāī

verses.sa:
जे गुर पद अंबुज अनुरागी ।
ते लोकहुँ बेदहुँ बड़भागी ॥
verses.tr:
je gur pad aṃbuj anurāgī
te lokahum̐ bedahum̐ bar̤abhāgī

verses.sa:
राउर जा पर अस अनुरागू ।
को कहि सकइ भरत कर भागू ॥
verses.tr:
rāur jā par as anurāgū
ko kahi sakai bharat kar bhāgū

verses.sa:
लखि लघु बंधु बुद्धि सकुचाई ।
करत बदन पर भरत बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
lakhi laghu baṃdhu buddhi sakucāī
karat badan par bharat bar̤āī

verses.sa:
भरतु कहहीं सोइ किएँ भलाई ।
अस कहि राम रहे अरगाई ॥
verses.tr:
bharatu kahahīṃ soi kiem̐ bhalāī
as kahi rām rahe aragāī

verses.sa:
तब मुनि बोले भरत सन सब सँकोचु तजि तात ।
कृपासिंधु प्रिय बंधु सन कहहु हृदय कै बात ॥
verses.tr:
tab muni bole bharat san sab sam̐kocu taji tāt
kṛpāsiṃdhu priya baṃdhu san kahahu hṛdaya kai bāt
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Seeing the guru’s love for Bharat, Rama’s heart rejoiced exceedingly, for he knew Bharat to be a champion of righteousness, and in thought, word and deed his own faithful servant. In obedience to the guru’s commands, he made this sweet, gentle and excellent reply: “I swear by you, my lord, and by my father’s feet that io all the world there has been no brother like Bharat. All who love the lotus feet of their guru are highly blessed: so say both the world and the Veda. But who can tell Bharat’s blessedness, to whom such love has been shown by you? When I look at him, my younger brother, my senses are abashed, as I thus praise him to his face. Whatever Bharat says, that will be good for us tu do.” Having so said Rama remained silent.
Then the saint said to Bharat. ‘Put:aside all diffidence, my son, and tell the Ocean of mercy, your own dear brother, what you really have at heart.”

sections.label: Doha 260
sections.name: महूँ सनेह सकोच बस सनमुख कही न बैन

verses.sa:
सुनि मुनि बचन राम रुख पाई ।
गुरु साहिब अनुकूल अघाई ॥
verses.tr:
suni muni bacan rām rukh pāī
guru sāhib anukūl aghāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
लखि अपने सिर सबु छरु भारू ।
कहि न सकहिं कछु करहिं बिचारू ॥
verses.tr:
lakhi apane sir sabu charu bhārū
kahi na sakahiṃ kachu karahiṃ bicārū

verses.sa:
पुलकि सरीर सभाँ भए ठाढें ।
नीरज नयन नेह जल बाढ़ें ॥
verses.tr:
pulaki sarīr sabhām̐ bhae ṭhāḍheṃ
nīraj nayan neh jal bār̤heṃ

verses.sa:
कहब मोर मुनिनाथ निबाहा ।
एहि तें अधिक कहौं मैं काहा ॥
verses.tr:
kahab mor munināth nibāhā
ehi teṃ adhik kahauṃ maiṃ kāhā

verses.sa:
मैं जानउँ निज नाथ सुभाऊ ।
अपराधिहु पर कोह न काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ jānaum̐ nij nāth subhāū
aparādhihu par koh na kāū

verses.sa:
मो पर कृपा सनेह बिसेषी ।
खेलत खुनिस न कबहूँ देखी ॥
verses.tr:
mo par kṛpā saneh biseṣī
khelat khunis na kabahūm̐ dekhī

verses.sa:
सिसुपन तेम परिहरेउँ न संगू ।
कबहुँ न कीन्ह मोर मन भंगू ॥
verses.tr:
sisupan tem parihareum̐ na saṃgū
kabahum̐ na kīnh mor man bhaṃgū

verses.sa:
मैं प्रभु कृपा रीति जियँ जोही ।
हारेहुँ खेल जितावहिं मोही ॥
verses.tr:
maiṃ prabhu kṛpā rīti jiyam̐ johī
hārehum̐ khel jitāvahiṃ mohī

verses.sa:
महूँ सनेह सकोच बस सनमुख कही न बैन ।
दरसन तृपित न आजु लगि पेम पिआसे नैन ॥
verses.tr:
mahūm̐ saneh sakoc bas sanamukh kahī na bain
darasan tṛpit na āju lagi pem piāse nain
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Hearing the saint’s address, and having already received Rama's consent, he was satisfied of the good-will both of his guru and his master; but seeing the weight of the whole business put upon his head, be could say nothing and remained lost in thought, as he stood in the assembly, quivering all over his body, and his lotus eyes filled with the moisture of affection: ‘The king of saints has already spoken for me: what more is there for me to say? I know my lord's amiable disposition, that he never shows displeasure even to the guilty; and for me he has a special tenderness and love; even in play he never gave me an angry look. From a child I have never left him, ‘and never at any time has he wounded my feelings. I have observed my lord’s gracious ways; when beating me in any game he would allow me to win,
T am too much overcome by affection and modesty to say a word before him; to this day my eyes, thirsting for his love, have not been satiated with the sight of him.

sections.label: Doha 261
sections.name: साधु सभा गुर प्रभु निकट कहउँ सुथल सति भाउ

verses.sa:
बिधि न सकेउ सहि मोर दुलारा ।
नीच बीचु जननी मिस पारा ॥
verses.tr:
bidhi na sakeu sahi mor dulārā
nīc bīcu jananī mis pārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
यहउ कहत मोहि आजु न सोभा ।
अपनीं समुझि साधु सुचि को भा ॥
verses.tr:
yahau kahat mohi āju na sobhā
apanīṃ samujhi sādhu suci ko bhā

verses.sa:
मातु मंदि मैं साधु सुचाली ।
उर अस आनत कोटि कुचाली ॥
verses.tr:
mātu maṃdi maiṃ sādhu sucālī
ur as ānat koṭi kucālī

verses.sa:
फरइ कि कोदव बालि सुसाली ।
मुकुता प्रसव कि संबुक काली ॥
verses.tr:
pharai ki kodav bāli susālī
mukutā prasav ki saṃbuk kālī

verses.sa:
सपनेहुँ दोसक लेसु न काहू ।
मोर अभाग उदधि अवगाहू ॥
verses.tr:
sapanehum̐ dosak lesu na kāhū
mor abhāg udadhi avagāhū

verses.sa:
बिनु समुझें निज अघ परिपाकू ।
जारिउँ जायँ जननि कहि काकू ॥
verses.tr:
binu samujheṃ nij agh paripākū
jārium̐ jāyam̐ janani kahi kākū

verses.sa:
हृदयँ हेरि हारेउँ सब ओरा ।
एकहि भाँति भलेहिं भल मोरा ॥
verses.tr:
hṛdayam̐ heri hāreum̐ sab orā
ekahi bhām̐ti bhalehiṃ bhal morā

verses.sa:
गुर गोसाइँ साहिब सिय रामू ।
लागत मोहि नीक परिनामू ॥
verses.tr:
gur gosāim̐ sāhib siya rāmū
lāgat mohi nīk parināmū

verses.sa:
साधु सभा गुर प्रभु निकट कहउँ सुथल सति भाउ ।
प्रेम प्रपंचु कि झूठ फुर जानहिं मुनि रघुराउ ॥
verses.tr:
sādhu sabhā gur prabhu nikaṭ kahaum̐ suthal sati bhāu
prem prapaṃcu ki jhūṭh phur jānahiṃ muni raghurāu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: God could not endure my fondness, and cruelly interposed an obstacle by means of my mother. [ saying this now I do myself no honour. Who is made good by his own good estimation? To get into my mind that my mother is a wretch and I myself good and upright is a thousand times worse. Can rice be produced from stalks of kodo, or the shells of a pond sweat pearls? Not a shadow of blame or wrong-doing attaches to any one; it is my ill-luck, like some fathomless ocean. Not perceiving that it is the fruit of my own sins, I revile my mother, to my own undoing I search my heart, but am beaten all round. In one matter only am I really fortunate; with Vasishtha for my guru and Sita and Rama for my masters, things must come right in the end.

In this honourable assemblage, in the presence of my lord and my guru and in this holy place, I speak my true sentiments; the saint and Rama know whether my affection ig sincere or feigned, and my words true or false.

sections.label: Doha 262
sections.name: तेइ रघुनंदनु लखनु सिय अनहित लागे जाहि

verses.sa:
भूपति मरन पेम पनु राखी ।
जननी कुमति जगतु सबु साखी ॥
verses.tr:
bhūpati maran pem panu rākhī
jananī kumati jagatu sabu sākhī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
देखि न जाहि बिकल महतारी ।
जरहिं दुसह जर पुर नर नारी ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi na jāhi bikal mahatārī
jarahiṃ dusah jar pur nar nārī

verses.sa:
महीं सकल अनरथ कर मूला ।
सो सुनि समुझि सहिउँ सब सूला ॥
verses.tr:
mahīṃ sakal anarath kar mūlā
so suni samujhi sahium̐ sab sūlā

verses.sa:
सुनि बन गवनु कीन्ह रघुनाथा ।
करि मुनि बेष लखन सिय साथा ॥
verses.tr:
suni ban gavanu kīnh raghunāthā
kari muni beṣ lakhan siya sāthā

verses.sa:
बिनु पानहिन्ह पयादेहि पाएँ ।
संकरु साखि रहेउँ एहि घाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
binu pānahinh payādehi pāem̐
saṃkaru sākhi raheum̐ ehi ghāem̐

verses.sa:
बहुरि निहार निषाद सनेहू ।
कुलिस कठिन उर भयउ न बेहू ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri nihār niṣād sanehū
kulis kaṭhin ur bhayau na behū

verses.sa:
अब सबु आँखिन्ह देखेउँ आई ।
जिअत जीव जड़ सबइ सहाई ॥
verses.tr:
ab sabu ām̐khinh dekheum̐ āī
jiat jīv jar̤ sabai sahāī

verses.sa:
जिन्हहि निरखि मग साँपिनि बीछी ।
तजहिं बिषम बिषु तामस तीछी ॥
verses.tr:
jinhahi nirakhi mag sām̐pini bīchī
tajahiṃ biṣam biṣu tāmas tīchī

verses.sa:
तेइ रघुनंदनु लखनु सिय अनहित लागे जाहि ।
तासु तनय तजि दुसह दुख दैउ सहावइ काहि ॥
verses.tr:
tei raghunaṃdanu lakhanu siya anahit lāge jāhi
tāsu tanaya taji dusah dukh daiu sahāvai kāhi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The whole world is witness to the king’s death, the result of his uncompromising love, and to my mother’s wickedness; the queens are so woe-begone that [ cannot bear to look at them; the citizens are consumed by intolerable anguish;and I am the cause of all their troubles; and yet though I hear and feel all this, I can still endure the torment. When I heard that Raghunath had taken with him Lakshman and Sita, and in pilgrim’s weeds had set out for the woods, without shoes and walking on foot, be Sun-kara my witness, how I survived the misery. Again, when I saw the Nishad's devotion, my heart must have been harder than adamant not to break. And now I have come and with my own eyes have seen everything; surely in this life my wretched soul has borne all that can be borne The serpents and scorpions on the road at the sight of them forget their virulent venom and savage viciousness;
But to her Rama, Lakshman and Sita appeared as enemies; and how can God spare her son, or on whom would he rather inflict intolerable pain?

sections.label: Doha 263
sections.name: मिटिहहिं पाप प्रपंच सब अखिल अमंगल भार

verses.sa:
सुनि अति बिकल भरत बर बानी ।
आरति प्रीति बिनय नय सानी ॥
verses.tr:
suni ati bikal bharat bar bānī
ārati prīti binaya naya sānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सोक मगन सब सभाँ खभारू ।
मनहुँ कमल बन परेउ तुसारू ॥
verses.tr:
sok magan sab sabhām̐ khabhārū
manahum̐ kamal ban pareu tusārū

verses.sa:
कहि अनेक बिधि कथा पुरानी ।
भरत प्रबोधु कीन्ह मुनि ग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
kahi anek bidhi kathā purānī
bharat prabodhu kīnh muni gyānī

verses.sa:
बोले उचित बचन रघुनंदू ।
दिनकर कुल कैरव बन चंदू ॥
verses.tr:
bole ucit bacan raghunaṃdū
dinakar kul kairav ban caṃdū

verses.sa:
तात जाँय जियँ करहु गलानी ।
ईस अधीन जीव गति जानी ॥
verses.tr:
tāt jām̐ya jiyam̐ karahu galānī
īs adhīn jīv gati jānī

verses.sa:
तीनि काल तिभुअन मत मोरें ।
पुन्यसिलोक तात तर तोरे ॥
verses.tr:
tīni kāl tibhuan mat moreṃ
punyasilok tāt tar tore

verses.sa:
उर आनत तुम्ह पर कुटिलाई ।
जाइ लोकु परलोकु नसाई ॥
verses.tr:
ur ānat tumh par kuṭilāī
jāi loku paraloku nasāī

verses.sa:
दोसु देहिं जननिहि जड़ तेई ।
जिन्ह गुर साधु सभा नहिं सेई ॥
verses.tr:
dosu dehiṃ jananihi jar̤ teī
jinh gur sādhu sabhā nahiṃ seī

verses.sa:
मिटिहहिं पाप प्रपंच सब अखिल अमंगल भार ।
लोक सुजसु परलोक सुखु सुमिरत नामु तुम्हार ॥
verses.tr:
miṭihahiṃ pāp prapaṃc sab akhil amaṃgal bhār
lok sujasu paralok sukhu sumirat nāmu tumhār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: On hesring these lamentable words of Bharat’s fraught with distress and love, humility and discretion, the whole assembly was lost in sorrow and anxiety, as when the frost smites a bed of lotuses. The learned sage comforted Bharat by reference to various ancient legends, and Rama, the moon of the liles of the Solar race, spoke thus in seemly wise; “Brother, grieve not your heart in vain; know that, the ways of life are in God’s hands. To my mind, brother, all the men of highest renown for virtue in all time, past, present or future, and in the three spheres of creation, fall short of you. Whoever even imagines wickedness in you shall] perish both in this life and in the next. It is only fools, who have never studied in the school of philosophy and religion, who ascribe blame to your mother.
Sin, Delusion and the burden of every ill are destroyed

sections.label: Doha 264
sections.name: मनु प्रसन्न करि सकुच तजि कहहु करौं सोइ आजु

verses.sa:
कहउँ सुभाउ सत्य सिव साखी ।
भरत भूमि रह राउरि राखी ॥
verses.tr:
kahaum̐ subhāu satya siv sākhī
bharat bhūmi rah rāuri rākhī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तात कुतरक करहु जनि जाएँ ।
बैर पेम नहि दुरइ दुराएँ ॥
verses.tr:
tāt kutarak karahu jani jāem̐
bair pem nahi durai durāem̐

verses.sa:
मुनि गन निकट बिहग मृग जाहीं ।
बाधक बधिक बिलोकि पराहीं ॥
verses.tr:
muni gan nikaṭ bihag mṛg jāhīṃ
bādhak badhik biloki parāhīṃ

verses.sa:
हित अनहित पसु पच्छिउ जाना ।
मानुष तनु गुन ग्यान निधाना ॥
verses.tr:
hit anahit pasu pacchiu jānā
mānuṣ tanu gun gyān nidhānā

verses.sa:
तात तुम्हहि मैं जानउँ नीकें ।
करौं काह असमंजस जीकें ॥
verses.tr:
tāt tumhahi maiṃ jānaum̐ nīkeṃ
karauṃ kāh asamaṃjas jīkeṃ

verses.sa:
राखेउ रायँ सत्य मोहि त्यागी ।
तनु परिहरेउ पेम पन लागी ॥
verses.tr:
rākheu rāyam̐ satya mohi tyāgī
tanu parihareu pem pan lāgī

verses.sa:
तासु बचन मेटत मन सोचू ।
तेहि तें अधिक तुम्हार सँकोचू ॥
verses.tr:
tāsu bacan meṭat man socū
tehi teṃ adhik tumhār sam̐kocū

verses.sa:
ता पर गुर मोहि आयसु दीन्हा ।
अवसि जो कहहु चहउँ सोइ कीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
tā par gur mohi āyasu dīnhā
avasi jo kahahu cahaum̐ soi kīnhā

verses.sa:
मनु प्रसन्न करि सकुच तजि कहहु करौं सोइ आजु ।
सत्यसंध रघुबर बचन सुनि भा सुखी समाजु ॥
verses.tr:
manu prasann kari sakuc taji kahahu karauṃ soi āju
satyasaṃdh raghubar bacan suni bhā sukhī samāju
verses.head: दोहा

trans: by the invocation of your name, glory is own in this world and eternal happiness in the world to come.

Be Siva my witness; I state the fact truly:the world, Bharat, exists by your support. Do not, brother, entertain evil surmises to no purpose; love and hatred cannot be hid: birds and beasts come up close toa saints, but flee at the sight of a fowler, though he tries to stop them. If beasts and birds can distinguish between friends and enemies, how much more man, whose body isa vessel of virtue and intelligence. I know you thoroughly, brother; how can I do anything that would be discordant with your spirit? The king, to keep his word, abandoned me and, to keep his vow of love, discarded life; if I now break his word, I shall be heartily grieved; and yet my respect for you is greater; the guru moreover has given me his commands; in short, whatever you say, that I am ready to do.
Set your mind at ease; cease this timidity and speak out;I will doit at once.” When they heard Nema, the ocean of truth, speak thus, the assembly rejoiced.

sections.label: Doha 265
sections.name: सुनि सुर मत सुरगुर कहेउ भल तुम्हार बड़ भागु

verses.sa:
सुर गन सहित सभय सुरराजू ।
सोचहिं चाहत होन अकाजू ॥
verses.tr:
sur gan sahit sabhaya surarājū
socahiṃ cāhat hon akājū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बनत उपाउ करत कछु नाहीं ।
राम सरन सब गे मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
banat upāu karat kachu nāhīṃ
rām saran sab ge man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
बहुरि बिचारि परस्पर कहहीं ।
रघुपति भगत भगति बस अहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bahuri bicāri paraspar kahahīṃ
raghupati bhagat bhagati bas ahahīṃ

verses.sa:
सुधि करि अंबरीष दुरबासा ।
भे सुर सुरपति निपट निरासा ॥
verses.tr:
sudhi kari aṃbarīṣ durabāsā
bhe sur surapati nipaṭ nirāsā

verses.sa:
सहे सुरन्ह बहु काल बिषादा ।
नरहरि किए प्रगट प्रहलादा ॥
verses.tr:
sahe suranh bahu kāl biṣādā
narahari kie pragaṭ prahalādā

verses.sa:
लगि लगि कान कहहिं धुनि माथा ।
अब सुर काज भरत के हाथा ॥
verses.tr:
lagi lagi kān kahahiṃ dhuni māthā
ab sur kāj bharat ke hāthā

verses.sa:
आन उपाउ न देखिअ देवा ।
मानत रामु सुसेवक सेवा ॥
verses.tr:
ān upāu na dekhia devā
mānat rāmu susevak sevā

verses.sa:
हियँ सपेम सुमिरहु सब भरतहि ।
निज गुन सील राम बस करतहि ॥
verses.tr:
hiyam̐ sapem sumirahu sab bharatahi
nij gun sīl rām bas karatahi

verses.sa:
सुनि सुर मत सुरगुर कहेउ भल तुम्हार बड़ भागु ।
सकल सुमंगल मूल जग भरत चरन अनुरागु ॥
verses.tr:
suni sur mat suragur kaheu bhal tumhār bar̤ bhāgu
sakal sumaṃgal mūl jag bharat caran anurāgu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: But the king of heaven and all the gods were alarmed and began to think.‘ Things will all go wrong.’ Though they took counsel together, nothing came of it; mentally all had recourse to Rama for protection. After again considering, they said to one another: “‘ Rama is moved by the faith of the faithful.”” Remembering the story of Ambarisha and Durvasas, Indra and the gods were greatly dejected. ‘Long time the gods endured distress, till at last PrahlAd revealed Narsingha.’ They beat their heads and whispered in the ear: ‘Now our only chance lies with Bharat there is no other plan, sir, that I can see. Rama accepts service done to one of his servants; do you all with loving heart do service to Bharat, and he will subdue Rama to his own
When the guru of the gods heard this their plan, he said: Well done, you are in great good fortune; devotion to Bharat’s feet is the source vf every good io the world.

sections.label: Doha 266
sections.name: कीन्ह अनुग्रह अमित अति सब बिधि सीतानाथ

verses.sa:
सीतापति सेवक सेवकाई ।
कामधेनु सय सरिस सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
sītāpati sevak sevakāī
kāmadhenu saya saris suhāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भरत भगति तुम्हरें मन आई ।
तजहु सोचु बिधि बात बनाई ॥
verses.tr:
bharat bhagati tumhareṃ man āī
tajahu socu bidhi bāt banāī

verses.sa:
देखु देवपति भरत प्रभाऊ ।
सहज सुभायँ बिबस रघुराऊ ॥
verses.tr:
dekhu devapati bharat prabhāū
sahaj subhāyam̐ bibas raghurāū

verses.sa:
मन थिर करहु देव डरु नाहीं ।
भरतहि जानि राम परिछाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
man thir karahu dev ḍaru nāhīṃ
bharatahi jāni rām parichāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सुनो सुरगुर सुर संमत सोचू ।
अंतरजामी प्रभुहि सकोचू ॥
verses.tr:
suno suragur sur saṃmat socū
aṃtarajāmī prabhuhi sakocū

verses.sa:
निज सिर भारु भरत जियँ जाना ।
करत कोटि बिधि उर अनुमाना ॥
verses.tr:
nij sir bhāru bharat jiyam̐ jānā
karat koṭi bidhi ur anumānā

verses.sa:
करि बिचारु मन दीन्ही ठीका ।
राम रजायस आपन नीका ॥
verses.tr:
kari bicāru man dīnhī ṭhīkā
rām rajāyas āpan nīkā

verses.sa:
निज पन तजि राखेउ पनु मोरा ।
छोहु सनेहु कीन्ह नहिं थोरा ॥
verses.tr:
nij pan taji rākheu panu morā
chohu sanehu kīnh nahiṃ thorā

verses.sa:
कीन्ह अनुग्रह अमित अति सब बिधि सीतानाथ ।
करि प्रनामु बोले भरतु जोरि जलज जुग हाथ ॥
verses.tr:
kīnh anugrah amit ati sab bidhi sītānāth
kari pranāmu bole bharatu jori jalaj jug hāth
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The service of the servant of Sita’s lord is as good asa thousand Kamadhenus. Now that you are resolved to put faith io Bharat, cease to have any anxiety; God has provided away. See, Indra, the extent of Bharat’s power; he has subdued Rama with the greatest ease. Make your mind easy, sir, never fear, knowing that Bharat is Rama’s shadow.” The Lord, who knows the heart, was disturbed when he heard the plans and tears of Vrihaspati and the other gods. Bharat, knowing that the whole responsibility rested upon him, was raising a thousand different arguments in his mind. After much deliberation, he came to the conclusion that his happiness consisted in obeying Rama. “He is breaking his own vow in order to satisfy me, and in this is showing me no little love and affection.
Sita’s lord has in every way done me great and unbounded favour.” Then bowing low, and with his lotus hands clasped io supplication, Bharat thus spoke:

sections.label: Doha 267
sections.name: जाइ निकट पहिचानि तरु छाहँ समनि सब सोच

verses.sa:
कहौं कहावौं का अब स्वामी ।
कृपा अंबुनिधि अंतरजामी ॥
verses.tr:
kahauṃ kahāvauṃ kā ab svāmī
kṛpā aṃbunidhi aṃtarajāmī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
गुर प्रसन्न साहिब अनुकूला ।
मिटी मलिन मन कलपित सूला ॥
verses.tr:
gur prasann sāhib anukūlā
miṭī malin man kalapit sūlā

verses.sa:
अपडर डरेउँ न सोच समूलें ।
रबिहि न दोसु देव दिसि भूलें ॥
verses.tr:
apaḍar ḍareum̐ na soc samūleṃ
rabihi na dosu dev disi bhūleṃ

verses.sa:
मोर अभागु मातु कुटिलाई ।
बिधि गति बिषम काल कठिनाई ॥
verses.tr:
mor abhāgu mātu kuṭilāī
bidhi gati biṣam kāl kaṭhināī

verses.sa:
पाउ रोपि सब मिलि मोहि घाला ।
प्रनतपाल पन आपन पाला ॥
verses.tr:
pāu ropi sab mili mohi ghālā
pranatapāl pan āpan pālā

verses.sa:
यह नइ रीति न राउरि होई ।
लोकहुँ बेद बिदित नहिं गोई ॥
verses.tr:
yah nai rīti na rāuri hoī
lokahum̐ bed bidit nahiṃ goī

verses.sa:
जगु अनभल भल एकु गोसाईं ।
कहिअ होइ भल कासु भलाईं ॥
verses.tr:
jagu anabhal bhal eku gosāīṃ
kahia hoi bhal kāsu bhalāīṃ

verses.sa:
देउ देवतरु सरिस सुभाऊ ।
सनमुख बिमुख न काहुहि काऊ ॥
verses.tr:
deu devataru saris subhāū
sanamukh bimukh na kāhuhi kāū

verses.sa:
जाइ निकट पहिचानि तरु छाहँ समनि सब सोच ।
मागत अभिमत पाव जग राउ रंकु भल पोच ॥
verses.tr:
jāi nikaṭ pahicāni taru chāham̐ samani sab soc
māgat abhimat pāv jag rāu raṃku bhal poc
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘All-merciful and omniscient Lord, what now can I say myself or have others to say for me My guru is pleased and my master kind: the imaginary torments of my troubled soul are allover. I feared disgrace, but my fear was uureasonable; it is no fault of the sun’s sir, if a man mistake the points of the compass.!| My ill-lack, my mother’s wickedness, God’s adverse action, and the malignity of fate set themselves firm and combined to overthrow me; but the protector of suppliants has maintained his character. This is ho strange procedure of his; it is declared both by Scripture and tradition, and is no secret. The world is evil; the Lord only is good; tell me by whose goodness is he good save by his own? Your attributes, sire, are those of the tree of paradise, which is never either for or against: and one in particular.
All who draw near and acknowledge that its shade relieves every sorrow, high or low, rich or poor, ask and obtain the fruit that they desire.

sections.label: Doha 268
sections.name: सानुज पठइअ मोहि बन कीजिअ सबहि सनाथ

verses.sa:
लखि सब बिधि गुर स्वामि सनेहू ।
मिटेउ छोभु नहिं मन संदेहू ॥
verses.tr:
lakhi sab bidhi gur svāmi sanehū
miṭeu chobhu nahiṃ man saṃdehū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अब करुनाकर कीजिअ सोई ।
जन हित प्रभु चित छोभु न होई ॥
verses.tr:
ab karunākar kījia soī
jan hit prabhu cit chobhu na hoī

verses.sa:
जो सेवकु साहिबहि सँकोची ।
निज हित चहइ तासु मति पोची ॥
verses.tr:
jo sevaku sāhibahi sam̐kocī
nij hit cahai tāsu mati pocī

verses.sa:
सेवक हित साहिब सेवकाई ।
करै सकल सुख लोभ बिहाई ॥
verses.tr:
sevak hit sāhib sevakāī
karai sakal sukh lobh bihāī

verses.sa:
स्वारथु नाथ फिरें सबही का ।
किएँ रजाइ कोटि बिधि नीका ॥
verses.tr:
svārathu nāth phireṃ sabahī kā
kiem̐ rajāi koṭi bidhi nīkā

verses.sa:
यह स्वारथ परमारथ सारु ।
सकल सुकृत फल सुगति सिंगारु ॥
verses.tr:
yah svārath paramārath sāru
sakal sukṛt phal sugati siṃgāru

verses.sa:
देव एक बिनती सुनि मोरी ।
उचित होइ तस करब बहोरी ॥
verses.tr:
dev ek binatī suni morī
ucit hoi tas karab bahorī

verses.sa:
तिलक समाजु साजि सबु आना ।
करिअ सुफल प्रभु जौं मनु माना ॥
verses.tr:
tilak samāju sāji sabu ānā
karia suphal prabhu jauṃ manu mānā

verses.sa:
सानुज पठइअ मोहि बन कीजिअ सबहि सनाथ ।
नतरु फेरिअहिं बंधु दोउ नाथ चलौं मैं साथ ॥
verses.tr:
sānuj paṭhaia mohi ban kījia sabahi sanāth
nataru pheriahiṃ baṃdhu dou nāth calauṃ maiṃ sāth
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Now that I have seen the affection of my guru and my master, my anxiety is gone: my mind is freed from doubt. Now, O Mine of compassion, do whatever will be for the good of your servant, without being a trouble to the soul of my lord. The servant who worries his master and seeks only hisown advantage is a base-minded varlet. A servant's gain is to do his master’s service, to get him every comfort, and not be greedy. If my lord returns to Ayodhya, every one will be a gainer; but obedience to orders will be a thousand times greater gain; it isthe highest good in this world, and in the next it is the fruit of all well-duing and the ornament of beatitude. Listen, sire, to this my one request, and then do as you think proper. I buve brought with me all the requisites for the coronation; if you approve, my lord, have them brought into use.
Send me and my brother into the woods, and give the people back their king; or else let Lakshman and Satrughna ‘return and let me accompany you:

sections.label: Doha 269
sections.name: प्रभु प्रसन्न मन सकुच तजि जो जेहि आयसु देब

verses.sa:
नतरु जाहिं बन तीनिउ भाई ।
बहुरिअ सीय सहित रघुराई ॥
verses.tr:
nataru jāhiṃ ban tīniu bhāī
bahuria sīya sahit raghurāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जेहि बिधि प्रभु प्रसन्न मन होई ।
करुना सागर कीजिअ सोई ॥
verses.tr:
jehi bidhi prabhu prasann man hoī
karunā sāgar kījia soī

verses.sa:
देवँ दीन्ह सबु मोहि अभारु ।
मोरें नीति न धरम बिचारु ॥
verses.tr:
devam̐ dīnh sabu mohi abhāru
moreṃ nīti na dharam bicāru

verses.sa:
कहउँ बचन सब स्वारथ हेतू ।
रहत न आरत कें चित चेतू ॥
verses.tr:
kahaum̐ bacan sab svārath hetū
rahat na ārat keṃ cit cetū

verses.sa:
उतरु देइ सुनि स्वामि रजाई ।
सो सेवकु लखि लाज लजाई ॥
verses.tr:
utaru dei suni svāmi rajāī
so sevaku lakhi lāj lajāī

verses.sa:
अस मैं अवगुन उदधि अगाधू ।
स्वामि सनेहँ सराहत साधू ॥
verses.tr:
as maiṃ avagun udadhi agādhū
svāmi saneham̐ sarāhat sādhū

verses.sa:
अब कृपाल मोहि सो मत भावा ।
सकुच स्वामि मन जाइँ न पावा ॥
verses.tr:
ab kṛpāl mohi so mat bhāvā
sakuc svāmi man jāim̐ na pāvā

verses.sa:
प्रभु पद सपथ कहउँ सति भाऊ ।
जग मंगल हित एक उपाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu pad sapath kahaum̐ sati bhāū
jag maṃgal hit ek upāū

verses.sa:
प्रभु प्रसन्न मन सकुच तजि जो जेहि आयसु देब ।
सो सिर धरि धरि करिहि सबु मिटिहि अनट अवरेब ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu prasann man sakuc taji jo jehi āyasu deb
so sir dhari dhari karihi sabu miṭihi anaṭ avareb
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Or all three brothers go into the woods, and only you and Sita return. ©O most merciful lord, do whatever is most pleasing to yourself. You have cast the whole burden upon me, sire, who am unversed both in politics and theology; I make all my proposals on the ground of worldly interest: but when a man is in distress he cannot reason. A _ servant who hears his master’s orders and answers him is one that Shame herself would be ashamed to look at: and yet though I do this and am a fathomless ocean of faultiness. still my master in his kindness praises me as good. Now, O merciful one, that plan best. pleases me which will cause my lord's soul the least vexation. By my lord's feet I swear that I speak the truth; there is only one scheme for securing the world’s happiness.
If my lord cheerfully and without reserve will only give each one of us his orders, they will be reverently obeyed, and all this trouble and perplexity’, will be at an end.”

sections.label: Doha 270
sections.name: नाहि त कोसल नाथ कें साथ कुसल गइ नाथ

verses.sa:
भरत बचन सुचि सुनि सुर हरषे ।
साधु सराहि सुमन सुर बरषे ॥
verses.tr:
bharat bacan suci suni sur haraṣe
sādhu sarāhi suman sur baraṣe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
असमंजस बस अवध नेवासी ।
प्रमुदित मन तापस बनबासी ॥
verses.tr:
asamaṃjas bas avadh nevāsī
pramudit man tāpas banabāsī

verses.sa:
चुपहिं रहे रघुनाथ सँकोची ।
प्रभु गति देखि सभा सब सोची ॥
verses.tr:
cupahiṃ rahe raghunāth sam̐kocī
prabhu gati dekhi sabhā sab socī

verses.sa:
जनक दूत तेहि अवसर आए ।
मुनि बसिष्ठँ सुनि बेगि बोलाए ॥
verses.tr:
janak dūt tehi avasar āe
muni basiṣṭham̐ suni begi bolāe

verses.sa:
करि प्रनाम तिन्ह रामु निहारे ।
बेषु देखि भए निपट दुखारे ॥
verses.tr:
kari pranām tinh rāmu nihāre
beṣu dekhi bhae nipaṭ dukhāre

verses.sa:
दूतन्ह मुनिबर बूझी बाता ।
कहहु बिदेह भूप कुसलाता ॥
verses.tr:
dūtanh munibar būjhī bātā
kahahu bideh bhūp kusalātā

verses.sa:
सुनि सकुचाइ नाइ महि माथा ।
बोले चर बर जोरें हाथा ॥
verses.tr:
suni sakucāi nāi mahi māthā
bole car bar joreṃ hāthā

verses.sa:
बूझब राउर सादर साईं ।
कुसल हेतु सो भयउ गोसाईं ॥
verses.tr:
būjhab rāur sādar sāīṃ
kusal hetu so bhayau gosāīṃ

verses.sa:
नाहि त कोसल नाथ कें साथ कुसल गइ नाथ ।
मिथिला अवध बिसेष तें जगु सब भयउ अनाथ ॥
verses.tr:
nāhi ta kosal nāth keṃ sāth kusal gai nāth
mithilā avadh biseṣ teṃ jagu sab bhayau anāth
verses.head: दोहा

trans: On hearing Bharat’s guileless speech the gods were glad of heart and extolled his generosity and rained down flowers; the people of Avadh were overwhelmed with uncertainty, and the hermits and all the dwellers in the woods were greatly rejoiced. Raghunath maintained an anxious silence. Seeing his state, the whole assembly became disturbed. At that very moment arrived messengers from Janak. Saint Vasishtha on hearing of it sent for them at once. They made obeisance and looked towards Rama. At the sight of his attire they were exceedingly grieved. The ' great saintasked the embassy the news: ‘Tell me is all well with the king of Videha? At this question the noble heralds with a deprecating air bowed their heads to the ground and with clasped hands replied: “Your courteous enquiry, sire, makes all well;
Otherwise, my lord, welfare died with the king of Kosala; the whole world is in bereavement, but especially Mithila and Avadh.

sections.label: Doha 271
sections.name: गए अवध चर भरत गति बूझि देखि करतूति

verses.sa:
कोसलपति गति सुनि जनकौरा ।
भे सब लोक सोक बस बौरा ॥
verses.tr:
kosalapati gati suni janakaurā
bhe sab lok sok bas baurā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जेहिं देखे तेहि समय बिदेहू ।
नामु सत्य अस लाग न केहू ॥
verses.tr:
jehiṃ dekhe tehi samaya bidehū
nāmu satya as lāg na kehū

verses.sa:
रानि कुचालि सुनत नरपालहि ।
सूझ न कछु जस मनि बिनु ब्यालहि ॥
verses.tr:
rāni kucāli sunat narapālahi
sūjh na kachu jas mani binu byālahi

verses.sa:
भरत राज रघुबर बनबासू ।
भा मिथिलेसहि हृदयँ हराँसू ॥
verses.tr:
bharat rāj raghubar banabāsū
bhā mithilesahi hṛdayam̐ harām̐sū

verses.sa:
नृप बूझे बुध सचिव समाजू ।
कहहु बिचारि उचित का आजू ॥
verses.tr:
nṛp būjhe budh saciv samājū
kahahu bicāri ucit kā ājū

verses.sa:
समुझि अवध असमंजस दोऊ ।
चलिअ कि रहिअ न कह कछु कोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
samujhi avadh asamaṃjas doū
calia ki rahia na kah kachu koū

verses.sa:
नृपहि धीर धरि हृदयँ बिचारी ।
पठए अवध चतुर चर चारी ॥
verses.tr:
nṛpahi dhīr dhari hṛdayam̐ bicārī
paṭhae avadh catur car cārī

verses.sa:
बूझि भरत सति भाउ कुभाऊ ।
आएहु बेगि न होइ लखाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
būjhi bharat sati bhāu kubhāū
āehu begi na hoi lakhāū

verses.sa:
गए अवध चर भरत गति बूझि देखि करतूति ।
चले चित्रकूटहि भरतु चार चले तेरहूति ॥
verses.tr:
gae avadh car bharat gati būjhi dekhi karatūti
cale citrakūṭahi bharatu cār cale terahūti
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When Janak and his court heard of king Dasarath’s death, every one was mad with excess of grief. All who at that time saw Videha thought that name a truly appropriate one. As he listened to the tale of the queen’s wickedness, the monarch became as helpless as a serpent without its headjewel. Bharat king, and Rama in exile Janak’s soul was sore distrest. He enquired of all his wise men and ministers, ‘Consider and tell me what ought now to be done.’ Reflecting on the state of Avadh and the double difficulty, if he went or if he stayed, no one gave any answer. After reasoning with himself, the king resolved to send four clever spies to Avadh, to discover whether Bharat meant well or ill, and return io haste without being seen.
The spies went to Avadh, ascertained Bharat’s movements and saw what he was doing, that he had started for Chitra-kuit, and then went back to Tirhit.

sections.label: Doha 272
sections.name: सुनत जनक आगवनु सबु हरषेउ अवध समाजु

verses.sa:
दूतन्ह आइ भरत कइ करनी ।
जनक समाज जथामति बरनी ॥
verses.tr:
dūtanh āi bharat kai karanī
janak samāj jathāmati baranī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुनि गुर परिजन सचिव महीपति ।
भे सब सोच सनेहँ बिकल अति ॥
verses.tr:
suni gur parijan saciv mahīpati
bhe sab soc saneham̐ bikal ati

verses.sa:
