धरि धीरजु करि भरत बड़ाई ।
लिए सुभट साहनी बोलाई ॥
verses.tr:
dhari dhīraju kari bharat bar̤āī
lie subhaṭ sāhanī bolāī

verses.sa:
घर पुर देस राखि रखवारे ।
हय गय रथ बहु जान सँवारे ॥
verses.tr:
ghar pur des rākhi rakhavāre
haya gaya rath bahu jān sam̐vāre

verses.sa:
दुघरी साधि चले ततकाला ।
किए बिश्रामु न मग महीपाला ॥
verses.tr:
dugharī sādhi cale tatakālā
kie biśrāmu na mag mahīpālā

verses.sa:
भोरहिं आजु नहाइ प्रयागा ।
चले जमुन उतरन सबु लागा ॥
verses.tr:
bhorahiṃ āju nahāi prayāgā
cale jamun utaran sabu lāgā

verses.sa:
खबरि लेन हम पठए नाथा ।
तिन्ह कहि अस महि नायउ माथा ॥
verses.tr:
khabari len ham paṭhae nāthā
tinh kahi as mahi nāyau māthā

verses.sa:
साथ किरात छ सातक दीन्हे ।
मुनिबर तुरत बिदा चर कीन्हे ॥
verses.tr:
sāth kirāt cha sātak dīnhe
munibar turat bidā car kīnhe

verses.sa:
सुनत जनक आगवनु सबु हरषेउ अवध समाजु ।
रघुनंदनहि सकोचु बड़ सोच बिबस सुरराजु ॥
verses.tr:
sunat janak āgavanu sabu haraṣeu avadh samāju
raghunaṃdanahi sakocu bar̤ soc bibas surarāju
verses.head: दोहा

trans: On their arrival, they announced in Janak’s court to the best of their ability all Bharat’s doings. The guru, the citizens, the ministers and the king were all agitated with grief and love at the report. Restraining his emotion and _ glori-fying Bharat, be summoned his warriors, and captains}, and having stationed guards for the palace, city, and realm and made ready horses, elephants, chariots and conveyances of every description, all in less thanan hour, the king set out and halted nowhere on the road, but this morning at daybreak bathed at Prayag. The host has begun to cross the Jamuna and we, my lord, have been sent on ahead for news.” So saying, they bowed the head to the ground. The saint at once gave them an escort of six or seven Kirats and allowed them to take leave.
The people of Avadh were all delighted to hear of Janak’s arrival; but Raghunandan was greatly disquieted and Indra overwhelmed with alarm:

sections.label: Doha 273
sections.name: गुर समाज भाइन्ह सहित राम राजु पुर होउ

verses.sa:
गरइ गलानि कुटिल कैकेई ।
काहि कहै केहि दूषनु देई ॥
verses.tr:
garai galāni kuṭil kaikeī
kāhi kahai kehi dūṣanu deī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
अस मन आनि मुदित नर नारी ।
भयउ बहोरि रहब दिन चारी ॥
verses.tr:
as man āni mudit nar nārī
bhayau bahori rahab din cārī

verses.sa:
एहि प्रकार गत बासर सोऊ ।
प्रात नहान लाग सबु कोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
ehi prakār gat bāsar soū
prāt nahān lāg sabu koū

verses.sa:
करि मज्जनु पूजहिं नर नारी ।
गनप गौरि तिपुरारि तमारी ॥
verses.tr:
kari majjanu pūjahiṃ nar nārī
ganap gauri tipurāri tamārī

verses.sa:
रमा रमन पद बंदि बहोरी ।
बिनवहिं अंजुलि अंचल जोरी ॥
verses.tr:
ramā raman pad baṃdi bahorī
binavahiṃ aṃjuli aṃcal jorī

verses.sa:
राजा रामु जानकी रानी ।
आनँद अवधि अवध रजधानी ॥
verses.tr:
rājā rāmu jānakī rānī
ānam̐d avadhi avadh rajadhānī

verses.sa:
सुबस बसउ फिरि सहित समाजा ।
भरतहि रामु करहुँ जुबराजा ॥
verses.tr:
subas basau phiri sahit samājā
bharatahi rāmu karahum̐ jubarājā

verses.sa:
एहि सुख सुधाँ सींची सब काहू ।
देव देहु जग जीवन लाहू ॥
verses.tr:
ehi sukh sudhām̐ sīṃcī sab kāhū
dev dehu jag jīvan lāhū

verses.sa:
गुर समाज भाइन्ह सहित राम राजु पुर होउ ।
अछत राम राजा अवध मरिअ माग सबु कोउ ॥
verses.tr:
gur samāj bhāinh sahit rām rāju pur hou
achat rām rājā avadh maria māg sabu kou
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The wicked Kaikeyi was sinking with remorse, ‘to whom shall I be able to speak or whom can I blame?’ while the people were delighted with the thought that now they had got another day or two to stay. In this manner the day was spent. On the morrow all bathed and after their ablutions worshipped Ganes, Gauri, Siva and the Sun; then reverenced the feet of Lakshman's lord and offered up their prayers, the men raising their joined hands, the women holding out the skirt of their dress: ‘“ With Rama our king and
out their hands.

Janaki our queen, may Avadh, our capital, the centre of all delights, be gloriously re-peopled, court and all, and Rama install Bharat as heir-apparent. Revive us all, O lord, with this ambrosial bliss and grant the world its life’s desire.
May Rama sway the state, assisted by his guru the council and his brothers; and may we die with Rama still Avadh’s king.” This was the universal prayer.

sections.label: Doha 274
sections.name: प्रेम मगन तेहि समय सब सुनि आवत मिथिलेसु

verses.sa:
सुनि सनेहमय पुरजन बानी ।
निंदहिं जोग बिरति मुनि ग्यानी ॥
verses.tr:
suni sanehamaya purajan bānī
niṃdahiṃ jog birati muni gyānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि नित्यकरम करि पुरजन ।
रामहि करहिं प्रनाम पुलकि तन ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi nityakaram kari purajan
rāmahi karahiṃ pranām pulaki tan

verses.sa:
ऊँच नीच मध्यम नर नारी ।
लहहिं दरसु निज निज अनुहारी ॥
verses.tr:
ūm̐c nīc madhyam nar nārī
lahahiṃ darasu nij nij anuhārī

verses.sa:
सावधान सबही सनमानहिं ।
सकल सराहत कृपानिधानहिं ॥
verses.tr:
sāvadhān sabahī sanamānahiṃ
sakal sarāhat kṛpānidhānahiṃ

verses.sa:
लरिकाइहि ते रघुबर बानी ।
पालत नीति प्रीति पहिचानी ॥
verses.tr:
larikāihi te raghubar bānī
pālat nīti prīti pahicānī

verses.sa:
सील सकोच सिंधु रघुराऊ ।
सुमुख सुलोचन सरल सुभाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
sīl sakoc siṃdhu raghurāū
sumukh sulocan saral subhāū

verses.sa:
कहत राम गुन गन अनुरागे ।
सब निज भाग सराहन लागे ॥
verses.tr:
kahat rām gun gan anurāge
sab nij bhāg sarāhan lāge

verses.sa:
हम सम पुन्य पुंज जग थोरे ।
जिन्हहि रामु जानत करि मोरे ॥
verses.tr:
ham sam punya puṃj jag thore
jinhahi rāmu jānat kari more

verses.sa:
प्रेम मगन तेहि समय सब सुनि आवत मिथिलेसु ।
सहित सभा संभ्रम उठेउ रबिकुल कमल दिनेसु ॥
verses.tr:
prem magan tehi samaya sab suni āvat mithilesu
sahit sabhā saṃbhram uṭheu rabikul kamal dinesu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When they heard the citizens’ loving words, the wisest saints thought little of their own penance and austerities. When the people had in this manner performed their daily devotions, with much joy they went and saluted Rama. High and low and of middle estate, men and women, all looked up to him as their own special patron, and he discreetly received them all with due honour. Every one extolled his inexhaustible generosity: ‘Hrom a child it
- was said of Raghubar that he cherishes all in whom he re-

cognizes sincerity and affection; with his bright face, bright eyes and guileless ways, he is a very ocean of amiability and gentleness.” Thus affectionately telling Rama’s good qualities, all began to magnify their own good fortune, “There are few people in the world who can have been so meritorious as we, whom Rama _ has thus accepted for his own.”
At the time when all were thus absorbed in love, they heard of the approach of the king of Mithila: the Sun of the lotuses of the Solar race rose in haste, he and the whole assembly.

sections.label: Doha 275
sections.name: आश्रम सागर सांत रस पूरन पावन पाथु

verses.sa:
भाइ सचिव गुर पुरजन साथा ।
आगें गवनु कीन्ह रघुनाथा ॥
verses.tr:
bhāi saciv gur purajan sāthā
āgeṃ gavanu kīnh raghunāthā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
गिरिबरु दीख जनकपति जबहीं ।
करि प्रनाम रथ त्यागेउ तबहीं ॥
verses.tr:
giribaru dīkh janakapati jabahīṃ
kari pranām rath tyāgeu tabahīṃ

verses.sa:
राम दरस लालसा उछाहू ।
पथ श्रम लेसु कलेसु न काहू ॥
verses.tr:
rām daras lālasā uchāhū
path śram lesu kalesu na kāhū

verses.sa:
मन तहँ जहँ रघुबर बैदेही ।
बिनु मन तन दुख सुख सुधि केही ॥
verses.tr:
man taham̐ jaham̐ raghubar baidehī
binu man tan dukh sukh sudhi kehī

verses.sa:
आवत जनकु चले एहि भाँती ।
सहित समाज प्रेम मति माती ॥
verses.tr:
āvat janaku cale ehi bhām̐tī
sahit samāj prem mati mātī

verses.sa:
आए निकट देखि अनुरागे ।
सादर मिलन परसपर लागे ॥
verses.tr:
āe nikaṭ dekhi anurāge
sādar milan parasapar lāge

verses.sa:
लगे जनक मुनिजन पद बंदन ।
रिषिन्ह प्रनामु कीन्ह रघुनंदन ॥
verses.tr:
lage janak munijan pad baṃdan
riṣinh pranāmu kīnh raghunaṃdan

verses.sa:
भाइन्ह सहित रामु मिलि राजहि ।
चले लवाइ समेत समाजहि ॥
verses.tr:
bhāinh sahit rāmu mili rājahi
cale lavāi samet samājahi

verses.sa:
आश्रम सागर सांत रस पूरन पावन पाथु ।
सेन मनहुँ करुना सरित लिएँ जाहिं रघुनाथु ॥
verses.tr:
āśram sāgar sāṃt ras pūran pāvan pāthu
sen manahum̐ karunā sarit liem̐ jāhiṃ raghunāthu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Raghunath led the way, accompanied by his brothers, the guru the Minister and the people. As soon as king Janak saw the holy hill, he dismounted from his chariot and saluted it. In their eagerness and excitement to see Rama, no one felt the slightest fatigue from the toilsome journey. for their soul was with Rama and Sita; and who without a soul can be conscious of bodily pain or Pleasure? In this manner Janak and his host advanced, drunken with the drankenness of love. When they came near and in sight, they lovingly and reverentially began mutual salutations. Janak kissed the feet of the hermits, and Rama with his brothers. having first reverenced the king’s spiritual advisers, embraced him, and led the way for him and his army.
Rama condacted the host to the hermitage, as it were a river of pitifulness flowing into an ocean full of the pure water of tranquillity;

sections.label: Doha 276
sections.name: किए अमित उपदेस जहँ तहँ लोगन्ह मुनिबरन्ह

verses.sa:
बोरति ग्यान बिराग करारे ।
बचन ससोक मिलत नद नारे ॥
verses.tr:
borati gyān birāg karāre
bacan sasok milat nad nāre
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सोच उसास समीर तंरगा ।
धीरज तट तरुबर कर भंगा ॥
verses.tr:
soc usās samīr taṃragā
dhīraj taṭ tarubar kar bhaṃgā

verses.sa:
बिषम बिषाद तोरावति धारा ।
भय भ्रम भवँर अबर्त अपारा ॥
verses.tr:
biṣam biṣād torāvati dhārā
bhaya bhram bhavam̐r abart apārā

verses.sa:
केवट बुध बिद्या बड़ि नावा ।
सकहिं न खेइ ऐक नहिं आवा ॥
verses.tr:
kevaṭ budh bidyā bar̤i nāvā
sakahiṃ na khei aik nahiṃ āvā

verses.sa:
बनचर कोल किरात बिचारे ।
थके बिलोकि पथिक हियँ हारे ॥
verses.tr:
banacar kol kirāt bicāre
thake biloki pathik hiyam̐ hāre

verses.sa:
आश्रम उदधि मिली जब जाई ।
मनहुँ उठेउ अंबुधि अकुलाई ॥
verses.tr:
āśram udadhi milī jab jāī
manahum̐ uṭheu aṃbudhi akulāī

verses.sa:
सोक बिकल दोउ राज समाजा ।
रहा न ग्यानु न धीरजु लाजा ॥
verses.tr:
sok bikal dou rāj samājā
rahā na gyānu na dhīraju lājā

verses.sa:
भूप रूप गुन सील सराही ।
रोवहिं सोक सिंधु अवगाही ॥
verses.tr:
bhūp rūp gun sīl sarāhī
rovahiṃ sok siṃdhu avagāhī

verses.sa:
अवगाहि सोक समुद्र सोचहिं नारि नर ब्याकुल महा ।
दै दोष सकल सरोष बोलहिं बाम बिधि कीन्हो कहा ॥
verses.tr:
avagāhi sok samudr socahiṃ nāri nar byākul mahā
dai doṣ sakal saroṣ bolahiṃ bām bidhi kīnho kahā
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
सुर सिद्ध तापस जोगिजन मुनि देखि दसा बिदेह की ।
तुलसी न समरथु कोउ जो तरि सकै सरित सनेह की ॥
verses.tr:
sur siddh tāpas jogijan muni dekhi dasā bideh kī
tulasī na samarathu kou jo tari sakai sarit saneh kī

verses.sa:
किए अमित उपदेस जहँ तहँ लोगन्ह मुनिबरन्ह ।
धीरजु धरिअ नरेस कहेउ बसिष्ठ बिदेह सन ॥
verses.tr:
kie amit upades jaham̐ taham̐ loganh munibaranh
dhīraju dharia nares kaheu basiṣṭh bideh san
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Flooding the banks of wisdom and asceticism: with sorrowful speeches for its tributary streams and torrents; with sighs and lamentations for the wind and waves that break the stout trees of Resolution on its bink; with grievous anguish for its rapid current, and terror and delusion for its many eddies and whirlpools; with sages for ferrymen and wisdom for the huge boat, which can no-how be got across; while the poor Kols and Kirats of the woods are the forlorn travellers wearied with waiting. When it reached the hermitage, it wasas though ocean had been agitated with a sudden rush of waters. The two royal-hosts were so overcome with grief that they had no sense, courage or shame left. Extolling king Dasarath’s majesty, virtue and amiability, they sorrowed like men drowned in a sea of sorrow.

Drowned in a sea of sorrow, they sorrowed, men and women alike, in utter bewilderment, all angrily and reproachfully exclaiming. ‘What is this that cruel fate has done ¢’ Gods, saints, anchorites, ascetics and sages witnessed Janak’s condition, but his love —says Tulsi—was like a broad river that no one could get over.
When all the people and the great sages had exhausted ever topic of consolation, Vasishtha thus addrest Videha: “King of men, be comforted.

sections.label: Doha 277
sections.name: दोउ समाज निमिराजु रघुराजु नहाने प्रात

verses.sa:
जासु ग्यानु रबि भव निसि नासा ।
बचन किरन मुनि कमल बिकासा ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu gyānu rabi bhav nisi nāsā
bacan kiran muni kamal bikāsā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तेहि कि मोह ममता निअराई ।
यह सिय राम सनेह बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
tehi ki moh mamatā niarāī
yah siya rām saneh bar̤āī

verses.sa:
बिषई साधक सिद्ध सयाने ।
त्रिबिध जीव जग बेद बखाने ॥
verses.tr:
biṣaī sādhak siddh sayāne
tribidh jīv jag bed bakhāne

verses.sa:
राम सनेह सरस मन जासू ।
साधु सभाँ बड़ आदर तासू ॥
verses.tr:
rām saneh saras man jāsū
sādhu sabhām̐ bar̤ ādar tāsū

verses.sa:
सोह न राम पेम बिनु ग्यानू ।
करनधार बिनु जिमि जलजानू ॥
verses.tr:
soh na rām pem binu gyānū
karanadhār binu jimi jalajānū

verses.sa:
मुनि बहुबिधि बिदेहु समुझाए ।
रामघाट सब लोग नहाए ॥
verses.tr:
muni bahubidhi bidehu samujhāe
rāmaghāṭ sab log nahāe

verses.sa:
सकल सोक संकुल नर नारी ।
सो बासरु बीतेउ बिनु बारी ॥
verses.tr:
sakal sok saṃkul nar nārī
so bāsaru bīteu binu bārī

verses.sa:
पसु खग मृगन्ह न कीन्ह अहारू ।
प्रिय परिजन कर कौन बिचारू ॥
verses.tr:
pasu khag mṛganh na kīnh ahārū
priya parijan kar kaun bicārū

verses.sa:
दोउ समाज निमिराजु रघुराजु नहाने प्रात ।
बैठे सब बट बिटप तर मन मलीन कृस गात ॥
verses.tr:
dou samāj nimirāju raghurāju nahāne prāt
baiṭhe sab baṭ biṭap tar man malīn kṛs gāt
verses.head: दोहा

trans: By the sun of your wisdom the darkness of the world is dispelled, and io the light of your speech saints expand like the lotus: how then can the power of delusion affect you? This is the marvellous result of love for Sita and Rama. There are three classes of beings, whom the Vedas term wise in their generation, the sensual, the sorcerer and the gaint: amongst the pious the highest honour is for him whose soul full of love for Rama: bat without knowledge love for Rama is imperfeot, like a boat without a helmsman.” When the saint had finished his exhortation to the king, all the people bathed at the Ramghet. Every one, men and women alike, were so agitated with grief that they spent the day without drinking water: even the cattle, birds and deer would eat nothing; much less would his own kindred think of doing so.
At daybreak the royal son of Nimi and the royal son of Raghu having bathed with all their retinue went and sat under the bar tree, sad at heart and wasted in body.

sections.label: Doha 278
sections.name: तेहि अवसर फल फूल दल मूल अनेक प्रकार

verses.sa:
जे महिसुर दसरथ पुर बासी ।
जे मिथिलापति नगर निवासी ॥
verses.tr:
je mahisur dasarath pur bāsī
je mithilāpati nagar nivāsī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
हंस बंस गुर जनक पुरोधा ।
जिन्ह जग मगु परमारथु सोधा ॥
verses.tr:
haṃs baṃs gur janak purodhā
jinh jag magu paramārathu sodhā

verses.sa:
लगे कहन उपदेस अनेका ।
सहित धरम नय बिरति बिबेका ॥
verses.tr:
lage kahan upades anekā
sahit dharam naya birati bibekā

verses.sa:
कौसिक कहि कहि कथा पुरानीं ।
समुझाई सब सभा सुबानीं ॥
verses.tr:
kausik kahi kahi kathā purānīṃ
samujhāī sab sabhā subānīṃ

verses.sa:
तब रघुनाथ कोसिकहि कहेऊ ।
नाथ कालि जल बिनु सबु रहेऊ ॥
verses.tr:
tab raghunāth kosikahi kaheū
nāth kāli jal binu sabu raheū

verses.sa:
मुनि कह उचित कहत रघुराई ।
गयउ बीति दिन पहर अढ़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
muni kah ucit kahat raghurāī
gayau bīti din pahar ar̤hāī

verses.sa:
रिषि रुख लखि कह तेरहुतिराजू ।
इहाँ उचित नहिं असन अनाजू ॥
verses.tr:
riṣi rukh lakhi kah terahutirājū
ihām̐ ucit nahiṃ asan anājū

verses.sa:
कहा भूप भल सबहि सोहाना ।
पाइ रजायसु चले नहाना ॥
verses.tr:
kahā bhūp bhal sabahi sohānā
pāi rajāyasu cale nahānā

verses.sa:
तेहि अवसर फल फूल दल मूल अनेक प्रकार ।
लइ आए बनचर बिपुल भरि भरि काँवरि भार ॥
verses.tr:
tehi avasar phal phūl dal mūl anek prakār
lai āe banacar bipul bhari bhari kām̐vari bhār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The Brebwans from Ayodhya, as also those from the capital of the king of Mithila: Vasishtha, the guru of the Solar race, and Satanand, Janak’s family priest, who while on earth had explored the path of heaven, began long exhortations full of religion, morality, asceticism and philosophy. Then Visvamitra eloquently admonished the assembly with many a reference to ancient legend; till Raghunath suggested to him: “Sire every one since yesterday has gone with out water.”’ Said the saint: “Rama has spoken in season; two-and-a-half watches of the day are now spent.” Understanding the saint's pleasure the king of Tirhut replied: It is not good for us to eat bread here.” The king’s word pleased every one, and having obtained his permission they went to bathe.
At the very moment arrived the people of the woods, bringing large baskets laden with fruits, flowers, leaves and roots of every description.

sections.label: Doha 279
sections.name: सादर सब कहँ रामगुर पठए भरि भरि भार

verses.sa:
कामद मे गिरि राम प्रसादा ।
अवलोकत अपहरत बिषादा ॥
verses.tr:
kāmad me giri rām prasādā
avalokat apaharat biṣādā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सर सरिता बन भूमि बिभागा ।
जनु उमगत आनँद अनुरागा ॥
verses.tr:
sar saritā ban bhūmi bibhāgā
janu umagat ānam̐d anurāgā

verses.sa:
बेलि बिटप सब सफल सफूला ।
बोलत खग मृग अलि अनुकूला ॥
verses.tr:
beli biṭap sab saphal saphūlā
bolat khag mṛg ali anukūlā

verses.sa:
तेहि अवसर बन अधिक उछाहू ।
त्रिबिध समीर सुखद सब काहू ॥
verses.tr:
tehi avasar ban adhik uchāhū
tribidh samīr sukhad sab kāhū

verses.sa:
जाइ न बरनि मनोहरताई ।
जनु महि करति जनक पहुनाई ॥
verses.tr:
jāi na barani manoharatāī
janu mahi karati janak pahunāī

verses.sa:
तब सब लोग नहाइ नहाई ।
राम जनक मुनि आयसु पाई ॥
verses.tr:
tab sab log nahāi nahāī
rām janak muni āyasu pāī

verses.sa:
देखि देखि तरुबर अनुरागे ।
जहँ तहँ पुरजन उतरन लागे ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi dekhi tarubar anurāge
jaham̐ taham̐ purajan utaran lāge

verses.sa:
दल फल मूल कंद बिधि नाना ।
पावन सुंदर सुधा समाना ॥
verses.tr:
dal phal mūl kaṃd bidhi nānā
pāvan suṃdar sudhā samānā

verses.sa:
सादर सब कहँ रामगुर पठए भरि भरि भार ।
पूजि पितर सुर अतिथि गुर लगे करन फरहार ॥
verses.tr:
sādar sab kaham̐ rāmagur paṭhae bhari bhari bhār
pūji pitar sur atithi gur lage karan pharahār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: By Rama’s favour the mountain had become a granter of desires: merely to look at it removed sorrow. The ponds, streams and glades were bursting as it were with joy and love; all the creepers and trees broke out into blossom and fruit: the birds and beasts made a most melodious concert. In short, the gladsomen+ss of the forest was surpassing; the air, soft, cool and fragrant, was delightful to every one; and the beauty of the scene was beyond description, as though Earth herself had prepared Janak’s reception. When each and all of the people had finished bathing and had received permission from Rama, Janak and the saint, they gazed _with rapture on the magnificent trees and threw themselves down here and there; while leaves and fruits, flowers and roots of every kind, fresh and fair, and sweet as nectar,
Were courteously sent to all, in baskets full, by Rama’s guru;on which they made their repast, after reverencing their ancestors, the gods, their guests and the guru.

sections.label: Doha 280
sections.name: एहि सुख जोग न लोग सब कहहिं कहाँ अस भागु

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि बासर बीते चारी ।
रामु निरखि नर नारि सुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi bāsar bīte cārī
rāmu nirakhi nar nāri sukhārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
दुहु समाज असि रुचि मन माहीं ।
बिनु सिय राम फिरब भल नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
duhu samāj asi ruci man māhīṃ
binu siya rām phirab bhal nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सीता राम संग बनबासू ।
कोटि अमरपुर सरिस सुपासू ॥
verses.tr:
sītā rām saṃg banabāsū
koṭi amarapur saris supāsū

verses.sa:
परिहरि लखन रामु बैदेही ।
जेहि घरु भाव बाम बिधि तेही ॥
verses.tr:
parihari lakhan rāmu baidehī
jehi gharu bhāv bām bidhi tehī

verses.sa:
दाहिन दइउ होइ जब सबही ।
राम समीप बसिअ बन तबही ॥
verses.tr:
dāhin daiu hoi jab sabahī
rām samīp basia ban tabahī

verses.sa:
मंदाकिनि मज्जनु तिहु काला ।
राम दरसु मुद मंगल माला ॥
verses.tr:
maṃdākini majjanu tihu kālā
rām darasu mud maṃgal mālā

verses.sa:
अटनु राम गिरि बन तापस थल ।
असनु अमिअ सम कंद मूल फल ॥
verses.tr:
aṭanu rām giri ban tāpas thal
asanu amia sam kaṃd mūl phal

verses.sa:
सुख समेत संबत दुइ साता ।
पल सम होहिं न जनिअहिं जाता ॥
verses.tr:
sukh samet saṃbat dui sātā
pal sam hohiṃ na janiahiṃ jātā

verses.sa: एहि सुख जोग न लोग सब कहहिं कहाँ अस भागु ॥
verses.tr: ehi sukh jog na log sab kahahiṃ kahām̐ as bhāgu
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: सहज सुभायँ समाज दुहु राम चरन अनुरागु ॥
verses.tr: sahaj subhāyam̐ samāj duhu rām caran anurāgu

trans: In this manner four days were spent, in which the people saw Rama and were happy. In both camps there was this desire at heart: “It is not good for us to return without Sita and Ramu. Life in the woods ia their society is a thousand times better than heaven. If any one, in his longing for home, would desert Lakshman, Rama and Sita, his fate is a0 unlucky one: it is the height of good fortune for us all to dwell in the forest near Rama, bathing three times a day in the Mandakini, seeing Rama, which will be a constant delight, rambling about on the sacred hill and among the hermitages in the wood, and feeding on sweet herbs and roots and fruits, so contentedly that the fourteen years will pass like a minute, without our knowing how they go.
We are not worthy of so great happiness” they all exclaimed. ‘Whatluck can be like it 7?’ Such was the spontaneous devotion to Rama's feet in both camps.

sections.label: Doha 281
sections.name: सुनिअ सुधा देखिअहिं गरल सब करतूति कराल

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि सकल मनोरथ करहीं ।
बचन सप्रेम सुनत मन हरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi sakal manorath karahīṃ
bacan saprem sunat man harahīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सीय मातु तेहि समय पठाईं ।
दासीं देखि सुअवसरु आईं ॥
verses.tr:
sīya mātu tehi samaya paṭhāīṃ
dāsīṃ dekhi suavasaru āīṃ

verses.sa:
सावकास सुनि सब सिय सासू ।
आयउ जनकराज रनिवासू ॥
verses.tr:
sāvakās suni sab siya sāsū
āyau janakarāj ranivāsū

verses.sa:
कौसल्याँ सादर सनमानी ।
आसन दिए समय सम आनी ॥
verses.tr:
kausalyām̐ sādar sanamānī
āsan die samaya sam ānī

verses.sa:
सीलु सनेह सकल दुहु ओरा ।
द्रवहिं देखि सुनि कुलिस कठोरा ॥
verses.tr:
sīlu saneh sakal duhu orā
dravahiṃ dekhi suni kulis kaṭhorā

verses.sa:
पुलक सिथिल तन बारि बिलोचन ।
महि नख लिखन लगीं सब सोचन ॥
verses.tr:
pulak sithil tan bāri bilocan
mahi nakh likhan lagīṃ sab socan

verses.sa:
सब सिय राम प्रीति कि सि मूरती ।
जनु करुना बहु बेष बिसूरति ॥
verses.tr:
sab siya rām prīti ki si mūratī
janu karunā bahu beṣ bisūrati

verses.sa:
सीय मातु कह बिधि बुधि बाँकी ।
जो पय फेनु फोर पबि टाँकी ॥
verses.tr:
sīya mātu kah bidhi budhi bām̐kī
jo paya phenu phor pabi ṭām̐kī

verses.sa:
सुनिअ सुधा देखिअहिं गरल सब करतूति कराल ।
जहँ तहँ काक उलूक बक मानस सकृत मराल ॥
verses.tr:
sunia sudhā dekhiahiṃ garal sab karatūti karāl
jaham̐ taham̐ kāk ulūk bak mānas sakṛt marāl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: In this manner us all were expressing their hearts’ desire in affectionate words, which it ravished the soul to hear, Sita’s mother sent a handmaid, who ascertained that it was “convenient time and returned. On learning that Sita’s mothers-in-law were at leisure, Janak's queen and her attendants came to visit them. Kausalya received them with due honour and gave them such seats as circumstances allowed. On both sides there was such love and tenderness, that the most rigid thunderbolt would have melted, could it have seen and heard, Their body quivering and unnerved, their eyes full of tears, and all lost in grief, they drew lines with their toes on the ground, each a separate incarnation of love to Sita and Rama, or as it were tearful Sympathy repeated io many forms. Said Sita’s mother: “God’s judgment has gone astray, using the thunderbolt for a chisel to break up foam!
We hear of ambrosia but see only venom; all his doings are hard; crows, owls and cranes are everywhere, but swans only in the inaccessible Manas lake.”

sections.label: Doha 282
sections.name: लखनु राम सिय जाहुँ बन भल परिनाम न पोचु

verses.sa:
सुनि ससोच कह देबि सुमित्रा ।
बिधि गति बड़ि बिपरीत बिचित्रा ॥
verses.tr:
suni sasoc kah debi sumitrā
bidhi gati bar̤i biparīt bicitrā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जो सृजि पालइ हरइ बहोरी ।
बाल केलि सम बिधि मति भोरी ॥
verses.tr:
jo sṛji pālai harai bahorī
bāl keli sam bidhi mati bhorī

verses.sa:
कौसल्या कह दोसु न काहू ।
करम बिबस दुख सुख छति लाहू ॥
verses.tr:
kausalyā kah dosu na kāhū
karam bibas dukh sukh chati lāhū

verses.sa:
कठिन करम गति जान बिधाता ।
जो सुभ असुभ सकल फल दाता ॥
verses.tr:
kaṭhin karam gati jān bidhātā
jo subh asubh sakal phal dātā

verses.sa:
ईस रजाइ सीस सबही कें ।
उतपति थिति लय बिषहु अमी कें ॥
verses.tr:
īs rajāi sīs sabahī keṃ
utapati thiti laya biṣahu amī keṃ

verses.sa:
देबि मोह बस सोचिअ बादी ।
बिधि प्रपंचु अस अचल अनादी ॥
verses.tr:
debi moh bas socia bādī
bidhi prapaṃcu as acal anādī

verses.sa:
भूपति जिअब मरब उर आनी ।
सोचिअ सखि लखि निज हित हानी ॥
verses.tr:
bhūpati jiab marab ur ānī
socia sakhi lakhi nij hit hānī

verses.sa:
सीय मातु कह सत्य सुबानी ।
सुकृती अवधि अवधपति रानी ॥
verses.tr:
sīya mātu kah satya subānī
sukṛtī avadhi avadhapati rānī

verses.sa:
लखनु राम सिय जाहुँ बन भल परिनाम न पोचु ।
गहबरि हियँ कह कौसिला मोहि भरत कर सोचु ॥
verses.tr:
lakhanu rām siya jāhum̐ ban bhal parinām na pocu
gahabari hiyam̐ kah kausilā mohi bharat kar socu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Upon this, queen Sumitra said sadly: “God’s ways are contrary and unaccountable. He creates and cherishes, and then destroys: his purposes are as idle as child’s play.” Said Kausalya: “[t is no one’s fault; pain and pleasure, loss and gain are governed by actions: the effects of action are inscrutable; God only knows them, who awards its own fruit to every act, whether it be good or bad. The Lord’s decree dominates over all, whether for rising, staying or falling, whether for poison or ambrosia. It is vain, madam, to give way to sorrow; God’s schemes are, as I have said, unchangeable and from everlasting. Consider the question of the king’s life or death; look now, friend, and think whether it was a loss to him or gain.” Sita’s mother replied: ‘Noblest of noble women, consort of Avadh’s kings, your eloquent words are true,
If Lakshman, Rama and Sita stay in exile, all will be right in the end and no harm done.” ** But’ (said Kausalya with a troubled heart.) ‘I am anxious.about Bharat.

sections.label: Doha 283
sections.name: कौसल्या कह धीर धरि सुनहु देबि मिथिलेसि

verses.sa:
ईस प्रसाद असीस तुम्हारी ।
सुत सुतबधू देवसरि बारी ॥
verses.tr:
īs prasād asīs tumhārī
sut sutabadhū devasari bārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राम सपथ मैं कीन्ह न काऊ ।
सो करि कहउँ सखी सति भाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
rām sapath maiṃ kīnh na kāū
so kari kahaum̐ sakhī sati bhāū

verses.sa:
भरत सील गुन बिनय बड़ाई ।
भायप भगति भरोस भलाई ॥
verses.tr:
bharat sīl gun binaya bar̤āī
bhāyap bhagati bharos bhalāī

verses.sa:
कहत सारदहु कर मति हीचे ।
सागर सीप कि जाहिं उलीचे ॥
verses.tr:
kahat sāradahu kar mati hīce
sāgar sīp ki jāhiṃ ulīce

verses.sa:
जानउँ सदा भरत कुलदीपा ।
बार बार मोहि कहेउ महीपा ॥
verses.tr:
jānaum̐ sadā bharat kuladīpā
bār bār mohi kaheu mahīpā

verses.sa:
कसें कनकु मनि पारिखि पाएँ ।
पुरुष परिखिअहिं समयँ सुभाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
kaseṃ kanaku mani pārikhi pāem̐
puruṣ parikhiahiṃ samayam̐ subhāem̐

verses.sa:
अनुचित आजु कहब अस मोरा ।
सोक सनेहँ सयानप थोरा ॥
verses.tr:
anucit āju kahab as morā
sok saneham̐ sayānap thorā

verses.sa:
सुनि सुरसरि सम पावनि बानी ।
भईं सनेह बिकल सब रानी ॥
verses.tr:
suni surasari sam pāvani bānī
bhaīṃ saneh bikal sab rānī

verses.sa:
कौसल्या कह धीर धरि सुनहु देबि मिथिलेसि ।
को बिबेकनिधि बल्लभहि तुम्हहि सकइ उपदेसि ॥
verses.tr:
kausalyā kah dhīr dhari sunahu debi mithilesi
ko bibekanidhi ballabhahi tumhahi sakai upadesi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: By God’s favour and your blessing, my son and his wife are both pure as Ganges water. Though I have never yet sworn by Rama, [ now invoke him to witness friend, that I speak truly. The greatness of Bharat’s generos ity, goodness and humility, his brotherly affection, faith hope and charity, even Sarasvati’s eloquence would fail te declare; can the ocean be ladled out with a shell? I have

A a (See ge Sag Nae) a gree are 1 For suta-badhit, ‘a son's wife. might be hett j: er to read aw-d ‘ood brother.’ 8 w-bandhi always known that Bharat was the glory of his house, and the king repeatedly told me so. Gold is known by assay and precious stones by the test; a man’s temper is tried by fortune. It is not right for me now to have spoken thus; bat sorrow and love have left me little reason.” On
hearing these words, as pure as Ganges stream, all the queens were overcome with emotion.
Kausalya continued: “Hearken to me, queen of Mithi-

sections.label: Doha 284
sections.name: बेगि पाउ धारिअ थलहि कह सनेहँ सतिभाय

verses.sa:
रानि राय सन अवसरु पाई ।
अपनी भाँति कहब समुझाई ॥
verses.tr:
rāni rāya san avasaru pāī
apanī bhām̐ti kahab samujhāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
रखिअहिं लखनु भरतु गबनहिं बन ।
जौं यह मत मानै महीप मन ॥
verses.tr:
rakhiahiṃ lakhanu bharatu gabanahiṃ ban
jauṃ yah mat mānai mahīp man

verses.sa:
तौ भल जतनु करब सुबिचारी ।
मोरें सौचु भरत कर भारी ॥
verses.tr:
tau bhal jatanu karab subicārī
moreṃ saucu bharat kar bhārī

verses.sa:
गूढ़ सनेह भरत मन माही ।
रहें नीक मोहि लागत नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
gūr̤h saneh bharat man māhī
raheṃ nīk mohi lāgat nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
लखि सुभाउ सुनि सरल सुबानी ।
सब भइ मगन करुन रस रानी ॥
verses.tr:
lakhi subhāu suni saral subānī
sab bhai magan karun ras rānī

verses.sa:
नभ प्रसून झरि धन्य धन्य धुनि ।
सिथिल सनेहँ सिद्ध जोगी मुनि ॥
verses.tr:
nabh prasūn jhari dhanya dhanya dhuni
sithil saneham̐ siddh jogī muni

verses.sa:
सबु रनिवासु बिथकि लखि रहेऊ ।
तब धरि धीर सुमित्राँ कहेऊ ॥
verses.tr:
sabu ranivāsu bithaki lakhi raheū
tab dhari dhīr sumitrām̐ kaheū

verses.sa:
देबि दंड जुग जामिनि बीती ।
राम मातु सुनी उठी सप्रीती ॥
verses.tr:
debi daṃḍ jug jāmini bītī
rām mātu sunī uṭhī saprītī

verses.sa:
बेगि पाउ धारिअ थलहि कह सनेहँ सतिभाय ।
हमरें तौ अब ईस गति के मिथिलेस सहाय ॥
verses.tr:
begi pāu dhāria thalahi kah saneham̐ satibhāya
hamareṃ tau ab īs gati ke mithiles sahāya
verses.head: दोहा

trans: le, and take courage. Who is able to advise you, the consort of the wisest of men?

Having found a fitting opportunity, speak, madam, to the king as if of yourself, and suggest that be should stop Lakshman and let Bharat go to the forest. If the king agrees to this proposal, I will then devise and carry out some proper plan. I am greatly disturbed about Bharat, for his love is so profound that if he stays I surmise evil.” When they saw her generosity and heard her frank appeal, they were all overpowered with sympathy. There was a shower of flowers from heaven with cries of Glory ‘Glory; ' saints, ascetics and sages grew faint with love. The queens, despite their fatigue, still looked and waited; till Sumitra made bold to say: “Madam nearly an hour of the night is gone.” Atthis Kausalya rose and affectionately
Said, “Pray return at once to your tent: of a truth now

sections.label: Doha 285
sections.name: अस कहि पग परि पेम अति सिय हित बिनय सुनाइ

verses.sa:
लखि सनेह सुनि बचन बिनीता ।
जनकप्रिया गह पाय पुनीता ॥
verses.tr:
lakhi saneh suni bacan binītā
janakapriyā gah pāya punītā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
देबि उचित असि बिनय तुम्हारी ।
दसरथ घरिनि राम महतारी ॥
verses.tr:
debi ucit asi binaya tumhārī
dasarath gharini rām mahatārī

verses.sa:
प्रभु अपने नीचहु आदरहीं ।
अगिनि धूम गिरि सिर तिनु धरहीं ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu apane nīcahu ādarahīṃ
agini dhūm giri sir tinu dharahīṃ

verses.sa:
सेवकु राउ करम मन बानी ।
सदा सहाय महेसु भवानी ॥
verses.tr:
sevaku rāu karam man bānī
sadā sahāya mahesu bhavānī

verses.sa:
रउरे अंग जोगु जग को है ।
दीप सहाय कि दिनकर सोहै ॥
verses.tr:
raure aṃg jogu jag ko hai
dīp sahāya ki dinakar sohai

verses.sa:
रामु जाइ बनु करि सुर काजू ।
अचल अवधपुर करिहहिं राजू ॥
verses.tr:
rāmu jāi banu kari sur kājū
acal avadhapur karihahiṃ rājū

verses.sa:
अमर नाग नर राम बाहुबल ।
सुख बसिहहिं अपनें अपने थल ॥
verses.tr:
amar nāg nar rām bāhubal
sukh basihahiṃ apaneṃ apane thal

verses.sa:
यह सब जागबलिक कहि राखा ।
देबि न होइ मुधा मुनि भाषा ॥
verses.tr:
yah sab jāgabalik kahi rākhā
debi na hoi mudhā muni bhāṣā

verses.sa: अस कहि पग परि पेम अति सिय हित बिनय सुनाइ ॥
verses.tr: as kahi pag pari pem ati siya hit binaya sunāi
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: सिय समेत सियमातु तब चली सुआयसु पाइ ॥
verses.tr: siya samet siyamātu tab calī suāyasu pāi

trans: our help is in God and the king of Mithila.” Chaupdi.

Seeing her affection and hearing her modest speech, Janak’s queen clasped her holy feet: ‘Madam, this modesty on your part is only natural, since you are Dasarath’s wife and Rama's mother. Monarchs give honour to the lowest of their servants; in the same way as fire tops itself with smoke and a hill with grass. King Janak is your servant in thought, word and deed, and Mahadeva and Bhavani are your constant auxiliaries. Whois there on earth who can act as your supplement? Does the sun shine by the help of a torch? After going into exile and assisting the gods, Rama will hold undisputed sway at Ayodhya. Through the might of his arm gods, serpents and men will all dwell in peace, each in his own place. This has all been foretold by Yajnavalkya; and the words of a saint, madam, can never be false.” Dohe 274. So saying, she fell at her feet and affectionately made
request for Sita; permission was accorded and Sita set out with her mother. Chaupdi.

sections.label: Doha 286
sections.name: सिय पितु मातु सनेह बस बिकल न सकी सँभारि

verses.sa:
प्रिय परिजनहि मिली बैदेही ।
जो जेहि जोगु भाँति तेहि तेही ॥
verses.tr:
priya parijanahi milī baidehī
jo jehi jogu bhām̐ti tehi tehī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तापस बेष जानकी देखी ।
भा सबु बिकल बिषाद बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
tāpas beṣ jānakī dekhī
bhā sabu bikal biṣād biseṣī

verses.sa:
जनक राम गुर आयसु पाई ।
चले थलहि सिय देखी आई ॥
verses.tr:
janak rām gur āyasu pāī
cale thalahi siya dekhī āī

verses.sa:
लीन्हि लाइ उर जनक जानकी ।
पाहुन पावन पेम प्रान की ॥
verses.tr:
līnhi lāi ur janak jānakī
pāhun pāvan pem prān kī

verses.sa:
उर उमगेउ अंबुधि अनुरागू ।
भयउ भूप मनु मनहुँ पयागू ॥
verses.tr:
ur umageu aṃbudhi anurāgū
bhayau bhūp manu manahum̐ payāgū

verses.sa:
सिय सनेह बटु बाढ़त जोहा ।
ता पर राम पेम सिसु सोहा ॥
verses.tr:
siya saneh baṭu bār̤hat johā
tā par rām pem sisu sohā

verses.sa:
चिरजीवी मुनि ग्यान बिकल जनु ।
बूड़त लहेउ बाल अवलंबनु ॥
verses.tr:
cirajīvī muni gyān bikal janu
būr̤at laheu bāl avalaṃbanu

verses.sa:
मोह मगन मति नहिं बिदेह की ।
महिमा सिय रघुबर सनेह की ॥
verses.tr:
moh magan mati nahiṃ bideh kī
mahimā siya raghubar saneh kī

verses.sa:
सिय पितु मातु सनेह बस बिकल न सकी सँभारि ।
धरनिसुताँ धीरजु धरेउ समउ सुधरमु बिचारि ॥
verses.tr:
siya pitu mātu saneh bas bikal na sakī sam̐bhāri
dharanisutām̐ dhīraju dhareu samau sudharamu bicāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Sita embraced all her old domestics in such manner as in each case was most befitting. When they saw her in hermit’s dress, they were all distrest with exceeding sorrow Janak, on receiving the permission of Rama and the guru, came to the tent to see his daughter and clasped her to his bosom, the sanctifying guest of the soul of love. His bosom swelled with a flood of affection and his royal soul resembled Prayag; with his love for Sita conspicuous as the spreading bar tree, on which devotion to Rama appeared like the child, clutched for support by the king’s bewildered senses as by the sage Chiranjiv when on the point of drowning.’ Videha was so overwhelmed by his feelings that he had no sense left; such is the power of love for Sita and Raghubar.
Sita could not bear to see her father and mother so overcome by affection, but calling to mind both the time and her own duty, Earth's daughter summoned up courage.

sections.label: Doha 287
sections.name: बार बार मिलि भेंट सिय बिदा कीन्ह सनमानि

verses.sa:
तापस बेष जनक सिय देखी ।
भयउ पेमु परितोषु बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
tāpas beṣ janak siya dekhī
bhayau pemu paritoṣu biseṣī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पुत्रि पवित्र किए कुल दोऊ ।
सुजस धवल जगु कह सबु कोऊ ॥
verses.tr:
putri pavitr kie kul doū
sujas dhaval jagu kah sabu koū

verses.sa:
जिति सुरसरि कीरति सरि तोरी ।
गवनु कीन्ह बिधि अंड करोरी ॥
verses.tr:
jiti surasari kīrati sari torī
gavanu kīnh bidhi aṃḍ karorī

verses.sa:
गंग अवनि थल तीनि बड़ेरे ।
एहिं किए साधु समाज घनेरे ॥
verses.tr:
gaṃg avani thal tīni bar̤ere
ehiṃ kie sādhu samāj ghanere

verses.sa:
पितु कह सत्य सनेहँ सुबानी ।
सीय सकुच महुँ मनहुँ समानी ॥
verses.tr:
pitu kah satya saneham̐ subānī
sīya sakuc mahum̐ manahum̐ samānī

verses.sa:
पुनि पितु मातु लीन्ह उर लाई ।
सिख आसिष हित दीन्हि सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
puni pitu mātu līnh ur lāī
sikh āsiṣ hit dīnhi suhāī

verses.sa:
कहति न सीय सकुचि मन माहीं ।
इहाँ बसब रजनीं भल नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
kahati na sīya sakuci man māhīṃ
ihām̐ basab rajanīṃ bhal nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
लखि रुख रानि जनायउ राऊ ।
हृदयँ सराहत सीलु सुभाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
lakhi rukh rāni janāyau rāū
hṛdayam̐ sarāhat sīlu subhāū

verses.sa:
बार बार मिलि भेंट सिय बिदा कीन्ह सनमानि ।
कही समय सिर भरत गति रानि सुबानि सयानि ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār mili bheṃṭ siya bidā kīnh sanamāni
kahī samaya sir bharat gati rāni subāni sayāni
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When Janak looked at her in her anchorite’s dress, he was filled with love and consolation: ‘Daughter, you have sanctified both families; everybody in the world proclaims your brilliant renown. The stream of your.fame excels the Ganges and has spread over millions of universes, The Ganges has only three great sites on earth, but the congrega-tions of saints that have been made by you are innumerable.” At her father’s sincere and loving eloquence Sita was abashed and shrank into herself, Again her father and mother took her to their arms and gave her kind instructions and invoked rich blessings upon her. Sita could not speak out, but was anxious at heart: “It is not well for me to spend the night here.” The queen saw her wish and explained it to the king, inwardly praising the excellence of her disposition.
After again and again embracing her, they graciously gave her leave to depart. Having now an excellent opportunity, the discreet queen adroitly mentioned Bharat’s going.

sections.label: Doha 288
sections.name: निरवधि गुन निरुपम पुरुषु भरतु भरत सम जानि

verses.sa:
सुनि भूपाल भरत ब्यवहारू ।
सोन सुगंध सुधा ससि सारू ॥
verses.tr:
suni bhūpāl bharat byavahārū
son sugaṃdh sudhā sasi sārū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मूदे सजल नयन पुलके तन ।
सुजसु सराहन लगे मुदित मन ॥
verses.tr:
mūde sajal nayan pulake tan
sujasu sarāhan lage mudit man

verses.sa:
सावधान सुनु सुमुखि सुलोचनि ।
भरत कथा भव बंध बिमोचनि ॥
verses.tr:
sāvadhān sunu sumukhi sulocani
bharat kathā bhav baṃdh bimocani

verses.sa:
धरम राजनय ब्रह्मबिचारू ।
इहाँ जथामति मोर प्रचारू ॥
verses.tr:
dharam rājanaya brahmabicārū
ihām̐ jathāmati mor pracārū

verses.sa:
सो मति मोरि भरत महिमाही ।
कहै काह छलि छुअति न छाँही ॥
verses.tr:
so mati mori bharat mahimāhī
kahai kāh chali chuati na chām̐hī

verses.sa:
बिधि गनपति अहिपति सिव सारद ।
कबि कोबिद बुध बुद्धि बिसारद ॥
verses.tr:
bidhi ganapati ahipati siv sārad
kabi kobid budh buddhi bisārad

verses.sa:
भरत चरित कीरति करतूती ।
धरम सील गुन बिमल बिभूती ॥
verses.tr:
bharat carit kīrati karatūtī
dharam sīl gun bimal bibhūtī

verses.sa:
समुझत सुनत सुखद सब काहू ।
सुचि सुरसरि रुचि निदर सुधाहू ॥
verses.tr:
samujhat sunat sukhad sab kāhū
suci surasari ruci nidar sudhāhū

verses.sa:
निरवधि गुन निरुपम पुरुषु भरतु भरत सम जानि ।
कहिअ सुमेरु कि सेर सम कबिकुल मति सकुचानि ॥
verses.tr:
niravadhi gun nirupam puruṣu bharatu bharat sam jāni
kahia sumeru ki ser sam kabikul mati sakucāni
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When the king heurd of Bharat’s conduct, brilliant as gold, refreshing as sweet perfumes, consolatory as ambrosia or the soft light of the moon, he closed his tearful eyes and his body thrilled with rapture, as he broke out into ecstatic praises of his glory. ‘Mark me well, fair-faced and brighteyed dame, the legend of Bharat is effectual to loosen the hands of existence. According to my ability, I too have mastered somewhat of theology, statecraft and spiritual meditation; but whatever my ability, if I would tell Bharat’s greatness, I cannot make u pretence of reaching even its shadow. Brahm4, Ganes, Seshnag, Siva, Sarasvati, the inspired poets and the sages most renowned for wisdom, when they hear or meditate upon Bharat’s doings, his glory, his vigour, his piety, his temper, his virtues and his spotless dignity, all are enraptured; it has a flavour of purity like the Ganges, surpassing ambrosia.
His perfection is limitless; he is incomparable pro-toplasm; I know none like Bharat but himself. Can Mount Meru be weighed in any balance? The wit of the whole race of poets is at fault.

sections.label: Doha 289
sections.name: भोरेहुँ भरत न पेलिहहिं मनसहुँ राम रजाइ

verses.sa:
अगम सबहि बरनत बरबरनी ।
जिमि जलहीन मीन गमु धरनी ॥
verses.tr:
agam sabahi baranat barabaranī
jimi jalahīn mīn gamu dharanī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भरत अमित महिमा सुनु रानी ।
जानहिं रामु न सकहिं बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
bharat amit mahimā sunu rānī
jānahiṃ rāmu na sakahiṃ bakhānī

verses.sa:
बरनि सप्रेम भरत अनुभाऊ ।
तिय जिय की रुचि लखि कह राऊ ॥
verses.tr:
barani saprem bharat anubhāū
tiya jiya kī ruci lakhi kah rāū

verses.sa:
बहुरहिं लखनु भरतु बन जाहीं ।
सब कर भल सब के मन माहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bahurahiṃ lakhanu bharatu ban jāhīṃ
sab kar bhal sab ke man māhīṃ

verses.sa:
देबि परंतु भरत रघुबर की ।
प्रीति प्रतीति जाइ नहिं तरकी ॥
verses.tr:
debi paraṃtu bharat raghubar kī
prīti pratīti jāi nahiṃ tarakī

verses.sa:
भरतु अवधि सनेह ममता की ।
जद्यपि रामु सीम समता की ॥
verses.tr:
bharatu avadhi saneh mamatā kī
jadyapi rāmu sīm samatā kī

verses.sa:
परमारथ स्वारथ सुख सारे ।
भरत न सपनेहुँ मनहुँ निहारे ॥
verses.tr:
paramārath svārath sukh sāre
bharat na sapanehum̐ manahum̐ nihāre

verses.sa:
साधन सिद्ध राम पग नेहू ।
मोहि लखि परत भरत मत एहू ॥
verses.tr:
sādhan siddh rām pag nehū
mohi lakhi parat bharat mat ehū

verses.sa:
भोरेहुँ भरत न पेलिहहिं मनसहुँ राम रजाइ ।
करिअ न सोचु सनेह बस कहेउ भूप बिलखाइ ॥
verses.tr:
bhorehum̐ bharat na pelihahiṃ manasahum̐ rām rajāi
karia na socu saneh bas kaheu bhūp bilakhāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: He is, fair dame, as impossible to describe as it is impossible for a fish to walk on dry land. Hearken, lady; Rama knows, but even he cannot describe Bharat’s illimitable greatness, If Lakshman returns and Bharat goes to the forest, every one will imagine it to be good for all: but, madam, Bharat’s love and confidence in Rama are past all telling. Bharat is the perfection of love and devoted attachment, but Rama is the lord of impartiality, Bharat’s mind has never even dreamt of all the felicities of this world and the next; only his love for Rama's feet has brought him success. This, as I consider, is Bharat’s belief.
He would never be beguiled into thwarting an order of Rama's; do not then in your affection give way to sorrow.” said the king, and sighed as he spoke.

sections.label: Doha 290
sections.name: प्रान प्रान के जीव के जिव सुख के सुख राम

verses.sa:
राम भरत गुन गनत सप्रीती ।
निसि दंपतिहि पलक सम बीती ॥
verses.tr:
rām bharat gun ganat saprītī
nisi daṃpatihi palak sam bītī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राज समाज प्रात जुग जागे ।
न्हाइ न्हाइ सुर पूजन लागे ॥
verses.tr:
rāj samāj prāt jug jāge
nhāi nhāi sur pūjan lāge

verses.sa:
गे नहाइ गुर पहीं रघुराई ।
बंदि चरन बोले रुख पाई ॥
verses.tr:
ge nahāi gur pahīṃ raghurāī
baṃdi caran bole rukh pāī

verses.sa:
नाथ भरतु पुरजन महतारी ।
सोक बिकल बनबास दुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
nāth bharatu purajan mahatārī
sok bikal banabās dukhārī

verses.sa:
सहित समाज राउ मिथिलेसू ।
बहुत दिवस भए सहत कलेसू ॥
verses.tr:
sahit samāj rāu mithilesū
bahut divas bhae sahat kalesū

verses.sa:
उचित होइ सोइ कीजिअ नाथा ।
हित सबही कर रौरें हाथा ॥
verses.tr:
ucit hoi soi kījia nāthā
hit sabahī kar raureṃ hāthā

verses.sa:
अस कहि अति सकुचे रघुराऊ ।
मुनि पुलके लखि सीलु सुभाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi ati sakuce raghurāū
muni pulake lakhi sīlu subhāū

verses.sa:
तुम्ह बिनु राम सकल सुख साजा ।
नरक सरिस दुहु राज समाजा ॥
verses.tr:
tumh binu rām sakal sukh sājā
narak saris duhu rāj samājā

verses.sa:
प्रान प्रान के जीव के जिव सुख के सुख राम ।
तुम्ह तजि तात सोहात गृह जिन्हहि तिन्हहिं बिधि बाम ॥
verses.tr:
prān prān ke jīv ke jiv sukh ke sukh rām
tumh taji tāt sohāt gṛh jinhahi tinhahiṃ bidhi bām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: As the wedded pair thus affectionately discoursed of Bharat’s excellences, the night passed like a minute. At daybreak both the royal camps awoke and bathed and worshipped the gods. After bathing, Rama approached his guru, embraced his feet, and on receiving permission spoke thus: ‘“My lord, Bharat and the people and my mothers are distrest and inconvenienced by their sojourn in the woods. The king of Mithila too and his retinue have been enduring hardships for, many days; be pleased to do, my lord, as seems to you good; the happiness of all is in your hands.” So saying, Rama was greatly abashed. The saint thrilled with delight on seeing his disposition. ‘Without
you, Rama, the greatest bliss would seem to both camps like hell.
O Rama, you are the soul of their soul, the life of their life, the joy of their joy. Any. one, my son, who would desert you for the sake of the pleasure of home has destiny against him. ‘

sections.label: Doha 291
sections.name: ग्यान निधान सुजान सुचि धरम धीर नरपाल

verses.sa:
सो सुखु करमु धरमु जरि जाऊ ।
जहँ न राम पद पंकज भाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
so sukhu karamu dharamu jari jāū
jaham̐ na rām pad paṃkaj bhāū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
जोगु कुजोगु ग्यानु अग्यानू ।
जहँ नहिं राम पेम परधानू ॥
verses.tr:
jogu kujogu gyānu agyānū
jaham̐ nahiṃ rām pem paradhānū

verses.sa:
तुम्ह बिनु दुखी सुखी तुम्ह तेहीं ।
तुम्ह जानहु जिय जो जेहि केहीं ॥
verses.tr:
tumh binu dukhī sukhī tumh tehīṃ
tumh jānahu jiya jo jehi kehīṃ

verses.sa:
राउर आयसु सिर सबही कें ।
बिदित कृपालहि गति सब नीकें ॥
verses.tr:
rāur āyasu sir sabahī keṃ
bidit kṛpālahi gati sab nīkeṃ

verses.sa:
आपु आश्रमहि धारिअ पाऊ ।
भयउ सनेह सिथिल मुनिराऊ ॥
verses.tr:
āpu āśramahi dhāria pāū
bhayau saneh sithil munirāū

verses.sa:
करि प्रनाम तब रामु सिधाए ।
रिषि धरि धीर जनक पहिं आए ॥
verses.tr:
kari pranām tab rāmu sidhāe
riṣi dhari dhīr janak pahiṃ āe

verses.sa:
राम बचन गुरु नृपहि सुनाए ।
सील सनेह सुभायँ सुहाए ॥
verses.tr:
rām bacan guru nṛpahi sunāe
sīl saneh subhāyam̐ suhāe

verses.sa:
महाराज अब कीजिअ सोई ।
सब कर धरम सहित हित होई ॥
verses.tr:
mahārāj ab kījia soī
sab kar dharam sahit hit hoī

verses.sa:
ग्यान निधान सुजान सुचि धरम धीर नरपाल ।
तुम्ह बिनु असमंजस समन को समरथ एहि काल ॥
verses.tr:
gyān nidhān sujān suci dharam dhīr narapāl
tumh binu asamaṃjas saman ko samarath ehi kāl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Perish the happiness life and religion, in which is no love for Rama's lotus feet That piety be impiety, and wisdom unwisdom, iv which love for Rama is not supreme | Through you men are made happy, and without you they are unhappy; you know the heart of every one. Your commands rule all, and every motion is thoroughly manifest to your benignity. Return now to the hermitage.” The king of saints was over-powered with love. When Rama had bowed and retired, the guru composed himself and went to Janak, and repeated to him what Rama had said, enlarging upon his amiability, affection and excellent disposition: ‘Now
sire, do whatever will be for the advantage of all without prejudice to religion.
O king of _men, you are the wisest among the most wise, the champion of true piety; whosave you can at this time end these troubles? ”’

sections.label: Doha 292
sections.name: राम सत्यब्रत धरम रत सब कर सीलु सनेहु

verses.sa:
सुनि मुनि बचन जनक अनुरागे ।
लखि गति ग्यानु बिरागु बिरागे ॥
verses.tr:
suni muni bacan janak anurāge
lakhi gati gyānu birāgu birāge
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सिथिल सनेहँ गुनत मन माहीं ।
आए इहाँ कीन्ह भल नाही ॥
verses.tr:
sithil saneham̐ gunat man māhīṃ
āe ihām̐ kīnh bhal nāhī

verses.sa:
रामहि रायँ कहेउ बन जाना ।
कीन्ह आपु प्रिय प्रेम प्रवाना ॥
verses.tr:
rāmahi rāyam̐ kaheu ban jānā
kīnh āpu priya prem pravānā

verses.sa:
हम अब बन तें बनहि पठाई ।
प्रमुदित फिरब बिबेक बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
ham ab ban teṃ banahi paṭhāī
pramudit phirab bibek bar̤āī

verses.sa:
तापस मुनि महिसुर सुनि देखी ।
भए प्रेम बस बिकल बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
tāpas muni mahisur suni dekhī
bhae prem bas bikal biseṣī

verses.sa:
समउ समुझि धरि धीरजु राजा ।
चले भरत पहिं सहित समाजा ॥
verses.tr:
samau samujhi dhari dhīraju rājā
cale bharat pahiṃ sahit samājā

verses.sa:
भरत आइ आगें भइ लीन्हे ।
अवसर सरिस सुआसन दीन्हे ॥
verses.tr:
bharat āi āgeṃ bhai līnhe
avasar saris suāsan dīnhe

verses.sa:
तात भरत कह तेरहुति राऊ ।
तुम्हहि बिदित रघुबीर सुभाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
tāt bharat kah terahuti rāū
tumhahi bidit raghubīr subhāū

verses.sa: राम सत्यब्रत धरम रत सब कर सीलु सनेहु ॥
verses.tr: rām satyabrat dharam rat sab kar sīlu sanehu
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: संकट सहत सकोच बस कहिअ जो आयसु देहु ॥
verses.tr: saṃkaṭ sahat sakoc bas kahia jo āyasu dehu

trans: Janak was so moved by the saint's address and by the sight of his agitation that all his philosophy and asceticism were forgotten. Faint with love, he reasoned to himself: “‘Thave not done well in coming here. Dasarath ordered Rama into exile, but himself gave the best proof of his affection; I have now sent him from one wood to another and return io triumph forsooth with increased reputation for wisdom.” Seeing the agitation of the anchorites, saints and Brahmans, the king was still more overcome with emotion; but considering the circumstances he made an effort, and with his retinue set forth to visit Bharat. Bharat advanced to meet him and gave him the best seat the time allowed. ‘Son Bharat,’ said the king of ‘Tirhut, ‘“ you are well acquainted with Rama's character.
He is devoted to truth, a zealot in religion; out of kindness, he endures inconveaience without murmuring; bat if you have any orders to give, speak.”

sections.label: Doha 293
sections.name: राखि राम रुख धरमु ब्रतु पराधीन मोहि जानि

verses.sa:
सुनि तन पुलकि नयन भरि बारी ।
बोले भरतु धीर धरि भारी ॥
verses.tr:
suni tan pulaki nayan bhari bārī
bole bharatu dhīr dhari bhārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
प्रभु प्रिय पूज्य पिता सम आपू ।
कुलगुरु सम हित माय न बापू ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu priya pūjya pitā sam āpū
kulaguru sam hit māya na bāpū

verses.sa:
कौसिकादि मुनि सचिव समाजू ।
ग्यान अंबुनिधि आपुनु आजू ॥
verses.tr:
kausikādi muni saciv samājū
gyān aṃbunidhi āpunu ājū

verses.sa:
सिसु सेवक आयसु अनुगामी ।
जानि मोहि सिख देइअ स्वामी ॥
verses.tr:
sisu sevak āyasu anugāmī
jāni mohi sikh deia svāmī

verses.sa:
एहिं समाज थल बूझब राउर ।
मौन मलिन मैं बोलब बाउर ॥
verses.tr:
ehiṃ samāj thal būjhab rāur
maun malin maiṃ bolab bāur

verses.sa:
छोटे बदन कहउँ बड़ि बाता ।
छमब तात लखि बाम बिधाता ॥
verses.tr:
choṭe badan kahaum̐ bar̤i bātā
chamab tāt lakhi bām bidhātā

verses.sa:
आगम निगम प्रसिद्ध पुराना ।
सेवाधरमु कठिन जगु जाना ॥
verses.tr:
āgam nigam prasiddh purānā
sevādharamu kaṭhin jagu jānā

verses.sa:
स्वामि धरम स्वारथहि बिरोधू ।
बैरु अंध प्रेमहि न प्रबोधू ॥
verses.tr:
svāmi dharam svārathahi birodhū
bairu aṃdh premahi na prabodhū

verses.sa:
राखि राम रुख धरमु ब्रतु पराधीन मोहि जानि ।
सब कें संमत सर्ब हित करिअ पेमु पहिचानि ॥
verses.tr:
rākhi rām rukh dharamu bratu parādhīn mohi jāni
sab keṃ saṃmat sarb hit karia pemu pahicāni
verses.head: दोहा

trans: At this Bharat’s whole frame quivered and his eyes filled with tears; but putting a strong restraint upon himself he replied: ‘My lord, I love and revere you as my father, and hold you as dear as my own family guru; father ‘and mother I have none. Here are Visvamitra and the other sages, and all this assembly; you too yourself, an ocean of wisdom;I am your obedient son and servant: regard me in this light, my lord, and instruct me. In this assembly and at this holy place you enquire of me, and I am to answer, though besmirched of soul and demented. Can I speak great words out of my little mouth? Pardon me, father; the fates are against me. [It is declared in the Vedas, Tantras and Puranas, and all the world knows, that loyal service is difficult. Duty to a master conflicts with self-interest the deaf and blind cannot show their love.
Have regard to Rama’s wishes, so pious as he is, and remember that I am but a servant: do as all approve and as willbe best for all, but forget not their love.”

sections.label: Doha 294
sections.name: रामु सनेह सकोच बस कह ससोच सुरराज

verses.sa:
भरत बचन सुनि देखि सुभाऊ ।
सहित समाज सराहत राऊ ॥
verses.tr:
bharat bacan suni dekhi subhāū
sahit samāj sarāhat rāū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सुगम अगम मृदु मंजु कठोरे ।
अरथु अमित अति आखर थोरे ॥
verses.tr:
sugam agam mṛdu maṃju kaṭhore
arathu amit ati ākhar thore

verses.sa:
ज्यौ मुख मुकुर मुकुरु निज पानी ।
गहि न जाइ अस अदभुत बानी ॥
verses.tr:
jyau mukh mukur mukuru nij pānī
gahi na jāi as adabhut bānī

verses.sa:
भूप भरत मुनि सहित समाजू ।
गे जहँ बिबुध कुमुद द्विजराजू ॥
verses.tr:
bhūp bharat muni sahit samājū
ge jaham̐ bibudh kumud dvijarājū

verses.sa:
सुनि सुधि सोच बिकल सब लोगा ।
मनहुँ मीनगन नव जल जोगा ॥
verses.tr:
suni sudhi soc bikal sab logā
manahum̐ mīnagan nav jal jogā

verses.sa:
देवँ प्रथम कुलगुर गति देखी ।
निरखि बिदेह सनेह बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
devam̐ pratham kulagur gati dekhī
nirakhi bideh saneh biseṣī

verses.sa:
राम भगतिमय भरतु निहारे ।
सुर स्वारथी हहरि हियँ हारे ॥
verses.tr:
rām bhagatimaya bharatu nihāre
sur svārathī hahari hiyam̐ hāre

verses.sa:
सब कोउ राम पेममय पेखा ।
भउ अलेख सोच बस लेखा ॥
verses.tr:
sab kou rām pemamaya pekhā
bhau alekh soc bas lekhā

verses.sa:
रामु सनेह सकोच बस कह ससोच सुरराज ।
रचहु प्रपंचहि पंच मिलि नाहिं त भयउ अकाजु ॥
verses.tr:
rāmu saneh sakoc bas kah sasoc surarāj
racahu prapaṃcahi paṃc mili nāhiṃ ta bhayau akāju
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When tbe king heard Bharat’s speech and witnessed his generosity, he and his court burst out into praises. Simple but profound; soft and delicate but severe; pregnant with meaning in a small compass; his. speech was as mysterious as the shadow of a face in u glass, with no hand can grasp. The king, Bharat, the saint, and all the venerable assembly went to Rama, by whom the gods were made as glad as the lilies by the moon. On hearing the news all the people were as distrest as fish in un-accustomed waters. The gods, seeing first the emotion of the family guru, and then Janak’s exceeding affection, and Bharat so full of devotion to Rama, were sorely anxious and began to despond in their selfishness. The sight of Rama’s kindness made the company of heaven unspeakably dismayed.
Indra cried sadly: Rama is overcome by love and modesty: we must combine to devise some scheme, or else we shall be undone.”

sections.label: Doha 295
sections.name: सुर स्वारथी मलीन मन कीन्ह कुमंत्र कुठाटु

verses.sa:
सुरन्ह सुमिरि सारदा सराही ।
देबि देव सरनागत पाही ॥
verses.tr:
suranh sumiri sāradā sarāhī
debi dev saranāgat pāhī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
फेरि भरत मति करि निज माया ।
पालु बिबुध कुल करि छल छाया ॥
verses.tr:
pheri bharat mati kari nij māyā
pālu bibudh kul kari chal chāyā

verses.sa:
बिबुध बिनय सुनि देबि सयानी ।
बोली सुर स्वारथ जड़ जानी ॥
verses.tr:
bibudh binaya suni debi sayānī
bolī sur svārath jar̤ jānī

verses.sa:
मो सन कहहु भरत मति फेरू ।
लोचन सहस न सूझ सुमेरू ॥
verses.tr:
mo san kahahu bharat mati pherū
locan sahas na sūjh sumerū

verses.sa:
बिधि हरि हर माया बड़ि भारी ।
सोउ न भरत मति सकइ निहारी ॥
verses.tr:
bidhi hari har māyā bar̤i bhārī
sou na bharat mati sakai nihārī

verses.sa:
सो मति मोहि कहत करु भोरी ।
चंदिनि कर कि चंडकर चोरी ॥
verses.tr:
so mati mohi kahat karu bhorī
caṃdini kar ki caṃḍakar corī

verses.sa:
भरत हृदयँ सिय राम निवासू ।
तहँ कि तिमिर जहँ तरनि प्रकासू ॥
verses.tr:
bharat hṛdayam̐ siya rām nivāsū
taham̐ ki timir jaham̐ tarani prakāsū

verses.sa:
अस कहि सारद गइ बिधि लोका ।
बिबुध बिकल निसि मानहुँ कोका ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi sārad gai bidhi lokā
bibudh bikal nisi mānahum̐ kokā

verses.sa: सुर स्वारथी मलीन मन कीन्ह कुमंत्र कुठाटु ॥
verses.tr: sur svārathī malīn man kīnh kumaṃtr kuṭhāṭu
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: रचि प्रपंच माया प्रबल भय भ्रम अरति उचाटु ॥
verses.tr: raci prapaṃc māyā prabal bhaya bhram arati ucāṭu

trans: The gods invoked Sarada in flattering terms: ‘Protect, O goddess, the gods your suppliants. Exert your power of delusion and change Bharat's purpose; by some deceptive artifice rescue the host of heaven.” When the wise goddess heard their prayer, she understood their stupid selfishness and said: ‘you tell me to change Bharat’s purpose; you have a thousand eyes and yet cannot see Mount Meru. The delusive power of Brahma, Vishnu and Siva is exceedingly great, but it cannot see through Bharat’s purpose, and yet you tell me to pervert it. What! can the moonlight rob the moon? Bharat’s heart inhabited by Sita and Rama; can darkness invade the splendour of the sun? So saying, Sa-radi withdrew to Brahma’s heaven, and the gods were as downcast as the chakwa at the approach of night.
The self-seeking gods were troubled at heart and devised artifices of fear, error, sorrow and vexation.

sections.label: Doha 296
sections.name: राम सपथ सुनि मुनि जनकु सकुचे सभा समेत

verses.sa:
करि कुचालि सोचत सुरराजू ।
भरत हाथ सबु काजु अकाजू ॥
verses.tr:
kari kucāli socat surarājū
bharat hāth sabu kāju akājū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
गए जनकु रघुनाथ समीपा ।
सनमाने सब रबिकुल दीपा ॥
verses.tr:
gae janaku raghunāth samīpā
sanamāne sab rabikul dīpā

verses.sa:
समय समाज धरम अबिरोधा ।
बोले तब रघुबंस पुरोधा ॥
verses.tr:
samaya samāj dharam abirodhā
bole tab raghubaṃs purodhā

verses.sa:
जनक भरत संबादु सुनाई ।
भरत कहाउति कही सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
janak bharat saṃbādu sunāī
bharat kahāuti kahī suhāī

verses.sa:
तात राम जस आयसु देहू ।
सो सबु करै मोर मत एहू ॥
verses.tr:
tāt rām jas āyasu dehū
so sabu karai mor mat ehū

verses.sa:
सुनि रघुनाथ जोरि जुग पानी ।
बोले सत्य सरल मृदु बानी ॥
verses.tr:
suni raghunāth jori jug pānī
bole satya saral mṛdu bānī

verses.sa:
बिद्यमान आपुनि मिथिलेसू ।
मोर कहब सब भाँति भदेसू ॥
verses.tr:
bidyamān āpuni mithilesū
mor kahab sab bhām̐ti bhadesū

verses.sa:
राउर राय रजायसु होई ।
राउरि सपथ सही सिर सोई ॥
verses.tr:
rāur rāya rajāyasu hoī
rāuri sapath sahī sir soī

verses.sa:
राम सपथ सुनि मुनि जनकु सकुचे सभा समेत ।
सकल बिलोकत भरत मुखु बनइ न उतरु देत ॥
verses.tr:
rām sapath suni muni janaku sakuce sabhā samet
sakal bilokat bharat mukhu banai na utaru det
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Indra practised this villainy, thinking ‘“ Success or defeat is all. in Bharat’s hands.” When Janak approached tama, the glory of Raghu's line received them all with honour. Then spoke Vasishtha in terms appropriate to the time, the assembly and the principles of religion, mentioning the conversation between Janak and Bharat, and eloquently repeating all that Bharat had urged. ‘Son Rama, any order that you may give, all will obey; this is my conclusion.” Upon this Raghunath, clasping his hands, made truthful and guileless reply in gentle tones: In the presence of yourself, sir, and the king of Mithila, for me to speak is altogether out of place. Whatever command you may be pleased to give I swear by yourself I am ready to comply.”
On hearing Rama’s oath, the saint and Janak and the whole assembly were confounded: and fixed their eyes on Bharat’s face helplessly and without power to answer.

sections.label: Doha 297
sections.name: निरखि बिबेक बिलोचनन्हि सिथिल सनेहँ समाजु

verses.sa:
सभा सकुच बस भरत निहारी ।
रामबंधु धरि धीरजु भारी ॥
verses.tr:
sabhā sakuc bas bharat nihārī
rāmabaṃdhu dhari dhīraju bhārī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कुसमउ देखि सनेहु सँभारा ।
बढ़त बिंधि जिमि घटज निवारा ॥
verses.tr:
kusamau dekhi sanehu sam̐bhārā
bar̤hat biṃdhi jimi ghaṭaj nivārā

verses.sa:
सोक कनकलोचन मति छोनी ।
हरी बिमल गुन गन जगजोनी ॥
verses.tr:
sok kanakalocan mati chonī
harī bimal gun gan jagajonī

verses.sa:
भरत बिबेक बराहँ बिसाला ।
अनायास उधरी तेहि काला ॥
verses.tr:
bharat bibek barāham̐ bisālā
anāyās udharī tehi kālā

verses.sa:
करि प्रनामु सब कहँ कर जोरे ।
रामु राउ गुर साधु निहोरे ॥
verses.tr:
kari pranāmu sab kaham̐ kar jore
rāmu rāu gur sādhu nihore

verses.sa:
छमब आजु अति अनुचित मोरा ।
कहउँ बदन मृदु बचन कठोरा ॥
verses.tr:
chamab āju ati anucit morā
kahaum̐ badan mṛdu bacan kaṭhorā

verses.sa:
हियँ सुमिरी सारदा सुहाई ।
मानस तें मुख पंकज आई ॥
verses.tr:
hiyam̐ sumirī sāradā suhāī
mānas teṃ mukh paṃkaj āī

verses.sa:
बिमल बिबेक धरम नय साली ।
भरत भारती मंजु मराली ॥
verses.tr:
bimal bibek dharam naya sālī
bharat bhāratī maṃju marālī

verses.sa:
निरखि बिबेक बिलोचनन्हि सिथिल सनेहँ समाजु ।
करि प्रनामु बोले भरतु सुमिरि सीय रघुराजु ॥
verses.tr:
nirakhi bibek bilocananhi sithil saneham̐ samāju
kari pranāmu bole bharatu sumiri sīya raghurāju
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Bharat saw the distress of the assembly, and being Rama's brother, put a strong restraint upon himself. Seeing the unfitness of the time, he subdued his emotion, in the same way as Agastya bowed down the Vindhya mountain. Grief like Hiranyaksha carried away his soul us it were the Earth; but at once from his spotless perfection like the womb of the universe came forth the mighty Boar of discretion and wrought immediate deliverance. Clasping his hands, he bowed reverentially to all, to Rama, the king, the guru, and the saints: ‘Pardon me if to-day I act most ua-becomingly and with the tongue of a child speak stubborn words.” Ashe mentally invoked the gracious Sarada, from the depths of his soul there came to his lotus mouth a swan-like strain fraught with pure intelligence, piety and righteousness.
With the eyes of his mind, Bharat saw that the assembly was faint with love; bowing low and invoking Sita and Rama he thus spoke;

sections.label: Doha 298
sections.name: कृपाँ भलाई आपनी नाथ कीन्ह भल मोर

verses.sa:
प्रभु पितु मातु सुह्रद गुर स्वामी ।
पूज्य परम हित अतंरजामी ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu pitu mātu suhrad gur svāmī
pūjya param hit ataṃrajāmī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सरल सुसाहिबु सील निधानू ।
प्रनतपाल सर्बग्य सुजानू ॥
verses.tr:
saral susāhibu sīl nidhānū
pranatapāl sarbagya sujānū

verses.sa:
समरथ सरनागत हितकारी ।
गुनगाहकु अवगुन अघ हारी ॥
verses.tr:
samarath saranāgat hitakārī
gunagāhaku avagun agh hārī

verses.sa:
स्वामि गोसाँइहि सरिस गोसाई ।
मोहि समान मैं साइँ दोहाई ॥
verses.tr:
svāmi gosām̐ihi saris gosāī
mohi samān maiṃ sāim̐ dohāī

verses.sa:
प्रभु पितु बचन मोह बस पेली ।
आयउँ इहाँ समाजु सकेली ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu pitu bacan moh bas pelī
āyaum̐ ihām̐ samāju sakelī

verses.sa:
जग भल पोच ऊँच अरु नीचू ।
अमिअ अमरपद माहुरु मीचू ॥
verses.tr:
jag bhal poc ūm̐c aru nīcū
amia amarapad māhuru mīcū

verses.sa:
राम रजाइ मेट मन माहीं ।
देखा सुना कतहुँ कोउ नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
rām rajāi meṭ man māhīṃ
dekhā sunā katahum̐ kou nāhīṃ

verses.sa:
सो मैं सब बिधि कीन्हि ढिठाई ।
प्रभु मानी सनेह सेवकाई ॥
verses.tr:
so maiṃ sab bidhi kīnhi ḍhiṭhāī
prabhu mānī saneh sevakāī

verses.sa:
कृपाँ भलाई आपनी नाथ कीन्ह भल मोर ।
दूषन भे भूषन सरिस सुजसु चारु चहु ओर ॥
verses.tr:
kṛpām̐ bhalāī āpanī nāth kīnh bhal mor
dūṣan bhe bhūṣan saris sujasu cāru cahu or
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ef My lord is my father and mother, my friend, my guru and my master; object of my adoration, my best benefactor, reader of my heart; the kindest of patrons, the perfection of amiability, the protector of the humble; the all-learned, the all-wise; the powerful befriender of suppliants; quick to appreciate merit and to ignore demerit and wickedness; my sovereign, my god-like God; while no servant can be.so bad asl um. In my infatuation I have come here at the head of ao army, io defiance of the commands of my lord and my father. In the world there are god and vile, high and low, ambrosia and heaven, poison and death; but never have I seen or heard of any one who even in thought could cancel an order of Rama’s. Yet I have been thus contumacious, and my lord in his kindness has taken it as ‘service.
Out of his own mercy and goodness he has made me good; my errors have become adornments and my fair fame has been spread all around.

sections.label: Doha 299
sections.name: यों सुधारि सनमानि जन किए साधु सिरमोर

verses.sa:
राउरि रीति सुबानि बड़ाई ।
जगत बिदित निगमागम गाई ॥
verses.tr:
rāuri rīti subāni bar̤āī
jagat bidit nigamāgam gāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कूर कुटिल खल कुमति कलंकी ।
नीच निसील निरीस निसंकी ॥
verses.tr:
kūr kuṭil khal kumati kalaṃkī
nīc nisīl nirīs nisaṃkī

verses.sa:
तेउ सुनि सरन सामुहें आए ।
सकृत प्रनामु किहें अपनाए ॥
verses.tr:
teu suni saran sāmuheṃ āe
sakṛt pranāmu kiheṃ apanāe

verses.sa:
देखि दोष कबहुँ न उर आने ।
सुनि गुन साधु समाज बखाने ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi doṣ kabahum̐ na ur āne
suni gun sādhu samāj bakhāne

verses.sa:
को साहिब सेवकहि नेवाजी ।
आपु समाज साज सब साजी ॥
verses.tr:
ko sāhib sevakahi nevājī
āpu samāj sāj sab sājī

verses.sa:
निज करतूति न समुझिअ सपनें ।
सेवक सकुच सोचु उर अपनें ॥
verses.tr:
nij karatūti na samujhia sapaneṃ
sevak sakuc socu ur apaneṃ

verses.sa:
सो गोसाइँ नहि दूसर कोपी ।
भुजा उठाइ कहउँ पन रोपी ॥
verses.tr:
so gosāim̐ nahi dūsar kopī
bhujā uṭhāi kahaum̐ pan ropī

verses.sa:
पसु नाचत सुक पाठ प्रबीना ।
गुन गति नट पाठक आधीना ॥
verses.tr:
pasu nācat suk pāṭh prabīnā
gun gati naṭ pāṭhak ādhīnā

verses.sa:
यों सुधारि सनमानि जन किए साधु सिरमोर ।
को कृपाल बिनु पालिहै बिरिदावलि बरजोर ॥
verses.tr:
yoṃ sudhāri sanamāni jan kie sādhu siramor
ko kṛpāl binu pālihai biridāvali barajor
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Your mode of procedure, your gracious, speech, and generosity are known throughout the world; they are sung in the Vedas and Tantras. The cruel, the perverse, the vile, the low-minded, the outcast, the base, the ill-conditioned, the godless, the reckless, so soon as you hear that they have come before you as suppliants and have made a single prostration, are all reckoned as friends. Though you see faults, you never take them to heart; and if you but hear of virtues you proclaim them in the assembly of the saints. What other master is there so kind to his servants, so perfect in all points, who never dreams of reckoning’ up what he has done himself, and is heartily vexed at any embarrassment of his servants. He is my sovereign lord, and there is none other, with arms upraised, I declare on oath. A beast may dance and a parrot be a clever talker; but all depends upon the music of the dancing-master and the method of the teacher.

Who now has corrected his servant and treated him with honour, and made him the crown of the head of the just. Who is there, save the all-merciful, who, whether we will or 00, maintains our fair fame?

sections.label: Doha 300
sections.name: सुह्रद सुजान सुसाहिबहि बहुत कहब बड़ि खोरि

verses.sa:
सोक सनेहँ कि बाल सुभाएँ ।
आयउँ लाइ रजायसु बाएँ ॥
verses.tr:
sok saneham̐ ki bāl subhāem̐
āyaum̐ lāi rajāyasu bāem̐
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
तबहुँ कृपाल हेरि निज ओरा ।
सबहि भाँति भल मानेउ मोरा ॥
verses.tr:
tabahum̐ kṛpāl heri nij orā
sabahi bhām̐ti bhal māneu morā

verses.sa:
देखेउँ पाय सुमंगल मूला ।
जानेउँ स्वामि सहज अनुकूला ॥
verses.tr:
dekheum̐ pāya sumaṃgal mūlā
jāneum̐ svāmi sahaj anukūlā

verses.sa:
बड़ें समाज बिलोकेउँ भागू ।
बड़ीं चूक साहिब अनुरागू ॥
verses.tr:
bar̤eṃ samāj bilokeum̐ bhāgū
bar̤īṃ cūk sāhib anurāgū

verses.sa:
कृपा अनुग्रह अंगु अघाई ।
कीन्हि कृपानिधि सब अधिकाई ॥
verses.tr:
kṛpā anugrah aṃgu aghāī
kīnhi kṛpānidhi sab adhikāī

verses.sa:
राखा मोर दुलार गोसाईं ।
अपनें सील सुभायँ भलाईं ॥
verses.tr:
rākhā mor dulār gosāīṃ
apaneṃ sīl subhāyam̐ bhalāīṃ

verses.sa:
नाथ निपट मैं कीन्हि ढिठाई ।
स्वामि समाज सकोच बिहाई ॥
verses.tr:
nāth nipaṭ maiṃ kīnhi ḍhiṭhāī
svāmi samāj sakoc bihāī

verses.sa:
अबिनय बिनय जथारुचि बानी ।
छमिहि देउ अति आरति जानी ॥
verses.tr:
abinaya binaya jathāruci bānī
chamihi deu ati ārati jānī

verses.sa:
सुह्रद सुजान सुसाहिबहि बहुत कहब बड़ि खोरि ।
आयसु देइअ देव अब सबइ सुधारी मोरि ॥
verses.tr:
suhrad sujān susāhibahi bahut kahab bar̤i khori
āyasu deia dev ab sabai sudhārī mori
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Whether it was from grief d affection or from mere childishness that I came here in despite of your commands, you in your compassion have.looked upon measa friend and in every way taken it in good part. Seeing your blessed feet and knowing my lord’s natural benignity, I look upon this great assembly as a piece of good fortune, and my great sin as evidence of my lord’s kindness; for by his gracious favour he has satisfied my whole being and his compassion has exceeded everything. Out of the goodness of his own disposition my good lord has made saro of my fidelity. | have now displayed great andacity in discarding respect for this august assembly and speaking boldly or humbly, just as the fancy moved me; but pardon me, sire, for I am in grievous perplexity.
It isa great mistake to say too much to a true friend or really wise man or good master. Be pleased, sire, to give your commands and set me all right. _

sections.label: Doha 301
sections.name: देखि दुखारी दीन दुहु समाज नर नारि सब

verses.sa:
प्रभु पद पदुम पराग दोहाई ।
सत्य सुकृत सुख सीवँ सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu pad padum parāg dohāī
satya sukṛt sukh sīvam̐ suhāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सो करि कहउँ हिए अपने की ।
रुचि जागत सोवत सपने की ॥
verses.tr:
so kari kahaum̐ hie apane kī
ruci jāgat sovat sapane kī

verses.sa:
सहज सनेहँ स्वामि सेवकाई ।
स्वारथ छल फल चारि बिहाई ॥
verses.tr:
sahaj saneham̐ svāmi sevakāī
svārath chal phal cāri bihāī

verses.sa:
अग्या सम न सुसाहिब सेवा ।
सो प्रसादु जन पावै देवा ॥
verses.tr:
agyā sam na susāhib sevā
so prasādu jan pāvai devā

verses.sa:
अस कहि प्रेम बिबस भए भारी ।
पुलक सरीर बिलोचन बारी ॥
verses.tr:
as kahi prem bibas bhae bhārī
pulak sarīr bilocan bārī

verses.sa:
प्रभु पद कमल गहे अकुलाई ।
समउ सनेहु न सो कहि जाई ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu pad kamal gahe akulāī
samau sanehu na so kahi jāī

verses.sa:
कृपासिंधु सनमानि सुबानी ।
बैठाए समीप गहि पानी ॥
verses.tr:
kṛpāsiṃdhu sanamāni subānī
baiṭhāe samīp gahi pānī

verses.sa:
भरत बिनय सुनि देखि सुभाऊ ।
सिथिल सनेहँ सभा रघुराऊ ॥
verses.tr:
bharat binaya suni dekhi subhāū
sithil saneham̐ sabhā raghurāū

verses.sa:
रघुराउ सिथिल सनेहँ साधु समाज मुनि मिथिला धनी ।
मन महुँ सराहत भरत भायप भगति की महिमा घनी ॥
verses.tr:
raghurāu sithil saneham̐ sādhu samāj muni mithilā dhanī
man mahum̐ sarāhat bharat bhāyap bhagati kī mahimā ghanī
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
भरतहि प्रसंसत बिबुध बरषत सुमन मानस मलिन से ।
तुलसी बिकल सब लोग सुनि सकुचे निसागम नलिन से ॥
verses.tr:
bharatahi prasaṃsat bibudh baraṣat suman mānas malin se
tulasī bikal sab log suni sakuce nisāgam nalin se

verses.sa:
देखि दुखारी दीन दुहु समाज नर नारि सब ।
मघवा महा मलीन मुए मारि मंगल चहत ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi dukhārī dīn duhu samāj nar nāri sab
maghavā mahā malīn mue māri maṃgal cahat
verses.head: दोहा

trans: I swear by the dust of my lord’s lotus feet, the glorious consummation of truth, virtue and happiness; with an oath I protest that the desire of my soul, whether waking, sleeping or dreaming, is to serve my lord with spontaneous devotion, without any regard to self-interest, fraud, or my own ends in this life or the next. There is no duty so imperative as submission; let your servant, sire, obtain this favour.” So saying he was utterly overwhelmed with emotion; his body quivered, his eyes filled with tears, and in great agitation he clasped his lord’s lotus feet. So pathetic a scene defies description. The Ocean of compassion honoured him with gracious words and took him by the hand and seated him by his side; while himself and all the assembly were faint with love, after hearing Bharat’s prayer and seeing his noble nature.

Raghareo himself, the august assembly, the saint, the king of Mithila, all were faint with love, and mentally applauded the exceeding greatness of Bharat’s brotherly affection and devotedness. The gods too commended Bharat and rained down flowers, though with a heavy heart. Every one, says Tulsi, was as distrest by what he had heard, as the lotus that withers at the approach of night.
Seeing every man and woman in both assemblies so grieved and downcast, Indra, vile wretch, still sought his own happiness, killing as it were the already dead.

sections.label: Doha 302
sections.name: भरतु जनकु मुनिजन सचिव साधु सचेत बिहाइ

verses.sa:
कपट कुचालि सीवँ सुरराजू ।
पर अकाज प्रिय आपन काजू ॥
verses.tr:
kapaṭ kucāli sīvam̐ surarājū
par akāj priya āpan kājū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
काक समान पाकरिपु रीती ।
छली मलीन कतहुँ न प्रतीती ॥
verses.tr:
kāk samān pākaripu rītī
chalī malīn katahum̐ na pratītī

verses.sa:
प्रथम कुमत करि कपटु सँकेला ।
सो उचाटु सब कें सिर मेला ॥
verses.tr:
pratham kumat kari kapaṭu sam̐kelā
so ucāṭu sab keṃ sir melā

verses.sa:
सुरमायाँ सब लोग बिमोहे ।
राम प्रेम अतिसय न बिछोहे ॥
verses.tr:
suramāyām̐ sab log bimohe
rām prem atisaya na bichohe

verses.sa:
भय उचाट बस मन थिर नाहीं ।
छन बन रुचि छन सदन सोहाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bhaya ucāṭ bas man thir nāhīṃ
chan ban ruci chan sadan sohāhīṃ

verses.sa:
दुबिध मनोगति प्रजा दुखारी ।
सरित सिंधु संगम जनु बारी ॥
verses.tr:
dubidh manogati prajā dukhārī
sarit siṃdhu saṃgam janu bārī

verses.sa:
दुचित कतहुँ परितोषु न लहहीं ।
एक एक सन मरमु न कहहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ducit katahum̐ paritoṣu na lahahīṃ
ek ek san maramu na kahahīṃ

verses.sa:
लखि हियँ हँसि कह कृपानिधानू ।
सरिस स्वान मघवान जुबानू ॥
verses.tr:
lakhi hiyam̐ ham̐si kah kṛpānidhānū
saris svān maghavān jubānū

verses.sa:
भरतु जनकु मुनिजन सचिव साधु सचेत बिहाइ ।
लागि देवमाया सबहि जथाजोगु जनु पाइ ॥
verses.tr:
bharatu janaku munijan saciv sādhu sacet bihāi
lāgi devamāyā sabahi jathājogu janu pāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Though king of the gods, there is no limit to his deceit-fnlness and villainy; he loves another’s loss and his own gain; Pakaripu’s ways are like those of a crow—crafty, disreputable and with no faith inany one. Having in the first instance formed an evil design and accumulated deceits, he piled up trouble on the heads of all. Every one was infatuated by the god's delusive power;-their love for Rama was so violent that they would not be separated from him. They were all distracted; with nothing settled in their mind; at one moment longing for the woods,at another anxious to return home. The people in their distress had the current of their ideas as divided us the water at the confluence of a river with the sea. ‘Thus wavering in mind they got no comfort in any quarter; no one told another his secret thoughts. Seeing this, the Ocean of compassion smiled to himself and said: “Indra is like a dog in his ways.” i Dohd 290.

sections.label: Doha 303
sections.name: भरत बिमल जसु बिमल बिधु सुमति चकोरकुमारि

verses.sa:
कृपासिंधु लखि लोग दुखारे ।
निज सनेहँ सुरपति छल भारे ॥
verses.tr:
kṛpāsiṃdhu lakhi log dukhāre
nij saneham̐ surapati chal bhāre
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सभा राउ गुर महिसुर मंत्री ।
भरत भगति सब कै मति जंत्री ॥
verses.tr:
sabhā rāu gur mahisur maṃtrī
bharat bhagati sab kai mati jaṃtrī

verses.sa:
रामहि चितवत चित्र लिखे से ।
सकुचत बोलत बचन सिखे से ॥
verses.tr:
rāmahi citavat citr likhe se
sakucat bolat bacan sikhe se

verses.sa:
भरत प्रीति नति बिनय बड़ाई ।
सुनत सुखद बरनत कठिनाई ॥
verses.tr:
bharat prīti nati binaya bar̤āī
sunat sukhad baranat kaṭhināī

verses.sa:
जासु बिलोकि भगति लवलेसू ।
प्रेम मगन मुनिगन मिथिलेसू ॥
verses.tr:
jāsu biloki bhagati lavalesū
prem magan munigan mithilesū

verses.sa:
महिमा तासु कहै किमि तुलसी ।
भगति सुभायँ सुमति हियँ हुलसी ॥
verses.tr:
mahimā tāsu kahai kimi tulasī
bhagati subhāyam̐ sumati hiyam̐ hulasī

verses.sa:
आपु छोटि महिमा बड़ि जानी ।
कबिकुल कानि मानि सकुचानी ॥
verses.tr:
āpu choṭi mahimā bar̤i jānī
kabikul kāni māni sakucānī

verses.sa:
कहि न सकति गुन रुचि अधिकाई ।
मति गति बाल बचन की नाई ॥
verses.tr:
kahi na sakati gun ruci adhikāī
mati gati bāl bacan kī nāī

verses.sa:
भरत बिमल जसु बिमल बिधु सुमति चकोरकुमारि ।
उदित बिमल जन हृदय नभ एकटक रही निहारि ॥
verses.tr:
bharat bimal jasu bimal bidhu sumati cakorakumāri
udit bimal jan hṛdaya nabh ekaṭak rahī nihāri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Excepting Bharat, Janak, the saints, the ministers and the more intelligent nobles, the heaven sent delusion took effect upon all, according to the circumstances of the individual.

The Ocean of compassion saw the people distrest by their love and hy Indra’s potent deception; the assembly, the king, the guru, the Brahmans and the ministers, all with their hearts under the spell of Bharat’s devotion; motionless as pictures, gazing upon lama, nervously uttering words which they seemed to have learnt by rote. The eulogy of Bharat’s affection and constant humility is delightful to hear, but difficult to pronounce. Seeing only the tiniest morsel of his devotion, the saints and the king of Mithila were absorbed in love; bow then can I, Tulsi, tell its greatness? It is only by the blessing of faith that the ambitious design of my heart has prospered. I am little; I know the enormous greatness of my subject, and | shrink in confusion before a crowd of other poets; unable to utter the vehemence of my passionate love for his perfection, the motions of my fancy are like the stammerings of a child.
Bharat’s bright fame isas the bright moon rising in the bright sky of a faithful heart,ever intently watched by my daring fancy as by an unfledged partridge.

sections.label: Doha 304
sections.name: करम बचन मानस बिमल तुम्ह समान तुम्ह तात

verses.sa:
भरत सुभाउ न सुगम निगमहूँ ।
लघु मति चापलता कबि छमहूँ ॥
verses.tr:
bharat subhāu na sugam nigamahūm̐
laghu mati cāpalatā kabi chamahūm̐
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कहत सुनत सति भाउ भरत को ।
सीय राम पद होइ न रत को ॥
verses.tr:
kahat sunat sati bhāu bharat ko
sīya rām pad hoi na rat ko

verses.sa:
सुमिरत भरतहि प्रेमु राम को ।
जेहि न सुलभ तेहि सरिस बाम को ॥
verses.tr:
sumirat bharatahi premu rām ko
jehi na sulabh tehi saris bām ko

verses.sa:
देखि दयाल दसा सबही की ।
राम सुजान जानि जन जी की ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi dayāl dasā sabahī kī
rām sujān jāni jan jī kī

verses.sa:
धरम धुरीन धीर नय नागर ।
सत्य सनेह सील सुख सागर ॥
verses.tr:
dharam dhurīn dhīr naya nāgar
satya saneh sīl sukh sāgar

verses.sa:
देसु काल लखि समउ समाजू ।
नीति प्रीति पालक रघुराजू ॥
verses.tr:
desu kāl lakhi samau samājū
nīti prīti pālak raghurājū

verses.sa:
बोले बचन बानि सरबसु से ।
हित परिनाम सुनत ससि रसु से ॥
verses.tr:
bole bacan bāni sarabasu se
hit parinām sunat sasi rasu se

verses.sa:
तात भरत तुम्ह धरम धुरीना ।
लोक बेद बिद प्रेम प्रबीना ॥
verses.tr:
tāt bharat tumh dharam dhurīnā
lok bed bid prem prabīnā

verses.sa:
करम बचन मानस बिमल तुम्ह समान तुम्ह तात ।
गुर समाज लघु बंधु गुन कुसमयँ किमि कहि जात ॥
verses.tr:
karam bacan mānas bimal tumh samān tumh tāt
gur samāj laghu baṃdhu gun kusamayam̐ kimi kahi jāt
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Bharat’s generosity is scarce fathomable by the Vedas; pardon, ye poets, the frivolities of my poor wit. Who, that hears or tells of Bharat’s perfect nature, does not become enamoured of the feet of Sita and Rama? Whoever invokes Bharat and still finds love for Rama a difficult matter is a monster without a parallel. Seeing the state that every one was in, the merciful and all-wise’ Rama, who knows their devotion to him, being the staunch champion of religion, a master of policy, an ocean of truth and love and amiability and everything good, having considered the place and circumstances, the time and assembly, Raghuraj, the muin-tainer of justice and affection, delivered a speech, the quintessence «£ eloquence, grateful as ambrosia at the time of hearing, and salutary also in the end; “Brother Bharat, you are the champion of righteousness, perfectly conversant with all the laws of the world and the Vedas;
For purity of thought, word and act, your only equal, brother, is yourself. In this venerable assembly and in such distressing circumstances how can all the virtues of my younger brother he told? i

sections.label: Doha 305
sections.name: राज काज सब लाज पति धरम धरनि धन धाम

verses.sa:
जानहु तात तरनि कुल रीती ।
सत्यसंध पितु कीरति प्रीती ॥
verses.tr:
jānahu tāt tarani kul rītī
satyasaṃdh pitu kīrati prītī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
समउ समाजु लाज गुरुजन की ।
उदासीन हित अनहित मन की ॥
verses.tr:
samau samāju lāj gurujan kī
udāsīn hit anahit man kī

verses.sa:
तुम्हहि बिदित सबही कर करमू ।
आपन मोर परम हित धरमू ॥
verses.tr:
tumhahi bidit sabahī kar karamū
āpan mor param hit dharamū

verses.sa:
मोहि सब भाँति भरोस तुम्हारा ।
तदपि कहउँ अवसर अनुसारा ॥
verses.tr:
mohi sab bhām̐ti bharos tumhārā
tadapi kahaum̐ avasar anusārā

verses.sa:
तात तात बिनु बात हमारी ।
केवल गुरुकुल कृपाँ सँभारी ॥
verses.tr:
tāt tāt binu bāt hamārī
keval gurukul kṛpām̐ sam̐bhārī

verses.sa:
नतरु प्रजा परिजन परिवारू ।
हमहि सहित सबु होत खुआरू ॥
verses.tr:
nataru prajā parijan parivārū
hamahi sahit sabu hot khuārū

verses.sa:
जौं बिनु अवसर अथवँ दिनेसू ।
जग केहि कहहु न होइ कलेसू ॥
verses.tr:
jauṃ binu avasar athavam̐ dinesū
jag kehi kahahu na hoi kalesū

verses.sa:
तस उतपातु तात बिधि कीन्हा ।
मुनि मिथिलेस राखि सबु लीन्हा ॥
verses.tr:
tas utapātu tāt bidhi kīnhā
muni mithiles rākhi sabu līnhā

verses.sa:
