राज काज सब लाज पति धरम धरनि धन धाम ।
गुर प्रभाउ पालिहि सबहि भल होइहि परिनाम ॥
verses.tr:
rāj kāj sab lāj pati dharam dharani dhan dhām
gur prabhāu pālihi sabahi bhal hoihi parinām
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Brother, you know the custom of the Solar race and the renown and the affection of our father, that Ocean of truth; the circumstances of the time and of this assembly, the reverence due to these venerable personages, and the secret thoughts of all men, whether they be indifferent, or friends, or unfriends, are understood by you, as also your own highest gain and mine and the requirements of religion. I have entire confidence in youand yet I speak us ¢the circumstances suggest. My words, brother, in be ‘absence of ‘my father, have been kept straight only by the favour of our guru; otherwise all my subjects, together with the citizens, the people of the palace and myself, would have been undone. If the lord of day sets at-the wrong time, tell me, will not the whole world be in confusion? Such trouble brother, fate had ordained; but the saint and the king of Mithila have averted it.
The State; our honour and fair name; Religion; oar land, wealth and homes; all have been defended by the power of the guru; and everything will be well in the end.

sections.label: Doha 306
sections.name: सेवक कर पद नयन से मुख सो साहिबु होइ

verses.sa:
सहित समाज तुम्हार हमारा ।
घर बन गुर प्रसाद रखवारा ॥
verses.tr:
sahit samāj tumhār hamārā
ghar ban gur prasād rakhavārā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मातु पिता गुर स्वामि निदेसू ।
सकल धरम धरनीधर सेसू ॥
verses.tr:
mātu pitā gur svāmi nidesū
sakal dharam dharanīdhar sesū

verses.sa:
सो तुम्ह करहु करावहु मोहू ।
तात तरनिकुल पालक होहू ॥
verses.tr:
so tumh karahu karāvahu mohū
tāt taranikul pālak hohū

verses.sa:
साधक एक सकल सिधि देनी ।
कीरति सुगति भूतिमय बेनी ॥
verses.tr:
sādhak ek sakal sidhi denī
kīrati sugati bhūtimaya benī

verses.sa:
सो बिचारि सहि संकटु भारी ।
करहु प्रजा परिवारु सुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
so bicāri sahi saṃkaṭu bhārī
karahu prajā parivāru sukhārī

verses.sa:
बाँटी बिपति सबहिं मोहि भाई ।
तुम्हहि अवधि भरि बड़ि कठिनाई ॥
verses.tr:
bām̐ṭī bipati sabahiṃ mohi bhāī
tumhahi avadhi bhari bar̤i kaṭhināī

verses.sa:
जानि तुम्हहि मृदु कहउँ कठोरा ।
कुसमयँ तात न अनुचित मोरा ॥
verses.tr:
jāni tumhahi mṛdu kahaum̐ kaṭhorā
kusamayam̐ tāt na anucit morā

verses.sa:
होहिं कुठायँ सुबंधु सुहाए ।
ओड़िअहिं हाथ असनिहु के घाए ॥
verses.tr:
hohiṃ kuṭhāyam̐ subaṃdhu suhāe
or̤iahiṃ hāth asanihu ke ghāe

verses.sa:
सेवक कर पद नयन से मुख सो साहिबु होइ ।
तुलसी प्रीति कि रीति सुनि सुकबि सराहहिं सोइ ॥
verses.tr:
sevak kar pad nayan se mukh so sāhibu hoi
tulasī prīti ki rīti suni sukabi sarāhahiṃ soi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: My followers and yours, the palace and the forest, are both protected by his favour. The order of a father or mother, a guru or a. master, is like Seshnag, the supporter of a whole world of righteousness. Obey it yourself, brother, and let me obey it, and thus become a protector of all the Solar race. Obedience is the one means for the attainment of every success, a triple flood of Glory, Salvation and Power. Having thus reflected, endure the grievous burden and make your people and family happy. 1 have distributed my afflictions amongst you all; but upon you is the full weight of the greatest difficulty. Ikavow your tenderness, though I speak so harshly; the times. brother, are out of joint; the fault is not mine. In an emergency a brother is used for a shield, in the same way as the stroke of & sword is parried by the hand.”’
A servant is like a hand, or foot, or eye;a master is like the head. [Hearing this description of love, say Tulsi, the greatest poets are full of admiratiun.

sections.label: Doha 307
sections.name: देव देव अभिषेक हित गुर अनुसासनु पाइ

verses.sa:
सभा सकल सुनि रघुबर बानी ।
प्रेम पयोधि अमिअ जनु सानी ॥
verses.tr:
sabhā sakal suni raghubar bānī
prem payodhi amia janu sānī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सिथिल समाज सनेह समाधी ।
देखि दसा चुप सारद साधी ॥
verses.tr:
sithil samāj saneh samādhī
dekhi dasā cup sārad sādhī

verses.sa:
भरतहि भयउ परम संतोषू ।
सनमुख स्वामि बिमुख दुख दोषू ॥
verses.tr:
bharatahi bhayau param saṃtoṣū
sanamukh svāmi bimukh dukh doṣū

verses.sa:
मुख प्रसन्न मन मिटा बिषादू ।
भा जनु गूँगेहि गिरा प्रसादू ॥
verses.tr:
mukh prasann man miṭā biṣādū
bhā janu gūm̐gehi girā prasādū

verses.sa:
कीन्ह सप्रेम प्रनामु बहोरी ।
बोले पानि पंकरुह जोरी ॥
verses.tr:
kīnh saprem pranāmu bahorī
bole pāni paṃkaruh jorī

verses.sa:
नाथ भयउ सुखु साथ गए को ।
लहेउँ लाहु जग जनमु भए को ॥
verses.tr:
nāth bhayau sukhu sāth gae ko
laheum̐ lāhu jag janamu bhae ko

verses.sa:
अब कृपाल जस आयसु होई ।
करौं सीस धरि सादर सोई ॥
verses.tr:
ab kṛpāl jas āyasu hoī
karauṃ sīs dhari sādar soī

verses.sa:
सो अवलंब देव मोहि देई ।
अवधि पारु पावौं जेहि सेई ॥
verses.tr:
so avalaṃb dev mohi deī
avadhi pāru pāvauṃ jehi seī

verses.sa:
देव देव अभिषेक हित गुर अनुसासनु पाइ ।
आनेउँ सब तीरथ सलिलु तेहि कहँ काह रजाइ ॥
verses.tr:
dev dev abhiṣek hit gur anusāsanu pāi
āneum̐ sab tīrath salilu tehi kaham̐ kāh rajāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: When they heard Raghubar’s speech, imbued as it were with the nectar of an ocean of tenderness, the whole assembly became lost in an overpowering trance of love. Sarada herself was struck dumb at the sight of them. Bharat was immensely consoled by the graciousness of his lord and his putting away of every trouble and wrong-doing. Cheerful of aspect and with the grief of his soul effaced, he seemed like « dumb man who has received the gift of speech. A tionately bowing again and again and folding his lotus hands, he thus spoke: “My lord, I am as happy as if I had gone with you; I have reaped the reward of being born into the world. Now, O merciful sire, whatever may be your order, that will I dutifully and reverently obey. But, sire, grant ine some support, by the help of which I may struggle on to the end of the time.
In compliance with the guru's command, sire, I have brought here water from all holy places for the purpose of your royal inauguration: what are your orders concerning it? Chaupdi.

sections.label: Doha 308
sections.name: भरत राम संबादु सुनि सकल सुमंगल मूल

verses.sa:
एकु मनोरथु बड़ मन माहीं ।
सभयँ सकोच जात कहि नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
eku manorathu bar̤ man māhīṃ
sabhayam̐ sakoc jāt kahi nāhīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कहहु तात प्रभु आयसु पाई ।
बोले बानि सनेह सुहाई ॥
verses.tr:
kahahu tāt prabhu āyasu pāī
bole bāni saneh suhāī

verses.sa:
चित्रकूट सुचि थल तीरथ बन ।
खग मृग सर सरि निर्झर गिरिगन ॥
verses.tr:
citrakūṭ suci thal tīrath ban
khag mṛg sar sari nirjhar girigan

verses.sa:
प्रभु पद अंकित अवनि बिसेषी ।
आयसु होइ त आवौं देखी ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu pad aṃkit avani biseṣī
āyasu hoi ta āvauṃ dekhī

verses.sa:
अवसि अत्रि आयसु सिर धरहू ।
तात बिगतभय कानन चरहू ॥
verses.tr:
avasi atri āyasu sir dharahū
tāt bigatabhaya kānan carahū

verses.sa:
मुनि प्रसाद बनु मंगल दाता ।
पावन परम सुहावन भ्राता ॥
verses.tr:
muni prasād banu maṃgal dātā
pāvan param suhāvan bhrātā

verses.sa:
रिषिनायकु जहँ आयसु देहीं ।
राखेहु तीरथ जलु थल तेहीं ॥
verses.tr:
riṣināyaku jaham̐ āyasu dehīṃ
rākhehu tīrath jalu thal tehīṃ

verses.sa:
सुनि प्रभु बचन भरत सुख पावा ।
मुनि पद कमल मुदित सिरु नावा ॥
verses.tr:
suni prabhu bacan bharat sukh pāvā
muni pad kamal mudit siru nāvā

verses.sa:
भरत राम संबादु सुनि सकल सुमंगल मूल ।
सुर स्वारथी सराहि कुल बरषत सुरतरु फूल ॥
verses.tr:
bharat rām saṃbādu suni sakal sumaṃgal mūl
sur svārathī sarāhi kul baraṣat surataru phūl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: I have one great desire at heart, but for fear and shame I cannot tell it.” ‘Tell me what it is, brother,” Upon this his lord’s command, he replied in affectionate and winning terms: ‘With your permission I would goand see Chitrakut with all its hermitages, shrines and woods, its birds and beasts, its ponds and streams, its waterfalls and rocks, and the apot so specially marked with the prints of my lord’s feet.” ‘Certainly, brother: only obtain Atri’s permission, and then wander without fear through the woods. It is the saint’s blessing, brother, that makes the forest so auspicious, holy and exquisitely beautiful. In whatever place the king of sagesmay direct, there deposit the holy water.” On hearing his lord’s words, Bharat was glad and joyfully bowed his head to the saint's lotus feet.
The selfish gods, when they heard this most delightful conversation between Bharat and Rama, praised the whole family and rapturously showered down flowers upon them.

sections.label: Doha 309
sections.name: अत्रि कहेउ तब भरत सन सैल समीप सुकूप

verses.sa:
धन्य भरत जय राम गोसाईं ।
कहत देव हरषत बरिआई ॥
verses.tr:
dhanya bharat jaya rām gosāīṃ
kahat dev haraṣat bariāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
मुनि मिथिलेस सभाँ सब काहू ।
भरत बचन सुनि भयउ उछाहू ॥
verses.tr:
muni mithiles sabhām̐ sab kāhū
bharat bacan suni bhayau uchāhū

verses.sa:
भरत राम गुन ग्राम सनेहू ।
पुलकि प्रसंसत राउ बिदेहू ॥
verses.tr:
bharat rām gun grām sanehū
pulaki prasaṃsat rāu bidehū

verses.sa:
सेवक स्वामि सुभाउ सुहावन ।
नेमु पेमु अति पावन पावन ॥
verses.tr:
sevak svāmi subhāu suhāvan
nemu pemu ati pāvan pāvan

verses.sa:
मति अनुसार सराहन लागे ।
सचिव सभासद सब अनुरागे ॥
verses.tr:
mati anusār sarāhan lāge
saciv sabhāsad sab anurāge

verses.sa:
सुनि सुनि राम भरत संबादू ।
दुहु समाज हियँ हरषु बिषादू ॥
verses.tr:
suni suni rām bharat saṃbādū
duhu samāj hiyam̐ haraṣu biṣādū

verses.sa:
राम मातु दुखु सुखु सम जानी ।
कहि गुन राम प्रबोधीं रानी ॥
verses.tr:
rām mātu dukhu sukhu sam jānī
kahi gun rām prabodhīṃ rānī

verses.sa:
एक कहहिं रघुबीर बड़ाई ।
एक सराहत भरत भलाई ॥
verses.tr:
ek kahahiṃ raghubīr bar̤āī
ek sarāhat bharat bhalāī

verses.sa:
अत्रि कहेउ तब भरत सन सैल समीप सुकूप ।
राखिअ तीरथ तोय तहँ पावन अमिअ अनूप ॥
verses.tr:
atri kaheu tab bharat san sail samīp sukūp
rākhia tīrath toya taham̐ pāvan amia anūp
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “Blessed be Bharat and glory to our lord Rama,”’ cried the gods in their irrepressible delight. The saint, the king of Mithila and every one in the assembly rejoiced on hearing Bharat’s speech. King Videha broke out into ecstatic praises of the many virtues and the affection both of Bharat and Rama; master and servant of equally charming disposition, there fidelity and love the purest of the pure. The ministers too and all the spectators affectionately extolled them, us each best could. In both camps there was blended joy and sorrow, when they heard the conversation between lia4ma, Bharat and the saint. Rama’s mother, feeling pleasure and pain equally balanced, exhorted the “queens, reckoning up both good and evil. One would magnify Rama, another would praise Bharat's amiability.
Then said Atri to Bharat: ‘There isa fine well near the hill; there deposit the holy water, pure, unsullied, incomparable.”.

sections.label: Doha 310
sections.name: कहत कूप महिमा सकल गए जहाँ रघुराउ

verses.sa:
भरत अत्रि अनुसासन पाई ।
जल भाजन सब दिए चलाई ॥
verses.tr:
bharat atri anusāsan pāī
jal bhājan sab die calāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
सानुज आपु अत्रि मुनि साधू ।
सहित गए जहँ कूप अगाधू ॥
verses.tr:
sānuj āpu atri muni sādhū
sahit gae jaham̐ kūp agādhū

verses.sa:
पावन पाथ पुन्यथल राखा ।
प्रमुदित प्रेम अत्रि अस भाषा ॥
verses.tr:
pāvan pāth punyathal rākhā
pramudit prem atri as bhāṣā

verses.sa:
तात अनादि सिद्ध थल एहू ।
लोपेउ काल बिदित नहिं केहू ॥
verses.tr:
tāt anādi siddh thal ehū
lopeu kāl bidit nahiṃ kehū

verses.sa:
तब सेवकन्ह सरस थलु देखा ।
किन्ह सुजल हित कूप बिसेषा ॥
verses.tr:
tab sevakanh saras thalu dekhā
kinh sujal hit kūp biseṣā

verses.sa:
बिधि बस भयउ बिस्व उपकारू ।
सुगम अगम अति धरम बिचारू ॥
verses.tr:
bidhi bas bhayau bisv upakārū
sugam agam ati dharam bicārū

verses.sa:
भरतकूप अब कहिहहिं लोगा ।
अति पावन तीरथ जल जोगा ॥
verses.tr:
bharatakūp ab kahihahiṃ logā
ati pāvan tīrath jal jogā

verses.sa:
प्रेम सनेम निमज्जत प्रानी ।
होइहहिं बिमल करम मन बानी ॥
verses.tr:
prem sanem nimajjat prānī
hoihahiṃ bimal karam man bānī

verses.sa:
कहत कूप महिमा सकल गए जहाँ रघुराउ ।
अत्रि सुनायउ रघुबरहि तीरथ पुन्य प्रभाउ ॥
verses.tr:
kahat kūp mahimā sakal gae jahām̐ raghurāu
atri sunāyau raghubarahi tīrath punya prabhāu
verses.head: दोहा

trans: On receiving Atri’s command, Bharat despatched all the water vessels, and himself with Satrughna, the saint and elders, went to the deep well. There he poured out the holy water on that sacred spot; and Atri in a rapture of affection thus spoke: ‘“ Son, this has been a holy place from all eternity; but time had obscured it, and it was known to no one, till my servants, seeing the spot to be a desirable one, made this great well for the sake of a good supply of water. By the decree of fate the whole universe has been benefited, and a merit most difficult to compass has been rendered easy. People will now call it Bharat’s well, hallowed in a special degree by the combination in it of the water of all holy places. Every one who lovingly and religiously bathes init, will be made pure in thought, word and act.”
All then went to Raghunath, telling the virtue of the well; and Atri explained to him the blessed efficacy of holy places,

sections.label: Doha 311
sections.name: सुलभ सिद्धि सब प्राकृतहु राम कहत जमुहात

verses.sa:
कहत धरम इतिहास सप्रीती ।
भयउ भोरु निसि सो सुख बीती ॥
verses.tr:
kahat dharam itihās saprītī
bhayau bhoru nisi so sukh bītī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नित्य निबाहि भरत दोउ भाई ।
राम अत्रि गुर आयसु पाई ॥
verses.tr:
nitya nibāhi bharat dou bhāī
rām atri gur āyasu pāī

verses.sa:
सहित समाज साज सब सादें ।
चले राम बन अटन पयादें ॥
verses.tr:
sahit samāj sāj sab sādeṃ
cale rām ban aṭan payādeṃ

verses.sa:
कोमल चरन चलत बिनु पनहीं ।
भइ मृदु भूमि सकुचि मन मनहीं ॥
verses.tr:
komal caran calat binu panahīṃ
bhai mṛdu bhūmi sakuci man manahīṃ

verses.sa:
कुस कंटक काँकरीं कुराईं ।
कटुक कठोर कुबस्तु दुराईं ॥
verses.tr:
kus kaṃṭak kām̐karīṃ kurāīṃ
kaṭuk kaṭhor kubastu durāīṃ

verses.sa:
महि मंजुल मृदु मारग कीन्हे ।
बहत समीर त्रिबिध सुख लीन्हे ॥
verses.tr:
mahi maṃjul mṛdu mārag kīnhe
bahat samīr tribidh sukh līnhe

verses.sa:
सुमन बरषि सुर घन करि छाहीं ।
बिटप फूलि फलि तृन मृदुताहीं ॥
verses.tr:
suman baraṣi sur ghan kari chāhīṃ
biṭap phūli phali tṛn mṛdutāhīṃ

verses.sa:
मृग बिलोकि खग बोलि सुबानी ।
सेवहिं सकल राम प्रिय जानी ॥
verses.tr:
mṛg biloki khag boli subānī
sevahiṃ sakal rām priya jānī

verses.sa:
सुलभ सिद्धि सब प्राकृतहु राम कहत जमुहात ।
राम प्रान प्रिय भरत कहुँ यह न होइ बड़ि बात ॥
verses.tr:
sulabh siddhi sab prākṛtahu rām kahat jamuhāt
rām prān priya bharat kahum̐ yah na hoi bar̤i bāt
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The night was pleasantly spent in loving discourse on matters of religion and sacred legends until it was dawn. After performing their daily duties, Bharat and his brother, having received permission from Rama and Saint Atri, attended by all their retinue in simple attire, proceeded on foot to visit Rama’s wood. Earth, in confusion of heart at being trodden by their delicate and uashod feet, smoothen-ed herself, and cleared away all the spiky grass and thorns and stones and ruts and everything rough and unpleasant. Earth made the way delightfully easy for them; they were refreshed by soft, cool and fragrant breezes; the gods rained down flowers; the clouds afforded shade; the trees gave blossom and fruit; the grass made a soft carpet; the deer with their timid glences, and the birds with their sweet song, all recognized Rama's friends and did them homage.
And what great matter is this for Bharat, Rama’s dearest friend? when any ordinary person finds the highest success easy of attainment, if he merely repeats Raima's name when he yawns.

sections.label: Doha 312
sections.name: देखे थल तीरथ सकल भरत पाँच दिन माझ

verses.sa:
एहि बिधि भरतु फिरत बन माहीं ।
नेमु प्रेमु लखि मुनि सकुचाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
ehi bidhi bharatu phirat ban māhīṃ
nemu premu lakhi muni sakucāhīṃ
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पुन्य जलाश्रय भूमि बिभागा ।
खग मृग तरु तृन गिरि बन बागा ॥
verses.tr:
punya jalāśraya bhūmi bibhāgā
khag mṛg taru tṛn giri ban bāgā

verses.sa:
चारु बिचित्र पबित्र बिसेषी ।
बूझत भरतु दिब्य सब देखी ॥
verses.tr:
cāru bicitr pabitr biseṣī
būjhat bharatu dibya sab dekhī

verses.sa:
सुनि मन मुदित कहत रिषिराऊ ।
हेतु नाम गुन पुन्य प्रभाऊ ॥
verses.tr:
suni man mudit kahat riṣirāū
hetu nām gun punya prabhāū

verses.sa:
कतहुँ निमज्जन कतहुँ प्रनामा ।
कतहुँ बिलोकत मन अभिरामा ॥
verses.tr:
katahum̐ nimajjan katahum̐ pranāmā
katahum̐ bilokat man abhirāmā

verses.sa:
कतहुँ बैठि मुनि आयसु पाई ।
सुमिरत सीय सहित दोउ भाई ॥
verses.tr:
katahum̐ baiṭhi muni āyasu pāī
sumirat sīya sahit dou bhāī

verses.sa:
देखि सुभाउ सनेहु सुसेवा ।
देहिं असीस मुदित बनदेवा ॥
verses.tr:
dekhi subhāu sanehu susevā
dehiṃ asīs mudit banadevā

verses.sa:
फिरहिं गएँ दिनु पहर अढ़ाई ।
प्रभु पद कमल बिलोकहिं आई ॥
verses.tr:
phirahiṃ gaem̐ dinu pahar ar̤hāī
prabhu pad kamal bilokahiṃ āī

verses.sa:
देखे थल तीरथ सकल भरत पाँच दिन माझ ।
कहत सुनत हरि हर सुजसु गयउ दिवसु भइ साँझ ॥
verses.tr:
dekhe thal tīrath sakal bharat pām̐c din mājh
kahat sunat hari har sujasu gayau divasu bhai sām̐jh
verses.head: दोहा

trans: In this manner Bharat roamed the woods, and the saints, who saw his faith and love, were abashed. Seeing all so divine, he asked about the sacred ponds and various locali-ties, the birds and deer, the trees and grasses, the hills, woods and orchards, beautiful and varied pre-eminently holy; and in reply the great saint with gladness of heart gave him the history of each, with its name, virtues and spiritual efficacy. Bathing at one place, prostrating himself at another; here admiring the beauty of the wood, here sitting down to rest as the saint directed, he meditated on Sita and the two brothers. Seeing the goodness of his disposition, his love and faithfulness in service, the gods of the wood were charmed and gave him their blessing. The third watch of the day was half spent when he returned to gaze upon the lotus feet of his lord.
In five days Bharat visited every shrine and holy place. The day was spent io discourse on the glory of Hari and Hara until the evening.

sections.label: Doha 313
sections.name: जेहिं उपाय पुनि पाय जनु देखै दीनदयाल

verses.sa:
भोर न्हाइ सबु जुरा समाजू ।
भरत भूमिसुर तेरहुति राजू ॥
verses.tr:
bhor nhāi sabu jurā samājū
bharat bhūmisur terahuti rājū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
भल दिन आजु जानि मन माहीं ।
रामु कृपाल कहत सकुचाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
bhal din āju jāni man māhīṃ
rāmu kṛpāl kahat sakucāhīṃ

verses.sa:
गुर नृप भरत सभा अवलोकी ।
सकुचि राम फिरि अवनि बिलोकी ॥
verses.tr:
gur nṛp bharat sabhā avalokī
sakuci rām phiri avani bilokī

verses.sa:
सील सराहि सभा सब सोची ।
कहुँ न राम सम स्वामि सँकोची ॥
verses.tr:
sīl sarāhi sabhā sab socī
kahum̐ na rām sam svāmi sam̐kocī

verses.sa:
भरत सुजान राम रुख देखी ।
उठि सप्रेम धरि धीर बिसेषी ॥
verses.tr:
bharat sujān rām rukh dekhī
uṭhi saprem dhari dhīr biseṣī

verses.sa:
करि दंडवत कहत कर जोरी ।
राखीं नाथ सकल रुचि मोरी ॥
verses.tr:
kari daṃḍavat kahat kar jorī
rākhīṃ nāth sakal ruci morī

verses.sa:
मोहि लगि सहेउ सबहिं संतापू ।
बहुत भाँति दुखु पावा आपू ॥
verses.tr:
mohi lagi saheu sabahiṃ saṃtāpū
bahut bhām̐ti dukhu pāvā āpū

verses.sa:
अब गोसाइँ मोहि देउ रजाई ।
सेवौं अवध अवधि भरि जाई ॥
verses.tr:
ab gosāim̐ mohi deu rajāī
sevauṃ avadh avadhi bhari jāī

verses.sa:
जेहिं उपाय पुनि पाय जनु देखै दीनदयाल ।
सो सिख देइअ अवधि लगि कोसलपाल कृपाल ॥
verses.tr:
jehiṃ upāya puni pāya janu dekhai dīnadayāl
so sikh deia avadhi lagi kosalapāl kṛpāl
verses.head: दोहा

trans: On the morrow, after bathing, the whole assembly was gathered together— Bharat, the Brahmans and the king of Tirhut. Rama knew at heart that the day was an auspicious one, but in his kindness hesitated to say so. He looked at the guru, the king, Bharat, and the assembly, and then in confusion turned his eyes to the ground. Allthe spectators admired his generosity, thinking. ‘Never was there a master so considerate as Rama is!’ Bharat in his wisdom understood Rama's wish. He stood up and, lovingly putting the greatest restraint upon himself, bowed low, and with clasped hands thus spoke: “My lord has granted my every desire. For me he has borne, every affliction and has himself experienced every kind of trouble. Now, sire, give
me your royal permission to go and serve at Avadh till the appointed time.
But, O merciful and compassionate king of Kosala, teach me some way by which your servant may see your feet again when the time is over.

sections.label: Doha 314
sections.name: दीनबंधु सुनि बंधु के बचन दीन छलहीन

verses.sa:
पुरजन परिजन प्रजा गोसाई ।
सब सुचि सरस सनेहँ सगाई ॥
verses.tr:
purajan parijan prajā gosāī
sab suci saras saneham̐ sagāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
राउर बदि भल भव दुख दाहू ।
प्रभु बिनु बादि परम पद लाहू ॥
verses.tr:
rāur badi bhal bhav dukh dāhū
prabhu binu bādi param pad lāhū

verses.sa:
स्वामि सुजानु जानि सब ही की ।
रुचि लालसा रहनि जन जी की ॥
verses.tr:
svāmi sujānu jāni sab hī kī
ruci lālasā rahani jan jī kī

verses.sa:
प्रनतपालु पालिहि सब काहू ।
देउ दुहू दिसि ओर निबाहू ॥
verses.tr:
pranatapālu pālihi sab kāhū
deu duhū disi or nibāhū

verses.sa:
अस मोहि सब बिधि भूरि भरोसो ।
किएँ बिचारु न सोचु खरो सो ॥
verses.tr:
as mohi sab bidhi bhūri bharoso
kiem̐ bicāru na socu kharo so

verses.sa:
आरति मोर नाथ कर छोहू ।
दुहुँ मिलि कीन्ह ढीठु हठि मोहू ॥
verses.tr:
ārati mor nāth kar chohū
duhum̐ mili kīnh ḍhīṭhu haṭhi mohū

verses.sa:
यह बड़ दोषु दूरि करि स्वामी ।
तजि सकोच सिखइअ अनुगामी ॥
verses.tr:
yah bar̤ doṣu dūri kari svāmī
taji sakoc sikhaia anugāmī

verses.sa:
भरत बिनय सुनि सबहिं प्रसंसी ।
खीर नीर बिबरन गति हंसी ॥
verses.tr:
bharat binaya suni sabahiṃ prasaṃsī
khīr nīr bibaran gati haṃsī

verses.sa:
दीनबंधु सुनि बंधु के बचन दीन छलहीन ।
देस काल अवसर सरिस बोले रामु प्रबीन ॥
verses.tr:
dīnabaṃdhu suni baṃdhu ke bacan dīn chalahīn
des kāl avasar saris bole rāmu prabīn
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Your citizens, your kinsmen, and all your subjects, sire, are true and real, and bound to you by ties of affection. The sorrows of this miserable life, borne by your command are a delight; without my lord, highest heaven is a worthless gain. The all wise master knows the fancies, the desires, the habit of mind of all his servants: the protector, of suppliants will be our protector, and both in this world and the next will secure our deliverance. I have thus the most perfect confidence; not 4 particle of anxiety disturbs my calculations. My own distress and my lord’s forbearance have combined to make me thus presumptuous. Pardon, my lord, this my great offence, and shrink not from instructing your servant what to do.” All who heard Bharat’s prayer applauded it; like a swan it had separated the milk prayer applauded it; like a awan it had separated the milk of truth from the water of error.
The all-wise Rama, the brother of the meek, on hearing his brother’s meek and guileless speech, replied in terms appropriate, to the place, the circumstances and the time:

sections.label: Doha 315
sections.name: मुखिआ मुखु सो चाहिऐ खान पान कहुँ एक

verses.sa:
तात तुम्हारि मोरि परिजन की ।
चिंता गुरहि नृपहि घर बन की ॥
verses.tr:
tāt tumhāri mori parijan kī
ciṃtā gurahi nṛpahi ghar ban kī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
माथे पर गुर मुनि मिथिलेसू ।
हमहि तुम्हहि सपनेहुँ न कलेसू ॥
verses.tr:
māthe par gur muni mithilesū
hamahi tumhahi sapanehum̐ na kalesū

verses.sa:
मोर तुम्हार परम पुरुषारथु ।
स्वारथु सुजसु धरमु परमारथु ॥
verses.tr:
mor tumhār param puruṣārathu
svārathu sujasu dharamu paramārathu

verses.sa:
पितु आयसु पालिहिं दुहु भाई ।
लोक बेद भल भूप भलाई ॥
verses.tr:
pitu āyasu pālihiṃ duhu bhāī
lok bed bhal bhūp bhalāī

verses.sa:
गुर पितु मातु स्वामि सिख पालें ।
चलेहुँ कुमग पग परहिं न खालें ॥
verses.tr:
gur pitu mātu svāmi sikh pāleṃ
calehum̐ kumag pag parahiṃ na khāleṃ

verses.sa:
अस बिचारि सब सोच बिहाई ।
पालहु अवध अवधि भरि जाई ॥
verses.tr:
as bicāri sab soc bihāī
pālahu avadh avadhi bhari jāī

verses.sa:
देसु कोसु परिजन परिवारू ।
गुर पद रजहिं लाग छरुभारू ॥
verses.tr:
desu kosu parijan parivārū
gur pad rajahiṃ lāg charubhārū

verses.sa:
तुम्ह मुनि मातु सचिव सिख मानी ।
पालेहु पुहुमि प्रजा रजधानी ॥
verses.tr:
tumh muni mātu saciv sikh mānī
pālehu puhumi prajā rajadhānī

verses.sa:
मुखिआ मुखु सो चाहिऐ खान पान कहुँ एक ।
पालइ पोषइ सकल अँग तुलसी सहित बिबेक ॥
verses.tr:
mukhiā mukhu so cāhiai khān pān kahum̐ ek
pālai poṣai sakal am̐g tulasī sahit bibek
verses.head: दोहा

trans: “The guru and the king, brother, take thought for you, for me and our people, whether at home or in the forest. So long as Visvamitra, Vasishtha, and Janak direct us, neither you nor I can dream of trouble. For us two brothers, both for me and you, obedience to our father’s command is the highest object we can have, our greatest gain, our glory, our duty and our salvation. A king’s good is a good thing both in the Vedas and in the estimation of the world. Whoever observes the injunctions of guru or father and mother, or master treads an easy path and never stumbles. Remember this, and putting aside all regrets, go and reign ut Avadh for the appointed time. The burden of the realm, the treasury, the people and the family will weigh po heavier than the dust of the guru’s feet. Observe the instructions

sections.label: Doha 316
sections.name: मागेउ बिदा प्रनामु करि राम लिए उर लाइ

verses.sa:
राजधरम सरबसु एतनोई ।
जिमि मन माहँ मनोरथ गोई ॥
verses.tr:
rājadharam sarabasu etanoī
jimi man māham̐ manorath goī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बंधु प्रबोधु कीन्ह बहु भाँती ।
बिनु अधार मन तोषु न साँती ॥
verses.tr:
baṃdhu prabodhu kīnh bahu bhām̐tī
binu adhār man toṣu na sām̐tī

verses.sa:
भरत सील गुर सचिव समाजू ।
सकुच सनेह बिबस रघुराजू ॥
verses.tr:
bharat sīl gur saciv samājū
sakuc saneh bibas raghurājū

verses.sa:
प्रभु करि कृपा पाँवरीं दीन्हीं ।
सादर भरत सीस धरि लीन्हीं ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu kari kṛpā pām̐varīṃ dīnhīṃ
sādar bharat sīs dhari līnhīṃ

verses.sa:
चरनपीठ करुनानिधान के ।
जनु जुग जामिक प्रजा प्रान के ॥
verses.tr:
caranapīṭh karunānidhān ke
janu jug jāmik prajā prān ke

verses.sa:
संपुट भरत सनेह रतन के ।
आखर जुग जुन जीव जतन के ॥
verses.tr:
saṃpuṭ bharat saneh ratan ke
ākhar jug jun jīv jatan ke

verses.sa:
कुल कपाट कर कुसल करम के ।
बिमल नयन सेवा सुधरम के ॥
verses.tr:
kul kapāṭ kar kusal karam ke
bimal nayan sevā sudharam ke

verses.sa:
भरत मुदित अवलंब लहे तें ।
अस सुख जस सिय रामु रहे तें ॥
verses.tr:
bharat mudit avalaṃb lahe teṃ
as sukh jas siya rāmu rahe teṃ

verses.sa:
मागेउ बिदा प्रनामु करि राम लिए उर लाइ ।
लोग उचाटे अमरपति कुटिल कुअवसरु पाइ ॥
verses.tr:
māgeu bidā pranāmu kari rām lie ur lāi
log ucāṭe amarapati kuṭil kuavasaru pāi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: ‘of the saint your mother and the Minister, and protect your country, yoursabjeots and your capital,” 4 $ Dohd 303. sections.label: Doha 317
sections.name: तेउ बिलोकि रघुबर भरत प्रीति अनूप अपार

verses.sa:
सो कुचालि सब कहँ भइ नीकी ।
अवधि आस सम जीवनि जी की ॥
verses.tr:
so kucāli sab kaham̐ bhai nīkī
avadhi ās sam jīvani jī kī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नतरु लखन सिय सम बियोगा ।
हहरि मरत सब लोग कुरोगा ॥
verses.tr:
nataru lakhan siya sam biyogā
hahari marat sab log kurogā

verses.sa:
रामकृपाँ अवरेब सुधारी ।
बिबुध धारि भइ गुनद गोहारी ॥
verses.tr:
rāmakṛpām̐ avareb sudhārī
bibudh dhāri bhai gunad gohārī

verses.sa:
भेंटत भुज भरि भाइ भरत सो ।
राम प्रेम रसु कहि न परत सो ॥
verses.tr:
bheṃṭat bhuj bhari bhāi bharat so
rām prem rasu kahi na parat so

verses.sa:
तन मन बचन उमग अनुरागा ।
धीर धुरंधर धीरजु त्यागा ॥
verses.tr:
tan man bacan umag anurāgā
dhīr dhuraṃdhar dhīraju tyāgā

verses.sa:
बारिज लोचन मोचत बारी ।
देखि दसा सुर सभा दुखारी ॥
verses.tr:
bārij locan mocat bārī
dekhi dasā sur sabhā dukhārī

verses.sa:
मुनिगन गुर धुर धीर जनक से ।
ग्यान अनल मन कसें कनक से ॥
verses.tr:
munigan gur dhur dhīr janak se
gyān anal man kaseṃ kanak se

verses.sa:
जे बिरंचि निरलेप उपाए ।
पदुम पत्र जिमि जग जल जाए ॥
verses.tr:
je biraṃci niralep upāe
padum patr jimi jag jal jāe

verses.sa:
तेउ बिलोकि रघुबर भरत प्रीति अनूप अपार ।
भए मगन मन तन बचन सहित बिराग बिचार ॥
verses.tr:
teu biloki raghubar bharat prīti anūp apār
bhae magan man tan bacan sahit birāg bicār
verses.head: दोहा

trans: But his villeiny was a good thing for all; the hope that the time of exile would soon be over was the life of their life. Otherwise the separation from Lakshman, Sita and Rama would have been such a blow that all would have died of it. The mercy of Rama solved this difficulty, and the hostile gods became serviceable allies. Rama closed his arms around Bharat with a burst of affection that cannot be described. Body, soul and speech overflowed with love; the firmest of the firm lost all firmness, and his lotus eyes streamed with tears. The assembled gods were grieved to see his condition: the saints and gurus who were as firm as Janak, the gold of whose soul had been tested
het cae cinalobibhnt cohen e pe Ree wis ta, by the fire of wisdom, and whom the Creator had created as ummpressionable by the world as the leaves of the lotus by the water;
Even they, seeing the unparalleled and boundless affection of Rama and Bharat, were overwhelmed in body, soul and speech, lost all reason and restraint.

sections.label: Doha 318
sections.name: लखनहि भेंटि प्रनामु करि सिर धरि सिय पद धूरि

verses.sa:
जहाँ जनक गुर मति भोरी ।
प्राकृत प्रीति कहत बड़ि खोरी ॥
verses.tr:
jahām̐ janak gur mati bhorī
prākṛt prīti kahat bar̤i khorī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
बरनत रघुबर भरत बियोगू ।
सुनि कठोर कबि जानिहि लोगू ॥
verses.tr:
baranat raghubar bharat biyogū
suni kaṭhor kabi jānihi logū

verses.sa:
सो सकोच रसु अकथ सुबानी ।
समउ सनेहु सुमिरि सकुचानी ॥
verses.tr:
so sakoc rasu akath subānī
samau sanehu sumiri sakucānī

verses.sa:
भेंटि भरत रघुबर समुझाए ।
पुनि रिपुदवनु हरषि हियँ लाए ॥
verses.tr:
bheṃṭi bharat raghubar samujhāe
puni ripudavanu haraṣi hiyam̐ lāe

verses.sa:
सेवक सचिव भरत रुख पाई ।
निज निज काज लगे सब जाई ॥
verses.tr:
sevak saciv bharat rukh pāī
nij nij kāj lage sab jāī

verses.sa:
सुनि दारुन दुखु दुहूँ समाजा ।
लगे चलन के साजन साजा ॥
verses.tr:
suni dārun dukhu duhūm̐ samājā
lage calan ke sājan sājā

verses.sa:
प्रभु पद पदुम बंदि दोउ भाई ।
चले सीस धरि राम रजाई ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu pad padum baṃdi dou bhāī
cale sīs dhari rām rajāī

verses.sa:
मुनि तापस बनदेव निहोरी ।
सब सनमानि बहोरि बहोरी ॥
verses.tr:
muni tāpas banadev nihorī
sab sanamāni bahori bahorī

verses.sa:
लखनहि भेंटि प्रनामु करि सिर धरि सिय पद धूरि ।
चले सप्रेम असीस सुनि सकल सुमंगल मूरि ॥
verses.tr:
lakhanahi bheṃṭi pranāmu kari sir dhari siya pad dhūri
cale saprem asīs suni sakal sumaṃgal mūri
verses.head: दोहा

trans: If Janak and Vasishtha were dumbfounded, the emotion of ordinary persons is not worth speaking about. People would think any poet harsh when they heard him describe the parting of Rama and Bharat; Eloquence herself, remembering the unspeakable pathos of the scene, would be struck dumb with confusion. Raghubar first embraced and consoled Bharat and then rejoiced to take Satrughna to his arms. Knowing Bharat’s wishes, his servants and ministers began each to set about his own work. In both camps there was sore distress at the news, as they commenced their preparations for the march. The two brothers, after reverencing their lord's lotus feet and submissively receiving his commands, set out on the way, bowing to the saints, the hermits and forest gods and again and again showing them respect.
Lakshman, too, they embraced, and making obeisance, placed on their head the dust of Sita’s feet, and received her affectionate blessing, the source of happiness.

sections.label: Doha 319
sections.name: भरत मातु पद बंदि प्रभु सुचि सनेहँ मिलि भेंटि

verses.sa:
सानुज राम नृपहि सिर नाई ।
कीन्हि बहुत बिधि बिनय बड़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
sānuj rām nṛpahi sir nāī
kīnhi bahut bidhi binaya bar̤āī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
देव दया बस बड़ दुखु पायउ ।
सहित समाज काननहिं आयउ ॥
verses.tr:
dev dayā bas bar̤ dukhu pāyau
sahit samāj kānanahiṃ āyau

verses.sa:
पुर पगु धारिअ देइ असीसा ।
कीन्ह धीर धरि गवनु महीसा ॥
verses.tr:
pur pagu dhāria dei asīsā
kīnh dhīr dhari gavanu mahīsā

verses.sa:
मुनि महिदेव साधु सनमाने ।
बिदा किए हरि हर सम जाने ॥
verses.tr:
muni mahidev sādhu sanamāne
bidā kie hari har sam jāne

verses.sa:
सासु समीप गए दोउ भाई ।
फिरे बंदि पग आसिष पाई ॥
verses.tr:
sāsu samīp gae dou bhāī
phire baṃdi pag āsiṣ pāī

verses.sa:
कौसिक बामदेव जाबाली ।
पुरजन परिजन सचिव सुचाली ॥
verses.tr:
kausik bāmadev jābālī
purajan parijan saciv sucālī

verses.sa:
जथा जोगु करि बिनय प्रनामा ।
बिदा किए सब सानुज रामा ॥
verses.tr:
jathā jogu kari binaya pranāmā
bidā kie sab sānuj rāmā

verses.sa:
नारि पुरुष लघु मध्य बड़ेरे ।
सब सनमानि कृपानिधि फेरे ॥
verses.tr:
nāri puruṣ laghu madhya bar̤ere
sab sanamāni kṛpānidhi phere

verses.sa:
भरत मातु पद बंदि प्रभु सुचि सनेहँ मिलि भेंटि ।
बिदा कीन्ह सजि पालकी सकुच सोच सब मेटि ॥
verses.tr:
bharat mātu pad baṃdi prabhu suci saneham̐ mili bheṃṭi
bidā kīnh saji pālakī sakuc soc sab meṭi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Rama and his brother bowed the head to the king with many expressions of modesty and praise: “In your kind-

ness, sire, you have suffered great inconvenience, you and your retinue, by coming to the forest; now grant me your blessing and return to the city.” The monarch mastered his emotion and went. After reverencing the saints, Brahmans and nobles, and taking leave of them as though they were the equals of Hari and Hara, the two brothers ap-

roached their mother-in-law, and came back after kissing for feet and obtaining her blessing. Then they took leave of Visvamitra, Vamadeva and Jabeli; the people of the court, the citizens, the good ministers and all; with courteous speech and address, as was most befitting. ‘The Ocean of compassion respectfully dismissed them all, men and women, high, middle-class and low. °
With sincere affection the Lord kissed the feet of Bharat’s mother and embraced her, and escorting her to the palki that he had in readiness, effaced all her alarm and distress.

sections.label: Doha 320
sections.name: गुर गुरतिय पद बंदि प्रभु सीता लखन समेत

verses.sa:
परिजन मातु पितहि मिलि सीता ।
फिरी प्रानप्रिय प्रेम पुनीता ॥
verses.tr:
parijan mātu pitahi mili sītā
phirī prānapriya prem punītā
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
करि प्रनामु भेंटी सब सासू ।
प्रीति कहत कबि हियँ न हुलासू ॥
verses.tr:
kari pranāmu bheṃṭī sab sāsū
prīti kahat kabi hiyam̐ na hulāsū

verses.sa:
सुनि सिख अभिमत आसिष पाई ।
रही सीय दुहु प्रीति समाई ॥
verses.tr:
suni sikh abhimat āsiṣ pāī
rahī sīya duhu prīti samāī

verses.sa:
रघुपति पटु पालकीं मगाईं ।
करि प्रबोधु सब मातु चढ़ाई ॥
verses.tr:
raghupati paṭu pālakīṃ magāīṃ
kari prabodhu sab mātu car̤hāī

verses.sa:
बार बार हिलि मिलि दुहु भाई ।
सम सनेहँ जननी पहुँचाई ॥
verses.tr:
bār bār hili mili duhu bhāī
sam saneham̐ jananī pahum̐cāī

verses.sa:
साजि बाजि गज बाहन नाना ।
भरत भूप दल कीन्ह पयाना ॥
verses.tr:
sāji bāji gaj bāhan nānā
bharat bhūp dal kīnh payānā

verses.sa:
हृदयँ रामु सिय लखन समेता ।
चले जाहिं सब लोग अचेता ॥
verses.tr:
hṛdayam̐ rāmu siya lakhan sametā
cale jāhiṃ sab log acetā

verses.sa:
बसह बाजि गज पसु हियँ हारें ।
चले जाहिं परबस मन मारें ॥
verses.tr:
basah bāji gaj pasu hiyam̐ hāreṃ
cale jāhiṃ parabas man māreṃ

verses.sa:
गुर गुरतिय पद बंदि प्रभु सीता लखन समेत ।
फिरे हरष बिसमय सहित आए परन निकेत ॥
verses.tr:
gur guratiya pad baṃdi prabhu sītā lakhan samet
phire haraṣ bisamaya sahit āe paran niket
verses.head: दोहा

trans: After saluting her father and mother and the court, Sita came back purified by the love of her beloved. Reverently she embraced all her mothers-in-law, with an affection which the poet’s soul shrinks from describing. Hearkening to their instruction and receiving the blessing she desired of them, Sita stood burdened with conflicting love. Having sent for elegant palkis, Rama with words of consolation escorted each of his mothers to their carriage. Again and again both brothers embraced them and led each by the hand with equal affection. When the horses, elephants and different vehicles were ready, the king and Bharat started the host. Their hearts full of Rama, Sita and Lakshman, all the people went disconsolate; even the bullocks, horses, _ elephants and cattle were out of heart and went only by force and against their will.
The Lord with Sita and Lakshman kissed the feet of. the guru and the guru’s wife, and turned and came back to their leafy hat with mingled pleasure and amazement.

sections.label: Doha 321
sections.name: सानुज सीय समेत प्रभु राजत परन कुटीर

verses.sa:
बिदा कीन्ह सनमानि निषादू ।
चलेउ हृदयँ बड़ बिरह बिषादू ॥
verses.tr:
bidā kīnh sanamāni niṣādū
caleu hṛdayam̐ bar̤ birah biṣādū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
कोल किरात भिल्ल बनचारी ।
फेरे फिरे जोहारि जोहारी ॥
verses.tr:
kol kirāt bhill banacārī
phere phire johāri johārī

verses.sa:
प्रभु सिय लखन बैठि बट छाहीं ।
प्रिय परिजन बियोग बिलखाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu siya lakhan baiṭhi baṭ chāhīṃ
priya parijan biyog bilakhāhīṃ

verses.sa:
भरत सनेह सुभाउ सुबानी ।
प्रिया अनुज सन कहत बखानी ॥
verses.tr:
bharat saneh subhāu subānī
priyā anuj san kahat bakhānī

verses.sa:
प्रीति प्रतीति बचन मन करनी ।
श्रीमुख राम प्रेम बस बरनी ॥
verses.tr:
prīti pratīti bacan man karanī
śrīmukh rām prem bas baranī

verses.sa:
तेहि अवसर खग मृग जल मीना ।
चित्रकूट चर अचर मलीना ॥
verses.tr:
tehi avasar khag mṛg jal mīnā
citrakūṭ car acar malīnā

verses.sa:
बिबुध बिलोकि दसा रघुबर की ।
बरषि सुमन कहि गति घर घर की ॥
verses.tr:
bibudh biloki dasā raghubar kī
baraṣi suman kahi gati ghar ghar kī

verses.sa:
प्रभु प्रनामु करि दीन्ह भरोसो ।
चले मुदित मन डर न खरो सो ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu pranāmu kari dīnh bharoso
cale mudit man ḍar na kharo so

verses.sa:
सानुज सीय समेत प्रभु राजत परन कुटीर ।
भगति ग्यानु बैराग्य जनु सोहत धरें सरीर ॥
verses.tr:
sānuj sīya samet prabhu rājat paran kuṭīr
bhagati gyānu bairāgya janu sohat dhareṃ sarīr
verses.head: दोहा

trans: The Nishad was dismissed with honour and departed; sorely grieved at heart to leave. The Kols, KirAts and Bhils, the people of the woods, turned again and again, after they had been dismissed, to make yet one more obeisance. The lord with Sita and Lakshman sat under the shade of the fig-tree and sorrowed for the loss of their dear friends. Rama, overpowered with affection, discoursed to his spouse and brother in eloquent terms on Bharat’s Love and generosity, and with his own blessed mouth declared that faith and devotion were in his’ every thought, word and deed. At that time the birds, deer and fish, every.
creature at Chitra-kut¢, whether animate or inanimate, were
all woe-begone, The gods, seeing Raghubar’s state, rained
down flowers and told him of what was doing in their
several spheres. The lord bowed and reassured them; they
went away glad, without a particle of anxiety in their mind, Dohd 309.

sections.label: Doha 322
sections.name: राम दरस लगि लोग सब करत नेम उपबास

verses.sa:
मुनि महिसुर गुर भरत भुआलू ।
राम बिरहँ सबु साजु बिहालू ॥
verses.tr:
muni mahisur gur bharat bhuālū
rām biraham̐ sabu sāju bihālū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
प्रभु गुन ग्राम गनत मन माहीं ।
सब चुपचाप चले मग जाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
prabhu gun grām ganat man māhīṃ
sab cupacāp cale mag jāhīṃ

verses.sa:
जमुना उतरि पार सबु भयऊ ।
सो बासरु बिनु भोजन गयऊ ॥
verses.tr:
jamunā utari pār sabu bhayaū
so bāsaru binu bhojan gayaū

verses.sa:
उतरि देवसरि दूसर बासू ।
रामसखाँ सब कीन्ह सुपासू ॥
verses.tr:
utari devasari dūsar bāsū
rāmasakhām̐ sab kīnh supāsū

verses.sa:
सई उतरि गोमतीं नहाए ।
चौथें दिवस अवधपुर आए ॥
verses.tr:
saī utari gomatīṃ nahāe
cautheṃ divas avadhapur āe

verses.sa:
जनकु रहे पुर बासर चारी ।
राज काज सब साज सँभारी ॥
verses.tr:
janaku rahe pur bāsar cārī
rāj kāj sab sāj sam̐bhārī

verses.sa:
सौंपि सचिव गुर भरतहि राजू ।
तेरहुति चले साजि सबु साजू ॥
verses.tr:
sauṃpi saciv gur bharatahi rājū
terahuti cale sāji sabu sājū

verses.sa:
नगर नारि नर गुर सिख मानी ।
बसे सुखेन राम रजधानी ॥
verses.tr:
nagar nāri nar gur sikh mānī
base sukhen rām rajadhānī

verses.sa:
राम दरस लगि लोग सब करत नेम उपबास ।
तजि तजि भूषन भोग सुख जिअत अवधि कीं आस ॥
verses.tr:
rām daras lagi log sab karat nem upabās
taji taji bhūṣan bhog sukh jiat avadhi kīṃ ās
verses.head: दोहा

trans: With Sita and his brother the Lord shone forth in the leafy hut as resplendent as Faith, Wisdom and Ascetism incarnate.

Vasishtha, the Brahmans and Visvamitra, Bharat and the king were all in evil case at leaving Rama and paced the road in silence, counting up in their mind all Rama's virtues. After crossing the Jamund they passed the Ganges, where Rama's friend made every arrangement for them. Then they crossed the Sai, bathed in the Gomati, and on the fourth day reached Ayodhya. Janak stayed four days in the city, settled the entire administration of the state, committed the government to the Minister, the guru and Bharat, and then with all his retinue set out for Tirhut. All the people, in compliance with the guru’s directions, settled down quietly in Rama’s capital.
Fasting and praying to see him once again, discarding all personal adornments, pleasure and enjoyment, and living only ia the hope of his return.

sections.label: Doha 323
sections.name: सुनि सिख पाइ असीस बड़ि गनक बोलि दिनु साधि

verses.sa:
सचिव सुसेवक भरत प्रबोधे ।
निज निज काज पाइ पाइ सिख ओधे ॥
verses.tr:
saciv susevak bharat prabodhe
nij nij kāj pāi pāi sikh odhe
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
पुनि सिख दीन्ह बोलि लघु भाई ।
सौंपी सकल मातु सेवकाई ॥
verses.tr:
puni sikh dīnh boli laghu bhāī
sauṃpī sakal mātu sevakāī

verses.sa:
भूसुर बोलि भरत कर जोरे ।
करि प्रनाम बय बिनय निहोरे ॥
verses.tr:
bhūsur boli bharat kar jore
kari pranām baya binaya nihore

verses.sa:
ऊँच नीच कारजु भल पोचू ।
आयसु देब न करब सँकोचू ॥
verses.tr:
ūm̐c nīc kāraju bhal pocū
āyasu deb na karab sam̐kocū

verses.sa:
परिजन पुरजन प्रजा बोलाए ।
समाधानु करि सुबस बसाए ॥
verses.tr:
parijan purajan prajā bolāe
samādhānu kari subas basāe

verses.sa:
सानुज गे गुर गेहँ बहोरी ।
करि दंडवत कहत कर जोरी ॥
verses.tr:
sānuj ge gur geham̐ bahorī
kari daṃḍavat kahat kar jorī

verses.sa:
आयसु होइ त रहौं सनेमा ।
बोले मुनि तन पुलकि सपेमा ॥
verses.tr:
āyasu hoi ta rahauṃ sanemā
bole muni tan pulaki sapemā

verses.sa:
समुझव कहब करब तुम्ह जोई ।
धरम सारु जग होइहि सोई ॥
verses.tr:
samujhav kahab karab tumh joī
dharam sāru jag hoihi soī

verses.sa:
सुनि सिख पाइ असीस बड़ि गनक बोलि दिनु साधि ।
सिंघासन प्रभु पादुका बैठारे निरुपाधि ॥
verses.tr:
suni sikh pāi asīs bar̤i ganak boli dinu sādhi
siṃghāsan prabhu pādukā baiṭhāre nirupādhi
verses.head: दोहा

trans: Bharat exhorted his ministers and trusty servants, and they executed his orders, each in their appointed sphere, Then he spoke and gave instructions to his younger brother, and entrusted to him the care of the dowager queens. He also with folded hands spoke to the Brahmans, bowing low and using humble supplication: “Give your orders and hesitate not, to high or to low, in great matters or in small.” Next he summoned the people of the palace, of the city, and all his subjects, and set their minds at rest and appointed them places to live in. After this he, with his brother, went to the guru's house, and after prostrating himself and joining his hands in prayer said thus: “With ul pers mission I will now live a life of penance.” ‘The saint thrilled with rapturous affection and replied: Whatever you think, or say, or do, is always best.”
On receiving his command and his blessing, he sent for a great astrologer and fixed the day, and then devoutly placed upon the throne his lord’s sandals.

sections.label: Doha 324
sections.name: राम पेम भाजन भरतु बड़े न एहिं करतूति

verses.sa:
राम मातु गुर पद सिरु नाई ।
प्रभु पद पीठ रजायसु पाई ॥
verses.tr:
rām mātu gur pad siru nāī
prabhu pad pīṭh rajāyasu pāī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नंदिगावँ करि परन कुटीरा ।
कीन्ह निवासु धरम धुर धीरा ॥
verses.tr:
naṃdigāvam̐ kari paran kuṭīrā
kīnh nivāsu dharam dhur dhīrā

verses.sa:
जटाजूट सिर मुनिपट धारी ।
महि खनि कुस साँथरी सँवारी ॥
verses.tr:
jaṭājūṭ sir munipaṭ dhārī
mahi khani kus sām̐tharī sam̐vārī

verses.sa:
असन बसन बासन ब्रत नेमा ।
करत कठिन रिषिधरम सप्रेमा ॥
verses.tr:
asan basan bāsan brat nemā
karat kaṭhin riṣidharam sapremā

verses.sa:
भूषन बसन भोग सुख भूरी ।
मन तन बचन तजे तिन तूरी ॥
verses.tr:
bhūṣan basan bhog sukh bhūrī
man tan bacan taje tin tūrī

verses.sa:
अवध राजु सुर राजु सिहाई ।
दसरथ धनु सुनि धनदु लजाई ॥
verses.tr:
avadh rāju sur rāju sihāī
dasarath dhanu suni dhanadu lajāī

verses.sa:
तेहिं पुर बसत भरत बिनु रागा ।
चंचरीक जिमि चंपक बागा ॥
verses.tr:
tehiṃ pur basat bharat binu rāgā
caṃcarīk jimi caṃpak bāgā

verses.sa:
रमा बिलासु राम अनुरागी ।
तजत बमन जिमि जन बड़भागी ॥
verses.tr:
ramā bilāsu rām anurāgī
tajat baman jimi jan bar̤abhāgī

verses.sa:
राम पेम भाजन भरतु बड़े न एहिं करतूति ।
चातक हंस सराहिअत टेंक बिबेक बिभूति ॥
verses.tr:
rām pem bhājan bharatu bar̤e na ehiṃ karatūti
cātak haṃs sarāhiat ṭeṃk bibek bibhūti
verses.head: दोहा

trans: After bowing hishead at the feet of Rama’s mother and the guru, and receiving the commands of his lord’s sandals, the champion of righteousness made for himself a but of leaves at Nandirdmal, and there abode, with his hair gathered up into a knot on his head, attired in hermit’s dress, and his couch of grass spread in a caveio the earth, lovingly practising the austerities of religious life in food, dress, posture, fasting and prayer; discarding in thought, word and deed, as of no more value than a broken blade of grass, all clothes and adornments and every luxury and enjoyment. The city of heaven envied the capital of Avadh, and the god of riches was confounded at the sight of Dasarath’s wealth; yet in that city Bharat dwelt as indifferent asa bee ina garden of champa trees. A man so highly blest as to be enamoured of Rama spurns like vomit all Lakshmi’s delights.
This is no such great achievement for Bharat, the very shrine of the love of Rama; even. the chdtak and the swan are models in their way, the one of marvellous constancy, the other of discrimination.

sections.label: Doha 325
sections.name: नित पूजत प्रभु पाँवरी प्रीति न हृदयँ समाति

verses.sa:
देह दिनहुँ दिन दूबरि होई ।
घटइ तेजु बलु मुखछबि सोई ॥
verses.tr:
deh dinahum̐ din dūbari hoī
ghaṭai teju balu mukhachabi soī
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
नित नव राम प्रेम पनु पीना ।
बढ़त धरम दलु मनु न मलीना ॥
verses.tr:
nit nav rām prem panu pīnā
bar̤hat dharam dalu manu na malīnā

verses.sa:
जिमि जलु निघटत सरद प्रकासे ।
बिलसत बेतस बनज बिकासे ॥
verses.tr:
jimi jalu nighaṭat sarad prakāse
bilasat betas banaj bikāse

verses.sa:
सम दम संजम नियम उपासा ।
नखत भरत हिय बिमल अकासा ॥
verses.tr:
sam dam saṃjam niyam upāsā
nakhat bharat hiya bimal akāsā

verses.sa:
ध्रुव बिस्वास अवधि राका सी ।
स्वामि सुरति सुरबीथि बिकासी ॥
verses.tr:
dhruv bisvās avadhi rākā sī
svāmi surati surabīthi bikāsī

verses.sa:
राम पेम बिधु अचल अदोषा ।
सहित समाज सोह नित चोखा ॥
verses.tr:
rām pem bidhu acal adoṣā
sahit samāj soh nit cokhā

verses.sa:
भरत रहनि समुझनि करतूती ।
भगति बिरति गुन बिमल बिभूती ॥
verses.tr:
bharat rahani samujhani karatūtī
bhagati birati gun bimal bibhūtī

verses.sa:
बरनत सकल सुकचि सकुचाहीं ।
सेस गनेस गिरा गमु नाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
baranat sakal sukaci sakucāhīṃ
ses ganes girā gamu nāhīṃ

verses.sa: नित पूजत प्रभु पाँवरी प्रीति न हृदयँ समाति ॥
verses.tr: nit pūjat prabhu pām̐varī prīti na hṛdayam̐ samāti
verses.head: दोहा

verses.sa: मागि मागि आयसु करत राज काज बहु भाँति ॥
verses.tr: māgi māgi āyasu karat rāj kāj bahu bhām̐ti

trans: Day by day his body grew thinner, but his lustre and vigour were not diminished, and the beauty of his face remained the same. Nourished by an ever-increasing devotion, his virtue waxed stronger and his soul was unclouded: us the waters decrease in the brightness of the autumn, but the reeds spring up and the lotuses blossom. His tranquillity, self-control, piety, fasting and prayer were like stars in the pure heaven of Bharat’s soul’ bis faith like the pole-star, the return from exile as the full moon, his constant remembrance of the Lord as the glistening milk-way, his devotion a fixed and unsullied moon shining’ ever clear amidst a galaxy of stars. All the greatest of poets would fail to describe Bharat’s composure, wisdom and magnanimity, his faith, his impassibility, and the perfect splendour of his virtues; not even Seshnag, Ganes and Sarasvati Could attain to them.
Paying daily homage to his lord’s sandals, his affection was greater than his heart could contain: he constantly referred to them in the disposal of all matters of state,

sections.label: Doha 326
sections.name: भरत चरित करि नेमु तुलसी जो सादर सुनहिं

verses.sa:
पुलक गात हियँ सिय रघुबीरू ।
जीह नामु जप लोचन नीरू ॥
verses.tr:
pulak gāt hiyam̐ siya raghubīrū
jīh nāmu jap locan nīrū
verses.head: चौपाई

verses.sa:
लखन राम सिय कानन बसहीं ।
भरतु भवन बसि तप तनु कसहीं ॥
verses.tr:
lakhan rām siya kānan basahīṃ
bharatu bhavan basi tap tanu kasahīṃ

verses.sa:
दोउ दिसि समुझि कहत सबु लोगू ।
सब बिधि भरत सराहन जोगू ॥
verses.tr:
dou disi samujhi kahat sabu logū
sab bidhi bharat sarāhan jogū

verses.sa:
सुनि ब्रत नेम साधु सकुचाहीं ।
देखि दसा मुनिराज लजाहीं ॥
verses.tr:
suni brat nem sādhu sakucāhīṃ
dekhi dasā munirāj lajāhīṃ

verses.sa:
परम पुनीत भरत आचरनू ।
मधुर मंजु मुद मंगल करनू ॥
verses.tr:
param punīt bharat ācaranū
madhur maṃju mud maṃgal karanū

verses.sa:
हरन कठिन कलि कलुष कलेसू ।
महामोह निसि दलन दिनेसू ॥
verses.tr:
haran kaṭhin kali kaluṣ kalesū
mahāmoh nisi dalan dinesū

verses.sa:
पाप पुंज कुंजर मृगराजू ।
समन सकल संताप समाजू ॥
verses.tr:
pāp puṃj kuṃjar mṛgarājū
saman sakal saṃtāp samājū

verses.sa:
जन रंजन भंजन भव भारू ।
राम सनेह सुधाकर सारू ॥
verses.tr:
jan raṃjan bhaṃjan bhav bhārū
rām saneh sudhākar sārū

verses.sa:
सिय राम प्रेम पियूष पूरन होत जनमु न भरत को ।
मुनि मन अगम जम नियम सम दम बिषम ब्रत आचरत को ॥
verses.tr:
siya rām prem piyūṣ pūran hot janamu na bharat ko
muni man agam jam niyam sam dam biṣam brat ācarat ko
verses.head: छंद

verses.sa:
दुख दाह दारिद दंभ दूषन सुजस मिस अपहरत को ।
कलिकाल तुलसी से सठन्हि हठि राम सनमुख करत को ॥
verses.tr:
dukh dāh dārid daṃbh dūṣan sujas mis apaharat ko
kalikāl tulasī se saṭhanhi haṭhi rām sanamukh karat ko

verses.sa:
भरत चरित करि नेमु तुलसी जो सादर सुनहिं ।
सीय राम पद पेमु अवसि होइ भव रस बिरति ॥
verses.tr:
bharat carit kari nemu tulasī jo sādar sunahiṃ
sīya rām pad pemu avasi hoi bhav ras birati
verses.head: दोहा

trans: His body quivering with emotion, Sita and Rama in his heart, their names upon his tongue, and with tears in his eyes. Rama, Lakshman and Sita dwelt in the forest, but Bharat dwelling in the palace endured the bodily penance. Every one after considering both sides said that Bharat was in every way praiseworthy. The religious were abashed who heard of his fasting and penance; the king of saints, who saw his condition, was put to shame. Bharat’s mode of life was utterly holy, sweet and charming, and the cause of every blessing; it removes the grievous distress of this sinful age: is the sun to disperse the darkness of the great delusion; the Lion to quell the elephant host of sin: the pacifier of every kind of affliction; the joy of the faithful: the liberator from the burden of existence the essence of the ambrosia of Rama’s love.

If Bharat had never been born, full of the ambrosia of devotion to Rama and Sita who would have practised such self-restraint and penance, such composure, patience and rigorous fasting, transcending every imagination of the ints Whoin legendary disguise would have removed our burning sorrows and poverty, our arrogance and sin? What poor wretch like Tulsi now in this iron age would have ventured to set Rama before you?
All, says Tulsi, who make a vow and listen with reverence to Bharat’s acts shall assuredly acquire a great devotion to the feet of Sita and Rama and a distaste for the pleasure of life.
